      otherProductTrackText: params.otherProductTrackText,
      fulfillmentMode: params.fulfillmentMode,
      activeMinutesPerOrder: params.activeMinutesPerOrder,
      directVariableCostPerOrder: params.directVariableCostPerOrder,
      maxOrdersPerWeekCeiling: params.maxOrdersPerWeekCeiling,
      premisesSetupMode: params.premisesSetupMode,
      monthlyPremisesOverheadCost: params.monthlyPremisesOverheadCost,
      totalEquipmentCapexExVat: params.totalEquipmentCapexExVat,
      supplierRedundancyPosture: params.supplierRedundancyPosture,
      estimatedReturnRatePercent: params.estimatedReturnRatePercent,
      expectedReturnBufferPerOrder: params.expectedReturnBufferPerOrder,
      estimatedAnnualInsurancePremium: params.estimatedAnnualInsurancePremium,
      selectedInsuranceProviderName: params.selectedInsuranceProviderName,
      currentReadinessConfidence: params.currentReadinessConfidence,
      currentBlindSpots: params.currentBlindSpots,
      mode: params.mode,
    });

    setSession((prev) => {
      const updatedSession: BmuLocalSession = {
        ...prev,
        entitlement: {
          ...prev.entitlement,
          aiCreditsUsedThisMonth:
            res.creditsUsedAfter ?? prev.entitlement.aiCreditsUsedThisMonth + 1,
        },
      };
      saveBmuSession(updatedSession);
      return updatedSession;
    });

    return {
      allowed: res.allowed,
      reason: res.reason,
      readinessConfidence: res.readinessConfidence,
      blindSpots: res.blindSpots,
      executiveOperationsSummaryNarrative:
        res.executiveOperationsSummaryNarrative,
      operationsToFinanceAndTeamHandshakeNarrative:
        res.operationsToFinanceAndTeamHandshakeNarrative,
      aiCoachTip: res.aiCoachTip,
      engineMode: res.engineMode,
    };
  }

  async function handleSaveMasterDocumentData(
    masterDocumentData: SavedMasterDocumentData
  ) {
    setSession((prev) => {
      const updatedPlans = prev.plans.map((p) => {
        if (p.id !== currentPlan.id) return p;
        return {
          ...p,
          masterDocumentData: {
            ...masterDocumentData,
            lastSavedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          },
        };
      });
      const updatedSession: BmuLocalSession = {
        ...prev,
        plans: updatedPlans,
      };
      saveBmuSession(updatedSession);
      return updatedSession;
    });

    await saveMasterDocumentDataAction({
      planId: currentPlan.id,
      masterDocumentData,
    });
  }

  async function handleWeaveMasterDocumentStoryWithAi(
    facts: MasterDocumentVerifiedFacts
  ) {
    if (!aiCreditCheck.allowed) {
      setPaywallModalFeature(
        `AI Master Document Story Weaver (${aiCreditCheck.reason})`
      );
      return {
        allowed: false,
        reason: aiCreditCheck.reason,
        story: buildDeterministicMasterStory(facts),
        engineMode: 'smart-synthesizer' as const,
      };
    }

    const res = await weaveMasterDocumentStoryWithAiAction({
      planId: currentPlan.id,
      facts,
    });

    setSession((prev) => {
      const updatedPlans = prev.plans.map((p) => {
        if (p.id !== currentPlan.id) return p;
        return {
          ...p,
          masterDocumentData: {
            ...res.story,
            lastSavedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          },
        };
      });
      const updatedSession: BmuLocalSession = {
        ...prev,
        entitlement: {
          ...prev.entitlement,
          aiCreditsUsedThisMonth:
            res.creditsUsedAfter ?? prev.entitlement.aiCreditsUsedThisMonth + 1,
        },
        plans: updatedPlans,
      };
      saveBmuSession(updatedSession);
      return updatedSession;
    });

    return {
      allowed: res.allowed,
      reason: res.reason,
      story: res.story,
      engineMode: res.engineMode,
    };
  }

  const effectiveCanvas: SavedConceptCanvas = conceptCanvas || {
    coreProblem: '',
    targetCustomer: '',
    proposedSolution: '',
    unfairAdvantage: '',
    revenueAndGrantFit: '',
  };

  // Live-computed 6-card Blind-Spot review that updates immediately as Steps 1-5 change
  const liveThingsToConsider: BlindSpotItem[] = buildDynamicModuleABlindSpots({
    planTitle: currentPlan.title,
    brainDumpText,
    industryCategory: currentPlan.industryCategory,
    hqCountryCode: selectedCountry,
    exportPotential: currentPlan.exportPotential,
    conceptCanvas: effectiveCanvas,
    founderMotivation,
    teamAndBudget,
    founderRealityCheck,
  });

  async function handleTidyUpNotesWithAi() {
    if (!aiCreditCheck.allowed) {
      setPaywallModalFeature(
        `AI Note Tidying (${aiCreditCheck.reason})`
      );
      return;
    }

    setIsSynthesizing(true);
    setSynthesisBanner(null);

    try {
      const result = await generateModuleAConceptCanvasAction({
        userId: session.user.id,
        planId: currentPlan.id,
        planTitle: currentPlan.title,
        brainDumpText,
        industryCategory: currentPlan.industryCategory,
        hqCountryCode: selectedCountry,
        exportPotential: currentPlan.exportPotential,
        draftCanvas: effectiveCanvas,
        founderMotivation,
        teamAndBudget,
        founderRealityCheck,
      });

      setConceptCanvas(result.canvas);
      setThingsToConsider(result.thingsToConsider);

      // Update local session store as well
      const updatedPlans = session.plans.map((p) =>
        p.id === currentPlan.id
          ? {
              ...p,
              brainDumpText,
              conceptCanvas: result.canvas,
              founderMotivation,
              teamAndBudget,
              founderRealityCheck,
              thingsToConsider: result.thingsToConsider,
            }
          : p
      );
      const updatedSession: BmuLocalSession = {
        ...session,
        entitlement: {
          ...session.entitlement,
          aiCreditsUsedThisMonth:
            result.creditsUsedAfter ??
            session.entitlement.aiCreditsUsedThisMonth + 1,
        },
        plans: updatedPlans,
      };
      setSession(updatedSession);
      saveBmuSession(updatedSession);

      setSynthesisBanner('✨ Your notes have been tidied up and saved!');
    } finally {
      setIsSynthesizing(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleSaveCanvasEdits(
    overrideGrantCheck?: SavedGrantEligibilityCheck | React.MouseEvent,
    options?: { silent?: boolean }
  ) {
    if (activeEntitlement.isVaultReadonly) return;
    setIsSavingCanvas(true);
    setGlobalSaveStatus('saving');
    if (!options?.silent) {
      setSynthesisBanner(null);
    }
    try {
      const toSave = effectiveCanvas;
      const validOverride =
        overrideGrantCheck &&
        typeof overrideGrantCheck === 'object' &&
        'legalEntityStage' in overrideGrantCheck
          ? (overrideGrantCheck as SavedGrantEligibilityCheck)
          : undefined;
      const grantCheckToSave: SavedGrantEligibilityCheck = validOverride
        ? {
            ...validOverride,
            lastCheckedAt:
              validOverride.lastCheckedAt || new Date().toISOString(),
          }
        : grantEligibilityCheck;
      await saveModuleACanvasEditsAction({
        planId: currentPlan.id,
        brainDumpText,
        exportPotential: currentPlan.exportPotential,
        canvas: toSave,
        founderMotivation,
        teamAndBudget,
        founderRealityCheck,
        grantEligibilityCheck: grantCheckToSave,
        thingsToConsider: liveThingsToConsider,
      });
      setConceptCanvas(toSave);
      setGrantEligibilityCheck(grantCheckToSave);
      setThingsToConsider(liveThingsToConsider);
      setIsEditingCanvas(false);

      const updatedPlans = session.plans.map((p) =>
        p.id === currentPlan.id
          ? {
              ...p,
              brainDumpText,
              conceptCanvas: toSave,
              founderMotivation,
              teamAndBudget,
              founderRealityCheck,
              grantEligibilityCheck: grantCheckToSave,
              thingsToConsider: liveThingsToConsider,
            }
          : p
      );
      const updatedSession = { ...session, plans: updatedPlans };
      setSession(updatedSession);
      saveBmuSession(updatedSession);

      setGlobalSaveStatus('saved');
      setGlobalLastSavedAt(new Date());

      if (!options?.silent) {
        setSynthesisBanner(
          validOverride
            ? '✅ Your Grant Eligibility Check answers have been saved!'
            : '✅ Your notes and Step 6 Blind-Spot Review have been updated and saved!'
        );
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to autosave Module A canvas edits:', err);
      setGlobalSaveStatus('error');
    } finally {
      setIsSavingCanvas(false);
    }
  }

  // Module A Automatic Background Autosave (1200ms debounce on keystroke/edits)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isModuleAFirstRenderRef.current) {
      isModuleAFirstRenderRef.current = false;
      return;
    }
    if (activeEntitlement.isVaultReadonly) return;
    if (activeModule !== 'MOD_A_IDEATION') return;

    isModuleADirtyRef.current = true;
    setGlobalSaveStatus('saving');

    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (isModuleADirtyRef.current) {
        isModuleADirtyRef.current = false;
        void handleSaveCanvasEdits(undefined, { silent: true });
      }
    }, 1200);

    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [
    brainDumpText,
    conceptCanvas,
    founderMotivation,
    teamAndBudget,
    founderRealityCheck,
    grantEligibilityCheck,
    activeModule,
    activeEntitlement.isVaultReadonly,
  ]);

  // Window exit guard if save is actively in flight
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleBeforeUnload = (e: BeforeUnloadEvent) => {
      if (globalSaveStatus === 'saving' || isModuleADirtyRef.current) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.returnValue = '';
        return '';
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', handleBeforeUnload);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', handleBeforeUnload);
    };
  }, [globalSaveStatus]);

  async function handleRunAiGrantPositioning(
    overrideGrantCheck?: SavedGrantEligibilityCheck
  ) {
    const activeCheck = overrideGrantCheck || grantEligibilityCheck;
    if (!aiCreditCheck.allowed) {
      setPaywallModalFeature(
        `AI Grant Positioning Advisor (${aiCreditCheck.reason})`
      );
      return;
    }

    setIsRunningGrantAdvisor(true);
    setSynthesisBanner(null);
    try {
      const res = await generateModuleAGrantPositioningAdviceAction({
        userId: session.user.id,
        planId: currentPlan.id,
        planTitle: currentPlan.title,
        hqCountryCode: selectedCountry,
        industryCategory: currentPlan.industryCategory,
        exportPotential: currentPlan.exportPotential,
        brainDumpText,
        canvas: effectiveCanvas,
        founderMotivation,
        teamAndBudget,
        founderRealityCheck,
        grantCheck: activeCheck,
      });

      const updatedGrantCheck: SavedGrantEligibilityCheck = {
        ...activeCheck,
        aiGrantPositioningAdvice: res.positioningTips,
        aiEngineUsed: res.engineMode,
        lastCheckedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
      const updatedCanvas: SavedConceptCanvas = {
        ...effectiveCanvas,
        revenueAndGrantFit: res.updatedRevenueAndGrantFit,
      };

      setGrantEligibilityCheck(updatedGrantCheck);
      setConceptCanvas(updatedCanvas);

      const updatedPlans = session.plans.map((p) =>
        p.id === currentPlan.id
          ? {
              ...p,
              conceptCanvas: updatedCanvas,
              grantEligibilityCheck: updatedGrantCheck,
            }
          : p
      );
      const updatedSession: BmuLocalSession = {
        ...session,
        entitlement: {
          ...session.entitlement,
          aiCreditsUsedThisMonth:
            res.creditsUsedAfter ?? session.entitlement.aiCreditsUsedThisMonth + 1,
        },
        plans: updatedPlans,
      };
      setSession(updatedSession);
      saveBmuSession(updatedSession);

      setSynthesisBanner(
        '🎯 Revealed your qualified grants, AI Grant Positioning Strategy, and synced Box 5 (Revenue & Grant Fit)!'
      );
    } finally {
      setIsRunningGrantAdvisor(false);
    }
  }

                                      ? {

                                          hqCountryCode: reg.code,
                                          baseCurrency: nextRule.defaultCurrency,
                                          fundingTrackMode: nextTrackMode,
                                        }
                                      : pl
                                  ),
                                };
                                saveBmuSession(next);
                                return next;
                              });
                            }}

                              isSelectedCountry
                                ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                                : 'border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-700 hover:border-indigo-300'
                            }`}
                          >
                            {reg.flag} {reg.label}
                          </button>

                                  pl.id === currentPlan.id
                                    ? { ...pl, fundingTrackMode: 'GRANT_AND_INVESTOR' as const }

                                ),
                              };
                              saveBmuSession(next);
                              return next;

                                          {!access.allowed ? (

                        Step 6: Blind-Spot Review (&ldquo;Things to Consider&rdquo;)
                      </h2>
                      {moduleAReadinessSteps[5]?.isComplete ? (
                        <Badge variant="success" className="shrink-0 text-[10px]">
                          Completed
                        </Badge>
                      ) : (
                        <Badge variant="outline" className="shrink-0 text-[10px] text-slate-600">
                          In Progress
                        </Badge>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-xs text-slate-500">
                      {moduleAReadinessSteps[5]?.summary}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0 ml-3">
                  <Button
                    size="sm"
                    variant="ghost"
                    className="h-8 shrink-0 px-2.5 text-xs font-medium text-indigo-600 group-hover:bg-indigo-50"
                  >
                    <span>Edit Step</span>
                    <ChevronDown className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div
              id="mod-a-step-6"
              className="scroll-mt-24 rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-xs"
            >
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 border-b border-slate-100 pb-4">
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <span
                      className={`flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-xs font-bold ${
                        moduleAReadinessSteps[5]?.isComplete
                          ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                          : 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {moduleAReadinessSteps[5]?.isComplete ? (
                        <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      ) : (
                        '6'
                      )}
                    </span>
                    <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
                      Step 6: Blind-Spot Review (&ldquo;Things to Consider&rdquo;)
                    </h2>
                    <Badge variant="default" className="shrink-0">Co-Founder Perspective</Badge>
                  </div>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-600">
                    Live co-founder check combining your idea, budget, and worry into constructive advice.
                  </p>
                </div>

                {openStep !== 'ALL' && (
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    size="sm"
                    variant="ghost"
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      setOpenStep(0);
                    }}
                    className="h-8 shrink-0 text-xs text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900"
                  >
                    <span>Collapse Step</span>
                    <ChevronUp className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="mt-5 space-y-5">
                {liveThingsToConsider.map((item, idx) => (
                  <div
                    key={item.id || idx}
                    className={`flex flex-col justify-between rounded-xl border p-4 shadow-2xs transition-all ${
                      item.severity === 'WARNING'
                        ? 'border-amber-300 bg-amber-50/40'
                        : 'border-slate-200/90 bg-white'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                        <span
                          className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-md px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide ${
                            item.severity === 'WARNING'
                              ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-900'
                              : 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-800'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {item.severity === 'WARNING'
                            ? '⚠️ Priority Blind Spot'
                            : '💡 Co-Founder Check'}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
                        {item.title}
                      </div>
                      <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs leading-relaxed text-slate-600">
                        {item.explanation}
                      </p>
                      {item.suggestedAction && (
                        <div className="mt-2.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 p-2 text-[11px] text-indigo-900 ring-1 ring-slate-200/70">
                          <strong>Action Step:</strong> {item.suggestedAction}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

              {/* Step 6 Bottom Save & AI Tidy Bar */}
              {!activeEntitlement.isVaultReadonly && (
                <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-indigo-100 bg-white/90 px-4 py-3">
                  <div className="text-xs text-slate-600">
                    ✨ Change any option or add notes in Steps 1–5 above and watch these cards adapt immediately.
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      variant="outline"
                      disabled={isSynthesizing}
                      onClick={handleTidyUpNotesWithAi}
                    >
                      {isSynthesizing ? (
                        <>
                          <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                          Tidying...
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          <Wand2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-600" />
                          AI Tidy Up All Notes
                        </>
                      )}
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      disabled={isSavingCanvas}
                      onClick={handleSaveCanvasEdits}
                      className="bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-700"
                    >
                      {isSavingCanvas ? (
                        <>
                          <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                          Saving Module A...
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          <Save className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                          Save All Module A Progress
                        </>
                      )}
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={() => {
                        setOpenStep(7);
                        setTimeout(() => {
                          const el = document.getElementById('mod-a-step-7');
                          if (el)
                            el.scrollIntoView({
                              behavior: 'smooth',
                              block: 'start',
                            });
                        }, 40);
                      }}
                      className="bg-emerald-600 text-white hover:bg-emerald-700"
                    >
                      {isGrantCheckerSupported
                        ? 'Next: Step 7 — Check Grant Eligibility'
                        : 'View Startup Overview & Summary'}
                      <ArrowRight className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ========================================================= */}
          {/* STEP 7: INSTANT GRANT & FUNDING ELIGIBILITY CHECKER       */}
          {/* (Only visible for supported regions: IE & GB)             */}
          {/* ========================================================= */}
          {isGrantCheckerSupported && (
            <ModuleAGrantCheckerStep
              isOpen={openStep === 'ALL' || openStep === 7}
              isAllExpanded={openStep === 'ALL'}
              onExpandStep={() => setOpenStep(7)}
              onCollapseStep={() => setOpenStep(6)}
              hqCountryCode={selectedCountry}
              planTitle={currentPlan.title}
              industryCategory={currentPlan.industryCategory}
              exportPotential={currentPlan.exportPotential}
              brainDumpText={brainDumpText}
              conceptCanvas={effectiveCanvas}
              founderMotivation={founderMotivation}
              teamAndBudget={teamAndBudget}
              founderRealityCheck={founderRealityCheck}
              grantCheck={grantEligibilityCheck}
              onChangeGrantCheck={(next) => setGrantEligibilityCheck(next)}
              onSaveGrantCheck={handleSaveCanvasEdits}
              isSaving={isSavingCanvas}
              onRunAiGrantPositioning={handleRunAiGrantPositioning}
              isRunningAiAdvisor={isRunningGrantAdvisor}
              onParkOpenQuestion={handleParkSpecificQuestion}
              onContinueToBrief={() => {
                setOpenStep(8);
                setTimeout(() => {
                  const el = document.getElementById('mod-a-step-8');
                  if (el) {
                    el.scrollIntoView({
                      behavior: 'smooth',
                      block: 'start',
                    });
                  }
                }, 40);
              }}
              onContinueToModuleB={() => {
                const modBAccess = canAccessModule(
                  activeEntitlement,
                  'MOD_B_MARKET'
                );
                if (!modBAccess.allowed) {
                  setPendingModuleAfterUnlock('MOD_B_MARKET');
                  setPaywallModalFeature(
                    `Module B: Market Sizing, Competitor Scout & Buyer Persona (${modBAccess.reason})`
                  );
                  return;
                }
                navigateToModuleWithHistory('MOD_B_MARKET');
              }}
              onOpenModuleJGrantsHub={() => {
                const modKAccess = canAccessModule(
                  activeEntitlement,
                  'MOD_K_GRANTS_FUNDING'
                );
                if (!modKAccess.allowed) {
                  setPendingModuleAfterUnlock('MOD_K_GRANTS_FUNDING');
                  setPaywallModalFeature(
                    `Module K: Full Non-Dilutive Grants, Loans & Tax Relief Hub (${modKAccess.reason})`
                  );
                  return;
                }
                setActiveModule('MOD_K_GRANTS_FUNDING');
                window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
              }}
              isVaultReadonly={activeEntitlement.isVaultReadonly}
            />
          )}

          {/* ========================================================= */}
          {/* STARTUP OVERVIEW & SUMMARY BRIEF (LIVE DOCUMENT)          */}
          {/* ========================================================= */}
          {openStep !== 'ALL' && openStep !== briefStepNumber ? (
            <div
              id={briefStepId}
              onClick={() => setOpenStep(briefStepNumber)}
              className="group scroll-mt-24 cursor-pointer rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 bg-gradient-to-r from-white via-indigo-50/40 to-violet-50/40 p-4 shadow-xs transition-all hover:border-indigo-300 hover:shadow-sm"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <span
                    className={`flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-xs font-bold ${
                      completedReadinessCount === totalReadinessStepsCount
                        ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                        : 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <FileText className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  </span>
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                      <h2 className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 group-hover:text-indigo-600">
                        Startup Overview &amp; Summary Brief
                      </h2>
                      {completedReadinessCount === totalReadinessStepsCount ? (
                        <Badge variant="success" className="shrink-0 text-[10px]">
                          Ready to Export
                        </Badge>
                      ) : (
                        <Badge variant="outline" className="shrink-0 text-[10px] text-slate-600">
                          {completedReadinessCount}/{totalReadinessStepsCount} Sections Ready
                        </Badge>
                      )}
                      {isGrantCheckerSupported && liveGrantEvaluation && (
                        <Badge variant="success" className="shrink-0 text-[10px]">
                          Includes {liveGrantEvaluation.qualifiesNowGrants.length} Qualified Grants ({liveGrantEvaluation.immediateQualifiedPoolFormatted})
                        </Badge>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-xs text-slate-500">
                      Your complete Module A startup summary &amp; grant eligibility brief — ready to view, print to PDF, or share before starting Module B.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0 ml-3">
                  <Button
                    size="sm"
                    variant="ghost"
                    className="h-8 shrink-0 px-2.5 text-xs font-medium text-indigo-600 group-hover:bg-indigo-50"
                  >
                    <span>Open Overview</span>
                    <ChevronDown className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div
              id={briefStepId}
              className="scroll-mt-24 rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-xs"
            >
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 border-b border-slate-100 pb-4">
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <span
                      className={`flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-xs font-bold ${
                        completedReadinessCount === totalReadinessStepsCount
                          ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                          : 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <FileText className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    </span>
                    <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
                      Startup Overview &amp; Summary Brief
                    </h2>
                    <Badge
                      variant={
                        completedReadinessCount === totalReadinessStepsCount
                          ? 'success'
                          : 'secondary'
                      }
                      className="shrink-0 text-[10px]"
                    >
                      {completedReadinessCount}/{totalReadinessStepsCount} Sections Ready
                    </Badge>
                  </div>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-600">
                    A live 1-page summary of your startup concept, founder profile, blind-spot review, and qualified grants — ready to download, print to PDF, or share with an advisor or co-founder.
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    variant="outline"
                    size="sm"
                    onClick={() => setShowBriefPreview(!showBriefPreview)}
                    className="h-8 shrink-0 border-indigo-200 text-xs text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-50"
                  >
                    <Eye className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    {showBriefPreview
                      ? 'Hide Document Preview'
                      : 'Show Document Preview'}
                  </Button>
                  {openStep !== 'ALL' && (
                    <Button
                      type="button"
                      size="sm"
                      variant="ghost"
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        setOpenStep(0);
                      }}
                      className="h-8 shrink-0 text-xs text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900"
                    >
                      <span>Collapse Overview</span>
                      <ChevronUp className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    </Button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-5 space-y-5">
              {/* OPTION C: MODULE A READINESS CHECKLIST */}
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-indigo-100 bg-white p-4 shadow-2xs">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700">
                    Module A Readiness Checklist (Steps 1–{totalReadinessStepsCount} Included in Your Brief)
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-700">
                    Live-Synced with Your Answers Above
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-1 gap-2.5 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
                  {moduleAReadinessSteps.map((step) => (
                    <div
                      key={step.stepNumber}
                      className={`flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl border p-3 text-xs transition-all ${
                        step.isComplete
                          ? 'border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50/40'
                          : 'border-amber-200 bg-amber-50/40'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <CheckCircle2
                        className={`mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 ${
                          step.isComplete
                            ? 'text-emerald-600'
                            : 'text-amber-500'
                        }`}
                      />
                      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                        <div className="font-bold text-slate-900">
                          Step {step.stepNumber}: {step.label}
                        </div>
                        <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-[11px] text-slate-600">
                          {step.summary}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* OPTION A: LIVE EXECUTIVE BRIEF DOCUMENT PREVIEW */}
              {showBriefPreview && (
                <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm">
                  {/* Document Header Banner */}
                  <div className="border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-900 px-6 py-5 text-white">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                      <span className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-indigo-300">
                        {activeEntitlement.whiteLabelExportEnabled
                          ? 'Startup Concept & Readiness Brief'
                          : 'Startup Preflight • Startup Concept & Readiness Brief'}
                      </span>
                      <span className="rounded-full bg-white/10 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-200">
                        {countryPack.countryName} ({countryPack.defaultCurrency})
                        • {currentPlan.industryCategory}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <h2 className="mt-1.5 text-lg font-bold text-white">
                      {currentPlan.title}
                    </h2>
                    <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-slate-300">
                      Prepared by {session.user.name} • {briefGeneratedDate}
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  {/* Document Body Sections */}
                  <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100 p-6 text-xs">
                    {/* Section 1: Raw Idea & 1-Page Concept Canvas */}
                    <div className="pb-5">
                      <div className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-600">
                        1. Core Concept &amp; 1-Page Canvas (Steps 1 &amp; 2)
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-3.5 text-slate-700 ring-1 ring-slate-200/70">
                        <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">
                          Founder&apos;s Raw Idea:{' '}
                        </span>
                        &ldquo;{brainDumpText}&rdquo;
                      </div>

                      <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
                        <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-3">
                          <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
                            Problem Worth Solving
                          </div>
                          <p className="mt-1 leading-relaxed text-slate-800">
                            {effectiveCanvas.coreProblem}
                          </p>
                        </div>
                        <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-3">
                          <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
                            Target Customer Segment
                          </div>
                          <p className="mt-1 leading-relaxed text-slate-800">
                            {effectiveCanvas.targetCustomer}
                          </p>
                        </div>
                        <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-3">
                          <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
                            Proposed Solution &amp; MVP
                          </div>
                          <p className="mt-1 leading-relaxed text-slate-800">
                            {effectiveCanvas.proposedSolution}
                          </p>
                        </div>
                        <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-3">
                          <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
                            Unfair Advantage &amp; Revenue/Grant Fit
                          </div>
                          <p className="mt-1 leading-relaxed text-slate-800">
                            {effectiveCanvas.unfairAdvantage}
                            {effectiveCanvas.revenueAndGrantFit
                              ? ` • ${effectiveCanvas.revenueAndGrantFit}`
                              : ''}
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Section 2: Founder Ambition, Team & Starting Budget */}
                    <div className="py-5">
                      <div className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-600">
                        2. Founder Ambition, Team &amp; Starting Budget (Steps 3
                        &amp; 4)
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-2.5 grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
                        <div className="rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-3 ring-1 ring-slate-200/70">
                          <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-slate-400">
                            Primary Motivation
                          </div>
                          <div className="mt-1 font-semibold text-slate-900">
                            {founderMotivation.primaryMotivation === 'OTHER' &&
                            founderMotivation.otherMotivationText?.trim()
                              ? `✨ Other: ${founderMotivation.otherMotivationText.trim()}`
                              : MOTIVATION_LABELS[
                                  founderMotivation.primaryMotivation
                                ]}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-3 ring-1 ring-slate-200/70">
                          <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-slate-400">
                            Weekly Bandwidth
                          </div>
                          <div className="mt-1 font-semibold text-slate-900">
                            {founderMotivation.weeklyHoursAvailable ===
                              'OTHER' &&
                            founderMotivation.otherWeeklyHoursText?.trim()
                              ? `✨ Other: ${founderMotivation.otherWeeklyHoursText.trim()}`
                              : WEEKLY_HOURS_LABELS[
                                  founderMotivation.weeklyHoursAvailable
                                ]}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-3 ring-1 ring-slate-200/70">
                          <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-slate-400">
                            Team &amp; Version 1 Skills
                          </div>
                          <div className="mt-1 font-semibold text-slate-900">
                            {teamAndBudget.teamStructureType === 'OTHER' &&
                            teamAndBudget.otherTeamStructureText?.trim()
                              ? `✨ Other: ${teamAndBudget.otherTeamStructureText.trim()}`
                              : TEAM_STRUCTURE_LABELS[
                                  teamAndBudget.teamStructureType
                                ]}
                          </div>
                          <div className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-slate-600">
                            {teamAndBudget.skillCoverage === 'OTHER' &&
                            teamAndBudget.otherSkillCoverageText?.trim()
                              ? `✨ Other: ${teamAndBudget.otherSkillCoverageText.trim()}`
                              : SKILL_COVERAGE_LABELS[
                                  teamAndBudget.skillCoverage
                                ]}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-3 ring-1 ring-slate-200/70">
                          <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-slate-400">
                            Starting Cash Budget
                          </div>
                          <div className="mt-1 font-semibold text-emerald-800">
                            {formatStartingBudgetBracket(
                              teamAndBudget.startingBudgetBracket,
                              countryPack.defaultCurrency,
                              teamAndBudget.otherBudgetText
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {(founderMotivation.twelveMonthSuccessVision.trim() ||
                        teamAndBudget.teamAndFundingNotes.trim()) && (
                        <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
                          {founderMotivation.twelveMonthSuccessVision.trim() && (
                            <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-3">
                              <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">
                                12-Month Success Vision:{' '}
                              </span>
                              <span className="text-slate-700">
                                {founderMotivation.twelveMonthSuccessVision}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          )}
                          {teamAndBudget.teamAndFundingNotes.trim() && (
                            <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-3">
                              <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">
                                Team &amp; Budget Notes:{' '}
                              </span>
                              <span className="text-slate-700">
                                {teamAndBudget.teamAndFundingNotes}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {/* Section 3: Reality Check & Non-Negotiables */}
                    <div className="py-5">
                      <div className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-600">
                        3. Founder Fit, Dealbreakers &amp; Reality Check (Step
                        5)
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-2.5 grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 md:grid-cols-3">
                        <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-3">
                          <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-slate-400">
                            Industry Access
                          </div>
                          <div className="mt-1 font-medium text-slate-800">
                            {founderRealityCheck.industryConnection ===
                              'OTHER' &&
                            founderRealityCheck.otherIndustryConnectionText?.trim()
                              ? `✨ Other: ${founderRealityCheck.otherIndustryConnectionText.trim()}`
                              : INDUSTRY_CONNECTION_LABELS[
                                  founderRealityCheck.industryConnection
                                ]}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-3">
                          <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-slate-400">
                            Personal Income Timeline
                          </div>
                          <div className="mt-1 font-medium text-slate-800">
                            {founderRealityCheck.personalIncomeUrgency ===
                              'OTHER' &&
                            founderRealityCheck.otherIncomeUrgencyText?.trim()
                              ? `✨ Other: ${founderRealityCheck.otherIncomeUrgencyText.trim()}`
                              : INCOME_URGENCY_LABELS[
                                  founderRealityCheck.personalIncomeUrgency
                                ]}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-3">
                          <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-slate-400">
                            Control vs. Speed Trade-Off

                    ? 'Stack an additional AppSumo code to unlock more Startup Plans, team seats, and AI credits.'
                    : 'Already have a university, accelerator, or partner voucher code?'}
                </p>
                <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Link href="/redeem" className="flex-1">
                    <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="w-full text-xs text-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-50">
                      Redeem Voucher Code →
                    </Button>
                  </Link>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-5 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-slate-100 pt-3">
              <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                Encrypted via Stripe 256-bit SSL
              </span>
              <Button
                variant="ghost"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => setPaywallModalFeature(null)}
                className="text-xs text-slate-500"
              >
                Close
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ========================================================= */}
      {/* DELETE PLAN CONFIRMATION MODAL                            */}
      {/* ========================================================= */}
      {planToDelete && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-900/60 p-4 backdrop-blur-xs no-print print:hidden">
          <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-2xl">
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <div className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-red-100 text-red-600">
                  <Trash2 className="h-5 w-5" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
                    Delete Startup Plan?
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                    This action will permanently remove this plan and its module data.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={isDeletingPlan}
                onClick={() => {
                  setPlanToDelete(null);
                  setDeletePlanError(null);
                }}
                className="rounded-lg p-1 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100 disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                <X className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-red-100 bg-red-50/70 p-3.5 text-xs text-red-950">
              <p className="font-semibold text-red-900">
                Are you sure you want to delete &ldquo;{planToDelete.title}&rdquo;?
              </p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-red-700">
                All associated ideation canvas, customer surveys, financial models, and research in this plan will be permanently deleted.
              </p>
            </div>

            {deletePlanError && (
              <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 p-3 text-xs text-rose-800">
                {deletePlanError}
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="mt-5 flex items-center justify-end gap-2.5 border-t border-slate-100 pt-3">
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                disabled={isDeletingPlan}
                onClick={() => {
                  setPlanToDelete(null);
                  setDeletePlanError(null);
                }}
                className="text-xs"
              >
                Cancel
              </Button>
              <Button
                type="button"
                size="sm"
                disabled={isDeletingPlan}
                onClick={handleConfirmDeletePlan}
                className="bg-red-600 text-xs font-semibold text-white hover:bg-red-700 shadow-xs"
              >
                {isDeletingPlan ? (
                  <>
                    <Loader2 className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                    Deleting...
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Trash2 className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    Delete Plan
                  </>
                )}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ========================================================= */}
      {/* HOW TO USE / PREFLIGHT FIELD GUIDE MODAL                  */}
      {/* ========================================================= */}
      <PreflightGuideModal
        isOpen={isGuideOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsGuideOpen(false)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import {
  ArrowLeft,
  User,
  CreditCard,
  AlertTriangle,
  CheckCircle2,
  Lock,
  Download,
  Trash2,
  ExternalLink,
  Shield,
  Sparkles,
  RefreshCw,
  Bell,
  Globe2,
  FileText,
  AlertCircle,
  HelpCircle,
  KeyRound,
  Check,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { GlobalFeedbackButton } from '@/components/feedback/global-feedback-dialog';
import {
  Card,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
  CardDescription,
  CardContent,
} from '@/components/ui/card';
import {
  getAccountDetailsAction,
  updateFounderProfileAction,
  updateFounderPasswordAction,
  createStripeCustomerPortalAction,
  cancelMicroSubscriptionAction,
  exportCompleteFounderDataArchive,
  softDeleteFounderAccountAction,
  type AccountProfileData,
} from '@/app/actions/account';
import { logoutFounderAction } from '@/app/actions/auth';
import {
  getPlanTypeDisplayName,
  getPlanTypeBadgeProps,
} from '@/lib/entitlements';
import type { SupportedCountryCode } from '@/lib/localization';
import type { StartupHat } from '@/db/schema';

type ActiveTab = 'profile' | 'billing' | 'danger';

export default function AccountPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<ActiveTab>('profile');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState<AccountProfileData | null>(null);

  // Profile Form State
  const [fullName, setFullName] = useState('');
  const [primaryHat, setPrimaryHat] = useState<StartupHat>('VISION_INVESTOR');
  const [defaultCountry, setDefaultCountry] = useState<SupportedCountryCode>('IE');
  const [regionOrCounty, setRegionOrCounty] = useState('');
  const [notifySurvey, setNotifySurvey] = useState(true);
  const [notifyGrants, setNotifyGrants] = useState(true);
  const [savingProfile, setSavingProfile] = useState(false);
  const [profileMessage, setProfileMessage] = useState<{
    type: 'success' | 'error';
    text: string;
  } | null>(null);

  // Password Form State
  const [currentPassword, setCurrentPassword] = useState('');
  const [newPassword, setNewPassword] = useState('');
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState('');
  const [updatingPassword, setUpdatingPassword] = useState(false);
  const [passwordMessage, setPasswordMessage] = useState<{
    type: 'success' | 'error';
    text: string;
  } | null>(null);

  // Billing State
  const [launchingPortal, setLaunchingPortal] = useState(false);
  const [cancellingSub, setCancellingSub] = useState(false);
  const [billingMessage, setBillingMessage] = useState<{
    type: 'success' | 'error';
    text: string;
  } | null>(null);

  // Export Data State
  const [exportingData, setExportingData] = useState(false);

  // Danger Zone Deletion State
  const [deleteConfirmationPhrase, setDeleteConfirmationPhrase] = useState('');
  const [deletePassword, setDeletePassword] = useState('');
  const [deletingAccount, setDeletingAccount] = useState(false);
  const [deleteError, setDeleteError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadAccountData();
  }, []);

  const loadAccountData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    const res = await getAccountDetailsAction();
    if (res.ok && res.profile) {
      setProfile(res.profile);
      setFullName(res.profile.name || '');
      setPrimaryHat(res.profile.founderProfile.primaryHat || 'VISION_INVESTOR');
      setDefaultCountry(res.profile.founderProfile.defaultCountryCode || 'IE');
      setRegionOrCounty(res.profile.founderProfile.regionOrCounty || '');
      setNotifySurvey(res.profile.founderProfile.notifyOnSurveyResponse ?? true);
      setNotifyGrants(res.profile.founderProfile.notifyOnGrantDeadlines ?? true);
    } else {
      router.push('/login');
    }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  const handleSaveProfile = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSavingProfile(true);
    setProfileMessage(null);

    const res = await updateFounderProfileAction({
      name: fullName,
      primaryHat,
      regionOrCounty,
      defaultCountryCode: defaultCountry,
      notifyOnSurveyResponse: notifySurvey,
      notifyOnGrantDeadlines: notifyGrants,
    });

    if (res.ok) {
      setProfileMessage({
        type: 'success',
        text: 'Profile preferences updated successfully.',
      });
      if (profile) {
        setProfile({
          ...profile,
          name: fullName,
          founderProfile: {
            ...profile.founderProfile,
            primaryHat,
            regionOrCounty,
            defaultCountryCode: defaultCountry,
            notifyOnSurveyResponse: notifySurvey,
            notifyOnGrantDeadlines: notifyGrants,
          },
        });
      }
    } else {
      setProfileMessage({
        type: 'error',
        text: res.error || 'Failed to update profile.',
      });
    }
    setSavingProfile(false);
  };

  const handleUpdatePassword = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setUpdatingPassword(true);
    setPasswordMessage(null);

    const res = await updateFounderPasswordAction({
      currentPassword,
      newPassword,
      confirmPassword,
    });

    if (res.ok) {
      setPasswordMessage({
        type: 'success',
        text: 'Your password has been changed securely.',
      });
      setCurrentPassword('');
      setNewPassword('');
      setConfirmPassword('');
    } else {
      setPasswordMessage({
        type: 'error',
        text: res.error || 'Failed to update password.',
      });
    }
    setUpdatingPassword(false);
  };

  const handleLaunchStripePortal = async () => {
    setLaunchingPortal(true);
    setBillingMessage(null);
    const res = await createStripeCustomerPortalAction();
    if (res.ok && res.portalUrl) {
      window.location.href = res.portalUrl;
    } else {
      setBillingMessage({
        type: 'error',
        text: res.error || 'Could not open billing portal. Please try again.',
      });
      setLaunchingPortal(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCancelSubscription = async () => {
    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      'Are you sure you want to cancel subscription auto-renewal?\n\nYour workspace will switch to Read-Only Vault mode at the end of the current period. Your startup plans and data will remain safe and exportable.'
    );
    if (!confirmed) return;

    setCancellingSub(true);
    setBillingMessage(null);

    const res = await cancelMicroSubscriptionAction();
    if (res.ok) {
      setBillingMessage({
        type: 'success',
        text: res.message || 'Subscription renewal cancelled.',
      });
      loadAccountData();
    } else {
      setBillingMessage({
        type: 'error',
        text: res.error || 'Failed to cancel subscription renewal.',
      });
    }
    setCancellingSub(false);
  };

  const handleExportData = async () => {
    setExportingData(true);
    try {
      const res = await exportCompleteFounderDataArchive();
      if (res.ok && res.exportData) {
        const dataStr =
          'data:text/json;charset=utf-8,' +
          encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(res.exportData, null, 2));
        const downloadAnchor = document.createElement('a');
        downloadAnchor.setAttribute('href', dataStr);
        downloadAnchor.setAttribute(
          'download',
          `startup-preflight-archive-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.json`
        );
        document.body.appendChild(downloadAnchor);
        downloadAnchor.click();
        downloadAnchor.remove();
      } else {
        alert(res.error || 'Failed to export data archive.');
      }
    } catch {
      alert('Network error while exporting data archive.');
    } finally {
      setExportingData(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteAccount = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setDeleteError(null);

    if (deleteConfirmationPhrase.trim().toUpperCase() !== 'DELETE MY ACCOUNT') {
      setDeleteError('Please type "DELETE MY ACCOUNT" exactly to confirm.');
      return;
    }

    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      'FINAL CONFIRMATION: Are you sure you want to deactivate your account?\n\n• Your startup plans will be archived.\n• Your live public surveys will be taken offline.\n• You will have 30 days to restore your account before permanent deletion.'
    );
    if (!confirmed) return;

    setDeletingAccount(true);

    const res = await softDeleteFounderAccountAction({
      confirmationPhrase: deleteConfirmationPhrase,
      passwordConfirmation: deletePassword,
    });

    if (res.ok) {
      await logoutFounderAction().catch(() => {});
      router.push('/login?account_deactivated=true');
    } else {
      setDeleteError(res.error || 'Failed to deactivate account.');
      setDeletingAccount(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-slate-50">
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3">
          <RefreshCw className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-indigo-600" />
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-600">Loading account settings...</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const entitlement = profile?.entitlement;
  const planType = entitlement?.planType || 'FREE_HOOK';
  const isVaultReadonly = entitlement?.isVaultReadonly ?? false;
  const aiUsed = entitlement?.aiCreditsUsedThisMonth || 0;
  const aiLimit = entitlement?.monthlyAiCreditsLimit || 50;
  const aiPercent = Math.min(100, Math.round((aiUsed / aiLimit) * 100));

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50/70 pb-16">
      {/* Top Navigation Bar */}
      <header className="sticky top-0 z-30 w-full border-b border-slate-200 bg-white/95 px-4 py-3 backdrop-blur-sm sm:px-8">
        <div className="flex w-full items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <Link
              href="/workspace"
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 transition-colors hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900"
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
              <span>Back to Workspace</span>
            </Link>
            <span className="text-slate-300">/</span>
            <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
              Account & Settings
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <GlobalFeedbackButton
              variant="header-pill"
              userEmail={profile?.email}
              userName={profile?.name}
            />
            <span className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 hidden sm:inline">
              {profile?.email}
            </span>
            {(() => {
              const badge = getPlanTypeBadgeProps(planType, isVaultReadonly);
              return (
                <Badge variant="outline" className={badge.className}>
                  {badge.label}
                </Badge>
              );
            })()}
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* Main Content Area */}
      <main className="mx-auto mt-6 max-w-5xl px-4 sm:px-8">

          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">

                </span>

                </CardTitle>

                </CardDescription>

                      />
                      <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                        Account email is locked. Contact support to transfer ownership.
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
                    <div>
                      <Label htmlFor="default-country" className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                        Default Jurisdiction & Currency
                      </Label>
                      <select

                          setDefaultCountry(e.target.value as SupportedCountryCode)

                        <option value="US">🇺🇸 United States (USD $)</option>
                        <option value="EU">🇪🇺 European Union (EUR €)</option>
                        <option value="AU">🇦🇺 Australia (AUD $)</option>
                        <option value="CA">🇨🇦 Canada (CAD $)</option>
                        <option value="ROW">🌐 Rest of World (USD $)</option>
                      </select>
                      <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                        Pre-configures grant checkers, PRSI/NIC payroll, and currency symbols.
                      </p>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <Label htmlFor="region-county" className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">

                      ].map((hat) => {

                                : 'border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-700 hover:border-slate-300'

                          type="checkbox"

                          onChange={(e) => setNotifySurvey(e.target.checked)}
                          className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 rounded border-slate-300 text-indigo-600 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                        />
                        <div>
                          <div className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-800">
                            Public Survey & Waitlist Response Alerts
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                            Receive an email alert whenever someone completes your hosted Module C customer survey.
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </label>

                      <label className="flex items-start gap-3 cursor-pointer">
                        <input

                          </div>

                  Ensure your account is protected with a secure password (minimum 8 characters).
                </CardDescription>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="pt-6">
                {passwordMessage && (
                  <div
                    className={`mb-4 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl p-3.5 text-xs font-medium ${

                        ? 'border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800'
                        : 'border border-red-200 bg-red-50 text-red-800'
                    }`}

                    {passwordMessage.type === 'success' ? (

                      <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-red-600" />

                    <span>{passwordMessage.text}</span>

                <form onSubmit={handleUpdatePassword} className="space-y-4 max-w-lg">

                      Current Password
                    </Label>
                    <Input
                      id="current-pw"
                      type="password"
                      value={currentPassword}
                      onChange={(e) => setCurrentPassword(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="••••••••"
                      className="mt-1.5 text-base sm:text-xs"
                      required
                    />
                  </div>

                      </Label>

                        type="password"
                        value={confirmPassword}

                        minLength={8}

                      type="submit"

        )}

                ) : (
                  <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-red-600" />

            )}

            {/* Active Subscription & Entitlement Hero */}
            <Card className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-xs">

                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <Label htmlFor="delete-pw" className="text-xs font-bold text-red-950">

                      </Label>

                            <Trash2 className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />

                          </>
                        )}
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </form>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

import type { MetadataRoute } from 'next';

export default function robots(): MetadataRoute.Robots {
  return {
    rules: [
      {
        userAgent: '*',
        allow: [
          '/',
          '/ie',
          '/uk',
          '/grants',
          '/grants/',
          '/about-founder',
          '/cohorts',
          '/pricing',
          '/register',
          '/login',
          '/redeem',
          '/appsumo',
          '/privacy',
          '/terms',
          '/v/',
        ],
        disallow: ['/admin/', '/api/', '/workspace/', '/account/'],
      },
    ],
    sitemap: 'https://startuppreflight.com/sitemap.xml',
  };
}

'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  FileText,
  Upload,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertCircle,
  Building2,
  Calendar,
  Layers,
  Euro,
  ExternalLink,
  ShieldCheck,
  Check,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import {
  getQuoteRfpByTokenAction,
  submitQuoteResponseAction,
} from '@/app/actions/quote-concierge';

export default function QuoteSubmitPortalPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ token: string }>;
}) {
  const [token, setToken] = useState<string>('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [data, setData] = useState<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getQuoteRfpByTokenAction>> | null>(null);

  // Form State
  const [quoteAmountNet, setQuoteAmountNet] = useState('');
  const [estimatedWeeks, setEstimatedWeeks] = useState('');
  const [quoteNotes, setQuoteNotes] = useState('');
  const [quoteFileUrl, setQuoteFileUrl] = useState('');
  const [quoteFileName, setQuoteFileName] = useState('');
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [isSuccess, setIsSuccess] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    params.then((p) => {
      setToken(p.token);
      getQuoteRfpByTokenAction(p.token).then((res) => {
        setIsLoading(false);
        if (!res.ok) {
          setError(res.error || 'Invalid quote link');
        } else {
          setData(res);
          if (res.response?.status === 'QUOTE_SUBMITTED') {
            setIsSuccess(true);
            setQuoteAmountNet(res.response.quoteAmountNet || '');
            setQuoteFileName(res.response.quoteFileName || '');
            setQuoteFileUrl(res.response.quoteFileUrl || '');
          }
        }
      });
    });
  }, [params]);

  async function handleFileUpload(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    if (file.type !== 'application/pdf') {
      alert('Please upload a PDF document.');
      return;
    }

    if (file.size > 15 * 1024 * 1024) {
      alert('File size must be under 15MB.');
      return;
    }

    // Convert file to base64 data URL for standalone persistence
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = () => {
      setQuoteFileUrl(reader.result as string);
      setQuoteFileName(file.name);
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  }

  async function handleSubmitQuote(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!quoteAmountNet || Number(quoteAmountNet) <= 0) {
      alert('Please enter a valid net quotation amount.');
      return;
    }

    if (!quoteFileUrl) {
      alert('Please attach your official quotation PDF letter.');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const res = await submitQuoteResponseAction({
        magicToken: token,
        quoteAmountNet: parseFloat(quoteAmountNet),
        estimatedWeeks: estimatedWeeks ? parseInt(estimatedWeeks, 10) : undefined,
        quoteNotes,
        quoteFileUrl,
        quoteFileName: quoteFileName || 'Official_Supplier_Quotation.pdf',
      });

      if (res.ok) {
        setIsSuccess(true);
      } else {
        alert(res.error || 'Failed to submit quote.');
      }
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-slate-950 text-white">
        <div className="text-center space-y-3">
          <div className="mx-auto h-8 w-8 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-indigo-500 border-t-transparent" />
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">Loading project quotation brief...</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error || !data || !data.rfp || !data.partner) {
    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-slate-950 p-4 text-white">
        <div className="max-w-md rounded-2xl border border-rose-900/50 bg-rose-950/20 p-6 text-center space-y-3">
          <AlertCircle className="mx-auto h-10 w-10 text-rose-400" />
          <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-white">Quotation Link Unavailable</h2>
          <p className="text-xs text-rose-200">{error || 'This quote token is invalid or has expired.'}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const { rfp, partner } = data;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-slate-100 py-10 px-4 sm:px-6">
      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-6">
        {/* Top Header Card */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-slate-800 pb-5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <span className="text-3xl">{partner.logoEmoji}</span>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h1 className="text-lg font-bold text-white">{partner.name}</h1>
                <Badge className="border-amber-500/40 bg-amber-500/20 text-[10px] text-amber-300">
                  Verified Supplier Candidate
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                Official Grant Quotation Submission Portal • Powered by Startup Preflight
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <Badge variant="outline" className="border-slate-800 text-xs text-slate-400">
            {rfp.targetCountryCode === 'IE' ? '🇮🇪 Ireland Grant Track' : '🇬🇧 UK Grant Track'}
          </Badge>
        </div>

        {/* Project RFP Overview Card */}
        <Card className="border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/90 text-slate-100 shadow-md">
          <CardHeader className="border-b border-slate-800 pb-4">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
              <div>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-400">
                  Client Project Scope &amp; RFP Brief
                </span>
                <CardTitle className="text-xl font-extrabold text-white mt-1">
                  {rfp.projectTitle}
                </CardTitle>
                <CardDescription className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">
                  Prepared by <strong>{rfp.founderName}</strong> ({rfp.founderCompany})
                </CardDescription>
              </div>

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <Badge className="border-indigo-500/40 bg-indigo-500/20 text-xs text-indigo-300">
                  {rfp.rfpCategory}
                </Badge>
                <Badge className="border-emerald-500/40 bg-emerald-500/20 text-xs text-emerald-300">
                  Est. Budget: {rfp.budgetRange}
                </Badge>
                <Badge variant="outline" className="border-slate-700 text-xs text-slate-300">
                  Timeline: {rfp.targetDeliveryTimeline}
                </Badge>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardHeader>

          <CardContent className="p-5 space-y-5">
            {/* Scope Summary */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">

                Core Project Requirements

=== src/app/sitemap.ts ===
import { MetadataRoute } from 'next';
import { db, grantsDirectory } from '@/db';
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import {
  ensureDefaultGrantsSeededInDb,
  getFallbackGrantRecords,
} from '@/lib/grants/ensure-grants';

const BASE_URL = 'https://startuppreflight.com';

const hreflangAlternates = {
  languages: {
    'x-default': `${BASE_URL}/`,
    en: `${BASE_URL}/`,
    'en-IE': `${BASE_URL}/ie`,
    'en-GB': `${BASE_URL}/uk`,
  },
};

export default async function sitemap(): Promise<MetadataRoute.Sitemap> {
  const now = new Date();

  const staticRoutes: MetadataRoute.Sitemap = [
    {
      url: `${BASE_URL}/`,
      lastModified: now,
      changeFrequency: 'daily',
      priority: 1.0,
      alternates: hreflangAlternates,
    },
    {
      url: `${BASE_URL}/ie`,
      lastModified: now,
      changeFrequency: 'daily',
      priority: 0.95,
      alternates: hreflangAlternates,
    },
    {
      url: `${BASE_URL}/uk`,
      lastModified: now,
      changeFrequency: 'daily',
      priority: 0.95,
      alternates: hreflangAlternates,
    },
    {
      url: `${BASE_URL}/grants`,
      lastModified: now,
      changeFrequency: 'daily',
      priority: 0.9,
    },
    {
      url: `${BASE_URL}/about-founder`,
      lastModified: now,
      changeFrequency: 'monthly',
      priority: 0.7,
    },
    {
      url: `${BASE_URL}/cohorts`,
      lastModified: now,
      changeFrequency: 'weekly',
      priority: 0.85,
    },
    {
      url: `${BASE_URL}/register`,
      lastModified: now,
      changeFrequency: 'monthly',
      priority: 0.8,
    },
    {
      url: `${BASE_URL}/redeem`,
      lastModified: now,
      changeFrequency: 'monthly',
      priority: 0.6,
    },
    {
      url: `${BASE_URL}/appsumo`,
      lastModified: now,
      changeFrequency: 'monthly',
      priority: 0.6,
    },
    {
      url: `${BASE_URL}/privacy`,
      lastModified: now,
      changeFrequency: 'yearly',
      priority: 0.3,
    },
    {
      url: `${BASE_URL}/terms`,
      lastModified: now,
      changeFrequency: 'yearly',
      priority: 0.3,
    },
  ];

  let activeDbGrants: { slug: string; countryCode: string; updatedAt: Date | null }[] = [];

  try {
    await ensureDefaultGrantsSeededInDb();

    activeDbGrants = await db
      .select({
        slug: grantsDirectory.slug,
        countryCode: grantsDirectory.countryCode,
        updatedAt: grantsDirectory.updatedAt,
      })
      .from(grantsDirectory)
      .where(eq(grantsDirectory.status, 'ACTIVE'));
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[Sitemap] Error querying grants catalog for sitemap:', err);
  }

  // Combine seed fallback catalog and live DB records by slug to guarantee 100% comprehensive coverage
  const grantMap = new Map<string, { slug: string; countryCode: string; updatedAt: Date | null }>();

  // 1. Seed with default code catalog
  for (const fallback of getFallbackGrantRecords()) {
    grantMap.set(fallback.slug.trim(), {
      slug: fallback.slug.trim(),
      countryCode: fallback.countryCode.trim(),
      updatedAt: fallback.updatedAt,
    });
  }

  // 2. Overwrite / augment with live active DB grants (including newer timestamps and admin additions)
  for (const dbGrant of activeDbGrants) {
    if (dbGrant.slug) {
      grantMap.set(dbGrant.slug.trim(), {
        slug: dbGrant.slug.trim(),
        countryCode: (dbGrant.countryCode || 'IE').trim(),
        updatedAt: dbGrant.updatedAt,
      });
    }
  }

  const allGrants = Array.from(grantMap.values());

  const grantRoutes: MetadataRoute.Sitemap = allGrants.flatMap((grant) => {
    const countrySegment = grant.countryCode.toLowerCase();
    const lastMod = grant.updatedAt || now;
    return [
      {
        url: `${BASE_URL}/grants/${countrySegment}/${grant.slug}`,
        lastModified: lastMod,
        changeFrequency: 'weekly' as const,
        priority: 0.85,
      },
      {
        url: `${BASE_URL}/grants/${countrySegment}/${grant.slug}/checklist`,
        lastModified: lastMod,
        changeFrequency: 'weekly' as const,
        priority: 0.8,
      },
    ];
  });

  return [...staticRoutes, ...grantRoutes];
}
