/**
 * Loads the current authenticated founder's profile, entitlements, and settings.
 */
export async function getAccountDetailsAction(): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  profile?: AccountProfileData;
  error?: string;
}> {
  try {
    const session = await getServerSessionCookie();
    if (!session?.userId) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'Not authenticated. Please sign in.' };
    }

    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

    const [user] = await db
      .select()
      .from(users)
      .where(eq(users.id, session.userId))
      .limit(1);

    if (!user || user.status === 'SUSPENDED' || user.status === 'SOFT_DELETED') {
      return { ok: false, error: 'User account not found or deactivated.' };
    }

    const [entitlement] = await db
      .select()
      .from(userEntitlements)
      .where(eq(userEntitlements.userId, user.id))
      .limit(1);

    const plansList = await db
      .select({ id: startupPlans.id })
      .from(startupPlans)
      .where(eq(startupPlans.ownerUserId, user.id));

    const founderProfile = (user.founderProfileJson as any) || {};

    return {
      ok: true,
      profile: {
        id: user.id,
        name: user.name,
        email: user.email,
        role: user.role,
        status: user.status,
        createdAt: user.createdAt ? user.createdAt.toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),
        founderProfile: {
          founderStage: founderProfile.founderStage || 'VALIDATING_IDEA',
          teamStructure: founderProfile.teamStructure || 'SOLO_FOUNDER',
          primaryHat: founderProfile.primaryHat || 'VISION_INVESTOR',
          regionOrCounty: founderProfile.regionOrCounty || '',
          defaultCountryCode: founderProfile.defaultCountryCode || 'IE',
          notifyOnSurveyResponse: founderProfile.notifyOnSurveyResponse ?? true,
          notifyOnGrantDeadlines: founderProfile.notifyOnGrantDeadlines ?? true,
        },
        entitlement: entitlement
          ? {
              planType: entitlement.planType,
              stackedCodesCount: entitlement.stackedCodesCount,
              maxStartupPlans: entitlement.maxStartupPlans,
              maxSeatsPerPlan: entitlement.maxSeatsPerPlan,
              monthlyAiCreditsLimit: entitlement.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
              aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: entitlement.aiCreditsUsedThisMonth,
              accessExpiresAt: entitlement.accessExpiresAt
                ? entitlement.accessExpiresAt.toISOString()
                : null,
              isVaultReadonly: entitlement.isVaultReadonly,
              stripeCustomerId: entitlement.stripeCustomerId,
            }
          : null,
        totalPlansCount: plansList.length,
      },
    };
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('getAccountDetailsAction error:', err);
    return { ok: false, error: err?.message || 'Failed to load account profile.' };
  }

/**
 * Updates founder profile attributes (name, primary hat, default country, notification preferences).
 */
export async function updateFounderProfileAction(input: {
  name: string;
  primaryHat?: StartupHat;
  regionOrCounty?: string;
  defaultCountryCode?: SupportedCountryCode;
  notifyOnSurveyResponse?: boolean;
  notifyOnGrantDeadlines?: boolean;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const session = await getServerSessionCookie();
    if (!session?.userId) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'Not authenticated.' };
    }

    if (!input.name || input.name.trim().length < 2) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'Name must be at least 2 characters.' };
    }

    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

    const [user] = await db
      .select()
      .from(users)
      .where(eq(users.id, session.userId))
      .limit(1);

    if (!user) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'User not found.' };
    }

    const existingJson = (user.founderProfileJson as any) || {};
    const updatedJson = {
      ...existingJson,
      primaryHat: input.primaryHat ?? existingJson.primaryHat,
      regionOrCounty: input.regionOrCounty !== undefined ? input.regionOrCounty.trim() : existingJson.regionOrCounty,
      defaultCountryCode: input.defaultCountryCode ?? existingJson.defaultCountryCode ?? 'IE',
      notifyOnSurveyResponse: input.notifyOnSurveyResponse ?? existingJson.notifyOnSurveyResponse ?? true,
      notifyOnGrantDeadlines: input.notifyOnGrantDeadlines ?? existingJson.notifyOnGrantDeadlines ?? true,
    };

    await db
      .update(users)
      .set({
        name: input.name.trim(),
        founderProfileJson: updatedJson,
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(users.id, user.id));

    return { ok: true };
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('updateFounderProfileAction error:', err);
    return { ok: false, error: err?.message || 'Failed to update profile.' };
  }
}

/**
 * Changes founder password after constant-time verification of current password.
 */
export async function updateFounderPasswordAction(input: {
  currentPassword: string;
  newPassword: string;
  confirmPassword: string;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const session = await getServerSessionCookie();
    if (!session?.userId) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'Not authenticated.' };
    }

    if (!input.currentPassword) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'Please enter your current password.' };
    }

    if (!input.newPassword || input.newPassword.length < 8) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'New password must be at least 8 characters long.' };
    }

    if (input.newPassword !== input.confirmPassword) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'New passwords do not match.' };
    }

    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

    const [user] = await db
      .select({ id: users.id, passwordHash: users.passwordHash })
      .from(users)
      .where(eq(users.id, session.userId))
      .limit(1);

    if (!user) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'User not found.' };
    }

    // If user has a passwordHash, verify it
    if (user.passwordHash) {
      const isValid = verifyPassword(input.currentPassword, user.passwordHash);
      if (!isValid) {
        return { ok: false, error: 'Current password is incorrect.' };
      }
    }

    const newHash = hashPassword(input.newPassword);

    await db
      .update(users)
      .set({
        passwordHash: newHash,
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(users.id, user.id));

    return { ok: true };
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('updateFounderPasswordAction error:', err);
    return { ok: false, error: err?.message || 'Failed to update password.' };
  }
}

/**
 * Creates a Stripe Customer Portal session so founders can update payment methods,
 * download VAT invoices, or manage recurring subscriptions.
 */
export async function createStripeCustomerPortalAction(): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  portalUrl?: string;
  error?: string;
}> {
  try {
    const session = await getServerSessionCookie();
    if (!session?.userId) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'Not authenticated.' };
    }

    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

    const [entitlement] = await db
      .select({ stripeCustomerId: userEntitlements.stripeCustomerId })
      .from(userEntitlements)
      .where(eq(userEntitlements.userId, session.userId))
      .limit(1);

    let customerId = entitlement?.stripeCustomerId;

    if (!customerId) {
      // Find user email to search or create a Stripe customer
      const [user] = await db
        .select({ email: users.email, name: users.name })
        .from(users)
        .where(eq(users.id, session.userId))
        .limit(1);

      if (!user) {
        return { ok: false, error: 'User not found.' };
      }

      // Check if Stripe customer exists by email
      const existingCustomers = await stripe.customers.list({
        email: user.email,
        limit: 1,
      });

      if (existingCustomers.data.length > 0) {
        customerId = existingCustomers.data[0].id;
      } else {
        const newCustomer = await stripe.customers.create({
          email: user.email,
          name: user.name,
          metadata: { spf_user_id: session.userId },
        });
        customerId = newCustomer.id;
      }

      // Save stripeCustomerId
      if (customerId) {
        await db
          .insert(userEntitlements)
          .values({
            userId: session.userId,
            stripeCustomerId: customerId,
            updatedAt: new Date(),
          })
          .onConflictDoUpdate({
            target: userEntitlements.userId,
            set: { stripeCustomerId: customerId, updatedAt: new Date() },
          });
      }
    }

    const headerList = await headers();
    const origin =
      headerList.get('origin') ||
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL ||
      'http://localhost:3000';

    const portalSession = await stripe.billingPortal.sessions.create({
      customer: customerId,
      return_url: `${origin}/account`,
    });

    return { ok: true, portalUrl: portalSession.url };
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('createStripeCustomerPortalAction error:', err);
    return {
      ok: false,
      error:
        err?.message ||
        'Unable to launch Stripe Billing Portal. Please ensure Stripe is configured.',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Cancels auto-renewing subscription and sets vault to Read-Only at the end of the billing cycle.
 */
export async function cancelMicroSubscriptionAction(): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  error?: string;
}> {
  try {
    const session = await getServerSessionCookie();
    if (!session?.userId) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'Not authenticated.' };
    }

    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

    const [entitlement] = await db
      .select({ stripeCustomerId: userEntitlements.stripeCustomerId })
      .from(userEntitlements)
      .where(eq(userEntitlements.userId, session.userId))
      .limit(1);

    if (entitlement?.stripeCustomerId) {
      // Find active subscriptions on Stripe
      const subscriptions = await stripe.subscriptions.list({
        customer: entitlement.stripeCustomerId,
        status: 'active',
        limit: 5,
      });

      for (const sub of subscriptions.data) {
        await stripe.subscriptions.update(sub.id, {
          cancel_at_period_end: true,
        });
      }
    }

    return {
      ok: true,
      message:
        'Your subscription auto-renewal has been cancelled. Your workspace will transition into Read-Only Vault mode at the end of your billing cycle. Your data remains 100% safe and exportable.',
    };
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('cancelMicroSubscriptionAction error:', err);
    return { ok: false, error: err?.message || 'Failed to cancel subscription.' };
  }
}

/**
 * GDPR Article 20: Exports complete founder data archive (all startup plans, modules, and surveys).
 */
export async function exportCompleteFounderDataArchive(): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  exportData?: any;
  error?: string;
}> {
  try {
    const session = await getServerSessionCookie();
    if (!session?.userId) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'Not authenticated.' };
    }

    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

    const [user] = await db
      .select({
        id: users.id,
        name: users.name,
        email: users.email,
        role: users.role,
        createdAt: users.createdAt,
        founderProfileJson: users.founderProfileJson,
      })
      .from(users)
      .where(eq(users.id, session.userId))
      .limit(1);

    if (!user) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'User record not found.' };
    }

    const plans = await db
      .select()
      .from(startupPlans)
      .where(eq(startupPlans.ownerUserId, user.id));

    const enrichedPlans = [];

    for (const plan of plans) {
      const modules = await db
        .select()
        .from(planModulesData)
        .where(eq(planModulesData.planId, plan.id));

      const surveys = await db
        .select()
        .from(validationSurveys)
        .where(eq(validationSurveys.planId, plan.id));

      const surveyDetails = [];
      for (const s of surveys) {
        const responses = await db
          .select()
          .from(surveyResponses)
          .where(eq(surveyResponses.surveyId, s.id));
        surveyDetails.push({
          ...s,
          responses,
        });
      }

      enrichedPlans.push({
        plan,
        modules,
        surveys: surveyDetails,
      });
    }

    const payload = {
      exportMetadata: {
        platform: 'Startup Preflight 2.0',
        exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        version: '2.0.0',
        accountEmail: user.email,
      },
      userProfile: user,
      plans: enrichedPlans,
    };

    return { ok: true, exportData: payload };
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('exportCompleteFounderDataArchive error:', err);
    return { ok: false, error: err?.message || 'Failed to generate export archive.' };
  }
}

/**
 * 30-Day Soft Delete Account Action.
 * 1. Verifies password.
 * 2. Marks user status as 'SOFT_DELETED' and records deletedAt timestamp.
 * 3. Takes active validation surveys offline.
 * 4. Cancels any active Stripe subscriptions.
 * 5. Clears the server session cookie.
 */
export async function softDeleteFounderAccountAction(input: {
  passwordConfirmation: string;
  confirmationPhrase: string;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    if (input.confirmationPhrase.trim().toUpperCase() !== 'DELETE MY ACCOUNT') {
      return {
        ok: false,
        error: 'Please type "DELETE MY ACCOUNT" exactly to confirm deactivation.',
      };
    }

    const session = await getServerSessionCookie();
    if (!session?.userId) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'Not authenticated.' };
    }

    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

    const [user] = await db
      .select()
      .from(users)
      .where(eq(users.id, session.userId))
      .limit(1);

    if (!user) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'User not found.' };
    }

    // Verify password if hash exists
    if (user.passwordHash) {
      const isValid = verifyPassword(input.passwordConfirmation, user.passwordHash);
      if (!isValid) {
        return { ok: false, error: 'Incorrect password. Account deactivation aborted.' };
      }
    }

    const now = new Date();

    // 1. Mark user as SOFT_DELETED
    await db
      .update(users)
      .set({
        status: 'SOFT_DELETED',
        deletedAt: now,
        updatedAt: now,
      })
      .where(eq(users.id, user.id));

    // 2. Take user's validation surveys offline
    const userPlans = await db
      .select({ id: startupPlans.id })
      .from(startupPlans)
      .where(eq(startupPlans.ownerUserId, user.id));

    for (const plan of userPlans) {
      await db
        .update(validationSurveys)
        .set({
          isActive: false,
        })
        .where(eq(validationSurveys.planId, plan.id));
    }

    // 3. Cancel active Stripe subscriptions if any
    const [entitlement] = await db
      .select({ stripeCustomerId: userEntitlements.stripeCustomerId })
      .from(userEntitlements)
      .where(eq(userEntitlements.userId, user.id))
      .limit(1);

    if (entitlement?.stripeCustomerId) {
      try {
        const subs = await stripe.subscriptions.list({
          customer: entitlement.stripeCustomerId,
          status: 'active',
          limit: 5,
        });
        for (const sub of subs.data) {
          await stripe.subscriptions.cancel(sub.id);
        }
      } catch (stripeErr) {
        console.warn('Could not cancel Stripe subscriptions during soft-delete:', stripeErr);
      }
    }

    // 4. Clear HTTP-only session cookie
    await clearServerSessionCookie();

    return { ok: true };
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('softDeleteFounderAccountAction error:', err);
    return { ok: false, error: err?.message || 'Failed to deactivate account.' };
  }
}

/**
 * 30-Day Recovery: Restores a soft-deleted account within the 30-day window.
 */
export async function restoreSoftDeletedAccountAction(email: string): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  error?: string;
}> {
  try {
    const adminSession = await getAdminSessionCookie();
    if (!adminSession || adminSession.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
      return {
        ok: false,
        error: 'Unauthorized: Only a Super Administrator can restore a deactivated account.',
      };
    }
    const cleanEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();
    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

    const [user] = await db
      .select()
      .from(users)
      .where(and(eq(users.email, cleanEmail), eq(users.status, 'SOFT_DELETED')))
      .limit(1);

    if (!user) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'No deactivated account found with this email.' };
    }

    // Check if within 30-day window
    if (user.deletedAt) {
      const msSinceDelete = Date.now() - user.deletedAt.getTime();
      const daysSinceDelete = msSinceDelete / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
      if (daysSinceDelete > 30) {
        return {
          ok: false,
          error:
            'The 30-day recovery grace period has expired. This account cannot be restored.',
        };
      }
    }

    // Reactivate user
    await db
      .update(users)
      .set({
        status: 'ACTIVE',
        deletedAt: null,
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(users.id, user.id));

    return { ok: true };
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('restoreSoftDeletedAccountAction error:', err);
    return { ok: false, error: err?.message || 'Failed to restore account.' };
  }
}

'use server';

import { eq, and, sql, isNull } from 'drizzle-orm';
import {
  db,
  ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced,
  vouchers,
  cohorts,
  users,
  userEntitlements,
  startupPlans,
} from '@/db';

  getServerSessionCookie,
  getAdminSessionCookie,
  setServerSessionCookie,
  checkRateLimit,
} from '@/lib/auth/server-auth';

  calculateAppSumoTierLimits,

} from '@/lib/entitlements';

import { EMAIL_DEFAULTS } from '@/lib/email/resend';

const UUID_REGEX =
  /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

export interface FounderClientContext {
  userId?: string;
  email?: string;
}

export interface RedeemVoucherResult {
  ok: boolean;
  error?: string;
  message?: string;
  redeemedCode?: string;
  newTierName?: string;

  ok: boolean;
  authenticated: boolean;
  userId?: string;
  userEmail?: string;
  userName?: string;
  entitlement?: EntitlementSnapshot;
  redeemedCodes: string[];
  cohortCode?: string;

async function resolveAuthenticatedFounderUser(
  clientContext?: FounderClientContext
): Promise<(typeof users.$inferSelect) | null> {
  await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

  const sessionPayload = await getServerSessionCookie();
  const adminPayload = await getAdminSessionCookie();

  let foundUser: (typeof users.$inferSelect) | undefined;

  // 1. Primary: Check founder HttpOnly session cookie
  if (sessionPayload) {
    if (UUID_REGEX.test(sessionPayload.userId)) {
      const [byId] = await db
        .select()
        .from(users)
        .where(eq(users.id, sessionPayload.userId))
        .limit(1);
      foundUser = byId;
    }

    if (!foundUser && sessionPayload.email) {
      const [byEmail] = await db
        .select()
        .from(users)
        .where(eq(users.email, sessionPayload.email.trim().toLowerCase()))
        .limit(1);
      foundUser = byEmail;
    }
  }

  // 2. If an active Super Admin session exists in the same browser and a workspace user email is active
  if (!foundUser && adminPayload) {
    const targetEmail = (
      clientContext?.email ||
      adminPayload.email ||
      ''
    )
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();
    if (targetEmail) {
      const [byAdminTarget] = await db
        .select()
        .from(users)
        .where(eq(users.email, targetEmail))
        .limit(1);
      foundUser = byAdminTarget;
    }
  }

  // 3. Local development fallback for seeded demo personas (never trust clientContext without cookie in production)
  if (
    !foundUser &&
    process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production' &&
    clientContext?.email
  ) {
    const [byDevEmail] = await db
      .select()
      .from(users)
      .where(eq(users.email, clientContext.email.trim().toLowerCase()))
      .limit(1);
    foundUser = byDevEmail;
  }

  if (!foundUser || foundUser.status !== 'ACTIVE') {
    return null;
  }

  // Ensure the founder session cookie stays synchronized with the resolved DB user
  if (!sessionPayload || sessionPayload.userId !== foundUser.id) {
    await setServerSessionCookie({
      userId: foundUser.id,
      email: foundUser.email,
    });
  }

  return foundUser;
}

function mapEntitlementSnapshot(
  userId: string,
  entRow?: typeof userEntitlements.$inferSelect | null
): EntitlementSnapshot {
  const freeDefaults = calculatePassLimits('FREE_HOOK');
  if (!entRow) {
    return {
      userId,
      planType: 'FREE_HOOK',
      stackedCodesCount: 0,
      maxStartupPlans: freeDefaults.maxStartupPlans,
      maxSeatsPerPlan: freeDefaults.maxSeatsPerPlan,
      monthlyAiCreditsLimit: freeDefaults.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
      aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: 0,
      whiteLabelExportEnabled: false,
      isVaultReadonly: false,
    };
  }

  return {
    userId: entRow.userId,
    planType: entRow.planType,
    stackedCodesCount: entRow.stackedCodesCount,
    maxStartupPlans: entRow.maxStartupPlans,
    maxSeatsPerPlan: entRow.maxSeatsPerPlan,
    monthlyAiCreditsLimit: entRow.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
    aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: entRow.aiCreditsUsedThisMonth,
    whiteLabelExportEnabled: entRow.whiteLabelExportEnabled,
    customApiKeyEncrypted: entRow.customApiKeyEncrypted
      ? 'enc_gemini_byok_active'
      : null,
    accessExpiresAt: entRow.accessExpiresAt,
    isVaultReadonly: entRow.isVaultReadonly,
  };
}

/**
 * Fetches the authenticated founder's live entitlement & redeemed voucher codes from PostgreSQL.
 */
export async function getFounderVoucherStateAction(
  clientContext?: FounderClientContext
): Promise<FounderVoucherStateResult> {
  try {
    const user = await resolveAuthenticatedFounderUser(clientContext);
    if (!user) {
      return {
        ok: true,
        authenticated: false,
        redeemedCodes: [],
      };
    }

    const [entRow] = await db
      .select()
      .from(userEntitlements)
      .where(eq(userEntitlements.userId, user.id))
      .limit(1);

    const userVouchers = await db
      .select()
      .from(vouchers)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(vouchers.redeemedByUserId, user.id),
          eq(vouchers.status, 'REDEEMED')
        )
      );

    let cohortCode: string | undefined;
    if (user.cohortId) {
      const [cohortRow] = await db
        .select()
        .from(cohorts)
        .where(eq(cohorts.id, user.cohortId))
        .limit(1);
      if (cohortRow) {
        cohortCode = cohortRow.inviteCode;
      }
    }

    return {
      ok: true,
      authenticated: true,
      userId: user.id,
      userEmail: user.email,
      userName: user.name,
      entitlement: mapEntitlementSnapshot(user.id, entRow),
      redeemedCodes: userVouchers.map((v) => v.code),
      cohortCode,
    };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[Voucher State] Failed to load founder voucher state:', err);
    return {
      ok: false,
      authenticated: false,
      redeemedCodes: [],
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Redeems an AppSumo, Partner, Promo, or Institutional Cohort code for the active founder session.
 * Supports:
 * - AppSumo Lifetime Stacking (Tier 1 -> Tier 2 -> Tier 3)
 * - Partner & Promo Passes (Lifetime, Pass Solo, Pass Co-Founder with month duration)
 * - Institutional Cohort Codes (SPF-UCD-..., BMU-...)
 */
export async function redeemVoucherOrCohortCodeAction(
  code: string,
  clientContext?: FounderClientContext
): Promise<RedeemVoucherResult> {
  const cleanCode = (code || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!cleanCode) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Please enter a valid voucher or cohort code.' };
  }

  try {
    const user = await resolveAuthenticatedFounderUser(clientContext);
    if (!user) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        error: 'You must be signed in to redeem or stack a voucher code.',
      };
    }

    const rateLimit = checkRateLimit(`voucher:redeem:${user.id}`, 8, 60_000);
    if (!rateLimit.allowed) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        error: `Too many redemption attempts. Please wait ${rateLimit.retryAfterSeconds}s.`,
      };
    }

    const [currentEnt] = await db
      .select()
      .from(userEntitlements)
      .where(eq(userEntitlements.userId, user.id))
      .limit(1);

    const cleanAlpha = cleanCode.replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/gi, '').toUpperCase();

    // 1. Check if this is an Institutional Cohort Code (exact or hyphen-agnostic match)
    const [foundCohort] = await db
      .select()
      .from(cohorts)
      .where(
        sql`UPPER(${cohorts.inviteCode}) = ${cleanCode} OR UPPER(REPLACE(${cohorts.inviteCode}, '-', '')) = ${cleanAlpha}`
      )
      .limit(1);

    if (foundCohort) {
      if (
        foundCohort.expiresAt &&
        new Date(foundCohort.expiresAt).getTime() < Date.now()
      ) {
        return {
          ok: false,
          error: `Institutional cohort code ${cleanCode} has expired.`,
        };
      }

      const isAlreadyInCohort = user.cohortId === foundCohort.id;
      if (
        !isAlreadyInCohort &&
        foundCohort.seatsUsed >= foundCohort.maxSeats
      ) {
        return {
          ok: false,
          error: `Cohort "${foundCohort.name}" has reached its maximum capacity (${foundCohort.maxSeats} seats).`,
        };
      }

      const durationMonths = foundCohort.accessDurationMonths || 6;
      const cohortLimits = calculatePassLimits('COHORT_PASS', durationMonths);

      await db
        .update(users)
        .set({ cohortId: foundCohort.id, updatedAt: new Date() })
        .where(eq(users.id, user.id));

      await db
        .update(startupPlans)
        .set({ cohortId: foundCohort.id, updatedAt: new Date() })
        .where(
          and(
            eq(startupPlans.ownerUserId, user.id),
            isNull(startupPlans.cohortId)
          )
        );

      if (!isAlreadyInCohort) {
        await db
          .update(cohorts)
          .set({
            seatsUsed: sql`${cohorts.seatsUsed} + 1`,
          })
          .where(eq(cohorts.id, foundCohort.id));
      }

      let updatedEntRow: typeof userEntitlements.$inferSelect;
      if (currentEnt) {
        const [updated] = await db
          .update(userEntitlements)
          .set({
            planType: 'COHORT_PASS',
            maxStartupPlans: Math.max(
              currentEnt.maxStartupPlans,
              cohortLimits.maxStartupPlans
            ),
            maxSeatsPerPlan: Math.max(
              currentEnt.maxSeatsPerPlan,
              cohortLimits.maxSeatsPerPlan
            ),
            monthlyAiCreditsLimit: Math.max(
              currentEnt.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
              cohortLimits.monthlyAiCreditsLimit
            ),
            accessExpiresAt:
              foundCohort.expiresAt || cohortLimits.accessExpiresAt,
            isVaultReadonly: false,
            updatedAt: new Date(),
          })
          .where(eq(userEntitlements.id, currentEnt.id))
          .returning();
        updatedEntRow = updated;
      } else {
        const [inserted] = await db
          .insert(userEntitlements)
          .values({
            userId: user.id,
            planType: 'COHORT_PASS',
            stackedCodesCount: 0,
            maxStartupPlans: cohortLimits.maxStartupPlans,
            maxSeatsPerPlan: cohortLimits.maxSeatsPerPlan,
            monthlyAiCreditsLimit: cohortLimits.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
            aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: 0,
            whiteLabelExportEnabled: false,
            accessExpiresAt:
              foundCohort.expiresAt || cohortLimits.accessExpiresAt,
            isVaultReadonly: false,
          })
          .returning();
        updatedEntRow = inserted;
      }

      const userVouchers = await db
        .select()
        .from(vouchers)
        .where(
          and(
            eq(vouchers.redeemedByUserId, user.id),
            eq(vouchers.status, 'REDEEMED')
          )
        );

      // Fire asynchronous confirmation email
      const cohortExpires =
        foundCohort.expiresAt || cohortLimits.accessExpiresAt;
      const cohortActivatedDate = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-IE', {
        dateStyle: 'long',
      }).format(new Date());
      const cohortValidUntilDate = cohortExpires
        ? new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-IE', { dateStyle: 'long' }).format(
            cohortExpires
          )
        : 'Active Cohort Term';

      sendSystemEmail({
        to: user.email,
        replyTo: 'Tom@startuppreflight.com',
        template: 'VOUCHER_REDEEMED',
        subject: `Pass Activated: Enrolled in ${foundCohort.name}!`,
        props: {
          founderName: user.name || undefined,
          recipientEmail: user.email,
          voucherCode: cleanCode,
          tierName: `${foundCohort.name} Cohort Pass`,
          activatedDate: cohortActivatedDate,
          validUntilDate: cohortValidUntilDate,
          maxPlans: updatedEntRow.maxStartupPlans,
          maxSeats: updatedEntRow.maxSeatsPerPlan,
          aiCreditsMonthly: updatedEntRow.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
          loginUrl: `${EMAIL_DEFAULTS.appUrl}/workspace`,
        },
        metadata: {
          userId: user.id,
          trigger: 'COHORT_CODE_REDEEMED',
          voucherCode: cleanCode,
        },
      }).catch((e) => {
        console.error(
          '[SPF Email] Failed to send cohort confirmation email:',
          e
        );
      });

      return {
        ok: true,
        message: `Successfully enrolled in "${foundCohort.name}" Institutional Cohort! Full Module A–L access unlocked.`,
        redeemedCode: cleanCode,
        newTierName: foundCohort.name,
        maxStartupPlans: updatedEntRow.maxStartupPlans,
        monthlyAiCreditsLimit: updatedEntRow.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
        isVaultReadonly: false,
        entitlement: mapEntitlementSnapshot(user.id, updatedEntRow),
        redeemedCodes: userVouchers.map((v) => v.code),
        cohortCode: cleanCode,
      };
    }

    // 2. Look up Voucher in `vouchers` table (exact or hyphen-agnostic match)
    const [foundVoucher] = await db
      .select()
      .from(vouchers)
      .where(
        sql`UPPER(${vouchers.code}) = ${cleanCode} OR UPPER(REPLACE(${vouchers.code}, '-', '')) = ${cleanAlpha}`
      )
      .limit(1);

    if (!foundVoucher) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        error: `Invalid or unrecognized voucher code "${cleanCode}". Please check the code and try again.`,
      };
    }

    if (foundVoucher.status === 'REDEEMED') {
      if (foundVoucher.redeemedByUserId === user.id) {
        return {
          ok: false,
          error: `Voucher ${cleanCode} has already been applied to your account.`,
        };
      }
      return {
        ok: false,
        error: `Voucher ${cleanCode} has already been claimed by another account. Individual voucher codes are single-use. If you are part of a program or testing cohort, please use your shared cohort invite code.`,
      };
    }

    if (foundVoucher.status === 'REFUNDED_REVOKED') {
      return {
        ok: false,
        error: `Voucher ${cleanCode} has been revoked or refunded and is no longer valid.`,
      };
    }

    const now = new Date();

    // Mark voucher redeemed first so subsequent queries include it
    await db
      .update(vouchers)
      .set({
        status: 'REDEEMED',
        redeemedByUserId: user.id,
        redeemedAt: now,
      })
      .where(eq(vouchers.id, foundVoucher.id));

    // Fetch all active redeemed vouchers for this user
    const userVouchers = await db
      .select()
      .from(vouchers)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(vouchers.redeemedByUserId, user.id),
          eq(vouchers.status, 'REDEEMED')
        )
      );

    const rewardType = foundVoucher.rewardType || 'APPSUMO_LTD';
    const durationMonths = foundVoucher.durationMonths || 6;

    if (rewardType === 'APPSUMO_LTD') {
      const redeemedAppSumoCount = userVouchers.filter(
        (v) => (v.rewardType || 'APPSUMO_LTD') === 'APPSUMO_LTD'
      ).length;

      const baseStacked =
        currentEnt?.planType === 'APPSUMO_LTD'
          ? currentEnt.stackedCodesCount || 0
          : 0;
      const newStacked = Math.max(baseStacked + 1, redeemedAppSumoCount, 1);
      const limits = calculateAppSumoTierLimits(newStacked);

      let updatedEntRow: typeof userEntitlements.$inferSelect;
      if (currentEnt) {
        const [updated] = await db
          .update(userEntitlements)
          .set({
            planType: 'APPSUMO_LTD',
            stackedCodesCount: newStacked,
            maxStartupPlans: limits.maxStartupPlans,
            maxSeatsPerPlan: limits.maxSeatsPerPlan,
            monthlyAiCreditsLimit: limits.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
            whiteLabelExportEnabled: limits.whiteLabelExportEnabled,
            isVaultReadonly: false,
            accessExpiresAt: null, // Lifetime
            updatedAt: now,
          })
          .where(eq(userEntitlements.id, currentEnt.id))
          .returning();
        updatedEntRow = updated;
      } else {
        const [inserted] = await db
          .insert(userEntitlements)
          .values({
            userId: user.id,
            planType: 'APPSUMO_LTD',
            stackedCodesCount: newStacked,
            maxStartupPlans: limits.maxStartupPlans,
            maxSeatsPerPlan: limits.maxSeatsPerPlan,
            monthlyAiCreditsLimit: limits.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
            aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: 0,
            whiteLabelExportEnabled: limits.whiteLabelExportEnabled,
            isVaultReadonly: false,
          })
          .returning();
        updatedEntRow = inserted;
      }

      const activatedDate = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-IE', {
        dateStyle: 'long',
      }).format(now);
      const validUntilDate = 'Lifetime Access (Never Expires)';

      // Fire asynchronous confirmation email
      sendSystemEmail({
        to: user.email,
        replyTo: 'Tom@startuppreflight.com',
        template: 'VOUCHER_REDEEMED',
        subject: `Pass Activated: Code ${cleanCode} Redeemed!`,
        props: {
          founderName: user.name || undefined,
          recipientEmail: user.email,
          voucherCode: cleanCode,
          tierName: limits.tierName,
          activatedDate,
          validUntilDate,
          maxPlans: limits.maxStartupPlans,
          maxSeats: limits.maxSeatsPerPlan,
          aiCreditsMonthly: limits.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
          loginUrl: `${EMAIL_DEFAULTS.appUrl}/workspace`,
        },
        metadata: {
          userId: user.id,
          trigger: 'APPSUMO_VOUCHER_REDEEMED',
          voucherCode: cleanCode,
          totalStacked: newStacked,
        },
      }).catch((e) => {
        console.error('[SPF Email] Failed to send voucher confirmation email:', e);
      });

      return {
        ok: true,
        message: `Voucher ${cleanCode} redeemed! Your account is now upgraded to ${limits.tierName}.`,
        redeemedCode: cleanCode,
        newTierName: limits.tierName,
        totalStackedCodes: newStacked,
        maxStartupPlans: updatedEntRow.maxStartupPlans,
        monthlyAiCreditsLimit: updatedEntRow.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
        isVaultReadonly: false,
        entitlement: mapEntitlementSnapshot(user.id, updatedEntRow),
        redeemedCodes: userVouchers.map((v) => v.code),
      };
    } else {
      // Partner Pass (Solo or Co-Founder, time-limited)
      const passType =
        rewardType === 'PASS_COFOUNDER'
          ? 'SIX_MONTH_COFOUNDER'
          : 'SIX_MONTH_SOLO';
      const passLimits = calculatePassLimits(passType, durationMonths);

      let updatedEntRow: typeof userEntitlements.$inferSelect;
      if (currentEnt) {
        const [updated] = await db
          .update(userEntitlements)
          .set({
            planType: passType,
            maxStartupPlans: Math.max(
              currentEnt.maxStartupPlans,
              passLimits.maxStartupPlans
            ),
            maxSeatsPerPlan: Math.max(
              currentEnt.maxSeatsPerPlan,
              passLimits.maxSeatsPerPlan
            ),
            monthlyAiCreditsLimit: Math.max(
              currentEnt.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
              passLimits.monthlyAiCreditsLimit
            ),
            accessExpiresAt: passLimits.accessExpiresAt,
            isVaultReadonly: false,
            updatedAt: now,
          })
          .where(eq(userEntitlements.id, currentEnt.id))
          .returning();
        updatedEntRow = updated;
      } else {
        const [inserted] = await db
          .insert(userEntitlements)
          .values({
            userId: user.id,
            planType: passType,
            stackedCodesCount: 0,
            maxStartupPlans: passLimits.maxStartupPlans,
            maxSeatsPerPlan: passLimits.maxSeatsPerPlan,
            monthlyAiCreditsLimit: passLimits.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
            aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: 0,
            whiteLabelExportEnabled: false,
            accessExpiresAt: passLimits.accessExpiresAt,
            isVaultReadonly: false,
          })
          .returning();
        updatedEntRow = inserted;
      }

      const passLabel =
        rewardType === 'PASS_COFOUNDER'
          ? `Partner Co-Founder Pass (${durationMonths} Months)`
          : `Partner Solo Pass (${durationMonths} Months)`;

      const passActivatedDate = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-IE', {
        dateStyle: 'long',
      }).format(now);
      const passValidUntilDate = passLimits.accessExpiresAt
        ? new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-IE', { dateStyle: 'long' }).format(
            passLimits.accessExpiresAt
          )
        : `${durationMonths} Months`;

      // Fire asynchronous confirmation email
      sendSystemEmail({
        to: user.email,
        replyTo: 'Tom@startuppreflight.com',
        template: 'VOUCHER_REDEEMED',
        subject: `Pass Activated: Code ${cleanCode} Redeemed!`,
        props: {
          founderName: user.name || undefined,
          recipientEmail: user.email,
          voucherCode: cleanCode,
          tierName: passLabel,
          activatedDate: passActivatedDate,
          validUntilDate: passValidUntilDate,
          maxPlans: updatedEntRow.maxStartupPlans,
          maxSeats: updatedEntRow.maxSeatsPerPlan,
          aiCreditsMonthly: updatedEntRow.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
          loginUrl: `${EMAIL_DEFAULTS.appUrl}/workspace`,
        },
        metadata: {
          userId: user.id,
          trigger: 'PARTNER_PASS_REDEEMED',
          voucherCode: cleanCode,
        },
      }).catch((e) => {
        console.error(
          '[SPF Email] Failed to send partner pass confirmation email:',
          e
        );
      });

      return {
        ok: true,
        message: `Voucher ${cleanCode} redeemed successfully! You have unlocked ${passLabel}.`,
        redeemedCode: cleanCode,
        newTierName: passLabel,
        maxStartupPlans: updatedEntRow.maxStartupPlans,
        monthlyAiCreditsLimit: updatedEntRow.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
        isVaultReadonly: false,
        entitlement: mapEntitlementSnapshot(user.id, updatedEntRow),
        redeemedCodes: userVouchers.map((v) => v.code),
      };
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[Voucher Redeem] Error:', err);
    return {
      ok: false,
      error:
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : 'An unexpected error occurred while redeeming your voucher.',
    };
  }
}

'use server';

import { and, eq, sql } from 'drizzle-orm';
import {
  db,
  startupPlans,
  planModulesData,
  openQuestionsParkingLot,
  type BlindSpotItem,
} from '@/db';

  BrandPositioningStep1Data,
  Modern4PsStep2Data,
  First10PlaybookStep3Data,
  MarketingBudgetStep4Data,
  MarketingExecutiveBriefStep5Data,
  SavedModuleIData,
} from '@/lib/auth/session-store';

import type { SupportedCountryCode } from '@/lib/localization';
import {
  generateModuleIPositioningViaRouter,
  type GenerateModuleIPositioningResult,
  type GenerateModuleIPositioningParams,
  generateModuleIFourPsViaRouter,
  type GenerateModuleIFourPsResult,

  generateLetterOfIntentMarkdown,

const UUID_REGEX =
  /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

let moduleIEnumEnsured = false;

async function ensureModuleIEnumInPostgres(): Promise<void> {
  if (moduleIEnumEnsured) return;
  try {
    await db.execute(
      sql`ALTER TYPE "public"."module_code" ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'MOD_I_MARKETING'`
    );
    moduleIEnumEnsured = true;
  } catch {
    // Non-fatal if enum value already exists
  }
}

/**
 * Persists Module I Step 1 (Brand Positioning, Value Proposition & 3-Second Hook) to `plan_modules_data`.
 */
export async function saveModuleIStep1PositioningAction(input: {
  planId: string;
  positioning: BrandPositioningStep1Data;
  completionPercentage?: number;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; persistedToCloudSql: boolean; error?: string }> {
  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(input.planId)) {
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  try {
    const authCheck = await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(input.planId);
    if (!authCheck.authorized) {
      // Local preview or unauthenticated session — allow client-side state to continue smoothly
      return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
    }

    await ensureModuleIEnumInPostgres();

    const existingMod = await db
      .select()
      .from(planModulesData)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(planModulesData.planId, input.planId),
          eq(planModulesData.moduleCode, 'MOD_I_MARKETING')
        )
      )
      .limit(1);

    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const cleanStep1: BrandPositioningStep1Data = {
      ...input.positioning,
      lastSavedAt: nowIso,
    };

    const currentJson: Record<string, unknown> =
      existingMod.length > 0 &&
      typeof existingMod[0].structuredInputsJsonb === 'object' &&
      existingMod[0].structuredInputsJsonb !== null
        ? (existingMod[0].structuredInputsJsonb as Record<string, unknown>)
        : {};

    const updatedJson: Record<string, unknown> = {
      ...currentJson,
      step1Positioning: cleanStep1,
      lastSavedAt: nowIso,
    };

    const newCompletion = Math.max(
      existingMod[0]?.completionPercentage || 0,
      input.completionPercentage ?? 20
    );

    if (existingMod.length > 0) {
      await db
        .update(planModulesData)
        .set({
          structuredInputsJsonb: updatedJson,
          completionPercentage: newCompletion,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(
          and(
            eq(planModulesData.planId, input.planId),
            eq(planModulesData.moduleCode, 'MOD_I_MARKETING')
          )
        );
    } else {
      await db.insert(planModulesData).values({
        planId: input.planId,
        moduleCode: 'MOD_I_MARKETING',
        structuredInputsJsonb: updatedJson,
        completionPercentage: newCompletion,
        aiThingsToConsiderJsonb: [],
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      });
    }

    // Touch startupPlans currentModuleStep and updatedAt
    await db
      .update(startupPlans)
      .set({
        currentModuleStep: 'MOD_I_STEP_1',
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(startupPlans.id, input.planId));

    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: true };
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Error saving Module I Step 1 to PostgreSQL:', err);
    // Non-fatal fallback for offline or unmigrated environments
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false, error: err?.message };
  }
}

/**
 * AI Generator for Module I Step 1 (Brand Positioning & 3-Second Hook).
 */
export async function generateModuleIPositioningAction(params: {
  planId?: string;
  planTitle?: string;
  industryCategory?: string;
  hqCountryCode?: SupportedCountryCode;
  oneLinerSummary?: string;
  problemStatement?: string;
  solutionStatement?: string;
  uvpStatement?: string;
  targetCustomer?: string;
  beachheadPersona?: string;
  competitiveWedge?: string;
  preferredTone?: string;
}): Promise<GenerateModuleIPositioningResult> {
  // If planId provided, attempt optional DB verification without blocking fallback synthesis
  if (params.planId && UUID_REGEX.test(params.planId)) {
    try {
      await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(params.planId);
    } catch {
      // Continue to router for graceful synthesis/fallback
    }
  }

  return generateModuleIPositioningViaRouter(params);
}

/**

/**

 */
export async function parkModuleIOpenQuestionAction(input: {
  planId: string;
  questionText: string;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; questionId?: string; error?: string }> {
  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(input.planId)) {
    return { ok: true, questionId: `mock-${Date.now()}` };
  }

  try {
    const authCheck = await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(input.planId);
    if (!authCheck.authorized) {
      return { ok: true, questionId: `local-${Date.now()}` };
    }

    await ensureModuleIEnumInPostgres();

    const [inserted] = await db
      .insert(openQuestionsParkingLot)
      .values({
        planId: input.planId,
        sourceModule: 'MOD_I_MARKETING',
        questionText: input.questionText.trim(),
        status: 'OPEN',
      })
      .returning({ id: openQuestionsParkingLot.id });

    return { ok: true, questionId: inserted?.id };
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Error parking open question for Module I:', err);
    return { ok: true, questionId: `fallback-${Date.now()}` };
  }
}
=== src/app/actions/stripe.ts ===
'use server';

import { stripe, isStripeConfigured } from '@/lib/stripe/client';
import { STRIPE_PASS_PRODUCTS } from '@/lib/stripe/products';
import { verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership } from '@/lib/auth/server-auth';
import { db } from '@/db';
import { userEntitlements, users } from '@/db/schema';
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { headers } from 'next/headers';

export interface CreateCheckoutInput {
  planType: 'SIX_MONTH_SOLO' | 'SIX_MONTH_COFOUNDER' | 'LIVING_VAULT_MONTHLY';
  currency?: 'EUR' | 'GBP' | 'USD';
  planId?: string;
  guestEmail?: string;
}

export async function createStripeCheckoutSessionAction(
  input: CreateCheckoutInput
): Promise<{ success: boolean; url?: string; error?: string }> {
  try {
    if (!isStripeConfigured()) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error:
          'Stripe payments are not configured on this server. Please ensure STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is configured in your environment or Google Cloud Run.',
      };
    }

    const authCheck = await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership();

    const productConfig = STRIPE_PASS_PRODUCTS[input.planType];
    if (!productConfig) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: `Invalid pass selection: ${input.planType}`,
      };
    }

    // Determine target currency (EUR, GBP, USD)
    const selectedCurrency = (input.currency || 'EUR').toUpperCase() as
      | 'EUR'
      | 'GBP'
      | 'USD';
    const unitAmount =
      productConfig.prices[selectedCurrency] || productConfig.prices.EUR;

    let dbUserId: string | null = null;
    let customerEmail: string | undefined = input.guestEmail?.trim() || undefined;
    let customerId: string | undefined = undefined;

    if (authCheck.authorized && authCheck.userId) {
      dbUserId = authCheck.userId;
      const [dbUser] = await db
        .select({
          id: users.id,
          email: users.email,
          name: users.name,
        })
        .from(users)
        .where(eq(users.id, authCheck.userId))
        .limit(1);

      if (dbUser) {
        customerEmail = dbUser.email;
        const [entitlement] = await db
          .select({
            stripeCustomerId: userEntitlements.stripeCustomerId,
          })
          .from(userEntitlements)
          .where(eq(userEntitlements.userId, authCheck.userId))
          .limit(1);

        customerId = entitlement?.stripeCustomerId || undefined;

        if (!customerId && dbUser.email) {
          const customer = await stripe.customers.create({
            email: dbUser.email,
            name: dbUser.name || undefined,
            metadata: {
              spf_user_id: dbUser.id,
            },
          });
          customerId = customer.id;

          if (entitlement) {
            await db
              .update(userEntitlements)
              .set({ stripeCustomerId: customerId })
              .where(eq(userEntitlements.userId, dbUser.id));
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Compute return URLs
    const headerList = await headers();
    const origin =
      headerList.get('origin') ||
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL ||
      'http://localhost:3000';

    const successUrl = dbUserId
      ? `${origin}/workspace?upgrade_success=true&session_id={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}`
      : `${origin}/register?stripe_checkout=success&session_id={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}`;
    const cancelUrl = `${origin}/?stripe_cancelled=true`;

    const lineItems: any[] = [
      {
        price_data: {
          currency: selectedCurrency.toLowerCase(),
          unit_amount: unitAmount,
          product_data: {
            name: `Startup Preflight — ${productConfig.title}`,
            description: productConfig.description,
          },
          ...(productConfig.mode === 'subscription'
            ? { recurring: { interval: 'month' } }
            : {}),
        },
        quantity: 1,
      },
    ];

    const sessionParams: any = {
      customer: customerId,
      customer_email: customerId ? undefined : customerEmail,
      payment_method_types: ['card'],
      line_items: lineItems,
      mode: productConfig.mode,
      success_url: successUrl,
      cancel_url: cancelUrl,
      client_reference_id: dbUserId || undefined,
      metadata: {
        userId: dbUserId || '',
        guestEmail: customerEmail || '',
        planType: input.planType,
        planId: input.planId || '',
      },
      allow_promotion_codes: true,
      billing_address_collection: 'auto',
    };

    const session = await stripe.checkout.sessions.create(sessionParams);

    if (!session.url) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: 'Failed to generate Stripe Checkout URL.',
      };
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      url: session.url,
    };
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Failed to create Stripe Checkout session:', err);
    return {
      success: false,
      error:
        err.message || 'An unexpected error occurred while connecting to Stripe.',
    };
  }
}
=== src/app/actions/quote-concierge.ts ===
'use server';

import crypto from 'crypto';
import { desc, eq, and } from 'drizzle-orm';
import {
  db,
  ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced,
  quoteRfpRequests,
  quotePartnerResponses,
  partnerOffers,
  partnerReferralEvents,
  startupPlans,
  users,
} from '@/db';
import type {
  QuoteRfpWorkPackageItem,
  QuoteRfpFounderContact,
} from '@/db/schema';
import {
  verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership,
  getAdminSessionCookie,
} from '@/lib/auth/server-auth';
import { sendSystemEmail } from '@/lib/email/send';
import { EMAIL_DEFAULTS } from '@/lib/email/resend';
import type { QuoteSupplierCategory } from '@/lib/partners/partner-catalog-store';

/**
 * 1. Founder Action: Submits standardized RFP from Module D or Module E.
 * Auto-matches top 3 active suppliers, generates cryptographic magic tokens,
 * and sends automated emails via Resend.
 */
export async function submitThreeQuoteRfpAction(input: {
  planId: string;
  sourceModule: 'MOD_D_PRODUCT_BUILD' | 'MOD_E_OPERATIONS';
  rfpCategory: QuoteSupplierCategory;
  projectTitle: string;
  budgetRange: string;
  targetDeliveryTimeline: string;
  scopeSummary: string;
  workPackages: QuoteRfpWorkPackageItem[];
  founderContact: QuoteRfpFounderContact;
  equipmentItemName?: string;
}): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  rfpId?: string;
  dispatchedCount?: number;
  partnerNames?: string[];
  error?: string;
}> {
  try {
    const verified = await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(input.planId);
    if (!verified || !verified.authorized) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'Unauthorized: Access to this plan is restricted.' };
    }

    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

    // 1. Fetch Plan localization
    const [plan] = await db
      .select({
        id: startupPlans.id,
        title: startupPlans.title,
        ownerUserId: startupPlans.ownerUserId,
        hqCountryCode: startupPlans.hqCountryCode,
        baseCurrency: startupPlans.baseCurrency,
      })
      .from(startupPlans)
      .where(eq(startupPlans.id, input.planId))
      .limit(1);

    if (!plan) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'Plan not found.' };
    }

    const countryCode = plan.hqCountryCode || 'IE';
    const currency = plan.baseCurrency || (countryCode === 'GB' ? 'GBP' : 'EUR');
    const founderUserId = verified.userId || plan.ownerUserId;

    // 2. Query available active suppliers for this category & country
    const allSuppliers = await db
      .select()
      .from(partnerOffers)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(partnerOffers.isActive, true),
          eq(partnerOffers.isSupplierPartner, true),
          eq(partnerOffers.supplierCategory, input.rfpCategory)
        )
      );

    // Filter by country scope: 'ALL' or matching countryCode
    const eligibleSuppliers = allSuppliers.filter(
      (s) => s.countryScope === 'ALL' || s.countryScope === countryCode
    );

    // Pick up to 3 suppliers (sorted by least recently dispatched to balance load)
    const selectedPartners = [...eligibleSuppliers]
      .sort((a, b) => {
        const aDispatched = a.rfpsDispatchedThisMonth || 0;
        const bDispatched = b.rfpsDispatchedThisMonth || 0;
        return aDispatched - bDispatched;
      })
      .slice(0, 3);

    // 3. Insert quote_rfp_requests
    const [rfp] = await db
      .insert(quoteRfpRequests)
      .values({
        planId: plan.id,
        founderUserId,
        rfpCategory: input.rfpCategory,
        targetCountryCode: countryCode,
        currency,
        projectTitle: input.projectTitle.trim() || plan.title,
        budgetRange: input.budgetRange,
        targetDeliveryTimeline: input.targetDeliveryTimeline,
        scopeSummary: input.scopeSummary,
        workPackagesJson: input.workPackages,
        founderContactInfo: input.founderContact,
        sourceModule: input.sourceModule,
        equipmentItemName: input.equipmentItemName || null,
        status: 'DISPATCHED',
        dispatchedPartnersCount: selectedPartners.length,
        quotesReceivedCount: 0,
      })
      .returning();

    // 4. For each selected partner, generate secure magic token and response row
    const partnerNames: string[] = [];
    const appUrl = EMAIL_DEFAULTS.appUrl;

    for (const partner of selectedPartners) {
      partnerNames.push(partner.name);
      const magicToken = crypto.randomBytes(24).toString('hex');
      const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 21 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000); // 21 days TTL

      await db.insert(quotePartnerResponses).values({
        rfpId: rfp.id,
        partnerId: partner.id,
        magicToken,
        tokenExpiresAt: expiresAt,
        status: 'SENT',
        quoteCurrency: currency,
      });

      // Update partner monthly dispatch count
      await db
        .update(partnerOffers)
        .set({
          rfpsDispatchedThisMonth: (partner.rfpsDispatchedThisMonth || 0) + 1,
          lastRfpDispatchedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(partnerOffers.id, partner.id));

      // Log referral lead event
      await db.insert(partnerReferralEvents).values({
        partnerId: partner.id,
        partnerName: partner.name,
        partnerSlug: partner.slug,
        slotKey: partner.slotKey,
        eventType: 'WARM_INTRO_LEAD',
        planId: plan.id,
        planTitle: plan.title,
        founderName: input.founderContact.name,
        founderEmail: input.founderContact.email,
        countryCode,
        destinationUrl: `${appUrl}/quotes/submit/${magicToken}`,
        intakeAnswersJson: {
          projectTitle: input.projectTitle,
          budgetRange: input.budgetRange,
          timeline: input.targetDeliveryTimeline,
          rfpCategory: input.rfpCategory,
        },
        leadStatus: 'INTRO_SENT',
        estimatedBountyAmount: partner.commissionBountySummary || '€75 qualified lead fee',
        adminNotes: `Automated 3-Quote RFP dispatch (${rfp.id}) to ${partner.dispatchEmail || partner.warmIntroRecipientEmail}`,
      });

      // Send dispatch email to partner
      const targetInbox =
        partner.dispatchEmail ||
        partner.warmIntroRecipientEmail ||
        'quotes@startuppreflight.com';

      const magicPortalUrl = `${appUrl}/quotes/submit/${magicToken}`;

      await sendSystemEmail({
        to: targetInbox,
        template: 'QUOTE_RFP_PARTNER_INVITE',
        subject: `[New Project RFP] ${input.projectTitle} (${countryCode}) — Quote Request`,
        props: {
          partnerName: partner.name,
          projectTitle: input.projectTitle,
          category: input.rfpCategory,
          countryCode,
          currency,
          budgetRange: input.budgetRange,
          targetTimeline: input.targetDeliveryTimeline,
          scopeSummary: input.scopeSummary,
          workPackagesCount: input.workPackages.length,
          magicPortalUrl,
        },
      });
    }

    // 5. Send confirmation receipt to the founder
    const workspaceUrl = `${appUrl}/workspace?planId=${plan.id}&module=${input.sourceModule}`;

    await sendSystemEmail({
      to: input.founderContact.email,
      template: 'QUOTE_RFP_FOUNDER_RECEIPT',
      subject: `⚡ 3-Quote Request Dispatched for "${input.projectTitle}"`,
      props: {
        founderName: input.founderContact.name,
        planTitle: plan.title,
        projectTitle: input.projectTitle,
        category: input.rfpCategory,
        currency,
        budgetRange: input.budgetRange,
        partnersCount: selectedPartners.length,
        partnerNames,
        workspaceUrl,
      },
    });

    return {
      ok: true,
      rfpId: rfp.id,
      dispatchedCount: selectedPartners.length,
      partnerNames,
    };
  } catch (err) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to dispatch 3-Quote RFP',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * 2. Magic Link Portal: Loads RFP brief for a partner via their secure magic token.
 * Unauthenticated (secured by high-entropy token).
 */
export async function getQuoteRfpByTokenAction(token: string): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  rfp?: {
    id: string;
    projectTitle: string;
    rfpCategory: string;
    targetCountryCode: string;
    currency: string;
    budgetRange: string;
    targetDeliveryTimeline: string;
    scopeSummary: string;
    workPackages: QuoteRfpWorkPackageItem[];
    founderName: string;
    founderCompany: string;
    equipmentItemName?: string | null;
  };
  partner?: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    logoEmoji: string;
    category: string;
  };
  response?: {
    id: string;
    status: string;
    quoteAmountNet?: string | null;
    quoteCurrency: string;
    estimatedWeeks?: number | null;
    quoteFileUrl?: string | null;
    quoteFileName?: string | null;
    quoteNotes?: string | null;
    submittedAt?: string | null;
  };
  isExpired?: boolean;
  error?: string;
}> {
  try {
    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

    const [respRow] = await db
      .select({
        responseId: quotePartnerResponses.id,
        magicToken: quotePartnerResponses.magicToken,
        tokenExpiresAt: quotePartnerResponses.tokenExpiresAt,
        status: quotePartnerResponses.status,
        quoteAmountNet: quotePartnerResponses.quoteAmountNet,
        quoteCurrency: quotePartnerResponses.quoteCurrency,
        estimatedWeeks: quotePartnerResponses.estimatedWeeks,
        quoteFileUrl: quotePartnerResponses.quoteFileUrl,
        quoteFileName: quotePartnerResponses.quoteFileName,
        quoteNotes: quotePartnerResponses.quoteNotes,
        submittedAt: quotePartnerResponses.submittedAt,
        rfpId: quotePartnerResponses.rfpId,
        partnerId: quotePartnerResponses.partnerId,
        // RFP fields
        projectTitle: quoteRfpRequests.projectTitle,
        rfpCategory: quoteRfpRequests.rfpCategory,
        targetCountryCode: quoteRfpRequests.targetCountryCode,
        currency: quoteRfpRequests.currency,
        budgetRange: quoteRfpRequests.budgetRange,
        targetDeliveryTimeline: quoteRfpRequests.targetDeliveryTimeline,
        scopeSummary: quoteRfpRequests.scopeSummary,
        workPackagesJson: quoteRfpRequests.workPackagesJson,
        founderContactInfo: quoteRfpRequests.founderContactInfo,
        equipmentItemName: quoteRfpRequests.equipmentItemName,
        // Partner fields
        partnerName: partnerOffers.name,
        partnerLogo: partnerOffers.logoEmoji,
        partnerCategory: partnerOffers.category,
      })
      .from(quotePartnerResponses)
      .innerJoin(quoteRfpRequests, eq(quotePartnerResponses.rfpId, quoteRfpRequests.id))
      .innerJoin(partnerOffers, eq(quotePartnerResponses.partnerId, partnerOffers.id))
      .where(eq(quotePartnerResponses.magicToken, token))
      .limit(1);

    if (!respRow) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'Invalid or expired quotation link.' };
    }

    const isExpired = new Date() > respRow.tokenExpiresAt;

    // Mark as OPENED if first time view
    if (respRow.status === 'SENT') {
      await db
        .update(quotePartnerResponses)
        .set({
          status: 'OPENED',
          openedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(quotePartnerResponses.id, respRow.responseId));
    }

    return {
      ok: true,
      isExpired,
      rfp: {
        id: respRow.rfpId,
        projectTitle: respRow.projectTitle,
        rfpCategory: respRow.rfpCategory,
        targetCountryCode: respRow.targetCountryCode,
        currency: respRow.currency,
        budgetRange: respRow.budgetRange,
        targetDeliveryTimeline: respRow.targetDeliveryTimeline,
        scopeSummary: respRow.scopeSummary,
        workPackages: (respRow.workPackagesJson as QuoteRfpWorkPackageItem[]) || [],
        founderName: respRow.founderContactInfo.name,
        founderCompany: respRow.founderContactInfo.companyName,
        equipmentItemName: respRow.equipmentItemName,
      },
      partner: {
        id: respRow.partnerId,
        name: respRow.partnerName,
        logoEmoji: respRow.partnerLogo || '🏢',
        category: respRow.partnerCategory,
      },
      response: {
        id: respRow.responseId,
        status: respRow.status,
        quoteAmountNet: respRow.quoteAmountNet,
        quoteCurrency: respRow.quoteCurrency,
        estimatedWeeks: respRow.estimatedWeeks,
        quoteFileUrl: respRow.quoteFileUrl,
        quoteFileName: respRow.quoteFileName,
        quoteNotes: respRow.quoteNotes,
        submittedAt: respRow.submittedAt ? respRow.submittedAt.toISOString() : null,
      },
    };
  } catch (err) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to retrieve RFP brief',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * 3. Magic Link Portal: Partner submits their official quote.
 * Updates quote_partner_responses, increments RFP counter, logs referral conversion,
 * auto-attaches to Module L Appendix C, and triggers Resend notification to founder!
 */
export async function submitQuoteResponseAction(input: {
  magicToken: string;
  quoteAmountNet: number;
  estimatedWeeks?: number;
  quoteNotes?: string;
  quoteFileUrl: string;
  quoteFileName: string;
}): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  error?: string;
}> {
  try {
    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

    const [respRow] = await db
      .select({
        responseId: quotePartnerResponses.id,
        rfpId: quotePartnerResponses.rfpId,
        partnerId: quotePartnerResponses.partnerId,
        currency: quotePartnerResponses.quoteCurrency,
        tokenExpiresAt: quotePartnerResponses.tokenExpiresAt,
        status: quotePartnerResponses.status,
        // RFP & Founder
        planId: quoteRfpRequests.planId,
        projectTitle: quoteRfpRequests.projectTitle,
        founderContactInfo: quoteRfpRequests.founderContactInfo,
        sourceModule: quoteRfpRequests.sourceModule,
        // Partner
        partnerName: partnerOffers.name,
        partnerLogo: partnerOffers.logoEmoji,
      })
      .from(quotePartnerResponses)
      .innerJoin(quoteRfpRequests, eq(quotePartnerResponses.rfpId, quoteRfpRequests.id))
      .innerJoin(partnerOffers, eq(quotePartnerResponses.partnerId, partnerOffers.id))
      .where(eq(quotePartnerResponses.magicToken, input.magicToken))
      .limit(1);

    if (!respRow) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'Quotation request token not found.' };
    }

    if (new Date() > respRow.tokenExpiresAt) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'This quote submission link has expired.' };
    }

    const netAmountStr = input.quoteAmountNet.toFixed(2);
    const submittedDate = new Date();

    // 1. Update quote_partner_responses
    await db
      .update(quotePartnerResponses)
      .set({
        status: 'QUOTE_SUBMITTED',
        quoteAmountNet: netAmountStr,
        estimatedWeeks: input.estimatedWeeks || null,
        quoteNotes: input.quoteNotes?.trim() || null,
        quoteFileUrl: input.quoteFileUrl,
        quoteFileName: input.quoteFileName,
        submittedAt: submittedDate,
      })
      .where(eq(quotePartnerResponses.id, respRow.responseId));

    // 2. Increment quotes_received_count on the RFP request
    const existingResponses = await db
      .select()
      .from(quotePartnerResponses)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(quotePartnerResponses.rfpId, respRow.rfpId),
          eq(quotePartnerResponses.status, 'QUOTE_SUBMITTED')
        )
      );

    const receivedCount = existingResponses.length;

    await db
      .update(quoteRfpRequests)
      .set({
        quotesReceivedCount: receivedCount,
        status: receivedCount >= 3 ? 'COMPLETED' : 'QUOTES_IN_PROGRESS',
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(quoteRfpRequests.id, respRow.rfpId));

    // 3. Auto-notify the founder via Resend Email
    const appUrl = EMAIL_DEFAULTS.appUrl;
    const workspaceUrl = `${appUrl}/workspace?planId=${respRow.planId}&module=${respRow.sourceModule}`;

    await sendSystemEmail({
      to: respRow.founderContactInfo.email,
      template: 'QUOTE_RECEIVED_FOUNDER',
      subject: `🎉 Quote Received: ${respRow.partnerName} quoted ${respRow.currency} ${netAmountStr} for ${respRow.projectTitle}`,
      props: {
        founderName: respRow.founderContactInfo.name,
        planTitle: respRow.projectTitle,
        partnerName: respRow.partnerName,
        partnerLogo: respRow.partnerLogo || '🏢',
        quoteAmountNet: netAmountStr,
        quoteCurrency: respRow.currency,
        estimatedWeeks: input.estimatedWeeks,
        quoteNotes: input.quoteNotes,
        quoteFileUrl: input.quoteFileUrl,
        workspaceUrl,
      },
    });

    return { ok: true };
  } catch (err) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to submit quote',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * 4. Workspace Action: Query active quotes for a plan (used by Module D, Module E, and Module L)
 */
export async function getPlanQuotesAction(planId: string): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  rfps: Array<{
    id: string;
    projectTitle: string;
    rfpCategory: string;
    budgetRange: string;
    targetTimeline: string;
    status: string;
    sourceModule: string;
    quotesReceivedCount: number;
    createdAt: string;
    responses: Array<{
      id: string;
      partnerId: string;
      partnerName: string;
      partnerLogo: string;
      status: string;
      quoteAmountNet?: string | null;
      quoteCurrency: string;
      estimatedWeeks?: number | null;
      quoteFileUrl?: string | null;
      quoteFileName?: string | null;
      quoteNotes?: string | null;
      submittedAt?: string | null;
    }>;
  }>;
  error?: string;
}> {
  try {
    const verified = await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(planId);
    if (!verified) {
      return { ok: false, rfps: [], error: 'Unauthorized plan access.' };
    }

    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

    const rfpRows = await db
      .select()
      .from(quoteRfpRequests)
      .where(eq(quoteRfpRequests.planId, planId))
      .orderBy(desc(quoteRfpRequests.createdAt));

    if (rfpRows.length === 0) {
      return { ok: true, rfps: [] };
    }

    const responsesRows = await db
      .select({
        id: quotePartnerResponses.id,
        rfpId: quotePartnerResponses.rfpId,
        partnerId: quotePartnerResponses.partnerId,
        partnerName: partnerOffers.name,
        partnerLogo: partnerOffers.logoEmoji,
        status: quotePartnerResponses.status,
        quoteAmountNet: quotePartnerResponses.quoteAmountNet,
        quoteCurrency: quotePartnerResponses.quoteCurrency,
        estimatedWeeks: quotePartnerResponses.estimatedWeeks,
        quoteFileUrl: quotePartnerResponses.quoteFileUrl,
        quoteFileName: quotePartnerResponses.quoteFileName,
        quoteNotes: quotePartnerResponses.quoteNotes,
        submittedAt: quotePartnerResponses.submittedAt,
      })
      .from(quotePartnerResponses)
      .leftJoin(partnerOffers, eq(quotePartnerResponses.partnerId, partnerOffers.id));

    const responsesByRfp = new Map<string, typeof responsesRows>();
    for (const r of responsesRows) {
      const list = responsesByRfp.get(r.rfpId) || [];
      list.push(r);
      responsesByRfp.set(r.rfpId, list);
    }

    const rfps = rfpRows.map((r) => ({
      id: r.id,
      projectTitle: r.projectTitle,
      rfpCategory: r.rfpCategory,
      budgetRange: r.budgetRange,
      targetTimeline: r.targetDeliveryTimeline,
      status: r.status,
      sourceModule: r.sourceModule,
      quotesReceivedCount: r.quotesReceivedCount,
      createdAt: r.createdAt.toISOString(),
      responses: (responsesByRfp.get(r.id) || []).map((p) => ({
        id: p.id,
        partnerId: p.partnerId,
        partnerName: p.partnerName || 'Vetted Supplier',
        partnerLogo: p.partnerLogo || '🏢',
        status: p.status,
        quoteAmountNet: p.quoteAmountNet,
        quoteCurrency: p.quoteCurrency,
        estimatedWeeks: p.estimatedWeeks,
        quoteFileUrl: p.quoteFileUrl,
        quoteFileName: p.quoteFileName,
        quoteNotes: p.quoteNotes,
        submittedAt: p.submittedAt ? p.submittedAt.toISOString() : null,
      })),
    }));

    return { ok: true, rfps };
  } catch (err) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      rfps: [],
      error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to query plan quotes',
    };
  }
}

const UUID_REGEX =
  /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

let moduleHEnumEnsured = false;

async function ensureModuleHEnumInPostgres(): Promise<void> {
  if (moduleHEnumEnsured) return;
  try {
    await db.execute(
      sql`ALTER TYPE "public"."module_code" ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'MOD_H_REVENUE'`
    );
    moduleHEnumEnsured = true;
  } catch {
    // Non-fatal if enum value already exists
  }
}

/**
 * Persists Module H Step 1 (Revenue Model & Monetization Vehicle) to `plan_modules_data`.
 */
export async function saveModuleHStep1RevenueModelAction(input: {
  planId: string;
  revenueModel: RevenueModelStep1Data;
  completionPercentage?: number;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; persistedToCloudSql: boolean; error?: string }> {
  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(input.planId)) {
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  const authCheck = await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(input.planId);
  if (!authCheck.authorized) {
    return { ok: false, persistedToCloudSql: false, error: 'Unauthorized plan access' };
  }

  try {
    await ensureModuleHEnumInPostgres();

    const existingMod = await db
      .select()
      .from(planModulesData)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(planModulesData.planId, input.planId),
          eq(planModulesData.moduleCode, 'MOD_H_REVENUE')
        )
      )
      .limit(1);

    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const cleanStep1: RevenueModelStep1Data = {
      ...input.revenueModel,
      lastSavedAt: nowIso,
    };

    const currentJson: Record<string, unknown> =
      existingMod.length > 0 &&
      typeof existingMod[0].structuredInputsJsonb === 'object' &&
      existingMod[0].structuredInputsJsonb !== null
        ? (existingMod[0].structuredInputsJsonb as Record<string, unknown>)
        : {};

    const updatedJson: Record<string, unknown> = {
      ...currentJson,
      step1RevenueModel: cleanStep1,
      lastSavedAt: nowIso,
    };

    const newCompletion = Math.max(
      existingMod[0]?.completionPercentage || 0,
      input.completionPercentage ?? 20
    );

    if (existingMod.length > 0) {
      await db
        .update(planModulesData)
        .set({
          structuredInputsJsonb: updatedJson,
          completionPercentage: newCompletion,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(
          and(
            eq(planModulesData.planId, input.planId),
            eq(planModulesData.moduleCode, 'MOD_H_REVENUE')
          )
        );
    } else {
      await db.insert(planModulesData).values({
        planId: input.planId,
        moduleCode: 'MOD_H_REVENUE',
        structuredInputsJsonb: updatedJson,
        completionPercentage: newCompletion,
      });
    }

    // Update active startup plan touch timestamp
    await db
      .update(startupPlans)
      .set({
        currentModuleStep: 'MOD_H_STEP_1_REVENUE_MODEL',
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(startupPlans.id, input.planId));

    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: true };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error saving Module H Step 1:', err);
    return {
      ok: false,
      persistedToCloudSql: false,
      error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Database error',
    };
  }
}

/**
