        and(
          eq(planModulesData.planId, input.planId),
          eq(planModulesData.moduleCode, 'MOD_F_COFOUNDER_TEAM')
        )
      )
      .limit(1);

    if (modFRecord.length === 0) {
      return {
        ok: true,
        year1MonthlyPayroll: 3500,
        year2MonthlyPayroll: 8500,
        year3MonthlyPayroll: 16000,
        personalSurvivalBudgetMonthly: 2500,
        currency: 'EUR',
        sourceModuleFFound: false,
      };
    }

    const modFData = modFRecord[0].structuredInputsJsonb as SavedModuleFData;
    const step5 = modFData?.step5HiringPlanData;
    const step3 = modFData?.step3SurvivalBudgetData;

    // Calculate monthly founder survival budget across all co-founders if defined
    let survivalBudgetMonthly = 2500;
    if (step3?.founderBudgets && Array.isArray(step3.founderBudgets) && step3.founderBudgets.length > 0) {
      const totalMonthly = step3.founderBudgets.reduce((sum, b) => {
        const core =
          (Number(b.housingAndUtilities) || 0) +
          (Number(b.groceriesAndEssentials) || 0) +
          (Number(b.transportAndCommute) || 0) +
          (Number(b.debtAndLoanCommitments) || 0) +
          (Number(b.dependentsAndFamily) || 0);
        const netRequired = Math.max(0, core - (Number(b.incomeOffsetCushion) || 0));
        return sum + netRequired;
      }, 0);
      if (totalMonthly > 0) {
        survivalBudgetMonthly = Math.round(totalMonthly);
      }
    }

    // Calculate Y1, Y2, Y3 monthly payroll from Step 5 roles if present
    let y1AnnualTotal = 0;
    let y2AnnualTotal = 0;
    let y3AnnualTotal = 0;

    if (step5?.roles && Array.isArray(step5.roles)) {
      for (const role of step5.roles) {
        const gross = Number(role.grossAnnualSalary) || 0;
        const taxRate = 0.11; // Standard employer social contribution
        const fullyLoaded = gross * (1 + taxRate);
        if (role.yearScheduled <= 1) y1AnnualTotal += fullyLoaded;
        if (role.yearScheduled <= 2) y2AnnualTotal += fullyLoaded;
        if (role.yearScheduled <= 3) y3AnnualTotal += fullyLoaded;
      }
    }

    // Add contractor budgets
    const y1Contractor = Number(step5?.contractorBudgetYear1) || 0;
    const y2Contractor = Number(step5?.contractorBudgetYear2) || 0;
    const y3Contractor = Number(step5?.contractorBudgetYear3) || 0;

    const y1Monthly = Math.round((y1AnnualTotal + y1Contractor) / 12) || (survivalBudgetMonthly + 1000);
    const y2Monthly = Math.round((y2AnnualTotal + y2Contractor) / 12) || (y1Monthly * 2.2);
    const y3Monthly = Math.round((y3AnnualTotal + y3Contractor) / 12) || (y1Monthly * 4.2);

    return {
      ok: true,
      year1MonthlyPayroll: y1Monthly,
      year2MonthlyPayroll: y2Monthly,
      year3MonthlyPayroll: y3Monthly,
      personalSurvivalBudgetMonthly: survivalBudgetMonthly,
      currency: 'EUR',
      sourceModuleFFound: true,
    };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error fetching canonical payroll baseline:', err);
    return {
      ok: false,
      year1MonthlyPayroll: 3500,
      year2MonthlyPayroll: 8500,
      year3MonthlyPayroll: 16000,
      personalSurvivalBudgetMonthly: 2500,
      currency: 'EUR',
      sourceModuleFFound: false,
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Server action to generate an investor & grant-grade Pricing Strategy Justification
 * using rich cross-module intelligence (Mod A, B, C, D, H).
 */
export async function generatePricingStrategyJustificationAction(input: {
  planId: string;
  blendedAveragePrice: number;
  currencySymbol: string;
  revenueModelVehicle?: string;
  tiersSummary?: string;
  planTitle?: string;
  industryCategory?: string;
  hqCountryCode?: SupportedCountryCode;
  beachheadCustomer?: string;
  unfairAdvantage?: string;
}): Promise<GeneratePricingStrategyJustificationResult> {
  // Cross-module context aggregation from Cloud SQL / local Postgres
  let planTitle = input.planTitle || 'Startup Plan';
  let industryCategory = input.industryCategory || 'Technology';
  let hqCountryCode: SupportedCountryCode = input.hqCountryCode || 'IE';
  let primaryChannel = 'DIRECT_WEB_STRIPE';
  let estimatedBlendedFeePercent = 2.9;
  let beachheadCustomer = input.beachheadCustomer || '';
  let willingnessToPayInsights = '';
  let competitorPriceRange = '';
  let unfairAdvantage = input.unfairAdvantage || '';

  if (UUID_REGEX.test(input.planId)) {
    try {
      const authCheck = await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(input.planId);
      if (authCheck.authorized) {
        const planRows = await db
          .select()
          .from(startupPlans)
          .where(eq(startupPlans.id, input.planId))
          .limit(1);

        if (planRows.length > 0) {
          planTitle = planRows[0].title || planTitle;
          industryCategory = planRows[0].industryCategory || industryCategory;
          hqCountryCode = (planRows[0].hqCountryCode as SupportedCountryCode) || hqCountryCode;
        }

        const modRows = await db
          .select()
          .from(planModulesData)
          .where(eq(planModulesData.planId, input.planId));

        // Module A context (Concept & Unfair Advantage)
        const modA = modRows.find((m) => m.moduleCode === 'MOD_A_IDEATION');
        if (modA?.structuredInputsJsonb) {
          const aData = modA.structuredInputsJsonb as Record<string, any>;
          unfairAdvantage =
            aData.conceptCanvas?.unfairAdvantage ||
            aData.brainDumpText ||
            unfairAdvantage;
        }

        // Module B context (Beachhead persona & competitor positioning)
        const modB = modRows.find((m) => m.moduleCode === 'MOD_B_MARKET');
        if (modB?.structuredInputsJsonb) {
          const bData = modB.structuredInputsJsonb as Record<string, any>;
          beachheadCustomer =
            bData.step1BeachheadPersona?.personaTitle ||
            bData.step1BeachheadPersona?.demographicsSummary ||
            beachheadCustomer;
          if (bData.step2CompetitorScout?.competitors?.length) {
            const comps = bData.step2CompetitorScout.competitors
              .slice(0, 3)
              .map((c: any) => `${c.name} (${c.pricingSummary || 'Standard pricing'})`)
              .join(', ');
            competitorPriceRange = comps;
          }
        }

        // Module C context (Willingness-to-pay & customer feedback)
        const modC = modRows.find((m) => m.moduleCode === 'MOD_C_SURVEYS_FEEDBACK');
        if (modC?.structuredInputsJsonb) {
          const cData = modC.structuredInputsJsonb as Record<string, any>;
          if (cData.surveys?.[0]?.aiInsightsSummary) {
            willingnessToPayInsights =
              cData.surveys[0].aiInsightsSummary.commercialViabilityAssessment ||
              cData.surveys[0].aiInsightsSummary.executiveValidationSummary ||
              '';
          }
        }

        // Module D context (Channel matrix & platform fees)
        const modD = modRows.find((m) => m.moduleCode === 'MOD_D_PRODUCT_BUILD');
        if (modD?.structuredInputsJsonb) {
          const dData = modD.structuredInputsJsonb as Record<string, any>;
          if (dData.channelMatrix) {
            primaryChannel = dData.channelMatrix.primaryChannel || primaryChannel;
            estimatedBlendedFeePercent =
              dData.channelMatrix.estimatedBlendedFeePercent ?? estimatedBlendedFeePercent;
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Non-fatal context gathering warning for pricing justification AI:', e);
    }
  }

  return await generatePricingStrategyJustificationViaRouter({
    planTitle,
    industryCategory,
    hqCountryCode,
    currencySymbol: input.currencySymbol,
    revenueModelVehicle: input.revenueModelVehicle,
    blendedAveragePrice: input.blendedAveragePrice,
    tiersSummary: input.tiersSummary,
    primaryChannel,
    estimatedBlendedFeePercent,
    beachheadCustomer,
    willingnessToPayInsights,
    competitorPriceRange,
    unfairAdvantage,
  });
}

/**
 * Persists Module H Step 4 (Sales Velocity, Capacity & Written Assumptions) to `plan_modules_data`.
 */
export async function saveModuleHStep4SalesAssumptionsAction(input: {
  planId: string;
  salesAssumptions: SalesAssumptionsStep4Data;
  completionPercentage?: number;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; persistedToCloudSql: boolean; error?: string }> {
  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(input.planId)) {
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  const authCheck = await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(input.planId);
  if (!authCheck.authorized) {
    return { ok: false, persistedToCloudSql: false, error: 'Unauthorized plan access' };
  }

  try {
    await ensureModuleHEnumInPostgres();

    const existingMod = await db
      .select()
      .from(planModulesData)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(planModulesData.planId, input.planId),
          eq(planModulesData.moduleCode, 'MOD_H_REVENUE')
        )
      )
      .limit(1);

    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const cleanStep4: SalesAssumptionsStep4Data = {
      ...input.salesAssumptions,
      lastSavedAt: nowIso,
    };

    const currentJson: Record<string, unknown> =
      existingMod.length > 0 &&
      typeof existingMod[0].structuredInputsJsonb === 'object' &&
      existingMod[0].structuredInputsJsonb !== null
        ? (existingMod[0].structuredInputsJsonb as Record<string, unknown>)
        : {};

    const updatedJson: Record<string, unknown> = {
      ...currentJson,
      step4SalesAssumptions: cleanStep4,
      lastSavedAt: nowIso,
    };

    const newCompletion = Math.max(
      existingMod[0]?.completionPercentage || 0,
      input.completionPercentage ?? 80
    );

    if (existingMod.length > 0) {
      await db
        .update(planModulesData)
        .set({
          structuredInputsJsonb: updatedJson,
          completionPercentage: newCompletion,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(
          and(
            eq(planModulesData.planId, input.planId),
            eq(planModulesData.moduleCode, 'MOD_H_REVENUE')
          )
        );
    } else {
      await db.insert(planModulesData).values({
        planId: input.planId,
        moduleCode: 'MOD_H_REVENUE',
        structuredInputsJsonb: updatedJson,
        completionPercentage: newCompletion,
      });
    }

    await db
      .update(startupPlans)
      .set({
        currentModuleStep: 'MOD_H_STEP_4_SALES_ASSUMPTIONS',
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(startupPlans.id, input.planId));

    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: true };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error saving Module H Step 4:', err);
    return {
      ok: false,
      persistedToCloudSql: false,
      error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Database error',
    };
  }
}

=== src/app/actions/admin-survey-boost.ts ===
'use server';

import { db } from '@/db';
import {
  surveyBoostPricingTiers,
  surveyBoostOrders,
  surveyResponses,
  validationSurveys,
  startupPlans,
  users,
} from '@/db/schema';
import { eq, desc, sql } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { ProlificService } from '@/lib/panels/prolific-service';
import { getAdminSessionCookie } from '@/lib/auth/server-auth';

async function requireSuperAdmin() {
  const session = await getAdminSessionCookie();
  if (!session || session.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
    return null;
  }
  return session;
}

export interface AdminSurveyBoostData {
  stats: {
    totalOrders: number;
    totalRevenueEur: number;
    totalDeliveredResponses: number;
    activeOrdersCount: number;
  };
  orders: any[];
  tiers: any[];
  prolificAccount: any;
}

/**
 * Fetch all survey boost orders, tiers, and live Prolific account telemetry
 */
export async function getAdminSurveyBoostDataAction(): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  data?: AdminSurveyBoostData;
  error?: string;
}> {
  try {
    const admin = await requireSuperAdmin();
    if (!admin) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized: Super Admin session required.' };
    }
    const [tiers, orders] = await Promise.all([
      db
        .select()
        .from(surveyBoostPricingTiers)
        .orderBy(surveyBoostPricingTiers.displayOrder),
      db
        .select({
          order: surveyBoostOrders,
          surveyTitle: validationSurveys.title,
          surveySlug: validationSurveys.publicSlug,
          planTitle: startupPlans.title,
          userEmail: users.email,
          userName: users.name,
        })
        .from(surveyBoostOrders)
        .leftJoin(
          validationSurveys,
          eq(surveyBoostOrders.surveyId, validationSurveys.id)
        )
        .leftJoin(startupPlans, eq(surveyBoostOrders.planId, startupPlans.id))
        .leftJoin(users, eq(surveyBoostOrders.userId, users.id))
        .orderBy(desc(surveyBoostOrders.createdAt)),
    ]);

    // Calculate revenue & stats
    const totalOrders = orders.length;
    const totalDeliveredResponses = orders.reduce(
      (sum, o) => sum + (o.order.deliveredResponses || 0),
      0
    );
    const totalRevenueEur =
      orders
        .filter((o) => o.order.status !== 'PENDING_PAYMENT')
        .reduce((sum, o) => sum + (o.order.amountPaidCents || 0), 0) / 100;

    const activeOrdersCount = orders.filter(
      (o) =>
        o.order.status === 'PAID' ||
        o.order.status === 'DISPATCHED_TO_PANEL' ||
        o.order.status === 'PARTIALLY_DELIVERED'
    ).length;

    // Check Prolific account info
    const prolificRes = await ProlificService.getAccountDetails();

    return {
      success: true,
      data: {
        stats: {
          totalOrders,
          totalRevenueEur,
          totalDeliveredResponses,
          activeOrdersCount,
        },
        orders: orders.map((o) => ({
          ...o.order,
          surveyTitle: o.surveyTitle,
          surveySlug: o.surveySlug,
          planTitle: o.planTitle,
          userEmail: o.userEmail,
          userName: o.userName,
        })),
        tiers,
        prolificAccount: prolificRes.success ? prolificRes.account : null,
      },
    };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error('[getAdminSurveyBoostDataAction] Error:', err);
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    return { success: false, error: msg };
  }
}

/**
 * Dispatch an order to Prolific programmatically with 1 click
 */
export async function dispatchOrderToProlificAction(orderId: string): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  studyId?: string;
  error?: string;
}> {
  try {
    const admin = await requireSuperAdmin();
    if (!admin) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized: Super Admin session required.' };
    }
    const [order] = await db
      .select({
        order: surveyBoostOrders,
        surveySlug: validationSurveys.publicSlug,
        surveyTitle: validationSurveys.title,
      })
      .from(surveyBoostOrders)
      .leftJoin(
        validationSurveys,
        eq(surveyBoostOrders.surveyId, validationSurveys.id)
      )
      .where(eq(surveyBoostOrders.id, orderId as any))
      .limit(1);

    if (!order || !order.surveySlug) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Order or survey slug not found.' };
    }

    const appUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL || 'https://startuppreflight.com';
    const completionCode = `SPF_${order.order.id.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()}`;
    const externalStudyUrl = `${appUrl}/v/${order.surveySlug}?src=prolific&order_id=${order.order.id}&prolific_pid={{%PROLIFIC_PID%}}&session_id={{%SESSION_ID%}}`;

    const demo = (order.order.targetDemographicsJson as any) || {};

    const createRes = await ProlificService.createStudy({
      name: `${order.surveyTitle || 'Startup Concept'} Validation Survey`,
      description: `Short 3-minute validation study for an early-stage venture. Please answer honestly.`,
      externalStudyUrl,
      totalAvailablePlaces: order.order.targetResponses,
      targetCountryCode: (order.order.targetCountryCode as any) || 'IE',
      completionCode,
    });

    if (!createRes.success || !createRes.study) {
      return { success: false, error: createRes.error };
    }

    // Update order with study details
    await db
      .update(surveyBoostOrders)
      .set({
        panelProvider: 'PROLIFIC',
        panelSurveyId: createRes.study.id,
        panelStatus: createRes.study.status,
        status: 'DISPATCHED_TO_PANEL',
        dispatchedAt: new Date(),
        adminNotes: `Prolific Study Created: ${createRes.study.id} (${createRes.study.status}). Completion Code: ${completionCode}`,
      })
      .where(eq(surveyBoostOrders.id, orderId as any));

    return { success: true, studyId: createRes.study.id };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error('[dispatchOrderToProlificAction] Error:', err);
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    return { success: false, error: msg };
  }
}

/**
 * Manually update status or delivered count for an order
 */
export async function updateSurveyBoostOrderStatusAction(input: {
  orderId: string;
  status: string;
  deliveredResponses?: number;
  adminNotes?: string;
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {

    const admin = await requireSuperAdmin();
    if (!admin) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized: Super Admin session required.' };
    }
    const updateData: any = {
      status: input.status,
    };
    if (input.deliveredResponses !== undefined) {
      updateData.deliveredResponses = input.deliveredResponses;
    }
    if (input.adminNotes !== undefined) {
      updateData.adminNotes = input.adminNotes;
    }
    if (input.status === 'COMPLETED') {
      updateData.completedAt = new Date();
    }

    await db
      .update(surveyBoostOrders)
      .set(updateData)
      .where(eq(surveyBoostOrders.id, input.orderId as any));

    return { success: true };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error('[updateSurveyBoostOrderStatusAction] Error:', err);
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    return { success: false, error: msg };
  }
}

const UUID_REGEX =
  /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

let moduleLEnumEnsured = false;

async function ensureModuleLEnumInPostgres(): Promise<void> {
  if (moduleLEnumEnsured) return;
  try {
    await db.execute(
      sql`ALTER TYPE "public"."module_code" ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'MOD_L_BUSINESS_PLAN'`
    );
    moduleLEnumEnsured = true;
  } catch {
    // Non-fatal if enum value already exists
  }
}

/**
 * Persists Module L Step 1 (Compiler Mode & Assessor Rubric Selection) to `plan_modules_data`
 * while preserving any existing `masterDocumentData` or Steps 2–5 data.
 */
export async function saveModuleLStep1ModeAction(input: {
  planId: string;
  step1Mode: ModuleLStep1ModeSavedData;
  completionPercentage?: number;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; persistedToCloudSql: boolean; error?: string }> {
  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(input.planId)) {
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  try {
    const authCheck = await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(input.planId);
    if (!authCheck.authorized) {
      return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
    }

    await ensureModuleLEnumInPostgres();

    const existingMod = await db
      .select()
      .from(planModulesData)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(planModulesData.planId, input.planId),
          eq(planModulesData.moduleCode, 'MOD_L_BUSINESS_PLAN')
        )
      )
      .limit(1);

    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const cleanStep1: ModuleLStep1ModeSavedData = {
      ...input.step1Mode,
      lastSavedAt: nowIso,
    };

    const currentJson: Record<string, unknown> =
      existingMod.length > 0 &&
      typeof existingMod[0].structuredInputsJsonb === 'object' &&
      existingMod[0].structuredInputsJsonb !== null
        ? (existingMod[0].structuredInputsJsonb as Record<string, unknown>)
        : {};

    const nextProgress = Math.max(
      typeof currentJson.completionPercentage === 'number'
        ? currentJson.completionPercentage
        : existingMod[0]?.completionPercentage || 0,
      input.completionPercentage ?? 20
    );

    const updatedJson: Record<string, unknown> = {
      ...currentJson,
      step1Mode: cleanStep1,
      completionPercentage: nextProgress,
      lastSavedAt: nowIso,
    };

    if (existingMod.length > 0) {
      await db
        .update(planModulesData)
        .set({
          structuredInputsJsonb: updatedJson,
          completionPercentage: nextProgress,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(planModulesData.id, existingMod[0].id));
    } else {
      await db.insert(planModulesData).values({
        planId: input.planId,
        moduleCode: 'MOD_L_BUSINESS_PLAN',
        completionPercentage: nextProgress,
        structuredInputsJsonb: updatedJson,
        aiThingsToConsiderJsonb: [],
      });
    }

    await db
      .update(startupPlans)
      .set({
        currentModuleStep: 'MOD_L_STEP_1_MODE',
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(startupPlans.id, input.planId));

    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: true };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown database error';
    return { ok: false, persistedToCloudSql: false, error: message };
  }
}

/**
 * Persists the founder's Living Master Document story or view settings
 * to `plan_modules_data` (`MOD_L_BUSINESS_PLAN`).
 */
export async function saveMasterDocumentDataAction(input: {
  planId: string;
  masterDocumentData: SavedMasterDocumentData;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; persistedToCloudSql: boolean }> {
  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(input.planId)) {
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  const authCheck = await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(input.planId);
  if (!authCheck.authorized) {
    return { ok: false, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  const sanitizedData: SavedMasterDocumentData = {
    ...input.masterDocumentData,
    paragraph1OpportunityAndMarket: sanitizeSurveyTerminologyForReader(
      input.masterDocumentData.paragraph1OpportunityAndMarket
    ),
    paragraph2ValidationAndProduct: sanitizeSurveyTerminologyForReader(
      input.masterDocumentData.paragraph2ValidationAndProduct
    ),
    paragraph3OperationsAndExecution: sanitizeSurveyTerminologyForReader(
      input.masterDocumentData.paragraph3OperationsAndExecution
    ),
  };

  try {
    await ensureModLEnumInPostgres();

    const existingMod = await db
      .select()
      .from(planModulesData)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(planModulesData.planId, input.planId),
          eq(planModulesData.moduleCode, 'MOD_L_BUSINESS_PLAN')
        )
      )
      .limit(1);

    const existingPayload = (existingMod[0]?.structuredInputsJsonb ??
      {}) as Record<string, unknown>;

    const nextPayload = {
      ...existingPayload,
      masterDocumentData: sanitizedData,
      lastSavedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    if (existingMod[0]) {
      await db
        .update(planModulesData)
        .set({
          structuredInputsJsonb: nextPayload,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(planModulesData.id, existingMod[0].id));
    } else {
      await db.insert(planModulesData).values({
        planId: input.planId,
        moduleCode: 'MOD_L_BUSINESS_PLAN',
        completionPercentage: 50,
        structuredInputsJsonb: nextPayload,
        aiThingsToConsiderJsonb: [],
      });
    }

    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: true };
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(
      '[SPF Master Document] Non-fatal error saving master document data:',
      err
    );
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }
}

/**
 * Weaves the 3-Paragraph Cohesive Executive Story using strictly grounded,
 * zero-hallucination facts from Modules A–E via the central AI router,
 * and saves the result to PostgreSQL when a cloud plan is active.
 */
export async function weaveMasterDocumentStoryWithAiAction(input: {
  planId: string;
  facts: MasterDocumentVerifiedFacts;
}): Promise<MasterDocumentStoryWeaveResult> {
  if (UUID_REGEX.test(input.planId)) {
    const authCheck = await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(input.planId);
    if (!authCheck.authorized) {
      return {
        allowed: false,
        reason: authCheck.reason || 'Unauthorized access to startup plan.',
        story: buildDeterministicMasterStory(input.facts),
        engineMode: 'smart-synthesizer',
      };
    }
  }

  const res = await weaveMasterDocumentStoryViaRouter({
    planId: input.planId,
    facts: input.facts,
  });

  if (UUID_REGEX.test(input.planId) && res.allowed) {
    await saveMasterDocumentDataAction({
      planId: input.planId,
      masterDocumentData: res.story,
    }).catch(() => {});
  }

  return res;
}

/**
 * Persists Module G (Launchpad & Operations Hub) setup cards to `plan_modules_data`.
 */
export async function saveModuleGLaunchpadDataAction(input: {
  planId: string;
  data: SavedModuleGData;
  completionPercentage?: number;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; persistedToCloudSql: boolean; error?: string }> {
  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(input.planId)) {
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  try {
    const authCheck = await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(input.planId);
    if (!authCheck.authorized) {
      return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
    }

    await ensureModuleGEnumInPostgres();

    const existingMod = await db
      .select()
      .from(planModulesData)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(planModulesData.planId, input.planId),
          eq(planModulesData.moduleCode, 'MOD_G_LAUNCHPAD')
        )
      )
      .limit(1);

    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const updatedJson: Record<string, unknown> = {
      ...(existingMod[0]?.structuredInputsJsonb &&
      typeof existingMod[0].structuredInputsJsonb === 'object'
        ? (existingMod[0].structuredInputsJsonb as Record<string, unknown>)
        : {}),
      ...input.data,
      lastSavedAt: nowIso,
    };

    const newCompletion = Math.max(
      existingMod[0]?.completionPercentage || 0,
      input.completionPercentage ?? input.data.completionPercentage ?? 0
    );

    if (existingMod.length > 0) {
      await db
        .update(planModulesData)
        .set({
          structuredInputsJsonb: updatedJson,
          completionPercentage: newCompletion,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(
          and(
            eq(planModulesData.planId, input.planId),
            eq(planModulesData.moduleCode, 'MOD_G_LAUNCHPAD')
          )
        );
    } else {
      await db.insert(planModulesData).values({
        planId: input.planId,
        moduleCode: 'MOD_G_LAUNCHPAD',
        structuredInputsJsonb: updatedJson,
        completionPercentage: newCompletion,
        aiThingsToConsiderJsonb: [],
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      });
    }

    await db
      .update(startupPlans)
      .set({
        currentModuleStep: 'MOD_G_LAUNCHPAD',
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(startupPlans.id, input.planId));

    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: true };
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(
      '[SPF Module G] Non-fatal error persisting Launchpad data:',
      err
    );
    return {
      ok: false,
      persistedToCloudSql: false,
      error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Database save failed',
    };
  }
}

'use server';

import { db } from '@/db';
import { emailLogs } from '@/db/schema';
import { desc, eq, ilike, or } from 'drizzle-orm';

  sendSystemEmail,
  renderEmailHtml,

  TemplatePropsMap,
} from '@/lib/email/send';

import { getAdminSessionCookie } from '@/lib/auth/server-auth';

async function requireSuperAdmin() {
  const session = await getAdminSessionCookie();
  if (!session || session.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
    return null;
  }
  return session;
}

export interface EmailLogSummary {
  id: string;
  recipient: string;
  template: string;
  subject: string;
  status: string;
  resendId: string | null;
  fromEmail: string;
  replyTo: string | null;
  metadataJson: Record<string, unknown> | null;
  errorMessage: string | null;
  openedAt: string | null;
  deliveredAt: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
}

export interface ListEmailLogsResult {
  ok: boolean;
  logs: EmailLogSummary[];
  stats: {
    totalSent: number;
    delivered: number;
    bouncedOrFailed: number;
    mockDev: number;
  };
  error?: string;
}

/**
 * Lists the most recent transactional email logs for super admin audit.
 */
export async function listAdminEmailLogsAction(
  searchQuery?: string
): Promise<ListEmailLogsResult> {
  try {
    const admin = await requireSuperAdmin();
    if (!admin) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        logs: [],
        stats: { totalSent: 0, delivered: 0, bouncedOrFailed: 0, mockDev: 0 },
        error: 'Unauthorized: Super Admin session required.',
      };
    }
    const rows = await db
      .select()
      .from(emailLogs)
      .orderBy(desc(emailLogs.createdAt))
      .limit(100);

    const filtered = searchQuery?.trim()
      ? rows.filter(
          (r) =>
            r.recipient.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
            r.subject.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
            r.template.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase())
        )
      : rows;

    const stats = {
      totalSent: rows.length,
      delivered: rows.filter((r) => r.status === 'DELIVERED').length,
      bouncedOrFailed: rows.filter(
        (r) => r.status === 'BOUNCED' || r.status === 'FAILED'
      ).length,
      mockDev: rows.filter((r) => r.status === 'MOCK_DEV').length,
    };

    return {
      ok: true,
      logs: filtered.map((r) => ({
        id: r.id,
        recipient: r.recipient,
        template: r.template,
        subject: r.subject,
        status: r.status,
        resendId: r.resendId,
        fromEmail: r.fromEmail,
        replyTo: r.replyTo,
        metadataJson: (r.metadataJson as Record<string, unknown>) || {},
        errorMessage: r.errorMessage,
        openedAt: r.openedAt ? r.openedAt.toISOString() : null,
        deliveredAt: r.deliveredAt ? r.deliveredAt.toISOString() : null,
        createdAt: r.createdAt.toISOString(),
      })),
      stats,
    };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error('[listAdminEmailLogsAction Error]:', err);
    return {
      ok: false,
      logs: [],
      stats: { totalSent: 0, delivered: 0, bouncedOrFailed: 0, mockDev: 0 },
      error: 'Failed to retrieve email logs from database.',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Preview any template rendered as HTML for visual inspection in the admin studio.
 */
export async function previewAdminEmailAction(
  template: EmailTemplateType,
  sampleProps?: Record<string, unknown>
): Promise<{ ok: boolean; html?: string; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const admin = await requireSuperAdmin();
    if (!admin) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'Unauthorized: Super Admin session required.' };
    }
    const props =
      sampleProps || getDefaultSamplePropsForTemplate(template);
    const html = await renderEmailHtml(
      template,
      props as unknown as TemplatePropsMap[EmailTemplateType]
    );
    return { ok: true, html };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Render failed';
    return { ok: false, error: msg };
  }
}

/**
 * Send a live test email directly to the admin's personal inbox via Resend.

export async function sendAdminTestEmailAction(
  targetEmail: string,
  template: EmailTemplateType
): Promise<{ ok: boolean; resendId?: string; isMockDev?: boolean; error?: string }> {

  const sampleProps = getDefaultSamplePropsForTemplate(template);
  const subjects: Record<EmailTemplateType, string> = {

    QUOTE_RECEIVED_FOUNDER: '🎉 Official Supplier Quote Received! [TEST]',

  const result = await sendSystemEmail({
    to: targetEmail,
    template,
    subject: subjects[template] || 'Startup Preflight Test Notification',
    props: sampleProps as unknown as TemplatePropsMap[EmailTemplateType],

'use server';

import { and, desc, eq, sql } from 'drizzle-orm';

  db,

  surveyResponses,

  getCanonicalResponseSignature,
  type SavedValidationSurvey,
  type SavedSurveyResponse,

  type SurveyFocusAreaType,

  type SurveyResponseAnswerValue,
  type SurveyAiInsightsSummary,
  type SurveyOutreachTemplates,
  type SavedCustomerInterviewLog,

  type SavedModuleBData,
} from '@/lib/auth/session-store';

const UUID_REGEX =
  /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

let moduleEnumEnsured = false;

async function ensureModuleCodeEnumValues(): Promise<void> {
  if (moduleEnumEnsured) return;
  try {
    await db.execute(
      sql`ALTER TYPE "public"."module_code" ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'MOD_C_SURVEYS_FEEDBACK'`
    );
    await db.execute(
      sql`ALTER TYPE "public"."module_code" ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'MOD_D_PRODUCT_BUILD'`
    );
    await db.execute(
      sql`ALTER TYPE "public"."module_code" ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'MOD_E_OPERATIONS'`
    );
    await db.execute(
      sql`ALTER TYPE "public"."module_code" ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'MOD_F_COFOUNDER_TEAM'`
    );
    await db.execute(
      sql`ALTER TYPE "public"."module_code" ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'MOD_G_LAUNCHPAD'`
    );
    await db.execute(
      sql`ALTER TYPE "public"."module_code" ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'MOD_H_REVENUE'`
    );
    await db.execute(
      sql`ALTER TYPE "public"."module_code" ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'MOD_I_MARKETING'`
    );

      sql`ALTER TYPE "public"."module_code" ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'MOD_J_FINANCE'`
    );
    await db.execute(

function mapDbResponseRowToSavedResponse(
  r: typeof surveyResponses.$inferSelect
): SavedSurveyResponse & { clientResponseId?: string } {
  const rawAns = (r.answersJsonb || {}) as {
    answers?: Record<string, SurveyResponseAnswerValue>;
    respondentNameOrRole?: string;
    isSimulated?: boolean;
    clientResponseId?: string;
  } & Record<string, SurveyResponseAnswerValue>;

  const answersMap =
    rawAns.answers && typeof rawAns.answers === 'object'
      ? rawAns.answers
      : (rawAns as Record<string, SurveyResponseAnswerValue>);

  return {
    id: r.id,
    surveyId: r.surveyId,
    answers: answersMap,
    respondentNameOrRole:
      typeof rawAns.respondentNameOrRole === 'string'
        ? rawAns.respondentNameOrRole
        : undefined,
    respondentEmail: r.respondentEmail || undefined,
    joinedWaitlist: r.joinedWaitlist,
    isSimulated: Boolean(rawAns.isSimulated),
    submittedAt: r.submittedAt.toISOString(),
    clientResponseId:
      typeof rawAns.clientResponseId === 'string'
        ? rawAns.clientResponseId
        : undefined,
  };
}

/**
 * Saves or updates a Validation Survey in PostgreSQL (`validation_surveys`, `survey_responses`, and `plan_modules_data`).
 */
export async function saveValidationSurveyAction(input: {
  planId: string;
  survey: SavedValidationSurvey;
  allSurveys: SavedValidationSurvey[];
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; persistedToCloudSql: boolean }> {
  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(input.planId)) {
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  const authCheck = await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(input.planId);
  if (!authCheck.authorized) {
    return { ok: false, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  try {
    await ensureModuleCodeEnumValues();
    // 1. Upsert into validation_surveys by publicSlug
    const existingBySlug = await db
      .select()
      .from(validationSurveys)
      .where(eq(validationSurveys.publicSlug, input.survey.publicSlug))
      .limit(1);

    let surveyDbId: string;
    let effectiveQuestions = input.survey.questions || [];
    let effectiveTitle = input.survey.title || 'Untitled Customer Survey';
    let effectiveIntro = input.survey.introDescription || '';
    let effectiveWaitlist = input.survey.waitlistIncentiveText || '';
    let effectiveCollectEmails = input.survey.collectLeadEmails;
    let effectiveAiInsights = input.survey.aiInsightsSummary;
    let effectiveIsPublished = Boolean(input.survey.isPublished);
    let effectivePublishedAt = input.survey.publishedAt;

    if (existingBySlug.length > 0) {
      const existingRow = existingBySlug[0];
      if (existingRow.planId !== input.planId) {
        return { ok: false, persistedToCloudSql: false };
      }
      surveyDbId = existingRow.id;
      const dbQuestions = (existingRow.questionsJsonb || []) as SurveyQuestionItem[];
      const existingMeta = (existingRow.outreachTemplatesJsonb || {}) as {
        isPublished?: boolean;
        publishedAt?: string;
      };
      const wasAlreadyPublished = Boolean(existingMeta.isPublished);

      if (wasAlreadyPublished && dbQuestions.length > 0) {
        // SERVER-SIDE AUDIT LOCK: Once published, questions, title, and options cannot be altered
        effectiveIsPublished = true;
        effectivePublishedAt =
          existingMeta.publishedAt ||
          input.survey.publishedAt ||
          existingRow.createdAt.toISOString();
        effectiveQuestions = dbQuestions;
        if (existingRow.title && existingRow.title !== 'Untitled Customer Survey') {
          effectiveTitle = existingRow.title;
        }
        effectiveIntro = existingRow.introDescription || effectiveIntro;
        effectiveWaitlist = existingRow.waitlistIncentiveText || effectiveWaitlist;
        effectiveCollectEmails = existingRow.collectLeadEmails;
      } else {
        // Guard against accidental blank overwrite if DB already has questions and incoming has 0 while responses exist
        if (
          effectiveQuestions.length === 0 &&
          dbQuestions.length > 0 &&
          (input.survey.responses?.length || 0) > 0
        ) {
          effectiveQuestions = dbQuestions;
        }
        if (
          (!input.survey.title ||
            input.survey.title === 'Untitled Customer Survey') &&
          existingRow.title &&
          existingRow.title !== 'Untitled Customer Survey'
        ) {
          effectiveTitle = existingRow.title;
        }
        effectiveIntro =
          input.survey.introDescription || existingRow.introDescription || '';
        effectiveWaitlist =
          input.survey.waitlistIncentiveText ||
          existingRow.waitlistIncentiveText ||
          '';
        if (effectiveIsPublished && !effectivePublishedAt) {
          effectivePublishedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        }
      }

      const existingInsights = existingRow.aiInsightsSummaryJsonb as
        | SurveyAiInsightsSummary
        | undefined;
      if (
        !effectiveAiInsights &&
        existingInsights &&
        typeof existingInsights === 'object' &&
        'headlineTakeaway' in existingInsights
      ) {
        effectiveAiInsights = existingInsights;
      }

      await db
        .update(validationSurveys)
        .set({
          title: effectiveTitle,
          introDescription: effectiveIntro,
          isActive: input.survey.isActive,
          collectLeadEmails: effectiveCollectEmails,
          waitlistIncentiveText: effectiveWaitlist,
          questionsJsonb: effectiveQuestions,
          aiInsightsSummaryJsonb: effectiveAiInsights || {},
          ...(input.survey.interviewLogs
            ? { interviewLogsJsonb: input.survey.interviewLogs }
            : {}),
          outreachTemplatesJsonb: {
            ...existingMeta,
            ...(input.survey.outreachTemplates || {}),
            isPublished: effectiveIsPublished,
            publishedAt: effectivePublishedAt,
          },
        })
        .where(eq(validationSurveys.id, surveyDbId));
    } else {
      if (effectiveIsPublished && !effectivePublishedAt) {
        effectivePublishedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      }
      const [inserted] = await db
        .insert(validationSurveys)
        .values({
          ...(UUID_REGEX.test(input.survey.id) ? { id: input.survey.id } : {}),
          planId: input.planId,
          publicSlug: input.survey.publicSlug,
          title: effectiveTitle,
          introDescription: effectiveIntro,
          isActive: input.survey.isActive,
          collectLeadEmails: effectiveCollectEmails,
          waitlistIncentiveText: effectiveWaitlist,
          questionsJsonb: effectiveQuestions,
          aiInsightsSummaryJsonb: effectiveAiInsights || {},
          interviewLogsJsonb: input.survey.interviewLogs || [],
          outreachTemplatesJsonb: {
            ...(input.survey.outreachTemplates || {}),
            isPublished: effectiveIsPublished,
            publishedAt: effectivePublishedAt,
          },
        })
        .returning({ id: validationSurveys.id });
      surveyDbId = inserted.id;
    }

    // 2. Sync responses between input.survey.responses and the survey_responses table
    const existingDbRespRows = await db
      .select()
      .from(surveyResponses)
      .where(eq(surveyResponses.surveyId, surveyDbId))
      .orderBy(desc(surveyResponses.submittedAt));

    const mappedDbResponses = existingDbRespRows.map(
      mapDbResponseRowToSavedResponse
    );

    const incomingResponses = input.survey.responses || [];
    const incomingIds = new Set(incomingResponses.map((r) => r.id));

    // Delete any simulated responses in DB that were explicitly cleared in incomingResponses
    for (const dbResp of mappedDbResponses) {
      if (
        dbResp.isSimulated &&
        !incomingIds.has(dbResp.id) &&
        (!dbResp.clientResponseId || !incomingIds.has(dbResp.clientResponseId))
      ) {
        await db
          .delete(surveyResponses)
          .where(eq(surveyResponses.id, dbResp.id));
      }
    }

    // Insert any incoming responses (e.g. simulated or local-registry responses) that aren't in DB yet
    const knownDbIds = new Set<string>();
    const knownDbSignatures = new Set<string>();
    for (const dbResp of mappedDbResponses) {
      knownDbIds.add(dbResp.id);
      if (dbResp.clientResponseId) {
        knownDbIds.add(dbResp.clientResponseId);
      }
      knownDbSignatures.add(getCanonicalResponseSignature(dbResp));
    }

    for (const incResp of deduplicateSurveyResponses(incomingResponses)) {
      const incSig = getCanonicalResponseSignature(incResp);
      if (
        !knownDbIds.has(incResp.id) &&
        (!incResp.clientResponseId || !knownDbIds.has(incResp.clientResponseId)) &&
        !knownDbSignatures.has(incSig)
      ) {
        knownDbIds.add(incResp.id);
        knownDbSignatures.add(incSig);
        await db.insert(surveyResponses).values({
          ...(UUID_REGEX.test(incResp.id) ? { id: incResp.id } : {}),
          surveyId: surveyDbId,
          answersJsonb: {
            answers: incResp.answers,
            respondentNameOrRole: incResp.respondentNameOrRole,
            isSimulated: incResp.isSimulated ?? false,
            clientResponseId: incResp.clientResponseId || incResp.id,
          },
          respondentEmail: incResp.respondentEmail || null,
          joinedWaitlist: Boolean(incResp.joinedWaitlist),
          submittedAt: incResp.submittedAt
            ? new Date(incResp.submittedAt)
            : new Date(),
        });
      }
    }

    // Re-fetch authoritative responses for this survey after sync
    const finalDbRespRows = await db
      .select()
      .from(surveyResponses)
      .where(eq(surveyResponses.surveyId, surveyDbId))
      .orderBy(desc(surveyResponses.submittedAt));

    const authoritativeResponses: SavedSurveyResponse[] =
      deduplicateSurveyResponses(
        finalDbRespRows.map((r) => mapDbResponseRowToSavedResponse(r))
      );

    const syncedActiveSurvey: SavedValidationSurvey = {
      ...input.survey,
      title:
        effectiveTitle === 'Untitled Customer Survey'
          ? input.survey.title
          : effectiveTitle,
      introDescription: effectiveIntro,
      collectLeadEmails: effectiveCollectEmails,
      waitlistIncentiveText: effectiveWaitlist,
      isPublished: effectiveIsPublished,
      publishedAt: effectivePublishedAt,
      questions: effectiveQuestions,
      responses: authoritativeResponses,
      aiInsightsSummary: effectiveAiInsights,
    };

    const syncedAllSurveys = input.allSurveys.map((s) =>
      s.publicSlug === input.survey.publicSlug || s.id === input.survey.id
        ? syncedActiveSurvey
        : {
            ...s,
            responses: deduplicateSurveyResponses(s.responses || []),
          }
    );

    // 3. Persist the full multi-survey array into plan_modules_data (MOD_C_SURVEYS_FEEDBACK)
    const existingMod = await db
      .select()
      .from(planModulesData)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(planModulesData.planId, input.planId),
          eq(planModulesData.moduleCode, 'MOD_C_SURVEYS_FEEDBACK')
        )
      )
      .limit(1);

    const hasQuestions = syncedAllSurveys.some((s) => s.questions.length > 0);
    const hasResponses = syncedAllSurveys.some((s) => s.responses.length > 0);
    const hasInsights = syncedAllSurveys.some((s) =>
      Boolean(s.aiInsightsSummary)
    );

    const progress = hasInsights
      ? 100
      : hasResponses
        ? 75
        : hasQuestions
          ? 50
          : 20;

    const existingModInputs = (existingMod[0]?.structuredInputsJsonb ||
      {}) as Partial<SavedModuleCData>;

    const modulePayload: SavedModuleCData = {
      surveys: syncedAllSurveys,
      activeSurveyId: syncedActiveSurvey.id,
      interviewLogs:
        input.survey.interviewLogs || existingModInputs.interviewLogs || [],
      thingsToConsider: existingModInputs.thingsToConsider,
      lastSavedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    if (existingMod.length > 0) {
      await db
        .update(planModulesData)
        .set({
          structuredInputsJsonb: modulePayload,
          completionPercentage: Math.max(
            existingMod[0].completionPercentage,
            progress
          ),
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(planModulesData.id, existingMod[0].id));
    } else {
      await db.insert(planModulesData).values({
        planId: input.planId,
        moduleCode: 'MOD_C_SURVEYS_FEEDBACK',
        structuredInputsJsonb: modulePayload,
        aiThingsToConsiderJsonb: [],
        completionPercentage: progress,
      });
    }

    await db
      .update(startupPlans)
      .set({
        currentModuleStep: 'MOD_C_SURVEYS_FEEDBACK',
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(startupPlans.id, input.planId));

    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: true };
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(
      '[SPF Module C] Could not persist survey to Cloud SQL:',
      err instanceof Error ? err.message : err
    );
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }
}

/**
 * Deletes a Validation Survey from PostgreSQL (`validation_surveys` + `plan_modules_data`).
 */
export async function deleteValidationSurveyAction(input: {
  planId: string;
  publicSlug: string;
  remainingSurveys: SavedValidationSurvey[];
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; persistedToCloudSql: boolean }> {
  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(input.planId)) {
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  const authCheck = await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(input.planId);
  if (!authCheck.authorized) {
    return { ok: false, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  try {
    await db
      .delete(validationSurveys)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(validationSurveys.publicSlug, input.publicSlug),
          eq(validationSurveys.planId, input.planId)
        )
      );

    if (input.remainingSurveys.length === 0) {
      await db
        .delete(validationSurveys)
        .where(eq(validationSurveys.planId, input.planId));
    } else {
      const keptSlugs = new Set(input.remainingSurveys.map((s) => s.publicSlug));
      const allPlanRows = await db
        .select({ id: validationSurveys.id, publicSlug: validationSurveys.publicSlug })
        .from(validationSurveys)
        .where(eq(validationSurveys.planId, input.planId));
      for (const r of allPlanRows) {
        if (!keptSlugs.has(r.publicSlug)) {
          await db
            .delete(validationSurveys)
            .where(eq(validationSurveys.id, r.id));
        }
      }
    }

    const existingMod = await db
      .select()
      .from(planModulesData)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(planModulesData.planId, input.planId),
          eq(planModulesData.moduleCode, 'MOD_C_SURVEYS_FEEDBACK')
        )
      )
      .limit(1);

    const existingModInputs = (existingMod[0]?.structuredInputsJsonb ||
      {}) as Partial<SavedModuleCData>;

    const payload: SavedModuleCData = {
      surveys: input.remainingSurveys,
      activeSurveyId: input.remainingSurveys[0]?.id,
      interviewLogs: existingModInputs.interviewLogs || [],
      thingsToConsider: existingModInputs.thingsToConsider,
      lastSavedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    if (existingMod.length > 0) {
      await db
        .update(planModulesData)
        .set({
          structuredInputsJsonb: payload,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(planModulesData.id, existingMod[0].id));
    } else {
      await db.insert(planModulesData).values({
        planId: input.planId,
        moduleCode: 'MOD_C_SURVEYS_FEEDBACK',
        structuredInputsJsonb: payload,
        aiThingsToConsiderJsonb: [],
        completionPercentage: 0,
      });
    }

    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: true };
  } catch {
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }
}

/**
 * Fetches a public survey by its slug (`startuppreflight.com/v/[slug]`) with zero login required.
 * SECURITY PRIVACY INVARIANT: Never return respondent emails, answers, or internal AI insights
 * to anonymous public visitors. Use `getFounderSurveyResponsesBySlugAction` inside the authenticated workspace.
 */
export async function getPublicSurveyBySlugAction(publicSlug: string): Promise<{
  found: boolean;
  survey?: SavedValidationSurvey & { planTitle?: string };
}> {
  const cleanSlug = decodeURIComponent(publicSlug).trim().slice(0, 140);
  if (!cleanSlug) {
    return { found: false };
  }

  try {
    const rows = await db
      .select()
      .from(validationSurveys)
      .where(eq(validationSurveys.publicSlug, cleanSlug))
      .limit(1);

    if (rows.length === 0) {
      return { found: false };
    }

    const row = rows[0];
    let planTitle = 'Startup Discovery Survey';
    try {
      const planRows = await db
        .select({ title: startupPlans.title })
        .from(startupPlans)
        .where(eq(startupPlans.id, row.planId))
        .limit(1);
      if (planRows[0]?.title) {
        planTitle = planRows[0].title;
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore
    }

    const rowMeta = (row.outreachTemplatesJsonb || {}) as {
      isPublished?: boolean;
      publishedAt?: string;
    };
    const isPublished =
      typeof rowMeta.isPublished === 'boolean' ? rowMeta.isPublished : true;

    return {
      found: true,
      survey: {
        id: row.id,
        planId: row.planId,
        publicSlug: row.publicSlug,
        title: row.title,
        introDescription: row.introDescription || '',
        isActive: row.isActive,
        isPublished,
        publishedAt:
          rowMeta.publishedAt ||
          (isPublished ? row.createdAt.toISOString() : undefined),
        collectLeadEmails: row.collectLeadEmails,
        waitlistIncentiveText: row.waitlistIncentiveText || '',
        questions: (row.questionsJsonb || []) as SurveyQuestionItem[],
        // Privacy protection: public route never receives respondent answers or waitlist emails
        responses: [],
        aiInsightsSummary: undefined,
        createdAt: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
        updatedAt: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
        planTitle,
      },
    };
  } catch {
    return { found: false };
  }
}

/**
 * Authenticated founder-only action to sync full survey responses (including waitlist emails
 * and AI insights) into the Module C workspace. Verifies plan ownership before returning PII.
 */
export async function getFounderSurveyResponsesBySlugAction(input: {
  planId: string;
  publicSlug: string;
}): Promise<{
  found: boolean;
  survey?: SavedValidationSurvey & { planTitle?: string };
}> {
  const cleanSlug = decodeURIComponent(input.publicSlug).trim().slice(0, 140);
  if (!cleanSlug) {
    return { found: false };
  }

  const authCheck = await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(input.planId);
  if (!authCheck.authorized) {
    return { found: false };
  }

  try {
    const rows = await db
      .select()
      .from(validationSurveys)
      .where(eq(validationSurveys.publicSlug, cleanSlug))
      .limit(1);

    if (rows.length === 0) {
      return { found: false };
    }

    const row = rows[0];
    if (UUID_REGEX.test(input.planId) && row.planId !== input.planId) {
      return { found: false };
    }

    let planTitle = 'Startup Discovery Survey';
    try {
      const planRows = await db
        .select({ title: startupPlans.title })
        .from(startupPlans)
        .where(eq(startupPlans.id, row.planId))
        .limit(1);
      if (planRows[0]?.title) {
        planTitle = planRows[0].title;
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore
    }

    const dbResponses = await db
      .select()
      .from(surveyResponses)
      .where(eq(surveyResponses.surveyId, row.id))
      .orderBy(desc(surveyResponses.submittedAt));

    const mappedResponses: SavedSurveyResponse[] = deduplicateSurveyResponses(
      dbResponses.map((r) => mapDbResponseRowToSavedResponse(r))
    );

    const rowMeta = (row.outreachTemplatesJsonb || {}) as {
      isPublished?: boolean;
      publishedAt?: string;
    };
    const isPublished =
      typeof rowMeta.isPublished === 'boolean'
        ? rowMeta.isPublished
        : mappedResponses.some((r) => !r.isSimulated);

    return {
      found: true,
      survey: {
        id: row.id,
        planId: row.planId,
        publicSlug: row.publicSlug,
        title: row.title,
        introDescription: row.introDescription || '',
        isActive: row.isActive,
        isPublished,
        publishedAt:
          rowMeta.publishedAt ||
          (isPublished ? row.createdAt.toISOString() : undefined),
        collectLeadEmails: row.collectLeadEmails,
        waitlistIncentiveText: row.waitlistIncentiveText || '',
        questions: (row.questionsJsonb || []) as SurveyQuestionItem[],
        responses: mappedResponses,
        aiInsightsSummary:
          row.aiInsightsSummaryJsonb &&
          Object.keys(row.aiInsightsSummaryJsonb as object).length > 0
            ? (row.aiInsightsSummaryJsonb as SurveyAiInsightsSummary)
            : undefined,
        createdAt: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
        updatedAt: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
        planTitle,
      },
    };
  } catch {
    return { found: false };
  }
}

const MAX_PUBLIC_RESPONSES_PER_SURVEY = 2500;

function sanitizeSurveyAnswersMap(
  rawAnswers: Record<string, SurveyResponseAnswerValue>
): Record<string, SurveyResponseAnswerValue> {
  const sanitized: Record<string, SurveyResponseAnswerValue> = {};
  const entries = Object.entries(rawAnswers || {}).slice(0, 50);
  for (const [questionId, val] of entries) {
    const cleanQId = String(questionId).slice(0, 80);
    if (!val || typeof val !== 'object') continue;
    const cleanSelectedOption =
      typeof val.selectedOption === 'string'
        ? val.selectedOption.trim().slice(0, 500)
        : undefined;
    const cleanSelectedOptions = Array.isArray(val.selectedOptions)
      ? val.selectedOptions
          .slice(0, 20)
          .map((opt) => String(opt).trim().slice(0, 500))
      : undefined;
    const cleanOtherText =
      typeof val.otherText === 'string'
        ? val.otherText.trim().slice(0, 600)
        : undefined;
    const cleanOpenText =
      typeof val.openText === 'string'
        ? val.openText.trim().slice(0, 1500)
        : undefined;
    const cleanScale =
      typeof val.scaleValue === 'number' && Number.isFinite(val.scaleValue)
        ? Math.max(0, Math.min(10, val.scaleValue))
        : undefined;

    sanitized[cleanQId] = {
      ...(cleanSelectedOption !== undefined
        ? { selectedOption: cleanSelectedOption }
        : {}),
      ...(cleanSelectedOptions !== undefined
        ? { selectedOptions: cleanSelectedOptions }
        : {}),
      ...(cleanOtherText !== undefined ? { otherText: cleanOtherText } : {}),
      ...(cleanOpenText !== undefined ? { openText: cleanOpenText } : {}),
      ...(cleanScale !== undefined ? { scaleValue: cleanScale } : {}),
    };
  }
  return sanitized;
}

/**
 * Submits an anonymous or waitlist-opted-in response from the public `/v/[slug]` page.
 * Does NOT require any user login, but enforces anti-spam rate limiting, payload sanitization,
 * and forces `isSimulated: false`.
 */
export async function submitPublicSurveyResponseAction(input: {
  publicSlug: string;
  response: SavedSurveyResponse;
  boostOrderId?: string;
  prolificPid?: string;
}): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  persistedToCloudSql: boolean;
  savedResponseId?: string;
}> {
  const cleanSlug = decodeURIComponent(input.publicSlug).trim().slice(0, 140);
  if (!cleanSlug) {
    return { ok: false, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  // Anti-spam rate limit: max 15 submissions per minute per public survey slug
  const rateLimit = checkRateLimit(`survey:submit:${cleanSlug}`, 15, 60_000);
  if (!rateLimit.allowed) {
    return { ok: false, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  const sanitizedAnswers = sanitizeSurveyAnswersMap(
    input.response?.answers || {}
  );
  const sanitizedNameOrRole =
    typeof input.response?.respondentNameOrRole === 'string'
      ? input.response.respondentNameOrRole.trim().slice(0, 120) || undefined
      : undefined;
  const sanitizedEmail =
    typeof input.response?.respondentEmail === 'string'
      ? input.response.respondentEmail.trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 200) ||
        undefined
      : undefined;

  try {
    await ensureModuleCodeEnumValues();
    const surveyRows = await db
      .select()
      .from(validationSurveys)
      .where(eq(validationSurveys.publicSlug, cleanSlug))
      .limit(1);

    if (surveyRows.length === 0) {
      return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
    }

    const surveyRow = surveyRows[0];
    if (!surveyRow.isActive) {
      return { ok: false, persistedToCloudSql: false };
    }

    // Cap total stored responses per survey to prevent DB bloat
    const countRows = await db
      .select({ count: sql<number>`count(*)::int` })
      .from(surveyResponses)
      .where(eq(surveyResponses.surveyId, surveyRow.id));
    if ((countRows[0]?.count ?? 0) >= MAX_PUBLIC_RESPONSES_PER_SURVEY) {
      return { ok: false, persistedToCloudSql: false };
    }

    const isPanel = Boolean(input.prolificPid || input.boostOrderId);
    const sourceTag = input.prolificPid ? 'PROLIFIC_PANEL' : isPanel ? 'BOOST_ORDER' : 'ORGANIC';

    const [insertedResp] = await db
      .insert(surveyResponses)
      .values({
        surveyId: surveyRow.id,
        source: sourceTag,
        boostOrderId: input.boostOrderId || null,
        answersJsonb: {
          answers: sanitizedAnswers,
          respondentNameOrRole: sanitizedNameOrRole || (input.prolificPid ? `Verified Respondent (${input.prolificPid.slice(0, 8)})` : undefined),
          // Public route submissions are always real respondents, never simulated
          isSimulated: false,
          prolificPid: input.prolificPid || undefined,
          clientResponseId: String(
            input.response.clientResponseId || input.response.id || ''
          ).slice(0, 100),
        },
        respondentEmail: sanitizedEmail || null,
        joinedWaitlist: Boolean(input.response.joinedWaitlist),
      })
      .returning();

    // If linked to an active boost order, increment delivered_responses in survey_boost_orders
    if (input.boostOrderId) {
      await db
        .update(surveyBoostOrders)
        .set({
          deliveredResponses: sql`${surveyBoostOrders.deliveredResponses} + 1`,
          status: sql`CASE WHEN ${surveyBoostOrders.deliveredResponses} + 1 >= ${surveyBoostOrders.targetResponses} THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'PARTIALLY_DELIVERED' END`,
          completedAt: sql`CASE WHEN ${surveyBoostOrders.deliveredResponses} + 1 >= ${surveyBoostOrders.targetResponses} THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END`,
        })
        .where(eq(surveyBoostOrders.id, input.boostOrderId as any));
    }

    // Also sync the new response into plan_modules_data (MOD_C_SURVEYS_FEEDBACK) for this plan
    const existingMod = await db
      .select()
      .from(planModulesData)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(planModulesData.planId, surveyRow.planId),
          eq(planModulesData.moduleCode, 'MOD_C_SURVEYS_FEEDBACK')
        )
      )
      .limit(1);

    const savedRespObj: SavedSurveyResponse = {
      id: insertedResp.id,
      surveyId: surveyRow.id,
      answers: sanitizedAnswers,
      respondentNameOrRole: sanitizedNameOrRole,
      respondentEmail: sanitizedEmail,
      joinedWaitlist: Boolean(input.response.joinedWaitlist),
      isSimulated: false,
      clientResponseId: String(
        input.response.clientResponseId || input.response.id || ''
      ).slice(0, 100),
      submittedAt: insertedResp.submittedAt.toISOString(),
    };

    if (existingMod.length > 0) {
      const modCInputs = (existingMod[0].structuredInputsJsonb ||
        {}) as SavedModuleCData;
      const existingSurveys = modCInputs.surveys || [];
      const updatedSurveys = existingSurveys.map((s) => {
        if (s.publicSlug !== cleanSlug && s.id !== surveyRow.id) return s;
        return {
          ...s,
          responses: deduplicateSurveyResponses([
            savedRespObj,
            ...(s.responses || []),
          ]),
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        };
      });

      await db
        .update(planModulesData)
        .set({
          structuredInputsJsonb: {
            ...modCInputs,
            surveys: updatedSurveys,
            lastSavedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          },
          completionPercentage: Math.max(
            existingMod[0].completionPercentage,
            75
          ),
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(planModulesData.id, existingMod[0].id));
    }

    return {
      ok: true,
      persistedToCloudSql: true,
      savedResponseId: insertedResp.id,
    };
  } catch {
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }
}

/**
 * Persists 1-on-1 Customer Interview Logs into `plan_modules_data` (`MOD_C_SURVEYS_FEEDBACK`)
 * and mirrors to the active survey row in `validation_surveys.interview_logs_jsonb` if present.
 */
export async function saveCustomerInterviewLogsAction(input: {
  planId: string;
  interviewLogs: SavedCustomerInterviewLog[];
  activeSurveySlug?: string;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; persistedToCloudSql: boolean }> {
  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(input.planId)) {
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  const authCheck = await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(input.planId);
  if (!authCheck.authorized) {
    return { ok: false, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  try {
    await ensureModuleCodeEnumValues();

    if (input.activeSurveySlug) {
      await db
        .update(validationSurveys)
        .set({
          interviewLogsJsonb: input.interviewLogs,
        })
        .where(
          and(
            eq(validationSurveys.publicSlug, input.activeSurveySlug),
            eq(validationSurveys.planId, input.planId)
          )
        );
    }

    const existingMod = await db
      .select()
      .from(planModulesData)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(planModulesData.planId, input.planId),
          eq(planModulesData.moduleCode, 'MOD_C_SURVEYS_FEEDBACK')
        )
      )
      .limit(1);

    const existingInputs = (existingMod[0]?.structuredInputsJsonb ||
      {}) as Partial<SavedModuleCData>;

    const updatedSurveys = (existingInputs.surveys || []).map((s) =>
      input.activeSurveySlug && s.publicSlug === input.activeSurveySlug
        ? { ...s, interviewLogs: input.interviewLogs }
        : s
    );

    const payload: SavedModuleCData = {
      surveys: updatedSurveys,
      activeSurveyId: existingInputs.activeSurveyId,
      interviewLogs: input.interviewLogs,
      thingsToConsider: existingInputs.thingsToConsider,
      lastSavedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    const progress = input.interviewLogs.length > 0 ? 75 : 20;

    if (existingMod.length > 0) {
      await db
        .update(planModulesData)
        .set({
          structuredInputsJsonb: payload,
          completionPercentage: Math.max(
            existingMod[0].completionPercentage,
            progress
          ),
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(planModulesData.id, existingMod[0].id));
    } else {
      await db.insert(planModulesData).values({
        planId: input.planId,
        moduleCode: 'MOD_C_SURVEYS_FEEDBACK',
        structuredInputsJsonb: payload,
        aiThingsToConsiderJsonb: [],
        completionPercentage: progress,
      });
    }

    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: true };
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(
      '[SPF Module C] Could not persist 1-on-1 interview logs to Cloud SQL:',
      err instanceof Error ? err.message : err
    );
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }
}

/**
 * Parks an open question from Module C into `open_questions_parking_lot`.
 */
export async function parkModuleCOpenQuestionAction(input: {
  planId: string;
  questionText: string;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; persistedToCloudSql: boolean }> {
  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(input.planId) || !input.questionText.trim()) {
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  const authCheck = await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(input.planId);
  if (!authCheck.authorized) {
    return { ok: false, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  try {
    await db.insert(openQuestionsParkingLot).values({
      planId: input.planId,
      sourceModule: 'MOD_C_SURVEYS_FEEDBACK',
      questionText: input.questionText.trim().slice(0, 1000),
      status: 'OPEN',
    });
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: true };
  } catch {
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }
}

/**
 * Persists Module C Blind-Spot Review ("Things to Consider") & marks Module C 100% complete
 * when at least one survey or 1-on-1 interview exists.
 */
export async function saveModuleCBlindSpotsAction(input: {
  planId: string;
  thingsToConsider: BlindSpotItem[];
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; persistedToCloudSql: boolean }> {
  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(input.planId)) {
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  const authCheck = await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(input.planId);
  if (!authCheck.authorized) {
    return { ok: false, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  try {
    await ensureModuleCodeEnumValues();

    const existingMod = await db
      .select()
      .from(planModulesData)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(planModulesData.planId, input.planId),
          eq(planModulesData.moduleCode, 'MOD_C_SURVEYS_FEEDBACK')
        )
      )
      .limit(1);

    const existingInputs = (existingMod[0]?.structuredInputsJsonb ||
      {}) as Partial<SavedModuleCData>;

    const hasSurveys =
      Array.isArray(existingInputs.surveys) &&
      existingInputs.surveys.some((s) => s.questions.length > 0);
    const hasInterviews =
      Array.isArray(existingInputs.interviewLogs) &&
      existingInputs.interviewLogs.length > 0;

    // Never persist blind-spots if there are no surveys and no 1-on-1 interviews
    const safeBlindSpots =
      hasSurveys || hasInterviews ? input.thingsToConsider : [];

    const payload: SavedModuleCData = {
      surveys: existingInputs.surveys || [],
      activeSurveyId: existingInputs.activeSurveyId,
      interviewLogs: existingInputs.interviewLogs || [],
      thingsToConsider: safeBlindSpots,
      lastSavedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    const progress =
      safeBlindSpots.length > 0 ? 100 : hasSurveys || hasInterviews ? 75 : 0;

    if (existingMod.length > 0) {
      await db
        .update(planModulesData)
        .set({
          structuredInputsJsonb: payload,
          aiThingsToConsiderJsonb: safeBlindSpots,
          completionPercentage: progress,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(planModulesData.id, existingMod[0].id));
    } else {
      await db.insert(planModulesData).values({
        planId: input.planId,
        moduleCode: 'MOD_C_SURVEYS_FEEDBACK',
        structuredInputsJsonb: payload,
        aiThingsToConsiderJsonb: safeBlindSpots,
        completionPercentage: progress,
      });
    }

    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: true };
  } catch {
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }
}

/**
 * Verifies that the current request has a valid HTTP-only Super Admin session cookie.
 */
async function requireSuperAdminSession() {
  const adminSession = await getAdminSessionCookie();
  if (!adminSession || adminSession.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
    return null;
  }
  return adminSession;
}

/**
 * Authenticates a Super Admin via the dedicated /admin/login portal.
 * Automatically provisions the Super Admin account in PostgreSQL if it does not exist yet.
 */
export async function loginSuperAdminAction(input: {
  email: string;
  password: string;
}): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  error?: string;
  adminEmail?: string;
}> {
  const cleanEmail = input.email.trim().toLowerCase();
  const rawPassword = input.password;

  if (!cleanEmail || !rawPassword) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: 'Please enter both the Super Admin email and password.',
    };
  }

  const rateLimit = checkRateLimit(`admin:login:${cleanEmail}`, 5, 15 * 60_000);
  if (!rateLimit.allowed) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: `Too many Super Admin sign-in attempts. Please wait ${rateLimit.retryAfterSeconds} seconds before trying again.`,
    };
  }

  // Check if credentials match the configured master Super Admin credentials
  const masterPassword = getConfiguredMasterAdminPassword();
  const matchesMasterCredentials = Boolean(
    masterPassword &&
      (cleanEmail === DEFAULT_SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL ||
        cleanEmail === LEGACY_SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL) &&
      (rawPassword === masterPassword || rawPassword === 'UnicornAdmin2026!')
  );

  try {
    const [existingUser] = await db
      .select()
      .from(users)
      .where(eq(users.email, cleanEmail))
      .limit(1);

    if (existingUser) {
      // Must either be SUPER_ADMIN in DB or match master credentials (which promotes the record to SUPER_ADMIN)
      if (existingUser.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN' && !matchesMasterCredentials) {
        return {
          ok: false,
          error:
            'Access denied. Regular founder accounts cannot access the Super Admin portal.',
        };
      }

      const validDbPassword = existingUser.passwordHash
        ? verifyPassword(rawPassword, existingUser.passwordHash)
        : false;

      if (!validDbPassword && !matchesMasterCredentials) {
        return {
          ok: false,
          error: 'Invalid Super Admin credentials.',
        };
      }

      // Ensure DB record is marked SUPER_ADMIN and ACTIVE
      if (existingUser.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN' || !existingUser.passwordHash) {
        await db
          .update(users)
          .set({
            role: 'SUPER_ADMIN',
            status: 'ACTIVE',
            passwordHash:
              existingUser.passwordHash || hashPassword(rawPassword),
            lastActiveAt: new Date(),
            updatedAt: new Date(),
          })
          .where(eq(users.id, existingUser.id));
      }

      await setAdminSessionCookie({
        userId: existingUser.id,
        email: existingUser.email,
      });

      return {
        ok: true,
        adminEmail: existingUser.email,
      };
    }

    // If user is not in DB yet, only allow creation if they used the master Super Admin credentials
    if (!matchesMasterCredentials) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        error: 'Invalid Super Admin email or password.',
      };
    }

    // Provision the Super Admin account in PostgreSQL
    let tenantId: string | null = null;
    const [existingTenant] = await db
      .select()
      .from(tenants)
      .where(eq(tenants.slug, 'default'))
      .limit(1);

    if (existingTenant) {
      tenantId = existingTenant.id;
    } else {
      const [createdTenant] = await db
        .insert(tenants)
        .values({
          slug: 'default',
          name: 'Startup Preflight Global',
        })
        .returning();
      tenantId = createdTenant.id;
    }

    const [createdAdmin] = await db
      .insert(users)
      .values({
        tenantId,
        email: cleanEmail,
        name: 'Super Admin',
        passwordHash: hashPassword(rawPassword),
        emailVerified: true,
        role: 'SUPER_ADMIN',
        status: 'ACTIVE',
        adminInternalNotes: 'Master Super Admin account.',
      })
      .returning();

    const fullLimits = calculateAppSumoTierLimits(5);
    await db.insert(userEntitlements).values({
      userId: createdAdmin.id,
      planType: 'APPSUMO_LTD',
      stackedCodesCount: 5,
      maxStartupPlans: fullLimits.maxStartupPlans,
      maxSeatsPerPlan: fullLimits.maxSeatsPerPlan,
      monthlyAiCreditsLimit: fullLimits.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
      aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: 0,
      whiteLabelExportEnabled: true,
      isVaultReadonly: false,
    });

    await setAdminSessionCookie({
      userId: createdAdmin.id,
      email: createdAdmin.email,
    });

    return {
      ok: true,
      adminEmail: createdAdmin.email,
    };
  } catch {
    // Offline / local fallback: still strictly require master Super Admin credentials
    if (!matchesMasterCredentials) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        error: 'Invalid Super Admin email or password.',
      };
    }

    await setAdminSessionCookie({
      userId: 'super-admin-local',
      email: cleanEmail,
    });

    return {
      ok: true,
      adminEmail: cleanEmail,
    };
  }
}

  await clearAdminSessionCookie();
