/**
 * Computes the entitlement database fields for a chosen admin account preset.
 * 'LIFETIME_FULL' grants complete, unrestricted lifetime access (Modules A–G, 25 Plans, 5 Seats/Plan, 1500 AI credits, White-label & BYOK).
 */
function buildEntitlementValuesForPreset(preset: AccountPresetType) {
  switch (preset) {
    case 'LIFETIME_FULL': {
      const limits = calculateAppSumoTierLimits(5);
      return {
        planType: 'APPSUMO_LTD' as const,
        stackedCodesCount: 5,
        maxStartupPlans: limits.maxStartupPlans,
        maxSeatsPerPlan: limits.maxSeatsPerPlan,
        monthlyAiCreditsLimit: limits.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
        whiteLabelExportEnabled: true,
        accessExpiresAt: null,
        isVaultReadonly: false,
      };
    }
    case 'APPSUMO_T1': {
      const limits = calculateAppSumoTierLimits(1);
      return {
        planType: 'APPSUMO_LTD' as const,
        stackedCodesCount: 1,
        maxStartupPlans: limits.maxStartupPlans,
        maxSeatsPerPlan: limits.maxSeatsPerPlan,
        monthlyAiCreditsLimit: limits.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
        whiteLabelExportEnabled: limits.whiteLabelExportEnabled,
        accessExpiresAt: null,
        isVaultReadonly: false,
      };
    }
    case 'APPSUMO_T2': {
      const limits = calculateAppSumoTierLimits(2);
      return {
        planType: 'APPSUMO_LTD' as const,
        stackedCodesCount: 2,
        maxStartupPlans: limits.maxStartupPlans,
        maxSeatsPerPlan: limits.maxSeatsPerPlan,
        monthlyAiCreditsLimit: limits.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
        whiteLabelExportEnabled: limits.whiteLabelExportEnabled,
        accessExpiresAt: null,
        isVaultReadonly: false,
      };
    }
    case 'SIX_MONTH_SOLO': {
      const limits = calculatePassLimits('SIX_MONTH_SOLO', 6);
      return {
        planType: 'SIX_MONTH_SOLO' as const,
        stackedCodesCount: 0,
        maxStartupPlans: limits.maxStartupPlans,
        maxSeatsPerPlan: limits.maxSeatsPerPlan,
        monthlyAiCreditsLimit: limits.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
        whiteLabelExportEnabled: limits.whiteLabelExportEnabled,
        accessExpiresAt: limits.accessExpiresAt,
        isVaultReadonly: false,
      };
    }
    case 'SIX_MONTH_COFOUNDER': {
      const limits = calculatePassLimits('SIX_MONTH_COFOUNDER', 6);
      return {
        planType: 'SIX_MONTH_COFOUNDER' as const,
        stackedCodesCount: 0,
        maxStartupPlans: limits.maxStartupPlans,
        maxSeatsPerPlan: limits.maxSeatsPerPlan,
        monthlyAiCreditsLimit: limits.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
        whiteLabelExportEnabled: limits.whiteLabelExportEnabled,
        accessExpiresAt: limits.accessExpiresAt,
        isVaultReadonly: false,
      };
    }
    case 'COHORT_PASS': {
      const limits = calculatePassLimits('COHORT_PASS', 6);
      return {
        planType: 'COHORT_PASS' as const,
        stackedCodesCount: 0,
        maxStartupPlans: limits.maxStartupPlans,
        maxSeatsPerPlan: limits.maxSeatsPerPlan,
        monthlyAiCreditsLimit: limits.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
        whiteLabelExportEnabled: limits.whiteLabelExportEnabled,
        accessExpiresAt: limits.accessExpiresAt,
        isVaultReadonly: false,
      };
    }
    case 'FREE_HOOK':
    default: {
      const limits = calculatePassLimits('FREE_HOOK');
      return {
        planType: 'FREE_HOOK' as const,
        stackedCodesCount: 0,
        maxStartupPlans: limits.maxStartupPlans,
        maxSeatsPerPlan: limits.maxSeatsPerPlan,
        monthlyAiCreditsLimit: limits.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
        whiteLabelExportEnabled: false,
        accessExpiresAt: null,
        isVaultReadonly: false,
      };
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Fetches all users, their entitlement tiers, startup plan counts, and redeemed vouchers.
 * Strictly requires an active Super Admin session.
 */
export async function listAdminUsersAction(): Promise<AdminDashboardResponse> {
  const adminSession = await requireSuperAdminSession();
  if (!adminSession) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      authenticated: false,
      dbConnected: false,
      error: 'Super Admin authentication required.',
      users: [],
    };
  }

  try {
    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();
    const allUsers = await db
      .select()
      .from(users)
      .orderBy(desc(users.createdAt));

    const allEntitlements = await db.select().from(userEntitlements);
    const allPlans = await db.select().from(startupPlans);
    const allVouchers = await db.select().from(vouchers);

    const entMap = new Map(allEntitlements.map((e) => [e.userId, e]));
    const freeDefaults = calculatePassLimits('FREE_HOOK');

    const records: AdminUserRecord[] = allUsers.map((u) => {
      const ent = entMap.get(u.id);
      const userPlans = allPlans.filter((p) => p.ownerUserId === u.id);
      const userVouchers = allVouchers.filter(
        (v) => v.redeemedByUserId === u.id
      );

      return {
        id: u.id,
        name: u.name,
        email: u.email,
        role: u.role,
        status: u.status,
        suspensionReason: u.suspensionReason ?? null,
        adminInternalNotes: u.adminInternalNotes ?? null,
        lastActiveAt: u.lastActiveAt ? u.lastActiveAt.toISOString() : null,
        deletedAt: u.deletedAt ? u.deletedAt.toISOString() : null,
        createdAt: u.createdAt.toISOString(),
        plansCount: userPlans.length,
        planTitles: userPlans.map((p) => p.title),
        redeemedCodes: userVouchers.map((v) => v.code),
        entitlement: ent
          ? {
              planType: ent.planType,
              stackedCodesCount: ent.stackedCodesCount,
              maxStartupPlans: ent.maxStartupPlans,
              maxSeatsPerPlan: ent.maxSeatsPerPlan,
              monthlyAiCreditsLimit: ent.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
              aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: ent.aiCreditsUsedThisMonth,
              whiteLabelExportEnabled: ent.whiteLabelExportEnabled,
              accessExpiresAt: ent.accessExpiresAt
                ? ent.accessExpiresAt.toISOString()
                : null,
              isVaultReadonly: ent.isVaultReadonly,
            }
          : {
              planType: 'FREE_HOOK',
              stackedCodesCount: 0,
              maxStartupPlans: freeDefaults.maxStartupPlans,
              maxSeatsPerPlan: freeDefaults.maxSeatsPerPlan,
              monthlyAiCreditsLimit: freeDefaults.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
              aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: 0,
              whiteLabelExportEnabled: false,
              accessExpiresAt: null,
              isVaultReadonly: false,
            },
      };
    });

    return {
      ok: true,
      authenticated: true,
      adminEmail: adminSession.email,
      dbConnected: true,
      users: records,
    };
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(
      '[SPF Admin] PostgreSQL unreachable; using local fallback:',
      err instanceof Error ? err.message : err
    );
    return {
      ok: true,
      authenticated: true,
      adminEmail: adminSession.email,
      dbConnected: false,
      users: [],
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Updates a user's account tier/entitlements (including 1-click "Grant Lifetime Full Access").
 */
export async function updateUserEntitlementPresetAction(input: {
  userId: string;
  preset: AccountPresetType;
}): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  dbConnected: boolean;
  error?: string;
  updatedEntitlement?: AdminUserRecord['entitlement'];
}> {
  const adminSession = await requireSuperAdminSession();
  if (!adminSession) {
    return { ok: false, dbConnected: false, error: 'Unauthorized' };
  }

  const values = buildEntitlementValuesForPreset(input.preset);

  const formattedEntitlement: AdminUserRecord['entitlement'] = {
    planType: values.planType,
    stackedCodesCount: values.stackedCodesCount,
    maxStartupPlans: values.maxStartupPlans,
    maxSeatsPerPlan: values.maxSeatsPerPlan,
    monthlyAiCreditsLimit: values.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
    aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: 0,
    whiteLabelExportEnabled: values.whiteLabelExportEnabled,
    accessExpiresAt: values.accessExpiresAt
      ? values.accessExpiresAt.toISOString()
      : null,
    isVaultReadonly: values.isVaultReadonly,
  };

  try {
    const existing = await db
      .select()
      .from(userEntitlements)
      .where(eq(userEntitlements.userId, input.userId))
      .limit(1);

    if (existing.length > 0) {
      const [updated] = await db
        .update(userEntitlements)
        .set({
          ...values,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(userEntitlements.userId, input.userId))
        .returning();

      formattedEntitlement.aiCreditsUsedThisMonth =
        updated.aiCreditsUsedThisMonth;
    } else {
      await db.insert(userEntitlements).values({
        userId: input.userId,
        ...values,
        aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: 0,
      });
    }

    await db
      .update(users)
      .set({ updatedAt: new Date() })
      .where(eq(users.id, input.userId));

    return {
      ok: true,
      dbConnected: true,
      updatedEntitlement: formattedEntitlement,
    };
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(
      '[SPF Admin] DB unreachable during updateUserEntitlementPresetAction:',
      err instanceof Error ? err.message : err
    );
    return {
      ok: true,
      dbConnected: false,
      updatedEntitlement: formattedEntitlement,
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Suspends or Reactivates a user account.
 */
export async function suspendOrReactivateUserAction(input: {
  userId: string;
  action: 'SUSPEND' | 'REACTIVATE';
  reason?: string;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; dbConnected: boolean; error?: string }> {
  const adminSession = await requireSuperAdminSession();
  if (!adminSession) {
    return { ok: false, dbConnected: false, error: 'Unauthorized' };
  }

  try {
    if (input.action === 'SUSPEND') {
      const cleanReason =
        input.reason?.trim() || 'Account suspended by administrator.';

      await db
        .update(users)
        .set({
          status: 'SUSPENDED',
          suspensionReason: cleanReason,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(users.id, input.userId));

      const ownedPlans = await db
        .select({ id: startupPlans.id })
        .from(startupPlans)
        .where(eq(startupPlans.ownerUserId, input.userId));

      if (ownedPlans.length > 0) {
        const planIds = ownedPlans.map((p) => p.id);
        await db
          .update(validationSurveys)
          .set({ isActive: false })
          .where(inArray(validationSurveys.planId, planIds));
      }
    } else {
      await db
        .update(users)
        .set({
          status: 'ACTIVE',
          suspensionReason: null,
          deletedAt: null,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(users.id, input.userId));
    }

    return { ok: true, dbConnected: true };
  } catch {
    return { ok: true, dbConnected: false };
  }
}

const UUID_REGEX =
  /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

function isValidUuid(id: string): boolean {
  return UUID_REGEX.test(id);
}

/**
 * Soft-deletes (moves to Trash with 30-day recovery window) or restores a user account.
 */
export async function softDeleteOrRestoreUserAction(input: {
  userId: string;
  action: 'SOFT_DELETE' | 'RESTORE';
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; dbConnected: boolean; error?: string }> {
  const adminSession = await requireSuperAdminSession();
  if (!adminSession) {
    return { ok: false, dbConnected: false, error: 'Unauthorized: Super Admin session required.' };
  }

  // Non-UUID mock/demo users are handled in local fallback mode
  if (!isValidUuid(input.userId)) {
    return { ok: true, dbConnected: false };
  }

  try {
    if (input.action === 'SOFT_DELETE') {
      await db
        .update(users)
        .set({
          status: 'SOFT_DELETED',
          deletedAt: new Date(),
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(users.id, input.userId));

      const ownedPlans = await db
        .select({ id: startupPlans.id })
        .from(startupPlans)
        .where(eq(startupPlans.ownerUserId, input.userId));

      if (ownedPlans.length > 0) {
        const planIds = ownedPlans.map((p) => p.id);
        await db
          .update(validationSurveys)
          .set({ isActive: false })
          .where(inArray(validationSurveys.planId, planIds));
      }
    } else {
      await db
        .update(users)
        .set({
          status: 'ACTIVE',
          deletedAt: null,
          suspensionReason: null,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(users.id, input.userId));
    }

    return { ok: true, dbConnected: true };
  } catch (err) {
    return {
      ok: true,
      dbConnected: false,
      error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Database operation failed.',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Permanently deletes a user account and cascades deletion across their entitlements, startup plans, and module data.
 */
export async function permanentlyDeleteUserAction(input: {
  userId: string;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; dbConnected: boolean; error?: string }> {
  const adminSession = await requireSuperAdminSession();
  if (!adminSession) {
    return { ok: false, dbConnected: false, error: 'Unauthorized: Super Admin session required.' };
  }

  // Guard against deleting oneself
  if (adminSession.userId && adminSession.userId === input.userId) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      dbConnected: true,
      error: 'You cannot delete your own active Super Admin account.',
    };
  }

  // Non-UUID mock/demo users (handled on frontend and local session storage)
  if (!isValidUuid(input.userId)) {
    return { ok: true, dbConnected: false };
  }

  try {
    // Also protect against deleting the logged-in super admin by email
    const [targetUser] = await db
      .select({ email: users.email, role: users.role })
      .from(users)
      .where(eq(users.id, input.userId))
      .limit(1);

    if (
      targetUser &&
      adminSession.email &&
      targetUser.email.toLowerCase() === adminSession.email.toLowerCase()
    ) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        dbConnected: true,
        error: 'You cannot delete your own active Super Admin account.',
      };
    }

    // Step 1: Explicitly cascade delete all plans owned by this user
    const ownedPlans = await db
      .select({ id: startupPlans.id })
      .from(startupPlans)
      .where(eq(startupPlans.ownerUserId, input.userId));

    if (ownedPlans.length > 0) {
      const planIds = ownedPlans.map((p) => p.id);

      // 1a: Find and delete survey responses, then surveys
      const surveys = await db
        .select({ id: validationSurveys.id })
        .from(validationSurveys)
        .where(inArray(validationSurveys.planId, planIds));

      if (surveys.length > 0) {
        const surveyIds = surveys.map((s) => s.id);
        await db
          .delete(surveyResponses)
          .where(inArray(surveyResponses.surveyId, surveyIds));
        await db
          .delete(validationSurveys)
          .where(inArray(validationSurveys.id, surveyIds));
      }

      // 1b: Delete open questions, module data, and collaborators on these plans
      await db
        .delete(openQuestionsParkingLot)
        .where(inArray(openQuestionsParkingLot.planId, planIds));
      await db
        .delete(planModulesData)
        .where(inArray(planModulesData.planId, planIds));
      await db
        .delete(planCollaborators)
        .where(inArray(planCollaborators.planId, planIds));

      // 1c: Unlink AI usage logs referencing these plans
      await db
        .update(aiUsageLogs)
        .set({ planId: null })
        .where(inArray(aiUsageLogs.planId, planIds));

      // 1d: Delete the startup plans
      await db
        .delete(startupPlans)
        .where(inArray(startupPlans.id, planIds));
    }

    // Step 2: Delete collaborator entries for this user on any external plans
    await db
      .delete(planCollaborators)
      .where(eq(planCollaborators.userId, input.userId));

    // Step 3: Unlink vouchers redeemed by this user
    await db
      .update(vouchers)
      .set({ redeemedByUserId: null })
      .where(eq(vouchers.redeemedByUserId, input.userId));

    // Step 4: Unlink AI usage logs created by this user
    await db
      .update(aiUsageLogs)
      .set({ userId: null })
      .where(eq(aiUsageLogs.userId, input.userId));

    // Step 5: Delete user entitlements
    await db
      .delete(userEntitlements)
      .where(eq(userEntitlements.userId, input.userId));

    // Step 6: Finally delete the user row from PostgreSQL
    await db.delete(users).where(eq(users.id, input.userId));

    return { ok: true, dbConnected: true };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[Admin] Error deleting user:', err);
    return {
      ok: false,
      dbConnected: false,
      error:
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : 'Failed to permanently delete user from database.',
    };
  }
}

// ==========================================
// EARLY-ACCESS WAITLIST LEADS (PUBLIC CAPTURE & ADMIN VIEW)
// ==========================================

export interface EarlyAccessLeadRecord {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  jurisdictionCode: string;
  customJurisdictionText: string | null;
  source: string;
  status: 'PENDING' | 'INVITED';
  createdAt: string;
}

const globalForWaitlist = globalThis as unknown as {
  bmuWaitlistFallback?: EarlyAccessLeadRecord[];
  bmuWaitlistTableInitialized?: boolean;
};

function getInMemoryWaitlistFallback(): EarlyAccessLeadRecord[] {
  if (!globalForWaitlist.bmuWaitlistFallback) {
    globalForWaitlist.bmuWaitlistFallback = [];
  }
  return globalForWaitlist.bmuWaitlistFallback;
}

async function ensureEarlyAccessWaitlistTable(): Promise<void> {
  if (globalForWaitlist.bmuWaitlistTableInitialized) return;
  await db.execute(sql`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS early_access_waitlist (
      id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
      email text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      jurisdiction_code text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'IE',
      custom_jurisdiction_text text,
      source text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'LANDING_HERO',
      status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
      created_at timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    );
  `);
  globalForWaitlist.bmuWaitlistTableInitialized = true;
}

/**
 * Public Server Action for the Landing Page Early-Access Waitlist form.
 * Enforces rate limiting, sanitizes inputs, and saves the lead to PostgreSQL (with local fallback).
 */
export async function submitEarlyAccessWaitlistAction(input: {
  email: string;
  jurisdictionCode: string;
  customJurisdictionText?: string;
}): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  error?: string;
  lead?: EarlyAccessLeadRecord;
}> {
  const cleanEmail = (input.email || '').trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 180);
  if (!cleanEmail || !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(cleanEmail)) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: 'Please enter a valid email address.',
    };
  }

  const rateLimit = checkRateLimit(
    `waitlist:submit:${cleanEmail}`,
    5,
    10 * 60_000
  );
  if (!rateLimit.allowed) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: `Too many requests. Please wait ${rateLimit.retryAfterSeconds} seconds.`,
    };
  }

  const allowedJurisdictions = new Set([
    'IE',
    'GB',
    'EU',
    'US',
    'AU_CA',
    'OTHER',
  ]);
  const cleanJurisdiction = allowedJurisdictions.has(input.jurisdictionCode)
    ? input.jurisdictionCode
    : 'IE';
  const cleanCustomText =
    cleanJurisdiction === 'OTHER' && input.customJurisdictionText
      ? input.customJurisdictionText.trim().slice(0, 120) || null
      : null;

  const fallbackRecord: EarlyAccessLeadRecord = {
    id: `wl-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`,
    email: cleanEmail,
    jurisdictionCode: cleanJurisdiction,
    customJurisdictionText: cleanCustomText,
    source: 'LANDING_HERO',
    status: 'PENDING',
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  // Always mirror in server memory so local dev works even if Docker Postgres is stopped
  const memoryList = getInMemoryWaitlistFallback();
  const existingIdx = memoryList.findIndex((item) => item.email === cleanEmail);
  if (existingIdx >= 0) {
    memoryList[existingIdx] = {
      ...memoryList[existingIdx],
      jurisdictionCode: cleanJurisdiction,
      customJurisdictionText: cleanCustomText,
    };
  } else {
    memoryList.unshift(fallbackRecord);
  }

  try {
    await ensureEarlyAccessWaitlistTable();

    const [existing] = await db
      .select()
      .from(earlyAccessWaitlist)
      .where(eq(earlyAccessWaitlist.email, cleanEmail))
      .limit(1);

    if (existing) {
      const [updated] = await db
        .update(earlyAccessWaitlist)
        .set({
          jurisdictionCode: cleanJurisdiction,
          customJurisdictionText: cleanCustomText,
        })
        .where(eq(earlyAccessWaitlist.id, existing.id))
        .returning();

      return {
        ok: true,
        lead: {
          id: updated.id,
          email: updated.email,
          jurisdictionCode: updated.jurisdictionCode,
          customJurisdictionText: updated.customJurisdictionText ?? null,
          source: updated.source,
          status: updated.status === 'INVITED' ? 'INVITED' : 'PENDING',
          createdAt: updated.createdAt.toISOString(),
        },
      };
    }

    const [inserted] = await db
      .insert(earlyAccessWaitlist)
      .values({
        email: cleanEmail,
        jurisdictionCode: cleanJurisdiction,
        customJurisdictionText: cleanCustomText,
        source: 'LANDING_HERO',
        status: 'PENDING',
      })
      .returning();

    return {
      ok: true,
      lead: {
        id: inserted.id,
        email: inserted.email,
        jurisdictionCode: inserted.jurisdictionCode,
        customJurisdictionText: inserted.customJurisdictionText ?? null,
        source: inserted.source,
        status: inserted.status === 'INVITED' ? 'INVITED' : 'PENDING',
        createdAt: inserted.createdAt.toISOString(),
      },
    };
  } catch {
    return {
      ok: true,
      lead: fallbackRecord,
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Super Admin action to list all Early-Access Waitlist leads.
 */
export async function listEarlyAccessWaitlistAction(): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  dbConnected: boolean;
  leads: EarlyAccessLeadRecord[];
}> {
  const adminSession = await requireSuperAdminSession();
  if (!adminSession) {
    return { ok: false, dbConnected: false, leads: [] };
  }

  try {
    await ensureEarlyAccessWaitlistTable();
    const rows = await db
      .select()
      .from(earlyAccessWaitlist)
      .orderBy(desc(earlyAccessWaitlist.createdAt));

    return {
      ok: true,
      dbConnected: true,
      leads: rows.map((r) => ({
        id: r.id,
        email: r.email,
        jurisdictionCode: r.jurisdictionCode,
        customJurisdictionText: r.customJurisdictionText ?? null,
        source: r.source,
        status: r.status === 'INVITED' ? 'INVITED' : 'PENDING',
        createdAt: r.createdAt.toISOString(),
      })),
    };
  } catch {
    return {
      ok: true,
      dbConnected: false,
      leads: getInMemoryWaitlistFallback(),
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Super Admin action to toggle a waitlist lead's status between PENDING and INVITED.
 */
export async function updateEarlyAccessLeadStatusAction(input: {
  id: string;
  status: 'PENDING' | 'INVITED';
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean }> {
  const adminSession = await requireSuperAdminSession();
  if (!adminSession) {
    return { ok: false };
  }

  const memoryList = getInMemoryWaitlistFallback();
  const memItem = memoryList.find((item) => item.id === input.id);
  if (memItem) {
    memItem.status = input.status;
  }

  try {
    await ensureEarlyAccessWaitlistTable();
    await db
      .update(earlyAccessWaitlist)
      .set({ status: input.status })
      .where(eq(earlyAccessWaitlist.id, input.id));
    return { ok: true };
  } catch {
    return { ok: true };
  }
}

/**
 * Super Admin action to remove a lead from the Early-Access Waitlist.
 */
export async function deleteEarlyAccessLeadAction(input: {
  id: string;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean }> {
  const adminSession = await requireSuperAdminSession();
  if (!adminSession) {
    return { ok: false };
  }

  const memoryList = getInMemoryWaitlistFallback();
  const idx = memoryList.findIndex((item) => item.id === input.id);
  if (idx >= 0) {
    memoryList.splice(idx, 1);
  }

  try {
    await ensureEarlyAccessWaitlistTable();
    await db
      .delete(earlyAccessWaitlist)
      .where(eq(earlyAccessWaitlist.id, input.id));
    return { ok: true };
  } catch {
    return { ok: true };
  }
}

const globalForSupportTracker = globalThis as unknown as {
  bmuSupportTicketsFallback?: SupportTicketRecord[];
  bmuSupportTicketsTableInitialized?: boolean;
};

function getInMemorySupportTicketsFallback(): SupportTicketRecord[] {
  if (!globalForSupportTracker.bmuSupportTicketsFallback) {
    globalForSupportTracker.bmuSupportTicketsFallback = [];
  }
  return globalForSupportTracker.bmuSupportTicketsFallback;
}

async function ensureSupportTicketsTable(): Promise<void> {
  if (globalForSupportTracker.bmuSupportTicketsTableInitialized) return;
  await db.execute(sql`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS support_tickets (
      id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
      source text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ADMIN_TRACKER',
      ticket_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'BUG',
      custom_type_text text,
      priority text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MEDIUM',
      status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPEN',
      module_scope text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GLOBAL',
      step_context text,
      page_url text,
      plan_id text,
      plan_title text,
      reporter_email text,
      reporter_name text,
      user_plan_type text,
      title text NOT NULL,
      description text NOT NULL,
      expected_behavior text,
      admin_notes text,
      device_info text,
      device_metadata_json jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
      created_at timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
      updated_at timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    );
    ALTER TABLE support_tickets ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS device_info text;
    ALTER TABLE support_tickets ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS reporter_name text;
    ALTER TABLE support_tickets ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS user_plan_type text;
    ALTER TABLE support_tickets ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS device_metadata_json jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb;
  `);
  globalForSupportTracker.bmuSupportTicketsTableInitialized = true;
}

function mapSupportTicketRow(
  r: typeof supportTickets.$inferSelect
): SupportTicketRecord {
  return {
    id: r.id,
    source: (r.source as SupportTicketSource) || 'ADMIN_TRACKER',
    ticketType: (r.ticketType as SupportTicketType) || 'BUG',
    customTypeText: r.customTypeText ?? null,
    priority: (r.priority as SupportTicketPriority) || 'MEDIUM',
    status: (r.status as SupportTicketStatus) || 'OPEN',
    moduleScope: (r.moduleScope as SupportModuleScope) || 'GLOBAL',
    stepContext: r.stepContext ?? null,
    pageUrl: r.pageUrl ?? null,
    planId: r.planId ?? null,
    planTitle: r.planTitle ?? null,
    reporterEmail: r.reporterEmail ?? null,
    reporterName: r.reporterName ?? null,
    userPlanType: r.userPlanType ?? null,
    title: r.title,
    description: r.description,
    expectedBehavior: r.expectedBehavior ?? null,
    adminNotes: r.adminNotes ?? null,
    deviceInfo: r.deviceInfo ?? null,
    deviceMetadataJson: (r.deviceMetadataJson as Record<string, unknown>) ?? null,
    createdAt: r.createdAt.toISOString(),
    updatedAt: r.updatedAt.toISOString(),
  };
}

/**
 * Lists all Support & Bug Tracker tickets for the Super Admin panel.
 */
export async function listSupportTicketsAction(): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  dbConnected: boolean;
  tickets: SupportTicketRecord[];
}> {
  const adminSession = await requireSuperAdminSession();
  if (!adminSession) {
    return { ok: false, dbConnected: false, tickets: [] };
  }

  try {
    await ensureSupportTicketsTable();
    const rows = await db
      .select()
      .from(supportTickets)
      .orderBy(desc(supportTickets.createdAt));

    return {
      ok: true,
      dbConnected: true,
      tickets: rows.map(mapSupportTicketRow),
    };
  } catch {
    return {
      ok: true,
      dbConnected: false,
      tickets: getInMemorySupportTicketsFallback(),
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Creates a new Support / Bug / Improvement ticket.
 * Allowed for Super Admins in production, and also allowed locally in development
 * so the in-workspace Quick-Capture button can log issues while testing without switching tabs.
 */
export async function createSupportTicketAction(input: {
  source?: SupportTicketSource;
  ticketType: SupportTicketType;
  customTypeText?: string | null;
  priority: SupportTicketPriority;
  moduleScope: SupportModuleScope;
  stepContext?: string | null;
  pageUrl?: string | null;
  planId?: string | null;
  planTitle?: string | null;
  reporterEmail?: string | null;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  expectedBehavior?: string | null;
  adminNotes?: string | null;
}): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  error?: string;
  ticket?: SupportTicketRecord;
}> {
  const adminSession = await requireSuperAdminSession();
  const isLocalDev = process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production';

  if (!adminSession && !isLocalDev) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: 'Unauthorized: Super Admin session required.',
    };
  }

  const cleanTitle = (input.title || '').trim().slice(0, 220);
  const cleanDescription = (input.description || '').trim().slice(0, 4000);
  if (!cleanTitle) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Please enter a short title for this issue.' };
  }
  if (!cleanDescription) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Please describe the bug or improvement.' };
  }

  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
  const cleanTicket: SupportTicketRecord = {
    id: `tkt-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`,
    source: input.source || 'ADMIN_TRACKER',
    ticketType: input.ticketType || 'BUG',
    customTypeText:
      input.ticketType === 'OTHER' && input.customTypeText
        ? input.customTypeText.trim().slice(0, 120) || null
        : null,
    priority: input.priority || 'MEDIUM',
    status: 'OPEN',
    moduleScope: input.moduleScope || 'GLOBAL',
    stepContext: input.stepContext
      ? input.stepContext.trim().slice(0, 140) || null
      : null,
    pageUrl: input.pageUrl ? input.pageUrl.trim().slice(0, 300) || null : null,
    planId: input.planId ? input.planId.trim().slice(0, 120) || null : null,
    planTitle: input.planTitle
      ? input.planTitle.trim().slice(0, 180) || null
      : null,
    reporterEmail:
      (input.reporterEmail || adminSession?.email || 'local-admin@startuppreflight.com')
        .trim()
        .slice(0, 180),
    title: cleanTitle,
    description: cleanDescription,
    expectedBehavior: input.expectedBehavior
      ? input.expectedBehavior.trim().slice(0, 2000) || null
      : null,
    adminNotes: input.adminNotes
      ? input.adminNotes.trim().slice(0, 2000) || null
      : null,
    createdAt: nowIso,
    updatedAt: nowIso,
  };

  const memoryList = getInMemorySupportTicketsFallback();
  memoryList.unshift(cleanTicket);

  try {
    await ensureSupportTicketsTable();
    const [inserted] = await db
      .insert(supportTickets)
      .values({
        source: cleanTicket.source,
        ticketType: cleanTicket.ticketType,
        customTypeText: cleanTicket.customTypeText,
        priority: cleanTicket.priority,
        status: cleanTicket.status,
        moduleScope: cleanTicket.moduleScope,
        stepContext: cleanTicket.stepContext,
        pageUrl: cleanTicket.pageUrl,
        planId: cleanTicket.planId,
        planTitle: cleanTicket.planTitle,
        reporterEmail: cleanTicket.reporterEmail,
        title: cleanTicket.title,
        description: cleanTicket.description,
        expectedBehavior: cleanTicket.expectedBehavior,
        adminNotes: cleanTicket.adminNotes,
      })
      .returning();

    const mapped = mapSupportTicketRow(inserted);
    // Keep fallback ID synced with DB UUID
    memoryList[0] = mapped;

    return {
      ok: true,
      ticket: mapped,
    };
  } catch {
    return {
      ok: true,
      ticket: cleanTicket,
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Updates an existing Support / Bug Tracker ticket (status, priority, notes, or details).
 */
export async function updateSupportTicketAction(input: {
  id: string;
  status?: SupportTicketStatus;
  priority?: SupportTicketPriority;
  ticketType?: SupportTicketType;
  customTypeText?: string | null;
  moduleScope?: SupportModuleScope;
  stepContext?: string | null;
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  expectedBehavior?: string | null;
  adminNotes?: string | null;
}): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  ticket?: SupportTicketRecord;
}> {
  const adminSession = await requireSuperAdminSession();
  if (!adminSession) {
    return { ok: false };
  }

  const now = new Date();
  const memoryList = getInMemorySupportTicketsFallback();
  const memIdx = memoryList.findIndex((t) => t.id === input.id);
  if (memIdx >= 0) {
    const prev = memoryList[memIdx];
    memoryList[memIdx] = {
      ...prev,
      status: input.status ?? prev.status,
      priority: input.priority ?? prev.priority,
      ticketType: input.ticketType ?? prev.ticketType,
      customTypeText:
        input.customTypeText !== undefined
          ? input.customTypeText
          : prev.customTypeText,
      moduleScope: input.moduleScope ?? prev.moduleScope,
      stepContext:
        input.stepContext !== undefined ? input.stepContext : prev.stepContext,
      title: input.title !== undefined ? input.title.trim() : prev.title,
      description:
        input.description !== undefined
          ? input.description.trim()
          : prev.description,
      expectedBehavior:
        input.expectedBehavior !== undefined
          ? input.expectedBehavior
          : prev.expectedBehavior,
      adminNotes:
        input.adminNotes !== undefined ? input.adminNotes : prev.adminNotes,
      updatedAt: now.toISOString(),
    };
  }

  try {
    await ensureSupportTicketsTable();
    const updatePayload: Partial<typeof supportTickets.$inferInsert> = {
      updatedAt: now,
    };
    if (input.status !== undefined) updatePayload.status = input.status;
    if (input.priority !== undefined) updatePayload.priority = input.priority;
    if (input.ticketType !== undefined)
      updatePayload.ticketType = input.ticketType;
    if (input.customTypeText !== undefined)
      updatePayload.customTypeText = input.customTypeText;
    if (input.moduleScope !== undefined)
      updatePayload.moduleScope = input.moduleScope;
    if (input.stepContext !== undefined)
      updatePayload.stepContext = input.stepContext;
    if (input.title !== undefined) updatePayload.title = input.title.trim();
    if (input.description !== undefined)
      updatePayload.description = input.description.trim();
    if (input.expectedBehavior !== undefined)
      updatePayload.expectedBehavior = input.expectedBehavior;
    if (input.adminNotes !== undefined)
      updatePayload.adminNotes = input.adminNotes;

    const [updated] = await db
      .update(supportTickets)
      .set(updatePayload)
      .where(eq(supportTickets.id, input.id))
      .returning();

    if (updated) {
      return { ok: true, ticket: mapSupportTicketRow(updated) };
    }
    return {
      ok: true,
      ticket: memIdx >= 0 ? memoryList[memIdx] : undefined,
    };
  } catch {
    return {
      ok: true,
      ticket: memIdx >= 0 ? memoryList[memIdx] : undefined,
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Deletes a Support / Bug Tracker ticket permanently.
 */
export async function deleteSupportTicketAction(input: {
  id: string;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean }> {
  const adminSession = await requireSuperAdminSession();
  if (!adminSession) {
    return { ok: false };
  }

  const memoryList = getInMemorySupportTicketsFallback();
  const idx = memoryList.findIndex((t) => t.id === input.id);
  if (idx >= 0) {
    memoryList.splice(idx, 1);
  }

  try {
    await ensureSupportTicketsTable();
    await db.delete(supportTickets).where(eq(supportTickets.id, input.id));
    return { ok: true };
  } catch {
    return { ok: true };
  }
}

  users,
  startupPlans,
  planModulesData,
  planCollaborators,
  validationSurveys,
  surveyResponses,
  emailLogs,
  type CohortMilestoneConfig,
} from '@/db';
import {
  getServerSessionCookie,
  getAdminSessionCookie,
} from '@/lib/auth/server-auth';
import { resend, EMAIL_DEFAULTS } from '@/lib/email/resend';

const UUID_REGEX =
  /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

export interface CohortPortalStartup {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  founders: string;
  founderEmail: string;
  avatarBg: string;
  hqCountryCode: string;
  baseCurrency: string;
  grantFocus: string;
  targetGrantAmount: string;
  overallProgress: number; // 0-100%
  currentModuleName: string;
  surveyResponsesCount: number;
  willingnessToPay: string;
  status: 'GRANT_READY' | 'ON_TRACK' | 'VALIDATING' | 'NEEDS_ATTENTION' | 'MILESTONE_CLAIMED';
  statusBadge: {
    label: string;
    bg: string;
    dot: string;
  };
  oneLiner: string;
  keyMetric: string;
  coFounderScore: number;
  coFounderStatus: string;
  mentorFlag?: string;
  mentorNotes?: string;
  modulesBreakdown: {
    ideation: number; // Mod A-B
    surveys: number; // Mod C
    product: number; // Mod D-E
    team: number; // Mod F
    financials: number; // Mod H-J
    grantPack: number; // Mod K-L
  };
  milestoneStatus: 'IN_PROGRESS' | 'ELIGIBLE_TO_CLAIM' | 'CLAIMED_PARTNER_NOTIFIED' | 'REWARD_ACTIVATED';
  milestoneClaimedAt?: string | null;
  verifiedDomain?: string | null;
  verifiedWorkEmail?: string | null;
  claimDossier?: any;
  createdAt: string;
}

export interface CohortPortalData {
  cohort: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    organizationName: string;
    partnerLogoUrl?: string | null;
    intakeType: 'FIXED_BATCH' | 'ROLLING';
    inviteCode: string;
    maxSeats: number;
    seatsUsed: number;
    accessDurationMonths: number;
    milestoneConfig?: CohortMilestoneConfig;
    createdAt: string;
  };
  staff: Array<{
    id: string;
    name: string | null;
    email: string;
    role: string;
  }>;
  startups: CohortPortalStartup[];
  aggregates: {
    totalStartups: number;
    averageBatchProgress: number;
    grantReadyCount: number;
    customerSignalsTotal: number;
    milestoneClaimsPendingCount: number;
    milestoneClaimsApprovedCount: number;
    attentionNeededCount: number;
  };
  sampleStartups?: CohortPortalStartup[];
  isSampleData?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Fetch Cohort Portal Data for Lead Directors & Mentors
 */
export async function getCohortPortalDataAction(cohortIdOrCode: string): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  data?: CohortPortalData;
  error?: string;
  isAuthorized?: boolean;
}> {
  try {
    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

    const founderSession = await getServerSessionCookie();
    const adminSession = await getAdminSessionCookie();
    const isSuperAdmin =
      Boolean(adminSession && adminSession.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN') ||
      founderSession?.userId === 'super-admin-root' ||
      founderSession?.userId === 'super-admin-local';

    const cleanInput = (cohortIdOrCode || '').trim();

    // 1. Locate Cohort by UUID or Invite Code
    let cohortRecord: any = null;
    if (UUID_REGEX.test(cleanInput)) {
      const [found] = await db
        .select()
        .from(cohorts)
        .where(eq(cohorts.id, cleanInput))
        .limit(1);
      cohortRecord = found;
    }

    if (!cohortRecord) {
      const [found] = await db
        .select()
        .from(cohorts)
        .where(sql`LOWER(${cohorts.inviteCode}) = ${cleanInput.toLowerCase()}`)
        .limit(1);
      cohortRecord = found;
    }

    // Demo Mode handling
    if (!cohortRecord && cleanInput.toLowerCase() === 'demo') {
      cohortRecord = {
        id: 'demo-cohort-novaucd',
        name: 'NovaUCD & Tangent Venture Batch 2027',
        organizationName: 'NovaUCD & Trinity Tangent',
        partnerLogoUrl: null,
        intakeType: 'FIXED_BATCH',
        inviteCode: 'BMU-UCD-2027',
        maxSeats: 30,
        seatsUsed: 24,
        accessDurationMonths: 6,
        milestoneConfigJson: {
          milestoneGateName: 'Google for Startups Cloud & Grant Acceleration',
          requiredProgressPercent: 65,
          requiredModules: ['MOD_A_IDEATION', 'MOD_B_MARKET', 'MOD_C_SURVEYS', 'MOD_D_PRODUCT', 'MOD_F_TEAM'],
          requireOfficialDomain: true,
          requireWorkEmail: true,
          rewardLabel: '$25,000 Google Cloud Credits & Partner Perks',
          partnerNotificationEmails: ['programs@novaucd.ie'],
        },
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
    }

    if (!cohortRecord) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: `Institutional cohort "${cleanInput}" could not be found.`,
      };
    }

    // 2. Fetch Cohort Staff
    let staffRecords: any[] = [];
    if (UUID_REGEX.test(cohortRecord.id)) {
      staffRecords = await db
        .select({
          id: cohortStaff.id,
          name: cohortStaff.name,
          email: cohortStaff.email,
          role: cohortStaff.role,
        })
        .from(cohortStaff)
        .where(eq(cohortStaff.cohortId, cohortRecord.id));
    }

    // Check Authorization:
    // If Super Admin, always allowed.
    // If Founder Session, check if their email or userId matches staff.
    let isStaffMember = false;
    if (founderSession?.email) {
      const lowerSessionEmail = founderSession.email.toLowerCase();
      isStaffMember = staffRecords.some(
        (s) => s.email && s.email.toLowerCase() === lowerSessionEmail
      );
    }

    // In production, strictly enforce director/mentor or super-admin role
    const isProduction = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production';
    if (isProduction && !isSuperAdmin && !isStaffMember) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: 'Unauthorized: Access restricted to assigned institutional cohort staff, directors, and administrators.',
        isAuthorized: false,
      };
    }

    const isAuthorized = isSuperAdmin || isStaffMember || !isProduction;

    // 3. Fetch Enrolled Startup Plans
    let startupList: CohortPortalStartup[] = [];

    if (UUID_REGEX.test(cohortRecord.id)) {
      // Find plans linked directly to cohortId
      const plans = await db
        .select({
          plan: startupPlans,
          user: {
            id: users.id,
            name: users.name,
            email: users.email,
          },
        })
        .from(startupPlans)
        .leftJoin(users, eq(startupPlans.ownerUserId, users.id))
        .where(eq(startupPlans.cohortId, cohortRecord.id))
        .orderBy(desc(startupPlans.createdAt));

      // Also find users with cohortId whose plans might not have had cohortId backfilled
      const cohortUsers = await db
        .select({ id: users.id })
        .from(users)
        .where(eq(users.cohortId, cohortRecord.id));

      const existingPlanIds = new Set(plans.map((p) => p.plan.id));
      const orphanUserIds = cohortUsers
        .map((u) => u.id)
        .filter((uid) => !plans.some((p) => p.user?.id === uid));

      if (orphanUserIds.length > 0) {
        const orphanPlans = await db
          .select({
            plan: startupPlans,
            user: {
              id: users.id,
              name: users.name,
              email: users.email,
            },
          })
          .from(startupPlans)
          .leftJoin(users, eq(startupPlans.ownerUserId, users.id))
          .where(inArray(startupPlans.ownerUserId, orphanUserIds));

        for (const op of orphanPlans) {
          if (!existingPlanIds.has(op.plan.id)) {
            plans.push(op);
            existingPlanIds.add(op.plan.id);
          }
        }
      }

      // Populate rich startup telemetry for each enrolled plan
      for (const item of plans) {
        const p = item.plan;
        const u = item.user;

        // Fetch Module Progress for this plan
        const moduleRows = await db
          .select({
            moduleCode: planModulesData.moduleCode,
            completionPercentage: planModulesData.completionPercentage,
          })
          .from(planModulesData)
          .where(eq(planModulesData.planId, p.id));

        const modMap = new Map<string, number>();
        moduleRows.forEach((r) => modMap.set(r.moduleCode, r.completionPercentage || 0));

        // Group into 6 Milestones
        const ideationScore = Math.round(
          ((modMap.get('MOD_A_IDEATION') || 0) + (modMap.get('MOD_B_MARKET') || 0)) / 2
        );
        const surveysScore = modMap.get('MOD_C_SURVEYS_FEEDBACK') || 0;
        const productScore = Math.round(
          ((modMap.get('MOD_D_PRODUCT_BUILD') || 0) + (modMap.get('MOD_E_OPERATIONS') || 0)) / 2
        );
        const teamScore = modMap.get('MOD_F_COFOUNDER_TEAM') || 0;
        const financialsScore = Math.round(
          ((modMap.get('MOD_H_REVENUE') || 0) + (modMap.get('MOD_J_FINANCE') || 0)) / 2
        );
        const grantScore = Math.round(
          ((modMap.get('MOD_K_GRANTS_FUNDING') || 0) + (modMap.get('MOD_L_BUSINESS_PLAN') || 0)) / 2
        );

        // Overall progress
        const overallProgress = Math.min(
          100,
          Math.round(
            (ideationScore + surveysScore + productScore + teamScore + financialsScore + grantScore) / 6
          )
        );

        // Survey Responses Count
        const [survey] = await db
          .select({ id: validationSurveys.id })
          .from(validationSurveys)
          .where(eq(validationSurveys.planId, p.id))
          .limit(1);

        let surveyCount = 0;
        if (survey) {
          const countRes = await db
            .select({ count: sql<number>`count(*)` })
            .from(surveyResponses)
            .where(eq(surveyResponses.surveyId, survey.id));
          surveyCount = Number(countRes[0]?.count || 0);
        }

        // Collaborators & Co-Founder Alignment
        const collabs = await db
          .select()
          .from(planCollaborators)
          .where(eq(planCollaborators.planId, p.id));

        let coFounderScore = 100;
        let coFounderStatus = 'Solo Founder Model Complete';
        if (collabs.length > 0) {
          const completedCount = collabs.filter((c) => c.alignmentInterviewCompleted).length;
          if (completedCount === collabs.length) {
            coFounderScore = 95;
            coFounderStatus = 'All Founders Completed Blind Alignment';
          } else {
            coFounderScore = 60;
            coFounderStatus = `${completedCount}/${collabs.length} Alignment Surveys Submitted`;
          }
        }

        // Target Grant
        const grantMeta = p.grantComplianceMetadataJson || {};
        const targetGrantStr =
          grantMeta.selectedTargetGrants && grantMeta.selectedTargetGrants.length > 0
            ? grantMeta.selectedTargetGrants[0].replace(/_/g, ' ')
            : p.hqCountryCode === 'GB'
              ? 'Innovate UK Smart Grant / Start Up Loans'
              : 'LEO Feasibility / Priming Grant';

        // Milestone Status
        const mStatus = (p.cohortMilestoneStatus as any) || 'IN_PROGRESS';
        const claimData = p.cohortMilestoneClaimDataJson as any;

        // Categorize Startup Status
        let status: CohortPortalStartup['status'] = 'VALIDATING';
        let statusBadge = {
          label: 'In Validation',
          bg: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border-blue-300',
          dot: 'bg-blue-500',
        };

        if (mStatus === 'REWARD_ACTIVATED') {
          status = 'MILESTONE_CLAIMED';
          statusBadge = {
            label: 'Milestone Activated 🎁',
            bg: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300',
            dot: 'bg-emerald-500',
          };
        } else if (mStatus === 'CLAIMED_PARTNER_NOTIFIED') {
          status = 'MILESTONE_CLAIMED';
          statusBadge = {
            label: 'Claim Under Review ⚡',
            bg: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 border-amber-300',
            dot: 'bg-amber-500',
          };
        } else if (overallProgress >= 85) {
          status = 'GRANT_READY';
          statusBadge = {
            label: 'Grant-Ready (Audited)',
            bg: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300',
            dot: 'bg-emerald-500',
          };
        } else if (coFounderScore < 65) {
          status = 'NEEDS_ATTENTION';
          statusBadge = {
            label: 'Attention: Co-Founder Alignment',
            bg: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 border-amber-300',
            dot: 'bg-amber-500',
          };
        } else if (overallProgress >= 40) {
          status = 'ON_TRACK';
          statusBadge = {
            label: 'On Track (Executing)',
            bg: 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800 border-indigo-300',
            dot: 'bg-indigo-500',
          };
        }

        // Color avatar by plan name hash
        const colorPalette = [
          'bg-indigo-600',
          'bg-emerald-600',
          'bg-violet-600',
          'bg-blue-600',
          'bg-teal-600',
          'bg-rose-600',
        ];
        const hash = (p.title || '').split('').reduce((acc, c) => acc + c.charCodeAt(0), 0);
        const avatarBg = colorPalette[hash % colorPalette.length];

        startupList.push({
          id: p.id,
          name: p.title || 'Untitled Startup',
          category: p.industryCategory || 'Technology / General',
          founders: u?.name || 'Founder',
          founderEmail: u?.email || '',
          avatarBg,
          hqCountryCode: p.hqCountryCode || 'IE',
          baseCurrency: p.baseCurrency || 'EUR',
          grantFocus: targetGrantStr,
          targetGrantAmount: p.hqCountryCode === 'GB' ? '£50,000' : '€50,000',
          overallProgress,
          currentModuleName: p.currentModuleStep || 'Mod A: Concept Canvas',
          surveyResponsesCount: surveyCount,
          willingnessToPay: surveyCount > 0 ? `${surveyCount} verified leads` : 'Gathering signals',
          status,
          statusBadge,
          oneLiner: p.oneLinerSummary || 'Building next-generation solution.',
          keyMetric: `${overallProgress}% Milestone Velocity`,
          coFounderScore,
          coFounderStatus,
          mentorFlag: claimData?.mentorFlag || undefined,
          mentorNotes: claimData?.mentorNotes || undefined,
          modulesBreakdown: {
            ideation: ideationScore,
            surveys: surveysScore,
            product: productScore,
            team: teamScore,
            financials: financialsScore,
            grantPack: grantScore,
          },
          milestoneStatus: mStatus,
          milestoneClaimedAt: p.cohortMilestoneClaimedAt ? p.cohortMilestoneClaimedAt.toISOString() : null,
          verifiedDomain: p.verifiedCohortDomain,
          verifiedWorkEmail: p.verifiedCohortWorkEmail,
          claimDossier: claimData,
          createdAt: p.createdAt.toISOString(),
        });
      }
    }

    // Only use SAMPLE_STARTUPS for the explicit Demo route (/cohort-portal/demo)
    const isDemo = cleanInput.toLowerCase() === 'demo' || cohortRecord.id === 'demo-cohort-novaucd';
    const isSampleData = isDemo;
    const finalStartups = isDemo ? SAMPLE_STARTUPS : startupList;

    // 4. Compute Aggregate Metrics
    const totalCount = finalStartups.length;
    const avgProgress = totalCount > 0
      ? Math.round(finalStartups.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.overallProgress, 0) / totalCount)
      : 0;
    const grantReadyCount = finalStartups.filter((s) => s.overallProgress >= 80).length;
    const customerSignalsTotal = finalStartups.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.surveyResponsesCount, 0);
    const milestoneClaimsPendingCount = finalStartups.filter(
      (s) => s.milestoneStatus === 'CLAIMED_PARTNER_NOTIFIED'
    ).length;
    const milestoneClaimsApprovedCount = finalStartups.filter(
      (s) => s.milestoneStatus === 'REWARD_ACTIVATED'
    ).length;
    const attentionNeededCount = finalStartups.filter(
      (s) => s.status === 'NEEDS_ATTENTION'
    ).length;

    return {
      success: true,
      isAuthorized,
      data: {
        cohort: {
          id: cohortRecord.id,
          name: cohortRecord.name,
          organizationName: cohortRecord.organizationName || 'Accelerator Partner',
          partnerLogoUrl: cohortRecord.partnerLogoUrl,
          intakeType: (cohortRecord.intakeType as any) || 'FIXED_BATCH',
          inviteCode: cohortRecord.inviteCode,
          maxSeats: cohortRecord.maxSeats,
          seatsUsed: cohortRecord.seatsUsed || startupList.length,
          accessDurationMonths: cohortRecord.accessDurationMonths || 6,
          milestoneConfig: cohortRecord.milestoneConfigJson || undefined,
          createdAt: cohortRecord.createdAt ? new Date(cohortRecord.createdAt).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),
        },
        staff: staffRecords,
        startups: finalStartups,
        sampleStartups: SAMPLE_STARTUPS,
        aggregates: {
          totalStartups: totalCount,
          averageBatchProgress: avgProgress,
          grantReadyCount,
          customerSignalsTotal,
          milestoneClaimsPendingCount,
          milestoneClaimsApprovedCount,
          attentionNeededCount,
        },
        isSampleData,
      },
    };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('[getCohortPortalDataAction] Error:', error);
    return {
      success: false,
      error: error?.message || 'Failed to retrieve cohort portal data.',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Save Mentor Intelligence Note for a Startup in the Cohort
 */
export async function updateCohortStartupMentorNoteAction(params: {
  planId: string;
  mentorNote: string;
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const { planId, mentorNote } = params;
    if (!planId) return { success: false, error: 'Missing plan ID' };

    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

    const founderSession = await getServerSessionCookie();
    const adminSession = await getAdminSessionCookie();
    if (!founderSession && !adminSession) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized session.' };
    }

    if (planId.startsWith('sample-') || !UUID_REGEX.test(planId)) {
      // Local preview mutation
      return { success: true };
    }

    const [plan] = await db
      .select({
        id: startupPlans.id,
        cohortId: startupPlans.cohortId,
        cohortMilestoneClaimDataJson: startupPlans.cohortMilestoneClaimDataJson,
      })
      .from(startupPlans)
      .where(eq(startupPlans.id, planId))
      .limit(1);

    if (!plan) return { success: false, error: 'Startup plan not found' };

    // Verify caller is Super Admin OR an assigned Director/Mentor for this cohort
    const isSuperAdmin =
      Boolean(adminSession && adminSession.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN') ||
      founderSession?.userId === 'super-admin-root' ||
      founderSession?.userId === 'super-admin-local';

    if (!isSuperAdmin) {
      if (!plan.cohortId) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: 'Unauthorized: Startup plan is not assigned to an institutional cohort.',
        };
      }

      const staffCheck = await db
        .select({ id: cohortStaff.id })
        .from(cohortStaff)
        .where(
          and(
            eq(cohortStaff.cohortId, plan.cohortId),
            founderSession?.email
              ? sql`LOWER(${cohortStaff.email}) = ${founderSession.email.toLowerCase().trim()}`
              : eq(cohortStaff.userId, founderSession?.userId || '')
          )
        )
        .limit(1);

      if (staffCheck.length === 0) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: 'Unauthorized: Only assigned cohort directors and mentors can update notes for this startup.',
        };
      }
    }

    const currentData = (plan.cohortMilestoneClaimDataJson as any) || {};
    const updatedData = {
      ...currentData,
      mentorNotes: mentorNote.trim(),
      mentorNotesUpdatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    await db
      .update(startupPlans)
      .set({
        cohortMilestoneClaimDataJson: updatedData,
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(startupPlans.id, planId));

    return { success: true };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('[updateCohortStartupMentorNoteAction] Error:', error);
    return { success: false, error: error?.message || 'Failed to save mentor note.' };
  }
}

/**
 * Review & Activate Milestone Reward for a Startup (e.g. Google Cloud Credits, Grant Voucher)
 */
export async function reviewCohortMilestoneClaimAction(params: {
  planId: string;
  decision: 'APPROVE' | 'REQUEST_INFO';
  approvalNotes?: string;
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const { planId, decision, approvalNotes } = params;
    if (!planId) return { success: false, error: 'Missing plan ID' };

    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

    const founderSession = await getServerSessionCookie();
    const adminSession = await getAdminSessionCookie();
    if (!founderSession && !adminSession) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized session.' };
    }

    if (planId.startsWith('sample-') || !UUID_REGEX.test(planId)) {
      // Local preview mutation
      return { success: true };
    }

    const [plan] = await db
      .select({
        id: startupPlans.id,
        title: startupPlans.title,
        cohortId: startupPlans.cohortId,
        verifiedCohortWorkEmail: startupPlans.verifiedCohortWorkEmail,
        verifiedCohortDomain: startupPlans.verifiedCohortDomain,
        cohortMilestoneClaimDataJson: startupPlans.cohortMilestoneClaimDataJson,
      })
      .from(startupPlans)
      .where(eq(startupPlans.id, planId))
      .limit(1);

    if (!plan) return { success: false, error: 'Startup plan not found.' };

    // Verify caller is Super Admin OR an assigned Director/Mentor for this cohort
    const isSuperAdmin =
      Boolean(adminSession && adminSession.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN') ||
      founderSession?.userId === 'super-admin-root' ||
      founderSession?.userId === 'super-admin-local';

    if (!isSuperAdmin) {
      if (!plan.cohortId) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: 'Unauthorized: Startup plan is not assigned to an institutional cohort.',
        };
      }

      const staffCheck = await db
        .select({ id: cohortStaff.id })
        .from(cohortStaff)
        .where(
          and(
            eq(cohortStaff.cohortId, plan.cohortId),
            founderSession?.email
              ? sql`LOWER(${cohortStaff.email}) = ${founderSession.email.toLowerCase().trim()}`
              : eq(cohortStaff.userId, founderSession?.userId || '')
          )
        )
        .limit(1);

      if (staffCheck.length === 0) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: 'Unauthorized: Only assigned cohort directors and mentors can review or approve milestone claims.',
        };
      }
    }

    const currentData = (plan.cohortMilestoneClaimDataJson as any) || {};
    const newStatus = decision === 'APPROVE' ? 'REWARD_ACTIVATED' : 'IN_PROGRESS';

    const updatedData = {
      ...currentData,
      reviewDecision: decision,
      reviewNotes: approvalNotes || '',
      reviewedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    await db
      .update(startupPlans)
      .set({
        cohortMilestoneStatus: newStatus,
        cohortMilestoneClaimDataJson: updatedData,
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(startupPlans.id, planId));

    // If approved, notify founder via email
    if (decision === 'APPROVE' && plan.verifiedCohortWorkEmail && resend) {
      try {
        const rewardLabel = currentData?.rewardTier?.label || 'Milestone Acceleration Perk';
        await resend.emails.send({
          from: EMAIL_DEFAULTS.notificationsFrom,
          to: [plan.verifiedCohortWorkEmail],
          subject: `🎉 Congratulations! Your ${rewardLabel} has been approved!`,
          html: `
            <div style="font-family: sans-serif; max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 24px; color: #1e293b;">
              <h2 style="color: #4f46e5; margin-top: 0;">Milestone Reward Activated!</h2>
              <p>Hi team <strong>${plan.title}</strong>,</p>
              <p>Great news! Your program directors have reviewed and approved your Milestone Acceleration Claim for <strong>${rewardLabel}</strong>.</p>
              <div style="background-color: #f1f5f9; padding: 16px; border-radius: 8px; margin: 20px 0;">
                <p style="margin: 0; font-size: 14px;"><strong>Verified Domain:</strong> ${plan.verifiedCohortDomain || 'Registered Domain'}</p>
                <p style="margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 14px;"><strong>Status:</strong> Approved &amp; Active</p>
                ${approvalNotes ? `<p style="margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 14px;"><strong>Director Note:</strong> ${approvalNotes}</p>` : ''}
              </div>
              <p>You can view your activation dossier inside your Startup Preflight workspace at any time.</p>
              <p style="margin-top: 32px; font-size: 12px; color: #64748b;">Startup Preflight Cohort Operations Team</p>
            </div>
          `,
        });

        await db.insert(emailLogs).values({
          recipient: plan.verifiedCohortWorkEmail,
          fromEmail: EMAIL_DEFAULTS.notificationsFrom,
          subject: `Milestone Reward Approved: ${plan.title}`,
          template: 'COHORT_MILESTONE_APPROVED',
          status: 'SENT',
        });
      } catch (mailErr) {
        console.warn('[reviewCohortMilestoneClaimAction] Non-fatal email dispatch warning:', mailErr);
      }
    }

    return { success: true };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('[reviewCohortMilestoneClaimAction] Error:', error);
    return { success: false, error: error?.message || 'Failed to update milestone review.' };
  }
}

const UUID_REGEX =
  /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

/**
 * Persists Module B Step 1 (Beachhead Market & Target Selling Geographies)
 * to `plan_modules_data` (MOD_B_MARKET) and updates `startup_plans.target_markets_array`.
 */
export async function saveModuleBStep1BeachheadAction(input: {
  planId: string;
  beachhead: BeachheadMarketData;
  completionPercentage?: number;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; persistedToCloudSql: boolean }> {
  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(input.planId)) {
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  const authCheck = await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(input.planId);
  if (!authCheck.authorized) {
    return { ok: false, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  try {
    const existingMod = await db
      .select()
      .from(planModulesData)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(planModulesData.planId, input.planId),
          eq(planModulesData.moduleCode, 'MOD_B_MARKET')
        )
      )
      .limit(1);

    const existingPayload = (existingMod[0]?.structuredInputsJsonb ??
      {}) as SavedModuleBData;

    const updatedPayload: SavedModuleBData = {
      ...existingPayload,
      beachhead: {
        ...input.beachhead,
        lastSavedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
    };

    const nextProgress = Math.max(
      existingMod[0]?.completionPercentage ?? 0,
      input.completionPercentage ?? 25
    );

    if (existingMod.length > 0) {
      await db
        .update(planModulesData)
        .set({
          structuredInputsJsonb: updatedPayload,
          completionPercentage: nextProgress,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(planModulesData.id, existingMod[0].id));
    } else {
      await db.insert(planModulesData).values({
        planId: input.planId,
        moduleCode: 'MOD_B_MARKET',
        structuredInputsJsonb: updatedPayload,
        aiThingsToConsiderJsonb: [],
        completionPercentage: nextProgress,
      });
    }

    await db
      .update(startupPlans)
      .set({
        targetMarketsArray:
          input.beachhead.targetMarketsArray.length > 0
            ? input.beachhead.targetMarketsArray
            : ['IE'],
        currentModuleStep: 'MOD_B_STEP_1',
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(startupPlans.id, input.planId));

    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: true };
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(
      '[SPF Module B] Could not persist Step 1 Beachhead to Cloud SQL:',
      err instanceof Error ? err.message : err
    );
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }
}

'use server';

import { db, grantsDirectory } from '@/db';
import { eq, desc } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { getAdminSessionCookie } from '@/lib/auth/server-auth';
import { GoogleGenAI, Type } from '@google/genai';
import { ensureDefaultGrantsSeededInDb } from '@/lib/grants/ensure-grants';
import {
  authorizeAndPrepareGeminiCall,
  recordGeminiUsageAndIncrementCredits,
  sanitizePromptInput,
} from '@/lib/ai/router';

function getGenAiClient(apiKey: string): GoogleGenAI {
  const isVertex =
    process.env.GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI === 'true' ||
    process.env.VERTEX_AI === 'true';

  if (isVertex) {
    if (apiKey && apiKey !== 'VERTEX_AI_ACTIVE') {
      return new GoogleGenAI({ apiKey });
    }
    return new GoogleGenAI({
      vertexai: true,
      project: process.env.GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT || 'startuppreflight',
      location: process.env.GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION || 'europe-west1',
    });
  }

  return new GoogleGenAI({ apiKey: apiKey || process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY || '' });
}

export type GrantDirectoryRecord = typeof grantsDirectory.$inferSelect;

export interface ExtractedGrantResult {
  slug: string;
  countryCode: string;
  grantName: string;
  providerAgency: string;
  fundingType: string;
  currency: string;
  maxAmountFormatted: string;
  maxFundingAmount: number;
  matchRatePercentage: number;
  isRepayable: boolean;
  minEmployees: number;
  maxEmployees: number;
  maxTradingMonths?: number;
  stageFit: string;
  turnaroundLabel: string;
  turnaroundSpeed: string;
  leoThreeQuoteEnforced: boolean;
  summary: string;
  descriptionMarkdown: string;
  eligibleCosts: string[];
  ineligibleCosts: string[];
  applicationRequirements: string[];
  disqualificationRedFlags: string[];
  reimbursementWarning: string;
  officialUrl: string;
  confidenceScore: number;
  sourceSnippets: string[];
}

export async function listAdminGrantsAction(): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  grants: GrantDirectoryRecord[];
  error?: string;
}> {
  try {
    const adminSession = await getAdminSessionCookie();
    if (!adminSession) {
      return { success: false, grants: [], error: 'Unauthorized admin session' };
    }

    await ensureDefaultGrantsSeededInDb();

    const grants = await db
      .select()
      .from(grantsDirectory)
      .orderBy(desc(grantsDirectory.createdAt));

    return { success: true, grants };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error('[AdminGrants] Error listing grants:', err);
    return { success: false, grants: [], error: 'Failed to retrieve grants list' };
  }
}

export async function aiExtractGrantFromPromptAction(input: {
  prompt: string;
  officialUrl?: string;
}): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  grant?: ExtractedGrantResult;
  error?: string;
}> {
  try {
    const adminSession = await getAdminSessionCookie();
    if (!adminSession || adminSession.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
      return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized: Super Admin session required' };
    }

    const authCtx = await authorizeAndPrepareGeminiCall(
      'ADMIN_GRANT_EXTRACT',
      'You are a Senior Government Grant Assessor & Enterprise Auditor.'
    );
    if (!authCtx.canCallLiveGemini || !authCtx.activeApiKey) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error:
          authCtx.blockReason ||
          'AI Billing Firewall active (daily platform limit or burst limit reached). Please try again shortly.',
      };
    }

    const ai = getGenAiClient(authCtx.activeApiKey);

    const systemInstruction = `You are a Senior Government Grant Assessor & Enterprise Auditor for Ireland (LEO, Enterprise Ireland, Revenue) and the United Kingdom (Innovate UK, British Business Bank, HMRC).
Your task is to take a natural language request or grant URL from an administrator and extract the complete, rigorous scheme specifications into a structured JSON schema.
Be realistic, accurate with statutory funding rules, and highlight strict assessor disqualification rules (e.g. LEO three-quote rules, laptop exclusions, de minimis state aid).`;

    const cleanPrompt = sanitizePromptInput(input.prompt, 1200);
    const cleanUrl = input.officialUrl ? sanitizePromptInput(input.officialUrl, 300) : '';

    const userPrompt = `Extract and structure the complete grant specification for this scheme:
Prompt / Request: "${cleanPrompt}"
${cleanUrl ? `Official Scheme URL: ${cleanUrl}` : ''}

Be precise with:
- Country Code ('IE' for Ireland, 'GB' for UK, 'ALL' for international)
- Max funding amount numeric and formatted
- Co-funding / match rate percentage (e.g. 50 for 50%)
- Whether it is a cash grant, loan, tax relief, or voucher
- High-priority list of eligible costs and strictly ineligible costs
- Common traps and disqualification red flags`;

    const response = await ai.models.generateContent({
      model: 'gemini-2.5-flash',
      contents: userPrompt,
      config: {
        systemInstruction,
        temperature: 0.2,
        maxOutputTokens: 2048,
        responseMimeType: 'application/json',
        responseSchema: {
          type: Type.OBJECT,
          properties: {
            slug: { type: Type.STRING, description: 'kebab-case URL slug e.g. ie-leo-priming-grant' },
            countryCode: { type: Type.STRING, description: 'IE or GB or ALL' },
            grantName: { type: Type.STRING },
            providerAgency: { type: Type.STRING },
            fundingType: { type: Type.STRING, description: 'GRANT, LOAN, TAX_RELIEF, VOUCHER, or R_AND_D_CREDIT' },
            currency: { type: Type.STRING, description: 'EUR or GBP' },
            maxAmountFormatted: { type: Type.STRING, description: 'e.g. Up to €150,000 (50% match)' },
            maxFundingAmount: { type: Type.INTEGER, description: 'Maximum numeric cap e.g. 150000' },
            matchRatePercentage: { type: Type.INTEGER, description: 'e.g. 50 or 70 or 100' },
            isRepayable: { type: Type.BOOLEAN },
            minEmployees: { type: Type.INTEGER },
            maxEmployees: { type: Type.INTEGER },
            maxTradingMonths: { type: Type.INTEGER },
            stageFit: { type: Type.STRING },
            turnaroundLabel: { type: Type.STRING, description: 'e.g. 4–6 Weeks Turnaround' },
            turnaroundSpeed: { type: Type.STRING },
            leoThreeQuoteEnforced: { type: Type.BOOLEAN },
            summary: { type: Type.STRING, description: '2 sentence plain-English summary for founders' },
            descriptionMarkdown: { type: Type.STRING, description: 'Detailed 2-3 paragraph overview' },
            eligibleCosts: { type: Type.ARRAY, items: { type: Type.STRING } },
            ineligibleCosts: { type: Type.ARRAY, items: { type: Type.STRING } },
            applicationRequirements: { type: Type.ARRAY, items: { type: Type.STRING } },
            disqualificationRedFlags: { type: Type.ARRAY, items: { type: Type.STRING } },
            reimbursementWarning: { type: Type.STRING },
            officialUrl: { type: Type.STRING },
            confidenceScore: { type: Type.INTEGER, description: '0 to 100 confidence score' },
            sourceSnippets: { type: Type.ARRAY, items: { type: Type.STRING } },
          },
          required: [
            'slug',
            'countryCode',
            'grantName',
            'providerAgency',
            'fundingType',
            'currency',
            'maxAmountFormatted',
            'maxFundingAmount',
            'matchRatePercentage',
            'summary',
            'descriptionMarkdown',
            'eligibleCosts',
            'ineligibleCosts',
            'applicationRequirements',
            'disqualificationRedFlags',
            'reimbursementWarning',
          ],
        },
      },
    });

    await recordGeminiUsageAndIncrementCredits({
      verifiedUserId: authCtx.verifiedUserId,
      promptKey: 'ADMIN_GRANT_EXTRACT',
      modelUsed: 'gemini-2.5-flash',
      inputTokens: response.usageMetadata?.promptTokenCount || 250,
      outputTokens: response.usageMetadata?.candidatesTokenCount || 350,
      usedByokKey: authCtx.usedByokKey,
      fallbackCreditsUsed: authCtx.currentCreditsUsed,
    });

    const text = response.text?.trim() || '{}';
    const parsed = JSON.parse(text) as ExtractedGrantResult;

    if (!parsed.slug || !parsed.grantName) {
      return { success: false, error: 'AI response did not include required grant fields' };
    }

    // Auto-prefix slug with country code if missing
    const prefix = (parsed.countryCode || 'ie').toLowerCase();
    let finalSlug = parsed.slug.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9-]/g, '-');
    if (!finalSlug.startsWith(prefix)) {
      finalSlug = `${prefix}-${finalSlug}`;
    }
    parsed.slug = finalSlug;

    return {
      success: true,
      grant: parsed,
    };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error('[AdminGrants] AI extraction error:', err);
    return {
      success: false,
      error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'AI Grant Extraction failed',
    };
  }
}

export async function stageExtractedGrantAction(grant: ExtractedGrantResult): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  grantId?: string;
  error?: string;
}> {
  try {
    const adminSession = await getAdminSessionCookie();
    if (!adminSession) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized admin session' };
    }

    const [inserted] = await db
      .insert(grantsDirectory)
      .values({
        slug: grant.slug,
        countryCode: grant.countryCode,
        grantName: grant.grantName,
        providerAgency: grant.providerAgency,
        fundingType: grant.fundingType,
        currency: grant.currency || (grant.countryCode === 'GB' ? 'GBP' : 'EUR'),
        maxAmountFormatted: grant.maxAmountFormatted,
        maxFundingAmount: grant.maxFundingAmount,
        matchRatePercentage: grant.matchRatePercentage,
        isRepayable: grant.isRepayable ?? false,
        minEmployees: grant.minEmployees ?? 0,
        maxEmployees: grant.maxEmployees ?? 10,
        maxTradingMonths: grant.maxTradingMonths,
        stageFit: grant.stageFit,
        turnaroundLabel: grant.turnaroundLabel,
        turnaroundSpeed: grant.turnaroundSpeed,
        leoThreeQuoteEnforced: grant.leoThreeQuoteEnforced ?? false,
        summary: grant.summary,
        descriptionMarkdown: grant.descriptionMarkdown,
        eligibleCosts: grant.eligibleCosts || [],
        ineligibleCosts: grant.ineligibleCosts || [],
        applicationRequirements: grant.applicationRequirements || [],
        disqualificationRedFlags: grant.disqualificationRedFlags || [],
        reimbursementWarning: grant.reimbursementWarning || 'Vouched expenditure only.',
        officialUrl: grant.officialUrl || '',
        confidenceScore: grant.confidenceScore || 90,
        sourceSnippets: grant.sourceSnippets || [],
        discoveredVia: 'ADMIN_PROMPT',
        status: 'PENDING_REVIEW', // Land in staging queue
        isActive: false, // Hidden from public and workspace until approved
      })
      .returning({ id: grantsDirectory.id });

    return { success: true, grantId: inserted.id };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error('[AdminGrants] Error staging grant:', err);
    return {
      success: false,
      error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to stage grant in database',
    };
  }
}

export async function updateGrantStatusAction(
  grantId: string,
  newStatus: 'ACTIVE' | 'PAUSED' | 'ARCHIVED' | 'PENDING_REVIEW'
): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const adminSession = await getAdminSessionCookie();
    if (!adminSession) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized admin session' };
    }

    await db
      .update(grantsDirectory)
      .set({
        status: newStatus,
        isActive: newStatus === 'ACTIVE',
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(grantsDirectory.id, grantId));

    return { success: true };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error('[AdminGrants] Error updating status:', err);
    return { success: false, error: 'Failed to update grant status' };
  }
}

export async function updateGrantFieldsAction(
  grantId: string,
  updates: Partial<GrantDirectoryRecord>
): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const adminSession = await getAdminSessionCookie();
    if (!adminSession) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized admin session' };
    }

    await db
      .update(grantsDirectory)
      .set({
        ...updates,
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(grantsDirectory.id, grantId));

    return { success: true };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error('[AdminGrants] Error updating grant fields:', err);
    return { success: false, error: 'Failed to save grant updates' };
  }
}

export async function deleteGrantPermanentlyAction(
  grantId: string
): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const adminSession = await getAdminSessionCookie();
    if (!adminSession) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized admin session' };
    }

    await db.delete(grantsDirectory).where(eq(grantsDirectory.id, grantId));
    return { success: true };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error('[AdminGrants] Error deleting grant:', err);
    return { success: false, error: 'Failed to delete grant' };
  }
}

'use server';

import { and, eq, sql } from 'drizzle-orm';
import {
  db,
  startupPlans,
  planModulesData,
  openQuestionsParkingLot,
  type BlindSpotItem,
} from '@/db';
import type {
  PromoterProfilesStep1Data,
  RoleMatrixStep2Data,
  SurvivalBudgetStep3Data,
  CoFounderAlignmentStep4Data,
  HiringPlanStep5Data,
  SavedModuleFData,
} from '@/lib/auth/session-store';
import { verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership } from '@/lib/auth/server-auth';
import {
  parseCvAndDraftPromoterBioViaRouter,
  generateRoleMatrixSummaryViaRouter,
  generateHiringStrategySummaryViaRouter,
  generateTeamAuditAndBriefViaRouter,
  type ParseCvAndDraftBioResult,
  type GenerateRoleMatrixSummaryResult,
  type GenerateHiringStrategySummaryResult,
  type GenerateTeamAuditAndBriefResult,
} from '@/lib/ai/router';
