const UUID_REGEX =
  /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

let moduleFEnumEnsured = false;

async function ensureModuleFEnumInPostgres(): Promise<void> {
  if (moduleFEnumEnsured) return;
  try {
    await db.execute(
      sql`ALTER TYPE "public"."module_code" ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'MOD_F_COFOUNDER_TEAM'`
    );
    moduleFEnumEnsured = true;
  } catch {
    // Non-fatal if enum value already exists
  }
}

/**
 * Persists Module F Step 1 (Promoter & Core Team Profiles) to `plan_modules_data`.
 */
export async function saveModuleFStep1PromoterProfilesAction(input: {
  planId: string;
  promoterProfiles: PromoterProfilesStep1Data;
  completionPercentage?: number;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; persistedToCloudSql: boolean }> {
  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(input.planId)) {
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  const authCheck = await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(input.planId);
  if (!authCheck.authorized) {
    return { ok: false, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  try {
    await ensureModuleFEnumInPostgres();

    const existingMod = await db
      .select()
      .from(planModulesData)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(planModulesData.planId, input.planId),
          eq(planModulesData.moduleCode, 'MOD_F_COFOUNDER_TEAM')
        )
      )
      .limit(1);

    const existingPayload = (existingMod[0]?.structuredInputsJsonb ??
      {}) as SavedModuleFData;

    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const updatedPayload: SavedModuleFData = {
      ...existingPayload,
      promoterProfiles: {
        ...input.promoterProfiles,
        lastSavedAt: nowIso,
      },
      lastSavedAt: nowIso,
    };

    const nextProgress = Math.max(
      existingMod[0]?.completionPercentage ?? 0,
      input.completionPercentage ?? 20
    );

    if (existingMod.length > 0) {
      await db
        .update(planModulesData)
        .set({
          structuredInputsJsonb: updatedPayload,
          completionPercentage: nextProgress,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(planModulesData.id, existingMod[0].id));
    } else {
      await db.insert(planModulesData).values({
        planId: input.planId,
        moduleCode: 'MOD_F_COFOUNDER_TEAM',
        structuredInputsJsonb: updatedPayload,
        aiThingsToConsiderJsonb: [],
        completionPercentage: nextProgress,
      });
    }

    await db
      .update(startupPlans)
      .set({
        currentModuleStep: 'MOD_F_STEP_1',
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(startupPlans.id, input.planId));

    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: true };
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(
      '[SPF Module F] Could not persist Step 1 Promoter Profiles to Cloud SQL:',
      err instanceof Error ? err.message : err
    );
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }
}

 */
export async function saveModuleFStep5HiringPlanAction(input: {

import crypto from 'crypto';

  cohorts,

  calculateAppSumoTierLimits,
  calculatePassLimits,
} from '@/lib/entitlements';

export type { CohortMilestoneConfig, CohortIntakeType } from '@/db';
export type VoucherSourceType = 'APPSUMO' | 'COHORT' | 'PROMO' | 'PARTNER';
export type VoucherRewardType = 'APPSUMO_LTD' | 'PASS_SOLO' | 'PASS_COFOUNDER';
export type VoucherStatusType = 'UNCLAIMED' | 'REDEEMED' | 'REFUNDED_REVOKED';

export interface AdminVoucherSummary {
  id: string;
  code: string;
  batchName: string;
  source: VoucherSourceType;
  rewardType: VoucherRewardType;
  durationMonths: number | null;
  status: VoucherStatusType;
  redeemedByUserId: string | null;
  redeemedByUserEmail?: string | null;
  redeemedByUserName?: string | null;
  redeemedAt: string | null;
  revokedAt: string | null;
  notes: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
}

export interface AdminCohortStaffMember {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  name: string | null;
  role: 'DIRECTOR' | 'MENTOR';
  createdAt: string;
}

export interface AdminCohortSummary {
  id: string;
  tenantId: string;
  name: string;
  organizationName: string | null;
  partnerLogoUrl: string | null;

  inviteCode: string;

  createdAt: string;
}

/**
 * Verifies caller has an active Super Admin server session
 */
async function verifyAdminAuth(): Promise<boolean> {
  const session = await getAdminSessionCookie();
  return Boolean(session && session.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN');
}

/**
 * Generate a random, cryptographically secure code segment
 */
function generateRandomCodePart(length: number): string {
  const chars = '23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ'; // Exclude ambiguous chars like 0, 1, I, O
  let result = '';
  const bytes = crypto.randomBytes(length);
  for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
    result += chars[bytes[i] % chars.length];
  }
  return result;
}

/**
 * Generates voucher code.
 * If isPureAlphanumeric is true, generates pure alphanumeric (e.g. SPF9K2X7B4M1Q),
 * which satisfies AppSumo's strict "Code is not alphanumeric" validator (no hyphens/symbols).
 */
function formatVoucherCode(prefix: string, isPureAlphanumeric = false): string {
  if (isPureAlphanumeric) {
    const cleanPrefix = prefix.trim().toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, '');
    const randomPart = generateRandomCodePart(12);
    return `${cleanPrefix}${randomPart}`;
  }
  const cleanPrefix = prefix.trim().toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9-]/g, '');
  const part1 = generateRandomCodePart(4);
  const part2 = generateRandomCodePart(4);
  const finalPrefix = cleanPrefix.endsWith('-') ? cleanPrefix : `${cleanPrefix}-`;
  return `${finalPrefix}${part1}-${part2}`;
}

/**
 * 1. LIST VOUCHERS & COHORTS FOR ADMIN STUDIO
 */
export async function listAdminVouchersAndCohortsAction(): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  error?: string;
  vouchers: AdminVoucherSummary[];
  cohorts: AdminCohortSummary[];
  stats: {
    totalVouchers: number;
    unclaimedVouchers: number;
    redeemedVouchers: number;
    refundedVouchers: number;
    totalCohorts: number;
  };
}> {
  const isAdmin = await verifyAdminAuth();
  if (!isAdmin) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: 'Unauthorized: Super Admin access required.',
      vouchers: [],
      cohorts: [],
      stats: {
        totalVouchers: 0,
        unclaimedVouchers: 0,
        redeemedVouchers: 0,
        refundedVouchers: 0,
        totalCohorts: 0,
      },
    };
  }

  try {
    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();
    const rawVouchers = await db
      .select({
        voucher: vouchers,
        userEmail: users.email,
        userName: users.name,
      })
      .from(vouchers)
      .leftJoin(users, eq(vouchers.redeemedByUserId, users.id))
      .orderBy(desc(vouchers.createdAt))
      .limit(1000);

    const formattedVouchers: AdminVoucherSummary[] = rawVouchers.map((row) => ({
      id: row.voucher.id,
      code: row.voucher.code,
      batchName: row.voucher.batchName,
      source: row.voucher.source as VoucherSourceType,
      rewardType: (row.voucher.rewardType as VoucherRewardType) || 'APPSUMO_LTD',
      durationMonths: row.voucher.durationMonths,
      status: row.voucher.status as VoucherStatusType,
      redeemedByUserId: row.voucher.redeemedByUserId,
      redeemedByUserEmail: row.userEmail || null,
      redeemedByUserName: row.userName || null,
      redeemedAt: row.voucher.redeemedAt?.toISOString() || null,
      revokedAt: row.voucher.revokedAt?.toISOString() || null,
      notes: row.voucher.notes || null,
      createdAt: row.voucher.createdAt.toISOString(),
    }));

    const rawCohorts = await db
      .select()
      .from(cohorts)
      .orderBy(desc(cohorts.createdAt));

    let allStaff: (typeof cohortStaff.$inferSelect)[] = [];
    try {
      allStaff = await db.select().from(cohortStaff);
    } catch {
      allStaff = [];
    }

    const staffByCohort = new Map<string, AdminCohortStaffMember[]>();
    for (const s of allStaff) {
      const list = staffByCohort.get(s.cohortId) || [];
      list.push({
        id: s.id,
        email: s.email,
        name: s.name,
        role: (s.role as 'DIRECTOR' | 'MENTOR') || 'DIRECTOR',
        createdAt: s.createdAt.toISOString(),
      });
      staffByCohort.set(s.cohortId, list);
    }

    const formattedCohorts: AdminCohortSummary[] = rawCohorts.map((c) => ({
      id: c.id,
      tenantId: c.tenantId,
      name: c.name,
      organizationName: c.organizationName || null,
      partnerLogoUrl: c.partnerLogoUrl || null,
      intakeType: (c.intakeType as CohortIntakeType) || 'FIXED_BATCH',
      inviteCode: c.inviteCode,
      maxSeats: c.maxSeats,
      seatsUsed: c.seatsUsed,
      accessDurationMonths: c.accessDurationMonths,
      milestoneConfig: (c.milestoneConfigJson as CohortMilestoneConfig) || {},
      staff: staffByCohort.get(c.id) || [],
      expiresAt: c.expiresAt?.toISOString() || null,
      createdAt: c.createdAt.toISOString(),
    }));

    const stats = {
      totalVouchers: formattedVouchers.length,
      unclaimedVouchers: formattedVouchers.filter((v) => v.status === 'UNCLAIMED').length,
      redeemedVouchers: formattedVouchers.filter((v) => v.status === 'REDEEMED').length,
      refundedVouchers: formattedVouchers.filter((v) => v.status === 'REFUNDED_REVOKED').length,
      totalCohorts: formattedCohorts.length,
    };

    return {
      ok: true,
      vouchers: formattedVouchers,
      cohorts: formattedCohorts,
      stats,
    };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error('[Admin Vouchers] Failed to load data:', err);
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: 'Failed to retrieve vouchers and cohorts.',
      vouchers: [],
      cohorts: [],
      stats: {
        totalVouchers: 0,
        unclaimedVouchers: 0,
        redeemedVouchers: 0,
        refundedVouchers: 0,
        totalCohorts: 0,
      },
    };
  }
}

/**
 * 2. BULK GENERATE VOUCHER BATCH
 */
export async function generateVoucherBatchAction(params: {
  batchName: string;
  source: VoucherSourceType;
  rewardType: VoucherRewardType;
  durationMonths?: number;
  quantity: number;
  prefix?: string;
  notes?: string;
}): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  error?: string;
  batchName?: string;
  generatedCount?: number;
  sampleCodes?: string[];
  csvContent?: string;
}> {
  const isAdmin = await verifyAdminAuth();
  if (!isAdmin) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Unauthorized: Super Admin access required.' };
  }

  const batchName = params.batchName?.trim();
  if (!batchName) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Batch name is required.' };
  }

  const quantity = Math.min(Math.max(1, params.quantity || 1), 5000);
  const source = params.source || 'APPSUMO';
  const rewardType = params.rewardType || 'APPSUMO_LTD';
  const durationMonths =
    rewardType === 'APPSUMO_LTD' ? null : params.durationMonths || 6;

  const isAppSumo = source === 'APPSUMO';
  let defaultPrefix = isAppSumo ? 'SPF' : 'SUMO-SPF-';
  if (source === 'PARTNER') defaultPrefix = 'PRTN-SPF-';
  if (source === 'PROMO') defaultPrefix = 'PROMO-SPF-';
  const prefix = (params.prefix?.trim() || defaultPrefix).toUpperCase();

  try {
    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();
    const generatedCodesSet = new Set<string>();
    while (generatedCodesSet.size < quantity) {
      // AppSumo requires strictly alphanumeric codes (letters and numbers only, no hyphens)
      generatedCodesSet.add(formatVoucherCode(prefix, isAppSumo));
    }
    const codesArray = Array.from(generatedCodesSet);

    // Insert in chunks of 500 to keep queries snappy
    const CHUNK_SIZE = 500;
    for (let i = 0; i < codesArray.length; i += CHUNK_SIZE) {
      const chunk = codesArray.slice(i, i + CHUNK_SIZE).map((code) => ({
        code,
        batchName,
        source,
        rewardType,
        durationMonths,
        status: 'UNCLAIMED' as const,
        notes: params.notes?.trim() || null,
      }));
      await db.insert(vouchers).values(chunk);
    }

    // Build standard CSV for AppSumo / Partners
    const csvHeader = 'Code,Batch,Source,Reward,DurationMonths\n';
    const csvRows = codesArray
      .map(
        (code) =>
          `"${code}","${batchName}","${source}","${rewardType}","${
            durationMonths ?? 'Lifetime'
          }"`
      )
      .join('\n');
    const csvContent = csvHeader + csvRows;

    return {
      ok: true,
      batchName,
      generatedCount: codesArray.length,
      sampleCodes: codesArray.slice(0, 5),
      csvContent,
    };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error('[Admin Vouchers] Failed to generate batch:', err);
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: 'Failed to generate voucher batch. Please ensure batch parameters are valid.',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * 3. CREATE INSTITUTIONAL COHORT
 */
export async function createCohortAction(params: {
  name: string;
  inviteCode: string;
  maxSeats: number;
  accessDurationMonths?: number;
  organizationName?: string;
  partnerLogoUrl?: string;
  intakeType?: CohortIntakeType;
  milestoneConfig?: CohortMilestoneConfig;
  directorEmail?: string;
  directorName?: string;
  inquiryId?: string;
  tenantSlug?: string;
}): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  error?: string;
  cohort?: AdminCohortSummary;
}> {
  const isAdmin = await verifyAdminAuth();
  if (!isAdmin) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Unauthorized: Super Admin access required.' };
  }

  await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

  const name = params.name?.trim();
  const rawCode = params.inviteCode?.trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!name || !rawCode) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Cohort name and shared invite code are required.' };
  }

  // Ensure default tenant exists
  let tenantId: string | null = null;
  const [defaultTenant] = await db
    .select()
    .from(tenants)
    .where(eq(tenants.slug, 'default'))
    .limit(1);

  if (defaultTenant) {
    tenantId = defaultTenant.id;
  } else {
    const [created] = await db
      .insert(tenants)
      .values({
        name: 'Startup Preflight Global',
        slug: 'default',
      })
      .returning();
    tenantId = created.id;
  }

  try {
    const maxSeats = Math.max(1, params.maxSeats || 30);
    const accessDurationMonths = params.accessDurationMonths || 6;
    const expiresAt = new Date();
    expiresAt.setMonth(expiresAt.getMonth() + accessDurationMonths);

    const [created] = await db
      .insert(cohorts)
      .values({
        tenantId,
        name,
        organizationName: params.organizationName?.trim() || null,
        partnerLogoUrl: params.partnerLogoUrl?.trim() || null,
        intakeType: params.intakeType || 'FIXED_BATCH',
        inviteCode: rawCode,
        maxSeats,
        seatsUsed: 0,
        accessDurationMonths,
        milestoneConfigJson: params.milestoneConfig || {},
        expiresAt,
      })
      .returning();

    // If converted from an inbound cohort inquiry, update inquiry record status
    if (params.inquiryId) {
      try {
        await db
          .update(cohortInquiries)
          .set({ status: 'CONVERTED', updatedAt: new Date() })
          .where(eq(cohortInquiries.id, params.inquiryId));
      } catch (inqErr) {
        console.warn('[Admin Vouchers] Failed to mark inquiry as converted:', inqErr);
      }
    }

    const staffMembers: AdminCohortStaffMember[] = [];

    // If a Program Director email was provided, link or create staff record
    if (params.directorEmail?.trim()) {
      const cleanEmail = params.directorEmail.trim().toLowerCase();
      try {
        const [existingUser] = await db
          .select({ id: users.id })
          .from(users)
          .where(eq(users.email, cleanEmail))
          .limit(1);

        const [createdStaff] = await db
          .insert(cohortStaff)
          .values({
            cohortId: created.id,
            userId: existingUser?.id || null,
            email: cleanEmail,
            name: params.directorName?.trim() || null,
            role: 'DIRECTOR',
          })
          .returning();

        if (createdStaff) {
          staffMembers.push({
            id: createdStaff.id,
            email: createdStaff.email,
            name: createdStaff.name,
            role: 'DIRECTOR',
            createdAt: createdStaff.createdAt.toISOString(),
          });
        }
      } catch (staffErr) {
        console.warn('[Admin Vouchers] Failed to insert initial cohort director:', staffErr);
      }
    }

    return {
      ok: true,
      cohort: {
        id: created.id,
        tenantId: created.tenantId,
        name: created.name,
        organizationName: created.organizationName,
        partnerLogoUrl: created.partnerLogoUrl,
        intakeType: (created.intakeType as CohortIntakeType) || 'FIXED_BATCH',
        inviteCode: created.inviteCode,
        maxSeats: created.maxSeats,
        seatsUsed: created.seatsUsed,
        accessDurationMonths: created.accessDurationMonths,
        milestoneConfig: (created.milestoneConfigJson as CohortMilestoneConfig) || {},
        staff: staffMembers,
        expiresAt: created.expiresAt?.toISOString() || null,
        createdAt: created.createdAt.toISOString(),
      },
    };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error('[Admin Vouchers] Failed to create cohort:', err);
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: 'Failed to create cohort. That invite code may already be in use.',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * 3B. UPDATE COHORT & MILESTONE SETTINGS
 */
export async function updateCohortAction(params: {
  cohortId: string;
  name?: string;
  organizationName?: string | null;
  partnerLogoUrl?: string | null;
  intakeType?: CohortIntakeType;
  maxSeats?: number;
  accessDurationMonths?: number;
  expiresAt?: string | null;
  milestoneConfig?: CohortMilestoneConfig | null;
}): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  error?: string;
}> {
  const isAdmin = await verifyAdminAuth();
  if (!isAdmin) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Unauthorized: Super Admin access required.' };
  }

  await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

  try {
    const updateData: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    if (params.name !== undefined) updateData.name = params.name.trim();
    if (params.organizationName !== undefined) updateData.organizationName = params.organizationName ? params.organizationName.trim() : null;
    if (params.partnerLogoUrl !== undefined) updateData.partnerLogoUrl = params.partnerLogoUrl ? params.partnerLogoUrl.trim() : null;
    if (params.intakeType !== undefined) updateData.intakeType = params.intakeType;
    if (params.maxSeats !== undefined) updateData.maxSeats = Math.max(1, params.maxSeats);
    if (params.accessDurationMonths !== undefined) updateData.accessDurationMonths = Math.max(1, params.accessDurationMonths);
    if (params.expiresAt !== undefined) updateData.expiresAt = params.expiresAt ? new Date(params.expiresAt) : null;
    if (params.milestoneConfig !== undefined) updateData.milestoneConfigJson = params.milestoneConfig;

    await db
      .update(cohorts)
      .set(updateData)
      .where(eq(cohorts.id, params.cohortId));

    return { ok: true };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[Admin Vouchers] Failed to update cohort:', err);
    return { ok: false, error: 'Failed to update cohort details.' };
  }
}

/**
 * 3C. MANAGE COHORT STAFF (Directors & Mentors)
 */
export async function manageCohortStaffAction(params: {
  cohortId: string;
  action: 'ADD' | 'REMOVE';
  staffId?: string;
  email?: string;
  name?: string;
  role?: 'DIRECTOR' | 'MENTOR';
}): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  error?: string;
  staff?: AdminCohortStaffMember[];
}> {
  const isAdmin = await verifyAdminAuth();
  if (!isAdmin) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Unauthorized: Super Admin access required.' };
  }

  await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

  try {
    if (params.action === 'REMOVE') {
      if (!params.staffId) {
        return { ok: false, error: 'Staff ID required to remove staff member.' };
      }
      await db
        .delete(cohortStaff)
        .where(and(eq(cohortStaff.id, params.staffId), eq(cohortStaff.cohortId, params.cohortId)));
    } else {
      // ADD
      const cleanEmail = params.email?.trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!cleanEmail || !cleanEmail.includes('@')) {
        return { ok: false, error: 'Valid staff email required.' };
      }

      const [existingUser] = await db
        .select({ id: users.id })
        .from(users)
        .where(eq(users.email, cleanEmail))
        .limit(1);

      await db.insert(cohortStaff).values({
        cohortId: params.cohortId,
        userId: existingUser?.id || null,
        email: cleanEmail,
        name: params.name?.trim() || null,
        role: params.role || 'DIRECTOR',
      });
    }

    // Return updated staff list
    const updatedStaff = await db
      .select()
      .from(cohortStaff)
      .where(eq(cohortStaff.cohortId, params.cohortId))
      .orderBy(desc(cohortStaff.createdAt));

    return {
      ok: true,
      staff: updatedStaff.map((s) => ({
        id: s.id,
        email: s.email,
        name: s.name,
        role: (s.role as 'DIRECTOR' | 'MENTOR') || 'DIRECTOR',
        createdAt: s.createdAt.toISOString(),
      })),
    };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[Admin Vouchers] Failed to manage cohort staff:', err);
    return { ok: false, error: 'Failed to update cohort staff.' };
  }
}

/**
 * 4. 1-CLICK REFUND / REVOCATION ENGINE
 * Revokes a single voucher (e.g. AppSumo refund within 60 days).
 * - Decrements user's stacked count
 * - If user drops to 0 codes: transitions to FREE_HOOK + is_vault_readonly = true (no data loss)
 */
export async function revokeVoucherAction(params: {
  voucherId?: string;
  voucherCode?: string;
  reason?: string;
}): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  error?: string;
  revokedCode?: string;
  affectedUserEmail?: string | null;
  newPlanType?: string;
  newStackedCount?: number;
  vaultReadonlyApplied?: boolean;
}> {
  const isAdmin = await verifyAdminAuth();
  if (!isAdmin) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Unauthorized: Super Admin access required.' };
  }

  try {
    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();
    let voucherQuery = db.select().from(vouchers);
    if (params.voucherId) {
      voucherQuery = voucherQuery.where(eq(vouchers.id, params.voucherId)) as any;
    } else if (params.voucherCode) {
      voucherQuery = voucherQuery.where(
        eq(vouchers.code, params.voucherCode.trim().toUpperCase())
      ) as any;
    } else {
      return { ok: false, error: 'Either voucherId or voucherCode must be provided.' };
    }

    const [voucher] = await voucherQuery.limit(1);
    if (!voucher) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'Voucher not found.' };
    }

    if (voucher.status === 'REFUNDED_REVOKED') {
      return { ok: false, error: 'This voucher has already been revoked / refunded.' };
    }

    const redeemedUserId = voucher.redeemedByUserId;
    const now = new Date();

    // Mark voucher as REFUNDED_REVOKED
    await db
      .update(vouchers)
      .set({
        status: 'REFUNDED_REVOKED',
        revokedAt: now,
        notes: params.reason
          ? `${voucher.notes || ''}\n[Revoked: ${params.reason.trim()}]`.trim()
          : voucher.notes,
      })
      .where(eq(vouchers.id, voucher.id));

    let affectedUserEmail: string | null = null;
    let newPlanType: string | undefined;
    let newStackedCount: number | undefined;
    let vaultReadonlyApplied = false;

    // If the voucher was already redeemed by a user, adjust their entitlement
    if (redeemedUserId) {
      const [user] = await db
        .select()
        .from(users)
        .where(eq(users.id, redeemedUserId))
        .limit(1);
      affectedUserEmail = user?.email || null;

      // Find remaining active/redeemed vouchers for this user
      const userActiveVouchers = await db
        .select()
        .from(vouchers)
        .where(
          and(
            eq(vouchers.redeemedByUserId, redeemedUserId),
            eq(vouchers.status, 'REDEEMED')
          )
        );

      const remainingAppSumoCodes = userActiveVouchers.filter(
        (v) => v.rewardType === 'APPSUMO_LTD'
      ).length;

      const [entitlement] = await db
        .select()
        .from(userEntitlements)
        .where(eq(userEntitlements.userId, redeemedUserId))
        .limit(1);

      if (entitlement) {
        if (voucher.rewardType === 'APPSUMO_LTD') {
          if (remainingAppSumoCodes > 0) {
            // User still has 1 or more codes stacked: re-calculate AppSumo limits
            const limits = calculateAppSumoTierLimits(remainingAppSumoCodes);
            await db
              .update(userEntitlements)
              .set({
                stackedCodesCount: limits.stackedCodesCount,
                maxStartupPlans: limits.maxStartupPlans,
                maxSeatsPerPlan: limits.maxSeatsPerPlan,
                monthlyAiCreditsLimit: limits.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
                whiteLabelExportEnabled: limits.whiteLabelExportEnabled,
                updatedAt: now,
              })
              .where(eq(userEntitlements.id, entitlement.id));

            newPlanType = 'APPSUMO_LTD';
            newStackedCount = limits.stackedCodesCount;
          } else {
            // User refunded their only code!
            // Transition to FREE_HOOK and enable Read-Only Vault mode (prevents data loss)
            const freeLimits = calculatePassLimits('FREE_HOOK');
            await db
              .update(userEntitlements)
              .set({
                planType: 'FREE_HOOK',
                stackedCodesCount: 0,
                maxStartupPlans: freeLimits.maxStartupPlans,
                maxSeatsPerPlan: freeLimits.maxSeatsPerPlan,
                monthlyAiCreditsLimit: freeLimits.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
                whiteLabelExportEnabled: false,
                isVaultReadonly: true,
                updatedAt: now,
              })
              .where(eq(userEntitlements.id, entitlement.id));

            newPlanType = 'FREE_HOOK';
            newStackedCount = 0;
            vaultReadonlyApplied = true;
          }
        } else {
          // If it was a time pass and no other active pass remains, switch to vault mode
          if (userActiveVouchers.length === 0) {
            await db
              .update(userEntitlements)
              .set({
                isVaultReadonly: true,
                updatedAt: now,
              })
              .where(eq(userEntitlements.id, entitlement.id));
            vaultReadonlyApplied = true;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    return {
      ok: true,
      revokedCode: voucher.code,
      affectedUserEmail,
      newPlanType,
      newStackedCount,
      vaultReadonlyApplied,
    };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error('[Admin Vouchers] Failed to revoke voucher:', err);
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: 'Failed to revoke voucher.',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * 4. EXPORT VOUCHERS AS APPSUMO-COMPLIANT PLAIN TEXT CSV
 * Rules:
 * - Single column, NO header
 * - Plain text (.csv)
 * - Randomized order (Fisher-Yates shuffle)
 * - Zero duplicates (guaranteed via Set/deduplication)
 * - Length between 3 and 200 characters per code
 * - Filterable by source ('APPSUMO', 'PARTNER', 'PROMO', 'ALL'), status, and batch
 */
export async function exportAppSumoPlainCsvAction(params: {
  source?: VoucherSourceType | 'ALL';
  status?: VoucherStatusType | 'ALL';
  batchName?: string;
}): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  error?: string;
  count?: number;
  csvContent?: string;
  filename?: string;
}> {
  const isAdmin = await verifyAdminAuth();
  if (!isAdmin) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Unauthorized: Super Admin access required.' };
  }

  try {
    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

    const conditions = [];
    if (params.source && params.source !== 'ALL') {
      conditions.push(eq(vouchers.source, params.source));
    }
    if (params.status && params.status !== 'ALL') {
      conditions.push(eq(vouchers.status, params.status));
    }
    if (params.batchName && params.batchName.trim()) {
      conditions.push(eq(vouchers.batchName, params.batchName.trim()));
    }

    const rows = await db
      .select({ code: vouchers.code })
      .from(vouchers)
      .where(conditions.length > 0 ? and(...conditions) : undefined);

    // For AppSumo exports, strip any hyphens or special characters to guarantee 100% alphanumeric compliance (A-Z, 0-9)
    const isAppSumoExport = params.source === 'APPSUMO';

    // Enforce deduplication and valid length (3-200 characters)
    const processedCodes = rows
      .map((r) => {
        const raw = r.code?.trim() || '';
        return isAppSumoExport ? raw.replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/gi, '').toUpperCase() : raw;
      })
      .filter((code): code is string => Boolean(code && code.length >= 3 && code.length <= 200));

    const uniqueCodes = Array.from(new Set(processedCodes));

    // Randomize order (Fisher-Yates shuffle) as strictly required by AppSumo
    for (let i = uniqueCodes.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      [uniqueCodes[i], uniqueCodes[j]] = [uniqueCodes[j], uniqueCodes[i]];
    }

    // Single column, NO headers, plain newline-separated text
    const csvContent = uniqueCodes.join('\n');
    const sourceLabel = params.source || 'ALL';
    const statusLabel = params.status || 'ALL';
    const filename = `appsumo_codes_${sourceLabel.toLowerCase()}_${statusLabel.toLowerCase()}_${Date.now()}.csv`;

    return {
      ok: true,
      count: uniqueCodes.length,
      csvContent,
      filename,
    };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error('[Admin Vouchers] Failed to export AppSumo CSV:', err);
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: 'Failed to export vouchers to CSV.',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Permanently deletes a startup plan and all cascading module data.
 * Enforces ownership verification (IDOR protection) via verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership.
 */
export async function deleteStartupPlanAction(input: {
  planId: string;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; error?: string }> {
  if (!input.planId) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Plan ID is required.' };
  }

  // If it's a local/demo plan ID, no Cloud SQL deletion needed
  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(input.planId)) {
    return { ok: true };
  }

  try {
    const ownership = await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(input.planId);
    if (!ownership.authorized) {
      if (
        ownership.reason === 'DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE' ||
        ownership.reason === 'UNAUTHENTICATED_SESSION' ||
        ownership.isLocalPreview
      ) {
        // Database offline or local session — allow workspace local cleanup
        return { ok: true };
      }
      return {
        ok: false,
        error: ownership.reason || 'You are not authorized to delete this plan.',
      };
    }

    // startupPlans has onDelete: 'cascade' on child tables (planModulesData, validationSurveys, openQuestionsParkingLot, etc.)
    await db.delete(startupPlans).where(eq(startupPlans.id, input.planId));
    return { ok: true };
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.warn('[SPF Plan Delete] Database deletion error or offline:', err);
    // Don't trap the user in the UI if DB is offline
    return { ok: true };
  }
}

/**
 * Clones and pivots an existing startup plan and all associated module data.
 * Enforces ownership verification (IDOR protection) and plan quota limits.
 */
export async function cloneStartupPlanAction(input: {
  sourcePlanId: string;
  newTitle?: string;
}): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  newPlanId?: string;
  newPlanTitle?: string;
  error?: string;
  limitReached?: boolean;
}> {
  if (!input.sourcePlanId) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Source plan ID is required.' };
  }

  // Handle local / demo preview plans
  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(input.sourcePlanId)) {
    const fallbackId = `plan-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`;
    return {
      ok: true,
      newPlanId: fallbackId,
      newPlanTitle: input.newTitle?.trim() || 'Cloned Plan (Pivot)',
    };
  }

  const ownership = await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(input.sourcePlanId);
  if (!ownership.authorized || !ownership.userId) {
    if (
      ownership.reason === 'DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE' ||
      ownership.reason === 'UNAUTHENTICATED_SESSION' ||
      ownership.isLocalPreview
    ) {
      const fallbackId = `plan-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`;
      return {
        ok: true,
        newPlanId: fallbackId,
        newPlanTitle: input.newTitle?.trim() || 'Cloned Plan (Pivot)',
      };
    }
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: ownership.reason || 'You are not authorized to clone this plan.',
    };
  }

  try {
    // Check user entitlements for plan limits
    const [entRow] = await db
      .select({ maxStartupPlans: userEntitlements.maxStartupPlans })
      .from(userEntitlements)
      .where(eq(userEntitlements.userId, ownership.userId))
      .limit(1);

    const maxPlans = entRow?.maxStartupPlans ?? 1;

    // Count user's current plans
    const existingPlans = await db
      .select({ id: startupPlans.id })
      .from(startupPlans)
      .where(eq(startupPlans.ownerUserId, ownership.userId));

    if (existingPlans.length >= maxPlans) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        limitReached: true,
        error: `You have reached your limit of ${maxPlans} active Startup Plan${maxPlans === 1 ? '' : 's'}. Upgrade your pass to create additional plans.`,
      };
    }

    // Query the source plan
    const [sourcePlan] = await db
      .select()
      .from(startupPlans)
      .where(eq(startupPlans.id, input.sourcePlanId))
      .limit(1);

    if (!sourcePlan) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'Source plan not found.' };
    }

    const cleanTitle = input.newTitle?.trim() || `${sourcePlan.title} (Pivot)`;

    // Insert cloned plan row with parentPlanId pointing to source plan
    const [createdPlan] = await db
      .insert(startupPlans)
      .values({
        ownerUserId: ownership.userId,
        tenantId: sourcePlan.tenantId,
        cohortId: sourcePlan.cohortId,
        parentPlanId: sourcePlan.id,
        title: cleanTitle,
        oneLinerSummary: sourcePlan.oneLinerSummary,
        industryCategory: sourcePlan.industryCategory,
        grantEligibilitySector: sourcePlan.grantEligibilitySector,
        innovateUkResearchCategory: sourcePlan.innovateUkResearchCategory,
        productVehicleType: sourcePlan.productVehicleType,
        primarySalesChannel: sourcePlan.primarySalesChannel,
        selectedBuildTier: sourcePlan.selectedBuildTier,
        hqCountryCode: sourcePlan.hqCountryCode,
        localAuthorityOrRegion: sourcePlan.localAuthorityOrRegion,
        baseCurrency: sourcePlan.baseCurrency,
        targetMarketsArray: sourcePlan.targetMarketsArray,
        targetLaunchDate: sourcePlan.targetLaunchDate,
        currentModuleStep: sourcePlan.currentModuleStep,
        grantComplianceMetadataJson: sourcePlan.grantComplianceMetadataJson,
        ideaComparatorScoresJson: sourcePlan.ideaComparatorScoresJson,
        status: 'ACTIVE',
      })
      .returning();

    // Copy all planModulesData
    const sourceModules = await db
      .select()
      .from(planModulesData)
      .where(eq(planModulesData.planId, sourcePlan.id));

    if (sourceModules.length > 0) {
      await db.insert(planModulesData).values(
        sourceModules.map((mod) => ({
          planId: createdPlan.id,
          moduleCode: mod.moduleCode,
          structuredInputsJsonb: mod.structuredInputsJsonb,
          aiThingsToConsiderJsonb: mod.aiThingsToConsiderJsonb,
          completionPercentage: mod.completionPercentage,
        }))
      );
    }

    // Copy open questions
    try {
      const sourceQuestions = await db
        .select()
        .from(openQuestionsParkingLot)
        .where(eq(openQuestionsParkingLot.planId, sourcePlan.id));

      if (sourceQuestions.length > 0) {
        await db.insert(openQuestionsParkingLot).values(
          sourceQuestions.map((q) => ({
            planId: createdPlan.id,
            sourceModule: q.sourceModule,
            questionText: q.questionText,
            status: q.status,
            resolutionNotes: q.resolutionNotes,
          }))
        );
      }
    } catch (qErr) {
      console.warn('[SPF Clone] Non-fatal error copying open questions:', qErr);
    }

    // Copy surveys with unique slugs
    try {
      const sourceSurveys = await db
        .select()
        .from(validationSurveys)
        .where(eq(validationSurveys.planId, sourcePlan.id));

      for (const srv of sourceSurveys) {
        const newSlug = `${srv.publicSlug.slice(0, 36)}-pivot-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`;
        await db.insert(validationSurveys).values({
          planId: createdPlan.id,
          publicSlug: newSlug,
          title: `${srv.title} (Pivot)`,
          introDescription: srv.introDescription,
          isActive: false,
          collectLeadEmails: srv.collectLeadEmails,
          waitlistIncentiveText: srv.waitlistIncentiveText,
          questionsJsonb: srv.questionsJsonb,
          outreachTemplatesJsonb: srv.outreachTemplatesJsonb,
          interviewLogsJsonb: srv.interviewLogsJsonb,
        });
      }
    } catch (surveyErr) {
      console.warn('[SPF Clone] Non-fatal error copying surveys:', surveyErr);
    }

    return {
      ok: true,
      newPlanId: createdPlan.id,
      newPlanTitle: createdPlan.title,
    };
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.warn('[SPF Clone Plan] DB clone failed, falling back to local clone:', err);
    // Graceful fallback: return ok: true with generated local UUID so the founder's session is not blocked
    const fallbackId =
      typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && crypto.randomUUID
        ? crypto.randomUUID()
        : `plan-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`;
    return {
      ok: true,
      newPlanId: fallbackId,
      newPlanTitle: (input.newTitle || 'My Cloned Plan').trim(),
    };
  }
}

async function verifyAdminAuth(): Promise<boolean> {
  const session = await getAdminSessionCookie();
  return Boolean(session && session.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN');
}

function escapeHtml(raw: string | undefined | null): string {
  if (!raw) return '';
  return String(raw)
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
}

async function resolveVerifiedPartnerRecipientEmail(
  partnerSlug: string,
  fallbackDefault: string
): Promise<string> {
  try {
    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();
    const [dbPartner] = await db
      .select({ warmIntroRecipientEmail: partnerOffers.warmIntroRecipientEmail })
      .from(partnerOffers)
      .where(eq(partnerOffers.slug, partnerSlug))
      .limit(1);
    if (dbPartner?.warmIntroRecipientEmail?.includes('@')) {
      return dbPartner.warmIntroRecipientEmail.trim();
    }
  } catch {
    // Fallback to catalog lookup
  }
  const catalogMatch = DEFAULT_PARTNER_OFFERS.find(
    (p) => p.slug === partnerSlug
  );
  if (catalogMatch?.warmIntroRecipientEmail?.includes('@')) {
    return catalogMatch.warmIntroRecipientEmail.trim();
  }
  return fallbackDefault;
}

function mapDbOfferToRecord(
  row: typeof partnerOffers.$inferSelect
): PartnerOfferRecord {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    slug: row.slug,
    slotKey: row.slotKey as PartnerSlotKey,
    name: row.name,
    logoEmoji: row.logoEmoji || '⚡',
    category: row.category,
    headline: row.headline,
    perkDescription: row.perkDescription,
    badgeText: row.badgeText,
    promoCode: row.promoCode,
    countryScope: (row.countryScope as PartnerCountryScope) || 'ALL',
    actionType: (row.actionType as PartnerActionType) || 'AFFILIATE_LINK',
    actionLabel: row.actionLabel,
    referralUrl: row.referralUrl,
    trustFactor: row.trustFactor,
    warmIntroRecipientEmail: row.warmIntroRecipientEmail,
    warmIntroQuestionsJson: Array.isArray(row.warmIntroQuestionsJson)
      ? row.warmIntroQuestionsJson
      : [],
    checkoutPriceAmount: row.checkoutPriceAmount ?? null,
    checkoutCurrency: row.checkoutCurrency || 'EUR',
    checkoutAddonsJson: Array.isArray(row.checkoutAddonsJson)
      ? row.checkoutAddonsJson
      : [],
    commissionBountySummary: row.commissionBountySummary,
    partnerContactNotes: row.partnerContactNotes,
    isSupplierPartner: Boolean(row.isSupplierPartner),
    supplierCategory: row.supplierCategory,
    dispatchEmail: row.dispatchEmail,
    monthlyRfpCap: row.monthlyRfpCap ?? 10,
    rfpsDispatchedThisMonth: row.rfpsDispatchedThisMonth ?? 0,
    lastRfpDispatchedAt: row.lastRfpDispatchedAt ? row.lastRfpDispatchedAt.toISOString() : null,
    sortOrder: row.sortOrder ?? 10,
    isActive: Boolean(row.isActive),
    createdAt: row.createdAt ? row.createdAt.toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),
    updatedAt: row.updatedAt ? row.updatedAt.toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),
  };
}

function mapDbEventToRecord(
  row: typeof partnerReferralEvents.$inferSelect
): PartnerReferralEventRecord {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    partnerId: row.partnerId,
    partnerName: row.partnerName,
    partnerSlug: row.partnerSlug,
    slotKey: row.slotKey as PartnerSlotKey,
    eventType:
      row.eventType === 'PAID_CONCIERGE_ORDER'
        ? 'PAID_CONCIERGE_ORDER'
        : row.eventType === 'WARM_INTRO_LEAD'
          ? 'WARM_INTRO_LEAD'
          : 'AFFILIATE_CLICK',
    planId: row.planId,
    planTitle: row.planTitle,
    founderName: row.founderName,
    founderEmail: row.founderEmail,
    countryCode: row.countryCode || 'IE',
    selectedDomain: row.selectedDomain,
    destinationUrl: row.destinationUrl,
    intakeAnswersJson:
      row.intakeAnswersJson && typeof row.intakeAnswersJson === 'object'
        ? (row.intakeAnswersJson as Record<string, string>)
        : {},
    leadStatus: (row.leadStatus as ReferralLeadStatus) || 'CLICKED',
    estimatedBountyAmount: row.estimatedBountyAmount,
    adminNotes: row.adminNotes,
    createdAt: row.createdAt ? row.createdAt.toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),
  };
}

/**
 * Ensures default partner offers are seeded in PostgreSQL if the table is empty,
 * and upgrades the default Step 1 Incorporation Concierge to PAID_STRIPE_CONCIERGE if unconfigured.
 */
async function ensureDefaultPartnersSeededInDb(): Promise<void> {
  await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();
  const existing = await db.select().from(partnerOffers).limit(20);

  if (existing.length > 0) {
    const step1Concierge = existing.find(
      (r) => r.slug === 'company-bureau-formations'
    );
    const defaultStep1 = DEFAULT_PARTNER_OFFERS.find(
      (d) => d.slug === 'company-bureau-formations'
    );
    if (
      step1Concierge &&
      defaultStep1 &&
      step1Concierge.actionType === 'WARM_INTRO_MODAL' &&
      step1Concierge.checkoutPriceAmount == null
    ) {
      await db
        .update(partnerOffers)
        .set({
          actionType: 'PAID_STRIPE_CONCIERGE',
          actionLabel: defaultStep1.actionLabel,
          badgeText: defaultStep1.badgeText,
          category: defaultStep1.category,
          headline: defaultStep1.headline,
          perkDescription: defaultStep1.perkDescription,
          checkoutPriceAmount: defaultStep1.checkoutPriceAmount ?? 150,
          checkoutCurrency: defaultStep1.checkoutCurrency || 'EUR',
          checkoutAddonsJson: defaultStep1.checkoutAddonsJson || [],
          commissionBountySummary: defaultStep1.commissionBountySummary,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(partnerOffers.id, step1Concierge.id));
    }
    return;
  }

  for (const def of DEFAULT_PARTNER_OFFERS) {
    await db
      .insert(partnerOffers)
      .values({
        slug: def.slug,
        slotKey: def.slotKey,
        name: def.name,
        logoEmoji: def.logoEmoji,
        category: def.category,
        headline: def.headline,
        perkDescription: def.perkDescription,
        badgeText: def.badgeText,
        promoCode: def.promoCode || null,
        countryScope: def.countryScope,
        actionType: def.actionType,
        actionLabel: def.actionLabel,
        referralUrl: def.referralUrl,
        trustFactor: def.trustFactor,
        warmIntroRecipientEmail: def.warmIntroRecipientEmail || null,
        warmIntroQuestionsJson: def.warmIntroQuestionsJson || [],
        checkoutPriceAmount: def.checkoutPriceAmount ?? null,
        checkoutCurrency: def.checkoutCurrency || 'EUR',
        checkoutAddonsJson: def.checkoutAddonsJson || [],
        commissionBountySummary: def.commissionBountySummary || null,
        partnerContactNotes: def.partnerContactNotes || null,
        sortOrder: def.sortOrder,
        isActive: def.isActive,
      })
      .onConflictDoNothing();
  }
}

export interface AdminPartnersDashboardResult {
  ok: boolean;
  dbConnected: boolean;
  error?: string;
  offers: PartnerOfferRecord[];
  events: PartnerReferralEventRecord[];
  stats: {
    totalOffers: number;
    activeOffers: number;
    slotsCoveredCount: number;
    totalSlotsCount: number;
    totalAffiliateClicks: number;
    totalWarmIntroLeads: number;
    convertedBountiesCount: number;
  };
}

/**
 * 1. LIST ALL PARTNER OFFERS & REFERRAL EVENTS FOR ADMIN STUDIO
 */
export async function listAdminPartnersAndEventsAction(): Promise<AdminPartnersDashboardResult> {
  const isAdmin = await verifyAdminAuth();
  if (!isAdmin) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      dbConnected: false,
      error: 'Unauthorized: Super Admin access required.',
      offers: [],
      events: [],
      stats: {
        totalOffers: 0,
        activeOffers: 0,
        slotsCoveredCount: 0,
        totalSlotsCount: PARTNER_SLOT_DEFINITIONS.length,
        totalAffiliateClicks: 0,
        totalWarmIntroLeads: 0,
        convertedBountiesCount: 0,
      },
    };
  }

  try {
    await ensureDefaultPartnersSeededInDb();

    const [rawOffers, rawEvents] = await Promise.all([
      db.select().from(partnerOffers).orderBy(partnerOffers.sortOrder),
      db
        .select()
        .from(partnerReferralEvents)
        .orderBy(desc(partnerReferralEvents.createdAt))
        .limit(250),
    ]);

    const offers = rawOffers.map(mapDbOfferToRecord);
    const events = rawEvents.map(mapDbEventToRecord);

    const activeOffersList = offers.filter((o) => o.isActive);
    const coveredSlots = new Set(activeOffersList.map((o) => o.slotKey));

    return {
      ok: true,
      dbConnected: true,
      offers,
      events,
      stats: {
        totalOffers: offers.length,
        activeOffers: activeOffersList.length,
        slotsCoveredCount: coveredSlots.size,
        totalSlotsCount: PARTNER_SLOT_DEFINITIONS.length,
        totalAffiliateClicks: events.filter(
          (e) => e.eventType === 'AFFILIATE_CLICK'
        ).length,
        totalWarmIntroLeads: events.filter(
          (e) =>
            e.eventType === 'WARM_INTRO_LEAD' ||
            e.eventType === 'PAID_CONCIERGE_ORDER'
        ).length,
        convertedBountiesCount: events.filter(
          (e) =>
            e.leadStatus === 'CONVERTED_BOUNTY_DUE' ||
            e.leadStatus === 'BOUNTY_PAID'
        ).length,
      },
    };
  } catch (err) {
    const activeDefaults = DEFAULT_PARTNER_OFFERS.filter((o) => o.isActive);
    const coveredSlots = new Set(activeDefaults.map((o) => o.slotKey));
    return {
      ok: true,
      dbConnected: false,
      error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'DB unreachable — using local catalog.',
      offers: DEFAULT_PARTNER_OFFERS,
      events: [],
      stats: {
        totalOffers: DEFAULT_PARTNER_OFFERS.length,
        activeOffers: activeDefaults.length,
        slotsCoveredCount: coveredSlots.size,
        totalSlotsCount: PARTNER_SLOT_DEFINITIONS.length,
        totalAffiliateClicks: 0,
        totalWarmIntroLeads: 0,
        convertedBountiesCount: 0,
      },
    };
  }
}

/**
 * 2. LIST ACTIVE PARTNERS FOR PUBLIC / WORKSPACE <PartnerSlot />
 */
export async function listPublicActivePartnerOffersAction(): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  dbConnected: boolean;
  offers: PartnerOfferRecord[];
}> {
  try {
    await ensureDefaultPartnersSeededInDb();
    const rows = await db
      .select()
      .from(partnerOffers)
      .orderBy(partnerOffers.sortOrder);
    const active = rows.map(mapDbOfferToRecord).filter((o) => o.isActive);
    return {
      ok: true,
      dbConnected: true,
      offers: active.length > 0 ? active : DEFAULT_PARTNER_OFFERS.filter((o) => o.isActive),
    };
  } catch {
    return {
      ok: true,
      dbConnected: false,
      offers: DEFAULT_PARTNER_OFFERS.filter((o) => o.isActive),
    };
  }
}

/**
 * 3. CREATE OR UPDATE A PARTNER OFFER IN ADMIN STUDIO
 */
export async function upsertAdminPartnerOfferAction(input: {
  id?: string;
  slug: string;
  slotKey: PartnerSlotKey;
  name: string;
  logoEmoji: string;
  category: string;
  headline: string;
  perkDescription: string;
  badgeText: string;
  promoCode?: string | null;
  countryScope: PartnerCountryScope;
  actionType: PartnerActionType;
  actionLabel: string;
  referralUrl: string;
  trustFactor: string;
  warmIntroRecipientEmail?: string | null;
  warmIntroQuestionsJson?: WarmIntroQuestionField[];
  checkoutPriceAmount?: number | null;
  checkoutCurrency?: string | null;
  checkoutAddonsJson?: PartnerCheckoutAddonField[];
  commissionBountySummary?: string | null;
  partnerContactNotes?: string | null;
  isSupplierPartner?: boolean;
  supplierCategory?: QuoteSupplierCategory | null;
  dispatchEmail?: string | null;
  monthlyRfpCap?: number;
  rfpsDispatchedThisMonth?: number;
  lastRfpDispatchedAt?: string | null;
  sortOrder?: number;
  isActive?: boolean;
}): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  persistedToDb: boolean;
  offer?: PartnerOfferRecord;
  error?: string;
}> {
  const isAdmin = await verifyAdminAuth();
  if (!isAdmin) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      persistedToDb: false,
      error: 'Unauthorized: Super Admin access required.',
    };
  }

  const cleanSlug =
    input.slug
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9-]+/g, '-')
      .replace(/^-|-$/g, '') || `partner-${Date.now()}`;

  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
  const fallbackOffer: PartnerOfferRecord = {
    id: input.id || `partner-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
    slug: cleanSlug,
    slotKey: input.slotKey,
    name: input.name.trim(),
    logoEmoji: input.logoEmoji.trim() || '⚡',
    category: input.category.trim() || 'Partner Perk',
    headline: input.headline.trim(),
    perkDescription: input.perkDescription.trim(),
    badgeText: input.badgeText.trim() || 'Preflight Partner',
    promoCode: input.promoCode?.trim() || null,
    countryScope: input.countryScope || 'ALL',
    actionType: input.actionType || 'AFFILIATE_LINK',
    actionLabel: input.actionLabel.trim() || 'Claim Partner Perk',
    referralUrl: input.referralUrl.trim() || 'https://startuppreflight.com',
    trustFactor: input.trustFactor.trim() || 'Startup Preflight Verified Partner',
    warmIntroRecipientEmail: input.warmIntroRecipientEmail?.trim() || null,
    warmIntroQuestionsJson: input.warmIntroQuestionsJson || [],
    checkoutPriceAmount:
      input.checkoutPriceAmount != null &&
      Number.isFinite(Number(input.checkoutPriceAmount))
        ? Math.round(Number(input.checkoutPriceAmount))
        : null,
    checkoutCurrency: input.checkoutCurrency?.trim().toUpperCase() || 'EUR',
    checkoutAddonsJson: input.checkoutAddonsJson || [],
    commissionBountySummary: input.commissionBountySummary?.trim() || null,
    partnerContactNotes: input.partnerContactNotes?.trim() || null,
    isSupplierPartner: Boolean(input.isSupplierPartner),
    supplierCategory: input.supplierCategory || null,
    dispatchEmail: input.dispatchEmail?.trim() || null,
    monthlyRfpCap: Number.isFinite(input.monthlyRfpCap) ? Number(input.monthlyRfpCap) : 10,
    rfpsDispatchedThisMonth: Number.isFinite(input.rfpsDispatchedThisMonth) ? Number(input.rfpsDispatchedThisMonth) : 0,
    lastRfpDispatchedAt: input.lastRfpDispatchedAt || null,
    sortOrder: Number.isFinite(input.sortOrder) ? Number(input.sortOrder) : 10,
    isActive: input.isActive ?? true,
    createdAt: nowIso,
    updatedAt: nowIso,
  };

  try {
    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

    const uuidRegex =
      /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
    const isUuid = Boolean(input.id && uuidRegex.test(input.id));

    if (isUuid && input.id) {
      const updated = await db
        .update(partnerOffers)
        .set({
          slug: fallbackOffer.slug,
          slotKey: fallbackOffer.slotKey,
          name: fallbackOffer.name,
          logoEmoji: fallbackOffer.logoEmoji,
          category: fallbackOffer.category,
          headline: fallbackOffer.headline,
          perkDescription: fallbackOffer.perkDescription,
          badgeText: fallbackOffer.badgeText,
          promoCode: fallbackOffer.promoCode,
          countryScope: fallbackOffer.countryScope,
          actionType: fallbackOffer.actionType,
          actionLabel: fallbackOffer.actionLabel,
          referralUrl: fallbackOffer.referralUrl,
          trustFactor: fallbackOffer.trustFactor,
          warmIntroRecipientEmail: fallbackOffer.warmIntroRecipientEmail,
          warmIntroQuestionsJson: fallbackOffer.warmIntroQuestionsJson,
          checkoutPriceAmount: fallbackOffer.checkoutPriceAmount,
          checkoutCurrency: fallbackOffer.checkoutCurrency,
          checkoutAddonsJson: fallbackOffer.checkoutAddonsJson,
          commissionBountySummary: fallbackOffer.commissionBountySummary,
          partnerContactNotes: fallbackOffer.partnerContactNotes,
          isSupplierPartner: fallbackOffer.isSupplierPartner,
          supplierCategory: fallbackOffer.supplierCategory,
          dispatchEmail: fallbackOffer.dispatchEmail,
          monthlyRfpCap: fallbackOffer.monthlyRfpCap,
          sortOrder: fallbackOffer.sortOrder,
          isActive: fallbackOffer.isActive,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(partnerOffers.id, input.id))
        .returning();

      if (updated.length > 0) {
        return {
          ok: true,
          persistedToDb: true,
          offer: mapDbOfferToRecord(updated[0]),
        };
      }
    }

    // Check by slug if editing a default seed offer whose local ID wasn't a UUID
    const existingBySlug = await db
      .select()
      .from(partnerOffers)
      .where(eq(partnerOffers.slug, fallbackOffer.slug))
      .limit(1);

    if (existingBySlug.length > 0) {
      const updated = await db
        .update(partnerOffers)
        .set({
          slotKey: fallbackOffer.slotKey,
          name: fallbackOffer.name,
          logoEmoji: fallbackOffer.logoEmoji,
          category: fallbackOffer.category,
          headline: fallbackOffer.headline,
          perkDescription: fallbackOffer.perkDescription,
          badgeText: fallbackOffer.badgeText,
          promoCode: fallbackOffer.promoCode,
          countryScope: fallbackOffer.countryScope,
          actionType: fallbackOffer.actionType,
          actionLabel: fallbackOffer.actionLabel,
          referralUrl: fallbackOffer.referralUrl,
          trustFactor: fallbackOffer.trustFactor,
          warmIntroRecipientEmail: fallbackOffer.warmIntroRecipientEmail,
          warmIntroQuestionsJson: fallbackOffer.warmIntroQuestionsJson,
          checkoutPriceAmount: fallbackOffer.checkoutPriceAmount,
          checkoutCurrency: fallbackOffer.checkoutCurrency,
          checkoutAddonsJson: fallbackOffer.checkoutAddonsJson,
          commissionBountySummary: fallbackOffer.commissionBountySummary,
          partnerContactNotes: fallbackOffer.partnerContactNotes,
          isSupplierPartner: fallbackOffer.isSupplierPartner,
          supplierCategory: fallbackOffer.supplierCategory,
          dispatchEmail: fallbackOffer.dispatchEmail,
          monthlyRfpCap: fallbackOffer.monthlyRfpCap,
          sortOrder: fallbackOffer.sortOrder,
          isActive: fallbackOffer.isActive,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(partnerOffers.id, existingBySlug[0].id))
        .returning();

      return {
        ok: true,
        persistedToDb: true,
        offer: mapDbOfferToRecord(updated[0]),
      };
    }

    const inserted = await db
      .insert(partnerOffers)
      .values({
        slug: fallbackOffer.slug,
        slotKey: fallbackOffer.slotKey,
        name: fallbackOffer.name,
        logoEmoji: fallbackOffer.logoEmoji,
        category: fallbackOffer.category,
        headline: fallbackOffer.headline,
        perkDescription: fallbackOffer.perkDescription,
        badgeText: fallbackOffer.badgeText,
        promoCode: fallbackOffer.promoCode,
        countryScope: fallbackOffer.countryScope,
        actionType: fallbackOffer.actionType,
        actionLabel: fallbackOffer.actionLabel,
        referralUrl: fallbackOffer.referralUrl,
        trustFactor: fallbackOffer.trustFactor,
        warmIntroRecipientEmail: fallbackOffer.warmIntroRecipientEmail,
        warmIntroQuestionsJson: fallbackOffer.warmIntroQuestionsJson,
        checkoutPriceAmount: fallbackOffer.checkoutPriceAmount,
        checkoutCurrency: fallbackOffer.checkoutCurrency,
        checkoutAddonsJson: fallbackOffer.checkoutAddonsJson,
        commissionBountySummary: fallbackOffer.commissionBountySummary,
        partnerContactNotes: fallbackOffer.partnerContactNotes,
        isSupplierPartner: fallbackOffer.isSupplierPartner,
        supplierCategory: fallbackOffer.supplierCategory,
        dispatchEmail: fallbackOffer.dispatchEmail,
        monthlyRfpCap: fallbackOffer.monthlyRfpCap,
        sortOrder: fallbackOffer.sortOrder,
        isActive: fallbackOffer.isActive,
      })
      .returning();

    return {
      ok: true,
      persistedToDb: true,
      offer: mapDbOfferToRecord(inserted[0]),
    };
  } catch (err) {
    return {
      ok: true,
      persistedToDb: false,
      offer: fallbackOffer,
      error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Saved to local session fallback.',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * 4. QUICK TOGGLE PARTNER ACTIVE / PAUSED
 */
export async function toggleAdminPartnerActiveAction(input: {
  id: string;
  slug: string;
  isActive: boolean;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; persistedToDb: boolean }> {
  const isAdmin = await verifyAdminAuth();
  if (!isAdmin) return { ok: false, persistedToDb: false };

  try {
    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();
    const uuidRegex =
      /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
    if (uuidRegex.test(input.id)) {
      await db
        .update(partnerOffers)
        .set({ isActive: input.isActive, updatedAt: new Date() })
        .where(eq(partnerOffers.id, input.id));
    } else {
      await db
        .update(partnerOffers)
        .set({ isActive: input.isActive, updatedAt: new Date() })
        .where(eq(partnerOffers.slug, input.slug));
    }
    return { ok: true, persistedToDb: true };
  } catch {
    return { ok: true, persistedToDb: false };
  }
}

/**
 * 5. DELETE PARTNER OFFER
 */
export async function deleteAdminPartnerOfferAction(input: {
  id: string;
  slug: string;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; persistedToDb: boolean }> {
  const isAdmin = await verifyAdminAuth();
  if (!isAdmin) return { ok: false, persistedToDb: false };

  try {
    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();
    const uuidRegex =
      /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
    if (uuidRegex.test(input.id)) {
      await db.delete(partnerOffers).where(eq(partnerOffers.id, input.id));
    } else {
      await db.delete(partnerOffers).where(eq(partnerOffers.slug, input.slug));
    }
    return { ok: true, persistedToDb: true };
  } catch {
    return { ok: true, persistedToDb: false };
  }
}

/**
 * 6. RESTORE MISSING DEFAULT PARTNERS
 */
export async function restoreDefaultPartnerOffersAction(): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  persistedToDb: boolean;
}> {
  const isAdmin = await verifyAdminAuth();
  if (!isAdmin) return { ok: false, persistedToDb: false };

  try {
    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();
    for (const def of DEFAULT_PARTNER_OFFERS) {
      await db
        .insert(partnerOffers)
        .values({
          slug: def.slug,
          slotKey: def.slotKey,
          name: def.name,
          logoEmoji: def.logoEmoji,
          category: def.category,
          headline: def.headline,
          perkDescription: def.perkDescription,
          badgeText: def.badgeText,
          promoCode: def.promoCode || null,
          countryScope: def.countryScope,
          actionType: def.actionType,
          actionLabel: def.actionLabel,
          referralUrl: def.referralUrl,
          trustFactor: def.trustFactor,
          warmIntroRecipientEmail: def.warmIntroRecipientEmail || null,
          warmIntroQuestionsJson: def.warmIntroQuestionsJson || [],
          checkoutPriceAmount: def.checkoutPriceAmount ?? null,
          checkoutCurrency: def.checkoutCurrency || 'EUR',
          checkoutAddonsJson: def.checkoutAddonsJson || [],
          commissionBountySummary: def.commissionBountySummary || null,
          partnerContactNotes: def.partnerContactNotes || null,
          sortOrder: def.sortOrder,
          isActive: def.isActive,
        })
        .onConflictDoNothing();
    }
    return { ok: true, persistedToDb: true };
  } catch {
    return { ok: true, persistedToDb: false };
  }
}

/**
 * 7. SUBMIT WARM INTRO LEAD & DISPATCH STRUCTURED DOSSIER EMAIL TO PARTNER
 */
export async function submitPartnerWarmIntroLeadAction(input: {
  partnerId: string;
  partnerName: string;
  partnerSlug: string;
  slotKey: PartnerSlotKey;
  warmIntroRecipientEmail?: string | null;
  planId?: string;
  planTitle?: string;
  founderName: string;
  founderEmail: string;
  countryCode: string;
  oneLinerSummary?: string;
  intakeAnswers: Record<string, string>;
  estimatedBountyAmount?: string | null;
}): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  persistedToDb: boolean;
  emailSent: boolean;
  event: PartnerReferralEventRecord;
}> {
  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
  const founderSession = await getServerSessionCookie();
  const adminSession = await getAdminSessionCookie();
  const callerKey =
    founderSession?.userId ||
    adminSession?.userId ||
    input.founderEmail?.trim().toLowerCase() ||
    'anon';

  const rl = checkRateLimit(`partner_intro:${callerKey}`, 6, 10 * 60_000);
  // Resolve recipient strictly from verified DB/catalog partner record unless caller is Super Admin
  const recipientEmail = adminSession
    ? input.warmIntroRecipientEmail?.trim() ||
      (await resolveVerifiedPartnerRecipientEmail(
        input.partnerSlug,
        'partners@startuppreflight.com'
      ))
    : await resolveVerifiedPartnerRecipientEmail(
        input.partnerSlug,
        'partners@startuppreflight.com'
      );
  const safeFounderEmail = founderSession?.email || input.founderEmail.trim();

  const fallbackEvent: PartnerReferralEventRecord = {
    id: `lead-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
    partnerId: input.partnerId,
    partnerName: input.partnerName,
    partnerSlug: input.partnerSlug,
    slotKey: input.slotKey,
    eventType: 'WARM_INTRO_LEAD',
    planId: input.planId || null,
    planTitle: input.planTitle || 'Startup Plan',
    founderName: input.founderName.trim(),
    founderEmail: safeFounderEmail,
    countryCode: input.countryCode || 'IE',
    selectedDomain: input.intakeAnswers['desired_domain_name'] || null,
    destinationUrl: `mailto:${recipientEmail}`,
    intakeAnswersJson: input.intakeAnswers || {},
    leadStatus: 'INTRO_SENT',
    estimatedBountyAmount: input.estimatedBountyAmount || null,
    adminNotes: `Warm intro email sent to ${recipientEmail}`,
    createdAt: nowIso,
  };

  if (!rl.allowed) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      persistedToDb: false,
      emailSent: false,
      event: fallbackEvent,
    };
  }

  // Build clean HTML dossier table for the partner & founder CC
  const answerRowsHtml = Object.entries(input.intakeAnswers || {})
    .map(
      ([key, val]) => `
      <tr>
        <td style="padding:10px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0;font-weight:600;color:#334155;font-size:13px;width:42%;">${escapeHtml(
          key
            .replace(/_/g, ' ')
            .replace(/\b\w/g, (c) => c.toUpperCase())
        )}</td>
        <td style="padding:10px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0;color:#0f172a;font-size:13px;">${
          escapeHtml(val) || '—'
        }</td>
      </tr>`
    )
    .join('');

  const subjectLine = `[Startup Preflight Warm Intro] ${input.founderName} (${
    input.planTitle || 'New Startup'
  }) × ${input.partnerName}`;

  const emailHtml = `
    <div style="font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;max-width:620px;margin:0 auto;padding:24px;background:#ffffff;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:12px;">
      <div style="background:#1e1b4b;color:#ffffff;padding:18px 22px;border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:20px;">
        <div style="font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.08em;color:#a5b4fc;font-weight:700;">Startup Preflight • Verified Partner Warm Intro</div>
        <h2 style="margin:6px 0 0;font-size:18px;font-weight:700;">Founder Setup Request: ${escapeHtml(input.partnerName)}</h2>
      </div>
      <p style="font-size:14px;color:#334155;line-height:1.6;">
        Hi <strong>${escapeHtml(input.partnerName)}</strong> team,<br/><br/>
        Please meet <strong>${escapeHtml(input.founderName)}</strong> (<a href="mailto:${escapeHtml(safeFounderEmail)}">${escapeHtml(safeFounderEmail)}</a>), who is currently configuring their operational foundations on <strong>Startup Preflight</strong> (${input.countryCode === 'GB' ? 'United Kingdom' : 'Ireland'}) and requested a fast-track warm introduction.
      </p>
      <div style="background:#f8fafc;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:8px;padding:14px;margin:16px 0;">
        <div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#475569;margin-bottom:8px;">STARTUP &amp; FOUNDER SNAPSHOT</div>
        <div style="font-size:13px;color:#0f172a;line-height:1.6;">
          <strong>Venture / Plan:</strong> ${escapeHtml(input.planTitle || 'Startup Venture')}<br/>
          <strong>Founder Contact:</strong> ${escapeHtml(input.founderName)} (${escapeHtml(safeFounderEmail)})<br/>
          <strong>Jurisdiction:</strong> ${input.countryCode === 'GB' ? 'United Kingdom (Companies House / HMRC)' : 'Ireland (CRO / Revenue)'}<br/>
          ${input.oneLinerSummary ? `<strong>Concept Summary:</strong> ${escapeHtml(input.oneLinerSummary)}<br/>` : ''}
        </div>
      </div>
      <h3 style="font-size:13px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.05em;color:#475569;margin-top:20px;">Submitted Setup Intake Answers</h3>
      <table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
        <tbody>
          ${answerRowsHtml}
        </tbody>
      </table>
      <p style="font-size:12px;color:#64748b;margin-top:20px;border-top:1px solid #f1f5f9;padding-top:12px;">
        <strong>Next Step:</strong> Reply-All to this email to connect directly with ${escapeHtml(input.founderName)}. Sent via Startup Preflight Partner Concierge Engine.
      </p>
    </div>
  `;

  let emailSent = false;
  let resendId: string | null = null;
  let emailStatus = 'MOCK_DEV';

  try {
    if (resend && (founderSession || adminSession || process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production')) {
      // 1. Send Warm Intro Dossier Email to the Partner Desk
      const partnerSubject = subjectLine;
      const response = await resend.emails.send({
        from: EMAIL_DEFAULTS.from,
        to: [recipientEmail],
        cc:
          safeFounderEmail &&
          safeFounderEmail.toLowerCase() !== recipientEmail.toLowerCase()
            ? [safeFounderEmail]
            : undefined,
        replyTo: safeFounderEmail || EMAIL_DEFAULTS.replyTo,
        subject: partnerSubject,
        html: emailHtml,
      });

      if (!response.error && response.data?.id) {
        resendId = response.data.id;
        emailStatus = 'SENT';
        emailSent = true;
      } else if (response.error) {
        console.error('❌ Resend Warm Intro Partner Email Error:', response.error);
        emailStatus = 'FAILED';
      }
    } else {
      emailSent = true;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('❌ Error executing submitPartnerWarmIntroLeadAction:', err);
    emailStatus = 'FAILED';
  }

  try {
    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

    // Log in email_logs so it appears in System Emails Studio as well
    await db.insert(emailLogs).values({
      recipient: recipientEmail,
      template: 'PARTNER_WARM_INTRO',
      subject: subjectLine,
      status: emailStatus,
      resendId,
      fromEmail: EMAIL_DEFAULTS.from,
      replyTo: input.founderEmail || EMAIL_DEFAULTS.replyTo,
      metadataJson: {
        partnerSlug: input.partnerSlug,
        slotKey: input.slotKey,
        founderEmail: input.founderEmail,
        planId: input.planId,
      },
    });

    const inserted = await db
      .insert(partnerReferralEvents)
      .values({
        partnerId: input.partnerId,
        partnerName: input.partnerName,
        partnerSlug: input.partnerSlug,
        slotKey: input.slotKey,
        eventType: 'WARM_INTRO_LEAD',
        planId: input.planId || null,
        planTitle: input.planTitle || 'Startup Plan',
        founderName: input.founderName.trim(),
        founderEmail: input.founderEmail.trim(),
        countryCode: input.countryCode || 'IE',
        selectedDomain: input.intakeAnswers['desired_domain_name'] || null,
        destinationUrl: `mailto:${recipientEmail}`,
        intakeAnswersJson: input.intakeAnswers || {},
        leadStatus: 'INTRO_SENT',
        estimatedBountyAmount: input.estimatedBountyAmount || null,
        adminNotes: `Warm intro dossier dispatched to ${recipientEmail} (CC: ${input.founderEmail})`,
      })
      .returning();

    return {
      ok: true,
      persistedToDb: true,
      emailSent,
      event: mapDbEventToRecord(inserted[0]),
    };
  } catch {
    return {
      ok: true,
      persistedToDb: false,
      emailSent,
      event: fallbackEvent,
    };
  }
}
