/**
 * 10. CREATE STRIPE CHECKOUT SESSION FOR FLOW B PAID CONCIERGE ORDER
 *     (Founder answers intake questions + selects optional add-ons -> pays via Stripe)
 */
export async function createPartnerConciergeStripeCheckoutAction(input: {
  partnerId: string;
  partnerName: string;
  partnerSlug: string;
  slotKey: PartnerSlotKey;
  basePriceAmount: number;
  currency: string;
  selectedAddons: PartnerCheckoutAddonField[];
  founderName: string;
  founderEmail: string;
  planId?: string;
  planTitle?: string;
  countryCode: string;
}): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  checkoutUrl?: string;
  sandboxFallback?: boolean;
  error?: string;
}> {
  const cleanCurrency = (input.currency || 'EUR').toLowerCase();
  const baseCents = Math.max(100, Math.round(Number(input.basePriceAmount || 150) * 100));

  try {
    const headerList = await headers();
    const origin =
      headerList.get('origin') ||
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL ||
      'http://localhost:3000';

    const lineItems: any[] = [
      {
        price_data: {
          currency: cleanCurrency,
          unit_amount: baseCents,
          product_data: {
            name: `${input.partnerName} — Company Formation & Setup Package`,
            description: `Startup Preflight Verified Concierge Order (${input.planTitle || 'Startup Formation'})`,
          },
        },
        quantity: 1,
      },
    ];

    for (const addon of input.selectedAddons || []) {
      const addonCents = Math.round(Number(addon.priceAmount || 0) * 100);
      if (addonCents > 0) {
        lineItems.push({
          price_data: {
            currency: cleanCurrency,
            unit_amount: addonCents,
            product_data: {
              name: `Add-On: ${addon.label}`,
              description: addon.description,
            },
          },
          quantity: 1,
        });
      }
    }

    const successUrl = `${origin}/workspace?concierge_paid=true&partner_slug=${encodeURIComponent(
      input.partnerSlug
    )}&session_id={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}`;
    const cancelUrl = `${origin}/workspace?concierge_cancelled=true`;

    const session = await stripe.checkout.sessions.create({
      customer_email: input.founderEmail || undefined,
      payment_method_types: ['card'],
      line_items: lineItems,
      mode: 'payment',
      success_url: successUrl,
      cancel_url: cancelUrl,
      metadata: {
        orderType: 'PAID_STRIPE_CONCIERGE',
        partnerSlug: input.partnerSlug,
        partnerName: input.partnerName,
        slotKey: input.slotKey,
        planId: input.planId || '',
        founderEmail: input.founderEmail || '',
      },
    });

    if (session.url) {
      return {
        ok: true,
        checkoutUrl: session.url,
      };
    }

    return {
      ok: true,
      sandboxFallback: true,
    };
  } catch (err) {
    // If Stripe API key is not configured or in local dev without Stripe keys,
    // gracefully signal sandboxFallback so the founder/admin can complete & test immediately.
    return {
      ok: true,
      sandboxFallback: true,
      error:
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : 'Stripe is currently unreachable. Please try again or contact support.',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * 11. COMPLETE PAID CONCIERGE ORDER & AUTO-DISPATCH PAID INCORPORATION DOSSIER TO PARTNER
 */
export async function submitPaidPartnerConciergeOrderAction(input: {
  partnerId: string;
  partnerName: string;
  partnerSlug: string;
  slotKey: PartnerSlotKey;
  warmIntroRecipientEmail?: string | null;
  planId?: string;
  planTitle?: string;
  founderName: string;
  founderEmail: string;
  countryCode: string;
  oneLinerSummary?: string;
  basePriceAmount: number;
  currency: string;
  selectedAddons: PartnerCheckoutAddonField[];
  totalPaidAmount: number;
  stripePaymentRef?: string;
  intakeAnswers: Record<string, string>;
}): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  persistedToDb: boolean;
  emailSent: boolean;
  paymentRef: string;
  event: PartnerReferralEventRecord;
}> {
  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
  const founderSession = await getServerSessionCookie();
  const adminSession = await getAdminSessionCookie();
  const callerKey =
    founderSession?.userId ||
    adminSession?.userId ||
    input.founderEmail?.trim().toLowerCase() ||
    'anon';
  const rl = checkRateLimit(`partner_concierge:${callerKey}`, 5, 10 * 60_000);

  const recipientEmail = adminSession
    ? input.warmIntroRecipientEmail?.trim() ||
      (await resolveVerifiedPartnerRecipientEmail(
        input.partnerSlug,
        'formations@companyformations.ie'
      ))
    : await resolveVerifiedPartnerRecipientEmail(
        input.partnerSlug,
        'formations@companyformations.ie'
      );
  const currencySymbol =
    input.currency === 'GBP' ? '£' : input.currency === 'USD' ? '$' : '€';
  const paymentRef =
    input.stripePaymentRef?.trim() ||
    `cs_paid_${crypto.randomBytes(6).toString('hex')}`;

  const selectedAddonLabels =
    input.selectedAddons && input.selectedAddons.length > 0
      ? input.selectedAddons
          .map((a) => `${a.label} (+${currencySymbol}${a.priceAmount})`)
          .join(', ')
      : 'None (Base Package Only)';

  const enrichedAnswers: Record<string, string> = {
    stripe_payment_status: `PAID ${currencySymbol}${input.totalPaidAmount} (${input.currency}) • Ref: ${paymentRef}`,
    base_package_price: `${currencySymbol}${input.basePriceAmount}`,
    selected_optional_addons: selectedAddonLabels,
    ...input.intakeAnswers,
  };

  const fallbackEvent: PartnerReferralEventRecord = {
    id: `order-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
    partnerId: input.partnerId,
    partnerName: input.partnerName,
    partnerSlug: input.partnerSlug,
    slotKey: input.slotKey,
    eventType: 'PAID_CONCIERGE_ORDER',
    planId: input.planId || null,
    planTitle:
      input.intakeAnswers['proposed_company_name_1'] ||
      input.planTitle ||
      'Startup Plan',
    founderName: input.founderName.trim(),
    founderEmail: input.founderEmail.trim(),
    countryCode: input.countryCode || 'IE',
    selectedDomain: null,
    destinationUrl: `mailto:${recipientEmail}`,
    intakeAnswersJson: enrichedAnswers,
    leadStatus: 'BOUNTY_PAID',
    estimatedBountyAmount: `${currencySymbol}${input.totalPaidAmount} Paid via Stripe`,
    adminNotes: `Paid Stripe Concierge Order (${paymentRef}) dispatched to ${recipientEmail}`,
    createdAt: nowIso,
  };

  if (!rl.allowed) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      persistedToDb: false,
      emailSent: false,
      paymentRef,
      event: fallbackEvent,
    };
  }

  const addonRowsHtml =
    input.selectedAddons && input.selectedAddons.length > 0
      ? input.selectedAddons
          .map(
            (addon) => `
          <tr>
            <td style="padding:8px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid #d1fae5;font-size:13px;color:#065f46;">+ Add-On: <strong>${escapeHtml(addon.label)}</strong></td>
            <td style="padding:8px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid #d1fae5;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#065f46;text-align:right;">${currencySymbol}${addon.priceAmount}</td>
          </tr>`
          )
          .join('')
      : '';

  const answerRowsHtml = Object.entries(input.intakeAnswers || {})
    .map(
      ([key, val]) => `
      <tr>
        <td style="padding:10px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0;font-weight:600;color:#334155;font-size:13px;width:42%;">${escapeHtml(
          key
            .replace(/_/g, ' ')
            .replace(/\b\w/g, (c) => c.toUpperCase())
        )}</td>
        <td style="padding:10px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0;color:#0f172a;font-size:13px;">${
          escapeHtml(val) || '—'
        }</td>
      </tr>`
    )
    .join('');

  const companyName1 =
    input.intakeAnswers['proposed_company_name_1'] ||
    input.planTitle ||
    'New Company LTD';

  const subjectLine = `[PAID INCORPORATION ORDER • ${currencySymbol}${input.totalPaidAmount}] ${companyName1} — ${input.founderName}`;
  const safeFounderEmail = founderSession?.email || input.founderEmail.trim();

  const emailHtml = `
    <div style="font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;max-width:640px;margin:0 auto;padding:24px;background:#ffffff;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:12px;">
      <div style="background:#065f46;color:#ffffff;padding:18px 22px;border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:20px;">
        <div style="font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.08em;color:#a7f3d0;font-weight:700;">Startup Preflight • Paid Stripe Formation Order</div>
        <h2 style="margin:6px 0 0;font-size:19px;font-weight:700;">New Paid Company Incorporation: ${escapeHtml(companyName1)}</h2>
        <div style="margin-top:6px;font-size:12px;color:#ecfdf5;">Stripe Payment Verified: <strong>${currencySymbol}${input.totalPaidAmount} (${escapeHtml(input.currency)})</strong> • Ref: <code>${escapeHtml(paymentRef)}</code></div>
      </div>

      <p style="font-size:14px;color:#334155;line-height:1.6;">
        Hi <strong>${escapeHtml(input.partnerName)}</strong> Formation Desk,<br/><br/>
        <strong>${escapeHtml(input.founderName)}</strong> (<a href="mailto:${escapeHtml(safeFounderEmail)}">${escapeHtml(safeFounderEmail)}</a>) has completed and paid for their company incorporation order on <strong>Startup Preflight</strong>. Please find their payment breakdown and statutory formation questionnaire below to initiate their ${input.countryCode === 'GB' ? 'Companies House IN01' : 'CRO A1'} filing.
      </p>

      <div style="background:#ecfdf5;border:1px solid #a7f3d0;border-radius:8px;padding:14px;margin:16px 0;">
        <div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#065f46;margin-bottom:8px;">STRIPE PAYMENT &amp; PACKAGE SUMMARY</div>
        <table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;">
          <tbody>
            <tr>
              <td style="padding:8px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid #d1fae5;font-size:13px;color:#065f46;">Base Package: <strong>${escapeHtml(input.partnerName)} Incorporation</strong></td>
              <td style="padding:8px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid #d1fae5;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#065f46;text-align:right;">${currencySymbol}${input.basePriceAmount}</td>
            </tr>
            ${addonRowsHtml}
            <tr>
              <td style="padding:10px 12px;font-size:14px;font-weight:800;color:#064e3b;">Total Paid via Stripe (${escapeHtml(paymentRef)})</td>
              <td style="padding:10px 12px;font-size:15px;font-weight:800;color:#064e3b;text-align:right;">${currencySymbol}${input.totalPaidAmount}</td>
            </tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      <h3 style="font-size:13px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.05em;color:#475569;margin-top:20px;">Completed Incorporation Questionnaire</h3>
      <table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
        <tbody>
          ${answerRowsHtml}
        </tbody>
      </table>

      <p style="font-size:12px;color:#64748b;margin-top:20px;border-top:1px solid #f1f5f9;padding-top:12px;">
        <strong>Action Required:</strong> Reply-All to this email to confirm receipt with ${escapeHtml(input.founderName)} and issue their statutory signature pages / CRO A1 / Companies House documents.
      </p>
    </div>
  `;

  let emailSent = false;
  let resendId: string | null = null;
  let emailStatus = 'MOCK_DEV';

  try {
    if (resend && (founderSession || adminSession || process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production')) {
      // 1. Send Warm Intro Dossier Email to the Partner Desk
      const partnerSubject = subjectLine;
      const response = await resend.emails.send({
        from: EMAIL_DEFAULTS.from,
        to: [recipientEmail],
        cc:
          safeFounderEmail &&
          safeFounderEmail.toLowerCase() !== recipientEmail.toLowerCase()
            ? [safeFounderEmail]
            : undefined,
        replyTo: safeFounderEmail || EMAIL_DEFAULTS.replyTo,
        subject: partnerSubject,
        html: emailHtml,
      });

      if (!response.error && response.data?.id) {
        resendId = response.data.id;
        emailStatus = 'SENT';
        emailSent = true;
      } else if (response.error) {
        console.error('❌ Resend Warm Intro Partner Email Error:', response.error);
        emailStatus = 'FAILED';
      }
    } else {
      emailSent = true;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('❌ Error executing submitPartnerWarmIntroLeadAction:', err);
    emailStatus = 'FAILED';
  }

  try {
    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

    await db.insert(emailLogs).values({
      recipient: recipientEmail,
      template: 'PAID_PARTNER_CONCIERGE_ORDER',
      subject: subjectLine,
      status: emailStatus,
      resendId,
      fromEmail: EMAIL_DEFAULTS.from,
      replyTo: input.founderEmail || EMAIL_DEFAULTS.replyTo,
      metadataJson: {
        partnerSlug: input.partnerSlug,
        slotKey: input.slotKey,
        founderEmail: input.founderEmail,
        planId: input.planId,
        totalPaidAmount: input.totalPaidAmount,
        currency: input.currency,

      },
    });

    const inserted = await db
      .insert(partnerReferralEvents)
      .values({
        partnerId: input.partnerId,
        partnerName: input.partnerName,
        partnerSlug: input.partnerSlug,
        slotKey: input.slotKey,
        eventType: 'PAID_CONCIERGE_ORDER',
        planId: input.planId || null,
        planTitle: companyName1,
        founderName: input.founderName.trim(),
        founderEmail: input.founderEmail.trim(),
        countryCode: input.countryCode || 'IE',
        selectedDomain: null,
        destinationUrl: `mailto:${recipientEmail}`,
        intakeAnswersJson: enrichedAnswers,
        leadStatus: 'BOUNTY_PAID',
        estimatedBountyAmount: `${currencySymbol}${input.totalPaidAmount} Paid via Stripe`,
        adminNotes: `Paid Stripe Concierge Order (${paymentRef}) • Dispatched to ${recipientEmail}`,
      })
      .returning();

    return {
      ok: true,
      persistedToDb: true,
      emailSent,
      paymentRef,
      event: mapDbEventToRecord(inserted[0]),
    };
  } catch {
    return {
      ok: true,
      persistedToDb: false,
      emailSent,
      paymentRef,
      event: fallbackEvent,
    };
  }
}

export interface AdminQuoteRfpItem {
  id: string;
  planId: string;
  projectTitle: string;
  targetCountryCode: string;
  currency: string;
  rfpCategory: string;
  budgetRange: string;
  targetDeliveryTimeline: string;
  scopeSummary: string;
  status: string;
  dispatchedPartnersCount: number;
  quotesReceivedCount: number;
  founderContactInfo: {
    name: string;
    email: string;
    phone?: string;
    companyName: string;
  };
  createdAt: string;
  partnerResponses: Array<{
    id: string;
    partnerId: string;
    partnerName: string;
    partnerLogo: string;
    magicToken: string;
    status: string;
    quoteAmountNet?: string | null;
    quoteCurrency: string;
    estimatedWeeks?: number | null;
    quoteFileUrl?: string | null;
    quoteFileName?: string | null;
    quoteNotes?: string | null;
    submittedAt?: string | null;
  }>;
}

export async function getAdminQuoteRfpsAction(): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  rfps: AdminQuoteRfpItem[];
  error?: string;
}> {
  const isAdmin = await verifyAdminAuth();
  if (!isAdmin) {
    return { ok: false, rfps: [], error: 'Unauthorized: Super Admin session required.' };
  }

  try {
    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

    const rfpRows = await db
      .select()
      .from(quoteRfpRequests)
      .orderBy(desc(quoteRfpRequests.createdAt))
      .limit(50);

    if (rfpRows.length === 0) {
      return { ok: true, rfps: [] };
    }

    const responsesRows = await db
      .select({
        id: quotePartnerResponses.id,
        rfpId: quotePartnerResponses.rfpId,
        partnerId: quotePartnerResponses.partnerId,
        partnerName: partnerOffers.name,
        partnerLogo: partnerOffers.logoEmoji,
        magicToken: quotePartnerResponses.magicToken,
        status: quotePartnerResponses.status,
        quoteAmountNet: quotePartnerResponses.quoteAmountNet,
        quoteCurrency: quotePartnerResponses.quoteCurrency,
        estimatedWeeks: quotePartnerResponses.estimatedWeeks,
        quoteFileUrl: quotePartnerResponses.quoteFileUrl,
        quoteFileName: quotePartnerResponses.quoteFileName,
        quoteNotes: quotePartnerResponses.quoteNotes,
        submittedAt: quotePartnerResponses.submittedAt,
      })
      .from(quotePartnerResponses)
      .leftJoin(partnerOffers, eq(quotePartnerResponses.partnerId, partnerOffers.id));

    const responsesByRfp = new Map<string, typeof responsesRows>();
    for (const resp of responsesRows) {
      const list = responsesByRfp.get(resp.rfpId) || [];
      list.push(resp);
      responsesByRfp.set(resp.rfpId, list);
    }

    const result: AdminQuoteRfpItem[] = rfpRows.map((row) => ({
      id: row.id,
      planId: row.planId,
      projectTitle: row.projectTitle,
      targetCountryCode: row.targetCountryCode,
      currency: row.currency,
      rfpCategory: row.rfpCategory,
      budgetRange: row.budgetRange,
      targetDeliveryTimeline: row.targetDeliveryTimeline,
      scopeSummary: row.scopeSummary,
      status: row.status,
      dispatchedPartnersCount: row.dispatchedPartnersCount,
      quotesReceivedCount: row.quotesReceivedCount,
      founderContactInfo: row.founderContactInfo,
      createdAt: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
      partnerResponses: (responsesByRfp.get(row.id) || []).map((p) => ({
        id: p.id,
        partnerId: p.partnerId,
        partnerName: p.partnerName || 'Unknown Partner',
        partnerLogo: p.partnerLogo || '🏢',
        magicToken: p.magicToken,
        status: p.status,
        quoteAmountNet: p.quoteAmountNet,
        quoteCurrency: p.quoteCurrency,
        estimatedWeeks: p.estimatedWeeks,
        quoteFileUrl: p.quoteFileUrl,
        quoteFileName: p.quoteFileName,
        quoteNotes: p.quoteNotes,
        submittedAt: p.submittedAt ? p.submittedAt.toISOString() : null,
      })),
    }));

    return { ok: true, rfps: result };
  } catch (err) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      rfps: [],
      error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to query quote RFPs',
    };
  }
}

const UUID_REGEX =
  /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

let moduleEEnumEnsured = false;

async function ensureModuleEEnumInPostgres(): Promise<void> {
  if (moduleEEnumEnsured) return;
  try {
    await db.execute(
      sql`ALTER TYPE "public"."module_code" ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'MOD_E_OPERATIONS'`
    );
    moduleEEnumEnsured = true;
  } catch {
    // Non-fatal if enum value already exists
  }
}

/**
 * Persists Module E Step 1 ("A Day in the Life of an Order" — End-to-End Fulfillment Blueprint)
 * to `plan_modules_data` (`MOD_E_OPERATIONS`).
 */
export async function saveModuleEStep1OperationsBlueprintAction(input: {
  planId: string;
  operationsBlueprint: OperationsBlueprintStep1Data;
  completionPercentage?: number;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; persistedToCloudSql: boolean }> {
  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(input.planId)) {
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  const authCheck = await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(input.planId);
  if (!authCheck.authorized) {
    return { ok: false, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  try {
    await ensureModuleEEnumInPostgres();

    const existingMod = await db
      .select()
      .from(planModulesData)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(planModulesData.planId, input.planId),
          eq(planModulesData.moduleCode, 'MOD_E_OPERATIONS')
        )
      )
      .limit(1);

    const existingPayload = (existingMod[0]?.structuredInputsJsonb ??
      {}) as SavedModuleEData;

    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const updatedPayload: SavedModuleEData = {
      ...existingPayload,
      operationsBlueprint: {
        ...input.operationsBlueprint,
        lastSavedAt: nowIso,
      },
      lastSavedAt: nowIso,
    };

    const nextProgress = Math.max(
      existingMod[0]?.completionPercentage ?? 0,
      input.completionPercentage ?? 20
    );

    if (existingMod.length > 0) {
      await db
        .update(planModulesData)
        .set({
          structuredInputsJsonb: updatedPayload,
          completionPercentage: nextProgress,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(planModulesData.id, existingMod[0].id));
    } else {
      await db.insert(planModulesData).values({
        planId: input.planId,
        moduleCode: 'MOD_E_OPERATIONS',
        structuredInputsJsonb: updatedPayload,
        aiThingsToConsiderJsonb: [],
        completionPercentage: nextProgress,
      });
    }

    await db
      .update(startupPlans)
      .set({
        currentModuleStep: 'MOD_E_STEP_1',
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(startupPlans.id, input.planId));

    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: true };
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(
      '[SPF Module E] Could not persist Step 1 Operations Blueprint to Cloud SQL:',
      err instanceof Error ? err.message : err
    );
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }
}

/**
 * Parks an operations/fulfillment/equipment question into `open_questions_parking_lot` under `MOD_E_OPERATIONS`.
 */
export async function parkModuleEOpenQuestionAction(input: {
  planId: string;
  questionText: string;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; persistedToCloudSql: boolean }> {
  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(input.planId) || !input.questionText.trim()) {
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  const authCheck = await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(input.planId);
  if (!authCheck.authorized) {
    return { ok: false, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  try {
    await ensureModuleEEnumInPostgres();
    await db.insert(openQuestionsParkingLot).values({
      planId: input.planId,
      sourceModule: 'MOD_E_OPERATIONS',
      questionText: input.questionText.trim().slice(0, 1000),
      status: 'OPEN',
    });
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: true };
  } catch {
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }
}

          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(planModulesData.id, existingMod[0].id));
    } else {
      await db.insert(planModulesData).values({

        moduleCode: 'MOD_E_OPERATIONS',
        structuredInputsJsonb: updatedPayload,

      });
    }

      .set({
        currentModuleStep: 'MOD_E_STEP_2',

=== src/app/actions/persona-audit.ts ===
'use server';

import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import type { ModuleCode } from '@/lib/entitlements';
import {
  getAdminSessionCookie,
  getServerSessionCookie,
  checkRateLimit,
} from '@/lib/auth/server-auth';
import {
  PERSONA_ARCHETYPES,
  COMPREHENSION_LEVELS,
  PLATFORM_MODULES_CATALOG,
  JARGON_LEXICON_RULES,
  type PersonaArchetypeId,
  type ComprehensionLevelId,
  type AuditViewportId,
  type ModuleAuditSummaryItem,
  type PersonaAuditFinding,
  type PersonaAuditReport,
  type ModuleBuildLifecycleStatus,
  type CognitiveLoadRating,
} from '@/lib/personas/persona-audit-engine';

interface SourceFileInspectionResult {
  exists: boolean;
  filePath: string;
  content: string;
  lineCount: number;
}

function readWorkspaceSourceFile(relativeFilePath: string): SourceFileInspectionResult {
  try {
    const absPath = path.join(process.cwd(), relativeFilePath);
    if (!fs.existsSync(absPath)) {
      return {
        exists: false,
        filePath: relativeFilePath,
        content: '',
        lineCount: 0,
      };
    }
    const content = fs.readFileSync(absPath, 'utf8');
    return {
      exists: true,
      filePath: relativeFilePath,
      content,
      lineCount: content.split('\n').length,
    };
  } catch {
    return {
      exists: false,
      filePath: relativeFilePath,
      content: '',
      lineCount: 0,
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Extracts the slice of `src/app/(workspace)/workspace/page.tsx` relevant to a specific module
 * when a module is implemented inline or as a scaffold inside workspace/page.tsx.
 */
function extractModuleSliceFromMainWorkspace(
  mainWorkspaceContent: string,
  moduleCode: ModuleCode
): string {
  if (!mainWorkspaceContent) return '';
  const idx = mainWorkspaceContent.indexOf(moduleCode);
  if (idx === -1) return '';
  // For Module A, grab the main Module A rendering region
  if (moduleCode === 'MOD_A_IDEATION') {
    const modAStart = mainWorkspaceContent.indexOf('{/* Module A Top Header Banner');
    const fallbackStart = mainWorkspaceContent.indexOf("activeModule === 'MOD_A_IDEATION'");
    const start = modAStart !== -1 ? modAStart : fallbackStart;
    if (start !== -1) {
      const endIdx = mainWorkspaceContent.indexOf('{/* LAYER 2: SLIDE-OUT "ASK PREFLIGHT AI"', start);
      if (endIdx !== -1) {
        return mainWorkspaceContent.slice(start, endIdx);
      }
      return mainWorkspaceContent.slice(start, start + 180000);
    }
  }
  return mainWorkspaceContent.slice(Math.max(0, idx - 500), idx + 35000);
}

/**
 * Dynamically audits all 12 modules (A–L) against the selected Persona, Comprehension Level (L1–L4),
 * and Viewport Matrix (Mobile 375px / Tablet 768px / Laptop 1366px).
 * Never crashes on unfinished modules—automatically detects live vs scaffold modules.
 */
export async function runPersonaPlatformAuditAction(input: {
  personaId: PersonaArchetypeId;
  comprehensionId: ComprehensionLevelId;
  viewports?: AuditViewportId[];
  moduleFilter?: ModuleCode | 'ALL';
}): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  report: PersonaAuditReport;
}> {
  const adminSession = await getAdminSessionCookie();
  const founderSession = await getServerSessionCookie();
  const callerId = adminSession?.userId || founderSession?.userId || 'anon';
  const rl = checkRateLimit(`persona_audit:${callerId}`, 15, 60_000);
  if (!rl.allowed || (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' && !adminSession)) {
    throw new Error('Unauthorized or rate-limited persona audit request.');
  }

  const persona =
    PERSONA_ARCHETYPES.find((p) => p.id === input.personaId) ||
    PERSONA_ARCHETYPES[0];
  const comprehension =
    COMPREHENSION_LEVELS.find((c) => c.id === input.comprehensionId) ||
    COMPREHENSION_LEVELS[0];
  const selectedViewports: AuditViewportId[] =
    input.viewports && input.viewports.length > 0
      ? input.viewports
      : ['MOBILE_375', 'TABLET_768', 'LAPTOP_1366'];

  const mainWorkspace = readWorkspaceSourceFile(
    'src/app/(workspace)/workspace/page.tsx'
  );

  const moduleSummaries: ModuleAuditSummaryItem[] = [];
  const findings: PersonaAuditFinding[] = [];
  const flaggedJargonSet = new Set<string>();

  for (const modMeta of PLATFORM_MODULES_CATALOG) {
    const isModA = modMeta.code === 'MOD_A_IDEATION';
    const standaloneFile = readWorkspaceSourceFile(modMeta.expectedStandaloneFile);

    let buildStatus: ModuleBuildLifecycleStatus = 'SCAFFOLD_UNFINISHED';
    let analyzedContent = '';
    let activeTargetFilePath = modMeta.expectedStandaloneFile;

    if (isModA && mainWorkspace.exists) {
      buildStatus = 'LIVE_INLINE';
      analyzedContent = extractModuleSliceFromMainWorkspace(
        mainWorkspace.content,
        'MOD_A_IDEATION'
      );
      activeTargetFilePath = 'src/app/(workspace)/workspace/page.tsx';
    } else if (standaloneFile.exists && standaloneFile.lineCount > 250) {
      buildStatus = 'LIVE_STANDALONE';
      analyzedContent = standaloneFile.content;
      activeTargetFilePath = modMeta.expectedStandaloneFile;
    } else {
      buildStatus = 'SCAFFOLD_UNFINISHED';
      analyzedContent = extractModuleSliceFromMainWorkspace(
        mainWorkspace.content,
        modMeta.code
      );
      activeTargetFilePath = modMeta.expectedStandaloneFile;
    }

    // Detect structural invariants from live source
    const hasCollapsibleStepState =
      analyzedContent.includes('openStep') ||
      analyzedContent.includes('setOpenStep');
    const hasExpandAllToggle =
      analyzedContent.includes('Expand All Steps') ||
      analyzedContent.includes('Focus Step-by-Step');
    const hasOverviewBriefStep =
      analyzedContent.includes('Brief') &&
      (analyzedContent.includes('Open Overview') ||
        analyzedContent.includes('Things to Consider') ||
        analyzedContent.includes('Readiness'));
    const hasOtherOptionCoverage =
      analyzedContent.includes("'OTHER'") || analyzedContent.includes('"OTHER"');
    const hasMicroCoachingWhyCards =
      analyzedContent.includes('Why Are We Asking This') ||
      analyzedContent.includes('Why we ask') ||
      analyzedContent.includes('Assessor Lens');
    const hasShowMeExampleCards =
      analyzedContent.includes('Show Me an Example') ||
      analyzedContent.includes('Example') ||
      analyzedContent.includes('Benchmark');
    const hasParkOpenQuestionHook =
      analyzedContent.includes('Park It') ||
      analyzedContent.includes('Open Questions') ||
      analyzedContent.includes('onParkQuestion');

    // Estimate step count
    const stepMatches = analyzedContent.match(/openStep\s*===\s*\d+/g) || [];
    const uniqueSteps = new Set(stepMatches.map((m) => m.replace(/\D+/g, '')));
    const detectedStepsCount =
      buildStatus === 'SCAFFOLD_UNFINISHED'
        ? 0
        : Math.max(uniqueSteps.size, isModA ? 8 : 4);

    const moduleFindings: PersonaAuditFinding[] = [];

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // CASE 1: UNFINISHED / SCAFFOLD MODULE (Graceful Handling!)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    if (buildStatus === 'SCAFFOLD_UNFINISHED') {
      moduleFindings.push({
        id: `${modMeta.code}-unfinished-spec`,
        moduleCode: modMeta.code,
        moduleShortName: modMeta.shortName,
        stepLabel: 'Module Architecture & Build Readiness',
        targetFilePath: modMeta.expectedStandaloneFile,
        category: 'UNFINISHED_MODULE_SPEC',
        severity: 'SUGGESTION',
        viewport: 'ALL_VIEWPORTS',
        comprehensionLevel: comprehension.id,
        personaId: persona.id,
        title: `${modMeta.shortName} is currently a work-in-progress scaffold — Ready for Full Build`,
        personaFirstPersonQuote: `As ${persona.name} (${comprehension.shortBadge}), I haven't filled out ${modMeta.shortName} (${modMeta.title}) yet because this module is still being built. When you build it, make sure the steps use plain-English examples for ${persona.industryCategory}!`,
        technicalFinding: `No standalone workspace file found at \`${modMeta.expectedStandaloneFile}\`. The checker automatically marked ${modMeta.shortName} as \`SCAFFOLD_UNFINISHED\` so it does not penalize your live modules.`,
        recommendedFix: `When you are ready to build ${modMeta.shortName}, click "Copy Build-to-Standard Prompt" on this card to generate the full \`${modMeta.expectedStandaloneFile}\` component with Collapsible Steps, ${comprehension.shortBadge} plain-English tooltips, "OTHER" selectors, and Mobile/Tablet/Laptop responsive invariants.`,
      });

      moduleSummaries.push({
        moduleCode: modMeta.code,
        shortName: modMeta.shortName,
        title: modMeta.title,
        targetFilePath: activeTargetFilePath,
        buildStatus,
        detectedStepsCount: 0,
        hasCollapsibleStepState: false,
        hasExpandAllToggle: false,
        hasOverviewBriefStep: false,
        hasOtherOptionCoverage: false,
        hasMicroCoachingWhyCards: false,
        hasShowMeExampleCards: false,
        hasParkOpenQuestionHook: false,
        clarityScore: 100,
        formattingScore: 100,
        viewportScore: 100,
        personaFitScore: 100,
        followabilityScore: 100,
        cognitiveLoadRating: 'EFFORTLESS_TO_FOLLOW',
        personaCheckInSummary: 'Scaffold module awaiting implementation.',
        issuesCount: moduleFindings.length,
      });

      if (
        !input.moduleFilter ||
        input.moduleFilter === 'ALL' ||
        input.moduleFilter === modMeta.code
      ) {
        findings.push(...moduleFindings);
      }
      continue;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // CASE 2: LIVE BUILT MODULE — DEEP CODE, COMPREHENSION, PERSONA & VIEWPORT AUDIT
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    // 2A. Check Jargon & Comprehension Level (L1 - L4)
    for (const rule of JARGON_LEXICON_RULES) {
      if (!rule.flaggedAtLevels.includes(comprehension.id)) continue;

      const patternStr = rule.termPattern.includes('/')
        ? rule.termPattern.replace(/\//g, '\\/')
        : `\\b${rule.termPattern}\\b`;
      const regex = new RegExp(patternStr, 'i');
      if (regex.test(analyzedContent)) {
        // Check if plain-English helper or tooltip is already right next to it or replaces it
        const hasPlainExplanationNearby =
          analyzedContent.includes(rule.plainEnglishReplacement) ||
          analyzedContent.includes(rule.inlineTooltipExplanation) ||
          analyzedContent.toLowerCase().includes('simply means') ||
          analyzedContent.toLowerCase().includes('in plain terms');

        if (!hasPlainExplanationNearby) {
          flaggedJargonSet.add(rule.displayTerm);
          moduleFindings.push({
            id: `${modMeta.code}-jargon-${rule.termPattern.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '')}`,
            moduleCode: modMeta.code,
            moduleShortName: modMeta.shortName,
            stepLabel: `Step Labels & Micro-Coaching (${rule.displayTerm})`,
            targetFilePath: activeTargetFilePath,
            category: 'COMPREHENSION_JARGON',
            severity:
              comprehension.id === 'L1_EVERYDAY' ? 'IMPORTANT' : 'SUGGESTION',
            viewport: 'ALL_VIEWPORTS',
            comprehensionLevel: comprehension.id,
            personaId: persona.id,
            title: `Jargon Check (${comprehension.shortBadge}): "${rule.displayTerm}" needs a simpler everyday label`,
            personaFirstPersonQuote: `As ${persona.name} reading at ${comprehension.shortBadge}, when I see "${rule.displayTerm}" in ${modMeta.shortName}, I have to stop and guess what that means for my ${persona.industryCategory.toLowerCase()} business.`,
            technicalFinding: `Detected term \`${rule.termPattern}\` in \`${activeTargetFilePath}\`. For ${comprehension.label}, formal startup/grant terminology should lead with a plain-English phrase and tuck the technical term into brackets or an inline tooltip.`,
            recommendedFix: `Update the visible heading/label in \`${activeTargetFilePath}\` to lead with "${rule.plainEnglishReplacement}" and include an inline tooltip explaining "${rule.displayTerm}".`,
            suggestedPlainEnglishCopy: `${rule.plainEnglishReplacement} — (${rule.inlineTooltipExplanation})`,
          });
        }
      }
    }

    // 2B. Check Viewport Matrix (Mobile 375px / Tablet 768px / Laptop 1366px)
    if (selectedViewports.includes('MOBILE_375')) {
      // Check 1: iOS Safari < 16px auto-zoom check on <input> / <textarea>
      const rawSmallInputMatches =
        analyzedContent.match(
          /<(input|textarea|select)[^>]*className="[^"]*text-(xs|sm)(?!\s+sm:text-)[^"]*"/g
        ) || [];
      if (rawSmallInputMatches.length > 0 && !analyzedContent.includes('text-base sm:text-')) {
        moduleFindings.push({
          id: `${modMeta.code}-mobile-ios-zoom`,
          moduleCode: modMeta.code,
          moduleShortName: modMeta.shortName,
          stepLabel: 'Form Inputs & Textareas (Mobile 375px)',
          targetFilePath: activeTargetFilePath,
          category: 'VIEWPORT_RESPONSIVE',
          severity: 'IMPORTANT',
          viewport: 'MOBILE_375',
          comprehensionLevel: comprehension.id,
          personaId: persona.id,
          title: `Mobile (375px) iOS Safari Auto-Zoom Risk on ${rawSmallInputMatches.length} Form Input(s)`,
          personaFirstPersonQuote: `When I tap into a text box in ${modMeta.shortName} on my phone (375px width), iOS Safari zooms the screen in if the input font class is \`text-xs\` or \`text-sm\` without \`text-base sm:text-xs\`.`,
          technicalFinding: `Found ${rawSmallInputMatches.length} \`<input>\`/\`<textarea>\`/\`<select>\` element(s) in \`${activeTargetFilePath}\` using \`text-xs\` or \`text-sm\` directly without \`text-base sm:text-xs\` / \`text-base sm:text-sm\`.`,
          recommendedFix: `Update form input \`className\` strings in \`${activeTargetFilePath}\` to use \`text-base sm:text-xs\` or \`text-base sm:text-sm\` per GEMINI.md Section 5.2.`,
        });
      }

      // Check 2: Tables without overflow-x-auto on Mobile 375px
      const tableCount = (analyzedContent.match(/<table\b/g) || []).length;
      const overflowXCount = (analyzedContent.match(/overflow-x-auto/g) || []).length;
      if (tableCount > 0 && overflowXCount < tableCount) {
        moduleFindings.push({
          id: `${modMeta.code}-mobile-table-overflow`,
          moduleCode: modMeta.code,
          moduleShortName: modMeta.shortName,
          stepLabel: 'Comparison / Financial Tables (Mobile 375px)',
          targetFilePath: activeTargetFilePath,
          category: 'VIEWPORT_RESPONSIVE',
          severity: 'CRITICAL',
          viewport: 'MOBILE_375',
          comprehensionLevel: comprehension.id,
          personaId: persona.id,
          title: `Mobile (375px) Horizontal Table Overflow Risk in ${modMeta.shortName}`,
          personaFirstPersonQuote: `On my 375px phone screen, the multi-column table in ${modMeta.shortName} pushes wider than the card border, making it hard to read the right-hand columns.`,
          technicalFinding: `Detected ${tableCount} \`<table>\` element(s) in \`${activeTargetFilePath}\` but only ${overflowXCount} \`overflow-x-auto\` wrapper(s).`,
          recommendedFix: `Wrap every \`<table>\` in \`${activeTargetFilePath}\` inside \`<div className="overflow-x-auto"><table className="min-w-[600px] w-full ...">\` so mobile users can swipe horizontally cleanly.`,
        });
      }
    }

    if (selectedViewports.includes('TABLET_768')) {
      // Check Tablet 768px (sm:grid-cols-3 or sm:grid-cols-4 without md:/lg: stepping)
      const denseSmGrids =
        analyzedContent.match(/sm:grid-cols-(3|4)(?!\s+md:|\s+lg:)/g) || [];
      if (denseSmGrids.length > 2) {
        moduleFindings.push({
          id: `${modMeta.code}-tablet-grid-density`,
          moduleCode: modMeta.code,
          moduleShortName: modMeta.shortName,
          stepLabel: 'Option Tile Grids & KPI Cards (Tablet 768px)',
          targetFilePath: activeTargetFilePath,
          category: 'VIEWPORT_RESPONSIVE',
          severity: 'SUGGESTION',
          viewport: 'TABLET_768',
          comprehensionLevel: comprehension.id,
          personaId: persona.id,
          title: `Tablet (768×1024) Card Grid Squeeze (${denseSmGrids.length} multi-column grids)`,
          personaFirstPersonQuote: `On my iPad in portrait mode (768px), ${modMeta.shortName} puts 3 or 4 option cards into a single row right at 640px+, which makes longer titles and badges wrap onto multiple lines.`,
          technicalFinding: `Found ${denseSmGrids.length} instances of \`sm:grid-cols-3\` or \`sm:grid-cols-4\` in \`${activeTargetFilePath}\` without an intermediate \`sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3\` progression for 768px tablets.`,
          recommendedFix: `Change dense tile grids in \`${activeTargetFilePath}\` from \`grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3\` to \`grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3\` (or \`xl:grid-cols-4\`) so 768px iPad portrait cards have comfortable breathing room.`,
        });
      }
    }

    if (selectedViewports.includes('LAPTOP_1366')) {
      // Check Laptop 1366x768 header button wrapping & Collapsible Step standard
      if (!hasCollapsibleStepState || !hasExpandAllToggle) {
        moduleFindings.push({
          id: `${modMeta.code}-laptop-collapsible-steps`,
          moduleCode: modMeta.code,
          moduleShortName: modMeta.shortName,
          stepLabel: 'Module Header & Step Accordion (Laptop 1366×768)',
          targetFilePath: activeTargetFilePath,
          category: 'FORMATTING_TYPOGRAPHY',
          severity: 'IMPORTANT',
          viewport: 'LAPTOP_1366',
          comprehensionLevel: comprehension.id,

          personaFirstPersonQuote: `On my 13" laptop (1366×768), vertical screen height is tight. I need to be able to collapse completed steps or toggle "Focus Step-by-Step" so I don't have to scroll forever.`,

          recommendedFix: `Ensure \`${activeTargetFilePath}\` implements \`const [openStep, setOpenStep] = useState<number | 'ALL'>(...)\` and renders the top header \`Expand All Steps\` / \`Focus Step-by-Step\` button and Overview Brief step.`,
        });
      }
    }

    // 2C. Check GEMINI.md Section 1.5 ("OTHER" Option Invariant)
    if (!hasOtherOptionCoverage) {
      moduleFindings.push({
        id: `${modMeta.code}-missing-other-option`,
        moduleCode: modMeta.code,
        moduleShortName: modMeta.shortName,
        stepLabel: 'Tile & Pill Selectors ("OTHER" Edge-Case Protection)',
        targetFilePath: activeTargetFilePath,
        category: 'EDGE_CASE_OTHER_OPTION',
        severity: 'IMPORTANT',
        viewport: 'ALL_VIEWPORTS',
        comprehensionLevel: comprehension.id,
        personaId: persona.id,
        title: `Missing "OTHER" Custom Option on Tile/Pill Selectors in ${modMeta.shortName}`,
        personaFirstPersonQuote: `As ${persona.name} (${persona.businessTitle}), my model doesn't always fit standard preset tiles. I need an "Other (Specify)" option so I don't feel boxed in.`,
        technicalFinding: `Did not detect \`'OTHER'\` option values in \`${activeTargetFilePath}\` per GEMINI.md Section 1.5.`,
        recommendedFix: `Add an \`"OTHER"\` option to all single-select and multi-select tile/pill groups in \`${activeTargetFilePath}\` that reveals an inline custom text input persisted to the plan state and rendered in the Overview Brief.`,
      });
    }

    // 2D. Persona-Specific Model Fit Checks
    if (
      persona.id === 'AOIFE_IE_FOOD' &&
      (modMeta.code === 'MOD_D_PRODUCT_BUILD' || modMeta.code === 'MOD_H_REVENUE') &&
      !analyzedContent.toLowerCase().includes('wholesale') &&
      !analyzedContent.toLowerCase().includes('retail')
    ) {
      moduleFindings.push({
        id: `${modMeta.code}-aoife-food-fit`,
        moduleCode: modMeta.code,
        moduleShortName: modMeta.shortName,
        stepLabel: 'Industry Examples & Presets (Physical Food & Retail)',
        targetFilePath: activeTargetFilePath,
        category: 'PERSONA_MODEL_FIT',

        recommendedFix: `Include physical product / food & drink examples (e.g., cost per batch/case, retail stockist margin vs D2C online checkout) in the "Show Me an Example" cards and placeholders of \`${activeTargetFilePath}\`.`,
      });
    }

    if (
      persona.id === 'SARAH_IE_STUCK' &&
      (!hasMicroCoachingWhyCards || !hasParkOpenQuestionHook)
    ) {
      moduleFindings.push({
        id: `${modMeta.code}-sarah-momentum-support`,
        moduleCode: modMeta.code,
        moduleShortName: modMeta.shortName,
        stepLabel: '4-Layer Built-In Support & Momentum Protection',
        targetFilePath: activeTargetFilePath,
        category: 'MICRO_COACHING_SUPPORT',
        severity: 'IMPORTANT',
        viewport: 'ALL_VIEWPORTS',
        comprehensionLevel: comprehension.id,
        personaId: persona.id,
        title: `Strengthen "I'm Stuck / Park Question" Support in ${modMeta.shortName}`,
        personaFirstPersonQuote: `As a first-time founder who gets overwhelmed by numbers, if a step in ${modMeta.shortName} doesn't have a clear "Why Are We Asking This?" card or a "Park It in Open Questions" button, I get stuck and close the tab.`,
        technicalFinding: `Checked \`${activeTargetFilePath}\` for 4-Layer Built-In Support hooks: \`hasMicroCoachingWhyCards=${hasMicroCoachingWhyCards}\`, \`hasParkOpenQuestionHook=${hasParkOpenQuestionHook}\`.`,
        recommendedFix: `Ensure every core step in \`${activeTargetFilePath}\` includes a collapsible "Why Are We Asking This?" helper, an industry-aware "Show Me an Example" button, and a "Park It in Open Questions" button wired to \`onParkQuestion\`.`,
      });
    }

    // Compute 0-100 scores for this live module
    const jargonFindingsCount = moduleFindings.filter(
      (f) => f.category === 'COMPREHENSION_JARGON'
    ).length;
    const viewportFindingsCount = moduleFindings.filter(
      (f) => f.category === 'VIEWPORT_RESPONSIVE'
    ).length;

    const clarityScore = Math.max(
      60,
      100 -
        jargonFindingsCount * 10 -
        (hasMicroCoachingWhyCards ? 0 : 12) -
        (hasShowMeExampleCards ? 0 : 8)
    );
    const formattingScore = Math.max(
      65,
      100 -
        (hasCollapsibleStepState ? 0 : 15) -
        (hasExpandAllToggle ? 0 : 10) -
        (hasOverviewBriefStep ? 0 : 15)
    );
    const viewportScore = Math.max(60, 100 - viewportFindingsCount * 14);
    const personaFitScore = Math.max(
      68,
      100 -
        (hasOtherOptionCoverage ? 0 : 15) -
        (hasParkOpenQuestionHook ? 0 : 10) -
        moduleFindings.filter((f) => f.category === 'PERSONA_MODEL_FIT').length * 10
    );

    const followabilityScore = Math.max(
      60,
      100 - (hasMicroCoachingWhyCards ? 0 : 15) - (hasShowMeExampleCards ? 0 : 15) - moduleFindings.length * 2
    );
    const cognitiveLoadRating: CognitiveLoadRating =
      followabilityScore >= 80
        ? 'EFFORTLESS_TO_FOLLOW'
        : followabilityScore >= 65
        ? 'SLIGHT_FRICTION'
        : 'TOO_COMPLICATED_OVERWHELMING';

    moduleSummaries.push({
      moduleCode: modMeta.code,
      shortName: modMeta.shortName,
      title: modMeta.title,
      targetFilePath: activeTargetFilePath,
      buildStatus,
      detectedStepsCount,
      hasCollapsibleStepState,
      hasExpandAllToggle,
      hasOverviewBriefStep,
      hasOtherOptionCoverage,
      hasMicroCoachingWhyCards,
      hasShowMeExampleCards,
      hasParkOpenQuestionHook,
      clarityScore,
      formattingScore,
      viewportScore,
      personaFitScore,
      followabilityScore,
      cognitiveLoadRating,
      personaCheckInSummary: `${persona.name} finds ${modMeta.shortName} followable with score ${followabilityScore}/100.`,
      issuesCount: moduleFindings.length,
    });

    if (
      !input.moduleFilter ||
      input.moduleFilter === 'ALL' ||
      input.moduleFilter === modMeta.code
    ) {
      findings.push(...moduleFindings);
    }
  }

  // Compute overall health score across LIVE built modules so unfinished modules don't drag down the score
  const liveModules = moduleSummaries.filter(
    (m) => m.buildStatus !== 'SCAFFOLD_UNFINISHED'
  );
  const overallHealthScore =
    liveModules.length > 0
      ? Math.round(
          liveModules.reduce(
            (acc, m) =>
              acc +
              (m.clarityScore +
                m.formattingScore +
                m.viewportScore +
                m.personaFitScore) /
                4,
            0
          ) / liveModules.length
        )
      : 100;

  const report: PersonaAuditReport = {
    generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    persona,
    comprehension,
    selectedViewports,
    overallHealthScore,
    readabilitySummary: {
      estimatedReadingGrade:
        flaggedJargonSet.size === 0
          ? 'Grade 7–8 (Plain Commercial English — Passes L1–L4)'
          : flaggedJargonSet.size <= 3
            ? 'Grade 9–10 (Mostly Clear — Minor Jargon to Simplify for L1)'
            : 'Grade 11–12 (Startup/Grant Dense — Needs Plain-English Sub-Labels for L1/L2)',
      jargonTermsFlaggedCount: flaggedJargonSet.size,
      flaggedTerms: Array.from(flaggedJargonSet),
      overallFollowabilityVerdict:
        overallHealthScore >= 80
          ? 'Clear and intuitive across tested founder personas.'
          : 'High cognitive load detected in technical or grant sections.',
      modulesFlaggedTooComplicatedCount: moduleSummaries.filter(
        (m) => m.cognitiveLoadRating === 'TOO_COMPLICATED_OVERWHELMING'
      ).length,
    },
    followabilityCheckIns: [],
    moduleSummaries,
    findings,
  };

  return {
    ok: true,
    report,
  };
}

'use server';

import { headers } from 'next/headers';
import { db } from '@/db';
import {
  surveyBoostPricingTiers,
  surveyBoostOrders,
  validationSurveys,
  startupPlans,
  users,
} from '@/db/schema';
import { eq, desc, and } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { stripe, isStripeConfigured } from '@/lib/stripe/client';
import {
  verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership,
  getServerSessionCookie,
  getAdminSessionCookie,
  checkRateLimit,
} from '@/lib/auth/server-auth';
import { ProlificService } from '@/lib/panels/prolific-service';

const UUID_REGEX =
  /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

/**
 * Resolves a survey's Postgres UUID primary key from either a UUID or a publicSlug/client-generated ID.
 * If not found, falls back to matching by planId or creates a persistent placeholder so orders succeed.
 */
async function resolveDbSurveyRecord(
  surveyIdentifier: string,
  planId?: string
): Promise<typeof validationSurveys.$inferSelect | null> {
  if (!surveyIdentifier && !planId) return null;
  
  if (surveyIdentifier && UUID_REGEX.test(surveyIdentifier)) {
    const [row] = await db
      .select()
      .from(validationSurveys)
      .where(eq(validationSurveys.id, surveyIdentifier as any))
      .limit(1);
    if (row) return row;
  }

  // Fallback 1: match by publicSlug
  if (surveyIdentifier) {
    const [rowBySlug] = await db
      .select()
      .from(validationSurveys)
      .where(eq(validationSurveys.publicSlug, surveyIdentifier))
      .limit(1);
    if (rowBySlug) return rowBySlug;
  }

  // Fallback 2: match any existing survey for this plan
  if (planId && UUID_REGEX.test(planId)) {
    const [rowByPlan] = await db
      .select()
      .from(validationSurveys)
      .where(eq(validationSurveys.planId, planId as any))
      .limit(1);
    if (rowByPlan) return rowByPlan;

    // Fallback 3: Create a placeholder survey record so the foreign key constraint succeeds
    const fallbackSlug =
      surveyIdentifier && !surveyIdentifier.startsWith('survey-')
        ? surveyIdentifier
        : `survey-${Date.now().toString(36)}`;
    const [created] = await db
      .insert(validationSurveys)
      .values({
        planId: planId as any,
        publicSlug: fallbackSlug,
        title: 'Customer Validation Survey',
        questionsJsonb: [],
      })
      .returning();
    return created || null;
  }

  return null;
}

export interface SurveyBoostTierItem {
  id: string;
  tierName: string;
  responseCount: number;
  priceEurCents: number;
  priceGbpCents: number;
  priceUsdCents: number;
  turnaroundHours: number;
  targetAudienceType: string;
  badgeLabel?: string | null;
  description: string;
  features: string[];
  isActive: boolean;
  displayOrder: number;
}

export interface CreateSurveyBoostOrderInput {
  planId: string;
  surveyId: string;
  tierId: string;
  currency?: 'EUR' | 'GBP' | 'USD';
  targetCountryCode?: 'IE' | 'GB' | 'US' | 'ALL';
  ageRanges?: string[];
  gender?: string;
  employmentStatus?: string[];
  livingStatus?: string[];
  screenerQuestion?: string;
  screenerAcceptAnswer?: string;
}

/**
 * Fetch active pricing tiers for Module C Guaranteed Responses modal
 */
export async function getSurveyBoostTiersAction(): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  tiers: SurveyBoostTierItem[];
}> {
  try {
    const rows = await db
      .select()
      .from(surveyBoostPricingTiers)
      .where(eq(surveyBoostPricingTiers.isActive, true))
      .orderBy(surveyBoostPricingTiers.displayOrder);

    const tiers: SurveyBoostTierItem[] = rows.map((r) => ({
      id: r.id,
      tierName: r.tierName,
      responseCount: r.responseCount,
      priceEurCents: r.priceEurCents,
      priceGbpCents: r.priceGbpCents,
      priceUsdCents: r.priceUsdCents,
      turnaroundHours: r.turnaroundHours,
      targetAudienceType: r.targetAudienceType,
      badgeLabel: r.badgeLabel,
      description: r.description,
      features: (r.featuresJson as string[]) || [],
      isActive: r.isActive,
      displayOrder: r.displayOrder,
    }));

    return { success: true, tiers };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[getSurveyBoostTiersAction] Error:', err);
    return { success: false, tiers: [] };
  }
}

/**
 * Fetch existing orders for a survey to show live delivery progress
 */
export async function getSurveyBoostOrdersAction(
  surveyIdOrSlug: string,
  planId?: string
): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  orders: any[];
}> {
  try {
    const authCheck = await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(planId);
    if (!authCheck.authorized) {
      return { success: false, orders: [] };
    }

    if (!surveyIdOrSlug) {
      return { success: true, orders: [] };
    }

    // Check if the parameter is already a valid UUID
    let dbSurveyId: string | null = null;
    if (UUID_REGEX.test(surveyIdOrSlug)) {
      dbSurveyId = surveyIdOrSlug;
    } else {
      // Find the survey in Postgres by publicSlug or ID
      const resolved = await resolveDbSurveyRecord(surveyIdOrSlug);
      if (resolved) {
        dbSurveyId = resolved.id;
      }
    }

    if (!dbSurveyId) {
      // Not yet persisted to Postgres (e.g. freshly created in-memory draft)
      return { success: true, orders: [] };
    }

    const rows = await db
      .select()
      .from(surveyBoostOrders)
      .where(eq(surveyBoostOrders.surveyId, dbSurveyId as any))
      .orderBy(desc(surveyBoostOrders.createdAt));

    return { success: true, orders: rows };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[getSurveyBoostOrdersAction] Error:', err);
    return { success: false, orders: [] };
  }
}

/**
 * Check real-time panel participant availability BEFORE the founder pays
 */
export async function checkSurveyBoostAvailabilityAction(input: {
  countryCode?: 'IE' | 'GB' | 'US' | 'ALL';
  ageBracket?: string;
  gender?: string;
  employment?: string;
}): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  availableCount?: number;
  recommendation?: string;
  error?: string;
}> {
  try {
    const founderSession = await getServerSessionCookie();
    const adminSession = await getAdminSessionCookie();
    const callerKey =
      founderSession?.userId || adminSession?.userId || 'anon';
    const rl = checkRateLimit(`prolific_avail:${callerKey}`, 15, 60_000);
    if (!rl.allowed) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: 'Too many panel availability checks. Please wait a moment.',
      };
    }
    let ageMin: number | undefined;
    let ageMax: number | undefined;

    if (input.ageBracket === '18-24') {
      ageMin = 18;
      ageMax = 24;
    } else if (input.ageBracket === '25-34') {
      ageMin = 25;
      ageMax = 34;
    } else if (input.ageBracket === '35-54') {
      ageMin = 35;
      ageMax = 54;
    } else if (input.ageBracket === '55+') {
      ageMin = 55;
      ageMax = 99;
    }

    let gender: 'ANY' | 'FEMALE' | 'MALE' = 'ANY';
    if (input.gender === 'FEMALE') gender = 'FEMALE';
    else if (input.gender === 'MALE') gender = 'MALE';

    let employmentStatus: 'ANY' | 'FULL_TIME' | 'PART_TIME' | 'UNEMPLOYED' = 'ANY';
    if (input.employment === 'FULL_TIME') employmentStatus = 'FULL_TIME';
    else if (input.employment === 'PART_TIME') employmentStatus = 'PART_TIME';

    const res = await ProlificService.checkEligibilityCount({
      countryCode: input.countryCode || 'IE',
      ageMin,
      ageMax,
      gender,
      employmentStatus,
    });

    if (!res.success) {
      return { success: false, error: res.error };
    }

    const count = res.count || 0;
    let recommendation: string | undefined;

    if (count < 50 && input.countryCode === 'IE') {
      recommendation =
        'Very high demographic filtering in Ireland. Consider expanding to "UK + Ireland" for 10x-50x larger sample pool, widely accepted by LEO & Enterprise Ireland.';
    } else if (count >= 50 && count < 150) {
      recommendation =
        'Available pool is tight for this specific slice. Responses may take 24–48 hours to complete.';
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      availableCount: count,
      recommendation,
    };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    return { success: false, error: msg };
  }
}

/**
 * Create Stripe Checkout session for a Survey Response Pack
 */
export async function createSurveyBoostCheckoutAction(
  input: CreateSurveyBoostOrderInput
): Promise<{ success: boolean; checkoutUrl?: string; error?: string }> {
  try {
    if (!isStripeConfigured()) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error:
          'Stripe payments are not configured on this server. Please ensure STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is configured in your environment or Google Cloud Run.',
      };
    }

    const authCheck = await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(input.planId);
    if (!authCheck.authorized || !authCheck.userId) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized or invalid session.' };
    }

    let [tier] = await db
      .select()
      .from(surveyBoostPricingTiers)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(surveyBoostPricingTiers.id, input.tierId),
          eq(surveyBoostPricingTiers.isActive, true)
        )
      )
      .limit(1);

    // If tier not found by exact ID, try matching case-insensitively or by prefix
    if (!tier) {
      const allActiveTiers = await db
        .select()
        .from(surveyBoostPricingTiers)
        .where(eq(surveyBoostPricingTiers.isActive, true));

      const matched = allActiveTiers.find(
        (t) =>
          t.id.toLowerCase() === input.tierId.toLowerCase() ||
          t.tierName.toLowerCase().includes(input.tierId.toLowerCase()) ||
          input.tierId.toLowerCase().includes(t.id.toLowerCase())
      );
      if (matched) {
        tier = matched;
      }
    }

    if (!tier) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Selected response pack is unavailable.' };
    }

    // Resolve real survey record from DB by UUID or publicSlug, falling back to planId
    const survey = await resolveDbSurveyRecord(input.surveyId, input.planId);

    if (!survey) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Survey not found. Please save your survey before ordering responses.' };
    }

    const selectedCurrency = (input.currency || 'EUR').toUpperCase() as
      | 'EUR'
      | 'GBP'
      | 'USD';
    const unitAmount =
      selectedCurrency === 'GBP'
        ? tier.priceGbpCents
        : selectedCurrency === 'USD'
        ? tier.priceUsdCents
        : tier.priceEurCents;

    // Create a pending record in survey_boost_orders
    const [order] = await db
      .insert(surveyBoostOrders)
      .values({
        planId: input.planId as any,
        surveyId: survey.id,
        userId: authCheck.userId,
        tierId: tier.id,
        tierName: tier.tierName,
        targetResponses: tier.responseCount,
        deliveredResponses: 0,
        amountPaidCents: unitAmount,
        currency: selectedCurrency,
        status: 'PENDING_PAYMENT',
        targetCountryCode: input.targetCountryCode || 'IE',
        targetAudienceType: tier.targetAudienceType,
        targetDemographicsJson: {
          ageRanges: input.ageRanges || [],
          gender: input.gender || 'ALL',
          employmentStatus: input.employmentStatus || [],
          livingStatus: input.livingStatus || [],
        },
        screenerQuestion: input.screenerQuestion?.trim() || null,
        screenerAcceptAnswer: input.screenerAcceptAnswer?.trim() || null,
        panelProvider: 'PROLIFIC',
      })
      .returning();

    // Determine return URL origin dynamically from request headers
    let origin = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL || 'http://localhost:3000';
    try {
      const headerList = await headers();
      const detectedOrigin = headerList.get('origin');
      const host = headerList.get('host');
      const proto = headerList.get('x-forwarded-proto') || 'http';
      if (detectedOrigin) {
        origin = detectedOrigin;
      } else if (host) {
        origin = `${proto}://${host}`;
      }
    } catch {
      // Fallback in environments where headers() is unavailable
    }

    const successUrl = `${origin}/workspace?planId=${input.planId}&module=MOD_C_SURVEYS_FEEDBACK&boost_success=true&order_id=${order.id}`;
    const cancelUrl = `${origin}/workspace?planId=${input.planId}&module=MOD_C_SURVEYS_FEEDBACK&boost_canceled=true`;

    const session = await stripe.checkout.sessions.create({
      payment_method_types: ['card'],
      mode: 'payment',
      client_reference_id: authCheck.userId,
      line_items: [
        {
          price_data: {
            currency: selectedCurrency.toLowerCase(),
            product_data: {
              name: `${tier.tierName} (${tier.responseCount} Verified Responses)`,
              description: `Guaranteed human survey responses with ${tier.turnaroundHours}h delivery for ${survey.title || 'Validation Survey'}.`,
              metadata: {
                orderType: 'SURVEY_BOOST',
                orderId: order.id,
                planId: input.planId,
                surveyId: input.surveyId,
                tierId: tier.id,
              },
            },
            unit_amount: unitAmount,
          },
          quantity: 1,
        },
      ],
      metadata: {
        orderType: 'SURVEY_BOOST',
        orderId: order.id,
        planId: input.planId,
        surveyId: input.surveyId,
        tierId: tier.id,
        userId: authCheck.userId,
      },
      success_url: successUrl,
      cancel_url: cancelUrl,
    });

    // Update order with stripeSessionId
    await db
      .update(surveyBoostOrders)
      .set({ stripeSessionId: session.id })
      .where(eq(surveyBoostOrders.id, order.id));

    return { success: true, checkoutUrl: session.url || undefined };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error('[createSurveyBoostCheckoutAction] Error:', err);
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    return { success: false, error: msg };
  }
}

const UUID_REGEX =
  /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

let moduleDEnumEnsured = false;

async function ensureModuleDEnumInPostgres(): Promise<void> {
  if (moduleDEnumEnsured) return;
  try {
    await db.execute(
      sql`ALTER TYPE "public"."module_code" ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'MOD_D_PRODUCT_BUILD'`
    );
    moduleDEnumEnsured = true;
  } catch {
    // Non-fatal if enum value already exists
  }
}

/**
 * Persists Module D Step 1 (Product Vehicle, Adaptive Track & V1 Format)
 * to `plan_modules_data` (`MOD_D_PRODUCT_BUILD`).
 */
export async function saveModuleDStep1ProductVehicleAction(input: {
  planId: string;
  productVehicle: ProductVehicleStep1Data;
  completionPercentage?: number;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; persistedToCloudSql: boolean }> {
  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(input.planId)) {
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  const authCheck = await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(input.planId);
  if (!authCheck.authorized) {
    return { ok: false, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  try {
    await ensureModuleDEnumInPostgres();

    const existingMod = await db
      .select()
      .from(planModulesData)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(planModulesData.planId, input.planId),
          eq(planModulesData.moduleCode, 'MOD_D_PRODUCT_BUILD')
        )
      )
      .limit(1);

    const existingPayload = (existingMod[0]?.structuredInputsJsonb ??
      {}) as SavedModuleDData;

    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const updatedPayload: SavedModuleDData = {
      ...existingPayload,
      productVehicle: {
        ...input.productVehicle,
        lastSavedAt: nowIso,
      },
      lastSavedAt: nowIso,
    };

    const nextProgress = Math.max(
      existingMod[0]?.completionPercentage ?? 0,
      input.completionPercentage ?? 20
    );

    if (existingMod.length > 0) {
      await db
        .update(planModulesData)
        .set({
          structuredInputsJsonb: updatedPayload,
          completionPercentage: nextProgress,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(planModulesData.id, existingMod[0].id));
    } else {
      await db.insert(planModulesData).values({
        planId: input.planId,
        moduleCode: 'MOD_D_PRODUCT_BUILD',
        structuredInputsJsonb: updatedPayload,
        aiThingsToConsiderJsonb: [],
        completionPercentage: nextProgress,
      });
    }

    await db
      .update(startupPlans)
      .set({
        currentModuleStep: 'MOD_D_STEP_1',
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(startupPlans.id, input.planId));

    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: true };
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(
      '[SPF Module D] Could not persist Step 1 Product Vehicle to Cloud SQL:',
      err instanceof Error ? err.message : err
    );
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }
}

/**

 */
export async function parkModuleDOpenQuestionAction(input: {
  planId: string;
  questionText: string;

  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(input.planId) || !input.questionText.trim()) {

    await db.insert(openQuestionsParkingLot).values({
      planId: input.planId,
      sourceModule: 'MOD_D_PRODUCT_BUILD',
      questionText: input.questionText.trim().slice(0, 1000),
      status: 'OPEN',
    });
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: true };
  } catch {
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }
}

        completionPercentage: nextProgress,
      });
    }

    await db
      .update(startupPlans)
      .set({
        currentModuleStep: 'MOD_D_STEP_5',
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(startupPlans.id, input.planId));

    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: true };
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(
      '[SPF Module D] Could not persist Step 5 Work Packages & Flow to Cloud SQL:',
      err instanceof Error ? err.message : err
    );
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }
}

/**
 * Persists Module D Step 6 (Constructive "Things to Consider" Blind-Spot Audit & Exportable Product Brief)
 * to `plan_modules_data` (`MOD_D_PRODUCT_BUILD`).
 */
export async function saveModuleDStep6BlindSpotAuditAction(input: {
  planId: string;
  blindSpotAudit: BlindSpotAuditStep6Data;
  completionPercentage?: number;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; persistedToCloudSql: boolean }> {
  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(input.planId)) {
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  const authCheck = await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(input.planId);
  if (!authCheck.authorized) {
    return { ok: false, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }

  try {
    await ensureModuleDEnumInPostgres();

    const existingMod = await db
      .select()
      .from(planModulesData)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(planModulesData.planId, input.planId),
          eq(planModulesData.moduleCode, 'MOD_D_PRODUCT_BUILD')
        )
      )
      .limit(1);

    const existingPayload = (existingMod[0]?.structuredInputsJsonb ??
      {}) as SavedModuleDData;

    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const updatedPayload: SavedModuleDData = {
      ...existingPayload,
      blindSpotAudit: {
        ...input.blindSpotAudit,
        lastSavedAt: nowIso,
      },
      lastSavedAt: nowIso,
    };

    const nextProgress = Math.max(
      existingMod[0]?.completionPercentage ?? 0,
      input.completionPercentage ?? 100
    );

    if (existingMod.length > 0) {
      await db
        .update(planModulesData)
        .set({
          structuredInputsJsonb: updatedPayload,
          completionPercentage: nextProgress,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(planModulesData.id, existingMod[0].id));
    } else {
      await db.insert(planModulesData).values({
        planId: input.planId,
        moduleCode: 'MOD_D_PRODUCT_BUILD',
        structuredInputsJsonb: updatedPayload,
        aiThingsToConsiderJsonb: [],
        completionPercentage: nextProgress,
      });
    }

    await db
      .update(startupPlans)
      .set({
        currentModuleStep: 'MOD_D_STEP_6',
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(startupPlans.id, input.planId));

    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: true };
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(
      '[SPF Module D] Could not persist Step 6 Blind-Spot Audit to Cloud SQL:',
      err instanceof Error ? err.message : err
    );
    return { ok: true, persistedToCloudSql: false };
  }
}

'use server';

import { db } from '@/db';
import { cohortInquiries, emailLogs } from '@/db/schema';
import { sql, desc, eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { checkRateLimit, getAdminSessionCookie } from '@/lib/auth/server-auth';

export interface SubmitCohortInquiryInput {
  name: string;
  email: string;
  organizationName: string;
  organizationType: string;
  customOrganizationType?: string | null;
  cohortSize: string;
  regionalFocus: string;
  targetStartDate?: string | null;
  goals?: string[];
  notes?: string | null;
}

export interface SubmitCohortInquiryResponse {
  ok: boolean;
  inquiryId?: string;
  error?: string;

const globalForCohort = globalThis as unknown as {
  spfCohortInquiriesTableEnsured?: boolean;
};

async function ensureTableReady() {
  if (globalForCohort.spfCohortInquiriesTableEnsured) return;
  try {
    await db.execute(sql`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cohort_inquiries (
        id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
        name text NOT NULL,
        email text NOT NULL,
        organization_name text NOT NULL,
        organization_type text NOT NULL,
        cohort_size text NOT NULL,
        regional_focus text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'IE_UK',
        target_start_date text,

        notes text,
        status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NEW',
        metadata_json jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
        created_at timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
        updated_at timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
      );
    `);
    globalForCohort.spfCohortInquiriesTableEnsured = true;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[Cohort Inquiry Action] Error ensuring cohort_inquiries table:', err);
  }
}

/**
 * Public server action to submit an inquiry for Preflight for Accelerators & Cohorts.
 * Performs server-side sanitization, rate limiting, database insertion, and admin notification email.
 */
export async function submitCohortInquiryAction(
  input: SubmitCohortInquiryInput
): Promise<SubmitCohortInquiryResponse> {
  const cleanName = (input.name || '').trim();
  const cleanEmail = (input.email || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const cleanOrgName = (input.organizationName || '').trim();
  const cleanOrgType = (input.organizationType || '').trim();
  const cleanCohortSize = (input.cohortSize || '').trim();
  const cleanRegionalFocus = (input.regionalFocus || 'IE_UK').trim();
  const cleanStartDate = (input.targetStartDate || '').trim();
  const cleanNotes = (input.notes || '').trim();
  const goals = Array.isArray(input.goals) ? input.goals : [];

  // Validation
  if (!cleanName) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Please enter your name.' };
  }
  if (!cleanEmail || !cleanEmail.includes('@') || !cleanEmail.includes('.')) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Please provide a valid work email address.' };
  }
  if (!cleanOrgName) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Please provide your organization or program name.' };
  }
  if (!cleanOrgType) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Please select an organization type.' };
  }
  if (!cleanCohortSize) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Please select your estimated cohort or batch size.' };
  }

  // Rate limiting: max 5 submissions per 10 minutes per IP/email
  const rateLimitKey = `cohort_inquiry:${cleanEmail}`;
  const rateLimit = checkRateLimit(rateLimitKey, 5, 10 * 60 * 1000);
  const globalLimit = checkRateLimit('cohort_inquiry:global', 25, 10 * 60 * 1000);
  if (!rateLimit.allowed || !globalLimit.allowed) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: 'You have submitted several inquiries recently. Please wait a few minutes before submitting again.',
    };
  }

  await ensureTableReady();

  const finalOrgType =
    cleanOrgType === 'OTHER' && input.customOrganizationType?.trim()
      ? `OTHER: ${input.customOrganizationType.trim()}`
      : cleanOrgType;

  let inquiryId = `ci-${Date.now()}`;

  try {
    const [inserted] = await db
      .insert(cohortInquiries)
      .values({
        name: cleanName,
        email: cleanEmail,
        organizationName: cleanOrgName,
        organizationType: finalOrgType,
        cohortSize: cleanCohortSize,
        regionalFocus: cleanRegionalFocus,
        targetStartDate: cleanStartDate || null,
        goalsJson: goals,
        notes: cleanNotes || null,
        status: 'NEW',
        metadataJson: {
          submittedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          source: 'COHORTS_PAGE',
        },
      })
      .returning({ id: cohortInquiries.id });

    if (inserted?.id) {
      inquiryId = inserted.id;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[Cohort Inquiry Action] Database insert error:', err);
    // Non-fatal if DB insert fails so lead notification can still fire
  }

  // Dispatch email notification to admin
  try {
    await sendAdminNotification({
      inquiryId,
      name: cleanName,
      email: cleanEmail,
      organizationName: cleanOrgName,
      organizationType: finalOrgType,
      cohortSize: cleanCohortSize,
      regionalFocus: cleanRegionalFocus,
      targetStartDate: cleanStartDate,
      goals,
      notes: cleanNotes,
    });
  } catch (emailErr) {
    console.error('[Cohort Inquiry Action] Email notification error:', emailErr);
  }

  return {
    ok: true,
    inquiryId,
  };
}

function escapeHtml(str: string): string {
  return str
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
}

export interface AdminCohortInquiryRecord {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  organizationName: string;
  organizationType: string;
  cohortSize: string;
  regionalFocus: string;
  targetStartDate: string | null;
  goals: string[];
  notes: string | null;
  status: 'NEW' | 'CONTACTED' | 'DEMO_SCHEDULED' | 'CONVERTED' | 'ARCHIVED';
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

/**
 * Super Admin: List all cohort & accelerator inquiries.
 */
export async function listCohortInquiriesAdminAction(): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  inquiries: AdminCohortInquiryRecord[];
  error?: string;
}> {
  try {
    const session = await getAdminSessionCookie();
    if (!session || session.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
      return { ok: false, inquiries: [], error: 'Unauthorized: Super Admin access required.' };
    }

    await ensureTableReady();

    const rows = await db
      .select()
      .from(cohortInquiries)
      .orderBy(desc(cohortInquiries.createdAt));

    const inquiries: AdminCohortInquiryRecord[] = rows.map((r) => ({
      id: r.id,
      name: r.name,
      email: r.email,
      organizationName: r.organizationName,
      organizationType: r.organizationType,
      cohortSize: r.cohortSize,
      regionalFocus: r.regionalFocus,
      targetStartDate: r.targetStartDate,
      goals: Array.isArray(r.goalsJson) ? (r.goalsJson as string[]) : [],
      notes: r.notes,
      status: (r.status as AdminCohortInquiryRecord['status']) || 'NEW',
      metadata: (r.metadataJson as Record<string, unknown>) || {},
      createdAt: r.createdAt.toISOString(),
      updatedAt: r.updatedAt.toISOString(),
    }));

    return { ok: true, inquiries };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[Cohort Inquiries Admin] List failed:', err);
    return { ok: false, inquiries: [], error: 'Failed to retrieve cohort inquiries.' };
  }
}

/**
 * Super Admin: Update status or internal notes on a cohort inquiry.
 */
export async function updateCohortInquiryStatusAdminAction(params: {
  inquiryId: string;
  status: AdminCohortInquiryRecord['status'];
  notes?: string;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const session = await getAdminSessionCookie();
    if (!session || session.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
      return { ok: false, error: 'Unauthorized: Super Admin access required.' };
    }

    await ensureTableReady();

    await db
      .update(cohortInquiries)
      .set({
        status: params.status,
        ...(params.notes !== undefined ? { notes: params.notes } : {}),
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(cohortInquiries.id, params.inquiryId));

    return { ok: true };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[Cohort Inquiries Admin] Update status failed:', err);
    return { ok: false, error: 'Failed to update cohort inquiry status.' };
  }
}

'use server';

import { db } from '@/db';
import { supportTickets, emailLogs, users, userEntitlements } from '@/db/schema';
import { sql, eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { getServerSessionCookie, checkRateLimit } from '@/lib/auth/server-auth';
import { resend, EMAIL_DEFAULTS } from '@/lib/email/resend';
import type {
  SupportTicketType,
  SupportTicketPriority,
  SupportModuleScope,
  SupportTicketSource,
  SupportTicketRecord,

export interface SubmitFeedbackInput {

  customTypeText?: string | null;

  stepContext?: string | null;

const globalForSupport = globalThis as unknown as {
  bmuSupportTicketsTableEnsured?: boolean;
