function normalizeMilestoneConfig(
  raw?: CohortMilestoneConfig | null,
  orgName?: string | null
): NonNullable<CohortMilestonePlanState['cohort']>['milestoneConfig'] {
  const defaultLabel = orgName?.toLowerCase().includes('google')
    ? 'Activate Google for Startups Cloud Credits'
    : 'Unlock Institutional Partner Milestone Reward';

  return {
    enabled: Boolean(raw?.enabled),
    rewardLabel: raw?.rewardLabel?.trim() || defaultLabel,
    requiredProgressPercent:
      typeof raw?.requiredProgressPercent === 'number' &&
      raw.requiredProgressPercent >= 10 &&
      raw.requiredProgressPercent <= 100
        ? raw.requiredProgressPercent
        : 50,
    requiredModules:
      Array.isArray(raw?.requiredModules) && raw.requiredModules.length > 0
        ? raw.requiredModules
        : [
            'MOD_A_IDEATION',
            'MOD_B_MARKET',
            'MOD_C_SURVEYS_FEEDBACK',
            'MOD_D_PRODUCT_BUILD',
          ],
    partnerNotificationEmails: Array.isArray(raw?.partnerNotificationEmails)
      ? raw.partnerNotificationEmails.filter(Boolean)
      : [],
    bccSuperAdmin: raw?.bccSuperAdmin !== false,
    requireOfficialDomain: raw?.requireOfficialDomain !== false,
    requireWorkEmail: raw?.requireWorkEmail !== false,
    instructionNotes: raw?.instructionNotes?.trim() || undefined,
  };
}

function cleanAndValidateDomain(rawDomain: string): {
  valid: boolean;
  cleanDomain: string;
  error?: string;
} {
  const trimmed = (rawDomain || '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/^https?:\/\//i, '')
    .replace(/^www\./i, '')
    .split('/')[0]
    .split('?')[0]
    .trim();

  if (!trimmed) {
    return {
      valid: false,
      cleanDomain: '',
      error: 'Please enter your official company domain (e.g., acme.ai or acme.ie).',
    };
  }

  // Basic domain syntax check with at least one dot and valid TLD
  const domainRegex =
    /^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?(?:\.[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?)+$/i;
  if (!domainRegex.test(trimmed) || trimmed.length < 4 || !trimmed.includes('.')) {
    return {
      valid: false,
      cleanDomain: trimmed,
      error:
        'Please enter a valid domain name (e.g., yourstartup.com, yourstartup.ie, or yourstartup.co.uk).',
    };
  }

  return { valid: true, cleanDomain: trimmed };
}

function validateCorporateWorkEmail(
  rawEmail: string,
  requireNonConsumer: boolean
): {
  valid: boolean;
  cleanEmail: string;
  isConsumerDomain: boolean;
  emailDomain: string;
  error?: string;
} {
  const cleanEmail = (rawEmail || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;

  if (!cleanEmail || !emailRegex.test(cleanEmail)) {
    return {
      valid: false,
      cleanEmail,
      isConsumerDomain: false,
      emailDomain: '',
      error: 'Please enter a valid email address.',
    };
  }

  const emailDomain = cleanEmail.split('@')[1] || '';
  const isConsumerDomain = CONSUMER_EMAIL_DOMAINS.has(emailDomain);

  if (requireNonConsumer && isConsumerDomain) {
    return {
      valid: false,
      cleanEmail,
      isConsumerDomain: true,
      emailDomain,
      error: `Institutional partners require an official @company domain email address rather than a personal @${emailDomain} address to provision startup credits.`,
    };
  }

  return {
    valid: true,
    cleanEmail,
    isConsumerDomain,
    emailDomain,
  };
}

/**
 * Fetches the active Cohort & Milestone Gate status for a founder's Startup Plan.
 */
export async function getCohortMilestoneStateForPlanAction(
  planId: string,
  clientFallback?: { cohortCode?: string; userEmail?: string }
): Promise<CohortMilestonePlanState> {
  try {
    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

    const authCheck = await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(planId);
    if (!authCheck.authorized && !authCheck.isLocalPreview) {
      return { ok: false, enrolledInCohort: false, error: 'Unauthorized' };
    }

    let planRow: (typeof startupPlans.$inferSelect) | undefined;
    if (planId && UUID_REGEX.test(planId)) {
      const [foundPlan] = await db
        .select()
        .from(startupPlans)
        .where(eq(startupPlans.id, planId))
        .limit(1);
      planRow = foundPlan;
    }

    let userRow: (typeof users.$inferSelect) | undefined;
    if (authCheck.userId && UUID_REGEX.test(authCheck.userId)) {
      const [foundUser] = await db
        .select()
        .from(users)
        .where(eq(users.id, authCheck.userId))
        .limit(1);
      userRow = foundUser;
    } else if (authCheck.email || clientFallback?.userEmail) {
      const targetEmail = (authCheck.email || clientFallback?.userEmail || '')
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase();
      if (targetEmail) {
        const [foundUser] = await db
          .select()
          .from(users)
          .where(eq(users.email, targetEmail))
          .limit(1);
        userRow = foundUser;
      }
    }

    // Resolve Cohort ID from plan -> user -> fallback inviteCode
    let resolvedCohortId = planRow?.cohortId || userRow?.cohortId || null;
    let cohortRow: (typeof cohorts.$inferSelect) | undefined;

    if (resolvedCohortId && UUID_REGEX.test(resolvedCohortId)) {
      const [foundCohort] = await db
        .select()
        .from(cohorts)
        .where(eq(cohorts.id, resolvedCohortId))
        .limit(1);
      cohortRow = foundCohort;
    }

    if (!cohortRow && clientFallback?.cohortCode) {
      const cleanCode = clientFallback.cohortCode.trim().toUpperCase();
      const cleanAlpha = cleanCode.replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/gi, '').toUpperCase();
      if (cleanCode) {
        const [foundByCode] = await db
          .select()
          .from(cohorts)
          .where(
            sql`UPPER(${cohorts.inviteCode}) = ${cleanCode} OR UPPER(REPLACE(${cohorts.inviteCode}, '-', '')) = ${cleanAlpha}`
          )
          .limit(1);
        cohortRow = foundByCode;
        if (cohortRow) {
          resolvedCohortId = cohortRow.id;
        }
      }
    }

    if (!cohortRow) {
      return { ok: true, enrolledInCohort: false };
    }

    // Auto-backfill planRow.cohortId if the user belongs to this cohort but the plan wasn't tagged yet
    if (planRow && !planRow.cohortId && resolvedCohortId) {
      try {
        await db
          .update(startupPlans)
          .set({ cohortId: resolvedCohortId, updatedAt: new Date() })
          .where(eq(startupPlans.id, planRow.id));
      } catch {
        // Non-fatal
      }
    }

    const milestoneConfig = normalizeMilestoneConfig(
      cohortRow.milestoneConfigJson,
      cohortRow.organizationName || cohortRow.name
    );

    const rawClaimData =
      planRow?.cohortMilestoneClaimDataJson &&
      typeof planRow.cohortMilestoneClaimDataJson === 'object' &&
      Object.keys(planRow.cohortMilestoneClaimDataJson as object).length > 0
        ? (planRow.cohortMilestoneClaimDataJson as CohortMilestoneClaimDossier)
        : null;

    const rawStatus = (planRow?.cohortMilestoneStatus || 'IN_PROGRESS') as
      | 'IN_PROGRESS'
      | 'ELIGIBLE_TO_CLAIM'
      | 'CLAIMED_PARTNER_NOTIFIED'
      | 'REWARD_ACTIVATED';

    return {
      ok: true,
      enrolledInCohort: true,
      cohort: {
        id: cohortRow.id,
        name: cohortRow.name,
        organizationName: cohortRow.organizationName || cohortRow.name,
        partnerLogoUrl: cohortRow.partnerLogoUrl || null,
        inviteCode: cohortRow.inviteCode,
        intakeType: cohortRow.intakeType || 'FIXED_BATCH',
        milestoneConfig,
      },
      claimState: {
        status: rawStatus,
        claimedAtIso: planRow?.cohortMilestoneClaimedAt
          ? planRow.cohortMilestoneClaimedAt.toISOString()
          : rawClaimData?.claimedAtIso || null,
        verifiedDomain:
          planRow?.verifiedCohortDomain || rawClaimData?.verifiedDomain || null,
        verifiedWorkEmail:
          planRow?.verifiedCohortWorkEmail ||
          rawClaimData?.verifiedWorkEmail ||
          null,
        dossier: rawClaimData,
      },
      prefilledDomain: planRow?.verifiedCohortDomain || undefined,
      prefilledWorkEmail:
        planRow?.verifiedCohortWorkEmail || userRow?.email || undefined,
    };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[Cohort Milestone State] Error:', err);
    return {
      ok: false,
      enrolledInCohort: false,
      error:
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : 'Failed to load cohort milestone status.',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Verifies that a founder's plan has passed the cohort milestone gate, validates their
 * official domain & work email, saves the claim dossier to PostgreSQL, and dispatches
 * the verification email to the partner organization (e.g., Google for Startups) + Super Admin.
 */
export async function claimCohortMilestoneRewardAction(input: {
  planId: string;
  verifiedDomain: string;
  verifiedWorkEmail: string;
  founderNotes?: string;
  clientFallback?: {
    cohortCode?: string;
    userEmail?: string;
    founderName?: string;
  };
  clientProgressSnapshot: {
    overallProgressPercent: number;
    moduleProgressMap: Record<string, number>;
    executiveSummary: CohortMilestoneExecutiveSummary;
  };
}): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  error?: string;
  dossier?: CohortMilestoneClaimDossier;
  isMockDev?: boolean;
}> {
  try {
    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

    const authCheck = await verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(input.planId);
    if (!authCheck.authorized && !authCheck.isLocalPreview) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        error: 'You must be signed in as the owner of this startup plan to claim cohort rewards.',
      };
    }

    const rateKey = `cohort:claim:${authCheck.userId || input.planId}`;
    const rateLimit = checkRateLimit(rateKey, 5, 60_000);
    if (!rateLimit.allowed) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        error: `Too many claim requests. Please wait ${rateLimit.retryAfterSeconds} seconds and try again.`,
      };
    }

    const stateRes = await getCohortMilestoneStateForPlanAction(input.planId, {
      cohortCode: input.clientFallback?.cohortCode,
      userEmail: input.clientFallback?.userEmail,
    });

    if (!stateRes.ok || !stateRes.enrolledInCohort || !stateRes.cohort) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        error:
          stateRes.error ||
          'This startup plan is not linked to an active institutional cohort.',
      };
    }

    const { cohort, claimState } = stateRes;
    const { milestoneConfig } = cohort;

    if (!milestoneConfig.enabled) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        error: 'Milestone reward claims are not currently enabled for this cohort.',
      };
    }

    if (
      claimState?.status === 'CLAIMED_PARTNER_NOTIFIED' ||
      claimState?.status === 'REWARD_ACTIVATED'
    ) {
      return {
        ok: true,
        dossier: claimState.dossier || undefined,
      };
    }

    // 1. Validate Official Company Domain if required
    let cleanDomain = (input.verifiedDomain || '').trim();
    if (milestoneConfig.requireOfficialDomain) {
      const domainCheck = cleanAndValidateDomain(cleanDomain);
      if (!domainCheck.valid) {
        return { ok: false, error: domainCheck.error };
      }
      cleanDomain = domainCheck.cleanDomain;
    } else if (cleanDomain) {
      const domainCheck = cleanAndValidateDomain(cleanDomain);
      cleanDomain = domainCheck.cleanDomain || cleanDomain;
    }

    // 2. Validate Official @company Work Email if required
    const emailCheck = validateCorporateWorkEmail(
      input.verifiedWorkEmail,
      milestoneConfig.requireWorkEmail
    );
    if (!emailCheck.valid) {
      return { ok: false, error: emailCheck.error };
    }
    const cleanWorkEmail = emailCheck.cleanEmail;

    // 3. Re-verify Milestone Progress & Required Modules (combining DB module rows & client snapshot)
    const mergedModuleProgress: Record<string, number> = {
      ...(input.clientProgressSnapshot?.moduleProgressMap || {}),
    };

    if (input.planId && UUID_REGEX.test(input.planId)) {
      const dbModRows = await db
        .select()
        .from(planModulesData)
        .where(eq(planModulesData.planId, input.planId));
      for (const row of dbModRows) {
        const dbPct = row.completionPercentage ?? 0;
        const currentPct = mergedModuleProgress[row.moduleCode] ?? 0;
        mergedModuleProgress[row.moduleCode] = Math.max(dbPct, currentPct);
      }
    }

    const requiredMods = milestoneConfig.requiredModules || [];
    const completedRequiredModules = requiredMods.filter(
      (modCode) => (mergedModuleProgress[modCode] ?? 0) >= 50
    );

    const overallProgressPercent = Math.max(
      input.clientProgressSnapshot?.overallProgressPercent || 0,
      requiredMods.length > 0
        ? Math.round(
            requiredMods.reduce(
              (sum, code) => sum + (mergedModuleProgress[code] ?? 0),
              0
            ) / requiredMods.length
          )
        : 0
    );

    if (overallProgressPercent < milestoneConfig.requiredProgressPercent) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        error: `Your plan is currently at ${overallProgressPercent}% milestone readiness, but ${cohort.organizationName} requires at least ${milestoneConfig.requiredProgressPercent}% completion before claiming ${milestoneConfig.rewardLabel}.`,
      };
    }

    if (completedRequiredModules.length < requiredMods.length) {
      const missing = requiredMods
        .filter((m) => !completedRequiredModules.includes(m))
        .map((m) => m.replace('MOD_', 'Module ').split('_')[0])
        .join(', ');
      return {
        ok: false,
        error: `Please complete at least 50% of all required modules (${missing}) before claiming ${milestoneConfig.rewardLabel}.`,
      };
    }

    // Resolve Founder Name & Account Email
    let founderName = input.clientFallback?.founderName?.trim() || 'Founder';
    let accountEmail =
      authCheck.email || input.clientFallback?.userEmail || cleanWorkEmail;

    if (authCheck.userId && UUID_REGEX.test(authCheck.userId)) {
      const [u] = await db
        .select()
        .from(users)
        .where(eq(users.id, authCheck.userId))
        .limit(1);
      if (u) {
        founderName = u.name || founderName;
        accountEmail = u.email || accountEmail;
      }
    }

    const partnerRecipients = Array.from(
      new Set(
        [
          ...(milestoneConfig.partnerNotificationEmails || []),
          ...(milestoneConfig.bccSuperAdmin !== false
            ? [EMAIL_DEFAULTS.replyTo || 'tom@startuppreflight.com']
            : []),
        ]
          .map((e) => e.trim().toLowerCase())
          .filter(Boolean)
      )
    );

    if (partnerRecipients.length === 0) {
      partnerRecipients.push(
        (EMAIL_DEFAULTS.replyTo || 'tom@startuppreflight.com').toLowerCase()
      );
    }

    const now = new Date();
    const dossier: CohortMilestoneClaimDossier = {
      claimedAtIso: now.toISOString(),
      claimedByName: founderName,
      claimedByAccountEmail: accountEmail,
      verifiedDomain: cleanDomain,
      verifiedWorkEmail: cleanWorkEmail,
      founderNotes: input.founderNotes?.trim() || undefined,
      cohortId: cohort.id,
      cohortName: cohort.name,
      organizationName: cohort.organizationName,
      inviteCode: cohort.inviteCode,
      rewardLabel: milestoneConfig.rewardLabel,
      overallProgressPercent,
      requiredProgressPercent: milestoneConfig.requiredProgressPercent,
      requiredModules: requiredMods,
      completedRequiredModules,
      moduleProgressMap: mergedModuleProgress,
      executiveSummary: input.clientProgressSnapshot.executiveSummary,
      partnerNotifiedEmails: partnerRecipients,
    };

    // 4. Dispatch Notification Email to Partner Team + Super Admin
    const partnerSubject = `[${cohort.organizationName}] Milestone Verified: ${dossier.executiveSummary.startupTitle} (${cleanDomain}) — ${milestoneConfig.rewardLabel}`;
    const partnerHtml = buildPartnerMilestoneNotificationHtml(dossier);

    let resendMessageId: string | null = null;
    let isMockDev = false;

    if (resend) {
      try {
        const sendRes = await resend.emails.send({
          from: EMAIL_DEFAULTS.notificationsFrom,
          to: partnerRecipients,
          replyTo: cleanWorkEmail,
          subject: partnerSubject,
          html: partnerHtml,
        });
        resendMessageId = sendRes.data?.id || null;

        await db.insert(emailLogs).values({
          recipient: partnerRecipients.join(', '),
          template: 'COHORT_MILESTONE_PARTNER_ALERT',
          subject: partnerSubject,
          status: sendRes.error ? 'FAILED' : 'SENT',
          resendId: resendMessageId,
          fromEmail: EMAIL_DEFAULTS.notificationsFrom,
          replyTo: cleanWorkEmail,
          errorMessage: sendRes.error?.message || null,
          metadataJson: {
            planId: input.planId,
            cohortId: cohort.id,
            inviteCode: cohort.inviteCode,
            verifiedDomain: cleanDomain,
            verifiedWorkEmail: cleanWorkEmail,
          },
        });
      } catch (emailErr) {
        console.error('[Cohort Milestone Claim] Partner email error:', emailErr);
      }
    } else {
      isMockDev = true;
      resendMessageId = `mock_cohort_claim_${Date.now()}`;
      try {
        await db.insert(emailLogs).values({
          recipient: partnerRecipients.join(', '),
          template: 'COHORT_MILESTONE_PARTNER_ALERT',
          subject: partnerSubject,
          status: 'MOCK_DEV',
          resendId: resendMessageId,
          fromEmail: EMAIL_DEFAULTS.notificationsFrom,
          replyTo: cleanWorkEmail,
          metadataJson: {
            isMockDev: true,
            planId: input.planId,
            cohortId: cohort.id,
            inviteCode: cohort.inviteCode,
            verifiedDomain: cleanDomain,
            verifiedWorkEmail: cleanWorkEmail,
          },
        });
      } catch {
        // Non-fatal
      }
    }

    dossier.resendMessageId = resendMessageId;

    // 5. Also dispatch confirmation receipt to the founder's verified work email
    const founderSubject = `✓ Claim Submitted: ${milestoneConfig.rewardLabel} (${cohort.organizationName})`;
    const founderHtml = buildFounderClaimReceiptHtml(
      dossier,
      milestoneConfig.instructionNotes
    );

    if (resend) {
      resend.emails
        .send({
          from: EMAIL_DEFAULTS.from,
          to: [cleanWorkEmail],
          replyTo: EMAIL_DEFAULTS.replyTo,
          subject: founderSubject,
          html: founderHtml,
        })
        .catch(() => {});
    }

    // 6. Persist Claim Status & Dossier on startup_plans
    if (input.planId && UUID_REGEX.test(input.planId)) {
      await db
        .update(startupPlans)
        .set({
          cohortId: cohort.id,
          cohortMilestoneStatus: 'CLAIMED_PARTNER_NOTIFIED',
          cohortMilestoneClaimedAt: now,
          verifiedCohortDomain: cleanDomain,
          verifiedCohortWorkEmail: cleanWorkEmail,
          cohortMilestoneClaimDataJson: dossier,
          updatedAt: now,
        })
        .where(eq(startupPlans.id, input.planId));
    }

    return {
      ok: true,
      dossier,
      isMockDev,
    };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[Claim Cohort Milestone] Error:', err);
    return {
      ok: false,
      error:
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : 'An unexpected error occurred while submitting your milestone claim.',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Ensures the global 'default' tenant exists in PostgreSQL before inserting users/plans.
 */
export async function ensureDefaultTenantId(): Promise<string> {
  const existing = await db
    .select()
    .from(tenants)
    .where(eq(tenants.slug, 'default'))
    .limit(1);

  if (existing.length > 0) {
    return existing[0].id;
  }

  const [created] = await db
    .insert(tenants)
    .values({
      slug: 'default',
      name: 'Startup Preflight Global',
      brandingJson: {
        primaryColor: '#4f46e5',
        accentColor: '#f59e0b',
      },
    })
    .returning();

  return created.id;
}

/**
 * Builds a complete BmuLocalSession from a database user row.
 */
async function buildSessionFromDbUser(
  dbUser: typeof users.$inferSelect
): Promise<BmuLocalSession> {
  await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

  const [entRow] = await db
    .select()
    .from(userEntitlements)
    .where(eq(userEntitlements.userId, dbUser.id))
    .limit(1);

  const userPlans = await db
    .select()
    .from(startupPlans)
    .where(eq(startupPlans.ownerUserId, dbUser.id))
    .orderBy(desc(startupPlans.createdAt));

  let userVouchers: Array<typeof vouchers.$inferSelect> = [];
  try {
    userVouchers = await db
      .select()
      .from(vouchers)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(vouchers.redeemedByUserId, dbUser.id),
          eq(vouchers.status, 'REDEEMED')
        )
      );
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[SPF Auth] Non-fatal error loading user vouchers:', err);
  }

  const mappedPlans: ActiveStartupPlan[] = [];

  for (const plan of userPlans) {
    const modRows = await db
      .select()
      .from(planModulesData)
      .where(eq(planModulesData.planId, plan.id));

    const modA = modRows.find((m) => m.moduleCode === 'MOD_A_IDEATION');
    const modB = modRows.find((m) => m.moduleCode === 'MOD_B_MARKET');
    const modC = modRows.find((m) => m.moduleCode === 'MOD_C_SURVEYS_FEEDBACK');
    const modD = modRows.find((m) => m.moduleCode === 'MOD_D_PRODUCT_BUILD');
    const modE = modRows.find((m) => m.moduleCode === 'MOD_E_OPERATIONS');
    const modF = modRows.find((m) => m.moduleCode === 'MOD_F_COFOUNDER_TEAM');
    const modG = modRows.find((m) => m.moduleCode === 'MOD_G_LAUNCHPAD');
    const modH = modRows.find((m) => m.moduleCode === 'MOD_H_REVENUE');
    const modI = modRows.find((m) => m.moduleCode === 'MOD_I_MARKETING');
    const modJ = modRows.find((m) => m.moduleCode === 'MOD_J_FINANCE');
    const modKGrants = modRows.find(
      (m) => m.moduleCode === 'MOD_K_GRANTS_FUNDING'
    );
    const modL = modRows.find(
      (m) =>
        m.moduleCode === 'MOD_L_BUSINESS_PLAN' ||
        (m.moduleCode as string) === 'MOD_K_BUSINESS_PLAN'

    const structuredInputs = (modA?.structuredInputsJsonb ?? {}) as {
      brainDumpText?: string;
      exportPotential?: 'DOMESTIC_ONLY' | 'EXPORTING_INTERNATIONALLY';
      conceptCanvas?: {
        coreProblem: string;
        targetCustomer: string;
        proposedSolution: string;
        unfairAdvantage: string;
        revenueAndGrantFit: string;
        lastSynthesizedAt?: string;

      };
      founderMotivation?: SavedFounderMotivation;
      teamAndBudget?: SavedTeamAndBudget;
      founderRealityCheck?: SavedFounderRealityCheck;
      grantEligibilityCheck?: SavedGrantEligibilityCheck;
      masterDocumentData?: SavedMasterDocumentData;
    };

    const modBInputs = (modB?.structuredInputsJsonb ?? {}) as SavedModuleBData;
    const modCInputs = (modC?.structuredInputsJsonb ?? {}) as SavedModuleCData;
    const modDInputs = (modD?.structuredInputsJsonb ?? {}) as SavedModuleDData;
    const modEInputs = (modE?.structuredInputsJsonb ?? {}) as SavedModuleEData;
    const modFInputs = (modF?.structuredInputsJsonb ?? {}) as SavedModuleFData;
    const modGInputs = (modG?.structuredInputsJsonb ?? {}) as SavedModuleGData;
    const modHInputs = (modH?.structuredInputsJsonb ?? {}) as SavedModuleHData;
    const modIInputs = (modI?.structuredInputsJsonb ?? {}) as SavedModuleIData;
    const modJInputs = (modJ?.structuredInputsJsonb ?? {}) as SavedModuleJData;

      for (const row of dbSurveyRows) {

          .select()
          .from(surveyResponses)

        const mappedDbResponses: Array<

            isSimulated?: boolean;
            clientResponseId?: string;
          } & Record<string, SurveyResponseAnswerValue>;

          const answersMap =
            rawAns.answers && typeof rawAns.answers === 'object'
              ? rawAns.answers
              : (rawAns as Record<string, SurveyResponseAnswerValue>);

          return {
            id: r.id,
            surveyId: r.surveyId,
            answers: answersMap,
            respondentNameOrRole:
              typeof rawAns.respondentNameOrRole === 'string'
                ? rawAns.respondentNameOrRole
                : undefined,
            respondentEmail: r.respondentEmail || undefined,
            joinedWaitlist: r.joinedWaitlist,
            isSimulated: Boolean(rawAns.isSimulated),
            submittedAt: r.submittedAt.toISOString(),
            clientResponseId:
              typeof rawAns.clientResponseId === 'string'

        const rowMeta = (row.outreachTemplatesJsonb || {}) as Partial<SurveyOutreachTemplates> & {
          isPublished?: boolean;

        const isPublished =

                lastGeneratedAt: rowMeta.lastGeneratedAt,
              }
            : undefined;

        mergedSurveysBySlug.set(row.publicSlug, {

          title:
            row.title === 'Untitled Customer Survey' && existingInMod?.title
              ? existingInMod.title
              : row.title === 'Untitled Customer Survey'
                ? ''
                : row.title,
          introDescription:
            existingInMod?.introDescription || row.introDescription || '',
          isActive: row.isActive,
          isPublished,
          publishedAt,
          collectLeadEmails: row.collectLeadEmails,
          waitlistIncentiveText:
            existingInMod?.waitlistIncentiveText ||
            row.waitlistIncentiveText ||
            '',
          focusAreas: existingInMod?.focusAreas || [
            'PROBLEM_AND_PAIN',
            'CURRENT_WORKAROUNDS',
          ],
          otherFocusAreaText: existingInMod?.otherFocusAreaText || '',
          customAiFocusPrompt: existingInMod?.customAiFocusPrompt || '',
          questions: chosenQuestions,
          responses: mergedResponses,
          outreachTemplates:
            existingInMod?.outreachTemplates || dbOutreachTemplates,
          interviewLogs:
            existingInMod?.interviewLogs ||
            (Array.isArray(row.interviewLogsJsonb)
              ? (row.interviewLogsJsonb as SavedCustomerInterviewLog[])
              : []),
          aiInsightsSummary: existingInMod?.aiInsightsSummary || dbInsights,
          createdAt: existingInMod?.createdAt || row.createdAt.toISOString(),
          updatedAt: existingInMod?.updatedAt || row.createdAt.toISOString(),

    } catch (err) {

    const explicitSlugsInModC = new Set(

        .from(openQuestionsParkingLot)
        .where(eq(openQuestionsParkingLot.planId, plan.id));

      fundingTrackMode:

      currentModuleStep: plan.currentModuleStep || 'MOD_A_STEP_1',
      isPivot: Boolean(plan.parentPlanId),
      brainDumpText: structuredInputs.brainDumpText || plan.oneLinerSummary || '',

      founderRealityCheck: structuredInputs.founderRealityCheck
        ? {
            ...structuredInputs.founderRealityCheck,
            dealbreakers: Array.isArray(
              structuredInputs.founderRealityCheck.dealbreakers
            )
              ? structuredInputs.founderRealityCheck.dealbreakers
              : [],
          }
        : undefined,
      grantEligibilityCheck: structuredInputs.grantEligibilityCheck,
      thingsToConsider: Array.isArray(modA?.aiThingsToConsiderJsonb)
        ? modA.aiThingsToConsiderJsonb
        : undefined,
      moduleBData: modB
        ? {
            ...modBInputs,
            thingsToConsider: Array.isArray(modB.aiThingsToConsiderJsonb)
              ? modB.aiThingsToConsiderJsonb
              : modBInputs.thingsToConsider,
          }
        : undefined,
      moduleCData: hasModCData
        ? {
            ...modCInputs,
            surveys: finalSurveys,
            activeSurveyId: resolvedActiveSurveyId,
            interviewLogs: finalInterviewLogs,
            thingsToConsider: Array.isArray(modC?.aiThingsToConsiderJsonb)
              ? modC.aiThingsToConsiderJsonb
              : modCInputs.thingsToConsider,
          }
        : undefined,
      moduleDData: modD
        ? {
            ...modDInputs,
            thingsToConsider: Array.isArray(modD.aiThingsToConsiderJsonb)
              ? modD.aiThingsToConsiderJsonb
              : modDInputs.thingsToConsider,
          }
        : undefined,
      moduleEData: modE
        ? {
            ...modEInputs,
            thingsToConsider: Array.isArray(modE.aiThingsToConsiderJsonb)
              ? modE.aiThingsToConsiderJsonb
              : modEInputs.thingsToConsider,
          }
        : undefined,
      moduleFData: modF
        ? {
            ...modFInputs,
            completionPercentage:
              modF.completionPercentage ?? modFInputs.completionPercentage,
            thingsToConsider: Array.isArray(modF.aiThingsToConsiderJsonb)
              ? modF.aiThingsToConsiderJsonb
              : modFInputs.thingsToConsider,
          }
        : undefined,
      moduleGData: modG
        ? {
            ...modGInputs,
            completionPercentage:
              modG.completionPercentage ?? modGInputs.completionPercentage,
            thingsToConsider: Array.isArray(modG.aiThingsToConsiderJsonb)
              ? modG.aiThingsToConsiderJsonb
              : modGInputs.thingsToConsider,
          }
        : undefined,
      moduleHData: modH
        ? {
            ...modHInputs,
            completionPercentage:
              modH.completionPercentage ?? modHInputs.completionPercentage,
            thingsToConsider: Array.isArray(modH.aiThingsToConsiderJsonb)
              ? modH.aiThingsToConsiderJsonb
              : modHInputs.thingsToConsider,
          }
        : undefined,
      moduleIData: modI
        ? {
            ...modIInputs,
            completionPercentage:
              modI.completionPercentage ?? modIInputs.completionPercentage,
            thingsToConsider: Array.isArray(modI.aiThingsToConsiderJsonb)
              ? modI.aiThingsToConsiderJsonb
              : modIInputs.thingsToConsider,
          }
        : undefined,
      moduleJData: modJ
        ? {
            ...modJInputs,
            completionPercentage:
              modJ.completionPercentage ?? modJInputs.completionPercentage,
            thingsToConsider: Array.isArray(modJ.aiThingsToConsiderJsonb)
              ? modJ.aiThingsToConsiderJsonb
              : modJInputs.thingsToConsider,
          }
        : undefined,
      moduleKData: modKGrants
        ? {
            ...modKGrantsInputs,
            completionPercentage:
              modKGrants.completionPercentage ??
              modKGrantsInputs.completionPercentage,
            thingsToConsider: Array.isArray(modKGrants.aiThingsToConsiderJsonb)
              ? modKGrants.aiThingsToConsiderJsonb
              : modKGrantsInputs.thingsToConsider,
          }
        : undefined,
      moduleLData: modL
        ? {
            ...modLInputs,
            step1Mode: modLInputs.step1Mode,
            step2Audit: modLInputs.step2Audit,
            step3Compiler: modLInputs.step3Compiler,
            step4Appendices: modLInputs.step4Appendices,
            step5DossierBrief: modLInputs.step5DossierBrief,
            versions: modLInputs.versions,
            activeVersionId: modLInputs.activeVersionId,
            completionPercentage:

            thingsToConsider: Array.isArray(modL.aiThingsToConsiderJsonb)

  let cohortCode: string | undefined;
  if (dbUser.cohortId) {
    try {
      const [cohortRow] = await db
        .select({ inviteCode: cohorts.inviteCode })
        .from(cohorts)
        .where(eq(cohorts.id, dbUser.cohortId))
        .limit(1);
      if (cohortRow) {
        cohortCode = cohortRow.inviteCode;
      }
    } catch {
      // Non-fatal
    }
  }

  const profile = dbUser.founderProfileJson || {};
  const freeDefaults = calculatePassLimits('FREE_HOOK');

  const entitlement: EntitlementSnapshot = entRow
    ? {
        userId: dbUser.id,
        planType: entRow.planType,
        stackedCodesCount: entRow.stackedCodesCount,
        maxStartupPlans: entRow.maxStartupPlans,
        maxSeatsPerPlan: entRow.maxSeatsPerPlan,
        monthlyAiCreditsLimit: entRow.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
        aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: entRow.aiCreditsUsedThisMonth,
        whiteLabelExportEnabled: entRow.whiteLabelExportEnabled,
        // Never transmit raw or encrypted BYOK key material to the browser
        customApiKeyEncrypted: entRow.customApiKeyEncrypted
          ? 'enc_gemini_byok_active'
          : null,
        accessExpiresAt: entRow.accessExpiresAt,
        isVaultReadonly: entRow.isVaultReadonly,
      }
    : {
        userId: dbUser.id,
        planType: 'FREE_HOOK',
        stackedCodesCount: 0,
        maxStartupPlans: freeDefaults.maxStartupPlans,
        maxSeatsPerPlan: freeDefaults.maxSeatsPerPlan,
        monthlyAiCreditsLimit: freeDefaults.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
        aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: 0,
        whiteLabelExportEnabled: false,
        isVaultReadonly: false,
      };

  return {
    user: {
      id: dbUser.id,
      name: dbUser.name,
      email: dbUser.email,
      role: dbUser.role,
      cohortCode,
      founderStage: (profile.founderStage as FounderStage) || undefined,
      teamStructure: (profile.teamStructure as TeamStructure) || undefined,
      primaryHat: profile.primaryHat || undefined,
      regionOrCounty: profile.regionOrCounty || undefined,
      onboardingCompleted: mappedPlans.length > 0,
    },
    entitlement,
    redeemedCodes: userVouchers.map((v) => v.code),
    plans: mappedPlans,
    activePlanId:
      typeof profile.lastActivePlanId === 'string' &&
      mappedPlans.some((p) => p.id === profile.lastActivePlanId)
        ? profile.lastActivePlanId
        : mappedPlans[0]?.id || '',
  };
}

/**
 * Persists the user's active plan selection to their profile in Cloud SQL PostgreSQL.
 */
export async function setActivePlanServerAction(planId: string): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const cookiePayload = await getServerSessionCookie();
    if (!cookiePayload || !planId?.trim()) return;

    const [dbUser] = await db
      .select({ id: users.id, founderProfileJson: users.founderProfileJson })
      .from(users)
      .where(eq(users.id, cookiePayload.userId))
      .limit(1);

    if (!dbUser) return;

    const existingProfile =
      (dbUser.founderProfileJson as Record<string, unknown>) || {};
    await db
      .update(users)
      .set({
        founderProfileJson: {
          ...existingProfile,
          lastActivePlanId: planId.trim(),
        },
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(users.id, dbUser.id));
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[SPF Auth] Non-fatal error persisting active plan to DB:', err);
  }
}

/**
 * Registers a new founder in Cloud SQL PostgreSQL with hashed password and entitlement row.
 */
export async function registerFounderAction(input: {
  name: string;
  email: string;
  password: string;
  voucherOrCohortCode?: string;
  acceptedTerms?: boolean;
}): Promise<AuthActionResult> {
  const cleanEmail = input.email.trim().toLowerCase();
  const cleanName = input.name.trim() || 'New Founder';
  const cleanCode = input.voucherOrCohortCode?.trim().toUpperCase() || '';

  if (!input.acceptedTerms) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error:
        'Please agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy before creating your account.',
      mode: 'cloud_sql',
    };
  }

  if (!cleanEmail || !input.password || input.password.length < 6) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: 'Please enter a valid email and a password of at least 6 characters.',
      mode: 'cloud_sql',
    };
  }

  const rateLimit = checkRateLimit(`auth:register:${cleanEmail}`, 5, 10 * 60_000);
  if (!rateLimit.allowed) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: `Too many registration attempts. Please wait ${rateLimit.retryAfterSeconds} seconds and try again.`,
      mode: 'cloud_sql',
    };
  }

  try {
    const tenantId = await ensureDefaultTenantId();

    const existing = await db
      .select()
      .from(users)
      .where(eq(users.email, cleanEmail))
      .limit(1);

    if (existing.length > 0) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        error:
          'An account with this email already exists. Please sign in instead.',
        mode: 'cloud_sql',
      };
    }

    let matchedCohort: (typeof cohorts.$inferSelect) | null = null;
    let matchedVoucher: (typeof vouchers.$inferSelect) | null = null;

    if (cleanCode) {
      await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();
      const cleanAlpha = cleanCode.replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/gi, '').toUpperCase();

      // 1. Check Institutional Cohort (exact match or hyphen-agnostic match)
      const [foundCohort] = await db
        .select()
        .from(cohorts)
        .where(
          sql`UPPER(${cohorts.inviteCode}) = ${cleanCode} OR UPPER(REPLACE(${cohorts.inviteCode}, '-', '')) = ${cleanAlpha}`
        )
        .limit(1);

      if (foundCohort) {
        if (
          foundCohort.expiresAt &&
          new Date(foundCohort.expiresAt).getTime() < Date.now()
        ) {
          return {
            ok: false,
            error: `Institutional cohort code "${cleanCode}" has expired.`,
            mode: 'cloud_sql',
          };
        }
        if (foundCohort.seatsUsed >= foundCohort.maxSeats) {
          return {
            ok: false,
            error: `Cohort "${foundCohort.name}" has reached its maximum capacity (${foundCohort.maxSeats} seats). Please contact your program administrator.`,
            mode: 'cloud_sql',
          };
        }
        matchedCohort = foundCohort;
      } else {
        // 2. Check Single-Use Voucher (exact match or hyphen-agnostic match)
        const [foundVoucher] = await db
          .select()
          .from(vouchers)
          .where(
            sql`UPPER(${vouchers.code}) = ${cleanCode} OR UPPER(REPLACE(${vouchers.code}, '-', '')) = ${cleanAlpha}`
          )
          .limit(1);

        if (!foundVoucher) {
          return {
            ok: false,
            error: `Invalid voucher or cohort code "${cleanCode}". Please check your code or leave it blank to start on the Free tier.`,
            mode: 'cloud_sql',
          };
        }
        if (foundVoucher.status === 'REDEEMED') {
          return {
            ok: false,
            error: `This voucher code (${cleanCode}) has already been redeemed by another account. Individual voucher codes are single-use. If you are part of an accelerator or testing cohort, please use your shared cohort invite code.`,
            mode: 'cloud_sql',
          };
        }
        if (foundVoucher.status !== 'UNCLAIMED') {
          return {
            ok: false,
            error: `Voucher ${cleanCode} has been revoked or is no longer valid.`,
            mode: 'cloud_sql',
          };
        }
        matchedVoucher = foundVoucher;
      }
    }

    const cohortId: string | null = matchedCohort ? matchedCohort.id : null;
    const passwordHash = hashPassword(input.password);

    const [createdUser] = await db
      .insert(users)
      .values({
        tenantId,
        cohortId,
        email: cleanEmail,
        name: cleanName,
        passwordHash,
        emailVerified: true,
        role: 'FOUNDER',
        status: 'ACTIVE',
        founderProfileJson: {
          termsAcceptedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          termsVersion: '2026-04',
        },
      })
      .returning();

    if (matchedCohort) {
      const durationMonths = matchedCohort.accessDurationMonths || 6;
      const cohortLimits = calculatePassLimits('COHORT_PASS', durationMonths);
      await db.insert(userEntitlements).values({
        userId: createdUser.id,
        planType: 'COHORT_PASS',
        stackedCodesCount: 0,
        maxStartupPlans: cohortLimits.maxStartupPlans,
        maxSeatsPerPlan: cohortLimits.maxSeatsPerPlan,
        monthlyAiCreditsLimit: cohortLimits.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
        aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: 0,
        whiteLabelExportEnabled: false,
        accessExpiresAt:
          matchedCohort.expiresAt || cohortLimits.accessExpiresAt,
        isVaultReadonly: false,
      });

      await db
        .update(cohorts)
        .set({ seatsUsed: sql`${cohorts.seatsUsed} + 1` })
        .where(eq(cohorts.id, matchedCohort.id));
    } else if (matchedVoucher) {
      const rewardType = matchedVoucher.rewardType || 'APPSUMO_LTD';
      const durationMonths = matchedVoucher.durationMonths || 6;

      if (rewardType === 'APPSUMO_LTD') {
        const sumoLimits = calculateAppSumoTierLimits(1);
        await db.insert(userEntitlements).values({
          userId: createdUser.id,
          planType: 'APPSUMO_LTD',
          stackedCodesCount: 1,
          maxStartupPlans: sumoLimits.maxStartupPlans,
          maxSeatsPerPlan: sumoLimits.maxSeatsPerPlan,
          monthlyAiCreditsLimit: sumoLimits.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
          aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: 0,
          whiteLabelExportEnabled: sumoLimits.whiteLabelExportEnabled,
          isVaultReadonly: false,
        });
      } else {
        const passType =
          rewardType === 'PASS_COFOUNDER'
            ? 'SIX_MONTH_COFOUNDER'
            : 'SIX_MONTH_SOLO';
        const passLimits = calculatePassLimits(passType, durationMonths);
        await db.insert(userEntitlements).values({
          userId: createdUser.id,
          planType: passType,
          stackedCodesCount: 0,
          maxStartupPlans: passLimits.maxStartupPlans,
          maxSeatsPerPlan: passLimits.maxSeatsPerPlan,
          monthlyAiCreditsLimit: passLimits.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
          aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: 0,
          whiteLabelExportEnabled: false,
          accessExpiresAt: passLimits.accessExpiresAt,
          isVaultReadonly: false,
        });
      }

      await db
        .update(vouchers)
        .set({
          status: 'REDEEMED',
          redeemedByUserId: createdUser.id,
          redeemedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(vouchers.id, matchedVoucher.id));
    } else {
      const freeLimits = calculatePassLimits('FREE_HOOK');
      await db.insert(userEntitlements).values({
        userId: createdUser.id,
        planType: 'FREE_HOOK',
        stackedCodesCount: 0,
        maxStartupPlans: freeLimits.maxStartupPlans,
        maxSeatsPerPlan: freeLimits.maxSeatsPerPlan,
        monthlyAiCreditsLimit: freeLimits.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
        aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: 0,
        whiteLabelExportEnabled: false,
        isVaultReadonly: false,
      });
    }

    await setServerSessionCookie({
      userId: createdUser.id,
      email: createdUser.email,
    });

    const now = new Date();
    const activatedDateStr = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-IE', {
      dateStyle: 'long',
    }).format(now);

    let emailTierName = 'Free Hook (Module A)';
    let emailValidUntilStr: string | undefined;
    let emailMaxPlans: number | undefined;
    let emailMaxSeats: number | undefined;
    let emailAiCredits: number | undefined;

    if (matchedCohort) {
      const durationMonths = matchedCohort.accessDurationMonths || 6;
      const cohortLimits = calculatePassLimits('COHORT_PASS', durationMonths);
      const cohortExpires =
        matchedCohort.expiresAt || cohortLimits.accessExpiresAt;
      emailTierName = `${matchedCohort.name} Cohort Pass`;
      emailValidUntilStr = cohortExpires
        ? new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-IE', { dateStyle: 'long' }).format(cohortExpires)
        : 'Active Cohort Term';
      emailMaxPlans = cohortLimits.maxStartupPlans;
      emailMaxSeats = cohortLimits.maxSeatsPerPlan;
      emailAiCredits = cohortLimits.monthlyAiCreditsLimit;
    } else if (matchedVoucher) {
      const rewardType = matchedVoucher.rewardType || 'APPSUMO_LTD';
      const durationMonths = matchedVoucher.durationMonths || 6;
      if (rewardType === 'APPSUMO_LTD') {
        const sumoLimits = calculateAppSumoTierLimits(1);
        emailTierName = sumoLimits.tierName;
        emailValidUntilStr = 'Lifetime Access (Never Expires)';
        emailMaxPlans = sumoLimits.maxStartupPlans;
        emailMaxSeats = sumoLimits.maxSeatsPerPlan;
        emailAiCredits = sumoLimits.monthlyAiCreditsLimit;
      } else {
        const passType =
          rewardType === 'PASS_COFOUNDER'
            ? 'SIX_MONTH_COFOUNDER'
            : 'SIX_MONTH_SOLO';
        const passLimits = calculatePassLimits(passType, durationMonths);
        emailTierName =
          rewardType === 'PASS_COFOUNDER'
            ? `Partner Co-Founder Pass (${durationMonths} Months)`
            : `Partner Solo Pass (${durationMonths} Months)`;
        emailValidUntilStr = passLimits.accessExpiresAt
          ? new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-IE', { dateStyle: 'long' }).format(passLimits.accessExpiresAt)
          : `${durationMonths} Months`;
        emailMaxPlans = passLimits.maxStartupPlans;
        emailMaxSeats = passLimits.maxSeatsPerPlan;
        emailAiCredits = passLimits.monthlyAiCreditsLimit;
      }
    }

    // Fire asynchronous Welcome Email via Resend without blocking registration
    sendSystemEmail({
      to: createdUser.email,
      replyTo: 'Tom@startuppreflight.com',
      template: 'WELCOME_FOUNDER',
      subject: matchedVoucher || matchedCohort
        ? `Pass Activated: Welcome to Startup Preflight — ${emailTierName}`
        : 'Welcome to Startup Preflight — Your Founder Workspace is Ready',
      props: {
        founderName: createdUser.name || undefined,
        loginEmail: createdUser.email,
        loginUrl: `${EMAIL_DEFAULTS.appUrl}/workspace`,
        tierName: emailTierName,
        hqCountry: 'IE',
        activatedDate: activatedDateStr,
        validUntilDate: emailValidUntilStr,
        voucherCode: cleanCode || undefined,
        maxPlans: emailMaxPlans,
        maxSeats: emailMaxSeats,
        aiCreditsMonthly: emailAiCredits,
      },
      metadata: {
        userId: createdUser.id,
        trigger: 'REGISTRATION',
        cohortId: cohortId,
        inviteCode: cleanCode || undefined,
      },
    }).catch((emailErr) => {
      console.error('[SPF Email] Failed to send welcome email upon registration:', emailErr);
    });

    const session = await buildSessionFromDbUser(createdUser);
    return {
      ok: true,
      mode: 'cloud_sql',
      session,
    };
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(
      '[SPF Auth] PostgreSQL unreachable during register; using local fallback:',
      err instanceof Error ? err.message : err
    );
    await setServerSessionCookie({
      userId: 'local-founder-session',
      email: cleanEmail,
    });
    return {
      ok: true,
      mode: 'local_fallback',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Authenticates a founder against Cloud SQL PostgreSQL using email & password.
 */
export async function loginFounderAction(input: {
  email: string;
  password: string;
}): Promise<AuthActionResult> {
  const cleanEmail = input.email.trim().toLowerCase();

  const rateLimit = checkRateLimit(`auth:login:${cleanEmail}`, 8, 10 * 60_000);
  if (!rateLimit.allowed) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: `Too many sign-in attempts. Please wait ${rateLimit.retryAfterSeconds} seconds before trying again.`,
      mode: 'cloud_sql',
    };
  }

  try {
    const [foundUser] = await db
      .select()
      .from(users)
      .where(eq(users.email, cleanEmail))
      .limit(1);

    if (!foundUser) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        error:
          'No account found with that email address. Create a new founder account first.',
        mode: 'cloud_sql',
      };
    }

    if (foundUser.status === 'SUSPENDED') {
      return {
        ok: false,
        error: `Account suspended: ${foundUser.suspensionReason || 'Contact support.'}`,
        mode: 'cloud_sql',
      };
    }

    if (foundUser.status === 'SOFT_DELETED') {
      return {
        ok: false,
        error:
          'This account has been deactivated and moved to trash. Please contact support to restore your account.',
        mode: 'cloud_sql',
      };
    }

    // Verify password hash strictly. Never allow unauthenticated password overwrite on Google OAuth accounts.
    if (foundUser.passwordHash) {
      const isValid = verifyPassword(input.password, foundUser.passwordHash);
      if (!isValid) {
        return {
          ok: false,
          error: 'Invalid email or password. Please try again.',
          mode: 'cloud_sql',
        };
      }
    } else if (
      process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production' &&
      (cleanEmail.endsWith('@startuppreflight.com') ||
        cleanEmail.endsWith('@buildmyunicorn.com') ||
        cleanEmail.endsWith('@example.com'))
    ) {
      // Only allow upgrading seeded demo user rows in local development
      const upgradedHash = hashPassword(input.password);
      await db
        .update(users)
        .set({ passwordHash: upgradedHash, lastActiveAt: new Date() })
        .where(eq(users.id, foundUser.id));
    } else {
      return {
        ok: false,
        error:
          'This account was created with Google Sign-In. Please click "Continue with Google" above, or use "Forgot Password" to set a password.',
        mode: 'cloud_sql',
      };
    }

    await db
      .update(users)
      .set({ lastActiveAt: new Date() })
      .where(eq(users.id, foundUser.id));

    await setServerSessionCookie({
      userId: foundUser.id,
      email: foundUser.email,
    });

    const session = await buildSessionFromDbUser(foundUser);
    return {
      ok: true,
      mode: 'cloud_sql',
      session,
    };
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(
      '[SPF Auth] PostgreSQL unreachable during login; using local fallback:',
      err instanceof Error ? err.message : err
    );
    await setServerSessionCookie({
      userId: 'local-founder-session',
      email: cleanEmail,
    });
    return {
      ok: true,
      mode: 'local_fallback',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Saves the 60-Second Founder Onboarding profile and creates the first Startup Plan in Cloud SQL.
 */
export async function completeOnboardingAction(input: {
  founderStage: FounderStage;
  teamStructure: TeamStructure;
  primaryHat: StartupHat;
  regionOrCounty: string;
  planTitle: string;
  oneLinerSummary: string;
  hqCountryCode: SupportedCountryCode;
  industryCategory: IndustryCategory;
  exportPotential: 'DOMESTIC_ONLY' | 'EXPORTING_INTERNATIONALLY';
  fundingTrackMode?: 'GRANT_AND_INVESTOR' | 'COMMERCIAL_ONLY';
}): Promise<AuthActionResult> {
  try {
    const cookiePayload = await getServerSessionCookie();
    if (!cookiePayload) {
      return {
        ok: true,
        mode: 'local_fallback',
      };
    }

    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

    const [dbUser] = await db
      .select()
      .from(users)
      .where(eq(users.id, cookiePayload.userId))
      .limit(1);

    if (!dbUser) {
      return {
        ok: true,
        mode: 'local_fallback',
      };
    }

    const countryPack = getCountryRulePack(input.hqCountryCode);
    const isGrantRegion =
      input.hqCountryCode === 'IE' || input.hqCountryCode === 'GB';
    const resolvedTrack: 'GRANT_AND_INVESTOR' | 'COMMERCIAL_ONLY' = isGrantRegion
      ? input.fundingTrackMode === 'COMMERCIAL_ONLY'
        ? 'COMMERCIAL_ONLY'
        : 'GRANT_AND_INVESTOR'
      : 'COMMERCIAL_ONLY';
    const targetMarkets =
      input.exportPotential === 'EXPORTING_INTERNATIONALLY'
        ? Array.from(new Set([input.hqCountryCode, 'GB', 'EU', 'US']))
        : [input.hqCountryCode];

    const [updatedUser] = await db
      .update(users)
      .set({
        founderProfileJson: {
          founderStage: input.founderStage,
          teamStructure: input.teamStructure,
          primaryHat: input.primaryHat,
          regionOrCounty: input.regionOrCounty.trim(),
        },
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(users.id, dbUser.id))
      .returning();

    const cleanTitle = input.planTitle.trim() || 'My First Startup Plan';
    const cleanSummary = input.oneLinerSummary.trim();

    const [createdPlan] = await db
      .insert(startupPlans)
      .values({
        ownerUserId: dbUser.id,
        tenantId: dbUser.tenantId,
        cohortId: dbUser.cohortId,
        title: cleanTitle,
        oneLinerSummary: cleanSummary,
        industryCategory: input.industryCategory,
        hqCountryCode: input.hqCountryCode,
        baseCurrency: countryPack.defaultCurrency,
        targetMarketsArray: targetMarkets,
        grantComplianceMetadataJson: {
          fundingTrackMode: resolvedTrack,
        },
        currentModuleStep: 'MOD_A_STEP_1',
        status: 'ACTIVE',
      })
      .returning();

    const initialTeamType =
      input.teamStructure === 'CO_FOUNDERS'
        ? 'COFOUNDER_TEAM'
        : input.teamStructure === 'LOOKING_FOR_COFOUNDER'
          ? 'SEEKING_COFOUNDER'
          : 'SOLO_FOUNDER';

    await db.insert(planModulesData).values({
      planId: createdPlan.id,
      moduleCode: 'MOD_A_IDEATION',
      structuredInputsJsonb: {
        brainDumpText: cleanSummary,
        exportPotential: input.exportPotential,
        fundingTrackMode: resolvedTrack,
        teamAndBudget: {
          teamStructureType: initialTeamType,
          skillCoverage: 'BUILD_IN_HOUSE',
          startingBudgetBracket: '1K_TO_5K',
          teamAndFundingNotes: '',
        },
      },
      aiThingsToConsiderJsonb: [],
      completionPercentage: cleanSummary ? 15 : 0,
    });

    const session = await buildSessionFromDbUser(updatedUser);
    return {
      ok: true,
      mode: 'cloud_sql',
      session,
    };
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(
      '[SPF Auth] PostgreSQL unreachable during onboarding; using local fallback:',
      err instanceof Error ? err.message : err
    );
    return {
      ok: true,
      mode: 'local_fallback',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Fetches the active Cloud SQL session if an HTTP-only session cookie is present.
 */
export async function getCurrentCloudSessionAction(): Promise<{
  dbConnected: boolean;
  authenticated: boolean;
  session: BmuLocalSession | null;
}> {
  try {
    const cookiePayload = await getServerSessionCookie();
    if (!cookiePayload) {
      // Still test lightweight DB connectivity so the footer can report live Cloud SQL status
      await db.select({ id: tenants.id }).from(tenants).limit(1);
      return {
        dbConnected: true,
        authenticated: false,
        session: null,
      };
    }

    const [dbUser] = await db
      .select()
      .from(users)
      .where(eq(users.id, cookiePayload.userId))
      .limit(1);

    if (!dbUser || dbUser.status === 'SUSPENDED' || dbUser.status === 'SOFT_DELETED') {
      if (dbUser && (dbUser.status === 'SUSPENDED' || dbUser.status === 'SOFT_DELETED')) {
        await clearServerSessionCookie();
      }
      return {
        dbConnected: true,
        authenticated: false,
        session: null,
      };
    }

    const session = await buildSessionFromDbUser(dbUser);
    return {
      dbConnected: true,
      authenticated: true,
      session,
    };
  } catch {
    return {
      dbConnected: false,
      authenticated: false,
      session: null,
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Logs out the current founder and clears the HTTP-only session cookie.
 */
export async function logoutFounderAction(): Promise<void> {
  await clearServerSessionCookie();
}

/**
 * Encrypts and stores (or clears) a Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) Gemini API key at rest
 * using AES-256-GCM in PostgreSQL (`user_entitlements.custom_api_key_encrypted`).
 * Never returns raw key material to the browser.
 */
export async function saveByokApiKeyServerAction(rawApiKey: string): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  hasActiveKey: boolean;
  error?: string;
}> {
  try {
    const cookiePayload = await getServerSessionCookie();
    if (!cookiePayload) {
      return { ok: false, hasActiveKey: false, error: 'Not authenticated' };
    }
    const trimmed = rawApiKey.trim();
    const encryptedValue = trimmed ? encryptByokApiKey(trimmed) : null;

    await db
      .update(userEntitlements)
      .set({
        customApiKeyEncrypted: encryptedValue,
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(userEntitlements.userId, cookiePayload.userId));

    return {
      ok: true,
      hasActiveKey: Boolean(encryptedValue),
    };
  } catch (err) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      hasActiveKey: false,
      error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to save BYOK key',
    };
  }
}
