'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import {
  Ticket,
  Sparkles,
  CheckCircle2,
  ArrowLeft,
  ArrowRight,
  Layers,
  ShieldCheck,
  KeyRound,
  Loader2,
  AlertCircle,
  LogIn,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import {
  calculateAppSumoTierLimits,
  calculatePassLimits,
  getPlanTypeDisplayName,
  type EntitlementSnapshot,
} from '@/lib/entitlements';
import {
  hasActiveBmuSession,
  loadBmuSession,
  saveBmuSession,
} from '@/lib/auth/session-store';
import {
  getFounderVoucherStateAction,
  redeemVoucherOrCohortCodeAction,
} from '@/app/actions/vouchers';

export default function RedeemPage() {
  const [isLoadingState, setIsLoadingState] = useState(true);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [isAuthenticated, setIsAuthenticated] = useState(false);
  const [activeUserId, setActiveUserId] = useState<string>('');
  const [activeUserEmail, setActiveUserEmail] = useState<string>('');
  const [entitlement, setEntitlement] = useState<EntitlementSnapshot>(() => {
    const freeDefaults = calculatePassLimits('FREE_HOOK');
    return {
      userId: '',
      planType: 'FREE_HOOK',
      stackedCodesCount: 0,
      maxStartupPlans: freeDefaults.maxStartupPlans,
      maxSeatsPerPlan: freeDefaults.maxSeatsPerPlan,
      monthlyAiCreditsLimit: freeDefaults.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
      aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: 0,
      whiteLabelExportEnabled: false,
      isVaultReadonly: false,
    };
  });
  const [redeemedCodes, setRedeemedCodes] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [cohortCode, setCohortCode] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined);
  const [inputCode, setInputCode] = useState('');
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<{
    type: 'success' | 'error';
    message: string;
  } | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function hydrateVoucherState() {
      const hasLocal = hasActiveBmuSession();
      const localSession = hasLocal ? loadBmuSession() : null;

      if (localSession) {
        setActiveUserId(localSession.user.id);
        setActiveUserEmail(localSession.user.email);
        setEntitlement(localSession.entitlement);
        setRedeemedCodes(localSession.redeemedCodes || []);
        setCohortCode(localSession.user.cohortCode);
        setIsAuthenticated(true);
      }

      try {
        const res = await getFounderVoucherStateAction(
          localSession
            ? {
                userId: localSession.user.id,
                email: localSession.user.email,
              }
            : undefined
        );

        if (cancelled) return;

        if (res.ok && res.authenticated && res.entitlement) {
          setIsAuthenticated(true);
          setActiveUserId(res.userId || localSession?.user.id || '');
          setActiveUserEmail(res.userEmail || localSession?.user.email || '');
          setEntitlement(res.entitlement);
          setRedeemedCodes(res.redeemedCodes || []);
          setCohortCode(res.cohortCode);

          // Synchronize localStorage session so /workspace reflects current DB entitlements
          const currentLocal = loadBmuSession();
          saveBmuSession({
            ...currentLocal,
            user: {
              ...currentLocal.user,
              id: res.userId || currentLocal.user.id,
              email: res.userEmail || currentLocal.user.email,
              name: res.userName || currentLocal.user.name,
              cohortCode: res.cohortCode || currentLocal.user.cohortCode,
            },
            entitlement: res.entitlement,
            redeemedCodes: res.redeemedCodes || [],
          });
        }
      } catch {
        // Keep local session fallback if network/DB is unreachable
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setIsLoadingState(false);
        }
      }
    }

    void hydrateVoucherState();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  async function handleRedeemCode(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const cleaned = inputCode.trim().toUpperCase();

    if (!cleaned) {
      setFeedback({
        type: 'error',
        message: 'Please enter a valid Partner, Promo, or Cohort voucher code.',
      });
      return;
    }

    if (redeemedCodes.includes(cleaned) || cohortCode === cleaned) {
      setFeedback({
        type: 'error',
        message: `Voucher ${cleaned} has already been applied to your account.`,
      });
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setFeedback(null);

    try {
      const res = await redeemVoucherOrCohortCodeAction(cleaned, {
        userId: activeUserId || undefined,
        email: activeUserEmail || undefined,
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        setFeedback({
          type: 'error',
          message:
            res.error || 'Could not redeem that voucher code. Please try again.',
        });
        return;
      }

      const nextEntitlement = res.entitlement || entitlement;
      const nextCodes =
        res.redeemedCodes && res.redeemedCodes.length > 0
          ? res.redeemedCodes
          : Array.from(new Set([...redeemedCodes, cleaned]));

      setEntitlement(nextEntitlement);
      setRedeemedCodes(nextCodes);
      if (res.cohortCode) {
        setCohortCode(res.cohortCode);
      }
      setInputCode('');

      // Persist immediately to localStorage so returning to /workspace unlocks Modules B–L right away
      const currentLocal = loadBmuSession();
      saveBmuSession({
        ...currentLocal,
        user: {
          ...currentLocal.user,
          cohortCode: res.cohortCode || currentLocal.user.cohortCode,
        },
        entitlement: nextEntitlement,
        redeemedCodes: nextCodes,
      });

      setFeedback({
        type: 'success',
        message:
          res.message ||
          `Code ${cleaned} redeemed! Your account is now upgraded to ${
            res.newTierName ||
            getPlanTypeDisplayName(nextEntitlement.planType, {
              isVaultReadonly: nextEntitlement.isVaultReadonly,
              stackedCodesCount: nextEntitlement.stackedCodesCount,
            })
          }.`,
      });
    } catch {
      setFeedback({
        type: 'error',
        message:
          'An unexpected network error occurred while redeeming your code. Please try again.',
      });
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  const effectiveStackedCount =
    entitlement.planType === 'APPSUMO_LTD'
      ? Math.max(entitlement.stackedCodesCount || 0, redeemedCodes.length)
      : redeemedCodes.length;

  const displayTierTitle =
    entitlement.planType === 'APPSUMO_LTD' && effectiveStackedCount > 0
      ? calculateAppSumoTierLimits(effectiveStackedCount).tierName
      : getPlanTypeDisplayName(entitlement.planType, {
          isVaultReadonly: entitlement.isVaultReadonly,
          stackedCodesCount: entitlement.stackedCodesCount,
        });

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col justify-between bg-slate-50">
      <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-4xl flex-1 space-y-6 px-4 py-8 sm:px-6 sm:py-10">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <Link
            href="/workspace"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900"
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
            Back to Workspace
          </Link>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            {activeUserEmail && (
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                Signed in as{' '}
                <strong className="font-semibold text-slate-800">
                  {activeUserEmail}
                </strong>
              </span>
            )}
            <Badge variant="default">Voucher &amp; Cohort Redemption</Badge>
          </div>
        </div>

        {!isLoadingState && !isAuthenticated && (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-start justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-4 text-xs text-amber-950 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-amber-600" />
              <span>
                You must be signed in to your founder account so your voucher code attaches to your workspace.
              </span>
            </div>
            <Link href="/login">
              <Button size="sm" className="h-8 text-xs">
                <LogIn className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Sign In / Create Account
              </Button>
            </Link>
          </div>
        )}

        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-amber-500 text-white">
                <Ticket className="h-6 w-6" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <CardTitle className="text-xl">
                  Redeem &amp; Stack Your Voucher Codes
                </CardTitle>
                <CardDescription>
                  Stack 1, 2, or 3+ codes to unlock Multi-Plan Clone &amp;
                  Pivot, Co-Founder Alignment Interviews, White-Label PDF
                  Exports, and BYOK.
                </CardDescription>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-6">
            <form onSubmit={handleRedeemCode} className="space-y-3">
              <Label htmlFor="voucher-code">
                Enter Voucher Code, Partner Pass, or University Cohort Code
              </Label>
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row">
                <Input
                  id="voucher-code"
                  value={inputCode}
                  onChange={(e) => setInputCode(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. PREFLIGHT-VIP-2027 or LEO-DUBLIN-BATCH"
                  className="font-mono text-base uppercase sm:text-sm"
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                />
                <Button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={isSubmitting || isLoadingState}
                  className="w-full shrink-0 sm:w-auto"
                >
                  {isSubmitting ? (
                    <>
                      <Loader2 className="mr-1.5 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                      Redeeming...
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <Sparkles className="mr-1.5 h-4 w-4" />
                      Redeem Code
                    </>
                  )}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </form>

            {feedback && (
              <div
                className={`flex flex-col justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border p-3.5 text-sm sm:flex-row sm:items-center ${
                  feedback.type === 'success'
                    ? 'border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-900'
                    : 'border-red-200 bg-red-50 text-red-900'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
                  {feedback.type === 'success' ? (
                    <CheckCircle2 className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-emerald-600" />
                  ) : (
                    <AlertCircle className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-red-600" />
                  )}
                  <span>{feedback.message}</span>
                </div>
                {feedback.type === 'success' && (
                  <Link href="/workspace" className="shrink-0">
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      className="h-8 w-full bg-emerald-700 text-xs text-white hover:bg-emerald-800 sm:w-auto"
                    >
                      Open Unlocked Workspace
                      <ArrowRight className="ml-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    </Button>
                  </Link>
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Current Unlocked Tier Summary */}
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/60 p-5">
              <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
                <div>
                  <div className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-600">
                    Active Account Entitlement
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">
                    {isLoadingState ? 'Loading account entitlement...' : displayTierTitle}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <Badge variant="default">
                  {effectiveStackedCount} Code(s) Stacked
                </Badge>
              </div>

              {redeemedCodes.length > 0 && (
                <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-500">
                    Applied Vouchers:
                  </span>
                  {redeemedCodes.map((code) => (
                    <span
                      key={code}
                      className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md border border-indigo-200 bg-white px-2 py-0.5 font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold text-indigo-900"
                    >
                      <CheckCircle2 className="h-3 w-3 text-emerald-600" />
                      {code}
                    </span>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-4">
                <div className="rounded-xl bg-white p-3 shadow-2xs">
                  <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">Startup Plans</div>
                  <div className="mt-1 text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">
                    {entitlement.maxStartupPlans} Plans
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="rounded-xl bg-white p-3 shadow-2xs">
                  <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">Team Seats / Plan</div>
                  <div className="mt-1 text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">
                    {entitlement.maxSeatsPerPlan} Seats
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="rounded-xl bg-white p-3 shadow-2xs">
                  <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">Monthly AI Credits</div>
                  <div className="mt-1 text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">
                    {entitlement.monthlyAiCreditsLimit} / mo
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="rounded-xl bg-white p-3 shadow-2xs">
                  <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                    White-Label &amp; BYOK
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-1 text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">
                    {entitlement.whiteLabelExportEnabled
                      ? 'Enabled (Tier 3)'
                      : 'Requires 3 Codes'}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* 3-Tier Stacking Breakdown Table */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-3">
              {[
                {
                  codes: 1,
                  title: 'Tier 1: Solo Founder',
                  plans: '1 Active Startup Plan',
                  seats: '1 User Seat (Solo)',
                  credits: '150 AI Credits / month',
                  extras: 'Full Modules A–L + Unlimited Exports',
                },
                {
                  codes: 2,
                  title: 'Tier 2: Co-Founder & Pivot',
                  plans: '3 Active Startup Plans (Clone & Pivot)',
                  seats: '3 Team Seats / Plan',
                  credits: '450 AI Credits / month',
                  extras:
                    'Unlocks Blind-Reveal Co-Founder Interview & Idea Comparator',
                },
                {
                  codes: 3,
                  title: 'Tier 3: Serial Entrepreneur',
                  plans: '10+ Active Startup Plans',
                  seats: '5 Team Seats / Plan',
                  credits: '1,500 AI Credits / month',
                  extras:
                    'White-Label PDF Exports + Bring Your Own API Key (BYOK)',
                },
              ].map((tier) => {
                const isUnlocked = effectiveStackedCount >= tier.codes;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={tier.codes}
                    className={`rounded-xl border p-4 ${
                      isUnlocked
                        ? 'border-indigo-500 bg-white ring-1 ring-indigo-500'
                        : 'border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 opacity-80'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-indigo-600">
                        {tier.codes} {tier.codes === 1 ? 'Code' : 'Codes'}
                      </span>
                      {isUnlocked && (
                        <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600" />
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="mt-1 font-semibold text-slate-900">
                      {tier.title}
                    </div>
                    <ul className="mt-3 space-y-1.5 text-xs text-slate-600">
                      <li className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <Layers className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-500" />
                        {tier.plans}
                      </li>
                      <li className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <ShieldCheck className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-500" />
                        {tier.seats}
                      </li>
                      <li className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <KeyRound className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-500" />
                        {tier.credits}
                      </li>
                    </ul>
                    <p className="mt-3 border-t border-slate-100 pt-2 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                      {tier.extras}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}
=== src/app/(public)/v/[slug]/layout.tsx ===
import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import React from 'react';
import { getPublicSurveyBySlugAction } from '@/app/actions/module-c';

interface SurveyLayoutProps {
  params: Promise<{
    slug: string;
  }>;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

export async function generateMetadata({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>;
}): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const cleanSlug = decodeURIComponent(slug).trim().slice(0, 140);

  try {
    const res = await getPublicSurveyBySlugAction(cleanSlug);
    if (res.found && res.survey) {
      const survey = res.survey;
      const startupName = survey.planTitle || 'Startup Concept';
      const surveyTitle = survey.title || `${startupName} Customer Survey`;
      const description =
        survey.introDescription ||
        `Help shape ${startupName} by taking a 60-second bias-free customer feedback survey.`;

      const pageUrl = `https://startuppreflight.com/v/${cleanSlug}`;

      return {
        title: `${surveyTitle} — Customer Survey`,
        description,
        alternates: {
          canonical: pageUrl,
        },
        openGraph: {
          type: 'website',
          locale: 'en_US',
          url: pageUrl,
          siteName: 'Startup Preflight',
          title: `${surveyTitle} | Quick Feedback Survey`,
          description,
          images: [
            {
              url: '/images/og-image.png',
              width: 1200,
              height: 630,
              alt: `${surveyTitle} on Startup Preflight`,
              type: 'image/png',
            },
          ],
        },
        twitter: {
          card: 'summary_large_image',
          title: `${surveyTitle} | Quick Feedback Survey`,
          description,
          images: ['/images/og-image.png'],
        },
      };
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[generateMetadata:v/[slug]] Error fetching survey metadata:', err);
  }

  return {
    title: 'Customer Feedback Survey | Startup Preflight',
    description:
      'Help shape a new startup idea by taking a fast 60-second customer feedback survey.',
    openGraph: {
      type: 'website',
      siteName: 'Startup Preflight',
      title: 'Customer Feedback Survey | Startup Preflight',
      description:
        'Help shape a new startup idea by taking a fast 60-second customer feedback survey.',
      images: [
        {
          url: '/images/og-image.png',
          width: 1200,
          height: 630,
          alt: 'Startup Preflight Customer Survey',
          type: 'image/png',
        },
      ],
    },
    twitter: {
      card: 'summary_large_image',
      title: 'Customer Feedback Survey | Startup Preflight',
      description:
        'Help shape a new startup idea by taking a fast 60-second customer feedback survey.',
      images: ['/images/og-image.png'],
    },
  };
}

export default function SurveyLayout({ children }: SurveyLayoutProps) {
  return <>{children}</>;
}
=== src/app/(public)/v/[slug]/page.tsx ===
'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useParams, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import Link from 'next/link';
import {
  Sparkles,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  ShieldCheck,
  Send,
  AlertCircle,
  Loader2,
  Check,
  Gift,
  RotateCcw,
  Lock,
  ExternalLink,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { GlobalFeedbackButton } from '@/components/feedback/global-feedback-dialog';
import {
  loadPublicSurveyFromLocalRegistry,
  appendResponseToLocalRegistryAndSession,
  type SavedValidationSurvey,
  type SurveyResponseAnswerValue,
  type SavedSurveyResponse,
} from '@/lib/auth/session-store';
import {
  getPublicSurveyBySlugAction,
  submitPublicSurveyResponseAction,
} from '@/app/actions/module-c';

export default function PublicValidationSurveyPage() {
  const params = useParams<{ slug: string }>();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const rawSlug = Array.isArray(params?.slug)
    ? params.slug[0]
    : params?.slug || '';
  const cleanSlug = decodeURIComponent(rawSlug).trim();

  // Prolific or Guaranteed Boost URL params:
  // e.g., /v/slug?prolific_pid={{%PROLIFIC_PID%}}&study_id={{%STUDY_ID%}}&session_id={{%SESSION_ID%}}&boost_order_id=...
  const prolificPid =
    searchParams.get('prolific_pid') ||
    searchParams.get('PROLIFIC_PID') ||
    searchParams.get('participant_id') ||
    '';
  const studyId =
    searchParams.get('study_id') ||
    searchParams.get('STUDY_ID') ||
    '';
  const boostOrderId =
    searchParams.get('boost_order_id') ||
    searchParams.get('order_id') ||
    '';

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [survey, setSurvey] = useState<
    (SavedValidationSurvey & { planTitle?: string }) | null
  >(null);

  // Respondent answers state keyed by question.id
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<
    Record<string, SurveyResponseAnswerValue>
  >({});
  const [respondentNameOrRole, setRespondentNameOrRole] = useState(
    prolificPid ? `Verified Prolific Panelist (${prolificPid.slice(0, 8)})` : ''
  );
  const [respondentEmail, setRespondentEmail] = useState('');
  const [joinedWaitlist, setJoinedWaitlist] = useState(false);

  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false);
  const [validationError, setValidationError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [prolificRedirectTimer, setProlificRedirectTimer] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const PROLIFIC_COMPLETION_URL = 'https://app.prolific.com/submissions/complete?cc=SPF_SURVEY_VERIFIED';

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    async function fetchSurvey() {
      setLoading(true);
      // 1. Check local browser registry first for instant preview / same-browser updates
      const localMatch = loadPublicSurveyFromLocalRegistry(cleanSlug);

      // 2. Also query Cloud SQL for public respondents on other devices
      const cloudRes = await getPublicSurveyBySlugAction(cleanSlug);

      if (!active) return;

      if (localMatch && cloudRes.found && cloudRes.survey) {
        // Prefer whichever has questions or was updated most recently
        const chosen =
          localMatch.questions.length >= cloudRes.survey.questions.length
            ? localMatch
            : cloudRes.survey;
        setSurvey({
          ...chosen,
          isPublished: Boolean(
            localMatch.isPublished || cloudRes.survey.isPublished
          ),
          publishedAt: localMatch.publishedAt || cloudRes.survey.publishedAt,
        });
      } else if (localMatch) {
        setSurvey(localMatch);
      } else if (cloudRes.found && cloudRes.survey) {
        setSurvey(cloudRes.survey);
      } else {
        setSurvey(null);
      }
      setLoading(false);
    }

    if (cleanSlug) {
      fetchSurvey();
    } else {
      setLoading(false);
    }

    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [cleanSlug]);

  const handleSelectSingleChoice = (questionId: string, option: string) => {
    setValidationError(null);
    setAnswers((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [questionId]: {
        ...prev[questionId],
        selectedOption: option,
      },
    }));
  };

  const handleToggleMultiSelect = (questionId: string, option: string) => {
    setValidationError(null);
    setAnswers((prev) => {
      const currentList = prev[questionId]?.selectedOptions || [];
      const exists = currentList.includes(option);
      const nextList = exists
        ? currentList.filter((item) => item !== option)
        : [...currentList, option];
      return {
        ...prev,
        [questionId]: {
          ...prev[questionId],
          selectedOptions: nextList,
        },
      };
    });
  };

  const handleOtherTextChange = (questionId: string, text: string) => {
    setValidationError(null);
    setAnswers((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [questionId]: {
        ...prev[questionId],
        otherText: text,
      },
    }));
  };

  const handleScaleSelect = (questionId: string, val: number) => {
    setValidationError(null);
    setAnswers((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [questionId]: {
        ...prev[questionId],
        scaleValue: val,
      },
    }));
  };

  const handleOpenTextChange = (questionId: string, text: string) => {
    setValidationError(null);
    setAnswers((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [questionId]: {
        ...prev[questionId],
        openText: text,
      },
    }));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!survey) return;

    // Ensure at least one question was answered
    const answeredCount = survey.questions.filter((q) => {
      const ans = answers[q.id];
      if (!ans) return false;
      if (q.type === 'MULTIPLE_CHOICE') return Boolean(ans.selectedOption);
      if (q.type === 'MULTI_SELECT')
        return (ans.selectedOptions?.length || 0) > 0;
      if (q.type === 'SCALE_1_5') return typeof ans.scaleValue === 'number';
      if (q.type === 'OPEN_TEXT') return Boolean(ans.openText?.trim());
      return false;
    }).length;

    if (answeredCount === 0 && survey.questions.length > 0) {
      setValidationError(
        'Please answer at least one question before submitting your feedback.'
      );
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    setValidationError(null);

    const clientRespId = `resp-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`;
    const newResponse: SavedSurveyResponse = {
      id: clientRespId,
      clientResponseId: clientRespId,
      surveyId: survey.id,
      answers,
      respondentNameOrRole: respondentNameOrRole.trim() || undefined,
      respondentEmail: respondentEmail.trim() || undefined,
      joinedWaitlist:
        joinedWaitlist || Boolean(respondentEmail.trim().includes('@')),
      isSimulated: false,
      submittedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    // 1. Save to PostgreSQL Cloud SQL first so we get the authoritative UUID
    const submitRes = await submitPublicSurveyResponseAction({
      publicSlug: cleanSlug,
      response: newResponse,
      boostOrderId: boostOrderId || undefined,
      prolificPid: prolificPid || undefined,
    });

    const finalResponse: SavedSurveyResponse = {
      ...newResponse,
      id: submitRes.savedResponseId || newResponse.id,
      clientResponseId: clientRespId,
    };

    // 2. Save to local registry & session with the exact same ID so same-browser tabs never duplicate
    appendResponseToLocalRegistryAndSession(cleanSlug, finalResponse);

    setSubmitting(false);
    setSubmitted(true);
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });

    // If this respondent is from Prolific, start countdown and auto-redirect to Prolific submission completion URL
    if (prolificPid) {
      setProlificRedirectTimer(4);
      const timer = setInterval(() => {
        setProlificRedirectTimer((prev) => {
          if (prev === null || prev <= 1) {
            clearInterval(timer);
            window.location.href = PROLIFIC_COMPLETION_URL;
            return 0;
          }
          return prev - 1;
        });
      }, 1000);
    }
  };

  const handleResetForAnotherResponse = () => {
    setAnswers({});
    setRespondentNameOrRole('');
    setRespondentEmail('');
    setJoinedWaitlist(false);
    setSubmitted(false);
    setValidationError(null);
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col items-center justify-center bg-slate-50 p-6">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-slate-600">
          <Loader2 className="h-5 w-5 animate-spin text-indigo-600" />
          Loading survey...
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!survey) {
    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col items-center justify-center bg-slate-50 p-6">
        <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 text-center shadow-xs">
          <div className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-amber-100 text-amber-700">
            <AlertCircle className="h-6 w-6" />
          </div>
          <h1 className="mt-4 text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">
            Survey Link Not Found
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs leading-relaxed text-slate-600">
            We couldn&apos;t find an active survey at{' '}
            <code className="rounded bg-slate-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-slate-800">
              /v/{cleanSlug}
            </code>
            . Make sure the survey has been saved in your Module C Survey
            Builder.
          </p>
          <div className="mt-5">
            <Link href="/workspace">
              <Button size="sm" className="bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-700">
                Return to Founder Workspace
              </Button>
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!survey.isActive) {
    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col items-center justify-center bg-slate-50 p-6">
        <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 text-center shadow-xs">
          <div className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 text-slate-600">
            <Clock className="h-6 w-6" />
          </div>
          <h1 className="mt-4 text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">
            This Survey is Currently Paused
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs leading-relaxed text-slate-600">
            The founder of <strong>{survey.title}</strong> has paused new
            responses for now. Thank you for stopping by!
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (submitted) {
    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col items-center justify-center bg-gradient-to-b from-indigo-50/60 via-white to-slate-50 p-6">
        <div className="w-full max-w-lg rounded-2xl border border-emerald-200 bg-white p-8 text-center shadow-lg">
          <div className="mx-auto flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700">
            <CheckCircle2 className="h-8 w-8" />
          </div>
          <Badge className="mt-4 bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800">
            Response Recorded
          </Badge>
          <h1 className="mt-2 text-xl font-bold text-slate-900">
            {prolificPid ? 'Thank you! Your response is verified.' : 'Thank you for sharing your honest feedback!'}
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-slate-600">
            Your answers help shape{' '}
            <strong>{survey.planTitle || survey.title}</strong> around real
            experiences instead of guesswork.
            {respondentEmail.trim() && (
              <span className="mt-1 block font-medium text-emerald-700">
                ✓ You&apos;re on the early-bird list ({respondentEmail.trim()}).
              </span>
            )}
          </p>

          {/* Prolific Completion Box & Auto-Redirect */}
          {prolificPid && (
            <div className="mt-6 rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/80 p-5 text-left">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-indigo-900">
                <Check className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600" />
                Prolific Study Completed (Completion Code:{' '}
                <span className="font-mono text-indigo-700">SPF_SURVEY_VERIFIED</span>)
              </div>
              <p className="mt-1.5 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-indigo-800">
                Participant ID: <code className="rounded bg-white px-1.5 py-0.5 text-indigo-950 font-mono text-[10px]">{prolificPid}</code>.
                {prolificRedirectTimer !== null && prolificRedirectTimer > 0 ? (
                  <span className="block mt-1 font-semibold text-indigo-900">
                    Redirecting back to Prolific in {prolificRedirectTimer} second{prolificRedirectTimer !== 1 ? 's' : ''}...
                  </span>
                ) : (
                  <span className="block mt-1 font-semibold text-indigo-900">
                    Click the button below to confirm your submission on Prolific:
                  </span>
                )}
              </p>
              <div className="mt-3">
                <a
                  href={PROLIFIC_COMPLETION_URL}
                  className="inline-flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-xs hover:bg-indigo-700 sm:w-auto"
                >
                  Return to Prolific Now
                  <ExternalLink className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                </a>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {!prolificPid && (
            <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2.5 border-t border-slate-100 pt-5">
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onClick={handleResetForAnotherResponse}
              >
                <RotateCcw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Submit Another Response
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-b from-indigo-50/50 via-slate-50 to-white px-4 py-8 sm:px-6 sm:py-12">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-2xl">
        {/* Top Trust Strip */}
        <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs text-slate-500">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-medium text-indigo-700">
            <Clock className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            <span>Takes ~60 seconds • Zero login required</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
            <ShieldCheck className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
            <span>100% Confidential Discovery Survey</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Survey Header Card */}
        <div className=" rounded-2xl border border-indigo-200/80 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-950 via-indigo-900 to-violet-900 p-6 text-white shadow-md sm:p-8">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <Badge className="border-indigo-400/40 bg-indigo-500/30 text-[11px] text-indigo-100">
                Customer Discovery &amp; Feedback
              </Badge>
              {survey.isPublished ? (
                <Badge className="border-emerald-400/40 bg-emerald-500/25 text-[11px] text-emerald-100">
                  <Lock className="mr-1 h-3 w-3" />
                  Verified &amp; Locked Questions
                </Badge>
              ) : (
                <Badge className="border-amber-400/40 bg-amber-500/25 text-[11px] text-amber-100">
                  Draft Preview Mode
                </Badge>
              )}
            </div>

            <GlobalFeedbackButton
              variant="header-pill"
              activeModule="MOD_C_SURVEYS_FEEDBACK"
              activeStepContext={`Public Survey: ${survey.title || cleanSlug}`}
            />
          </div>
          <h1 className="mt-2.5 text-xl font-bold tracking-tight sm:text-2xl">
            {survey.title || 'Quick Customer Feedback Survey'}
          </h1>
          {survey.introDescription && (
            <p className="mt-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-indigo-100/90 sm:text-sm">
              {survey.introDescription}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Questions Single-Page Form */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="mt-6 space-y-5">
          {survey.questions.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-white p-8 text-center text-xs text-slate-500">
              No questions have been added to this survey yet.
            </div>
          ) : (
            survey.questions.map((q, idx) => {
              const currentAns = answers[q.id] || {};
              const isOtherSelectedSingle =
                currentAns.selectedOption === 'OTHER';
              const isOtherSelectedMulti = (
                currentAns.selectedOptions || []
              ).includes('OTHER');

              return (
                <div
                  key={q.id}
                  className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 bg-white p-5 shadow-2xs transition-all hover:border-indigo-200 sm:p-6"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                    <span className="flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-indigo-100 text-xs font-bold text-indigo-800">
                      {idx + 1}
                    </span>
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <label className="block text-sm font-bold leading-snug text-slate-900 sm:text-base">
                        {q.questionText || `Question ${idx + 1}`}
                      </label>
                      {q.type === 'MULTI_SELECT' && (
                        <span className="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                          Select all options that apply to you
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* 1. MULTIPLE_CHOICE (Single Select) */}
                  {q.type === 'MULTIPLE_CHOICE' && (
                    <div className="mt-4 space-y-2 sm:pl-9">
                      {(q.options || []).map((opt) => {
                        const selected = currentAns.selectedOption === opt;
                        return (
                          <button
                            key={opt}
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleSelectSingleChoice(q.id, opt)}
                            className={`flex w-full items-center justify-between rounded-xl border px-3.5 py-2.5 text-left text-xs font-medium transition-all sm:text-sm ${
                              selected
                                ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50/90 text-indigo-950 ring-1 ring-indigo-600'
                                : 'border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/60 text-slate-700 hover:border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100/70'
                            }`}
                          >
                            <span>{opt}</span>
                            <span
                              className={`flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border ${
                                selected
                                  ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                                  : 'border-slate-300 bg-white'
                              }`}
                            >
                              {selected && <Check className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />}
                            </span>
                          </button>
                        );
                      })}

                      {q.allowOther !== false && (
                        <div className="space-y-2">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() =>
                              handleSelectSingleChoice(q.id, 'OTHER')
                            }
                            className={`flex w-full items-center justify-between rounded-xl border px-3.5 py-2.5 text-left text-xs font-medium transition-all sm:text-sm ${
                              isOtherSelectedSingle
                                ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50/90 text-indigo-950 ring-1 ring-indigo-600'
                                : 'border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/60 text-slate-700 hover:border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100/70'
                            }`}
                          >
                            <span>Other (please specify)</span>
                            <span
                              className={`flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border ${
                                isOtherSelectedSingle
                                  ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                                  : 'border-slate-300 bg-white'
                              }`}
                            >
                              {isOtherSelectedSingle && (
                                <Check className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
                              )}
                            </span>
                          </button>

                          {isOtherSelectedSingle && (
                            <Input
                              value={currentAns.otherText || ''}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                handleOtherTextChange(q.id, e.target.value)
                              }
                              placeholder="Type your own answer..."
                              className="border-indigo-300 bg-white text-base sm:text-xs"
                              autoFocus
                            />
                          )}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* 2. MULTI_SELECT (Checkboxes) */}
                  {q.type === 'MULTI_SELECT' && (
                    <div className="mt-4 space-y-2 sm:pl-9">
                      {(q.options || []).map((opt) => {
                        const selected = (
                          currentAns.selectedOptions || []
                        ).includes(opt);
                        return (
                          <button
                            key={opt}
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleToggleMultiSelect(q.id, opt)}
                            className={`flex w-full items-center justify-between rounded-xl border px-3.5 py-2.5 text-left text-xs font-medium transition-all sm:text-sm ${
                              selected
                                ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50/90 text-indigo-950 ring-1 ring-indigo-600'
                                : 'border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/60 text-slate-700 hover:border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100/70'
                            }`}
                          >
                            <span>{opt}</span>
                            <span
                              className={`flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md border ${
                                selected
                                  ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                                  : 'border-slate-300 bg-white'
                              }`}
                            >
                              {selected && <Check className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />}
                            </span>
                          </button>
                        );
                      })}

                      {q.allowOther !== false && (
                        <div className="space-y-2">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() =>
                              handleToggleMultiSelect(q.id, 'OTHER')
                            }
                            className={`flex w-full items-center justify-between rounded-xl border px-3.5 py-2.5 text-left text-xs font-medium transition-all sm:text-sm ${
                              isOtherSelectedMulti
                                ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50/90 text-indigo-950 ring-1 ring-indigo-600'
                                : 'border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/60 text-slate-700 hover:border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100/70'
                            }`}
                          >
                            <span>Other (please specify)</span>
                            <span
                              className={`flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md border ${
                                isOtherSelectedMulti
                                  ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                                  : 'border-slate-300 bg-white'
                              }`}
                            >
                              {isOtherSelectedMulti && (
                                <Check className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
                              )}
                            </span>
                          </button>

                          {isOtherSelectedMulti && (
                            <Input
                              value={currentAns.otherText || ''}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                handleOtherTextChange(q.id, e.target.value)
                              }
                              placeholder="Type your own answer..."
                              className="border-indigo-300 bg-white text-base sm:text-xs"
                              autoFocus
                            />
                          )}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* 3. SCALE_1_5 (1 to 5 Rating Scale) */}
                  {q.type === 'SCALE_1_5' && (
                    <div className="mt-4 sm:pl-9">
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-5 gap-2">
                        {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((num) => {
                          const selected = currentAns.scaleValue === num;
                          return (
                            <button
                              key={num}
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleScaleSelect(q.id, num)}
                              className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-xl border py-3 text-sm font-bold transition-all ${
                                selected
                                  ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-xs ring-2 ring-indigo-300'
                                  : 'border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 hover:border-indigo-300 hover:bg-indigo-50/50'
                              }`}
                            >
                              <span>{num}</span>
                            </button>
                          );
                        })}
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-500">
                        <span>{q.scaleMinLabel || '1 = Low / Not painful'}</span>
                        <span className="text-right">{q.scaleMaxLabel || '5 = High / Very urgent'}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* 4. OPEN_TEXT (Short Story / Workaround Textarea) */}
                  {q.type === 'OPEN_TEXT' && (
                    <div className="mt-4 sm:pl-9">
                      <textarea
                        rows={3}
                        value={currentAns.openText || ''}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          handleOpenTextChange(q.id, e.target.value)
                        }
                        placeholder="Share a quick example or how you handle this today..."
                        className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/60 p-3 text-base text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:bg-white focus:outline-hidden sm:text-sm"
                      />
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })
          )}

          {/* Optional Early-Bird Waitlist & Respondent Info Card */}
          {survey.collectLeadEmails && (
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/60 p-5 shadow-2xs sm:p-6">
              <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                <div className="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 text-white">
                  <Gift className="h-4 w-4" />
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div className="text-sm font-bold text-indigo-950">
                    Optional: Join the Early-Bird Waitlist
                  </div>
                  <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-indigo-900/80">
                    {survey.waitlistIncentiveText ||
                      'Leave your email if you would like early beta access or a launch discount (100% optional — leave blank to stay anonymous).'}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                <div>
                  <label className="mb-1 block text-[11px] font-semibold text-indigo-950">
                    Your Name or Role (Optional)
                  </label>
                  <Input
                    value={respondentNameOrRole}
                    onChange={(e) => setRespondentNameOrRole(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g., Sarah • Clinic Owner"
                    className="bg-white text-base sm:text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="mb-1 block text-[11px] font-semibold text-indigo-950">
                    Email for Early-Bird Access (Optional)
                  </label>
                  <Input
                    type="email"
                    value={respondentEmail}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      setRespondentEmail(e.target.value);
                      if (e.target.value.includes('@')) {
                        setJoinedWaitlist(true);
                      }
                    }}
                    placeholder="you@example.com"
                    className="bg-white text-base sm:text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <label className="mt-3 flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-xs font-medium text-indigo-950">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={joinedWaitlist}
                  onChange={(e) => setJoinedWaitlist(e.target.checked)}
                  className="h-4 w-4 rounded border-indigo-300 text-indigo-600"
                />
                <span>
                  Yes, notify me when early access launches (no spam, ever).
                </span>
              </label>
            </div>
          )}

          {validationError && (
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 px-4 py-3 text-xs font-medium text-amber-900">
              ⚠️ {validationError}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Submit Bar */}
          <div className="flex flex-col-reverse items-stretch justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-xs sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:gap-4 sm:px-6">
            <div className="text-center text-xs text-slate-500 sm:text-left">
              Powered by{' '}
              <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800">
                Startup Preflight
              </span>{' '}
              • No login required
            </div>
            <Button
              type="submit"
              disabled={submitting || survey.questions.length === 0}
              className="w-full bg-indigo-600 py-2.5 text-white hover:bg-indigo-700 sm:w-auto sm:px-6 sm:py-2"
            >
              {submitting ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                  Submitting...
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Send className="h-4 w-4" />
                  Submit Feedback
                </>
              )}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';

import {
  Rocket,

    );

=== src/app/api/domains/check/route.ts ===
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import dns from 'dns/promises';
import { checkRateLimit } from '@/lib/auth/server-auth';

export interface DomainCheckItem {
  domain: string;
  tld: string;
  status: 'AVAILABLE' | 'TAKEN';
  available: boolean;
  statusLabel: string;
  reason: string;
  recommended?: boolean;
  notes?: string;
}

/**
 * Checks domain availability using a 2-tier strategy:
 * Tier 1: Google DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH). High speed, zero UDP port blocking in Cloud Run / container networks.
 * Tier 2: Native Node.js dns.resolveNs / dns.resolve4 fallback.
 */
async function checkDomainAvailability(
  domain: string
): Promise<{ available: boolean; reason: string }> {
  // Tier 1: Google DoH (Reliable across serverless and cloud containers)
  try {
    const dohUrl = `https://dns.google/resolve?name=${encodeURIComponent(domain)}&type=NS`;
    const res = await fetch(dohUrl, {
      headers: { Accept: 'application/dns-json' },
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(2500),
    });

    if (res.ok) {
      const data = await res.json();
      // Status 3 = NXDOMAIN (Non-Existent Domain -> unequivocally Available)
      if (data.Status === 3) {
        return {
          available: true,
          reason: 'No active DNS delegation or NS records found (Available to Claim)',
        };
      }
      // Status 0 with Answer = Active NS delegation -> Registered
      if (data.Status === 0 && Array.isArray(data.Answer) && data.Answer.length > 0) {
        return {
          available: false,
          reason: 'Active NS delegation / DNS records detected (Already Claimed)',
        };
      }
      // Status 0 with Authority indicating domain SOA
      if (data.Status === 0 && Array.isArray(data.Authority)) {
        const hasDirectAuthority = data.Authority.some(
          (a: { name?: string }) =>
            a.name && (a.name === domain || a.name === `${domain}.`)
        );
        if (hasDirectAuthority) {
          return {
            available: false,
            reason: 'Active SOA authority zone detected (Already Claimed)',
          };
        }
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Fall through to native DNS
  }

  // Tier 2: Native Node.js DNS fallback
  try {
    const ns = await Promise.race([
      dns.resolveNs(domain),
      new Promise<string[]>((_, reject) =>
        setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('DNS_TIMEOUT')), 1500)
      ),
    ]);
    if (Array.isArray(ns) && ns.length > 0) {
      return {
        available: false,
        reason: 'Active NS delegation / DNS records detected (Already Claimed)',
      };
    }
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const code =
      err && typeof err === 'object' && 'code' in err
        ? String((err as { code?: unknown }).code)
        : '';
    if (code === 'ENOTFOUND' || code === 'NXDOMAIN') {
      return {
        available: true,
        reason: 'No active DNS delegation found (Available to Claim)',
      };
    }
  }

  try {
    const aRecords = await Promise.race([
      dns.resolve4(domain),
      new Promise<string[]>((_, reject) =>
        setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('DNS_TIMEOUT')), 1200)
      ),
    ]);
    if (Array.isArray(aRecords) && aRecords.length > 0) {
      return {
        available: false,
        reason: 'Active A records pointing to hosting server (Already Claimed)',
      };
    }
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const code =
      err && typeof err === 'object' && 'code' in err
        ? String((err as { code?: unknown }).code)
        : '';
    if (code === 'ENOTFOUND' || code === 'NXDOMAIN') {
      return {
        available: true,
        reason: 'No active DNS records found (Available to Claim)',
      };
    }
  }

  // If no NS or A records were found or resolved, assume available
  return {
    available: true,
    reason: 'No active DNS delegation or NS records found (Available to Claim)',
  };
}

function sanitizeBaseLabel(rawInput: string): string {
  const cleaned = rawInput
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/^https?:\/\//, '')
    .replace(/^www\./, '')
    .split('/')[0]
    .split('.')[0]
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9-]/g, '')
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');
  return cleaned;
}

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  const forwardedFor = request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for');
  const clientIp =
    request.headers.get('cf-connecting-ip') ||
    (forwardedFor ? forwardedFor.split(',')[0].trim() : 'anon');

  const rl = checkRateLimit(`domain_check:${clientIp}`, 30, 60_000);
  if (!rl.allowed) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        ok: false,
        error: `Too many domain checks. Please wait ${rl.retryAfterSeconds} seconds.`,
        results: [],
      },
      { status: 429 }
    );
  }

  const rawQuery = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get('q') || '';
  const countryCode = (
    request.nextUrl.searchParams.get('country') || 'IE'
  ).toUpperCase();

  const baseName = sanitizeBaseLabel(rawQuery);
  if (!baseName || baseName.length < 2) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        ok: false,
        error: 'Please enter at least 2 characters for a domain name.',
        results: [],
      },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  const primaryLocalTld = countryCode === 'GB' || countryCode === 'UK' ? '.co.uk' : '.ie';
  const secondaryLocalTld = primaryLocalTld === '.ie' ? '.co.uk' : '.ie';

  const candidates: Array<{
    domain: string;
    tld: string;
    recommended?: boolean;
    notes?: string;
  }> = [
    {
      domain: `${baseName}${primaryLocalTld}`,
      tld: primaryLocalTld,
      recommended: true,
      notes:
        primaryLocalTld === '.ie'
          ? 'Best for Irish trust & LEO/EI grants (requires CRO/RBN or Irish connection)'
          : 'Best for UK customer trust & Companies House alignment',
    },
    {
      domain: `${baseName}.com`,
      tld: '.com',
      recommended: true,
      notes: 'Global commercial standard for international expansion',
    },
    {
      domain: `${baseName}${secondaryLocalTld}`,
      tld: secondaryLocalTld,
      notes:
        secondaryLocalTld === '.co.uk'
          ? 'Recommended if exporting to the UK market'
          : 'Recommended if trading in Ireland',
    },
    {
      domain: `${baseName}.io`,
      tld: '.io',
      notes: 'Popular for SaaS, AI & developer platforms',
    },
    {
      domain: `get${baseName}.com`,
      tld: '.com',
      notes: 'Clean fallback if primary .com is already taken',
    },
  ];

  const results: DomainCheckItem[] = await Promise.all(
    candidates.map(async (item) => {
      const check = await checkDomainAvailability(item.domain);
      const isAvail = check.available;
      return {
        domain: item.domain,
        tld: item.tld,
        status: isAvail ? 'AVAILABLE' : 'TAKEN',
        available: isAvail,
        statusLabel: isAvail ? 'Available to Claim' : 'Already Registered',
        reason: check.reason,
        recommended: item.recommended,
        notes: item.notes,
      };
    })
  );

  return NextResponse.json({
    ok: true,
    baseName,
    countryCode,
    checkedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    results,
  });
}
