import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import {
  db,
  ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced,
  partnerOffers,
  partnerReferralEvents,
} from '@/db';
import {
  DEFAULT_PARTNER_OFFERS,
  resolvePartnerReferralUrl,
  type PartnerSlotKey,
} from '@/lib/partners/partner-catalog-store';

export async function GET(
  request: NextRequest,
  context: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }
) {
  const { slug } = await context.params;
  const cleanSlug = (slug || '').trim().toLowerCase();

  const searchParams = request.nextUrl.searchParams;
  const planId =
    searchParams.get('planId') || searchParams.get('projectId') || undefined;
  const planTitle = searchParams.get('planTitle') || undefined;
  const domain = searchParams.get('domain') || undefined;
  const countryCode = (searchParams.get('country') || 'IE').toUpperCase();
  const founderName = searchParams.get('founderName') || undefined;
  const founderEmail = searchParams.get('founderEmail') || undefined;

  let matchedOffer = DEFAULT_PARTNER_OFFERS.find(
    (p) => p.slug.toLowerCase() === cleanSlug || p.id.toLowerCase() === cleanSlug
  );

  try {
    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();
    const dbRows = await db
      .select()
      .from(partnerOffers)
      .where(eq(partnerOffers.slug, cleanSlug))
      .limit(1);

    if (dbRows.length > 0) {
      const row = dbRows[0];
      matchedOffer = {
        id: row.id,
        slug: row.slug,
        slotKey: row.slotKey as PartnerSlotKey,
        name: row.name,
        logoEmoji: row.logoEmoji,
        category: row.category,
        headline: row.headline,
        perkDescription: row.perkDescription,
        badgeText: row.badgeText,
        promoCode: row.promoCode,
        countryScope: (row.countryScope as 'ALL' | 'IE' | 'GB') || 'ALL',
        actionType:
          (row.actionType as 'AFFILIATE_LINK' | 'WARM_INTRO_MODAL') ||
          'AFFILIATE_LINK',
        actionLabel: row.actionLabel,
        referralUrl: row.referralUrl,
        trustFactor: row.trustFactor,
        warmIntroRecipientEmail: row.warmIntroRecipientEmail,
        warmIntroQuestionsJson: row.warmIntroQuestionsJson || [],
        commissionBountySummary: row.commissionBountySummary,
        partnerContactNotes: row.partnerContactNotes,
        sortOrder: row.sortOrder,
        isActive: row.isActive,
        createdAt: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
        updatedAt: row.updatedAt.toISOString(),
      };
    }
  } catch {
    // Fall back to default offer catalog if DB is unreachable
  }

  const targetUrl = resolvePartnerReferralUrl(
    matchedOffer?.referralUrl || 'https://startuppreflight.com',
    {
      planId,
      domain,
      countryCode,
    }
  );

  // Fire-and-forget click log to PostgreSQL
  if (matchedOffer) {
    (async () => {
      try {
        await db.insert(partnerReferralEvents).values({
          partnerId: matchedOffer.id,
          partnerName: matchedOffer.name,
          partnerSlug: matchedOffer.slug,
          slotKey: matchedOffer.slotKey,
          eventType: 'AFFILIATE_CLICK',
          planId: planId || null,
          planTitle: planTitle || null,
          founderName: founderName || null,
          founderEmail: founderEmail || null,
          countryCode,
          selectedDomain: domain || null,
          destinationUrl: targetUrl,
          intakeAnswersJson: domain ? { claimed_domain: domain } : {},
          leadStatus: 'CLICKED',
          estimatedBountyAmount: matchedOffer.commissionBountySummary || null,
        });
      } catch {
        // Non-fatal if DB is offline
      }
    })();
  }

  return NextResponse.redirect(targetUrl, { status: 307 });
}
=== src/app/api/auth/google/route.ts ===
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import crypto from 'crypto';
import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
import { resolvePublicOrigin } from '@/lib/auth/oauth-helpers';

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const clientId = process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID?.trim();
  const clientSecret = process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET?.trim();

  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const from = url.searchParams.get('from') || 'login';
  const returnTo = url.searchParams.get('returnTo');
  const termsAccepted = url.searchParams.get('termsAccepted') === 'true';

  const origin = resolvePublicOrigin(req);

  if (from === 'register' && !termsAccepted) {
    const redirectUrl = new URL('/register', origin);
    redirectUrl.searchParams.set('error', 'terms_required');
    return NextResponse.redirect(redirectUrl);
  }

  // If Google OAuth credentials are not configured, redirect back with a helpful explanation
  if (!clientId || !clientSecret) {
    const fallbackPath = from === 'register' ? '/register' : '/login';
    const redirectUrl = new URL(fallbackPath, origin);
    redirectUrl.searchParams.set('error', 'missing_google_keys');
    return NextResponse.redirect(redirectUrl);
  }

  const redirectUri = `${origin}/api/auth/callback/google`;
  const state = crypto.randomBytes(24).toString('hex');

  const authUrl = new URL('https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth');
  authUrl.searchParams.set('client_id', clientId);
  authUrl.searchParams.set('redirect_uri', redirectUri);
  authUrl.searchParams.set('response_type', 'code');
  authUrl.searchParams.set('scope', 'openid email profile');
  authUrl.searchParams.set('state', state);
  authUrl.searchParams.set('access_type', 'offline');
  authUrl.searchParams.set('prompt', 'select_account');

  // Store CSRF state & original intent in a secure HttpOnly cookie (10 min TTL)
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  cookieStore.set(
    'spf_oauth_state',
    JSON.stringify({
      state,
      from: from === 'register' ? 'register' : 'login',
      returnTo: returnTo && returnTo.startsWith('/') ? returnTo : undefined,
    }),
    {
      httpOnly: true,
      sameSite: 'lax',
      secure: origin.startsWith('https://'),
      path: '/',
      maxAge: 10 * 60, // 10 minutes
    }
  );

  return NextResponse.redirect(authUrl.toString());
}
=== src/app/api/auth/callback/google/route.ts ===
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { db, ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced } from '@/db';
import { users, userEntitlements, startupPlans } from '@/db/schema';
import { setServerSessionCookie } from '@/lib/auth/server-auth';
import { ensureDefaultTenantId } from '@/app/actions/auth';
import { calculatePassLimits } from '@/lib/entitlements';
import { sendSystemEmail } from '@/lib/email/send';
import { EMAIL_DEFAULTS } from '@/lib/email/resend';
import { resolvePublicOrigin } from '@/lib/auth/oauth-helpers';

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const code = url.searchParams.get('code');
  const state = url.searchParams.get('state');
  const errorParam = url.searchParams.get('error');

  const origin = resolvePublicOrigin(req);

  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const rawSavedState = cookieStore.get('spf_oauth_state')?.value;
  let savedState: { state: string; from?: string; returnTo?: string } | null = null;

  if (rawSavedState) {
    try {
      savedState = JSON.parse(rawSavedState);
    } catch {
      savedState = { state: rawSavedState };
    }
  }

  // Clear state cookie immediately to prevent replay
  cookieStore.delete('spf_oauth_state');

  const fallbackPath = savedState?.from === 'register' ? '/register' : '/login';

  // Check if Google returned an error (e.g. user canceled consent)
  if (errorParam) {
    const redirectUrl = new URL(fallbackPath, origin);
    redirectUrl.searchParams.set(
      'error',
      errorParam === 'access_denied' ? 'oauth_denied' : 'oauth_error'
    );
    return NextResponse.redirect(redirectUrl);
  }

  // Check state and code
  if (!code || !state || !savedState || savedState.state !== state) {
    const redirectUrl = new URL(fallbackPath, origin);
    redirectUrl.searchParams.set('error', 'invalid_state');
    return NextResponse.redirect(redirectUrl);
  }

  const clientId = process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID?.trim();
  const clientSecret = process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET?.trim();

  if (!clientId || !clientSecret) {
    const redirectUrl = new URL(fallbackPath, origin);
    redirectUrl.searchParams.set('error', 'missing_google_keys');
    return NextResponse.redirect(redirectUrl);
  }

  const redirectUri = `${origin}/api/auth/callback/google`;

  // 1. Exchange authorization code for Google access token
  let tokenData: { access_token?: string; id_token?: string };
  try {
    const tokenRes = await fetch('https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
      body: new URLSearchParams({
        code,
        client_id: clientId,
        client_secret: clientSecret,
        redirect_uri: redirectUri,
        grant_type: 'authorization_code',
      }),
    });

    if (!tokenRes.ok) {
      const errText = await tokenRes.text();
      console.error('[SPF Google OAuth] Token exchange failed:', errText);
      const redirectUrl = new URL(fallbackPath, origin);
      redirectUrl.searchParams.set('error', 'oauth_exchange_failed');
      return NextResponse.redirect(redirectUrl);
    }

    tokenData = await tokenRes.json();
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[SPF Google OAuth] Network error during token exchange:', err);
    const redirectUrl = new URL(fallbackPath, origin);
    redirectUrl.searchParams.set('error', 'oauth_exchange_failed');
    return NextResponse.redirect(redirectUrl);
  }

  if (!tokenData.access_token) {
    const redirectUrl = new URL(fallbackPath, origin);
    redirectUrl.searchParams.set('error', 'oauth_exchange_failed');
    return NextResponse.redirect(redirectUrl);
  }

  // 2. Fetch user profile from Google UserInfo endpoint
  let googleProfile: {
    sub?: string;
    email?: string;
    name?: string;
    picture?: string;
    email_verified?: boolean;
  };
  try {
    const profileRes = await fetch('https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v3/userinfo', {
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${tokenData.access_token}`,
      },
    });

    if (!profileRes.ok) {
      const redirectUrl = new URL(fallbackPath, origin);
      redirectUrl.searchParams.set('error', 'oauth_profile_failed');
      return NextResponse.redirect(redirectUrl);
    }

    googleProfile = await profileRes.json();
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[SPF Google OAuth] Error fetching user profile:', err);
    const redirectUrl = new URL(fallbackPath, origin);
    redirectUrl.searchParams.set('error', 'oauth_profile_failed');
    return NextResponse.redirect(redirectUrl);
  }

  const cleanEmail = googleProfile.email?.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!cleanEmail) {
    const redirectUrl = new URL(fallbackPath, origin);
    redirectUrl.searchParams.set('error', 'oauth_no_email');
    return NextResponse.redirect(redirectUrl);
  }

  const cleanName =
    googleProfile.name?.trim() || cleanEmail.split('@')[0] || 'Founder';
  const cleanImage = googleProfile.picture || null;

  try {
    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

    // 3. Look up user by email in PostgreSQL
    const [existingUser] = await db
      .select()
      .from(users)
      .where(eq(users.email, cleanEmail))
      .limit(1);

    let userId: string;
    let isNewUser = false;

    if (existingUser) {
      if (
        existingUser.status === 'SUSPENDED' ||
        existingUser.status === 'SOFT_DELETED'
      ) {
        const redirectUrl = new URL(fallbackPath, origin);
        redirectUrl.searchParams.set('error', 'account_suspended');
        return NextResponse.redirect(redirectUrl);
      }

      userId = existingUser.id;

      // Update image and emailVerified if needed
      await db
        .update(users)
        .set({
          image: existingUser.image || cleanImage,
          emailVerified: true,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(users.id, existingUser.id));
    } else {
      isNewUser = true;
      const tenantId = await ensureDefaultTenantId();

      const [createdUser] = await db
        .insert(users)
        .values({
          tenantId,
          email: cleanEmail,
          name: cleanName,
          image: cleanImage,
          emailVerified: true,
          role: 'FOUNDER',
          status: 'ACTIVE',
          founderProfileJson: {
            termsAcceptedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            termsVersion: '2026-04',
          },
        })
        .returning();

      userId = createdUser.id;

      // Create initial FREE_HOOK entitlements
      const freeLimits = calculatePassLimits('FREE_HOOK');
      await db.insert(userEntitlements).values({
        userId: createdUser.id,
        planType: 'FREE_HOOK',
        stackedCodesCount: 0,
        maxStartupPlans: freeLimits.maxStartupPlans,
        maxSeatsPerPlan: freeLimits.maxSeatsPerPlan,
        monthlyAiCreditsLimit: freeLimits.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
        aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: 0,
        whiteLabelExportEnabled: false,
        isVaultReadonly: false,
      });

      // Fire welcome email asynchronously
      sendSystemEmail({
        to: cleanEmail,
        template: 'WELCOME_FOUNDER',
        subject:
          'Welcome to Startup Preflight — Your Founder Workspace is Ready',
        props: {
          founderName: cleanName,
          loginEmail: cleanEmail,
          loginUrl: `${EMAIL_DEFAULTS.appUrl}/workspace`,
          tierName: 'Free Ideation Hook',
          hqCountry: 'IE',
        },
        metadata: {
          userId: createdUser.id,
          trigger: 'GOOGLE_OAUTH_REGISTRATION',
        },
      }).catch((emailErr) => {
        console.error(
          '[SPF Email] Failed to send welcome email upon Google registration:',
          emailErr
        );
      });
    }

    // 4. Issue authenticated HttpOnly session cookie
    await setServerSessionCookie({
      userId,
      email: cleanEmail,
    });

    // 5. Route to onboarding for brand new users or founders without plans
    if (isNewUser) {
      return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/onboarding', origin));
    }

    const existingPlans = await db
      .select({ id: startupPlans.id })
      .from(startupPlans)
      .where(eq(startupPlans.ownerUserId, userId))
      .limit(1);

    if (existingPlans.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/onboarding', origin));
    }

    const destination =
      savedState?.returnTo && savedState.returnTo.startsWith('/')
        ? savedState.returnTo
        : '/workspace';

    return NextResponse.redirect(new URL(destination, origin));
  } catch (dbErr) {
    console.error('[SPF Google OAuth] Database error processing user:', dbErr);
    const redirectUrl = new URL(fallbackPath, origin);
    redirectUrl.searchParams.set('error', 'db_error');
    return NextResponse.redirect(redirectUrl);
  }
}
=== src/app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts ===
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { stripe } from '@/lib/stripe/client';
import { db } from '@/db';
import { userEntitlements, surveyBoostOrders } from '@/db/schema';
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { calculatePassLimits } from '@/lib/entitlements';
import type Stripe from 'stripe';

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const body = await req.text();
  const signature = req.headers.get('stripe-signature');
  const webhookSecret = process.env.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET;

  let event: Stripe.Event;

  try {
    if (webhookSecret) {
      if (!signature) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: 'Missing stripe-signature header' },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }
      event = stripe.webhooks.constructEvent(body, signature, webhookSecret);
    } else if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') {
      // Only in local dev without STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET configured
      event = JSON.parse(body) as Stripe.Event;
    } else {
      console.error('⚠️ STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is not configured in production!');
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: 'Webhook secret not configured' },
        { status: 500 }
      );
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('⚠️ Stripe Webhook signature verification failed:', err.message);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: `Webhook Error: ${err.message}` },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // Handle relevant Stripe event types
  switch (event.type) {
    case 'checkout.session.completed': {
      const session = event.data.object as Stripe.Checkout.Session;
      const orderType = session.metadata?.orderType;

      // 1. Handle Survey Boost Order Completion
      if (orderType === 'SURVEY_BOOST') {
        const orderId = session.metadata?.orderId;
        const paymentIntentId =
          typeof session.payment_intent === 'string'
            ? session.payment_intent
            : session.payment_intent?.id;

        if (orderId) {
          console.log(`🚀 Stripe: Survey Boost Order ${orderId} successfully paid!`);
          await db
            .update(surveyBoostOrders)
            .set({
              status: 'PAID',
              stripePaymentIntentId: paymentIntentId || null,
            })
            .where(eq(surveyBoostOrders.id, orderId as any));
        }
        break;
      }

      const userId = session.client_reference_id || session.metadata?.userId;
      const planType = session.metadata?.planType as
        | 'SIX_MONTH_SOLO'
        | 'SIX_MONTH_COFOUNDER'
        | 'LIVING_VAULT_MONTHLY'
        | undefined;
      const customerId =
        typeof session.customer === 'string'
          ? session.customer
          : session.customer?.id;

      if (!userId || !planType) {
        console.warn(
          'Stripe checkout session missing userId or planType metadata:',
          session.id
        );
        break;
      }

      console.log(
        `💳 Stripe Checkout completed for User ${userId}: Activating ${planType}`
      );

      if (planType === 'SIX_MONTH_SOLO' || planType === 'SIX_MONTH_COFOUNDER') {
        const limits = calculatePassLimits(planType, 6);

        await db
          .insert(userEntitlements)
          .values({
            userId,
            planType: limits.planType,
            maxStartupPlans: limits.maxStartupPlans,
            maxSeatsPerPlan: limits.maxSeatsPerPlan,
            monthlyAiCreditsLimit: limits.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
            accessExpiresAt: limits.accessExpiresAt,
            isVaultReadonly: false,
            stripeCustomerId: customerId || null,
            updatedAt: new Date(),
          })
          .onConflictDoUpdate({
            target: userEntitlements.userId,
            set: {
              planType: limits.planType,
              maxStartupPlans: limits.maxStartupPlans,
              maxSeatsPerPlan: limits.maxSeatsPerPlan,
              monthlyAiCreditsLimit: limits.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
              accessExpiresAt: limits.accessExpiresAt,
              isVaultReadonly: false,
              stripeCustomerId: customerId || undefined,
              updatedAt: new Date(),
            },
          });
      } else if (planType === 'LIVING_VAULT_MONTHLY') {
        // Living Vault extension: unfreeze vault and keep active
        const nextMonth = new Date();
        nextMonth.setMonth(nextMonth.getMonth() + 1);

        await db
          .update(userEntitlements)
          .set({
            isVaultReadonly: false,
            accessExpiresAt: nextMonth,
            stripeCustomerId: customerId || undefined,
            updatedAt: new Date(),
          })
          .where(eq(userEntitlements.userId, userId));
      }

      break;
    }

    case 'customer.subscription.deleted': {
      // Living Vault cancelled or lapsed
      const subscription = event.data.object as Stripe.Subscription;
      const customerId =
        typeof subscription.customer === 'string'
          ? subscription.customer
          : subscription.customer?.id;

      if (customerId) {
        console.log(
          `🔒 Stripe Subscription cancelled for customer ${customerId}: marking vault read-only`
        );
        await db
          .update(userEntitlements)
          .set({
            isVaultReadonly: true,
            updatedAt: new Date(),
          })
          .where(eq(userEntitlements.stripeCustomerId, customerId));
      }
      break;
    }

    default:
      // Ignore other events
      break;
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ received: true });
}

'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import {
  Sparkles,
  ArrowRight,
  Ticket,
  CheckCircle2,
  ChevronDown,
  Wrench,
  Loader2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { BrandLogo } from '@/components/ui/brand-logo';
import { GoogleIcon } from '@/components/ui/google-icon';
import {
  registerNewFounderSession,
  saveBmuSession,
} from '@/lib/auth/session-store';
import { registerFounderAction } from '@/app/actions/auth';

export default function RegisterPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [fullName, setFullName] = useState('');
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [showVoucherField, setShowVoucherField] = useState(false);
  const [voucherCode, setVoucherCode] = useState('');
  const [detectedCohortParam, setDetectedCohortParam] = useState<string | null>(
    null
  );
  const [acceptedTerms, setAcceptedTerms] = useState(false);
  const [termsHighlightError, setTermsHighlightError] = useState(false);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const cohortOrCode = (
        params.get('cohort') ||
        params.get('voucher') ||
        params.get('code') ||
        ''
      )
        .trim()
        .toUpperCase();
      if (cohortOrCode) {
        setVoucherCode(cohortOrCode);
        setShowVoucherField(true);
        setDetectedCohortParam(cohortOrCode);
      }
      const err = params.get('error');
      if (err) {
        const messages: Record<string, string> = {
          terms_required:
            'Please agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy before creating your account.',
          missing_google_keys:
            'Google Sign-In is not configured yet. Please add GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET to your .env file.',
          oauth_denied: 'Google registration was canceled or access was denied.',
          oauth_exchange_failed:
            'Failed to verify Google credentials. Please try again.',

            'Unable to retrieve your Google profile details. Please try again.',
          oauth_no_email:
            'No email address was returned by Google. Please check your Google account permissions.',
          invalid_state:
            'Security verification failed (state mismatch). Please try again.',
          account_suspended:
            'This account has been suspended. Please contact support.',
          db_error:
            'Database error during Google sign-up. Please try again or use standard registration.',
          oauth_error:
            'An error occurred during Google registration. Please try again.',
        };
        if (err === 'terms_required') {
          setTermsHighlightError(true);
        }
        setErrorMsg(messages[err] || 'Authentication error. Please try again.');
      }
    }
  }, []);

  function handleGoogleRegister() {
    setErrorMsg(null);
    if (!acceptedTerms) {
      setTermsHighlightError(true);
      setErrorMsg(
        'Please tick the box below to agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy before creating your account.'
      );
      const el = document.getElementById('accept-terms');
      if (el) {
        el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
        el.focus();
      }
      return;
    }
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    window.location.href = '/api/auth/google?from=register&termsAccepted=true';
  }

  async function handleRegisterSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMsg(null);

    if (!fullName.trim() || !email.trim() || !password.trim()) {
      setErrorMsg('Please enter your name, email address, and a password.');
      return;
    }

    if (password.trim().length < 6) {
      setErrorMsg('Password must be at least 6 characters.');
      return;
    }

    if (!acceptedTerms) {
      setTermsHighlightError(true);
      setErrorMsg(
        'Please agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy before creating your account.'
      );
      return;
    }

    // Voucher or cohort code is optional; if provided, server validates both vouchers and institutional cohorts.
    if (voucherCode.trim().length > 64) {
      setErrorMsg('Voucher or cohort code is too long. Please check the code.');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const result = await registerFounderAction({
        name: fullName,
        email,
        password,
        voucherOrCohortCode: voucherCode,
        acceptedTerms: true,
      });

      if (!result.ok) {
        setErrorMsg(result.error || 'Could not create your account.');
        setIsSubmitting(false);

      } else {

'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import {
  Sparkles,
  ArrowRight,
  UserCheck,
  Ticket,
  GraduationCap,
  ShieldAlert,
  Wrench,
  Loader2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { BrandLogo } from '@/components/ui/brand-logo';
import { GoogleIcon } from '@/components/ui/google-icon';
import {
  getDefaultDemoSession,
  hasActiveBmuSession,
  loadBmuSessionForEmail,
  recoverAllRealPlansFromBrowserStorage,
  saveBmuSession,
  type BmuLocalSession,
} from '@/lib/auth/session-store';
import {
  calculateAppSumoTierLimits,
  calculatePassLimits,
} from '@/lib/entitlements';
import { loginFounderAction } from '@/app/actions/auth';

export default function LoginPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const err = params.get('error');
      if (err) {
        const messages: Record<string, string> = {
          missing_google_keys:
            'Google Sign-In is not configured yet. Please add GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET to your .env file.',
          oauth_denied: 'Google sign-in was canceled or access was denied.',
          oauth_exchange_failed:
            'Failed to verify Google credentials. Please try signing in again.',
          oauth_profile_failed:
            'Unable to retrieve your Google profile details. Please try again.',
          oauth_no_email:
            'No email address was returned by Google. Please check your Google account permissions.',
          invalid_state:
            'Security verification failed (state mismatch). Please try again.',
          account_suspended:
            'This account has been suspended. Please contact support.',
          db_error:
            'Database error while signing in with Google. Please try again or use email login.',
          oauth_error:
            'An error occurred during Google sign-in. Please try again.',
        };
        setErrorMsg(messages[err] || 'Authentication error. Please try again.');
      }
    }

    if (hasActiveBmuSession()) {
      const returnUrl = typeof window !== 'undefined'
        ? new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('returnUrl') ||
          new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('redirect')
        : null;
      if (returnUrl && returnUrl.startsWith('/')) {
        router.replace(returnUrl);
      } else {
        router.replace('/workspace');
      }
    }
  }, [router]);

  async function handleStandardLogin(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMsg(null);

    const returnUrl = typeof window !== 'undefined'
      ? new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('returnUrl') ||
        new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('redirect')
      : null;
    const destination = returnUrl && returnUrl.startsWith('/') ? returnUrl : '/workspace';

    if (!email.trim() || !password.trim()) {
      setErrorMsg('Please enter both your email address and password.');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const result = await loginFounderAction({
        email,
        password,
      });

      if (!result.ok) {
        setErrorMsg(result.error || 'Invalid login credentials.');
        setIsSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }

      if (result.session) {
        const cachedForEmail = loadBmuSessionForEmail(result.session.user.email);
        const mergedSession: BmuLocalSession = cachedForEmail
          ? {
              ...result.session,
              plans: result.session.plans.map((dbPlan) => {
                const localMatch = cachedForEmail.plans.find(
                  (lp) => lp.id === dbPlan.id
                );
                if (!localMatch) return dbPlan;
                return {
                  ...localMatch,
                  ...dbPlan,
                  moduleBData: dbPlan.moduleBData || localMatch.moduleBData,
                  moduleCData: dbPlan.moduleCData || localMatch.moduleCData,
                  moduleDData: dbPlan.moduleDData || localMatch.moduleDData,
                  moduleEData: dbPlan.moduleEData || localMatch.moduleEData,
                };
              }),
            }
          : result.session;

        saveBmuSession(mergedSession);
        if (!mergedSession.user.onboardingCompleted && !returnUrl) {
          router.push('/onboarding');
        } else {
          router.replace(destination);
        }
        return;
      }

      // Offline / local fallback: restore per-email cached session or any recovered real plans
      const cachedForEmail = loadBmuSessionForEmail(email);
      if (cachedForEmail && cachedForEmail.plans.length > 0) {
        saveBmuSession(cachedForEmail);
      } else {
        const base = getDefaultDemoSession();
        base.user.email = email.trim();
        const recoveredPlans = recoverAllRealPlansFromBrowserStorage();
        if (recoveredPlans.length > 0) {
          base.plans = recoveredPlans;
          base.activePlanId = recoveredPlans[0].id;
        }
        saveBmuSession(base);
      }
      router.replace(destination);
    } catch {
      const cachedForEmail = loadBmuSessionForEmail(email);
      if (cachedForEmail && cachedForEmail.plans.length > 0) {
        saveBmuSession(cachedForEmail);
      } else {
        const base = getDefaultDemoSession();
        if (email.trim()) {
          base.user.email = email.trim();
        }
        const recoveredPlans = recoverAllRealPlansFromBrowserStorage();
        if (recoveredPlans.length > 0) {
          base.plans = recoveredPlans;
          base.activePlanId = recoveredPlans[0].id;
        }
        saveBmuSession(base);
      }
      router.replace(destination);
    }
  }

  function handleGoogleLogin() {
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setErrorMsg(null);
    const returnUrl = typeof window !== 'undefined'
      ? new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('returnUrl') ||
        new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('redirect')
      : null;
    const dest = returnUrl && returnUrl.startsWith('/')
      ? `/api/auth/google?from=login&returnTo=${encodeURIComponent(returnUrl)}`
      : '/api/auth/google?from=login';
    window.location.href = dest;
  }

  function loginWithDevPersona(
    persona: 'FREE' | 'APPSUMO_T2' | 'UCD_COHORT' | 'SUPER_ADMIN'
  ) {
    const base = getDefaultDemoSession();

    if (persona === 'FREE') {
      saveBmuSession(base);
    } else if (persona === 'APPSUMO_T2') {
      const sumo = calculateAppSumoTierLimits(2);
      const session: BmuLocalSession = {
        ...base,
        user: {
          ...base.user,
          name: 'Liam O’Connor',
          email: 'appsumo@startuppreflight.com',
        },
        entitlement: {
          userId: 'user-liam-sumo',
          planType: 'APPSUMO_LTD',
          stackedCodesCount: 2,
          maxStartupPlans: sumo.maxStartupPlans,
          maxSeatsPerPlan: sumo.maxSeatsPerPlan,
          monthlyAiCreditsLimit: sumo.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
          aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: 24,
          whiteLabelExportEnabled: false,
          isVaultReadonly: false,
        },
        redeemedCodes: ['SUMO-SPF-1001-ALPHA', 'SUMO-SPF-1002-BRAVO'],
      };
      saveBmuSession(session);
    } else if (persona === 'UCD_COHORT') {
      const cohort = calculatePassLimits('COHORT_PASS', 6);
      const session: BmuLocalSession = {
        ...base,
        user: {
          ...base.user,
          name: 'Ciara Murphy',
          email: 'ciara@ucdconnect.ie',
          founderStage: 'ACCELERATOR_COHORT',
          cohortCode: 'SPF-UCD-2027',
        },
        entitlement: {
          userId: 'user-ciara-cohort',
          planType: 'COHORT_PASS',
          stackedCodesCount: 0,
          maxStartupPlans: cohort.maxStartupPlans,
          maxSeatsPerPlan: cohort.maxSeatsPerPlan,
          monthlyAiCreditsLimit: cohort.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
          aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: 15,
          whiteLabelExportEnabled: false,
          accessExpiresAt: cohort.accessExpiresAt,
          isVaultReadonly: false,
        },
      };
      saveBmuSession(session);
    } else if (persona === 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
      const sumo3 = calculateAppSumoTierLimits(5);
      const session: BmuLocalSession = {
        ...base,
        user: {
          ...base.user,
          name: 'Tomo (Super Admin)',
          email: 'admin@startuppreflight.com',
          role: 'SUPER_ADMIN',
        },
        entitlement: {
          userId: 'user-admin',
          planType: 'APPSUMO_LTD',
          stackedCodesCount: 5,
          maxStartupPlans: sumo3.maxStartupPlans,
          maxSeatsPerPlan: sumo3.maxSeatsPerPlan,
          monthlyAiCreditsLimit: 5000,
          aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: 0,
          whiteLabelExportEnabled: true,
          isVaultReadonly: false,
        },
      };
      saveBmuSession(session);
    }

    router.replace('/workspace');
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col justify-between bg-slate-50">
      {/* Main Centered Login Card */}
      <main className="flex flex-1 flex-col justify-center px-6 py-12">
        <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-md space-y-6">
          <div className="space-y-2 text-center">
            <Link href="/" className="inline-flex items-center justify-center">
              <BrandLogo variant="full" size="md" theme="light" />
            </Link>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
              Sign in to access your Startup Plans and AI Co-Founder Workspace.
            </p>
          </div>

          <Card className="border-slate-200 shadow-md">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="text-lg">Welcome Back</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>
                Continue with Google or your email address.
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-5">
              {/* OAuth Buttons */}
              <div>
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="outline"
                  className="w-full h-10 text-xs font-medium border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 flex items-center justify-center gap-2.5 shadow-xs transition-colors"
                  onClick={handleGoogleLogin}
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                >
                  <GoogleIcon className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                  <span>Continue with Google</span>
                </Button>
              </div>

              <div className="relative flex items-center justify-center">

];

const STARTUP_HATS_OPTIONS: Array<{ id: StartupHat; label: string }> = [
  { id: 'PRODUCT_TECH', label: '💻 Product & Tech Build' },
  { id: 'SALES', label: '🤝 Sales & Commercial' },
  { id: 'MARKETING', label: '📣 Marketing & Growth' },
  { id: 'OPERATIONS_ADMIN', label: '⚙️ Operations & Domain Expert' },
  { id: 'VISION_INVESTOR', label: '🧭 Vision & Strategy' },
  { id: 'FINANCE_BOOKS', label: '📊 Finance & Numbers' },
];

const INDUSTRY_OPTIONS: IndustryCategory[] = [
  'B2B SaaS / AI App',
  'Consumer App / Marketplace',
  'E-Commerce / Physical Product / Food & Drink',
  'Service / Agency / Consulting',
  'Hardware / MedTech / DeepTech',
  'Brick & Mortar / Hospitality / Local Business',
];

export default function OnboardingPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [founderName, setFounderName] = useState('Founder');

  // Card A State: About the Founder
  const [founderStage, setFounderStage] =
    useState<FounderStage>('IDEA_EXPLORER');
  const [teamStructure, setTeamStructure] = useState<TeamStructure>('SOLO');
  const [primaryHat, setPrimaryHat] = useState<StartupHat>('PRODUCT_TECH');
  const [regionOrCounty, setRegionOrCounty] = useState('Dublin');

  // Card B State: First Startup Plan Setup
  const [planTitle, setPlanTitle] = useState('');
  const [oneLinerSummary, setOneLinerSummary] = useState('');
  const [hqCountryCode, setHqCountryCode] =
    useState<SupportedCountryCode>('IE');
  const [fundingTrackMode, setFundingTrackMode] = useState<
    'GRANT_AND_INVESTOR' | 'COMMERCIAL_ONLY'
  >('GRANT_AND_INVESTOR');
  const [industryCategory, setIndustryCategory] =
    useState<IndustryCategory>('B2B SaaS / AI App');
  const [exportPotential, setExportPotential] = useState<
    'DOMESTIC_ONLY' | 'EXPORTING_INTERNATIONALLY'
  >('EXPORTING_INTERNATIONALLY');
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const isGrantRegion = hqCountryCode === 'IE' || hqCountryCode === 'GB';
  const effectiveTrackMode: 'GRANT_AND_INVESTOR' | 'COMMERCIAL_ONLY' =
    isGrantRegion ? fundingTrackMode : 'COMMERCIAL_ONLY';

  useEffect(() => {
    const session = loadBmuSession();
    if (session?.user?.name) {
      setFounderName(session.user.name);
    } else {
      // If arriving straight from Google OAuth callback without local storage pre-existing
      getCurrentCloudSessionAction()
        .then((res) => {
          if (res.authenticated && res.session) {
            saveBmuSession(res.session);
            if (res.session.user.name) {
              setFounderName(res.session.user.name);
            }
          }
        })
        .catch(() => {});
    }

    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const cookieMatch = document.cookie.match(/(?:^|;\s*)spf_region=([^;]+)/);
      const savedRegion = (
        cookieMatch?.[1] ||
        window.localStorage.getItem('spf_region') ||
        ''
      )
        .trim()
        .toUpperCase();

      const validCodes: SupportedCountryCode[] = [
        'IE',
        'GB',
        'US',
        'AU',
        'CA',
        'EU',
        'ROW',
      ];
      if (validCodes.includes(savedRegion as SupportedCountryCode)) {
        const code = savedRegion as SupportedCountryCode;
        setHqCountryCode(code);
        const defaultCityMap: Record<SupportedCountryCode, string> = {
          IE: 'Dublin',
          GB: 'London',
          US: 'Austin, TX',
          AU: 'Sydney',
          CA: 'Toronto',
          EU: 'Amsterdam',
          ROW: 'Global',
        };
        setRegionOrCounty(defaultCityMap[code]);
      }
    }
  }, []);

  const countryPack = getCountryRulePack(hqCountryCode);
  const countryGrants = getGrantsForCountry(hqCountryCode);

  async function handleCompleteOnboarding(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsSubmitting(true);

    const payload = {
      founderStage,
      teamStructure,
      primaryHat,
      regionOrCounty,
      planTitle: planTitle.trim() || 'GreenCart AI — Zero-Waste Grocery',
      oneLinerSummary:
        oneLinerSummary.trim() ||
        'Automated expiry prediction & dynamic markdowns for independent supermarkets.',
      hqCountryCode,
      industryCategory,
      exportPotential,
      fundingTrackMode: effectiveTrackMode,
    };

    try {
      const result = await completeOnboardingAction(payload);
      if (result.session) {
        saveBmuSession(result.session);
      } else {
        completeFounderOnboarding(payload);
      }
    } catch {
      completeFounderOnboarding(payload);
    }

    router.push('/workspace');
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 py-10 px-6">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-4xl space-y-6">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <PreflightMark size={40} />
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900">
                  Welcome, {founderName}! Let&apos;s Set Up Your First Workspace
                </h1>
                <Badge variant="default">Step 2 of 2 (60 Seconds)</Badge>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                This configures your AI Co-Pilot examples, local tax &amp; payroll benchmarks, and government grant matcher.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <GlobalFeedbackButton variant="header-pill" userName={founderName} />
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleCompleteOnboarding} className="space-y-6">
          {/* CARD A: ABOUT YOU AS A FOUNDER */}
          <Card className="border-slate-200 shadow-xs">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base">
                <UserCircle2 className="h-5 w-5 text-indigo-600" />
                Part 1: About You as a Founder
              </CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>
                Helps Ask Preflight AI tailor its guidance and pre-fills your Day-1 Startup Hats in Module C.
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-5">
              {/* Stage Selector */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>1. Where are you right now on your journey?</Label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2.5 sm:grid-cols-2">
                  {FOUNDER_STAGES.map((stage) => (
                    <button
                      key={stage.id}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setFounderStage(stage.id)}
                      className={`rounded-xl border p-3 text-left transition ${
                        founderStage === stage.id
                          ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50/70 ring-1 ring-indigo-600'
                          : 'border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
                        {stage.label}
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                        {stage.desc}
                      </div>
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Solo vs Co-Founders + Primary Superpower Hat */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>2. Are you building Solo or with Co-Founders?</Label>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                    {[
                      { id: 'SOLO', label: 'Solo Founder' },
                      { id: 'CO_FOUNDERS', label: 'With Co-Founders' },
                      { id: 'LOOKING_FOR_COFOUNDER', label: 'Seeking Co-Founder' },
                    ].map((t) => (
                      <button
                        key={t.id}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() =>
                          setTeamStructure(t.id as TeamStructure)
                        }
                        className={`rounded-lg border px-2.5 py-2 text-xs font-medium ${
                          teamStructure === t.id
                            ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                            : 'border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {t.label}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>3. Your #1 Superpower (Pre-fills Module C Hats)</Label>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                    {STARTUP_HATS_OPTIONS.map((hat) => (
                      <button
                        key={hat.id}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setPrimaryHat(hat.id)}
                        className={`rounded-lg border px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium ${
                          primaryHat === hat.id
                            ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                            : 'border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {hat.label}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          {/* CARD B: YOUR FIRST STARTUP WORKSPACE & LOCALIZATION */}
          <Card className="border-slate-200 shadow-xs">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base">
                <Rocket className="h-5 w-5 text-indigo-600" />
                Part 2: Your First Startup Plan &amp; Jurisdiction Rules
              </CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>
                You can create or clone additional plans anytime. Every plan has its own Home Country, Currency, and Grant Rules.
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-5">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <Label htmlFor="plan-title">
                    Working Title or Codename for Your Idea
                  </Label>
                  <Input
                    id="plan-title"
                    placeholder="e.g. GreenCart AI (or Project Apollo)"
                    value={planTitle}
                    onChange={(e) => setPlanTitle(e.target.value)}
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <Label htmlFor="region-county">
                    {isGrantRegion
                      ? 'City / County / Region (For Local LEO / Growth Hub Matching)'
                      : 'City / State / Region'}
                  </Label>
                  <Input
                    id="region-county"
                    placeholder="e.g. Dublin, Galway, London, Austin"
                    value={regionOrCounty}
                    onChange={(e) => setRegionOrCounty(e.target.value)}

              {/* HQ Country & Base Currency Selector */}
              <div className="space-y-2">

                  <Globe2 className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-600" />
                  Home / Incorporation Country &amp; Base Currency
                </Label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-4 md:grid-cols-7">
                  {(
                    [
                      { code: 'IE', flag: '🇮🇪', label: 'Ireland (€)' },
                      { code: 'GB', flag: '🇬🇧', label: 'UK (£)' },
                      { code: 'US', flag: '🇺🇸', label: 'USA ($)' },
                      { code: 'AU', flag: '🇦🇺', label: 'Australia ($)' },
                      { code: 'CA', flag: '🇨🇦', label: 'Canada ($)' },
                      { code: 'EU', flag: '🇪🇺', label: 'EU (€)' },
                      { code: 'ROW', flag: '🌍', label: 'Global ($)' },

                    >
                      <span className="text-lg">{c.flag}</span>

                </div>

                {/* Funding Track Selector for IE & GB (Option 3: Commercial Track Opt-Out) */}
                {isGrantRegion && (

                    <Label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-emerald-900">

                      {countryPack.standardTaxRatePercent}%)

                    <div className="rounded-lg bg-white/80 p-2">
                      <strong>Payroll Tax:</strong>{' '}
                      {countryPack.employerPayrollTaxName} (
                      {countryPack.employerPayrollTaxPercent}%)

                    <div className="rounded-lg bg-white/80 p-2">
                      {effectiveTrackMode === 'GRANT_AND_INVESTOR' ? (

                          active ({countryGrants[0]?.grantName ?? 'National R&D'})
                        </>

                        </>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Industry Category Selector */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Building2 className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-600" />
                  Industry / Business Model (Tailors &ldquo;Show Me an Example&rdquo; Coaching)
                </Label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3">
                  {INDUSTRY_OPTIONS.map((ind) => (
                    <button
                      key={ind}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setIndustryCategory(ind)}
                      className={`rounded-xl border px-3 py-2.5 text-left text-xs font-medium transition ${
                        industryCategory === ind
                          ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-2xs'
                          : 'border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50'

                    >
                      {ind}

                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Target Selling Geography */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Coins className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-600" />
                  {effectiveTrackMode === 'GRANT_AND_INVESTOR'
                    ? 'Where Will Your Customers Live? (Informs Export Grant Eligibility)'
                    : 'Where Will Your Customers Live? (Target Market Scope)'}

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setExportPotential('DOMESTIC_ONLY')}
                    className={`rounded-xl border p-3 text-left text-xs ${
                      exportPotential === 'DOMESTIC_ONLY'
                        ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50/70 font-semibold text-indigo-950 ring-1 ring-indigo-600'
                        : 'border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-700'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div>🏠 Domestic / Local Market Only ({countryPack.countryName})</div>

                    <div>🌍 International / Global Market Potential</div>
                    <div className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] font-normal text-slate-500">
                      {effectiveTrackMode === 'GRANT_AND_INVESTOR'
                        ? 'Unlocks export-focused grants (e.g. LEO Feasibility/Priming, Enterprise Ireland PSSF).'
                        : 'Selling across multiple countries or global online markets.'}

                  </button>

              {/* Optional Quick 1-Sentence Idea Teaser */}
              <div className="space-y-1.5">

                  Optional: In 1 messy sentence, what is the idea? (You can refine this in Module A next)
                </Label>
                <Input
                  id="one-liner"

                  value={oneLinerSummary}
                  onChange={(e) => setOneLinerSummary(e.target.value)}
                />
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-end border-t border-slate-100 pt-4">
                <Button type="submit" size="lg" disabled={isSubmitting}>
                  {isSubmitting ? (
                    <>
                      <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                      Saving Workspace to Cloud...
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      Launch My Startup Workspace (Module A)
                      <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4" />
                    </>
                  )}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function inferPresetFromEntitlement(
  ent: AdminUserRecord['entitlement']
): AccountPresetType {
  if (ent.planType === 'APPSUMO_LTD') {
    if (ent.stackedCodesCount >= 3 || ent.whiteLabelExportEnabled) {
      return 'LIFETIME_FULL';
    }
    if (ent.stackedCodesCount === 2) {
      return 'APPSUMO_T2';
    }
    return 'APPSUMO_T1';
  }
  if (ent.planType === 'SIX_MONTH_COFOUNDER') return 'SIX_MONTH_COFOUNDER';
  if (ent.planType === 'SIX_MONTH_SOLO') return 'SIX_MONTH_SOLO';
  if (ent.planType === 'COHORT_PASS') return 'COHORT_PASS';
  return 'FREE_HOOK';
}

function isLifetimeFullAccess(ent: AdminUserRecord['entitlement']): boolean {
  return (
    ent.planType === 'APPSUMO_LTD' &&
    (ent.stackedCodesCount >= 3 || ent.whiteLabelExportEnabled)
  );
}

const LOCAL_STORAGE_DELETED_USERS_KEY = 'spf_admin_deleted_user_ids_v1';
const LOCAL_STORAGE_STATUS_OVERRIDES_KEY = 'spf_admin_user_status_overrides_v1';

function getLocalDeletedUserIds(): string[] {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return [];
  try {
    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_STORAGE_DELETED_USERS_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function addLocalDeletedUserId(id: string) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    const list = getLocalDeletedUserIds();
    if (!list.includes(id)) {
      list.push(id);
      window.localStorage.setItem(
        LOCAL_STORAGE_DELETED_USERS_KEY,
        JSON.stringify(list)
      );
    }
  } catch {}
}

function getLocalStatusOverrides(): Record<
  string,
  {
    status: UserStatusType;
    deletedAt: string | null;
    suspensionReason: string | null;
  }
> {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return {};
  try {
    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_STORAGE_STATUS_OVERRIDES_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

function setLocalStatusOverride(
  userId: string,
  data: {
    status: UserStatusType;
    deletedAt: string | null;
    suspensionReason: string | null;
  }
) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    const overrides = getLocalStatusOverrides();
    overrides[userId] = data;
    window.localStorage.setItem(
      LOCAL_STORAGE_STATUS_OVERRIDES_KEY,
      JSON.stringify(overrides)
    );
  } catch {}
}
