export default function AdminDashboardPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [usersList, setUsersList] = useState<AdminUserRecord[]>([]);
  const [waitlistLeads, setWaitlistLeads] = useState<EarlyAccessLeadRecord[]>(
    []
  );
  const [supportTicketsList, setSupportTicketsList] = useState<
    SupportTicketRecord[]
  >([]);
  const [vouchersList, setVouchersList] = useState<AdminVoucherSummary[]>([]);
  const [cohortsList, setCohortsList] = useState<AdminCohortSummary[]>([]);
  const [cohortInquiriesList, setCohortInquiriesList] = useState<
    AdminCohortInquiryRecord[]
  >([]);
  const [voucherStats, setVoucherStats] = useState<{
    totalVouchers: number;
    unclaimedVouchers: number;
    redeemedVouchers: number;
    refundedVouchers: number;
    totalCohorts: number;
  }>({
    totalVouchers: 0,
    unclaimedVouchers: 0,
    redeemedVouchers: 0,
    refundedVouchers: 0,
    totalCohorts: 0,
  });
  const [partnerOffersList, setPartnerOffersList] = useState<
    PartnerOfferRecord[]
  >([]);
  const [partnerReferralEventsList, setPartnerReferralEventsList] = useState<
    PartnerReferralEventRecord[]
  >([]);
  const [grantsList, setGrantsList] = useState<GrantDirectoryRecord[]>([]);
  const [activeAdminSection, setActiveAdminSection] = useState<
    | 'ACCOUNTS_AND_WAITLIST'
    | 'GRANTS_CATALOG'
    | 'SURVEY_BOOST'
    | 'VOUCHERS_AND_COHORTS'
    | 'PARTNERS_AND_REFERRALS'
    | 'SYSTEM_EMAILS'
    | 'SUPPORT_AND_BUGS'
    | 'PERSONA_UX_LAB'
  >('ACCOUNTS_AND_WAITLIST');
  const [adminAuthenticated, setAdminAuthenticated] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [adminEmail, setAdminEmail] = useState<string>('');
  const [dbConnected, setDbConnected] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<StatusFilterTab>('ALL_ACTIVE');
  const [bannerMessage, setBannerMessage] = useState<{
    type: 'success' | 'warning';
    text: string;
  } | null>(null);
  const [busyUserId, setBusyUserId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Modals state
  const [suspendModalUser, setSuspendModalUser] =
    useState<AdminUserRecord | null>(null);
  const [suspensionReasonInput, setSuspensionReasonInput] =
    useState<string>('');

  const [deleteModalUser, setDeleteModalUser] =
    useState<AdminUserRecord | null>(null);
  const [deleteModalMode, setDeleteModalMode] =
    useState<'CHOOSE' | 'PURGE'>('CHOOSE');
  const [deleteConfirmEmail, setDeleteConfirmEmail] = useState<string>('');

  const [notesModalUser, setNotesModalUser] =
    useState<AdminUserRecord | null>(null);
  const [notesInput, setNotesInput] = useState<string>('');
  const [roleInput, setRoleInput] = useState<UserRoleType>('FOUNDER');

  async function fetchUsers() {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const [res, waitlistRes, supportRes, voucherRes, partnersRes, grantsRes, inquiriesRes] =
        await Promise.all([
          listAdminUsersAction(),
          listEarlyAccessWaitlistAction(),
          listSupportTicketsAction(),
          listAdminVouchersAndCohortsAction(),
          listAdminPartnersAndEventsAction(),
          listAdminGrantsAction(),
          listCohortInquiriesAdminAction(),
        ]);
      if (!res.authenticated) {
        router.replace('/admin/login');
        return;
      }
      setAdminAuthenticated(true);
      setAdminEmail(res.adminEmail || 'admin@startuppreflight.com');
      setDbConnected(res.dbConnected);

      if (grantsRes.success) {
        setGrantsList(grantsRes.grants);
      }

      const deletedIds = getLocalDeletedUserIds();
      if (res.dbConnected && res.users.length > 0) {
        setUsersList(res.users.filter((u) => !deletedIds.includes(u.id)));
      } else if (res.dbConnected && res.users.length === 0) {
        setUsersList([]);
      } else {
        setUsersList(getDemoFallbackAdminUsers());
      }

      // Merge server/PostgreSQL waitlist leads with any browser-cached local leads
      const mergedMap = new Map<string, EarlyAccessLeadRecord>();
      for (const lead of waitlistRes.leads || []) {
        mergedMap.set(lead.email.toLowerCase(), lead);
      }
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        try {
          const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(
            'bmu_early_access_waitlist_v1'
          );
          const localLeads: EarlyAccessLeadRecord[] = raw
            ? JSON.parse(raw)
            : [];
          for (const localLead of localLeads) {
            if (!mergedMap.has(localLead.email.toLowerCase())) {
              mergedMap.set(localLead.email.toLowerCase(), localLead);
            }
          }
        } catch {
          // ignore localStorage errors
        }
      }
      setWaitlistLeads(Array.from(mergedMap.values()));

      // Merge server/PostgreSQL support & bug tracker items with local browser-cached items
      const localTickets = loadLocalSupportTickets();
      const mergedTickets = mergeSupportTickets(
        supportRes.tickets || [],
        localTickets
      );
      setSupportTicketsList(mergedTickets);
      saveLocalSupportTickets(mergedTickets);

      // Set vouchers and cohorts
      if (voucherRes.ok) {
        setVouchersList(voucherRes.vouchers);
        setCohortsList(voucherRes.cohorts);
        setVoucherStats(voucherRes.stats);
      }

      if (inquiriesRes.ok) {
        setCohortInquiriesList(inquiriesRes.inquiries);
      }

      // Merge server/PostgreSQL partner offers & referral events with local cache
      if (partnersRes.ok) {
        if (partnersRes.dbConnected && partnersRes.offers.length > 0) {
          setPartnerOffersList(partnersRes.offers);
          saveLocalPartnerOffers(partnersRes.offers);
        } else {
          const localOffers = loadLocalPartnerOffers();
          setPartnerOffersList(
            localOffers.length > 0 ? localOffers : partnersRes.offers
          );
        }

        const localEvents = loadLocalReferralEvents();
        const eventMap = new Map<string, PartnerReferralEventRecord>();
        for (const ev of partnersRes.events || []) {
          eventMap.set(ev.id, ev);
        }
        for (const ev of localEvents) {
          if (!eventMap.has(ev.id)) {
            eventMap.set(ev.id, ev);
          }
        }
        const mergedEvents = Array.from(eventMap.values()).sort((a, b) =>
          b.createdAt.localeCompare(a.createdAt)
        );
        setPartnerReferralEventsList(mergedEvents);
        saveLocalReferralEvents(mergedEvents);
      }
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleCreateSupportTicket(input: {
    ticketType: SupportTicketType;
    customTypeText?: string | null;
    priority: SupportTicketPriority;
    moduleScope: SupportModuleScope;
    stepContext?: string | null;
    pageUrl?: string | null;
    title: string;
    description: string;
    expectedBehavior?: string | null;
    adminNotes?: string | null;
  }) {
    const res = await createSupportTicketAction({
      ...input,
      source: 'ADMIN_TRACKER',
      reporterEmail: adminEmail || 'admin@startuppreflight.com',
    });
    if (res.ok && res.ticket) {
      const updated = upsertLocalSupportTicket(res.ticket);
      setSupportTicketsList((prev) => mergeSupportTickets([res.ticket!], prev));
      saveLocalSupportTickets(updated);
      setBannerMessage({
        type: 'success',
        text: `Logged "${res.ticket.title}" to the Support & Bug Tracker.`,
      });
    } else if (res.error) {
      setBannerMessage({
        type: 'warning',
        text: res.error,
      });
    }
  }

  async function handleUpdateSupportTicket(input: {
    id: string;
    status?: SupportTicketStatus;
    priority?: SupportTicketPriority;
    ticketType?: SupportTicketType;
    customTypeText?: string | null;
    moduleScope?: SupportModuleScope;
    stepContext?: string | null;
    title?: string;
    description?: string;
    expectedBehavior?: string | null;
    adminNotes?: string | null;
  }) {
    await updateSupportTicketAction(input);
    setSupportTicketsList((prev) => {
      const next = prev.map((t) => {
        if (t.id !== input.id) return t;
        return {
          ...t,
          status: input.status ?? t.status,
          priority: input.priority ?? t.priority,
          ticketType: input.ticketType ?? t.ticketType,
          customTypeText:
            input.customTypeText !== undefined
              ? input.customTypeText
              : t.customTypeText,
          moduleScope: input.moduleScope ?? t.moduleScope,
          stepContext:
            input.stepContext !== undefined ? input.stepContext : t.stepContext,
          title: input.title !== undefined ? input.title : t.title,
          description:
            input.description !== undefined ? input.description : t.description,
          expectedBehavior:
            input.expectedBehavior !== undefined
              ? input.expectedBehavior
              : t.expectedBehavior,
          adminNotes:
            input.adminNotes !== undefined ? input.adminNotes : t.adminNotes,
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        };
      });
      saveLocalSupportTickets(next);
      return next;
    });
    setBannerMessage({
      type: 'success',
      text: 'Updated ticket in Support & Bug Tracker.',
    });
  }

  async function handleDeleteSupportTicket(id: string) {
    await deleteSupportTicketAction({ id });
    removeLocalSupportTicket(id);
    setSupportTicketsList((prev) => prev.filter((t) => t.id !== id));
    setBannerMessage({
      type: 'warning',
      text: 'Deleted item from Support & Bug Tracker.',
    });
  }

  async function handleToggleWaitlistStatus(lead: EarlyAccessLeadRecord) {
    const nextStatus: 'PENDING' | 'INVITED' =
      lead.status === 'INVITED' ? 'PENDING' : 'INVITED';
    await updateEarlyAccessLeadStatusAction({
      id: lead.id,
      status: nextStatus,
    });
    setWaitlistLeads((prev) => {
      const updated = prev.map((item) =>
        item.email.toLowerCase() === lead.email.toLowerCase()
          ? { ...item, status: nextStatus }
          : item
      );
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        window.localStorage.setItem(
          'bmu_early_access_waitlist_v1',
          JSON.stringify(updated)
        );
      }
      return updated;
    });
  }

  async function handleDeleteWaitlistLead(lead: EarlyAccessLeadRecord) {
    await deleteEarlyAccessLeadAction({ id: lead.id });
    setWaitlistLeads((prev) => {
      const updated = prev.filter(
        (item) => item.email.toLowerCase() !== lead.email.toLowerCase()
      );
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        window.localStorage.setItem(
          'bmu_early_access_waitlist_v1',
          JSON.stringify(updated)
        );
      }
      return updated;
    });
    setBannerMessage({
      type: 'warning',
      text: `Removed ${lead.email} from the Early-Access Waitlist.`,
    });
  }

  function handleExportWaitlistCsv() {
    if (waitlistLeads.length === 0) return;
    const header = [
      'Email',
      'Jurisdiction',
      'Custom Region',
      'Status',
      'Signed Up At',
    ];
    const rows = waitlistLeads.map((l) => [
      `"${l.email.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
      `"${l.jurisdictionCode}"`,
      `"${(l.customJurisdictionText || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
      `"${l.status}"`,
      `"${l.createdAt}"`,
    ]);
    const csvContent = [header.join(','), ...rows.map((r) => r.join(','))].join(
      '\n'
    );
    const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url;
    link.setAttribute(
      'download',
      `bmu-early-access-waitlist-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`
    );
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }

  async function handleCopyWaitlistEmails() {
    if (waitlistLeads.length === 0) return;
    const emailsText = waitlistLeads.map((l) => l.email).join(', ');
    if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.clipboard) {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(emailsText);
      setBannerMessage({
        type: 'success',
        text: `Copied ${waitlistLeads.length} early-access email address(es) to clipboard.`,
      });
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      if (params.get('tab') === 'support') {
        setActiveAdminSection('SUPPORT_AND_BUGS');
      } else if (params.get('tab') === 'persona-lab') {
        setActiveAdminSection('PERSONA_UX_LAB');
      } else if (params.get('tab') === 'vouchers') {
        setActiveAdminSection('VOUCHERS_AND_COHORTS');
      } else if (params.get('tab') === 'partners') {
        setActiveAdminSection('PARTNERS_AND_REFERRALS');
      }
    }
    fetchUsers();
  }, []);

  /**
   * If the updated user matches the active browser session user, sync the new entitlement to localStorage
   * so returning to /workspace immediately reflects Lifetime Full Access!
   */
  function syncLocalBrowserSessionIfMatching(
    userId: string,
    email: string,
    updatedEnt: AdminUserRecord['entitlement'],
    updatedRole?: UserRoleType
  ) {
    const currentLocal = loadBmuSession();
    if (
      currentLocal.user.id === userId ||
      currentLocal.user.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase()
    ) {
      saveBmuSession({
        ...currentLocal,
        user: {
          ...currentLocal.user,
          role: updatedRole || currentLocal.user.role,
        },
        entitlement: {
          userId: currentLocal.user.id,
          planType: updatedEnt.planType,
          stackedCodesCount: updatedEnt.stackedCodesCount,
          maxStartupPlans: updatedEnt.maxStartupPlans,
          maxSeatsPerPlan: updatedEnt.maxSeatsPerPlan,
          monthlyAiCreditsLimit: updatedEnt.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
          aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: updatedEnt.aiCreditsUsedThisMonth,
          whiteLabelExportEnabled: updatedEnt.whiteLabelExportEnabled,
          accessExpiresAt: updatedEnt.accessExpiresAt
            ? new Date(updatedEnt.accessExpiresAt)
            : null,
          isVaultReadonly: updatedEnt.isVaultReadonly,
        },
      });
    }
  }

  async function handlePresetChange(
    user: AdminUserRecord,
    preset: AccountPresetType
  ) {
    setBusyUserId(user.id);
    setBannerMessage(null);
    try {
      const res = await updateUserEntitlementPresetAction({
        userId: user.id,
        preset,
      });
      if (res.updatedEntitlement) {
        const newEnt = res.updatedEntitlement;
        setUsersList((prev) =>
          prev.map((u) =>
            u.id === user.id ? { ...u, entitlement: newEnt } : u
          )
        );
        syncLocalBrowserSessionIfMatching(user.id, user.email, newEnt);

        const presetMeta = PRESET_OPTIONS.find((p) => p.value === preset);
        setBannerMessage({
          type: 'success',
          text: `Updated ${user.name} (${user.email}) to ${
            presetMeta?.shortBadge || preset
          }. All permissions and limits are live immediately.`,
        });
      }
    } finally {
      setBusyUserId(null);
    }
  }

  async function handleResetAiCredits(user: AdminUserRecord) {
    setBusyUserId(user.id);
    try {
      await resetUserAiCreditsAction({ userId: user.id });
      setUsersList((prev) =>
        prev.map((u) =>
          u.id === user.id
            ? {
                ...u,
                entitlement: { ...u.entitlement, aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: 0 },
              }
            : u
        )
      );
      setBannerMessage({
        type: 'success',
        text: `Reset monthly AI credits to 0 used for ${user.name}.`,
      });
    } finally {
      setBusyUserId(null);
    }
  }

  async function handleConfirmSuspend() {
    if (!suspendModalUser) return;
    const target = suspendModalUser;
    const reason =
      suspensionReasonInput.trim() || 'Account suspended by administrator.';
    setBusyUserId(target.id);
    setSuspendModalUser(null);
    setSuspensionReasonInput('');

    try {
      await suspendOrReactivateUserAction({
        userId: target.id,
        action: 'SUSPEND',
        reason,
      });
      setUsersList((prev) =>
        prev.map((u) =>
          u.id === target.id
            ? { ...u, status: 'SUSPENDED', suspensionReason: reason }
            : u
        )
      );
      setBannerMessage({
        type: 'warning',
        text: `Suspended ${target.name} (${target.email}). Active sessions are blocked and public validation surveys have been paused.`,
      });
    } finally {
      setBusyUserId(null);
    }
  }

  async function handleReactivateUser(user: AdminUserRecord) {
    setBusyUserId(user.id);
    try {
      await suspendOrReactivateUserAction({
        userId: user.id,
        action: 'REACTIVATE',
      });
      setUsersList((prev) =>
        prev.map((u) =>
          u.id === user.id
            ? {
                ...u,
                status: 'ACTIVE',
                suspensionReason: null,
                deletedAt: null,
              }
            : u
        )
      );
      setBannerMessage({
        type: 'success',
        text: `Reactivated ${user.name} (${user.email}). Account access restored.`,
      });
    } finally {
      setBusyUserId(null);
    }
  }

  async function handleSoftDeleteUser(user: AdminUserRecord) {
    setBusyUserId(user.id);
    try {
      const res = await softDeleteOrRestoreUserAction({
        userId: user.id,
        action: 'SOFT_DELETE',
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        setBannerMessage({
          type: 'warning',
          text: res.error || 'Failed to soft delete user.',
        });
        return;
      }
      const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
      setLocalStatusOverride(user.id, {
        status: 'SOFT_DELETED',
        deletedAt: nowIso,
        suspensionReason: user.suspensionReason,
      });
      setUsersList((prev) =>
        prev.map((u) =>
          u.id === user.id
            ? { ...u, status: 'SOFT_DELETED', deletedAt: nowIso }
            : u
        )
      );
      setBannerMessage({
        type: 'warning',
        text: `Moved ${user.name} (${user.email}) to Trash (30-day recovery window). Login is disabled.`,
      });
      setDeleteModalUser(null);
      setDeleteConfirmEmail('');
    } finally {
      setBusyUserId(null);
    }
  }

  async function handleRestoreSoftDeletedUser(user: AdminUserRecord) {
    setBusyUserId(user.id);
    try {
      const res = await softDeleteOrRestoreUserAction({
        userId: user.id,
        action: 'RESTORE',
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        setBannerMessage({
          type: 'warning',
          text: res.error || 'Failed to restore user.',
        });
        return;
      }
      setLocalStatusOverride(user.id, {
        status: 'ACTIVE',
        deletedAt: null,
        suspensionReason: null,
      });
      setUsersList((prev) =>
        prev.map((u) =>
          u.id === user.id
            ? {
                ...u,
                status: 'ACTIVE',
                deletedAt: null,
                suspensionReason: null,
              }
            : u
        )
      );
      setBannerMessage({
        type: 'success',
        text: `Restored ${user.name} (${user.email}) from Trash to Active status.`,
      });
      setDeleteModalUser(null);
      setDeleteConfirmEmail('');
    } finally {
      setBusyUserId(null);
    }
  }

  async function handleConfirmPermanentDelete() {
    if (!deleteModalUser) return;
    const target = deleteModalUser;
    setBusyUserId(target.id);

    try {
      const res = await permanentlyDeleteUserAction({ userId: target.id });
      if (!res.ok) {
        setBannerMessage({
          type: 'warning',
          text: res.error || 'Failed to permanently delete user.',
        });
        return;
      }
      addLocalDeletedUserId(target.id);
      setUsersList((prev) => prev.filter((u) => u.id !== target.id));
      setBannerMessage({
        type: 'success',
        text: `Permanently deleted ${target.name} (${target.email}) and all associated startup plans.`,
      });
      setDeleteModalUser(null);
      setDeleteConfirmEmail('');
    } finally {
      setBusyUserId(null);
    }
  }

  async function handleSaveNotesAndRole() {
    if (!notesModalUser) return;
    const target = notesModalUser;
    setBusyUserId(target.id);
    setNotesModalUser(null);

    try {
      await updateAdminUserNotesAndRoleAction({
        userId: target.id,
        adminInternalNotes: notesInput,
        role: roleInput,
      });
      setUsersList((prev) =>
        prev.map((u) =>
          u.id === target.id
            ? {
                ...u,
                adminInternalNotes: notesInput.trim() || null,
                role: roleInput,
              }
            : u
        )
      );
      syncLocalBrowserSessionIfMatching(
        target.id,
        target.email,
        target.entitlement,
        roleInput
      );
      setBannerMessage({
        type: 'success',
        text: `Saved role (${roleInput}) and admin notes for ${target.name}.`,
      });
    } finally {
      setBusyUserId(null);
    }
  }

  // Compute KPI metrics
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const nonDeleted = usersList.filter((u) => u.status !== 'SOFT_DELETED');
    const activeCount = usersList.filter((u) => u.status === 'ACTIVE').length;
    const suspendedCount = usersList.filter(
      (u) => u.status === 'SUSPENDED'
    ).length;
    const trashCount = usersList.filter(
      (u) => u.status === 'SOFT_DELETED'
    ).length;
    const lifetimeFullCount = nonDeleted.filter((u) =>
      isLifetimeFullAccess(u.entitlement)
    ).length;
    const freeHookCount = nonDeleted.filter(
      (u) => u.entitlement.planType === 'FREE_HOOK'
    ).length;
    const totalPlans = nonDeleted.reduce((acc, u) => acc + u.plansCount, 0);
    const totalAiCreditsUsed = nonDeleted.reduce(
      (acc, u) => acc + u.entitlement.aiCreditsUsedThisMonth,
      0
    );

    return {
      totalAccounts: usersList.length,
      activeCount,
      suspendedCount,
      trashCount,
      lifetimeFullCount,
      freeHookCount,
      totalPlans,
      totalAiCreditsUsed,
    };
  }, [usersList]);

  // Filter users by tab & search query
  const filteredUsers = useMemo(() => {
    return usersList.filter((u) => {
      // Tab filter
      if (activeTab === 'ALL_ACTIVE' && u.status === 'SOFT_DELETED') {
        return false;
      }
      if (
        activeTab === 'LIFETIME_FULL' &&
        (u.status === 'SOFT_DELETED' || !isLifetimeFullAccess(u.entitlement))
      ) {
        return false;
      }
      if (
        activeTab === 'FREE_HOOK' &&
        (u.status === 'SOFT_DELETED' || u.entitlement.planType !== 'FREE_HOOK')
      ) {
        return false;
      }
      if (activeTab === 'SUSPENDED' && u.status !== 'SUSPENDED') {
        return false;
      }
      if (activeTab === 'TRASH' && u.status !== 'SOFT_DELETED') {
        return false;
      }

      // Search filter
      if (searchQuery.trim().length > 0) {
        const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
        const matchName = u.name.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const matchEmail = u.email.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const matchNotes = (u.adminInternalNotes || '')
          .toLowerCase()
          .includes(q);
        const matchPlan = u.planTitles.some((t) =>
          t.toLowerCase().includes(q)
        );
        return matchName || matchEmail || matchNotes || matchPlan;
      }

      return true;
    });
  }, [usersList, activeTab, searchQuery]);

  if (!adminAuthenticated) {
    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-slate-950 text-slate-300">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-sm">
          <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin text-indigo-400" />
          Verifying Super Admin session...
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 text-slate-900">
      {/* Top Admin Header */}
      <header className="sticky top-0 z-30 border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-900 text-white shadow-xs">
        <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-7xl flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 px-6 py-3.5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-500 to-amber-500 text-white shadow-xs">
              <ShieldCheck className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-base font-bold tracking-tight">
                  Startup Preflight
                </span>
                <Badge className="bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-200 ring-1 ring-indigo-400/40">
                  Super Admin
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                Signed in as <strong className="text-slate-200">{adminEmail}</strong>
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            {dbConnected ? (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/15 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-emerald-300 ring-1 ring-emerald-500/30">
                <Database className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Cloud SQL PostgreSQL Live
              </span>
            ) : (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500/15 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-amber-300 ring-1 ring-amber-500/30">
                <HardDrive className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Local Session Sync Mode
              </span>
            )}

            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={fetchUsers}
              disabled={isLoading}
              className="border-slate-700 bg-slate-800 text-xs text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-700 hover:text-white"
            >
              <RefreshCw
                className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 ${isLoading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`}
              />
              Refresh
            </Button>

            <Link href="/workspace">
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                className="border-slate-700 bg-slate-800 text-xs text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-700 hover:text-white"
              >
                <ArrowLeft className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Founder Workspace
              </Button>
            </Link>

            <Button
              size="sm"
              onClick={async () => {
                await logoutSuperAdminAction();
                router.replace('/admin/login');
              }}
              className="bg-rose-600 text-xs text-white hover:bg-rose-500"
            >
              <LogOut className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              Sign Out
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      <main className="mx-auto max-w-7xl space-y-6 px-6 py-6">
        {/* Status / Feedback Banner */}
        {bannerMessage && (
          <div
            className={`flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border px-4 py-3 text-sm shadow-2xs ${
              bannerMessage.type === 'success'
                ? 'border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-950'
                : 'border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-950'
            }`}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              {bannerMessage.type === 'success' ? (
                <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-emerald-600" />
              ) : (
                <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-amber-600" />
              )}
              <span>{bannerMessage.text}</span>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setBannerMessage(null)}
              className="rounded-lg p-1 text-slate-500 hover:bg-black/5"
            >
              <X className="h-4 w-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Top-Level Admin Section Navigation Tabs */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-2 shadow-2xs">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActiveAdminSection('ACCOUNTS_AND_WAITLIST')}
              className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                activeAdminSection === 'ACCOUNTS_AND_WAITLIST'
                  ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white shadow-xs'
                  : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900'
              }`}
            >
              <Users className="h-4 w-4" />
              <span>Accounts, Entitlements &amp; Waitlist</span>
              <span
                className={`rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] ${
                  activeAdminSection === 'ACCOUNTS_AND_WAITLIST'
                    ? 'bg-white/20 text-white'
                    : 'bg-slate-200 text-slate-700'
                }`}
              >
                {stats.totalAccounts}
              </span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActiveAdminSection('GRANTS_CATALOG')}
              className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                activeAdminSection === 'GRANTS_CATALOG'
                  ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-xs'
                  : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900'
              }`}
            >
              <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4" />
              <span>Grants &amp; Funding Hub</span>
              <span
                className={`rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] ${
                  activeAdminSection === 'GRANTS_CATALOG'
                    ? 'bg-white/20 text-white'
                    : grantsList.filter((g) => g.status === 'PENDING_REVIEW').length > 0
                    ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800'
                    : 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                }`}
              >
                {grantsList.filter((g) => g.status === 'PENDING_REVIEW').length > 0
                  ? `${grantsList.filter((g) => g.status === 'PENDING_REVIEW').length} Review`
                  : `${grantsList.filter((g) => g.status === 'ACTIVE').length} Live`}
              </span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActiveAdminSection('SURVEY_BOOST')}
              className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                activeAdminSection === 'SURVEY_BOOST'
                  ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-xs'
                  : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900'
              }`}
            >
              <TrendingUp className="h-4 w-4" />
              <span>Survey Boost &amp; Panels</span>
              <span
                className={`rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] ${
                  activeAdminSection === 'SURVEY_BOOST'
                    ? 'bg-white/20 text-white'
                    : 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                }`}
              >
                Prolific API

            </button>

            <button

              onClick={() => setActiveAdminSection('VOUCHERS_AND_COHORTS')}
              className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                activeAdminSection === 'VOUCHERS_AND_COHORTS'
                  ? 'bg-amber-600 text-white shadow-xs'
                  : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900'
              }`}
            >
              <Crown className="h-4 w-4" />
              <span>Vouchers &amp; Cohorts Studio</span>
              <span
                className={`rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] ${

                }`}
              >
                {voucherStats.totalVouchers} codes
              </span>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActiveAdminSection('PARTNERS_AND_REFERRALS')}

                  ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-xs'
                  : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900'

            >

              </span>

              type="button"

                activeAdminSection === 'SUPPORT_AND_BUGS'
                  ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-xs'
                  : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900'
              }`}
            >

                className={`rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] ${

                Open

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActiveAdminSection('PERSONA_UX_LAB')}

                activeAdminSection === 'PERSONA_UX_LAB'
                  ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-xs'
                  : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900'
              }`}
            >
              <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4" />
              <span>Persona &amp; UX Audit Lab</span>
              <span
                className={`rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] ${
                  activeAdminSection === 'PERSONA_UX_LAB'
                    ? 'bg-white/20 text-white'
                    : 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                }`}
              >
                L1–L4 • 3 Screens
              </span>
            </button>
          </div>

          <span className="hidden pr-2 text-xs text-slate-400 md:inline">
            {activeAdminSection === 'SUPPORT_AND_BUGS'
              ? 'QA Bug Backlog, UX Improvements & Phase 2 Founder Support Hub'
              : activeAdminSection === 'PERSONA_UX_LAB'
                ? 'Synthetic Founder Personas, L1–L4 Literacy Lever, Mobile/Tablet/Laptop & Fix Prompt Generator'
                : activeAdminSection === 'VOUCHERS_AND_COHORTS'
                  ? 'Batch Generator, CSV Exports, Lifetime & Time-Limited Passes, Safe Refund Downgrades'
                  : activeAdminSection === 'PARTNERS_AND_REFERRALS'
                    ? 'Module Step Slot Mapper, Warm Intro Intake Builder, Affiliate Links & Bounty Ledger'
                    : 'Manage Founder Tiers, Lifetime Access & Early-Access Leads'}
          </span>
        </div>

        {activeAdminSection === 'GRANTS_CATALOG' ? (
          <GrantsManagementStudioTab
            initialGrants={grantsList}
            onRefresh={fetchUsers}
            onNotify={(type, text) =>
              setBannerMessage({
                type: type === 'error' ? 'warning' : 'success',
                text,
              })
            }
          />
        ) : activeAdminSection === 'SURVEY_BOOST' ? (
          <SurveyBoostStudioTab
            onNotify={(type, text) =>
              setBannerMessage({
                type: type === 'error' ? 'warning' : 'success',
                text,
              })
            }
          />
        ) : activeAdminSection === 'VOUCHERS_AND_COHORTS' ? (
          <VouchersCohortsStudioTab
            vouchers={vouchersList}
            cohorts={cohortsList}
            inquiries={cohortInquiriesList}
            stats={voucherStats}
            onRefresh={fetchUsers}
            onNotify={(type, text) =>
              setBannerMessage({
                type: type === 'error' ? 'warning' : 'success',
                text,
              })
            }
          />
        ) : activeAdminSection === 'PARTNERS_AND_REFERRALS' ? (
          <PartnersReferralsStudioTab
            offers={partnerOffersList}
            events={partnerReferralEventsList}
            onUpdateOffers={setPartnerOffersList}
            onUpdateEvents={setPartnerReferralEventsList}
            onRefresh={fetchUsers}
            onNotify={(type, text) => setBannerMessage({ type, text })}
          />
        ) : activeAdminSection === 'SYSTEM_EMAILS' ? (
          <SystemEmailsStudioTab
            adminEmail={adminEmail}
            onNotify={(type, text) =>
              setBannerMessage({
                type: type === 'error' ? 'warning' : 'success',
                text,
              })
            }
          />
        ) : activeAdminSection === 'SUPPORT_AND_BUGS' ? (
          <SupportBugTrackerTab

                <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-indigo-950">

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

                              ? `OTHER: ${lead.customJurisdictionText}`

                        </td>

                        <td className="px-4 py-3">
                          {lead.status === 'INVITED' ? (
                            <Badge variant="success">INVITED</Badge>

                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            <Button
                              variant="outline"
                              size="sm"

                            >
                              {lead.status === 'INVITED'
                                ? 'Mark Pending'
                                : 'Mark Invited'}
                            </Button>
                            <Button
                              variant="outline"
                              size="sm"
                              onClick={() => handleDeleteWaitlistLead(lead)}
                              className="h-7 border-rose-200 bg-rose-50/50 px-2 text-[11px] text-rose-700 hover:bg-rose-100"
                            >
                              <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                            </Button>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}

            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* User Management Directory Card */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader className="border-b border-slate-100 pb-4">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
              <div>
                <CardTitle className="text-lg">
                  Founder Accounts &amp; Entitlement Control
                </CardTitle>
                <CardDescription>
                  View user account tiers, upgrade anyone to{' '}
                  <strong>Lifetime Full Access</strong> (access to everything),
                  or suspend and delete accounts.
                </CardDescription>
              </div>

              {/* Search Bar */}
              <div className="relative w-full sm:w-80">
                <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-2.5 h-4 w-4 text-slate-400" />
                <Input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Search name, email, startup plan..."
                  value={searchQuery}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}

                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Filter Tabs */}
            <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
              {(
                [
                  {
                    id: 'ALL_ACTIVE',
                    label: `Active & Suspended (${
                      stats.activeCount + stats.suspendedCount
                    })`,
                  },
                  {
                    id: 'LIFETIME_FULL',
                    label: `⚡ Lifetime Full Access (${stats.lifetimeFullCount})`,
                  },
                  {
                    id: 'FREE_HOOK',
                    label: `Free Hook (${stats.freeHookCount})`,
                  },
                  {
                    id: 'SUSPENDED',
                    label: `Suspended (${stats.suspendedCount})`,
                  },
                  {
                    id: 'TRASH',
                    label: `Trash / Soft-Deleted (${stats.trashCount})`,
                  },
                ] as Array<{ id: StatusFilterTab; label: string }>
              ).map((tab) => (
                <button
                  key={tab.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}
                  className={`rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors ${
                    activeTab === tab.id
                      ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-2xs'
                      : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200'
                  }`}

                  {tab.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </CardHeader>

          <CardContent className="p-0">
            {filteredUsers.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="p-10 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">
                No accounts match the current filter.
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="divide-y divide-slate-200">
                {filteredUsers.map((user) => {
                  const currentPreset = inferPresetFromEntitlement(
                    user.entitlement
                  );
                  const hasLifetimeFull = isLifetimeFullAccess(
                    user.entitlement
                  );
                  const isBusy = busyUserId === user.id;

                  return (
                    <div
                      key={user.id}

                        user.status === 'SUSPENDED'

                          : user.status === 'SOFT_DELETED'
                            ? 'bg-rose-50/30 opacity-85'
                            : 'hover:bg-slate-50/80'

                            <span className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
                              {user.name}
                            </span>
                            <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                              {user.email}
                            </span>

                            {/* Status Badge */}
                            {user.status === 'ACTIVE' && (
                              <Badge variant="success">ACTIVE</Badge>
                            )}
                            {user.status === 'SUSPENDED' && (
                              <Badge variant="warning">SUSPENDED</Badge>
                            )}
                            {user.status === 'SOFT_DELETED' && (

                                TRASH (SOFT DELETED)
                              </Badge>
                            )}

                            {/* Role Badge */}
                            {user.role !== 'FOUNDER' && (
                              <Badge variant="default">{user.role}</Badge>
                            )}

                            {/* Current Account Tier Badge */}
                            {hasLifetimeFull ? (
                              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-violet-600 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-white shadow-2xs">

                              </Badge>

                          </div>

                          {/* Suspension Reason Alert if Suspended */}
                          {user.status === 'SUSPENDED' &&
                            user.suspensionReason && (

                                <Ban className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-amber-700" />

                                  <strong>Suspension Reason:</strong>{' '}
                                  {user.suspensionReason}
                                </span>
                              </div>
                            )}

                          {/* Soft Delete Timestamp if in Trash */}
                          {user.status === 'SOFT_DELETED' && user.deletedAt && (
                            <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-rose-200 bg-rose-100/70 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-rose-900">
                              <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-rose-600" />

                            </div>
                          )}

                          {/* Entitlement Limits & Startup Plans Summary */}
                          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-5 gap-y-1.5 text-xs text-slate-600">
                            <span>
                              <strong>Modules:</strong>{' '}
                              {user.entitlement.planType === 'FREE_HOOK'
                                ? 'Module A Only (Locked B–G)'
                                : 'All Modules A–G Unlocked'}
                            </span>

                              <strong>Startup Plans:</strong> {user.plansCount}{' '}
                              / {user.entitlement.maxStartupPlans}

                              <strong>Team Seats / Plan:</strong>{' '}
                              {user.entitlement.maxSeatsPerPlan}

                          {user.status !== 'SOFT_DELETED' && (
                            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">

                                  size="sm"

                                </span>
                              )}

                              {/* Dropdown to switch to any specific account type */}
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                <SlidersHorizontal className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-400" />
                                <select
                                  aria-label={`Change account tier for ${user.name}`}

                                    handlePresetChange(
                                      user,

                                >

                                    </option>
                                  ))}
                                </select>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          )}

                          {/* Secondary Row: Notes/Role, Suspend/Reactivate, Soft Delete / Hard Delete */}
                          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                            <Button
                              variant="outline"

                                setNotesModalUser(user);
                                setNotesInput(user.adminInternalNotes || '');
                                setRoleInput(user.role);
                              }}
                              className="h-7 px-2.5 text-xs"
                            >
                              <StickyNote className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-500" />
                              Role &amp; Notes
                            </Button>

                            {user.status === 'ACTIVE' && (
                              <Button
                                variant="outline"

                                  );
                                }}

                                <Ban className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-amber-700" />

                              </Button>
                            )}

                            {user.status === 'SUSPENDED' && (
                              <Button
                                variant="outline"
                                size="sm"
                                disabled={isBusy}
                                onClick={() => handleReactivateUser(user)}
                                className="h-7 border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 px-2.5 text-xs text-emerald-900 hover:bg-emerald-100"
                              >
                                <RotateCcw className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-700" />
                                Reactivate Account
                              </Button>
                            )}

                            {user.status !== 'SOFT_DELETED' ? (
                              <Button
                                variant="outline"
                                size="sm"
                                disabled={isBusy}
                                onClick={() => {
                                  setDeleteModalUser(user);
                                  setDeleteModalMode('CHOOSE');
                                  setDeleteConfirmEmail('');
                                }}
                                className="h-7 border-rose-200 bg-rose-50/50 px-2.5 text-xs text-rose-700 hover:bg-rose-100"
                              >
                                <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                                Delete
                              </Button>
                            ) : (
                              <>
                                <Button
                                  variant="outline"
                                  size="sm"
                                  disabled={isBusy}
                                  onClick={() =>
                                    handleRestoreSoftDeletedUser(user)
                                  }
                                  className="h-7 border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 px-2.5 text-xs text-emerald-900 hover:bg-emerald-100"
                                >
                                  <RotateCcw className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-700" />
                                  Restore Account
                                </Button>
                                <Button
                                  variant="destructive"
                                  size="sm"
                                  disabled={isBusy}
                                  onClick={() => {
                                    setDeleteModalUser(user);
                                    setDeleteModalMode('PURGE');
                                    setDeleteConfirmEmail('');
                                  }}
                                  className="h-7 px-2.5 text-xs"
                                >
                                  <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                                  Permanently Purge
                                </Button>
                              </>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
          </>
        )}
      </main>

      {/* ========================================================= */}
      {/* MODAL 1: SUSPEND ACCOUNT WITH REASON                      */}
      {/* ========================================================= */}
      {suspendModalUser && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-900/60 p-4 backdrop-blur-xs">
          <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-2xl">
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-amber-100 text-amber-700">
                  <Ban className="h-5 w-5" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
                    Suspend Founder Account
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                    {suspendModalUser.name} ({suspendModalUser.email})
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSuspendModalUser(null)}
                className="rounded-lg p-1 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100"
              >
                <X className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-4 space-y-3 text-xs text-slate-600">
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50/70 p-3 text-amber-950">
                <strong>What happens when you suspend this account:</strong>
                <ul className="mt-1.5 list-disc space-y-1 pl-4">
                  <li>
                    Immediately blocks login and invalidates active browser
                    sessions.
                  </li>
                  <li>
                    Automatically pauses all public Hosted Validation Surveys (
                    <code>/v/[slug]</code>).
                  </li>
                  <li>
                    Preserves all Startup Plans so you can reactivate anytime in
                    1 click.
                  </li>
                </ul>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <Label htmlFor="suspension-reason">
                  Suspension Reason (shown if user tries to sign in)
                </Label>
                <Input
                  id="suspension-reason"
                  placeholder="e.g., AppSumo refund processed / Terms of Service violation"
                  value={suspensionReasonInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setSuspensionReasonInput(e.target.value)}
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-5 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => setSuspendModalUser(null)}
              >
                Cancel
              </Button>
              <Button
                size="sm"
                onClick={handleConfirmSuspend}
                className="bg-amber-600 text-white hover:bg-amber-700"
              >
                Suspend Account
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ========================================================= */}
      {/* MODAL 2: DELETE USER (SOFT DELETE OR PERMANENT PURGE)     */}
      {/* ========================================================= */}
      {deleteModalUser && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-900/60 p-4 backdrop-blur-xs">

                </div>
                <div>

                    {deleteModalMode === 'CHOOSE'
                      ? 'Delete User Account'
                      : 'Permanently Purge Account (GDPR)'}
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                    {deleteModalUser.name} ({deleteModalUser.email})
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setDeleteModalUser(null);
                  setDeleteConfirmEmail('');
                }}
                className="rounded-lg p-1 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100"
              >
                <X className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {deleteModalMode === 'CHOOSE' ? (
              <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-600">
                  Choose how you want to handle this account. You can move the user to the Trash (soft delete) where they can be restored later, or permanently purge them and all their data immediately.
                </p>

                <div className="space-y-2.5 pt-1">
                  {/* Option A: Soft Delete (Move to Trash) */}

                          Move to Trash (Soft Delete — Recommended)
                        </div>
                        <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-amber-800 leading-relaxed">
                          Disables login access, revokes active sessions, and hides the user from the active roster. All {deleteModalUser.plansCount} startup plan(s) and surveys are preserved and can be restored at any time.

                        variant="outline"

                      Type <strong>{deleteModalUser.email}</strong> to confirm:
                    </Label>

                    onChange={(e) => setDeleteConfirmEmail(e.target.value)}

                  />
                </div>

                  <Button
                    variant="ghost"
                    size="sm"

                    disabled={busyUserId === deleteModalUser.id}
                  >
                    ← Back

                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

          </div>

'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { ShieldCheck, Lock, ArrowRight, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { loginSuperAdminAction } from '@/app/actions/admin';

export default function SuperAdminLoginPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  async function handleAdminLogin(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMsg(null);
    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const result = await loginSuperAdminAction({
        email,
        password,
      });

      if (!result.ok) {
        setErrorMsg(result.error || 'Invalid Super Admin credentials.');
        setIsSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }

      router.push('/admin');
    } catch {
      setErrorMsg('Unable to authenticate. Please try again.');
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col justify-center bg-slate-950 px-6 py-12 text-slate-100">
      <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-md space-y-6">
        <div className="space-y-2 text-center">
          <div className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-500 to-amber-500 text-white shadow-lg">
            <ShieldCheck className="h-6 w-6" />
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white">
            Startup Preflight • Super Admin Portal
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
            Restricted access. Only authorized Super Administrators can sign in.
          </p>
        </div>

        <Card className="border-slate-800 bg-slate-900 text-slate-100 shadow-2xl">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base text-white">
              <Lock className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-400" />
              Super Admin Authentication
            </CardTitle>
            <CardDescription className="text-xs text-slate-400">
              Enter your dedicated Super Admin credentials to manage founder
              accounts and entitlements.
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <form onSubmit={handleAdminLogin} className="space-y-4">
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <Label htmlFor="admin-email" className="text-slate-200">
                  Super Admin Email
                </Label>
                <Input
                  id="admin-email"
                  type="email"
                  placeholder="admin@startuppreflight.com"
                  value={email}
                  onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                  className="border-slate-700 bg-slate-950 text-white placeholder:text-slate-500"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <Label htmlFor="admin-password" className="text-slate-200">
                  Super Admin Password
                </Label>
                <Input
                  id="admin-password"
                  type="password"
                  placeholder="Enter Super Admin password"
                  value={password}
                  onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                  className="border-slate-700 bg-slate-950 text-white placeholder:text-slate-500"
                />
              </div>

              {errorMsg && (
                <div className="rounded-lg border border-rose-500/40 bg-rose-950/60 p-3 text-xs font-medium text-rose-200">
                  {errorMsg}
                </div>
              )}

              <Button
                type="submit"
                size="lg"
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                className="w-full bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-500"
              >
                {isSubmitting ? (
                  <>
                    <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                    Verifying Super Admin...
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    Sign In to Admin Panel
                    <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4" />
                  </>
                )}
              </Button>
            </form>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { TestTube2 } from 'lucide-react';

interface SandboxBadgeProps {
  className?: string;
  variant?: 'banner' | 'card' | 'pill';
}

/**
 * Stripe Sandbox Badge:
 * Automatically checks if Stripe is configured with a test key (pk_test_...).
 * - When in LIVE mode (pk_live_...), it returns null (zero mentions of test/sandbox in production).
 * - When in TEST mode (pk_test_...) on your local server, it displays an amber notice
 *   confirming you are safe to test with Stripe test cards without using real money.
 */
export function StripeSandboxBadge({
  className = '',
  variant = 'banner',
}: SandboxBadgeProps) {
  const publishableKey =
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY?.trim() || '';
  const isTestMode =
    publishableKey.startsWith('pk_test_') ||
    publishableKey.toLowerCase().includes('test');

  // If in live mode or not configured, show absolutely nothing
  if (!isTestMode) {
    return null;
  }

  if (variant === 'pill') {
    return (
      <div
        className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-amber-900 shadow-2xs ${className}`}
      >
        <TestTube2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-amber-600" />
        <span>Stripe Sandbox (Test Mode)</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (variant === 'card') {
    return (
      <div
        className={`rounded-xl border border-amber-300/80 bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-50/90 via-amber-50/60 to-amber-100/40 p-3.5 text-xs text-amber-950 shadow-2xs ${className}`}
      >
        <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
          <div className="flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-amber-200 text-amber-900">
            <TestTube2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-0.5">
            <p className="font-bold text-amber-900">
              Stripe Test Sandbox Active
            </p>
            <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-amber-800">
              Running with Stripe Test Keys. <strong>No real money is charged.</strong> Checkout sessions accept test cards (e.g. <code>4242 4242...</code>).
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div
      className={`border-b border-amber-300/80 bg-amber-50 px-4 py-2 text-center text-xs text-amber-950 sm:px-6 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-6xl items-center justify-center gap-2">
        <TestTube2 className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-amber-600 animate-pulse" />
        <span className="font-medium">
          <strong>Local Stripe Sandbox:</strong> Connected to Stripe Test Mode. Checkouts are simulated test transactions — no real money will be charged.
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

          <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#6366F1" stopOpacity="0.95" />
        </linearGradient>

        {/* Subtle Apex Glow */}
        <filter
          id={`spf-glow-${uniqueId}`}
          x="-30%"
          y="-30%"
          width="160%"
          height="160%"
          filterUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
        >
          <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="0.8" result="glow" />
          <feComposite in="SourceGraphic" in2="glow" operator="over" />
        </filter>
      </defs>

      {/* Primary Runway / Guidance Arc */}
      <path
        d="M 6 40 C 10 42, 17 41, 23 35 C 26 32, 28 28, 27 25"
        stroke={`url(#spf-orbit-${uniqueId})`}
        strokeWidth="2.5"
        strokeLinecap="round"
        fill="none"
      />

      {/* Secondary Speed Slipstream */}
      <path
        d="M 7 34 C 11 35, 16 33, 20 28"
        stroke={`url(#spf-orbit-${uniqueId})`}
        strokeWidth="1.5"
        strokeLinecap="round"
        fill="none"
        opacity="0.6"
      />

      {/* Upper Port Wing (Climb & Lift) */}
      <path
        d="M 39 9 L 11 20 L 23 27 Z"
        fill={`url(#spf-top-${uniqueId})`}
      />

      {/* Lower Starboard Wing (Structural Base) */}
      <path
        d="M 39 9 L 23 27 L 29 37 Z"
        fill={`url(#spf-bot-${uniqueId})`}
      />

      {/* Center Dorsal Spine / Cockpit Vector */}
      <path
        d="M 39 9 L 23 27 L 24.5 25 L 34 14 Z"
        fill={`url(#spf-keel-${uniqueId})`}
        opacity="0.95"
      />

      {/* Trailing Thruster Core */}
      <path
        d="M 23 27 L 20 30 L 22 26 Z"
        fill="#06B6D4"
        opacity="0.85"
      />

      {/* Launch Beacon (Polaris / Flight Clearance Star) */}
      <g filter={`url(#spf-glow-${uniqueId})`}>
        <circle cx="39" cy="9" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF" />
        <circle
          cx="39"
          cy="9"
          r="2.8"
          stroke="#38BDF8"
          strokeWidth="0.8"
          opacity="0.75"
          fill="none"
        />
      </g>
    </svg>
  );
}

/**
 * BrandLogo: Primary branding component for Startup Preflight.
 * Supports Mark-only, Full lockup, light/dark themes, and responsive sizes.
 */
export function BrandLogo({
  variant = 'full',
  theme = 'light',
  size = 'md',
  badge,
  showTagline = false,
  href,
  onClick,
  className = '',
}: BrandLogoProps) {
  const conf = sizeMap[size];

  const content = (
    <div
      className={`group inline-flex items-center ${conf.gap} select-none ${className}`}
      onClick={onClick}
    >
      {/* Aerodynamic Mark Container */}
      <div
        className={`flex ${conf.container} shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl transition-shadow group-hover:shadow-md`}
      >
        <PreflightMark size={conf.mark} />
      </div>

      {/* Wordmark */}
      {variant !== 'mark' && (
        <div className="flex flex-col text-left leading-none">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span
              className={`font-black tracking-tight ${conf.title} ${
                theme === 'dark' ? 'text-white' : 'text-slate-900'
              }`}
            >
              Startup
              <span
                className={
                  theme === 'dark'
                    ? 'ml-1 text-indigo-400'
                    : 'ml-1 text-indigo-600'
                }
              >
                Preflight
              </span>
            </span>

            {badge && (
              <span
                className={`rounded-full font-bold uppercase tracking-wider ${conf.badge} ${
                  theme === 'dark'
                    ? 'border border-indigo-400/30 bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-300'
                    : 'border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700'
                }`}
              >
                {badge}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          {showTagline && (
            <span
              className={`mt-1 font-bold uppercase tracking-widest ${conf.tagline} ${
                theme === 'dark' ? 'text-slate-400' : 'text-slate-500'
              }`}
            >
              Supportive Co-Founder &amp; Blind-Spot Engine
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );

  if (href) {
    return (
      <Link
        href={href}
        className="inline-flex items-center focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 rounded-lg"
      >
        {content}
      </Link>
    );
  }

  return content;
}

import * as React from 'react';

import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const badgeVariants = cva(
  'inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors',
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default:
          'border-transparent bg-indigo-600 text-white',
        secondary:
          'border-transparent bg-slate-100 text-slate-900',
        destructive:
          'border-transparent bg-red-100 text-red-700',
        outline: 'text-slate-700 border-slate-200',
        success:
          'border-transparent bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800',
        warning:
          'border-transparent bg-amber-100 text-amber-800',
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: 'default',
    },
  }
);

export interface BadgeProps
  extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>,
    VariantProps<typeof badgeVariants> {}

function Badge({ className, variant, ...props }: BadgeProps) {
  return (
    <div className={cn(badgeVariants({ variant }), className)} {...props} />
  );
}

import * as React from 'react';
import { Slot } from '@radix-ui/react-slot';
import { cva, type VariantProps } from 'class-variance-authority';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const buttonVariants = cva(
  'inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50',
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default:
          'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-sm hover:bg-indigo-700',
        destructive:
          'bg-red-600 text-white shadow-sm hover:bg-red-700',
        outline:
          'border border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-xs hover:bg-slate-50',
        secondary:
          'bg-slate-100 text-slate-900 shadow-xs hover:bg-slate-200',
        ghost: 'hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900',
        link: 'text-indigo-600 underline-offset-4 hover:underline',
      },
      size: {
        default: 'h-10 px-4 py-2',
        sm: 'h-8 rounded-md px-3 text-xs',
        lg: 'h-11 rounded-lg px-6 text-base',
        icon: 'h-9 w-9',
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: 'default',
      size: 'default',
    },
  }
);

export interface ButtonProps
  extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>,
    VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants> {
  asChild?: boolean;
}

const Button = React.forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonProps>(
  ({ className, variant, size, asChild = false, ...props }, ref) => {
    const Comp = asChild ? Slot : 'button';
    return (
      <Comp
        className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size, className }))}
        ref={ref}
        {...props}
      />
    );
  }
);
Button.displayName = 'Button';

export { Button, buttonVariants };
