                                          <option value={1}>1-Year Vesting</option>
                                          <option value={2}>2-Year Vesting</option>
                                          <option value={3}>3-Year Vesting</option>
                                          <option value={4}>4-Year Vesting (Standard)</option>
                                        </select>
                                        <select
                                          value={role.cliffMonths ?? 12}
                                          onChange={(e) =>
                                            handleUpdatePlannedRole(role.id, {
                                              cliffMonths: Number(e.target.value),
                                            })
                                          }
                                          className="rounded-md border border-slate-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-800"
                                        >
                                          <option value={0}>0-Mo Cliff</option>
                                          <option value={6}>6-Mo Cliff</option>
                                          <option value={12}>12-Mo Cliff (Standard)</option>
                                        </select>
                                      </div>
                                    </div>
                                  </div>

                                  {/* Fully-Loaded Live Tax Breakdown */}
                                  <div className="rounded-lg bg-slate-50 p-2.5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs">
                                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-slate-600 text-[11px]">
                                      <span>
                                        Statutory Taxes:{' '}
                                        <strong>
                                          {formatPlanCurrency(
                                            taxCost,
                                            selectedCountry === 'GB' ? 'GBP' : 'EUR'
                                          )}
                                        </strong>{' '}
                                        ({isGb ? '13.8% NIC' : '11.15% PRSI'})
                                      </span>
                                      {isGb && (
                                        <span>
                                          Workplace Pension:{' '}
                                          <strong>
                                            {formatPlanCurrency(pensionCost, 'GBP')}
                                          </strong>{' '}
                                          (3%)
                                        </span>
                                      )}
                                      <span className="font-bold text-indigo-900">
                                        True Loaded Cost:{' '}
                                        {formatPlanCurrency(
                                          loadedCost,
                                          selectedCountry === 'GB' ? 'GBP' : 'EUR'
                                        )}
                                        /yr
                                      </span>
                                    </div>

                                    {/* Grant Eligibility Checkboxes */}
                                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-[11px]">
                                      <label className="flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer">
                                        <input
                                          type="checkbox"
                                          checked={Boolean(
                                            role.isGrantReimbursableEligible
                                          )}
                                          onChange={(e) =>
                                            handleUpdatePlannedRole(role.id, {
                                              isGrantReimbursableEligible:
                                                e.target.checked,
                                            })
                                          }
                                          className="rounded border-slate-300 text-indigo-600"
                                        />
                                        <span className="text-slate-700 font-medium">
                                          LEO / Innovate UK Grant Candidate
                                        </span>
                                      </label>
                                      <label className="flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer">
                                        <input
                                          type="checkbox"
                                          checked={Boolean(
                                            role.isRdTaxCreditEligible
                                          )}
                                          onChange={(e) =>
                                            handleUpdatePlannedRole(role.id, {
                                              isRdTaxCreditEligible:
                                                e.target.checked,
                                            })
                                          }
                                          className="rounded border-slate-300 text-purple-600"
                                        />
                                        <span className="text-slate-700 font-medium">
                                          R&amp;D Tax Credit Candidate
                                        </span>
                                      </label>
                                    </div>
                                  </div>

                                  {/* Sweat Equity Conditions & Notes */}
                                  {(isPureSweat ||
                                    role.compensationModel ===
                                      'HYBRID_CASH_EQUITY' ||
                                    Number(role.equityGrantPercent) > 0) && (
                                    <div className="space-y-1">
                                      <Label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-purple-900">
                                        Sweat Equity Milestone or Cash Conversion Trigger:
                                      </Label>
                                      <Input
                                        type="text"
                                        value={
                                          role.sweatEquityMilestoneConditions || ''
                                        }
                                        onChange={(e) =>
                                          handleUpdatePlannedRole(role.id, {
                                            sweatEquityMilestoneConditions:
                                              e.target.value,
                                          })
                                        }
                                        placeholder="e.g. Automatically converts to standard market cash salary once Seed round closes or MRR crosses €15k..."
                                        className="text-xs bg-purple-50/40 border-purple-200"
                                      />
                                    </div>
                                  )}
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        );
                      })
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Freelance & Contractor Contingency Budget */}
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                    <div>
                      <Label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800">
                        Year {activeYearTab} Specialist Contractor &amp; Agency Budget
                      </Label>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                        For ad-hoc legal, accounting, branding, or specialized dev contractors outside direct payroll.
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="w-40 relative">
                      <span className="absolute left-3 top-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-400">
                        {selectedCountry === 'GB' ? '£' : '€'}
                      </span>
                      <Input
                        type="number"
                        min={0}
                        step={1000}
                        value={
                          activeYearTab === 1
                            ? step5Data.contractorBudgetYear1
                            : activeYearTab === 2
                            ? step5Data.contractorBudgetYear2
                            : step5Data.contractorBudgetYear3
                        }
                        onChange={(e) => {
                          const val = Number(e.target.value) || 0;
                          setStep5Data((prev) => ({
                            ...prev,
                            [activeYearTab === 1
                              ? 'contractorBudgetYear1'
                              : activeYearTab === 2
                              ? 'contractorBudgetYear2'
                              : 'contractorBudgetYear3']: val,
                          }));
                        }}
                        className="pl-7 text-xs font-bold text-slate-900"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* ------------------------------------------------------------- */}
              {/* SECTION 3: 3-YEAR HEADCOUNT SCORECARD & FINANCIAL PROJECTIONS */}
              {/* ------------------------------------------------------------- */}
              <div className="space-y-3 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <Label className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700">
                    3. Live 3-Year Headcount, Payroll &amp; Grant Scorecard
                  </Label>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-emerald-600 font-bold">
                    ✓ Feeds directly into Module J Financial Model
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                  {/* Year 1 Card */}
                  <div className="rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-50/60 via-white to-slate-50 p-4 space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-950 uppercase">
                        Year 1 Projection
                      </span>
                      <Badge className="bg-indigo-600 text-white text-[10px]">
                        {calculateFteForRoles(step5RolesYear1)} FTEs
                      </Badge>
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-1 text-xs text-slate-600">
                      <div className="flex justify-between">
                        <span>Gross Wages:</span>
                        <strong className="text-slate-900">
                          {formatPlanCurrency(
                            y1Stats.grossWages,
                            selectedCountry === 'GB' ? 'GBP' : 'EUR'
                          )}
                        </strong>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex justify-between">
                        <span>Employer Taxes &amp; Pension:</span>
                        <strong className="text-slate-900">
                          {formatPlanCurrency(
                            y1Stats.employerTaxes,
                            selectedCountry === 'GB' ? 'GBP' : 'EUR'
                          )}
                        </strong>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex justify-between">
                        <span>Contractor Budget:</span>
                        <strong className="text-slate-900">
                          {formatPlanCurrency(
                            step5Data.contractorBudgetYear1,
                            selectedCountry === 'GB' ? 'GBP' : 'EUR'
                          )}
                        </strong>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex justify-between pt-1 border-t border-indigo-100 font-bold text-indigo-950">
                        <span>Total Wage Outflow:</span>
                        <span>
                          {formatPlanCurrency(
                            y1Stats.totalCashBurn,
                            selectedCountry === 'GB' ? 'GBP' : 'EUR'
                          )}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    {y1Stats.totalEquityPoolPledged > 0 && (
                      <div className="pt-1 text-[10px] text-purple-700 font-semibold">
                        ⚡ {y1Stats.totalEquityPoolPledged}% Sweat Equity Pledged
                      </div>
                    )}
                    {y1Stats.estimatedGrantSubsidy > 0 && (
                      <div className="rounded-md bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-800">
                        LEO/Grant Subsidy Potential: ~
                        {formatPlanCurrency(
                          y1Stats.estimatedGrantSubsidy,
                          selectedCountry === 'GB' ? 'GBP' : 'EUR'
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* Year 2 Card */}
                  <div className="rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-50/60 via-white to-slate-50 p-4 space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-950 uppercase">
                        Year 2 Projection
                      </span>
                      <Badge className="bg-indigo-600 text-white text-[10px]">
                        {calculateFteForRoles(step5RolesYear2)} FTEs
                      </Badge>
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-1 text-xs text-slate-600">
                      <div className="flex justify-between">
                        <span>Gross Wages:</span>
                        <strong className="text-slate-900">
                          {formatPlanCurrency(
                            y2Stats.grossWages,
                            selectedCountry === 'GB' ? 'GBP' : 'EUR'
                          )}
                        </strong>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex justify-between">
                        <span>Employer Taxes &amp; Pension:</span>
                        <strong className="text-slate-900">
                          {formatPlanCurrency(
                            y2Stats.employerTaxes,
                            selectedCountry === 'GB' ? 'GBP' : 'EUR'
                          )}
                        </strong>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex justify-between">
                        <span>Contractor Budget:</span>
                        <strong className="text-slate-900">
                          {formatPlanCurrency(
                            step5Data.contractorBudgetYear2,
                            selectedCountry === 'GB' ? 'GBP' : 'EUR'
                          )}
                        </strong>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex justify-between pt-1 border-t border-indigo-100 font-bold text-indigo-950">
                        <span>Total Wage Outflow:</span>
                        <span>
                          {formatPlanCurrency(
                            y2Stats.totalCashBurn,
                            selectedCountry === 'GB' ? 'GBP' : 'EUR'
                          )}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    {y2Stats.totalEquityPoolPledged > 0 && (
                      <div className="pt-1 text-[10px] text-purple-700 font-semibold">
                        ⚡ {y2Stats.totalEquityPoolPledged}% Sweat Equity Pledged
                      </div>
                    )}
                    {y2Stats.estimatedGrantSubsidy > 0 && (
                      <div className="rounded-md bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-800">
                        LEO/Grant Subsidy Potential: ~
                        {formatPlanCurrency(
                          y2Stats.estimatedGrantSubsidy,
                          selectedCountry === 'GB' ? 'GBP' : 'EUR'
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* Year 3 Card */}
                  <div className="rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-50/60 via-white to-slate-50 p-4 space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-950 uppercase">
                        Year 3 Projection
                      </span>
                      <Badge className="bg-indigo-600 text-white text-[10px]">
                        {calculateFteForRoles(step5RolesYear3)} FTEs
                      </Badge>
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-1 text-xs text-slate-600">
                      <div className="flex justify-between">
                        <span>Gross Wages:</span>
                        <strong className="text-slate-900">
                          {formatPlanCurrency(
                            y3Stats.grossWages,
                            selectedCountry === 'GB' ? 'GBP' : 'EUR'
                          )}
                        </strong>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex justify-between">
                        <span>Employer Taxes &amp; Pension:</span>
                        <strong className="text-slate-900">
                          {formatPlanCurrency(
                            y3Stats.employerTaxes,
                            selectedCountry === 'GB' ? 'GBP' : 'EUR'
                          )}
                        </strong>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex justify-between">
                        <span>Contractor Budget:</span>
                        <strong className="text-slate-900">
                          {formatPlanCurrency(
                            step5Data.contractorBudgetYear3,
                            selectedCountry === 'GB' ? 'GBP' : 'EUR'
                          )}
                        </strong>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex justify-between pt-1 border-t border-indigo-100 font-bold text-indigo-950">
                        <span>Total Wage Outflow:</span>
                        <span>
                          {formatPlanCurrency(
                            y3Stats.totalCashBurn,
                            selectedCountry === 'GB' ? 'GBP' : 'EUR'
                          )}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    {y3Stats.totalEquityPoolPledged > 0 && (
                      <div className="pt-1 text-[10px] text-purple-700 font-semibold">
                        ⚡ {y3Stats.totalEquityPoolPledged}% Sweat Equity Pledged
                      </div>
                    )}
                    {y3Stats.estimatedRdOffset > 0 && (
                      <div className="rounded-md bg-purple-50 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-purple-800">

              {/* SECTION 4: EXECUTIVE HIRING & TALENT STRATEGY NARRATIVE       */}

              <div className="space-y-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <div>
                    <Label className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700">
                      4. Executive Hiring &amp; Retention Strategy (LEO &amp; Innovate UK Grant Narrative)

                      Official form summary for grant assessors and loan underwriters

                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    size="sm"

                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="ghost"
                  size="sm"

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Button
                    type="button"

                  <Button
                    type="button"

                      setOpenStep(6);

                    Next: Module F Overview Brief

          </Card>

      </div>

      {/* =================================================================== */}
      {/* OVERVIEW: TEAM, GOVERNANCE & HIRING BRIEF (MODULE F OVERVIEW)         */}
      {/* =================================================================== */}
      <div id="module-f-step-6" className="scroll-mt-24">
        {openStep !== 'ALL' && openStep !== 6 ? (
          <div
            onClick={() => setOpenStep(6)}

          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-3">
                <div
                  className={`flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-xs font-bold ${
                    completedModuleFCoreStepsCount === 5
                      ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                      : 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                  }`}
                >
                  <FileText className="h-4 w-4" />
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <h2 className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 group-hover:text-indigo-600">
                      Team, Governance &amp; Hiring Brief
                    </h2>
                    <Badge
                      variant={
                        completedModuleFCoreStepsCount === 5
                          ? 'default'
                          : 'outline'
                      }
                      className={`shrink-0 text-[10px] font-medium ${
                        completedModuleFCoreStepsCount === 5
                          ? 'border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                          : 'border-slate-300 text-slate-600'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {completedModuleFCoreStepsCount}/5 Sections Ready
                    </Badge>
                    <Badge variant="outline" className="border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 text-[10px] text-indigo-700 shrink-0 font-medium">
                      LEO Appendix D &amp; Innovate UK Q8 Compliant
                    </Badge>
                  </div>
                  <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-xs text-slate-500">
                    Executive team dossier, 7 hats workload balance, survival runway, founder charter, and constructive blind-spot audit.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="ml-3 flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant="ghost"
                  className="h-8 shrink-0 px-2.5 text-xs font-medium text-indigo-600 group-hover:bg-indigo-50"
                >
                  <span>{completedModuleFCoreStepsCount === 5 ? 'Open Overview' : 'Review Overview'}</span>
                  <ChevronDown className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />

            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <Card className="border-indigo-200 bg-gradient-to-br from-white via-indigo-50/30 to-violet-50/40 shadow-sm">

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div
                    className={`flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-xs font-bold ${

                    <FileText className="h-4 w-4" />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                      <CardTitle className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
                        Team, Governance &amp; Hiring Brief (Overview)
                      </CardTitle>
                      <Badge className="bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800 text-[10px] shrink-0 font-medium">
                        Module F Overview
                      </Badge>
                      <Badge
                        variant={
                          completedModuleFCoreStepsCount === 5
                            ? 'default'
                            : 'outline'
                        }
                        className={`text-[10px] shrink-0 font-medium ${
                          completedModuleFCoreStepsCount === 5
                            ? 'border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                            : 'border-slate-300 text-slate-600'
                        }`}

                        {completedModuleFCoreStepsCount}/5 Core Sections Ready
                      </Badge>
                    </div>
                    <CardDescription className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-600">

                    </CardDescription>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    size="sm"
                    variant="outline"
                    onClick={handleCopyMarkdownBrief}
                    className="h-8 text-xs border-indigo-200 bg-white text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-50 font-semibold"

                      </>

                  {openStep !== 'ALL' && (
                    <Button
                      type="button"
                      size="sm"
                      variant="ghost"
                      onClick={() => setOpenStep(0)}
                      className="h-8 text-xs text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900"
                    >
                      <span>Collapse Step</span>
                      <ChevronUp className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />

              </div>
            </CardHeader>

            <CardContent className="space-y-6 pt-5">
              {/* ============================================================= */}
              {/* SECTION 1: 5-PILLAR TEAM READINESS CHECKLIST GRID             */}
              {/* ============================================================= */}
              <div className="space-y-2.5">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <h3 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700">
                    1. Founding Team &amp; Governance Architecture Checklist
                  </h3>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 font-medium">
                    {completedModuleFCoreStepsCount} of 5 Core Sections Complete

                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
                  {/* Pillar 1: Promoter Profiles */}
                  <div
                    onClick={() => setOpenStep(1)}

                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
                        1. Promoter Profiles &amp; CVs
                      </span>
                      {step1Complete ? (
                        <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600" />
                      ) : (
                        <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-500" />
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-600">
                      {step1Data.teamMembers.length} team member(s) •{' '}
                      {step1Data.teamMembers.filter((m) => m.cvReadyForAppendixD).length}/{step1Data.teamMembers.length} CVs formatted for LEO Appendix D.
                    </p>
                    <span className="mt-2 inline-block text-[10px] font-bold text-indigo-600">
                      Edit Profiles →
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Pillar 2: 7 Startup Hats */}
                  <div
                    onClick={() => setOpenStep(2)}
                    className="cursor-pointer rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-3.5 shadow-2xs transition hover:border-indigo-300 hover:shadow-xs"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
                        2. 7 Startup Hats Matrix
                      </span>
                      {step2Complete ? (
                        <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600" />
                      ) : (
                        <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-500" />
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-600">
                      {step2AssignedHatsCount}/7 functional hats mapped •{' '}
                      {step2Data.advisors.length} external advisor(s) in governance roster.
                    </p>
                    <span className="mt-2 inline-block text-[10px] font-bold text-indigo-600">
                      Edit Hat Allocation →
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Pillar 3: Survival Budget & Runway */}
                  <div
                    onClick={() => setOpenStep(3)}
                    className="cursor-pointer rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-3.5 shadow-2xs transition hover:border-indigo-300 hover:shadow-xs"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
                        3. Personal Survival Budget
                      </span>
                      {step3Complete ? (
                        <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600" />
                      ) : (
                        <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-500" />
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-600">
                      {formatPlanCurrency(totalTeamMonthlyDrawingsNeed, step3Data.currencyCode)}/mo survival floor across {step3Data.founderBudgets.length} founder(s).
                    </p>
                    <span className="mt-2 inline-block text-[10px] font-bold text-indigo-600">
                      Edit Survival Runway →
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Pillar 4: Founder Alignment / 20 Hard Questions */}
                  <div
                    onClick={() => setOpenStep(4)}
                    className="cursor-pointer rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-3.5 shadow-2xs transition hover:border-indigo-300 hover:shadow-xs"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
                        4. Founder Alignment Charter
                      </span>
                      {step4Complete ? (
                        <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600" />
                      ) : (
                        <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-500" />
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-600">
                      {isSoloFounderMode
                        ? `${answeredQuestionsCountForActiveFounder}/20 Hard Questions Answered (Solo Charter)`
                        : `${step4Data.responses.length} Founders • ${step4Data.isRevealed ? 'Heatmap Revealed' : 'Blind-Reveal'}`}

                      Review Questions →
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div
                    onClick={() => setOpenStep(5)}
                    className="cursor-pointer rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-3.5 shadow-2xs transition hover:border-indigo-300 hover:shadow-xs sm:col-span-2 lg:col-span-2"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
                        5. 3-Year Headcount &amp; Grant Salary Roadmap
                      </span>
                      {step5Complete ? (
                        <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600" />
                      ) : (
                        <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-500" />
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-600">
                      Year 1: {calculateFteForRoles(step5RolesYear1)} FTEs ({formatPlanCurrency(y1Stats.totalCashBurn, isGb ? 'GBP' : 'EUR')}) → Year 3: {calculateFteForRoles(step5RolesYear3)} FTEs ({formatPlanCurrency(y3Stats.totalCashBurn, isGb ? 'GBP' : 'EUR')}) • {step5Data.roles.length} roles scheduled.
                    </p>
                    <span className="mt-2 inline-block text-[10px] font-bold text-indigo-600">
                      Edit Hiring Schedule →
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* ============================================================= */}
              {/* SECTION 2: AUDIT READINESS POSTURE SELECTOR                   */}
              {/* ============================================================= */}
              <div className="space-y-3 border-t border-indigo-100/80 pt-4">
                <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-1 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
                  <label className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-800">

                    Includes &ldquo;Other&rdquo; custom posture option
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2.5 sm:grid-cols-2">
                  {TEAM_READINESS_CONFIDENCE_OPTIONS.map((opt) => {

                    return (
                      <button
                        key={opt.value}
                        type="button"
                        disabled={isVaultReadonly}

                          setStep6Data((prev) => ({
                            ...prev,
                            readinessConfidence: opt.value,
                          }))
                        }
                        className={`flex flex-col justify-between rounded-xl border p-3 text-left transition ${

                                  : 'border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-[10px] text-slate-600'
                              }
                            >
                              {opt.badge}
                            </Badge>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-slate-600">
                            {opt.subtitle}
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </button>

                {step6Data.readinessConfidence === 'OTHER' && (
                  <div className="rounded-lg border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/40 p-3">

                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                      value={step6Data.otherReadinessConfidenceText || ''}

                        setStep6Data((prev) => ({

                      3. Constructive Team &amp; Governance &ldquo;Things to Consider&rdquo; Blind-Spot Review

                      type="button"
                      size="sm"
                      variant="outline"

                          <Loader2 className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                          Auditing Team &amp; Risks...
                        </>
                      ) : (

                          <Sparkles className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-600" />
                          AI Run Team Blind-Spot Audit &amp; Brief
                        </>
                      )}
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      type="button"
                      size="sm"
                      variant="outline"
                      disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                      onClick={handleAddBlindSpotItem}
                      className="text-xs"

                      <Plus className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      Add Consideration
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-3">
                  {step6Data.blindSpots.map((item, idx) => {
                    const isCritical = item.severity === 'CRITICAL';
                    const isWatch = item.severity === 'WATCH';
                    return (
                      <div
                        key={item.id}
                        className={`rounded-xl border p-3.5 transition ${
                          item.isResolved
                            ? 'border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50/40'
                            : isCritical
                            ? 'border-rose-200 bg-rose-50/30'
                            : isWatch
                            ? 'border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/30'
                            : 'border-amber-200 bg-amber-50/30'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
                          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-md bg-slate-900 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-white">
                              Consideration #{idx + 1}
                            </span>

                            <select
                              disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                              value={item.category}
                              onChange={(e) =>

                                  category: e.target.value as TeamBlindSpotCategoryType,
                                })
                              }
                              className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white px-2 py-1 text-base font-semibold text-slate-800 sm:text-xs"
                            >
                              {TEAM_BLIND_SPOT_CATEGORY_OPTIONS.map((cat) => (
                                <option key={cat.value} value={cat.value}>
                                  {cat.label}
                                </option>
                              ))}
                            </select>

                            <select
                              disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                              value={item.severity}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                handleUpdateBlindSpotItem(item.id, {
                                  severity: e.target.value as TeamBlindSpotSeverityType,
                                })
                              }
                              className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white px-2 py-1 text-base font-bold text-slate-800 sm:text-xs"
                            >
                              <option value="CRITICAL">🚨 Critical Team Risk</option>
                              <option value="IMPORTANT">⚠️ Governance Watch-Out</option>
                              <option value="WATCH">✨ Strategic &amp; Grant Advisory</option>

                          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">

                              type="button"
                              size="sm"
                              variant={item.isResolved ? 'default' : 'outline'}

                              onClick={() => handleToggleBlindSpotResolved(item.id)}

                                item.isResolved

                            <input
                              type="text"
                              disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                              value={item.otherCategoryText || ''}
                              onChange={(e) =>

                                  otherCategoryText: e.target.value,
                                })
                              }
                              placeholder="Specify custom team blind-spot category..."
                              className="w-full rounded-lg border border-indigo-300 bg-white px-2.5 py-1.5 text-base text-slate-900 sm:text-xs"
                            />
                          </div>
                        )}

                        <div className="mt-2.5 grid grid-cols-1 gap-2.5 lg:grid-cols-12">
                          <div className="lg:col-span-4">
                            <label className="block text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-slate-500">
                              Consideration Headline
                            </label>
                            <input
                              type="text"

                              value={item.title}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                handleUpdateBlindSpotItem(item.id, {
                                  title: e.target.value,
                                })
                              }
                              className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white px-2.5 py-1.5 text-base font-semibold text-slate-900 sm:text-xs"

                              Why It Matters to Assessors / Investors
                            </label>
                            <textarea
                              rows={2}
                              disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                              value={item.whyItMatters}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                handleUpdateBlindSpotItem(item.id, {
                                  whyItMatters: e.target.value,
                                })
                              }
                              className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white p-2 text-base text-slate-700 sm:text-xs"
                            />

                            <label className="block text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-slate-500">
                              Recommended Action or Mitigation
                            </label>
                            <textarea
                              rows={2}
                              disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                              value={item.recommendedActionOrFix}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                handleUpdateBlindSpotItem(item.id, {
                                  recommendedActionOrFix: e.target.value,
                                })
                              }
                              className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white p-2 text-base text-slate-700 sm:text-xs"

                      4. Official Grant Form Copy Blocks (LEO Appendix D &amp; Innovate UK Q8)
                    </h3>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                      Copy and paste these verified narrative paragraphs directly into your official grant applications or investment proposals.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <Badge variant="outline" className="border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 text-[10px] text-indigo-700">
                    Auto-Formatted Dossier
                  </Badge>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-4">
                  {/* Block 1: Executive Team Capability */}
                  <div className="space-y-1.5">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800">
                        A. Executive Team Capability &amp; Execution Track Record (LEO Appendix D &amp; Innovate UK Q8)
                      </label>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                        {step6Data.executiveTeamCapabilityNarrative.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length} words
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <textarea
                      rows={4}
                      disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                      value={step6Data.executiveTeamCapabilityNarrative}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setStep6Data((prev) => ({
                          ...prev,
                          executiveTeamCapabilityNarrative: e.target.value,
                        }))
                      }
                      placeholder="Click 'AI Run Team Blind-Spot Audit & Brief' above to synthesize your LEO Appendix D / Innovate UK capability narrative..."
                      className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 bg-white p-3 text-base leading-relaxed text-slate-900 sm:text-xs"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="space-y-1.5">

                      <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800">
                        B. Corporate Governance, 4-Year Vesting &amp; Deadlock Resolution
                      </label>

                        {step6Data.governanceAndVestingNarrative.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length} words
                      </span>

                    <textarea
                      rows={3}

                      value={step6Data.governanceAndVestingNarrative}

                          ...prev,

                        }))
                      }
                      placeholder="Click 'AI Run Team Blind-Spot Audit & Brief' above to synthesize your Corporate Governance narrative..."
                      className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 bg-white p-3 text-base leading-relaxed text-slate-900 sm:text-xs"
                    />
                  </div>

                  {/* Block 3: Talent Retention & Hiring */}
                  <div className="space-y-1.5">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800">
                        C. Talent Retention &amp; Non-Dilutive Grant Salary Offsets (LEO Priming / Innovate UK)
                      </label>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                        {step6Data.talentRetentionAndHiringNarrative.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length} words
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <textarea
                      rows={3}
                      disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                      value={step6Data.talentRetentionAndHiringNarrative}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setStep6Data((prev) => ({
                          ...prev,
                          talentRetentionAndHiringNarrative: e.target.value,
                        }))
                      }
                      placeholder="Click 'AI Run Team Blind-Spot Audit & Brief' above to synthesize your Talent Retention narrative..."
                      className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 bg-white p-3 text-base leading-relaxed text-slate-900 sm:text-xs"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Assessor Coaching Tip */}
              {step6Data.aiCoachTip && (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-indigo-100 bg-indigo-50/60 p-3.5 text-xs text-indigo-950 flex items-start gap-2.5">
                  <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                  <div>
                    <strong className="font-bold text-indigo-900">Grant Assessor Insight: </strong>
                    <span className="leading-relaxed">{step6Data.aiCoachTip}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Save Overview Action */}
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-indigo-100/80 pt-4">
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => setOpenStep(5)}
                  className="text-xs"
                >
                  &larr; Back to Step 5 (Hiring Plan)
                </Button>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleSaveStep6}
                    disabled={isSavingStep6 || isVaultReadonly}
                    className="bg-emerald-600 text-white hover:bg-emerald-700 text-xs font-semibold"
                  >
                    {isSavingStep6 ? (
                      <Loader2 className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                    ) : (
                      <CheckCircle2 className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    )}
                    Save Team Brief (Complete Module F)
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Conversion / Handoff CTA Bar into Module G Launchpad */}
              {onContinueToModuleG && (
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 px-4 py-3.5 text-white">
                  <div className="text-xs min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <span className="font-semibold text-indigo-300">
                      Module F Complete! Ready to set up legal, banking &amp; operational infrastructure for {plan.title}?
                    </span>{' '}
                    <span className="text-slate-300">
                      Continue to Module G: Getting Set Up (Launchpad &amp; Operations Hub) to register CRO / Companies House, live domain &amp; official email, business banking, and statutory insurance.
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    size="sm"
                    disabled={isVaultReadonly || isSavingStep6}
                    onClick={async () => {
                      await handleSaveStep6();
                      onContinueToModuleG();
                    }}
                    className="shrink-0 bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-500 text-xs font-semibold"
                  >
                    Continue to Module G: Launchpad
                    <ArrowRight className="ml-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  </Button>
                </div>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  FileText,
  Sparkles,
  Printer,
  Download,
  Copy,
  Check,
  Pencil,
  Save,
  ShieldCheck,
  Compass,
  BarChart3,
  MessageSquare,
  Wrench,
  Briefcase,
  Users,
  DollarSign,
  Megaphone,
  Scale,
  ArrowUpRight,
  Loader2,
  Eye,
  Lock,
  CheckCircle2,
  Layers,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { formatPlanCurrency } from '@/lib/localization';
import type { BlindSpotItem } from '@/db/schema';
import type { ModuleCode } from '@/lib/entitlements';
import type {
  ActiveStartupPlan,
  SavedConceptCanvas,
  SavedFounderMotivation,
  SavedTeamAndBudget,
  SavedFounderRealityCheck,
  SavedMasterDocumentData,
} from '@/lib/auth/session-store';
import {
  formatInterviewChannel,
  formatInterviewCommitment,
  INTERVIEW_SIGNAL_LABELS,
} from '@/lib/export/module-c-brief';
import {
  extractMasterDocumentVerifiedFacts,
  buildDeterministicMasterStory,
  buildMasterDocumentMarkdown,
  buildMasterDocumentStandaloneHtml,
  sanitizeSurveyTerminologyForReader,
} from '@/lib/export/master-document-brief';

export interface MasterDocumentWorkspaceProps {
  plan: ActiveStartupPlan;
  founderName: string;
  brainDumpText: string;
  conceptCanvas: SavedConceptCanvas;
  founderMotivation: SavedFounderMotivation;
  teamAndBudget: SavedTeamAndBudget;
  founderRealityCheck: SavedFounderRealityCheck;
  moduleABlindSpots: BlindSpotItem[];
  whiteLabelEnabled?: boolean;
  isVaultReadonly?: boolean;
  onJumpToModule: (moduleCode: ModuleCode) => void;
  onSaveMasterDocumentData: (data: SavedMasterDocumentData) => Promise<void>;
  onWeaveStoryWithAi: (
    facts: ReturnType<typeof extractMasterDocumentVerifiedFacts>
  ) => Promise<{
    allowed: boolean;
    reason?: string;
    story: SavedMasterDocumentData;
    engineMode: 'gemini-2.5-flash' | 'smart-synthesizer';
  }>;
}

export function MasterDocumentWorkspace({
  plan,
  founderName,
  brainDumpText,
  conceptCanvas,
  founderMotivation,
  teamAndBudget,
  founderRealityCheck,
  moduleABlindSpots,
  whiteLabelEnabled = false,
  isVaultReadonly = false,
  onJumpToModule,
  onSaveMasterDocumentData,
  onWeaveStoryWithAi,
}: MasterDocumentWorkspaceProps) {
  const facts = extractMasterDocumentVerifiedFacts({
    plan,
    founderName,
    brainDumpText,
    conceptCanvas,
    founderMotivation,
    teamAndBudget,
    founderRealityCheck,
    moduleABlindSpots,
    whiteLabelEnabled,
  });

  const deterministicStory = buildDeterministicMasterStory(facts);

  // If the user has custom-edited or AI-weaved the story, use that; otherwise use live deterministic story
  const effectiveStory: SavedMasterDocumentData = plan.masterDocumentData
    ?.paragraph1OpportunityAndMarket
    ? {
        ...deterministicStory,
        ...plan.masterDocumentData,
        paragraph1OpportunityAndMarket: sanitizeSurveyTerminologyForReader(
          plan.masterDocumentData.paragraph1OpportunityAndMarket
        ),
        paragraph2ValidationAndProduct: sanitizeSurveyTerminologyForReader(
          plan.masterDocumentData.paragraph2ValidationAndProduct
        ),
        paragraph3OperationsAndExecution: sanitizeSurveyTerminologyForReader(
          plan.masterDocumentData.paragraph3OperationsAndExecution
        ),
        paragraph1Sources: deterministicStory.paragraph1Sources,
        paragraph2Sources: deterministicStory.paragraph2Sources,
        paragraph3Sources: deterministicStory.paragraph3Sources,
      }
    : deterministicStory;

  const [showUpcomingRoadmap, setShowUpcomingRoadmap] = useState<boolean>(
    Boolean(plan.masterDocumentData?.showUpcomingChaptersRoadmap)
  );
  const [isEditingStory, setIsEditingStory] = useState(false);
  const [draftP1, setDraftP1] = useState(
    effectiveStory.paragraph1OpportunityAndMarket
  );
  const [draftP2, setDraftP2] = useState(
    effectiveStory.paragraph2ValidationAndProduct
  );
  const [draftP3, setDraftP3] = useState(
    effectiveStory.paragraph3OperationsAndExecution
  );
  const [isWeavingStory, setIsWeavingStory] = useState(false);
  const [isSavingStory, setIsSavingStory] = useState(false);
  const [copiedMarkdown, setCopiedMarkdown] = useState(false);
  const [statusBanner, setStatusBanner] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isEditingStory) {
      setDraftP1(effectiveStory.paragraph1OpportunityAndMarket);
      setDraftP2(effectiveStory.paragraph2ValidationAndProduct);
      setDraftP3(effectiveStory.paragraph3OperationsAndExecution);
    }
  }, [
    plan.id,
    effectiveStory.paragraph1OpportunityAndMarket,
    effectiveStory.paragraph2ValidationAndProduct,
    effectiveStory.paragraph3OperationsAndExecution,
    isEditingStory,
  ]);

  function scrollToAnchor(id: string) {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el) {
      el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
    }
  }

  async function handleWeaveWithAi() {
    setIsWeavingStory(true);
    setStatusBanner(null);
    try {
      const res = await onWeaveStoryWithAi(facts);
      if (res.allowed) {
        setDraftP1(res.story.paragraph1OpportunityAndMarket);
        setDraftP2(res.story.paragraph2ValidationAndProduct);
        setDraftP3(res.story.paragraph3OperationsAndExecution);
        setIsEditingStory(false);
        setStatusBanner(
          res.engineMode === 'gemini-2.5-flash'
            ? '✨ Cohesive Executive Story woven strictly from your saved inputs (Zero-Hallucination Verified)!'
            : '✨ Cohesive Executive Story updated from your verified workspace inputs!'
        );
      }
    } finally {
      setIsWeavingStory(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleSaveCustomStory() {
    setIsSavingStory(true);
    setStatusBanner(null);
    try {
      const updated: SavedMasterDocumentData = {
        ...effectiveStory,
        paragraph1OpportunityAndMarket:
          sanitizeSurveyTerminologyForReader(draftP1.trim()) ||
          deterministicStory.paragraph1OpportunityAndMarket,
        paragraph2ValidationAndProduct:
          sanitizeSurveyTerminologyForReader(draftP2.trim()) ||
          deterministicStory.paragraph2ValidationAndProduct,
        paragraph3OperationsAndExecution:
          sanitizeSurveyTerminologyForReader(draftP3.trim()) ||
          deterministicStory.paragraph3OperationsAndExecution,
        isCustomEdited: true,
        showUpcomingChaptersRoadmap: showUpcomingRoadmap,
        lastWeavedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
      await onSaveMasterDocumentData(updated);
      setIsEditingStory(false);
      setStatusBanner('✅ Your Executive Story edits have been saved!');
    } finally {
      setIsSavingStory(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleToggleRoadmap(nextVal: boolean) {
    setShowUpcomingRoadmap(nextVal);
    await onSaveMasterDocumentData({
      ...effectiveStory,
      showUpcomingChaptersRoadmap: nextVal,
    }).catch(() => {});
  }

  function handleDownloadHtml() {
    const htmlContent = buildMasterDocumentStandaloneHtml({
      plan,
      founderName,
      brainDumpText,
      conceptCanvas,
      founderMotivation,
      teamAndBudget,
      founderRealityCheck,
      moduleABlindSpots,
      whiteLabelEnabled,
      story: effectiveStory,
      showUpcomingChaptersRoadmap: showUpcomingRoadmap,
    });
    const blob = new Blob([htmlContent], { type: 'text/html;charset=utf-8' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    const safeSlug =
      plan.title
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
        .replace(/^-|-$/g, '') || 'startup';
    link.href = url;
    link.download = `${safeSlug}-master-business-blueprint.html`;
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    setStatusBanner(
      '📄 Downloaded your standalone Living Master Business Blueprint (.html)!'
    );
  }

  function handlePrintPdf() {
    const htmlContent = buildMasterDocumentStandaloneHtml({
      plan,
      founderName,
      brainDumpText,
      conceptCanvas,
      founderMotivation,
      teamAndBudget,
      founderRealityCheck,
      moduleABlindSpots,
      whiteLabelEnabled,
      story: effectiveStory,
      showUpcomingChaptersRoadmap: showUpcomingRoadmap,
    });
    const printWindow = window.open('', '_blank', 'width=980,height=820');
    if (!printWindow) {
      handleDownloadHtml();
      return;
    }
    printWindow.document.open();
    printWindow.document.write(htmlContent);
    printWindow.document.close();
    printWindow.focus();
    setTimeout(() => {
      printWindow.print();
    }, 250);
  }

  async function handleCopyMarkdown() {
    const md = buildMasterDocumentMarkdown({
      plan,
      founderName,
      brainDumpText,
      conceptCanvas,
      founderMotivation,
      teamAndBudget,
      founderRealityCheck,
      moduleABlindSpots,
      whiteLabelEnabled,
      story: effectiveStory,
      showUpcomingChaptersRoadmap: showUpcomingRoadmap,
    });
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(md);
      setCopiedMarkdown(true);
      setStatusBanner(
        '📋 Copied your complete Living Master Business Blueprint to clipboard!'
      );
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedMarkdown(false), 3000);
    } catch {
      // Clipboard fallback
    }
  }

  const formattedDate = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-IE', {
    day: 'numeric',
    month: 'short',
    year: 'numeric',
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* =================================================================== */}
      {/* TOP MASTER DOCUMENT CONTROL BAR & CHAPTER JUMP NAVIGATION           */}
      {/* =================================================================== */}
      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-indigo-200 bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-950 via-slate-900 to-violet-950 p-5 text-white shadow-md sm:p-6">
        <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-start">
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-500/25 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-200 ring-1 ring-indigo-400/30">
                <FileText className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-300" />
                Living Master Blueprint
              </span>
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/20 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-200 ring-1 ring-emerald-400/30">
                <ShieldCheck className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-300" />
                Zero-Hallucination Verified
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-300">
                {facts.activeChaptersCount} of 12 Chapters Active (
                {facts.overallCompletionPercent}% Assembled)
              </span>
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-white sm:text-2xl">
              {facts.planTitle} — Whole-Picture Master Document
            </h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-300 sm:text-sm">
              Prepared by <span className="font-semibold text-white">{facts.founderName}</span> •{' '}
              HQ: <span className="font-semibold text-white">{facts.countryName} ({facts.currency})</span> •{' '}
              Sector: <span className="font-semibold text-white">{facts.industryCategory}</span> •{' '}
              Updated {formattedDate}
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Export Action Buttons */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <Button
              type="button"
              size="sm"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => onJumpToModule('MOD_L_BUSINESS_PLAN')}
              className="border-emerald-400/50 bg-emerald-500/20 text-xs font-bold text-emerald-100 hover:bg-emerald-500/30"
            >
              <Sparkles className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-300" />
              Open Official Compiler (Mod L)
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="button"
              size="sm"
              onClick={handlePrintPdf}
              className="bg-white text-xs font-bold text-indigo-950 hover:bg-indigo-50"
            >
              <Printer className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-700" />
              Print / Save PDF
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="button"
              size="sm"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={handleDownloadHtml}
              className="border-indigo-400/40 bg-indigo-900/40 text-xs text-white hover:bg-indigo-800/60"
            >
              <Download className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-200" />
              Download .HTML
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="button"
              size="sm"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={handleCopyMarkdown}
              className="border-indigo-400/40 bg-indigo-900/40 text-xs text-white hover:bg-indigo-800/60"
            >
              {copiedMarkdown ? (
                <>
                  <Check className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-300" />
                  Copied!
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Copy className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-200" />
                  Copy Markdown
                </>
              )}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Chapter Jump Bar & Unstarted Chapters Toggle */}
        <div className="mt-4 flex flex-col justify-between gap-3 border-t border-white/10 pt-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className="mr-1 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-300">
              Jump to:
            </span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => scrollToAnchor('master-doc-snapshot')}
              className="rounded-lg bg-white/10 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-white transition hover:bg-white/20"
            >
              1. Executive Snapshot
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => scrollToAnchor('master-doc-story')}
              className="rounded-lg bg-white/10 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-white transition hover:bg-white/20"
            >
              2. Cohesive Story
            </button>
            {facts.hasModuleA && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => scrollToAnchor('master-doc-ch-a')}
                className="rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/20 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-emerald-100 ring-1 ring-emerald-400/30 transition hover:bg-emerald-500/30"
              >
                Ch 1: Concept (A)
              </button>
            )}
            {facts.hasModuleB && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => scrollToAnchor('master-doc-ch-b')}
                className="rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/20 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-emerald-100 ring-1 ring-emerald-400/30 transition hover:bg-emerald-500/30"
              >
                Ch 2: Market (B)
              </button>
            )}
            {facts.hasModuleC && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => scrollToAnchor('master-doc-ch-c')}
                className="rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/20 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-emerald-100 ring-1 ring-emerald-400/30 transition hover:bg-emerald-500/30"
              >
                Ch 3: Validation (C)

              </span>
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 sm:text-lg">
                  Chapter 12: Interactive Business Plan &amp; Grant Compiler (Module L)
                </h2>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                  Pre-Flight Contradiction Audit, official grant narrative compiler &amp; mandatory proof binder.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onJumpToModule('MOD_L_BUSINESS_PLAN')}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-800"
            >
              <Pencil className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              Edit in Module L
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 p-4 text-sm text-slate-700">
              <div className="mb-1 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
                Compiler Mode &amp; Objective
              </div>
              <p>
                <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">Mode:</span>{' '}
                <span className="font-bold text-indigo-900">{facts.compilerModeLabel}</span>
              </p>
              <p className="mt-1">
                <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">Target Committee:</span>{' '}
                {facts.targetAgencyOrCommitteeName} ({formatPlanCurrency(facts.targetFundingAskAmount, facts.currency)} ask • {facts.submissionObjectiveLabel})
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 p-4 text-sm text-slate-700">
              <div className="mb-1 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
                Pre-Flight Contradiction Audit &amp; Readiness
              </div>
              <p>
                <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">Audit Score:</span>{' '}
                <span className="font-bold text-emerald-700">{facts.contradictionAuditScore}/100 Pre-Flight Clearance</span>{' '}
                ({facts.auditPassedCount} Passed, {facts.auditWarningCount} Warnings, {facts.auditCriticalCount} Critical)
              </p>
              <p className="mt-1">
                <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">Dossier Readiness:</span>{' '}
                {facts.compiledSectionsCount} question(s) compiled (~{facts.totalCompiledWordCount.toLocaleString()} words) •{' '}
                {facts.appendicesReadyCount}/{facts.totalAppendicesCount} proof appendices ready (
                <span className="font-bold text-indigo-700">{facts.committeeReadinessScore}/100 Committee Ready</span>)
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {facts.executiveHookStatement && (
            <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-indigo-100 bg-indigo-50/50 p-3.5 text-xs text-indigo-950">
              <div className="mb-1 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-700">
                Executive Hook Statement
              </div>
              <p className="italic leading-relaxed">"{facts.executiveHookStatement}"</p>
            </div>
          )}

          {facts.preFlightDefenseSummary && (
            <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/60 p-4 text-sm text-slate-700">
              <div className="mb-1 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-600">
                Pre-Flight Assessor Defense Statement
              </div>
              <p className="leading-relaxed">{facts.preFlightDefenseSummary}</p>
            </div>
          )}

          {facts.executiveDossierSummary && (
            <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/60 p-4 text-sm text-slate-700">
              <div className="mb-1 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-700">
                Official Submission Dossier Executive Brief
              </div>
              <p className="leading-relaxed">{facts.executiveDossierSummary}</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </section>
      ) : (
        <section className="rounded-2xl border border-indigo-200 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-50 via-white to-emerald-50/60 p-5 shadow-xs sm:p-6">
          <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-700">
                <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-600" />
                Module L • Official Grant &amp; Business Plan Compiler
              </div>
              <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
                Ready to compile your official LEO, Innovate UK, Start Up Loans, or SEIS/EIS pack?
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-600">
                Module L auto-compiles all 11 foundation chapters (Modules A–K) into official submission templates with live proof blocks and Pre-Flight Contradiction &amp; Grant Audit.
              </p>
            </div>
            <Button
              type="button"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => onJumpToModule('MOD_L_BUSINESS_PLAN')}
              className="shrink-0 bg-indigo-600 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-indigo-700"
            >
              Open Module L Compiler
              <ArrowUpRight className="ml-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </Button>
          </div>
        </section>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
