export interface ModuleLModeSelectorStepProps {
  plan: ActiveStartupPlan;
  isOpen: boolean;
  onOpenStep: () => void;
  onToggleCollapse: () => void;
  isVaultReadonly?: boolean;
  onSaveStep1: (
    data: ModuleLStep1ModeSavedData,
    progress?: number
  ) => Promise<void> | void;
  onAdvanceToStep2: () => void;
  onJumpToCompilerStep3?: () => void;
  onParkQuestionInSession?: (questionText: string) => void;
}

export function ModuleLModeSelectorStep({
  plan,
  isOpen,
  onOpenStep,
  onToggleCollapse,
  isVaultReadonly = false,
  onSaveStep1,
  onAdvanceToStep2,
  onJumpToCompilerStep3,
  onParkQuestionInSession,
}: ModuleLModeSelectorStepProps) {
  const trackCaps = useMemo(
    () => getPlanTrackCapabilities(plan.hqCountryCode, plan.fundingTrackMode),
    [plan.hqCountryCode, plan.fundingTrackMode]
  );
  const isUK = trackCaps.countryCode === 'GB';
  const isIreland = trackCaps.countryCode === 'IE';
  const isGrantsEnabled = trackCaps.isGrantsEnabled;
  const currency =
    plan.baseCurrency || (isUK ? 'GBP' : isIreland ? 'EUR' : 'USD');

  // Filter compiler modes so international & commercial-only plans only see global commercial formats
  const availableCompilerModes = useMemo(() => {
    return MODULE_L_COMPILER_MODES.filter((m) => {
      if (!isGrantsEnabled) {
        return m.countryTag === 'GLOBAL';
      }
      if (isIreland) {
        return (
          m.countryTag === 'IE' ||
          m.countryTag === 'IE_GB' ||
          m.countryTag === 'GLOBAL'
        );
      }
      if (isUK) {
        return (
          m.countryTag === 'GB' ||
          m.countryTag === 'IE_GB' ||
          m.countryTag === 'GLOBAL'
        );
      }
      return m.countryTag === 'GLOBAL';
    });
  }, [isGrantsEnabled, isIreland, isUK]);

  const availableObjectiveOptions = useMemo(() => {
    if (isGrantsEnabled) return SUBMISSION_OBJECTIVE_OPTIONS;
    return [
      {
        value: 'BANK_OR_COMMERCIAL_PARTNERSHIP' as ModuleLSubmissionObjectiveType,
        label: 'Commercial Bank, Lease or Enterprise Approval',
        subtitle: 'Prove working capital resilience, insurance & operational SLA readiness',
      },
      {
        value: 'TAX_RELIEF_CLEARANCE_AND_SEED' as ModuleLSubmissionObjectiveType,
        label: 'Angel Syndicate / Pre-Seed Equity Round',
        subtitle: 'Demonstrate scalable unit economics, TAM/SAM/SOM wedge & 18-month runway',
      },
      {
        value: 'OTHER' as ModuleLSubmissionObjectiveType,
        label: 'Other Submission Objective',
        subtitle: 'Specify a custom milestone, accelerator, or board approval goal',
      },
    ];
  }, [isGrantsEnabled]);

  // Derive intelligent default mode from Module K or HQ Country
  const syncedRecommendedMode: ModuleLCompilerModeType = useMemo(() => {
    if (!isGrantsEnabled) {
      return 'STANDARD_COMMERCIAL_PLAN';
    }
    const modKMode = plan.moduleKData?.step5FundingBrief?.moduleLGrantMode;
    if (modKMode === 'IE_LEO' && isIreland) return 'IE_LEO_OFFICIAL_FORM';
    if (modKMode === 'UK_INNOVATE_UK' && isUK) return 'UK_INNOVATE_UK_9Q';
    if (modKMode === 'UK_START_UP_LOANS' && isUK) return 'UK_START_UP_LOANS_WORKBOOK';
    if (modKMode === 'HMRC_SEIS') return 'INVESTOR_SEIS_EIS_EII_PACK';

    const selectedGrant = plan.moduleKData?.step1Audit?.selectedGrantKey;
    if (selectedGrant === 'GB_INNOVATE_UK_SMART' && isUK) return 'UK_INNOVATE_UK_9Q';
    if (selectedGrant === 'GB_BBB_START_UP_LOAN' && isUK) return 'UK_START_UP_LOANS_WORKBOOK';
    if (
      selectedGrant === 'GB_HMRC_SEIS_ASSURANCE' ||
      selectedGrant === 'IE_EI_EII_INVESTOR_RELIEF'
    ) {
      return 'INVESTOR_SEIS_EIS_EII_PACK';
    }
    if (isIreland) return 'IE_LEO_OFFICIAL_FORM';
    if (isUK) return 'UK_INNOVATE_UK_9Q';
    return 'STANDARD_COMMERCIAL_PLAN';
  }, [isGrantsEnabled, isIreland, isUK, plan.moduleKData]);

  // Derive intelligent default ask amount from Module K or Module J
  const syncedDefaultAskAmount = useMemo(() => {
    const modKGrants = plan.moduleKData?.step2CapitalStack?.totalGrantsAllocated || 0;
    const modKLoans = plan.moduleKData?.step2CapitalStack?.totalLoansAllocated || 0;
    const modKAngel = plan.moduleKData?.step2CapitalStack?.totalAngelAllocated || 0;
    const modKTotalGap = plan.moduleKData?.step2CapitalStack?.totalTargetFundingGap || 0;
    if (isGrantsEnabled && modKGrants > 0) return modKGrants;
    if (modKLoans > 0) return modKLoans;
    if (modKAngel > 0) return modKAngel;
    if (modKTotalGap > 0) return modKTotalGap;
    return 25000;
  }, [plan.moduleKData, isGrantsEnabled]);

  const saved = plan.moduleLData?.step1Mode;
  const resolvedInitialMode: ModuleLCompilerModeType = useMemo(() => {
    if (
      saved?.compilerMode &&
      availableCompilerModes.some((m) => m.mode === saved.compilerMode)
    ) {
      return saved.compilerMode;
    }
    return syncedRecommendedMode;
  }, [saved?.compilerMode, availableCompilerModes, syncedRecommendedMode]);

  const initialCatalog =
    availableCompilerModes.find((m) => m.mode === resolvedInitialMode) ||
    MODULE_L_COMPILER_MODES.find((m) => m.mode === 'STANDARD_COMMERCIAL_PLAN') ||
    MODULE_L_COMPILER_MODES[0];

  const [compilerMode, setCompilerMode] = useState<ModuleLCompilerModeType>(
    resolvedInitialMode
  );
  const [otherCompilerModeText, setOtherCompilerModeText] = useState<string>(
    saved?.otherCompilerModeText || ''
  );
  const [narrativeTone, setNarrativeTone] = useState<ModuleLNarrativeToneType>(
    saved?.narrativeTone || initialCatalog.defaultTone
  );
  const [otherNarrativeToneText, setOtherNarrativeToneText] = useState<string>(
    saved?.otherNarrativeToneText || ''
  );
  const [submissionObjective, setSubmissionObjective] =
    useState<ModuleLSubmissionObjectiveType>(
      saved?.submissionObjective || initialCatalog.defaultObjective
    );
  const [otherSubmissionObjectiveText, setOtherSubmissionObjectiveText] =
    useState<string>(saved?.otherSubmissionObjectiveText || '');
  const [submissionWindow, setSubmissionWindow] =
    useState<ModuleLSubmissionWindowType>(
      saved?.submissionWindow || 'IMMEDIATE_THIS_MONTH'
    );
  const [otherSubmissionWindowText, setOtherSubmissionWindowText] =
    useState<string>(saved?.otherSubmissionWindowText || '');
  const [targetAgencyOrCommitteeName, setTargetAgencyOrCommitteeName] =
    useState<string>(
      saved?.targetAgencyOrCommitteeName || initialCatalog.defaultAgencyName
    );
  const [targetFundingAskAmount, setTargetFundingAskAmount] = useState<number>(
    saved?.targetFundingAskAmount ?? syncedDefaultAskAmount
  );
  const [includeAppendicesBinder, setIncludeAppendicesBinder] =
    useState<boolean>(saved?.includeAppendicesBinder ?? true);
  const [strictWordCountEnforcement, setStrictWordCountEnforcement] =
    useState<boolean>(saved?.strictWordCountEnforcement ?? true);
  const [compilerMandateNotes, setCompilerMandateNotes] = useState<string>(
    saved?.compilerMandateNotes ||
      `Compile "${plan.title}" for ${initialCatalog.defaultAgencyName} (${formatPlanCurrency(syncedDefaultAskAmount, currency)} target ask). Anchor every section in verified customer validation from Module C, product work packages from Module D, 3-quote operational controls from Module E, and 36-month cashflow projections from Module J.`
  );
  const [aiAssessorTip, setAiAssessorTip] = useState<string>(
    saved?.aiAssessorTip || initialCatalog.underwriterFootNote
  );
  const [aiEngineUsed, setAiEngineUsed] = useState<
    'gemini-2.5-flash' | 'smart-synthesizer' | undefined
  >(saved?.aiEngineUsed);

  const [showWhyDrawer, setShowWhyDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [showExampleDrawer, setShowExampleDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [isGeneratingAi, setIsGeneratingAi] = useState(false);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [statusMessage, setStatusMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!availableCompilerModes.some((m) => m.mode === compilerMode)) {
      const fallback =
        availableCompilerModes.find((m) => m.mode === syncedRecommendedMode) ||
        availableCompilerModes[0];
      if (fallback) {
        setCompilerMode(fallback.mode);
        setNarrativeTone(fallback.defaultTone);
        setSubmissionObjective(fallback.defaultObjective);
        setTargetAgencyOrCommitteeName(fallback.defaultAgencyName);
      }
    }
  }, [availableCompilerModes, compilerMode, syncedRecommendedMode]);

  const activeCatalogItem = useMemo(
    () =>
      availableCompilerModes.find((m) => m.mode === compilerMode) ||
      MODULE_L_COMPILER_MODES.find((m) => m.mode === compilerMode) ||
      availableCompilerModes[0] ||
      MODULE_L_COMPILER_MODES[0],
    [compilerMode, availableCompilerModes]
  );

  // Calculate live cross-module telemetry for the 4-Card Underwriting Diagnostic Grid
  const moduleSyncTelemetry = useMemo(() => {
    const modules = [
      { code: 'Mod A (Concept)', ready: Boolean(plan.conceptCanvas?.coreProblem || plan.brainDumpText) },
      { code: 'Mod B (Market)', ready: Boolean(plan.moduleBData?.beachhead || plan.moduleBData?.marketSizing) },
      { code: 'Mod C (Validation)', ready: Boolean((plan.moduleCData?.surveys?.length || 0) > 0 || (plan.moduleCData?.interviewLogs?.length || 0) > 0) },
      { code: 'Mod D (Product)', ready: Boolean(plan.moduleDData?.productVehicle || plan.moduleDData?.workPackagesAndFlow) },
      { code: 'Mod E (Operations)', ready: Boolean(plan.moduleEData?.operationsBlueprint || plan.moduleEData?.riskRegister) },
      { code: 'Mod F (Team)', ready: Boolean(plan.moduleFData?.promoterProfiles || plan.moduleFData?.step3SurvivalBudgetData) },
      { code: 'Mod G (Launchpad)', ready: Boolean(plan.moduleGData?.step1) },
      { code: 'Mod H (Revenue)', ready: Boolean(plan.moduleHData?.step1RevenueModel || plan.moduleHData?.step3BreakevenCalculator) },
      { code: 'Mod I (Marketing)', ready: Boolean(plan.moduleIData?.step1Positioning || plan.moduleIData?.step3First10) },
      { code: 'Mod J (Finance)', ready: Boolean(plan.moduleJData?.step1OverheadsTax || plan.moduleJData?.step3CashflowGap) },
      { code: 'Mod K (Grants)', ready: Boolean(plan.moduleKData?.step1Audit || plan.moduleKData?.step2CapitalStack) },
    ];
    const syncedCount = modules.filter((m) => m.ready).length;

    const appendicesReady = [
      Boolean(plan.moduleFData?.promoterProfiles), // App A: CVs & Cap Table
      Boolean(plan.moduleJData?.step1OverheadsTax || plan.moduleHData?.step3BreakevenCalculator), // App B: 3-Yr Financials
      Boolean(plan.moduleDData?.workPackagesAndFlow || plan.moduleEData?.premisesAndEquipment), // App C: Work Packages & Quotes
      Boolean((plan.moduleCData?.surveys?.length || 0) > 0 || (plan.moduleCData?.interviewLogs?.length || 0) > 0), // App D: Survey Proof
      Boolean(plan.moduleEData?.riskRegister), // App E: Risk Register
      Boolean(plan.moduleGData?.step1 || plan.moduleKData?.step2CapitalStack), // App F: Statutory & Capital Stack
    ].filter(Boolean).length;

    return {
      syncedCount,
      totalModules: 11,
      appendicesReady,
      totalAppendices: 6,
    };
  }, [plan]);

  const isStepComplete = Boolean(saved?.lastSavedAt);

  function handleSelectMode(nextMode: ModuleLCompilerModeType) {
    if (isVaultReadonly) return;
    setCompilerMode(nextMode);
    const catalog =
      MODULE_L_COMPILER_MODES.find((m) => m.mode === nextMode) ||
      MODULE_L_COMPILER_MODES[0];
    setNarrativeTone(catalog.defaultTone);
    setSubmissionObjective(catalog.defaultObjective);
    setTargetAgencyOrCommitteeName(catalog.defaultAgencyName);
    setAiAssessorTip(catalog.underwriterFootNote);
    setCompilerMandateNotes(
      `Compile "${plan.title}" for ${catalog.defaultAgencyName} (${formatPlanCurrency(targetFundingAskAmount, currency)} target ask) using the ${catalog.title} rubric (${catalog.rubricWeightsSummary}).`
    );
  }

  async function handleCalibrateWithAi() {
    if (isVaultReadonly || isGeneratingAi) return;
    setIsGeneratingAi(true);
    setStatusMessage(null);
    try {
      const res = await generateModuleLStep1MandateAction({
        planId: plan.id,
        planTitle: plan.title,
        oneLinerSummary: plan.oneLinerSummary,
        industryCategory: plan.industryCategory,
        hqCountryCode: plan.hqCountryCode,
        baseCurrency: currency,
        compilerMode,
        otherCompilerModeText,
        targetAgencyOrCommitteeName,
        targetFundingAskAmount,
        exportPotential: plan.exportPotential,
      });

      if (res.allowed) {
        setCompilerMandateNotes(res.compilerMandateNotes);
        setAiAssessorTip(res.assessorStrategyTip);
        setNarrativeTone(res.recommendedNarrativeTone);
        setSubmissionObjective(res.recommendedSubmissionObjective);
        setAiEngineUsed(res.engineMode);
        setStatusMessage(
          res.engineMode === 'gemini-2.5-flash'
            ? '✨ Calibrated compilation mandate and evaluator scoring tip with Preflight AI!'
            : '✨ Calibrated compilation mandate and evaluator scoring rubric from your workspace data!'
        );
      }
    } finally {
      setIsGeneratingAi(false);
    }
  }

  function handleApplyIndustryBenchmark() {
    if (isVaultReadonly) return;
    const catalog = activeCatalogItem;
    const benchmarkAsk =
      compilerMode === 'IE_LEO_OFFICIAL_FORM'
        ? 25000
        : compilerMode === 'UK_INNOVATE_UK_9Q'
          ? 100000
          : compilerMode === 'UK_START_UP_LOANS_WORKBOOK'
            ? 25000
            : compilerMode === 'INVESTOR_SEIS_EIS_EII_PACK'
              ? 150000
              : 50000;
    setTargetFundingAskAmount(benchmarkAsk);
    setTargetAgencyOrCommitteeName(catalog.defaultAgencyName);
    setNarrativeTone(catalog.defaultTone);
    setSubmissionObjective(catalog.defaultObjective);
    setIncludeAppendicesBinder(true);
    setStrictWordCountEnforcement(true);
    setCompilerMandateNotes(
      `Compile "${plan.title}" for ${catalog.defaultAgencyName} (${formatPlanCurrency(benchmarkAsk, currency)} benchmark ask). Enforce ${catalog.wordLimitDisciplineLabel} discipline and attach Appendices A–F.`
    );
    setStatusMessage(
      `✅ Applied standard ${catalog.badge} committee benchmark (${formatPlanCurrency(benchmarkAsk, currency)} target ask).`
    );
  }

  async function handleParkOpenQuestion() {
    const question = `Module L Step 1 (Compiler Mode): Confirm exact submission window and committee ceiling for ${targetAgencyOrCommitteeName} (${formatPlanCurrency(targetFundingAskAmount, currency)} target).`;
    onParkQuestionInSession?.(question);
    await parkModuleLOpenQuestionAction({
      planId: plan.id,
      questionText: question,
    });
    setStatusMessage(
      '📌 Parked committee deadline & ask verification in your Open Questions Parking Lot!'
    );
  }

  function buildPayload(): ModuleLStep1ModeSavedData {
    return {
      compilerMode,
      otherCompilerModeText:
        compilerMode === 'OTHER' ? otherCompilerModeText.trim() : undefined,
      narrativeTone,
      otherNarrativeToneText:
        narrativeTone === 'OTHER' ? otherNarrativeToneText.trim() : undefined,
      submissionObjective,
      otherSubmissionObjectiveText:
        submissionObjective === 'OTHER'
          ? otherSubmissionObjectiveText.trim()
          : undefined,
      submissionWindow,
      otherSubmissionWindowText:
        submissionWindow === 'OTHER'
          ? otherSubmissionWindowText.trim()
          : undefined,
      targetAgencyOrCommitteeName:
        targetAgencyOrCommitteeName.trim() || activeCatalogItem.defaultAgencyName,
      targetFundingAskAmount: Math.max(0, Number(targetFundingAskAmount) || 0),
      includeAppendicesBinder,
      strictWordCountEnforcement,
      compilerMandateNotes: compilerMandateNotes.trim(),
      aiAssessorTip,
      aiEngineUsed: aiEngineUsed || 'smart-synthesizer',
      lastSavedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
  }

  async function handleSaveOnly() {
    if (isVaultReadonly || isSaving) return;
    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      const payload = buildPayload();
      await onSaveStep1(payload, 20);
      setStatusMessage('✅ Saved Step 1 Compiler Mode & Committee Rubric settings!');
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleSaveAndContinue() {
    if (isSaving) return;
    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      if (!isVaultReadonly) {
        const payload = buildPayload();
        await onSaveStep1(payload, 20);
      }
      onAdvanceToStep2();
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleSaveAndJumpToCompiler() {
    if (isSaving) return;
    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      if (!isVaultReadonly) {
        const payload = buildPayload();
        await onSaveStep1(payload, 20);
      }
      if (onJumpToCompilerStep3) {
        onJumpToCompilerStep3();
      } else {
        onAdvanceToStep2();
      }
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  }

  // ===========================================================================
  // COLLAPSED STEP STATE (Strict GEMINI.md Section 6.1 Standard)
  // ===========================================================================
  if (!isOpen) {
    return (
      <div
        id="module-l-step-1"
        onClick={onOpenStep}
        className="group scroll-mt-24 cursor-pointer rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-xs transition-all hover:border-indigo-300 hover:shadow-sm"
      >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
            <div
              className={`flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-xs font-bold ${
                isStepComplete
                  ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                  : 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
              }`}
            >
              {isStepComplete ? <Check className="h-4 w-4" /> : '1'}
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <h2 className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 group-hover:text-indigo-600">
                  1. Compiler Mode, Target Committee &amp; Scoring Rubric
                </h2>
                <Badge
                  variant={isStepComplete ? 'default' : 'outline'}
                  className={
                    isStepComplete
                      ? 'shrink-0 bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300 text-[10px] font-medium'
                      : 'shrink-0 border-slate-300 text-slate-600 text-[10px] font-medium'
                  }
                >
                  {isStepComplete ? 'Mode Locked' : 'In Progress'}
                </Badge>
                <Badge
                  variant="outline"
                  className="shrink-0 border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 text-[10px] font-medium"
                >
                  {activeCatalogItem.badge}
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-xs text-slate-500">
                {compilerMode === 'OTHER' && otherCompilerModeText
                  ? `Custom Mode: ${otherCompilerModeText}`
                  : activeCatalogItem.title}{' '}
                • Target: {targetAgencyOrCommitteeName} (
                {formatPlanCurrency(targetFundingAskAmount, currency)})
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <Button
            type="button"
            size="sm"
            variant="ghost"
            className="h-8 shrink-0 px-2.5 text-xs font-medium text-indigo-600 group-hover:bg-indigo-50"
          >
            {isStepComplete ? 'Edit Step' : 'Open Step'}
            <ChevronDown className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // ===========================================================================
  // EXPANDED STEP STATE (Strict GEMINI.md Section 6.1 & 6.2 Standard)
  // ===========================================================================
  return (
    <Card
      id="module-l-step-1"
      className="scroll-mt-24 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-xs"
    >
      <CardHeader className="border-b border-slate-100 pb-4">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
            <div
              className={`flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-xs font-bold ${
                isStepComplete
                  ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                  : 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
              }`}
            >
              {isStepComplete ? <Check className="h-4 w-4" /> : '1'}
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <CardTitle className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
                  1. Compiler Mode, Target Committee &amp; Scoring Rubric
                </CardTitle>
                <Badge
                  variant={isStepComplete ? 'default' : 'outline'}
                  className={
                    isStepComplete
                      ? 'shrink-0 bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300 text-[10px] font-medium'
                      : 'shrink-0 border-slate-300 text-slate-600 text-[10px] font-medium'
                  }
                >
                  {isStepComplete ? 'Completed' : 'Step 1 of 5'}
                </Badge>
                <Badge
                  variant="outline"
                  className="shrink-0 border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 text-[10px] font-medium"
                >
                  {activeCatalogItem.badge}
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <CardDescription className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-600">
                Choose the official grant application form, loan workbook, or investor pack format so the compiler structures your answers from Modules A–K into the exact questions, word limits, and appendices your evaluator grades on.
              </CardDescription>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Top-Right Header Actions (CLEAN RULE: Collapse Step ONLY) */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
            <Button
              type="button"
              size="sm"
              variant="ghost"
              onClick={onToggleCollapse}
              className="text-xs text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-100"
            >
              Collapse Step
              <ChevronUp className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Dedicated 4-Layer Support Strip (Directly Below Title & Description) */}
        <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 pt-2">
          <Button
            type="button"
            size="sm"
            variant="outline"
            onClick={() => setShowWhyDrawer((prev) => !prev)}
            className="h-7 border-indigo-200 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-50"
          >
            <HelpCircle className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            Why Are We Asking This?
          </Button>
          <Button
            type="button"
            size="sm"
            variant="outline"
            onClick={() => setShowExampleDrawer((prev) => !prev)}
            className="h-7 border-emerald-200 text-[11px] font-medium text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-50"
          >
            <Lightbulb className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            Show Me an Example
          </Button>
          <Button
            type="button"
            size="sm"
            variant="outline"
            onClick={handleCalibrateWithAi}
            disabled={isGeneratingAi || isVaultReadonly}
            className="h-7 border-violet-200 bg-violet-50/60 text-[11px] font-medium text-violet-700 hover:bg-violet-100"
          >
            {isGeneratingAi ? (
              <Loader2 className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin text-violet-600" />
            ) : (
              <Sparkles className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-violet-600" />
            )}
            Auto-Calibrate Mandate with AI
          </Button>
        </div>

        {/* Collapsible Micro-Coaching Drawer 1: Why Are We Asking This? */}
        {showWhyDrawer && (
          <div className="mt-3 rounded-lg border border-indigo-100 bg-indigo-50/70 p-3.5 text-xs text-indigo-900">
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <p className="font-bold text-indigo-950">
                  Why the Compiler Mode changes your entire business plan output:
                </p>
                <p className="leading-relaxed">
                  A generic 30-page business plan will fail an <strong>Innovate UK 9-Question IFS</strong> panel (which enforces a strict 400-word limit per question) and will frustrate a <strong>UK Start Up Loans</strong> underwriter (who looks first at your Personal Survival Budget vs. Month 1–6 drawings). Conversely, an <strong>Irish LEO Evaluation Committee (EVAC)</strong> requires explicit proof of non-displacement (that you aren&apos;t simply taking market share from another local business in the same county) and 3 independent supplier quotes.
                </p>
                <p className="leading-relaxed">
                  Selecting your primary target mode here configures the <strong>Step 2 Pre-Flight Contradiction Audit</strong>, the <strong>Step 3 Question-by-Question Narrative Compiler</strong>, and the <strong>Step 4 Appendices A–F Evidence Binder</strong> automatically.
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowWhyDrawer(false)}
                className="rounded-md p-1 text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-100"
                aria-label="Close Why Drawer"
              >
                <X className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Collapsible Micro-Coaching Drawer 2: Show Me an Example */}
        {showExampleDrawer && (
          <div className="mt-3 rounded-lg border border-emerald-100 bg-emerald-50/70 p-3.5 text-xs text-emerald-950">
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <p className="font-bold text-emerald-950">
                  Example Compiler Mode Calibration ({plan.industryCategory}):
                </p>
                <ul className="list-disc space-y-1 pl-4 leading-relaxed">
                  <li>
                    <strong>🇮🇪 Irish B2B SaaS / Manufacturing Founder applying for €25k LEO Priming:</strong> Selects <em>IE LEO &amp; Enterprise Ireland Official Form Mode</em> + <em>Evidence-Led Grant Assessor Tone</em>. The compiler automatically highlights international export revenue outside Ireland, 3-year full-time job creation (from Module F), and 3-quote software/equipment compliance (from Modules D &amp; E).
                  </li>
                  <li>
                    <strong>🇬🇧 UK DeepTech / AI Founder applying for £100k Innovate UK Smart Grant:</strong> Selects <em>UK Innovate UK 9-Question IFS Mode</em>. The compiler maps Module D Work Packages (`WP1..n`) to Question 5, Module E&apos;s 4-category Risk Register to Question 6, and caps every answer at 400 words.
                  </li>
                  <li>
                    <strong>🇬🇧 / 🇮🇪 Seed Founder raising £150k / €150k from Angels:</strong> Selects <em>Investor Tax Relief &amp; Seed Memo (HMRC SEIS/EIS &amp; Irish EII)</em>. The compiler foregrounds statutory Qualifying Trade compliance, the Risk-to-Capital condition, and your Module H Pocket Profit breakeven curve.
                  </li>
                </ul>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowExampleDrawer(false)}
                className="rounded-md p-1 text-emerald-800 hover:bg-emerald-100"
                aria-label="Close Example Drawer"
              >
                <X className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </CardHeader>

      <CardContent className="space-y-6 pt-5">
        {statusMessage && (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/80 px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-medium text-indigo-950">
            <span>{statusMessage}</span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setStatusMessage(null)}
              className="ml-3 text-[11px] font-bold text-indigo-700 underline hover:text-indigo-900"
            >
              Dismiss
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* =================================================================== */}
        {/* AUTO-SYNC BANNER FROM MODULE K & HQ GEO-ROUTING                     */}
        {/* =================================================================== */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-emerald-200 bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-50/80 via-white to-indigo-50/50 p-3.5">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 min-w-0 flex-1">
            <ShieldCheck className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-emerald-600" />
            <div className="text-xs text-slate-700">
              <span className="font-bold text-slate-900">
                Synced from Geo-Profile ({trackCaps.countryFlag} {trackCaps.countryName}):
              </span>{' '}
              Based on your workspace funding strategy, your recommended compilation format is{' '}
              <strong className="text-indigo-700">
                {
                  MODULE_L_COMPILER_MODES.find(
                    (m) => m.mode === syncedRecommendedMode
                  )?.title
                }
              </strong>
              . You can switch between available modes at any time without losing data.
            </div>
          </div>
          {compilerMode !== syncedRecommendedMode && !isVaultReadonly && (
            <Button
              type="button"
              size="sm"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => handleSelectMode(syncedRecommendedMode)}
              className="h-7 shrink-0 border-emerald-300 bg-white text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-800 hover:bg-emerald-50"
            >
              Restore Recommended Mode
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* =================================================================== */}
        {/* 2. PRIMARY COMPILATION MODE SELECTOR                                */}
        {/* =================================================================== */}
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <div>
              <label className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700">
                Select Official Compilation Mode &amp; Committee Format
              </label>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                Click any mode card to preview its official question structure and evaluator scoring weights.
              </p>
            </div>
            <span
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] text-slate-600"
              title="Jargon Tooltip: Each stakeholder uses a specific scoring rubric. Switching modes reformats your data without erasing anything."
            >
              <Info className="h-3 w-3 text-indigo-600" />
              Non-Destructive Mode Switcher
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
            {availableCompilerModes.map((item) => {
              const isSelected = compilerMode === item.mode;
              const isRecommended = syncedRecommendedMode === item.mode;
              return (
                <button
                  key={item.mode}
                  type="button"
                  disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                  onClick={() => handleSelectMode(item.mode)}
                  className={`flex flex-col justify-between rounded-xl border p-4 text-left transition-all ${
                    isSelected
                      ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50/50 shadow-sm ring-2 ring-indigo-600/20'
                      : 'border-slate-200 bg-white hover:border-indigo-300 hover:bg-slate-50/60'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-1.5">
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-md bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-800">
                        {item.badge}
                      </span>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        {isRecommended && (
                          <span className="rounded-full bg-emerald-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-800">
                            Recommended
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {isSelected && (
                          <span className="flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-indigo-600 text-white">
                            <Check className="h-3 w-3" />
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">
                      {item.title}
                    </h4>
                    <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-slate-600">
                      {item.description}
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <div className="mt-3 space-y-1.5 border-t border-slate-200/80 pt-2.5 text-[11px]">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-slate-600">
                      <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700">Format:</span>
                      <span>{item.sectionStructureLabel}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-slate-600">
                      <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700">Hurdle:</span>
                      <span className="font-semibold text-indigo-700">
                        {item.passThresholdLabel}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {/* Mandatory Inline "OTHER" Input when compilerMode === 'OTHER' */}
          {compilerMode === 'OTHER' && (
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/40 p-4 space-y-2">
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-indigo-950">
                Specify Your Custom Submission Format, Accelerator, or Tender Name
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                value={otherCompilerModeText}
                onChange={(e) => setOtherCompilerModeText(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g., Enterprise Ireland HPSU Feasibility, Y Combinator Application, EU EIC Accelerator, or University Spin-Out Board..."
                className="w-full rounded-lg border border-indigo-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-base sm:text-xs text-slate-900 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* =================================================================== */}
        {/* SELECTED MODE STRUCTURE & RUBRIC PREVIEW CARD                       */}
        {/* =================================================================== */}
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-50/60 via-white to-violet-50/40 p-4 sm:p-5 space-y-4">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <FileText className="h-5 w-5 text-indigo-600" />
              <div>
                <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-950">
                  Compiler Blueprint Output Preview: {activeCatalogItem.title}
                </h4>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                  Format: <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700">{activeCatalogItem.sectionStructureLabel}</span> ({activeCatalogItem.wordLimitDisciplineLabel}) • Scoring Weights: <span className="font-semibold text-indigo-700">{activeCatalogItem.rubricWeightsSummary}</span>
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            {onJumpToCompilerStep3 && (
              <Button
                type="button"
                size="sm"
                onClick={handleSaveAndJumpToCompiler}
                disabled={isSaving}
                className="bg-emerald-600 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-emerald-700 shadow-xs"
              >
                <Sparkles className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-200" />
                ⚡ Auto-Compile This Blueprint Now (Step 3)

              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 text-[11px] text-slate-600 pt-1">
            <p className="max-w-xl">
              <strong className="text-slate-900">Evaluator Underwriting Note:</strong>{' '}
              {activeCatalogItem.underwriterFootNote}
            </p>
            <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-700">

            </div>

        {/* =================================================================== */}
        {/* 3. EVALUATOR TONE & PRIMARY OBJECTIVE SELECTORS (with "OTHER")      */}
        {/* =================================================================== */}

          <div className="space-y-2.5">

            </label>

                    key={opt.value}

                    }`}
                  >
                    <div>
                      <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
                        {opt.label}
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                        {opt.subtitle}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div
                      className={`mt-0.5 flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border ${

              />

          </div>

          {/* Primary Submission Objective Selector */}
          <div className="space-y-2.5">
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700">
              Primary Committee Approval Objective
            </label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2">

                }
                className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 rounded border-slate-300 text-indigo-600 focus:ring-indigo-500"
              />
              <div className="text-xs">
                <div className="font-bold text-slate-900">
                  Enforce Official Portal Word-Limit Gauges
                </div>
                <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                  Displays live word/character meters (e.g., 400w cap for Innovate UK IFS or LEO section limits)
                </div>
              </div>
            </label>
          </div>

          {/* Compiler Mandate Instructions Textarea */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                Compiler Mandate &amp; Committee Emphasis Notes
              </label>
              <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                Guides Step 2 Contradiction Audit &amp; Step 3 Section Compiler
              </span>
            </div>
            <textarea
              rows={3}
              disabled={isVaultReadonly}
              value={compilerMandateNotes}
              onChange={(e) => setCompilerMandateNotes(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Specify any special angles or evaluator priorities to emphasize across the compiled plan..."
              className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 bg-white p-3 text-base sm:text-xs leading-relaxed text-slate-900 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Assessor Strategy Tip Callout */}
          {aiAssessorTip && (
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-violet-200 bg-violet-50/60 p-3.5 text-xs text-violet-950">
              <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
                <Sparkles className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-violet-600" />
                <div>
                  <span className="font-bold">
                    Committee Evaluator Insider Tip:
                  </span>{' '}
                  {aiAssessorTip}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* =================================================================== */}
        {/* BOTTOM STEP TOOLBAR (Save & Advance to Step 2)                      */}
        {/* =================================================================== */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-slate-100 pt-4">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <Button
              type="button"
              size="sm"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={handleCalibrateWithAi}
              disabled={isGeneratingAi || isVaultReadonly}
              className="border-violet-200 bg-violet-50/70 text-xs font-medium text-violet-700 hover:bg-violet-100"
            >
              {isGeneratingAi ? (
                <Loader2 className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
              ) : (
                <Sparkles className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              )}
              Calibrate Mandate with AI
            </Button>
            {!isVaultReadonly && (
              <Button
                type="button"
                size="sm"
                variant="outline"
                onClick={handleSaveOnly}
                disabled={isSaving}
                className="border-slate-300 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100"
              >
                <Save className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                {isSaving ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Step 1'}
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>

          <Button
            type="button"
            size="sm"
            onClick={handleSaveAndContinue}
            disabled={isSaving}
            className="bg-indigo-600 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-indigo-700"
          >
            Save &amp; Continue to Step 2: Pre-Flight Audit
            <ArrowRight className="ml-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          </Button>
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

export interface ModuleBWorkspaceProps {
  plan: ActiveStartupPlan;
  selectedCountry: SupportedCountryCode;
  isVaultReadonly: boolean;
  onSaveStep1Beachhead: (
    beachhead: BeachheadMarketData,
    progressPercent: number
  ) => Promise<void>;
  onSaveStep2Competitors: (
    competitorsAndStatusQuo: CompetitorsAndStatusQuoData,
    progressPercent: number
  ) => Promise<void>;
  onScoutCompetitorsWithAi: (params: {
    targetCustomerDescription: string;
    targetMarketsArray: string[];
    buyerTypes: BuyerModelType[];
  }) => Promise<{
    competitors: CompetitorEntry[];
    suggestedWhySwitchSentence?: string;
    engineMode: 'gemini-2.5-flash' | 'smart-synthesizer';
  } | null>;
  onSaveStep3MarketSizing: (
    marketSizing: MarketSizingData,
    progressPercent: number
  ) => Promise<void>;
  onEstimateMarketSizingWithAi: (params: {
    targetCustomerDescription: string;
    targetMarketsArray: string[];
    buyerTypes: BuyerModelType[];
  }) => Promise<{
    segments: MarketSizingSegmentEntry[];
    widerMarketMultiplier: WiderMarketScalePreset;
    sourceAndAssumptionNotes: string;
    engineMode: 'gemini-2.5-flash' | 'smart-synthesizer';
  } | null>;
  onSaveStep4CompetitiveWedge: (
    competitiveWedge: CompetitiveWedgeData,
    progressPercent: number
  ) => Promise<void>;
  onGenerateCompetitiveEdgeWithAi: (params: {
    targetCustomerDescription: string;
    targetMarketsArray: string[];
    competitorNames: string[];
  }) => Promise<{
    comparisonRows: CompetitiveComparisonRow[];
    switchingFrictionReducers: SwitchingFrictionReducerType[];
    switchingFrictionPlanNotes: string;
    unfairAdvantages: UnfairAdvantageMoatType[];
    competitiveEdgeSummary: string;
    engineMode: 'gemini-2.5-flash' | 'smart-synthesizer';
  } | null>;
  onSaveStep5Complete: (thingsToConsider: BlindSpotItem[]) => Promise<void>;
  onContinueToModuleC: () => void;
  founderName?: string;
  whiteLabelEnabled?: boolean;
  onParkQuestion: (questionText: string) => void;
  onBackToModuleA: () => void;
  initialStep?: number;
  highlightTarget?: string;
}

export function ModuleBWorkspace({
  plan,
  selectedCountry,
  isVaultReadonly,
  onSaveStep1Beachhead,
  onSaveStep2Competitors,
  onScoutCompetitorsWithAi,
  onSaveStep3MarketSizing,
  onEstimateMarketSizingWithAi,
  onSaveStep4CompetitiveWedge,
  onGenerateCompetitiveEdgeWithAi,
  onSaveStep5Complete,
  onContinueToModuleC,
  founderName = 'Founder',
  whiteLabelEnabled = false,
  onParkQuestion,
  onBackToModuleA,
  initialStep,
  highlightTarget,
}: ModuleBWorkspaceProps) {
  const countryPack = getCountryRulePack(selectedCountry);
  const localGrants = getGrantsForCountry(selectedCountry);
  const industryExamples = getIndustryBeachheadExamples(plan.industryCategory);
  const competitorExamples = getIndustryCompetitorExamples(
    plan.industryCategory
  );
  const marketSizingExamples = getIndustryMarketSizingExamples(
    plan.industryCategory
  );
  const competitiveEdgeExamples = getIndustryCompetitiveEdgeExamples(
    plan.industryCategory
  );

  const defaultBuyerType: BuyerModelType =
    plan.industryCategory === 'Consumer App / Marketplace'
      ? 'TWO_SIDED_MARKETPLACE'
      : plan.industryCategory ===
            'E-Commerce / Physical Product / Food & Drink' ||
          plan.industryCategory ===
            'Brick & Mortar / Hospitality / Local Business'
        ? 'B2C_CONSUMERS'
        : 'B2B_BUSINESSES';

  // Step Accordion state: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 (Summary Brief), or 'ALL'
  const [openStep, setOpenStep] = useState<number | 'ALL'>(() => {
    if (initialStep && initialStep >= 1 && initialStep <= 6) {
      return initialStep;
    }
    return 0;
  });

  // Handle deep-link scrolling and highlight
  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialStep && initialStep >= 1 && initialStep <= 6) {
      setOpenStep(initialStep);
      setTimeout(() => {
        const targetId = highlightTarget || `module-b-step-${initialStep}`;
        const el = document.getElementById(targetId);
        if (el) {
          el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
          el.classList.remove('attention-highlight');
          void el.offsetWidth;
          el.classList.add('attention-highlight');
          setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('attention-highlight'), 3000);
        }
      }, 250);
    }
  }, [initialStep, highlightTarget]);

  const savedBeachhead = plan.moduleBData?.beachhead;

  const initialBuyerTypes: BuyerModelType[] =
    savedBeachhead?.buyerTypes?.length
      ? savedBeachhead.buyerTypes
      : savedBeachhead?.buyerType
        ? [savedBeachhead.buyerType]
        : [defaultBuyerType];

  const [buyerTypes, setBuyerTypes] =
    useState<BuyerModelType[]>(initialBuyerTypes);
  const buyerType: BuyerModelType = buyerTypes[0] ?? defaultBuyerType;
  const [beachheadSegment, setBeachheadSegment] = useState<string>(
    savedBeachhead?.beachheadSegment ??
      plan.conceptCanvas?.targetCustomer ??
      ''
  );
  const [endUserVsDecisionMaker, setEndUserVsDecisionMaker] =
    useState<EndUserVsDecisionMakerType>(
      savedBeachhead?.endUserVsDecisionMaker ??
        (initialBuyerTypes.length === 1 &&
        initialBuyerTypes[0] === 'B2C_CONSUMERS'
          ? 'SAME_PERSON'
          : 'DIFFERENT_DECISION_MAKER')
    );
  const [decisionMakerRole, setDecisionMakerRole] = useState<string>(
    savedBeachhead?.decisionMakerRole ?? ''
  );
  const [buyingTriggerPreset, setBuyingTriggerPreset] =
    useState<BuyingTriggerPreset>(
      savedBeachhead?.buyingTriggerPreset ?? 'LOSING_MONEY_WASTE'
    );
  const [buyingTriggerNotes, setBuyingTriggerNotes] = useState<string>(
    savedBeachhead?.buyingTriggerNotes ?? ''
  );
  const [targetMarkets, setTargetMarkets] = useState<string[]>(
    savedBeachhead?.targetMarketsArray?.length
      ? savedBeachhead.targetMarketsArray
      : plan.targetMarketsArray?.length
        ? plan.targetMarketsArray
        : [selectedCountry]
  );
  const [otherBuyerModelText, setOtherBuyerModelText] = useState<string>(
    savedBeachhead?.otherBuyerModelText ?? ''
  );
  const [otherDecisionMakerSetupText, setOtherDecisionMakerSetupText] =
    useState<string>(savedBeachhead?.otherDecisionMakerSetupText ?? '');
  const [otherGeographyText, setOtherGeographyText] = useState<string>(
    savedBeachhead?.otherGeographyText ?? ''
  );

  // Sync state when plan changes or Cloud SQL hydrates savedBeachhead
  useEffect(() => {
    const nextBuyerTypes: BuyerModelType[] =
      savedBeachhead?.buyerTypes?.length
        ? savedBeachhead.buyerTypes
        : savedBeachhead?.buyerType
          ? [savedBeachhead.buyerType]
          : [defaultBuyerType];
    setBuyerTypes(nextBuyerTypes);
    setBeachheadSegment(
      savedBeachhead?.beachheadSegment ??
        plan.conceptCanvas?.targetCustomer ??
        ''
    );
    setEndUserVsDecisionMaker(
      savedBeachhead?.endUserVsDecisionMaker ??
        (nextBuyerTypes.length === 1 && nextBuyerTypes[0] === 'B2C_CONSUMERS'
          ? 'SAME_PERSON'
          : 'DIFFERENT_DECISION_MAKER')
    );
    setDecisionMakerRole(savedBeachhead?.decisionMakerRole ?? '');
    setBuyingTriggerPreset(
      savedBeachhead?.buyingTriggerPreset ?? 'LOSING_MONEY_WASTE'
    );
    setBuyingTriggerNotes(savedBeachhead?.buyingTriggerNotes ?? '');
    setTargetMarkets(
      savedBeachhead?.targetMarketsArray?.length
        ? savedBeachhead.targetMarketsArray
        : plan.targetMarketsArray?.length
          ? plan.targetMarketsArray
          : [selectedCountry]
    );
    setOtherBuyerModelText(savedBeachhead?.otherBuyerModelText ?? '');
    setOtherDecisionMakerSetupText(
      savedBeachhead?.otherDecisionMakerSetupText ?? ''
    );
    setOtherGeographyText(savedBeachhead?.otherGeographyText ?? '');
  }, [
    plan.id,
    savedBeachhead?.lastSavedAt,
    plan.conceptCanvas?.targetCustomer,
    defaultBuyerType,
    selectedCountry,
  ]);

  function toggleBuyerType(model: BuyerModelType) {
    if (isVaultReadonly) return;
    setBuyerTypes((prev) => {
      let next: BuyerModelType[];
      if (prev.includes(model)) {
        if (prev.length === 1) return prev; // Keep at least 1 customer model selected
        next = prev.filter((item) => item !== model);
      } else {
        next = [...prev, model];
      }
      if (next.length === 1 && next[0] === 'B2C_CONSUMERS') {
        setEndUserVsDecisionMaker('SAME_PERSON');
      } else if (
        next.some(
          (m) =>
            m === 'B2B_BUSINESSES' ||
            m === 'B2G_PUBLIC_SECTOR' ||
            m === 'TWO_SIDED_MARKETPLACE'
        )
      ) {
        setEndUserVsDecisionMaker('DIFFERENT_DECISION_MAKER');
      }
      return next;
    });
  }

  // Layer 1-3 Coaching States
  const [showWhyCard, setShowWhyCard] = useState(true);
  const [showExamples, setShowExamples] = useState(false);
  const [showImStuck, setShowImStuck] = useState(false);
  const [showJargonTooltip, setShowJargonTooltip] = useState(false);
  const [showBeachheadTooltip, setShowBeachheadTooltip] = useState(false);

  // "I'm Stuck" 3-mini-question builder states
  const [stuckWho, setStuckWho] = useState('');
  const [stuckSizeOrTrait, setStuckSizeOrTrait] = useState('');
  const [stuckWhereFind10, setStuckWhereFind10] = useState('');

  // Saving state
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [saveBanner, setSaveBanner] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Background Autosave States & Refs
  const [step1AutosavedAt, setStep1AutosavedAt] = useState<Date | null>(null);
  const [step2AutosavedAt, setStep2AutosavedAt] = useState<Date | null>(null);
  const [step3AutosavedAt, setStep3AutosavedAt] = useState<Date | null>(null);
  const [step4AutosavedAt, setStep4AutosavedAt] = useState<Date | null>(null);
  const isDirtyStep1Ref = useRef(false);
  const isDirtyStep2Ref = useRef(false);
  const isDirtyStep3Ref = useRef(false);
  const isDirtyStep4Ref = useRef(false);
  const isFirstRenderStep1Ref = useRef(true);
  const isFirstRenderStep2Ref = useRef(true);
  const isFirstRenderStep3Ref = useRef(true);
  const isFirstRenderStep4Ref = useRef(true);

  // =========================================================================
  // STEP 2 STATE: COMPETITORS & HOW CUSTOMERS DEAL WITH THIS TODAY
  // =========================================================================
  const savedStep2 = plan.moduleBData?.competitorsAndStatusQuo;

  // =========================================================================

  function createDefaultBlankSegments(
    count: number
  ): MarketSizingSegmentEntry[] {
    return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, idx) => ({
      id: `seg-init-${idx + 1}`,

      pricePerCustomerInput: '',

  }

  const [marketSegments, setMarketSegments] = useState<

  >(

      ? savedStep3.segments
      : createDefaultBlankSegments(initialBuyerTypes.length > 1 ? 2 : 1)
  );
  const [widerMarketMultiplier, setWiderMarketMultiplier] =
    useState<WiderMarketScalePreset>(
      savedStep3?.widerMarketMultiplier ?? '5X'
    );

  const [sourceAndAssumptionNotes, setSourceAndAssumptionNotes] =
    useState<string>(savedStep3?.sourceAndAssumptionNotes ?? '');

  const [showStep3Examples, setShowStep3Examples] = useState(false);
  const [showStep3ImStuck, setShowStep3ImStuck] = useState(false);
  const [isEstimatingStep3Ai, setIsEstimatingStep3Ai] = useState(false);
  const [isSavingStep3, setIsSavingStep3] = useState(false);
  const [copiedGrantSummary, setCopiedGrantSummary] = useState(false);

      savedStep3?.segments?.length
        ? savedStep3.segments
        : createDefaultBlankSegments(
            (savedBeachhead?.buyerTypes?.length || 1) > 1 ? 2 : 1
          )
    );
    setWiderMarketMultiplier(savedStep3?.widerMarketMultiplier ?? '5X');
    setOtherWiderMarketScaleText(savedStep3?.otherWiderMarketScaleText ?? '');
    setSourceAndAssumptionNotes(savedStep3?.sourceAndAssumptionNotes ?? '');
  }, [plan.id, savedStep3?.lastSavedAt, savedBeachhead?.buyerTypes?.length]);

  // =========================================================================
  // STEP 4 STATE (COMPETITIVE EDGE & DEFENSIBILITY MATRIX)
  // =========================================================================
  const savedStep4 = plan.moduleBData?.competitiveWedge;

  const createDefaultComparisonRows = (): CompetitiveComparisonRow[] => {
    const base: CompetitiveComparisonRow[] = [
      {
        rowId: 'row-your-startup',

        priceValueScore: 'HIGH',
        speedTimeSavedScore: 'LOW',
        easeOfUseScore: 'LOW',
        specialistQualityScore: 'LOW',
      },
    ];
    const step2Comps = (savedStep2?.competitors ?? []).filter(
      (c) => c.name.trim().length > 0
    );
    step2Comps.forEach((c, idx) => {
      base.push({
        rowId: `row-step2-${idx + 1}`,
        label: c.name.trim(),
        priceValueScore: 'MEDIUM',
        speedTimeSavedScore: 'MEDIUM',
        easeOfUseScore: 'LOW',
        specialistQualityScore: 'MEDIUM',
      });

    return base;
  };

  const [comparisonRows, setComparisonRows] = useState<

  function handleUpdateComparisonScore(
    rowId: string,
    field:
      | 'priceValueScore'
      | 'speedTimeSavedScore'
      | 'easeOfUseScore'
      | 'specialistQualityScore',
    score: ComparisonScoreLevel
  ) {
    if (isVaultReadonly) return;
    setComparisonRows((prev) =>
      prev.map((r) => (r.rowId === rowId ? { ...r, [field]: score } : r))
    );
  }

  function handleUpdateComparisonLabel(rowId: string, label: string) {
    if (isVaultReadonly) return;
    setComparisonRows((prev) =>
      prev.map((r) => (r.rowId === rowId ? { ...r, label } : r))
    );
  }

  function handleAddComparisonRow() {
    if (isVaultReadonly) return;
    setComparisonRows((prev) => [
      ...prev,
      {
        rowId: `row-custom-${Date.now()}`,
        label: '',
        priceValueScore: 'MEDIUM',
        speedTimeSavedScore: 'MEDIUM',
        easeOfUseScore: 'LOW',
        specialistQualityScore: 'MEDIUM',
      },
    ]);

  function handleSyncCompetitorsFromStep2() {
    if (isVaultReadonly) return;
    const namedCompetitors = competitors.filter(
      (c) => c.name.trim().length > 0
    );
    if (namedCompetitors.length === 0) {
      setSaveBanner(
        'ℹ️ Add or scout competitors in Step 2 first so we can pull their names into your comparison table.'
      );
      return;
    }
    setComparisonRows((prev) => {
      const existingLabels = new Set(
        prev.map((r) => r.label.trim().toLowerCase())
      );
      const added: CompetitiveComparisonRow[] = [];
      namedCompetitors.forEach((c, idx) => {
        if (!existingLabels.has(c.name.trim().toLowerCase())) {
          added.push({
            rowId: `row-sync-${Date.now()}-${idx}`,
            label: c.name.trim(),
            priceValueScore: 'MEDIUM',
            speedTimeSavedScore: 'MEDIUM',
            easeOfUseScore: 'LOW',
            specialistQualityScore: 'MEDIUM',
          });
        }
      });
      return [...prev, ...added];
    });
    setSaveBanner(
      '✨ Synced your competitors from Step 2 into the comparison table!'
    );
  }

  function toggleSwitchingFrictionReducer(item: SwitchingFrictionReducerType) {
    if (isVaultReadonly) return;
    setSwitchingFrictionReducers((prev) =>
      prev.includes(item) ? prev.filter((x) => x !== item) : [...prev, item]
    );
  }

  function toggleUnfairAdvantage(item: UnfairAdvantageMoatType) {

  function handleDraftSummaryFromSelections() {
    if (isVaultReadonly) return;
    const switchLabels = SWITCHING_FRICTION_REDUCER_OPTIONS.filter((o) =>
      switchingFrictionReducers.includes(o.value)
    ).map((o) => o.label.replace(/^[^\w]+/, '').toLowerCase());
    const moatLabels = UNFAIR_ADVANTAGE_MOAT_OPTIONS.filter((o) =>
      unfairAdvantages.includes(o.value)
    ).map((o) => o.label.replace(/^[^\w]+/, '').toLowerCase());

    const switchPart =
      switchLabels.length > 0
        ? switchLabels.join(' and ')
        : 'a fast, low-risk onboarding experience';
    const moatPart =
      moatLabels.length > 0
        ? moatLabels.join(', ')
        : `deep focus on ${targetMarkets.join(' & ')} customers`;

    const summary = `Customers switch from manual workarounds and legacy alternatives to ${plan.title} because we offer ${switchPart} with higher speed and ease of use. Over time, our position in ${targetMarkets.join(' & ')} is protected against copycats through ${moatPart}.`;
    setCompetitiveEdgeSummary(summary);
    setSaveBanner(
      '✨ Drafted your 2-sentence Competitive Edge Summary from your selected cards!'
    );
  }

  function handleDraftStep4FromStuckHelper() {
    const firstStepPart =
      stuckStep4EasyFirstStep.trim() ||
      'try a free first step in under 15 minutes with zero risk';
    const hardToCopyPart =
      stuckStep4WhyHardToCopy.trim() ||

    setSwitchingFrictionPlanNotes(

    );

  async function handleRunAiCompetitiveEdge() {
    if (isVaultReadonly) return;
    setIsGeneratingStep4Ai(true);
    setSaveBanner(null);
    try {
      const compNames = competitors
        .map((c) => c.name.trim())
        .filter((n) => n.length > 0);
      const result = await onGenerateCompetitiveEdgeWithAi({
        targetCustomerDescription: beachheadSegment,
        targetMarketsArray: targetMarkets,
        competitorNames: compNames,
      });
      if (result) {
        if (result.comparisonRows.length > 0) {
          setComparisonRows(result.comparisonRows);
        }
        if (result.switchingFrictionReducers.length > 0) {
          setSwitchingFrictionReducers(result.switchingFrictionReducers);
        }
        if (result.switchingFrictionPlanNotes) {
          setSwitchingFrictionPlanNotes(result.switchingFrictionPlanNotes);
        }
        if (result.unfairAdvantages.length > 0) {
          setUnfairAdvantages(result.unfairAdvantages);
        }
        if (result.competitiveEdgeSummary) {
          setCompetitiveEdgeSummary(result.competitiveEdgeSummary);
        }
        setSaveBanner(
          `✨ Generated your Competitive Comparison Matrix and 2-Sentence Edge Summary! Feel free to tweak any score or card below.`
        );
      }
    } finally {
      setIsGeneratingStep4Ai(false);
    }
  }

  function handleAddMarketSegment() {

      );
    } else {
      setMarketSegments([
        {
          id: `seg-bench-${Date.now()}-1`,
          segmentName: 'Target Business Customers (SMEs)',
          billingCadence: 'MONTHLY_SUBSCRIPTION',
          pricePerCustomerInput: '99',
          year1To2CustomerGoalInput: '45',
          reachableCustomersInTargetMarketsInput: '3500',
        },
      ]);
      setWiderMarketMultiplier('5X');
      setSourceAndAssumptionNotes(
        `Industry benchmark for ${targetMarkets.join(', ')}: bottom-up count of target SMEs on a monthly subscription.`
      );
    }
    setSaveBanner(
      '📊 Loaded typical industry benchmark numbers! Feel free to adjust any number to match your plan.'
    );

  async function handleRunAiMarketSizing() {
    if (isVaultReadonly) return;
    setIsEstimatingStep3Ai(true);
    setSaveBanner(null);
    try {
      const result = await onEstimateMarketSizingWithAi({
        targetCustomerDescription: beachheadSegment,
        targetMarketsArray: targetMarkets,
        buyerTypes,
      });
      if (result && result.segments.length > 0) {
        setMarketSegments(result.segments);
        setWiderMarketMultiplier(result.widerMarketMultiplier);
        if (result.sourceAndAssumptionNotes) {
          setSourceAndAssumptionNotes(result.sourceAndAssumptionNotes);
        }
        setSaveBanner(
          `✨ Estimated realistic customer counts and pricing in ${countryPack.defaultCurrency} for ${targetMarkets.join(', ')}! You can tweak any box below.`
        );
      }
    } finally {
      setIsEstimatingStep3Ai(false);
    }
  }

  // Sync Step 2 state when plan changes or Cloud SQL hydrates
  useEffect(() => {
    setCurrentWorkarounds(savedStep2?.currentWorkarounds ?? []);
    setWorkaroundFrustrationNotes(
      savedStep2?.workaroundFrustrationNotes ?? ''
    );
    setCompetitors(savedStep2?.competitors ?? []);
    setWhySwitchEdges(savedStep2?.whySwitchEdges ?? []);
    setWhySwitchOneSentence(savedStep2?.whySwitchOneSentence ?? '');
    setOtherWorkaroundText(savedStep2?.otherWorkaroundText ?? '');
    setOtherWhySwitchEdgeText(savedStep2?.otherWhySwitchEdgeText ?? '');
  }, [plan.id, savedStep2?.lastSavedAt]);

  function toggleWorkaround(item: CustomerWorkaroundType) {

  function handleDraftStep2FromStuckHelper() {
    const complaintPart =
      stuckStep2MainComplaint.trim() ||
      'slow, manual workarounds or overpriced alternatives';
    const fixPart =
      stuckStep2OurFix.trim() ||
      `gives them a simpler, purpose-built workflow in ${targetMarkets.join(' & ')}`;
    setWhySwitchOneSentence(
      `Customers switch from ${complaintPart} to ${plan.title} because it ${fixPart}.`

    );

  async function handleRunAiMarketScout() {
    if (isVaultReadonly) return;
    setIsScoutingAi(true);
    setSaveBanner(null);
    try {
      const result = await onScoutCompetitorsWithAi({
        targetCustomerDescription: beachheadSegment,
        targetMarketsArray: targetMarkets,
        buyerTypes,
      });
      if (result && result.competitors.length > 0) {
        setCompetitors((prev) => {
          const existingNames = new Set(
            prev.map((c) => c.name.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean)
          );
          const fresh = result.competitors.filter(
            (c) => !existingNames.has(c.name.trim().toLowerCase())
          );
          return [...prev, ...fresh];
        });
        if (
          !whySwitchOneSentence.trim() &&
          result.suggestedWhySwitchSentence
        ) {
          setWhySwitchOneSentence(result.suggestedWhySwitchSentence);
        }
        setSaveBanner(
          `✨ Found ${result.competitors.length} realistic alternatives in ${targetMarkets.join(', ')}! Feel free to edit or remove any card below.`
        );
      }
    } finally {
      setIsScoutingAi(false);
    }
  }

  function toggleTargetMarket(code: string) {
    if (isVaultReadonly) return;
    setTargetMarkets((prev) => {
      if (prev.includes(code)) {
        if (prev.length === 1) return prev; // Keep at least 1 market selected
        return prev.filter((c) => c !== code);
      }
      return [...prev, code];
    });
  }

  function handleDraftFromStuckHelper() {
    const whoPart =
      stuckWho.trim() ||
      `urgent buyers in ${plan.industryCategory.toLowerCase()}`;
    const traitPart =
      stuckSizeOrTrait.trim() ||
      `who are actively struggling with ${plan.title}'s core problem`;
    const wherePart = stuckWhereFind10.trim()
      ? ` (reachable first via ${stuckWhereFind10.trim()})`
      : '';

    const drafted = `${whoPart} in ${targetMarkets.join(' & ')} — specifically ${traitPart}${wherePart}.`;
    setBeachheadSegment(drafted);
    setShowImStuck(false);
    setSaveBanner(
      '✨ Drafted your Target Customer description from your 3 quick answers!'
    );
  }

  const isExporting =
    targetMarkets.some((m) => m !== selectedCountry) ||
    targetMarkets.includes('EU') ||
    targetMarkets.includes('ROW');

  // =========================================================================
  // LIVE BOTTOM-UP MARKET SIZING CALCULATIONS (ACROSS ALL CUSTOMER GROUPS)
  // =========================================================================
  const computedSegments = marketSegments.map((seg, idx) => {
    const rawPrice =
      parseFloat(seg.pricePerCustomerInput.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '')) || 0;
    const annualRevenuePerCustomer =
      seg.billingCadence === 'MONTHLY_SUBSCRIPTION' ? rawPrice * 12 : rawPrice;
    const year1To2GoalCustomers =
      parseInt(seg.year1To2CustomerGoalInput.replace(/[^0-9]/g, ''), 10) || 0;
    const reachableCustomersInMarkets =
      parseInt(
        seg.reachableCustomersInTargetMarketsInput.replace(/[^0-9]/g, ''),
        10
      ) || 0;

    const year1To2AnnualRevenue =
      annualRevenuePerCustomer * year1To2GoalCustomers;
    const reachableMarketAnnualValue =
      annualRevenuePerCustomer * reachableCustomersInMarkets;

    return {
      ...seg,
      displayLabel: seg.segmentName.trim() || `Customer Group #${idx + 1}`,
      rawPrice,
      annualRevenuePerCustomer,
      year1To2GoalCustomers,
      reachableCustomersInMarkets,
      year1To2AnnualRevenue,
      reachableMarketAnnualValue,
    };
  });

  const totalYear1To2Customers = computedSegments.reduce(
    (sum, s) => sum + s.year1To2GoalCustomers,
    0
  );
  const totalReachableCustomers = computedSegments.reduce(
    (sum, s) => sum + s.reachableCustomersInMarkets,
    0
  );
  const totalYear1To2RevenueSom = computedSegments.reduce(
    (sum, s) => sum + s.year1To2AnnualRevenue,
    0
  );
  const totalReachableMarketSam = computedSegments.reduce(
    (sum, s) => sum + s.reachableMarketAnnualValue,
    0
  );

  const selectedScaleMultiplierObj =
    WIDER_MARKET_SCALE_OPTIONS.find(
      (opt) => opt.value === widerMarketMultiplier
    ) || WIDER_MARKET_SCALE_OPTIONS[1];
  const totalWiderMarketTam =
    totalReachableMarketSam * selectedScaleMultiplierObj.multiplier;

  const hasEnteredMarketSizingNumbers =
    totalYear1To2RevenueSom > 0 && totalReachableMarketSam > 0;

    ? computedSegments.length > 1

          )
          .join(
            ' and '
          )}, totaling a ${formatPlanCurrency(totalReachableMarketSam, countryPack.defaultCurrency)}/yr reachable market (SAM) and a ${formatPlanCurrency(totalWiderMarketTam, countryPack.defaultCurrency)}/yr wider expansion opportunity (TAM). In Year 1–2, our realistic target (SOM) is ${computedSegments
          .filter((s) => s.year1To2GoalCustomers > 0)
          .map(
            (s) => `${s.year1To2GoalCustomers.toLocaleString()} ${s.displayLabel}`
          )
          .join(' + ')}, generating ${formatPlanCurrency(totalYear1To2RevenueSom, countryPack.defaultCurrency)}/yr.`
      : `In ${targetMarkets.join(' & ')}, there are approximately ${totalReachableCustomers.toLocaleString()} target customers (${computedSegments[0]?.displayLabel || 'primary buyers'}) worth ${formatPlanCurrency(computedSegments[0]?.annualRevenuePerCustomer || 0, countryPack.defaultCurrency)}/year each, representing a ${formatPlanCurrency(totalReachableMarketSam, countryPack.defaultCurrency)}/yr reachable market (SAM) and a ${formatPlanCurrency(totalWiderMarketTam, countryPack.defaultCurrency)}/yr wider long-term market (TAM). Our realistic Year 1–2 goal (SOM) is to win ${totalYear1To2Customers.toLocaleString()} paying customers, generating ${formatPlanCurrency(totalYear1To2RevenueSom, countryPack.defaultCurrency)}/year.`
    : '';

  const step1Checkpoints = [
    buyerTypes.length > 0,
    beachheadSegment.trim().length > 12,
    decisionMakerRole.trim().length > 5,
    Boolean(buyingTriggerPreset),
    buyingTriggerNotes.trim().length > 5,
    targetMarkets.length > 0,
  ];
  const step1Completion = Math.round(
    (step1Checkpoints.filter(Boolean).length / step1Checkpoints.length) * 20
  );

  const step2Checkpoints = [
    currentWorkarounds.length > 0,
    workaroundFrustrationNotes.trim().length > 5,
    competitors.some((c) => c.name.trim().length > 1),
    whySwitchEdges.length > 0,
    whySwitchOneSentence.trim().length > 10,
  ];
  const step2Completion = Math.round(
    (step2Checkpoints.filter(Boolean).length / step2Checkpoints.length) * 20
  );

  const step3Checkpoints = [
    computedSegments.some((s) => s.segmentName.trim().length > 1),
    computedSegments.some((s) => s.annualRevenuePerCustomer > 0),
    totalYear1To2Customers > 0,
    totalReachableCustomers > 0,
    sourceAndAssumptionNotes.trim().length > 5,
  ];
  const step3Completion = Math.round(
    (step3Checkpoints.filter(Boolean).length / step3Checkpoints.length) * 20
  );

  const step4Checkpoints = [
    comparisonRows.length >= 2,
    switchingFrictionReducers.length > 0,
    switchingFrictionPlanNotes.trim().length > 5,
    unfairAdvantages.length > 0,
    competitiveEdgeSummary.trim().length > 12,
  ];
  const step4Completion = Math.round(
    (step4Checkpoints.filter(Boolean).length / step4Checkpoints.length) * 20
  );

  // Live 6-Card Blind-Spot Review for Module B Step 5
  const liveModuleBThingsToConsider: BlindSpotItem[] =
    buildDynamicModuleBBlindSpots({
      planTitle: plan.title,
      industryCategory: plan.industryCategory,
      hqCountryCode: selectedCountry,
      targetMarketsArray: targetMarkets,
      beachhead: {
        buyerType,
        buyerTypes,
        beachheadSegment,
        endUserVsDecisionMaker,
        decisionMakerRole,
        buyingTriggerPreset,
        buyingTriggerNotes,
        targetMarketsArray: targetMarkets,
        otherBuyerModelText: otherBuyerModelText.trim() || undefined,
        otherDecisionMakerSetupText:
          otherDecisionMakerSetupText.trim() || undefined,
        otherGeographyText: otherGeographyText.trim() || undefined,
      },
      competitorsAndStatusQuo: {
        currentWorkarounds,
        workaroundFrustrationNotes,
        competitors,
        whySwitchEdges,
        whySwitchOneSentence,
        otherWorkaroundText: otherWorkaroundText.trim() || undefined,
        otherWhySwitchEdgeText: otherWhySwitchEdgeText.trim() || undefined,

  const briefGeneratedDate = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-IE', {
    day: 'numeric',
    month: 'short',
    year: 'numeric',
  });

  const moduleBReadinessSteps = [
    {
      stepNumber: 1,
      label: 'Your First Core Customer Group & Markets',

      stepNumber: 3,
      label: `Market Sizing (${countryPack.defaultCurrency})`,
      isComplete: totalYear1To2RevenueSom > 0,

        totalYear1To2RevenueSom > 0

          : 'Enter price & customer counts in Step 3',
    },
    {
      stepNumber: 4,
      label: 'Competitive Edge & Stand Out',
      isComplete:
        competitiveEdgeSummary.trim().length > 10 ||
        unfairAdvantages.length > 0,
      summary:
        competitiveEdgeSummary.trim() ||
        'Define how you stand out & lower switching friction in Step 4',

    {
      stepNumber: 5,
      label: 'Blind-Spot Review',

      summary: `${liveModuleBThingsToConsider.length} market & customer blind spots reviewed`,

    (s) => s.isComplete

    step5MarkedComplete ||

      ? 20
      : 10;
