              </div>

              {/* Sales Motion Tiles */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5">
                {SALES_MOTION_OPTIONS.map((motion) => {
                  const isSelected = step4Data.primarySalesMotion === motion.id;
                  const Icon = motion.icon;
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={motion.id}
                      onClick={() => {
                        let newConv = step4Data.expectedConversionRatePercent;
                        let newCycle = step4Data.salesCycleDays;
                        if (motion.id === 'SELF_SERVE_WEB') {
                          newConv = 2.5;
                          newCycle = 3;
                        } else if (motion.id === 'INSIDE_SALES_DEMO') {
                          newConv = 12.0;
                          newCycle = 21;
                        } else if (motion.id === 'ENTERPRISE_RFP') {
                          newConv = 25.0;
                          newCycle = 60;
                        } else if (motion.id === 'RETAIL_MARKETPLACE') {
                          newConv = 2.0;
                          newCycle = 5;
                        }
                        setStep4Data((prev) => ({
                          ...prev,
                          primarySalesMotion: motion.id,
                          expectedConversionRatePercent: newConv,
                          salesCycleDays: newCycle,
                        }));
                      }}
                      className={`cursor-pointer rounded-xl border p-3 transition-all ${
                        isSelected
                          ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50/50 shadow-xs ring-1 ring-indigo-500'
                          : 'border-slate-200 bg-white hover:border-indigo-200 hover:bg-slate-50/50'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <div
                          className={`flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg ${
                            isSelected ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white' : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <Icon className="h-4 w-4" />
                        </div>
                        <div className="font-bold text-xs text-slate-900 truncate flex-1">
                          {motion.title}
                        </div>
                        {isSelected && <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-600 shrink-0" />}
                      </div>
                      <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-500 line-clamp-2">
                        {motion.subtitle}
                      </p>
                      <div className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] text-slate-500 border-t border-slate-100 pt-1.5">
                        <span>Bench Conv: <strong>{motion.benchmarkConv}</strong></span>
                        <span>Cycle: <strong>{motion.benchmarkCycle}</strong></span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>

              {/* Revealed input for OTHER motion (Rule 1.5) */}
              {step4Data.primarySalesMotion === 'OTHER' && (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/30 p-3 space-y-1.5 animate-in fade-in-50">
                  <Label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800">
                    Specify Your Custom Sales Motion
                  </Label>
                  <Input
                    type="text"
                    value={step4Data.otherSalesMotionText || ''}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setStep4Data((prev) => ({ ...prev, otherSalesMotionText: e.target.value }))
                    }
                    placeholder="e.g. Account-Based Marketing + Distributor agreements..."
                    className="h-8 text-xs bg-white"
                  />
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Conversion Rate & Velocity Sliders */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4 pt-1">
                {/* Conversion Rate % */}
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 space-y-2.5">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <Label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
                      Expected Conversion Rate (%)
                    </Label>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                      <Input
                        type="number"
                        min="0.1"
                        max="100"
                        step="0.5"
                        value={step4Data.expectedConversionRatePercent}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          setStep4Data((prev) => ({
                            ...prev,
                            expectedConversionRatePercent: parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0.1,
                          }))
                        }
                        className="h-7 w-16 text-right text-xs font-bold bg-slate-50"
                      />
                      <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">%</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <input
                    type="range"
                    min="0.5"
                    max="40"
                    step="0.5"
                    value={step4Data.expectedConversionRatePercent}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setStep4Data((prev) => ({
                        ...prev,
                        expectedConversionRatePercent: parseFloat(e.target.value) || 1,
                      }))
                    }
                    className="w-full accent-indigo-600"
                  />

                  {/* Preset chips */}
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 pt-1">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Presets:</span>
                    {[
                      { label: 'E-com Web (2%)', val: 2.0 },
                      { label: 'SaaS Free-to-Paid (3%)', val: 3.0 },
                      { label: 'B2B Demo (12%)', val: 12.0 },
                      { label: 'RFP / Tender (25%)', val: 25.0 },
                    ].map((p) => (
                      <button
                        key={p.label}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() =>
                          setStep4Data((prev) => ({
                            ...prev,
                            expectedConversionRatePercent: p.val,
                          }))
                        }
                        className={`rounded-md px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium transition-colors ${
                          step4Data.expectedConversionRatePercent === p.val
                            ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                            : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {p.label}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Sales Cycle Days */}
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 space-y-2.5">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <Label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
                      Sales Cycle Velocity (Lead to Cash)
                    </Label>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                      <Input
                        type="number"
                        min="1"
                        max="365"
                        value={step4Data.salesCycleDays}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          setStep4Data((prev) => ({
                            ...prev,
                            salesCycleDays: parseInt(e.target.value) || 1,
                          }))
                        }
                        className="h-7 w-16 text-right text-xs font-bold bg-slate-50"
                      />
                      <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">days</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <input
                    type="range"
                    min="1"
                    max="90"
                    step="1"
                    value={step4Data.salesCycleDays}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setStep4Data((prev) => ({
                        ...prev,
                        salesCycleDays: parseInt(e.target.value) || 1,
                      }))
                    }
                    className="w-full accent-indigo-600"
                  />

                  {/* Preset chips */}
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 pt-1">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Presets:</span>
                    {[
                      { label: 'Instant (2 days)', val: 2 },
                      { label: 'Fast B2B (14 days)', val: 14 },
                      { label: 'Mid-Market (30 days)', val: 30 },
                      { label: 'Enterprise (60 days)', val: 60 },
                    ].map((p) => (
                      <button
                        key={p.label}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() =>
                          setStep4Data((prev) => ({
                            ...prev,
                            salesCycleDays: p.val,
                          }))
                        }
                        className={`rounded-md px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium transition-colors ${
                          step4Data.salesCycleDays === p.val
                            ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                            : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {p.label}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Interactive Reverse Funnel Calculator Card */}
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-indigo-700/30 bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 via-indigo-950 to-slate-900 p-4 sm:p-5 text-white shadow-sm space-y-3">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Target className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-400" />
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-200">
                    Reverse-Engineered Pipeline Requirements
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                  <div className="rounded-lg bg-white/5 border border-white/10 p-3.5 space-y-1">
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-indigo-200/80 font-medium">
                      Required Monthly Qualified Leads / Visitors
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
                      <span className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-emerald-400">
                        {calculatedRequiredMonthlyLeads.toLocaleString()}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-xs text-white/70">prospects/month</span>
                    </div>

                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="rounded-lg bg-white/5 border border-white/10 p-3.5 space-y-1">
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-indigo-200/80 font-medium">
                      Daily Acquisition Run-Rate
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
                      <span className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-white">
                        ~{calculatedDailyLeads.toLocaleString()}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-xs text-white/70">qualified leads/day</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-white/60">
                      Top-of-funnel velocity needed across web, ads, waitlist &amp; outreach
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <p className="text-[11px] text-indigo-100/80 pt-1">
                  💡 This establishes the exact pipeline volume that <strong>Module I (Marketing)</strong> and <strong>Module C (Customer Waitlists)</strong> will be engineered to generate.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* ------------------------------------------------------------- */}
            {/* PART C: RETENTION & CHURN REALITY                              */}
            {/* ------------------------------------------------------------- */}
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <Label className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-800">
                    Part C: Retention &amp; Customer Churn Assumptions
                  </Label>
                  <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-slate-500">
                    {step1Data.revenueModelVehicle === 'SUBSCRIPTION_RECURRING' ||
                    step1Data.revenueModelVehicle === 'USAGE_BASED_METERED'
                      ? 'What percentage of subscribers cancel each month?'
                      : 'What percentage of buyers make a repeat purchase within 30–60 days?'}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] bg-slate-50">
                  {step1Data.revenueModelVehicle === 'SUBSCRIPTION_RECURRING'
                    ? 'Recurring Churn'
                    : 'Repeat Purchase'}
                </Badge>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                <input
                  type="range"
                  min="1"
                  max="50"
                  step="1"
                  value={step4Data.expectedMonthlyChurnOrRepeatPercent}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setStep4Data((prev) => ({
                      ...prev,
                      expectedMonthlyChurnOrRepeatPercent: parseInt(e.target.value) || 5,
                    }))
                  }
                  className="w-full accent-indigo-600"
                />
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                  <Input
                    type="number"
                    min="1"
                    max="100"
                    value={step4Data.expectedMonthlyChurnOrRepeatPercent}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setStep4Data((prev) => ({
                        ...prev,
                        expectedMonthlyChurnOrRepeatPercent: parseInt(e.target.value) || 5,
                      }))
                    }
                    className="h-8 w-16 text-right text-xs font-bold bg-slate-50"
                  />
                  <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">%</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-slate-100 pt-2">
                {step1Data.revenueModelVehicle === 'SUBSCRIPTION_RECURRING' ||
                step1Data.revenueModelVehicle === 'USAGE_BASED_METERED' ? (
                  <span>
                    Benchmark: <strong>&lt; 2%</strong> (Enterprise SaaS) • <strong>3%–5%</strong> (Healthy SMB SaaS) • <strong>&gt; 7%</strong> (High Churn Alert)
                  </span>
                ) : (
                  <span>
                    Benchmark: <strong>10%–20%</strong> (Typical E-com) • <strong>25%–40%</strong> (Strong Brand Loyalty) • <strong>&gt; 50%</strong> (High Retention Retainer)
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* ------------------------------------------------------------- */}
            {/* PART D: WRITTEN SALES ASSUMPTIONS & ASSESSOR DEFENSE (AI)      */}
            {/* ------------------------------------------------------------- */}
            <div className="space-y-3 pt-2">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <div>
                  <Label className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-800">
                    Part D: Written Sales Assumptions &amp; Assessor Defense
                  </Label>
                  <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-slate-500">
                    Defend your conversion rates, sales cycle timing, and operational capacity for grant and loan assessors.
                  </p>
                </div>

                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant="outline"
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleGenerateAiSalesNarrative}
                  disabled={isGeneratingAiSalesNarrative || isVaultReadonly}
                  className="h-8 border-indigo-300 bg-indigo-50/50 text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-100 hover:text-indigo-900"
                >
                  {isGeneratingAiSalesNarrative ? (
                    <>
                      <RefreshCw className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin text-indigo-600" />
                      Synthesizing Pipeline Math...
                    </>
                  ) : aiSalesNarrativeSuccess ? (
                    <>
                      <Check className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                      Assumptions Updated!
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <Wand2 className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-600" />
                      Auto-Draft with AI (Assessor Mode)
                    </>
                  )}
                </Button>
              </div>

              {/* Assessor Tip Callout */}
              {(aiSalesAssessorTip || step4Data.assessorTip) && (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/60 p-3.5 text-xs text-indigo-950 flex items-start gap-2.5 animate-in fade-in-50">
                  <Lightbulb className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                  <div>
                    <span className="font-bold text-indigo-900">Assessor Defense Tip: </span>
                    <span className="text-slate-700">{aiSalesAssessorTip || step4Data.assessorTip}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Structured 3-Paragraph Textarea */}
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <textarea
                  rows={8}
                  value={step4Data.writtenAssumptionsNarrative || ''}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setStep4Data((prev) => ({
                      ...prev,
                      writtenAssumptionsNarrative: e.target.value,
                    }))
                  }
                  placeholder={`Click "Auto-Draft with AI (Assessor Mode)" above or enter your 3 structured paragraphs:\n\n1. Commercial Acquisition & Conversion Mechanics (Explaining the ${step4Data.expectedConversionRatePercent}% conversion rate and required ${calculatedRequiredMonthlyLeads} leads/month)...\n\n2. Pipeline Velocity & Revenue Realization Lag (Explaining the ${step4Data.salesCycleDays}-day sales cycle lag and cashflow timing)...\n\n3. Operational Delivery Capacity & Scalability (Comparing ${yr1BreakevenUnits} breakeven units against your ${currentCapacity} units/month operational ceiling)...`}
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-3 text-base sm:text-xs text-slate-800 leading-relaxed shadow-2xs focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                />
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                  <span>
                    Directly exports to Module L Official Business Plan &amp; Grant Appendices.
                  </span>
                  <span>{(step4Data.writtenAssumptionsNarrative || '').length} characters</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* ------------------------------------------------------------- */}
            {/* STEP 4 FOOTER TOOLBAR                                         */}
            {/* ------------------------------------------------------------- */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-slate-100 pt-5">
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="outline"
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setOpenStep(3);
                  window.scrollTo({ top: 400, behavior: 'smooth' });
                }}
                className="text-xs text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100"
              >
                <ArrowLeft className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Back to Step 3: Pocket Profit
              </Button>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                {saveStatus === 'saved' && (
                  <span className="flex items-center text-xs font-medium text-emerald-600">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    Saved
                  </span>
                )}
                {saveStatus === 'error' && (
                  <span className="flex items-center text-xs font-medium text-rose-600">
                    <AlertTriangle className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    Save Failed
                  </span>
                )}

                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant="outline"
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleSaveStep4}
                  disabled={saveStatus === 'saving' || isVaultReadonly}
                  className="border-slate-300 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
                >
                  {saveStatus === 'saving' ? (
                    <>
                      <RefreshCw className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                      Saving...
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <Check className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      Save Step 4
                    </>
                  )}
                </Button>

                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  type="button"
                  onClick={async () => {
                    await handleSaveStep4();
                    setOpenStep(5);
                    window.scrollTo({ top: 450, behavior: 'smooth' });
                  }}
                  disabled={!isStep4Complete || isVaultReadonly}
                  className="bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white text-xs font-semibold"
                >
                  Next: Revenue Brief &amp; Audit (Step 5)
                  <ArrowRight className="ml-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* ------------------------------------------------------------- */}
      {/* STEP 5: REVENUE STRATEGY & POCKET PROFIT BRIEF (EXECUTIVE OVERVIEW) */}
      {/* ------------------------------------------------------------- */}
      {openStep !== 'ALL' && openStep !== 5 ? (
        // COLLAPSED STEP 5 OVERVIEW CARD
        <div
          id="module-h-step-5"
          onClick={() => setOpenStep(5)}

        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
              <div
                className={`flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-xs font-bold ${
                  completedCoreStepsCount === 4 && isStep5Complete
                    ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                    : 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                }`}
              >
                <FileText className="h-4 w-4" />
              </div>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <h2 className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 group-hover:text-indigo-600">
                    Revenue Strategy &amp; Pocket Profit Brief
                  </h2>
                  <Badge
                    variant="outline"
                    className={`shrink-0 text-[10px] ${
                      completedCoreStepsCount === 4
                        ? 'border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800'
                        : 'border-slate-300 text-slate-600'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {completedCoreStepsCount}/4 Sections Ready
                  </Badge>
                  <Badge
                    variant="outline"
                    className="border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 text-[10px] text-indigo-700 shrink-0 hidden sm:inline-flex"
                  >
                    LEO &amp; Innovate UK Ready
                  </Badge>
                </div>
                <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-xs text-slate-500">
                  1-page commercial dossier, unit economics waterfall, 3-year breakeven horizon, and constructive blind-spot audit.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="ml-3 flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="ghost"
                className="h-8 shrink-0 px-2.5 text-xs font-medium text-indigo-600 group-hover:bg-indigo-50"
              >
                {completedCoreStepsCount === 4 ? 'Open Overview' : 'Review Overview'}
                <ChevronDown className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        // EXPANDED STEP 5 OVERVIEW CARD
        <Card id="module-h-step-5" className="scroll-mt-24 rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 bg-gradient-to-br from-white via-indigo-50/30 to-violet-50/40 shadow-sm">
          <CardHeader className="border-b border-indigo-100/80 pb-4">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
              <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div
                  className={`flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-xs font-bold ${
                    completedCoreStepsCount === 4 && isStep5Complete
                      ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                      : 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                  }`}
                >
                  <FileText className="h-4 w-4" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <CardTitle className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
                      Revenue Strategy &amp; Pocket Profit Brief (Executive Overview)
                    </CardTitle>
                    <Badge className="bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800 text-[10px] shrink-0">
                      Module H Overview
                    </Badge>
                    <Badge
                      variant="outline"
                      className={`text-[10px] shrink-0 ${
                        completedCoreStepsCount === 4
                          ? 'border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800'
                          : 'border-slate-300 text-slate-600'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {completedCoreStepsCount}/4 Core Sections Ready
                    </Badge>
                  </div>
                  <CardDescription className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-600">
                    Review your complete commercial summary, verify your readiness checklist across Steps 1–4, and audit potential margin, debtor, and capacity blind spots for grant and loan defense.
                  </CardDescription>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  size="sm"
                  variant="outline"
                  onClick={handleCopyMarkdownBrief}
                  className="h-8 text-xs border-indigo-200 bg-white text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-50 font-semibold"
                >
                  {copiedBrief ? (
                    <>
                      <Check className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                      Copied Dossier!
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <Copy className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      Copy Markdown Dossier
                    </>
                  )}
                </Button>
                {openStep !== 'ALL' && (
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    size="sm"
                    variant="ghost"
                    onClick={() => setOpenStep(0)}
                    className="h-8 text-xs text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900"
                  >
                    <span>Collapse Step</span>
                    <ChevronUp className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  </Button>

              </div>
            </div>
          </CardHeader>

          <CardContent className="space-y-6 pt-5">
            {/* ============================================================= */}
            {/* SECTION 1: 4-PILLAR COMMERCIAL READINESS CHECKLIST GRID       */}
            {/* ============================================================= */}
            <div className="space-y-2.5">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <h3 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700">
                  1. Commercial Architecture Readiness Checklist
                </h3>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 font-medium">

                  </div>

                  </p>
                  <span className="mt-2 inline-block text-[10px] font-bold text-indigo-600">
                    Edit Pocket Profit →
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* Pillar 4: Sales Velocity & Capacity */}
                <div
                  onClick={() => setOpenStep(4)}
                  className="cursor-pointer rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-3.5 shadow-2xs transition hover:border-indigo-300 hover:shadow-xs"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
                      4. Sales Velocity &amp; Capacity
                    </span>
                    {isStep4Complete ? (
                      <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600" />
                    ) : (
                      <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-500" />
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-600">
                    {step4Data.expectedConversionRatePercent}% conv • {step4Data.salesCycleDays}d cycle • {currentCapacity} cap/mo ({isCapacitySurplus ? `+${capacitySurplusOrDeficit}` : `${capacitySurplusOrDeficit}`}).
                  </p>
                  <span className="mt-2 inline-block text-[10px] font-bold text-indigo-600">

                  </span>

            {/* SECTION 2: 1-PAGE EXECUTIVE COMMERCIAL DOSSIER                */}

                      <td className="py-2 px-3 text-right text-slate-500">
                        {simulatedNetPrice > 0 ? ((directCogsAmount / simulatedNetPrice) * 100).toFixed(1) : 0}%
                      </td>

                    </tr>

                      <td className="py-2 px-3 text-slate-600 pl-6">Less: Refunds &amp; Dispute Reserve ({step3Data.frictionCosts.disputeRefundBufferPercent || 0}%)</td>
                      <td className="py-2 px-3 text-right text-rose-600">-{currencySymbol}{refundAndAffiliateFeeAmount.toFixed(2)}</td>

                      Generates {currencySymbol}{yt.monthlyRevenueAtBreakeven.toLocaleString()}/mo revenue to pay {currencySymbol}{yt.monthlyPayrollBaseline.toLocaleString()} scheduled payroll and {currencySymbol}{yt.otherFixedMonthlyOverheads.toLocaleString()} operational overheads.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                ))}

            {/* ============================================================= */}
            {/* SECTION 3: AUDIT READINESS POSTURE SELECTOR                   */}
            {/* ============================================================= */}
            <div className="space-y-3 border-t border-indigo-100/80 pt-4">
              <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-1 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">

                  3. Commercial Readiness Posture (Grant &amp; Investor Diligence)
                </label>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                  Includes &ldquo;Other&rdquo; custom posture option
                </span>

                {[
                  {
                    value: 'READY_FOR_COMMERCIAL_LAUNCH' as const,

                    badge: 'Validated & Viable',
                    subtitle: 'Contribution margin >65%, clear breakeven volume, and operational capacity safely accommodates Year 1 targets.',
                  },
                  {
                    value: 'PRICING_TESTING_RECOMMENDED' as const,

                  {
                    value: 'OTHER' as const,

                  return (
                    <button
                      key={opt.value}

                        }))

                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                    Specific vulnerabilities grant committees and loan assessors look for in financial submissions.
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    size="sm"
                    variant="outline"
                    disabled={isGeneratingAiBrief || isVaultReadonly}
                    onClick={handleGenerateAiRevenueBrief}
                    className="h-8 text-xs font-semibold border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/50 text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-100/80"
                  >
                    {isGeneratingAiBrief ? (
                      <>
                        <RefreshCw className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin text-indigo-600" />
                        Auditing Commercial Blind Spots...
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <Sparkles className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-600" />
                        Audit Commercial Blind Spots with AI
                      </>
                    )}
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    size="sm"
                    variant="outline"
                    disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                    onClick={handleAddCustomBlindSpot}
                    className="h-8 text-xs border-slate-300 text-slate-700"
                  >
                    <Plus className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    Add Consideration
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Blind Spot Cards List */}
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {step5Data.blindSpots.map((item, idx) => {
                  const isCritical = item.severity === 'CRITICAL';
                  const isWarning = item.severity === 'WARNING';

                  return (
                    <div
                      key={item.id}
                      className={`rounded-xl border p-3.5 transition ${
                        isCritical
                          ? 'border-rose-200 bg-rose-50/30'
                          : isWarning
                          ? 'border-amber-200 bg-amber-50/30'
                          : 'border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/30'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-md bg-slate-900 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-white">
                            Consideration #{idx + 1}
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">{item.title}</span>
                          <Badge
                            variant="outline"
                            className={`text-[10px] font-bold ${
                              isCritical
                                ? 'border-rose-300 bg-rose-100 text-rose-800'
                                : isWarning
                                ? 'border-amber-300 bg-amber-100 text-amber-800'
                                : 'border-indigo-300 bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800'
                            }`}
                          >
                            {item.severity}
                          </Badge>
                        </div>

                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <Button
                            type="button"
                            size="sm"
                            variant="ghost"
                            onClick={() => handleParkBlindSpotInOpenQuestions(item)}
                            className="h-7 text-[11px] text-slate-600 hover:text-indigo-600 hover:bg-slate-100"
                          >
                            Park in Open Questions
                          </Button>
                          <Button
                            type="button"
                            size="sm"
                            variant="ghost"
                            onClick={() =>
                              setStep5Data((prev) => ({
                                ...prev,
                                blindSpots: prev.blindSpots.filter((b) => b.id !== item.id),
                              }))
                            }
                            className="h-7 text-[11px] text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-700 leading-relaxed">
                        {item.explanation}
                      </p>

                      <div className="mt-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200/80 bg-white/80 p-2.5 text-xs">
                        <span className="font-semibold text-indigo-950">Recommended Action: </span>
                        <span className="text-slate-700">{item.suggestedAction}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* ============================================================= */}
            {/* SECTION 5: EXECUTIVE COMMERCIAL SUMMARY NARRATIVE (3 PARAS)  */}
            {/* ============================================================= */}
            <div className="space-y-3 border-t border-indigo-100/80 pt-4">
              <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-1 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-800">
                    5. Executive Commercial Defense Narrative (3 Structured Paragraphs)
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                    Formal narrative addressing unit economics, breakeven viability, and delivery feasibility for Module L grant appendices.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Assessor Tip Callout */}
              {(aiBriefAssessorTip || step5Data.aiAssessorTip) && (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/60 p-3.5 text-xs text-indigo-950 flex items-start gap-2.5">
                  <Lightbulb className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                  <div>
                    <span className="font-bold text-indigo-900">Commercial Assessor Tip: </span>
                    <span className="text-slate-700">{aiBriefAssessorTip || step5Data.aiAssessorTip}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <textarea
                  rows={9}
                  disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                  value={step5Data.executiveCommercialSummaryNarrative}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setStep5Data((prev) => ({
                      ...prev,
                      executiveCommercialSummaryNarrative: e.target.value,
                    }))
                  }
                  placeholder="Click 'Audit Commercial Blind Spots with AI' above or enter your 3 structured paragraphs..."
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-3 text-base sm:text-xs text-slate-800 leading-relaxed shadow-2xs focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                />
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                  <span>
                    Directly populates Module L Commercial Viability &amp; LEO / Innovate UK Appendices.
                  </span>
                  <span>{step5Data.executiveCommercialSummaryNarrative.length} characters</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Save Overview Action */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-indigo-100/80 pt-4">
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => setOpenStep(4)}
                className="text-xs text-slate-600"
              >
                <ArrowLeft className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Back to Step 4 (Sales Velocity)
              </Button>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                {saveStatus === 'saved' && (
                  <span className="flex items-center text-xs font-medium text-emerald-600">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    Saved
                  </span>
                )}
                {saveStatus === 'error' && (
                  <span className="flex items-center text-xs font-medium text-rose-600">
                    <AlertTriangle className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    Save Failed
                  </span>
                )}

                <Button
                  type="button"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={handleSaveStep5}
                  disabled={saveStatus === 'saving' || isVaultReadonly}
                  className="bg-emerald-600 text-white hover:bg-emerald-700 text-xs font-semibold"
                >
                  {saveStatus === 'saving' ? (
                    <>
                      <RefreshCw className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                      Saving Brief...
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <CheckCircle2 className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      Save Revenue Brief (Complete Module H)
                    </>
                  )}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Conversion / Handoff CTA Bar into Module I */}
            {onContinueToModuleI && (
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 px-4 py-3.5 text-white">
                <div className="text-xs min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-indigo-300">
                    Module H Complete! Commercial model &amp; pocket profit verified for {plan.title}.
                  </span>{' '}
                  <span className="text-slate-300">
                    Ready to build your customer acquisition engine? Advance to Module I: Marketing &amp; First 10 Customers.
                  </span>
                </div>
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  size="sm"
                  disabled={isVaultReadonly || saveStatus === 'saving'}
                  onClick={async () => {
                    await handleSaveStep5();
                    onContinueToModuleI();
                  }}
                  className="shrink-0 bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-500 text-xs font-semibold"
                >
                  Advance to Module I: Marketing
                  <ArrowRight className="ml-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                </Button>
              </div>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

    title: 'Comprehensive Master Business Plan (10-Section Full Plan)',
    badge: '📋 Comprehensive 10-Chapter Master Plan',
    targetAudience: 'INTERNAL_TEAM',
    targetTone: 'EXECUTIVE_CRISP',
    summary:
      'Complete, publication-grade business plan covering every operational and financial dimension for partners, senior executives, and all institutional stakeholders.',
    sectionsTemplate: [
      {
        sectionNumber: 1,
        title: 'Executive Summary',
        assessorPrompt: 'Synthesize the entire venture into an authoritative 350-word executive overview.',
        wordLimit: 350,
        scoringWeightPercent: 10,
        sourceModules: ['MOD_A_IDEATION', 'MOD_H_REVENUE'],
      },
      {
        sectionNumber: 2,
        title: 'Company Description, Mission & Statutory Structure',
        assessorPrompt: 'Legal entity type, registered location, founder vision, and core purpose.',
        wordLimit: 300,
        scoringWeightPercent: 10,
        sourceModules: ['MOD_A_IDEATION', 'MOD_G_LAUNCHPAD'],
      },
      {
        sectionNumber: 3,
        title: 'Market Analysis & Target Beachhead Customer',
        assessorPrompt: 'TAM, SAM, SOM, beachhead segment sizing, and primary persona pains.',
        wordLimit: 400,
        scoringWeightPercent: 10,
        sourceModules: ['MOD_B_MARKET'],
      },
      {
        sectionNumber: 4,
        title: 'Competitive Wedge & State-of-the-Art Analysis',
        assessorPrompt: 'Direct and indirect alternatives, unfair competitive advantage, and barrier to entry.',
        wordLimit: 350,
        scoringWeightPercent: 10,
        sourceModules: ['MOD_B_MARKET'],
      },
      {
        sectionNumber: 5,
        title: 'Product Architecture & Build Vehicle',
        assessorPrompt: 'What is being built? Own-vs-rent technology infrastructure and key work packages.',
        wordLimit: 400,
        scoringWeightPercent: 10,
        sourceModules: ['MOD_D_PRODUCT_BUILD'],
      },
      {
        sectionNumber: 6,
        title: 'Operations, Fulfillment & Premises',
        assessorPrompt: 'Day in the life of an order, premises, required equipment, and risk management.',
        wordLimit: 400,
        scoringWeightPercent: 10,
        sourceModules: ['MOD_E_OPERATIONS'],
      },
      {
        sectionNumber: 7,
        title: 'Management Team & Governance',
        assessorPrompt: 'Founder CVs, 7 startup hats matrix, and 3-year headcount plan.',
        wordLimit: 350,
        scoringWeightPercent: 10,
        sourceModules: ['MOD_F_COFOUNDER_TEAM'],
      },
      {
        sectionNumber: 8,
        title: 'Go-to-Market & Customer Acquisition Strategy',
        assessorPrompt: 'Positioning, channels, sales pipeline, and initial marketing budget.',
        wordLimit: 350,
        scoringWeightPercent: 10,
        sourceModules: ['MOD_I_MARKETING'],
      },
      {
        sectionNumber: 9,
        title: '3-Year Financial Plan & Breakeven Analysis',
        assessorPrompt: 'Unit economics, monthly breakeven crossover, and 36-month P&L forecasts.',
        wordLimit: 450,
        scoringWeightPercent: 10,
        sourceModules: ['MOD_H_REVENUE', 'MOD_J_FINANCE'],
      },
      {
        sectionNumber: 10,
        title: 'Funding Requirements & Milestone Roadmap',
        assessorPrompt: 'Total capital requirement, breakdown of sources & uses, and key milestone horizons.',
        wordLimit: 350,
        scoringWeightPercent: 10,
        sourceModules: ['MOD_K_GRANTS_FUNDING'],
      },
    ],
  },
];

export function BusinessPlanStudioWorkspace({
  plan,
  founderName = 'Founder',
  selectedCountry = 'IE',
  isVaultReadonly = false,
  whiteLabelEnabled = false,
  onUpdatePlanModuleLData,
  onJumpToModule,
  onNavigateToModule,
  onParkQuestionInSession,
}: BusinessPlanStudioWorkspaceProps) {
  const jumpHandler = onJumpToModule || onNavigateToModule;
  const effectiveCountry = plan.hqCountryCode || selectedCountry || 'IE';
  const trackCaps = useMemo(
    () => getPlanTrackCapabilities(effectiveCountry, plan.fundingTrackMode),
    [effectiveCountry, plan.fundingTrackMode]
  );
  const isUK = trackCaps.countryCode === 'GB';
  const isIreland = trackCaps.countryCode === 'IE';
  const isGrantsEnabled = trackCaps.isGrantsEnabled;
  const currency =
    plan.baseCurrency || (isUK ? 'GBP' : isIreland ? 'EUR' : 'USD');
  const currencySymbol =
    currency === 'GBP'
      ? '£'
      : currency === 'EUR'
        ? '€'
        : currency === 'AUD'
          ? 'A$'
          : currency === 'CAD'
            ? 'C$'
            : '$';

  // Filter archetypes so international / non-grant plans never see IE/UK grant forms,
  // and IE/UK plans only see their own country's grant forms.
  const availableArchetypes = useMemo(() => {
    return ARCHETYPE_CATALOG.filter((cat) => {
      if (cat.archetype === 'IE_LEO_OFFICIAL_GRANT') {
        return isGrantsEnabled && isIreland;
      }
      if (cat.archetype === 'UK_INNOVATE_UK_9Q') {
        return isGrantsEnabled && isUK;
      }
      return true;
    }).map((cat) => {
      if (cat.archetype === 'COMMERCIAL_BANK_LOAN') {
        return {
          ...cat,
          summary: `Engineered specifically for commercial credit risk officers and bank loan underwriters (${trackCaps.exampleBanksLabel}). Emphasizes cashflow trough, debt service coverage, collateral assets, personal survival budget, and down-side risk buffers.`,
        };
      }
      return cat;
    });
  }, [isGrantsEnabled, isIreland, isUK, trackCaps.exampleBanksLabel]);

  const defaultArchetypeForPlan: BusinessPlanArchetype = useMemo(() => {
    if (isGrantsEnabled && isIreland) return 'IE_LEO_OFFICIAL_GRANT';
    if (isGrantsEnabled && isUK) return 'COMMERCIAL_BANK_LOAN';
    return 'STANDARD_COMPREHENSIVE_PLAN';
  }, [isGrantsEnabled, isIreland, isUK]);

  const defaultTitleForPlan = useMemo(() => {
    if (isGrantsEnabled && isIreland) {
      return 'LEO Official Grant & Growth Business Plan';
    }
    if (isGrantsEnabled && isUK) {
      return 'Commercial Bank Credit Application & Plan';
    }
    return 'Comprehensive Master Business Plan';
  }, [isGrantsEnabled, isIreland, isUK]);

  // Helper to sanitize existing versions if a plan switched away from IE/UK grants
  const normalizeVersionsForTrack = useMemo(() => {
    return (rawVersions: BusinessPlanVersionItem[]): BusinessPlanVersionItem[] => {
      return (rawVersions || [])
        .map((ver) => {
          // Helper to ensure sections array is always valid
          const resolveSectionsForVersion = (v: BusinessPlanVersionItem): ModuleLCompiledSectionItem[] => {
            if (Array.isArray(v.sections) && v.sections.length > 0) {
              return v.sections;
            }
            if (
              Array.isArray(plan.moduleLData?.step3Compiler?.sections) &&
              plan.moduleLData.step3Compiler.sections.length > 0 &&
              (v.isPrimary ||
                v.id === plan.moduleLData?.activeVersionId ||
                v.archetype === plan.moduleLData?.step3Compiler?.modeCompiledFor)
            ) {
              return plan.moduleLData.step3Compiler.sections;
            }
            const cat =
              ARCHETYPE_CATALOG.find((c) => c.archetype === v.archetype) ||
              ARCHETYPE_CATALOG.find((c) => c.archetype === defaultArchetypeForPlan) ||
              ARCHETYPE_CATALOG[5];
            return cat.sectionsTemplate.map((tpl) => ({
              id: `sec-${tpl.sectionNumber}-${Date.now()}`,
              sectionNumber: tpl.sectionNumber,
              title: tpl.title,
              assessorQuestionPrompt: tpl.assessorPrompt,
              scoringWeightPercent: tpl.scoringWeightPercent,
              wordLimit: tpl.wordLimit,
              sourceModules: tpl.sourceModules,
              compiledResponseText: '',
            }));
          };

          const isForeignOrDisabledGrant =
            (ver.archetype === 'IE_LEO_OFFICIAL_GRANT' &&
              (!isGrantsEnabled || !isIreland)) ||
            (ver.archetype === 'UK_INNOVATE_UK_9Q' &&
              (!isGrantsEnabled || !isUK));

          if (!isForeignOrDisabledGrant) {
            return {
              ...ver,
              sections: resolveSectionsForVersion(ver),
            };
          }

          // Check if the user has actually written custom content in this grant version
          const hasCompiledContent = (ver.sections || []).some(
            (s) => (s.compiledResponseText || '').trim().length > 20
          );

          // Convert untouched default grant versions to the clean Master Business Plan
          const replacementCat =
            ARCHETYPE_CATALOG.find(
              (c) => c.archetype === defaultArchetypeForPlan
            ) || ARCHETYPE_CATALOG[5];

          if (!hasCompiledContent) {
            return {
              ...ver,
              title: defaultTitleForPlan,
              archetype: replacementCat.archetype,
              targetAudience: replacementCat.targetAudience,
              targetTone: replacementCat.targetTone,
              sections: replacementCat.sectionsTemplate.map((tpl) => ({
                id: `sec-${tpl.sectionNumber}-${Date.now()}`,
                sectionNumber: tpl.sectionNumber,
                title: tpl.title,
                assessorQuestionPrompt: tpl.assessorPrompt,
                scoringWeightPercent: tpl.scoringWeightPercent,
                wordLimit: tpl.wordLimit,
                sourceModules: tpl.sourceModules,
                compiledResponseText: '',
              })),
            };
          }
          return null;
        })
        .filter((v): v is BusinessPlanVersionItem => v !== null);
    };
  }, [
    defaultArchetypeForPlan,
    defaultTitleForPlan,
    isGrantsEnabled,
    isIreland,
    isUK,
    plan.moduleLData?.step3Compiler?.sections,
    plan.moduleLData?.activeVersionId,
    plan.moduleLData?.step3Compiler?.modeCompiledFor,
  ]);

  // 1. Initial Versions
  const initialVersions: BusinessPlanVersionItem[] = useMemo(() => {
    if (plan.moduleLData?.versions && plan.moduleLData.versions.length > 0) {
      const cleaned = normalizeVersionsForTrack(plan.moduleLData.versions);
      if (cleaned.length > 0) return cleaned;
    }

    const catalogItem =
      ARCHETYPE_CATALOG.find((c) => c.archetype === defaultArchetypeForPlan) ||
      ARCHETYPE_CATALOG[5];

    const defaultSections: ModuleLCompiledSectionItem[] =
      catalogItem.sectionsTemplate.map((tpl) => ({
        id: `sec-${tpl.sectionNumber}-${Date.now()}`,
        sectionNumber: tpl.sectionNumber,
        title: tpl.title,
        assessorQuestionPrompt: tpl.assessorPrompt,
        scoringWeightPercent: tpl.scoringWeightPercent,
        wordLimit: tpl.wordLimit,
        sourceModules: tpl.sourceModules,
        compiledResponseText: '',
      }));

    return [
      {
        id: `bp-ver-${Date.now()}`,
        title: defaultTitleForPlan,
        archetype: defaultArchetypeForPlan,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        lastEditedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        isPrimary: true,
        targetAudience: catalogItem.targetAudience,
        targetTone: catalogItem.targetTone,
        targetFundingAsk: 50000,
        sections: defaultSections,
        executiveHookStatement: `${plan.title} is an evidence-backed commercial venture positioned for sustainable, high-value growth in ${trackCaps.countryName}.`,
      },
    ];
  }, [
    plan.moduleLData?.versions,
    normalizeVersionsForTrack,
    defaultArchetypeForPlan,
    defaultTitleForPlan,
    plan.title,
    trackCaps.countryName,
  ]);

  const [versions, setVersions] = useState<BusinessPlanVersionItem[]>(initialVersions);
  const [activeVersionId, setActiveVersionId] = useState<string>(
    plan.moduleLData?.activeVersionId || initialVersions[0]?.id || ''
  );

  // Synchronize versions from plan prop when background cloud session hydration finishes or country/track changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (plan.moduleLData?.versions && plan.moduleLData.versions.length > 0) {
      const cleaned = normalizeVersionsForTrack(plan.moduleLData.versions);
      if (cleaned.length > 0) {
        setVersions(cleaned);
        setActiveVersionId((prevId) => {
          if (prevId && cleaned.some((v) => v.id === prevId)) {
            return prevId;
          }
          return cleaned[0]?.id || prevId;
        });
      }
    } else {
      setVersions(initialVersions);
      setActiveVersionId(initialVersions[0]?.id || '');
    }
  }, [
    plan.moduleLData?.versions,
    plan.moduleLData?.activeVersionId,
    normalizeVersionsForTrack,
    initialVersions,
  ]);

  const activeVersion = useMemo(() => {
    const raw = versions.find((v) => v.id === activeVersionId) || versions[0];
    if (!raw) return raw;
    if (!Array.isArray(raw.sections) || raw.sections.length === 0) {
      if (
        Array.isArray(plan.moduleLData?.step3Compiler?.sections) &&
        plan.moduleLData.step3Compiler.sections.length > 0 &&
        (raw.isPrimary ||
          raw.id === plan.moduleLData?.activeVersionId ||
          raw.archetype === plan.moduleLData?.step3Compiler?.modeCompiledFor)
      ) {
        return { ...raw, sections: plan.moduleLData.step3Compiler.sections };
      }
      const cat =
        ARCHETYPE_CATALOG.find((c) => c.archetype === raw.archetype) ||
        ARCHETYPE_CATALOG.find((c) => c.archetype === defaultArchetypeForPlan) ||
        ARCHETYPE_CATALOG[5];
      return {
        ...raw,
        sections: cat.sectionsTemplate.map((tpl) => ({
          id: `sec-${tpl.sectionNumber}-${Date.now()}`,
          sectionNumber: tpl.sectionNumber,
          title: tpl.title,
          assessorQuestionPrompt: tpl.assessorPrompt,
          scoringWeightPercent: tpl.scoringWeightPercent,
          wordLimit: tpl.wordLimit,
          sourceModules: tpl.sourceModules,
          compiledResponseText: '',
        })),
      };
    }
    return raw;
  }, [
    versions,
    activeVersionId,
    defaultArchetypeForPlan,
    plan.moduleLData?.step3Compiler?.sections,
    plan.moduleLData?.activeVersionId,
    plan.moduleLData?.step3Compiler?.modeCompiledFor,
  ]);

  const catalogMeta = useMemo(() => {
    return (
      availableArchetypes.find((c) => c.archetype === activeVersion?.archetype) ||
      ARCHETYPE_CATALOG.find((c) => c.archetype === activeVersion?.archetype) ||
      availableArchetypes[0] ||
      ARCHETYPE_CATALOG[0]
    );
  }, [activeVersion?.archetype, availableArchetypes]);

  // 2. Option A: Inline "Click-to-Edit" State
  // Which section is currently being edited inline on the continuous canvas (null = reader mode)
  const [editingSectionNumber, setEditingSectionNumber] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [inlineEditText, setInlineEditText] = useState<string>('');
  const [customPolishInstruction, setCustomPolishInstruction] = useState<string>('');
  const [isPolishing, setIsPolishing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [polishBanner, setPolishBanner] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Batch Generation State
  const [isCompilingAll, setIsCompilingAll] = useState(false);
  const [compileAllProgress, setCompileAllProgress] = useState<{ current: number; total: number } | null>(null);

  // Pre-flight Contradiction Assessor Audit state
  const [showAuditDrawer, setShowAuditDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [isAuditing, setIsAuditing] = useState(false);

  // New Version Modal
  const [isCreatingNewVersion, setIsCreatingNewVersion] = useState(false);
  const [newVersionTitle, setNewVersionTitle] = useState('');
  const [selectedArchetypeForNew, setSelectedArchetypeForNew] =
    useState<BusinessPlanArchetype>(defaultArchetypeForPlan);

  useEffect(() => {
    setSelectedArchetypeForNew(defaultArchetypeForPlan);
  }, [defaultArchetypeForPlan]);

  // Saving state
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [saveBanner, setSaveBanner] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [copiedSuccess, setCopiedSuccess] = useState(false);

  // Refs for smooth scroll navigation
  const chapterRefs = useRef<{ [key: number]: HTMLElement | null }>({});

  // 3. Save helper
  async function persistVersions(newVersions: BusinessPlanVersionItem[], newActiveId?: string) {
    setIsSaving(true);
    setVersions(newVersions);
    const targetActive = newActiveId ?? activeVersionId;
    setActiveVersionId(targetActive);

    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    // Optimistic local persistence: update moduleLData immediately so localStorage saves it synchronously
    onUpdatePlanModuleLData?.({
      ...(plan.moduleLData || {}),
      versions: newVersions,
      activeVersionId: targetActive,
      completionPercentage: Math.max(plan.moduleLData?.completionPercentage || 0, 60),
      lastSavedAt: nowIso,
    });

    try {
      const res = await saveBusinessPlanStudioVersionsAction({
        planId: plan.id,
        versions: newVersions,
        activeVersionId: targetActive,
        completionPercentage: 60,
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        setSaveBanner('Saved');
        setTimeout(() => setSaveBanner(null), 2500);
      }
    } catch {
      // non-fatal
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  }

  // 4. Update section text in active version
  function handleSaveSectionText(sectionNumber: number, text: string) {
    if (!activeVersion) return;
    const updatedSections = (activeVersion.sections || []).map((s) =>
      s.sectionNumber === sectionNumber ? { ...s, compiledResponseText: text } : s
    );
    const updatedVer: BusinessPlanVersionItem = {
      ...activeVersion,
      sections: updatedSections,
      lastEditedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    const nextVersions = versions.map((v) => (v.id === activeVersion.id ? updatedVer : v));
    persistVersions(nextVersions);
    setEditingSectionNumber(null);
  }

  // 5. Option A: Inline AI Polish Action
  async function handleApplyPolish(presetInstruction?: string) {
    if (!activeVersion || editingSectionNumber === null) return;
    const currentSec = (activeVersion.sections || []).find((s) => s.sectionNumber === editingSectionNumber);
    if (!currentSec) return;

    const instruction = presetInstruction || customPolishInstruction;
    if (!instruction.trim()) return;

    setIsPolishing(true);
    setPolishBanner(null);

    try {
      const res = await polishBusinessPlanChapterAction({
        planId: plan.id,
        chapterTitle: currentSec.title,
        currentText: inlineEditText || currentSec.compiledResponseText,
        instruction,
        targetTone: activeVersion.targetTone,
        planTitle: plan.title,
        industryCategory: plan.industryCategory,
        hqCountryCode: selectedCountry,
        baseCurrency: currency,
      });

      if (res.polishedText) {
        setInlineEditText(res.polishedText);
        setPolishBanner(res.summaryOfChanges || 'Prose refined with AI');
        setCustomPolishInstruction('');
      }
    } catch {
      // non-fatal fallback
    } finally {
      setIsPolishing(false);
    }
  }

  // 6. One-Click Compile/Refresh Entire Document for Active Version
  async function handleCompileAllChapters() {
    if (!activeVersion || isVaultReadonly) return;
    setIsCompilingAll(true);
    setCompileAllProgress({ current: 0, total: activeVersion.sections?.length || 0 });

    const segments = plan.moduleBData?.marketSizing?.segments || [];
    let samCalc = 0;
    let somCalc = 0;
    segments.forEach((s) => {
      const price = parseFloat(s.pricePerCustomerInput || '0') || 0;
      const reachable = parseFloat(s.reachableCustomersInTargetMarketsInput || '0') || 0;
      const year1 = parseFloat(s.year1To2CustomerGoalInput || '0') || 0;
      samCalc += price * reachable;
      somCalc += price * year1;
    });
    if (samCalc === 0) samCalc = 250000;
    if (somCalc === 0) somCalc = 50000;
    const tamCalc = samCalc * 5;

    const summaryFactPack = `
VENTURE: "${plan.title}" (${plan.industryCategory || 'Startup'}) in ${selectedCountry} (${currency}).
PROBLEM: ${plan.conceptCanvas?.coreProblem || 'Market pain points identified'}
SOLUTION: ${plan.conceptCanvas?.proposedSolution || 'High-margin structured product'}
CUSTOMER: ${plan.conceptCanvas?.targetCustomer || 'Target beachhead persona'}
MARKET: TAM ${formatPlanCurrency(tamCalc, currency)}, SAM ${formatPlanCurrency(samCalc, currency)}, SOM ${formatPlanCurrency(somCalc, currency)}.
VALIDATION: ${plan.moduleCData?.surveys?.[0]?.responses?.length || 0} customer discovery responses, ${plan.moduleCData?.surveys?.[0]?.aiInsightsSummary?.headlineTakeaway || 'Validated willingness to pay'}.
PRICING & REVENUE: Target pricing modeled in Module H Pocket Profit breakeven.
HEADCOUNT & SURVIVAL: Scheduled hiring and founder survival budget verified in Module F.
OPERATIONS: Equipment and 3-quote schedules established in Module E.
FINANCES: 36-month cashflow trough and localized employer taxes modeled in Module J.
`;

    try {
      const res = await compileAllBusinessPlanSectionsAction({
        planId: plan.id,
        versionId: activeVersion.id,
        archetype: activeVersion.archetype,
        targetTone: activeVersion.targetTone,
        planTitle: plan.title,
        industryCategory: plan.industryCategory,
        hqCountryCode: selectedCountry,
        baseCurrency: currency,
        planContextSummary: summaryFactPack,
        sections: (activeVersion.sections || []).map((s) => ({
          sectionNumber: s.sectionNumber,
          title: s.title,
          assessorPrompt: s.assessorQuestionPrompt,
          wordLimit: s.wordLimit,
          scoringWeightPercent: s.scoringWeightPercent,
          currentResponseText: s.compiledResponseText,
        })),
      });

      if (res.ok && res.compiledSections.length > 0) {
        const resultMap = new Map(res.compiledSections.map((r) => [r.sectionNumber, r.compiledResponseText]));
        const updatedSections = (activeVersion.sections || []).map((s) => ({
          ...s,
          compiledResponseText: resultMap.get(s.sectionNumber) || s.compiledResponseText,
        }));
        const updatedVer: BusinessPlanVersionItem = {
          ...activeVersion,
          sections: updatedSections,
          lastEditedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        };
        const nextVersions = versions.map((v) => (v.id === activeVersion.id ? updatedVer : v));
        persistVersions(nextVersions);
        setSaveBanner('Entire plan regenerated successfully');
        setTimeout(() => setSaveBanner(null), 3500);
      }
    } catch {
      // non-fatal
    } finally {
      setIsCompilingAll(false);
      setCompileAllProgress(null);
    }
  }

  // 7. Version Management Handlers
  function handleCreateVersion() {
    if (!newVersionTitle.trim()) return;
    const cat = ARCHETYPE_CATALOG.find((c) => c.archetype === selectedArchetypeForNew) || ARCHETYPE_CATALOG[0];
    const newVer: BusinessPlanVersionItem = {
      id: `bp-ver-${Date.now()}`,
      title: newVersionTitle.trim(),
      archetype: selectedArchetypeForNew,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      lastEditedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      isPrimary: false,
      targetAudience: cat.targetAudience,
      targetTone: cat.targetTone,
      targetFundingAsk: 50000,
      sections: cat.sectionsTemplate.map((tpl) => ({
        id: `sec-${tpl.sectionNumber}-${Date.now()}`,
        sectionNumber: tpl.sectionNumber,
        title: tpl.title,
        assessorQuestionPrompt: tpl.assessorPrompt,
        scoringWeightPercent: tpl.scoringWeightPercent,
        wordLimit: tpl.wordLimit,
        sourceModules: tpl.sourceModules,
        compiledResponseText: '',
      })),
      executiveHookStatement: `${plan.title} addresses ${plan.conceptCanvas?.targetCustomer || 'verified customers'} with high commercial additionality in ${selectedCountry}.`,
    };

    const next = [...versions, newVer];
    persistVersions(next, newVer.id);
    setIsCreatingNewVersion(false);
    setNewVersionTitle('');
  }

  function handleDuplicateVersion(ver: BusinessPlanVersionItem) {
    const dup: BusinessPlanVersionItem = {
      ...ver,
      id: `bp-ver-copy-${Date.now()}`,
      title: `${ver.title} (Copy)`,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      lastEditedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      isPrimary: false,
      sections: (ver.sections || []).map((s) => ({ ...s, id: `sec-${s.sectionNumber}-${Date.now()}` })),
    };
    persistVersions([...versions, dup], dup.id);
  }

  function handleDeleteVersion(id: string) {
    if ((versions?.length || 0) <= 1) return;
    const filtered = versions.filter((v) => v.id !== id);
    persistVersions(filtered, filtered[0].id);
  }

  // 8. Copy Entire Document as clean text
  function handleCopyEntireDocument() {
    if (!activeVersion) return;
    const fullDoc = `
# ${plan.title}
## ${activeVersion.title} (${catalogMeta.badge})
Target Stakeholder: ${activeVersion.targetAudience}
Date: ${new Date().toLocaleDateString()}
Location: ${selectedCountry} | Currency: ${currency} (${currencySymbol})
Facility / Ask Amount: ${formatPlanCurrency(activeVersion.targetFundingAsk || 50000, currency)}

---

${(activeVersion.sections || [])
  .map(
    (sec) => `### Chapter ${sec.sectionNumber}: ${sec.title}

${sec.compiledResponseText || '(Chapter not compiled yet)'}
`
  )
  .join('\n---\n\n')}

---
Generated by Startup Preflight Business Plan Studio
`.trim();

    navigator.clipboard.writeText(fullDoc);
    setCopiedSuccess(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedSuccess(false), 2500);
  }

  // Metrics summary
  const totalWords = useMemo(() => {
    if (!activeVersion?.sections) return 0;
    return activeVersion.sections.reduce((acc, sec) => {
      const words = sec?.compiledResponseText
        ? sec.compiledResponseText.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length
        : 0;
      return acc + words;
    }, 0);
  }, [activeVersion?.sections]);

  const compiledCount = useMemo(() => {
    if (!activeVersion?.sections) return 0;
    return activeVersion.sections.filter((s) => (s?.compiledResponseText || '').trim().length > 30).length;
  }, [activeVersion?.sections]);

  // Smooth scroll to chapter
  function scrollToChapter(num: number) {
    const el = chapterRefs.current[num];
    if (el) {
      el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 print:space-y-0 print:bg-white">
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* 1. TOP CONTROL BAR (Audience Selector, Multi-Version Ribbon, Top Actions) */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-30 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 bg-white/95 p-4 shadow-sm backdrop-blur-md no-print print:hidden">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
          {/* Left: Active Version Badge & Switcher */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-violet-600 text-white shadow-xs">
              <Sparkles className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
                  Business Plan Studio
                </span>
                <Badge className="border-violet-200 bg-violet-100 text-[10px] font-bold text-violet-800">
                  AI COMPILER
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-sm font-extrabold text-slate-900 sm:text-base">
                  {activeVersion?.title}
                </span>
                <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] font-medium text-slate-600">
                  {catalogMeta.badge}
                </Badge>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Right: Primary Document Action Controls */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            {/* Compile All Button */}
            <Button
              size="sm"
              onClick={handleCompileAllChapters}
              disabled={isCompilingAll || isVaultReadonly}
              className="bg-violet-700 text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-xs hover:bg-violet-800 transition-all"
            >
              {isCompilingAll ? (
                <>
                  <RefreshCw className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                  Synthesizing Plan...
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Sparkles className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-violet-200" />
                  Generate / Refresh Plan
                </>
              )}
            </Button>

            {/* Print / PDF Button */}
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => window.print()}
              className="text-xs text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
            >
              <Printer className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-500" />
              Print / Save PDF
            </Button>

            {/* Copy Full Document */}
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={handleCopyEntireDocument}
              className="text-xs text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
            >
              {copiedSuccess ? (
                <>
                  <Check className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                  Copied!
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Copy className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-500" />
                  Copy Document
                </>
              )}
            </Button>

            {/* Create New Version */}
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="ghost"
              onClick={() => setIsCreatingNewVersion(true)}
              className="text-xs text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-50"
            >
              <Plus className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              New Version
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Version Switcher Tabs Strip */}
        <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-slate-100 pt-2.5">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-400 mr-1">VERSIONS:</span>
            {versions.map((ver) => {
              const isActive = ver.id === activeVersion?.id;
              return (
                <button
                  key={ver.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setActiveVersionId(ver.id);
                    persistVersions(versions, ver.id);
                    setEditingSectionNumber(null);
                  }}

                      ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white shadow-2xs'
                      : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200 hover:text-slate-900'

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] text-slate-500 font-medium shrink-0">
            <span>
              {compiledCount}/{activeVersion?.sections?.length || 0} Chapters Ready
            </span>
            <span>•</span>
            <span>{totalWords.toLocaleString()} Words</span>
            {saveBanner && (
              <span className="ml-2 font-bold text-emerald-600 animate-pulse">✓ {saveBanner}</span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* 2. MAIN TWO-COLUMN WORKSPACE: STICKY OUTLINE ON LEFT + CONTINUOUS CANVAS */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 items-start print:block print:w-full print:bg-white">
        {/* Left Sticky Outline Rail (Hidden on small screens, desktop navigation) */}
        <div className="hidden lg:block lg:col-span-3 sticky top-28 space-y-3 no-print print:hidden">
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-3.5 shadow-xs">

              <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                {activeVersion?.sections?.length || 0} Chapters

            </div>

            <nav className="mt-2.5 space-y-1">
              {(activeVersion?.sections || []).map((sec) => {

            </nav>

            {/* Audience Context Box */}
            <div className="mt-4 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 p-2.5 border border-slate-100 text-[11px] space-y-1">
              <div className="font-bold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-1">
                <Target className="h-3 w-3 text-violet-600" />
                Target Audience Filter:
              </div>
              <p className="text-slate-500 leading-snug">

        {/* CENTER: CONTINUOUS, BOARD-READY BUSINESS PLAN DOCUMENT CANVAS */}

        <div className="lg:col-span-9 space-y-8 print:w-full print:max-w-none print:p-0 print:m-0 print:bg-white">

                    {new Date().toLocaleDateString()}

            {/* ------------------------------------------------------------------- */}

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">

                  Table of Contents &amp; Chapter Structure
                </h3>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                  {activeVersion?.sections?.length || 0} Chapters • {totalWords.toLocaleString()} Words
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-8 gap-y-2 text-xs">
                {(activeVersion?.sections || []).map((sec, idx) => (

                  </div>

                            <button
                              type="button"

                                setEditingSectionNumber(sec.sectionNumber);
                                setInlineEditText(sec.compiledResponseText || '');
                                setPolishBanner(null);
