                    <div className="text-slate-800 text-sm sm:text-base leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap font-sans space-y-4">
                      {hasProse ? (

                      ) : (
                        <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-slate-50/70 p-6 text-center">

                          </p>
                          <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-500 no-print print:hidden">

                                <th className="px-4 py-2.5 text-right">ARPU / LTV</th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-2.5 text-right">Total Opportunity</th>
                              </tr>
                            </thead>
                            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 font-sans">
                              <tr className="hover:bg-slate-50/50">
                                <td className="px-4 py-2.5 font-semibold text-slate-900">Total Addressable Market (TAM)</td>

                                <td className="px-4 py-2.5 text-right text-slate-700">12,500</td>

=== src/components/workspace/autosave-status-indicator.tsx ===
'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Cloud, Check, Loader2, AlertTriangle, RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react';

export type AutosaveStatus = 'idle' | 'saving' | 'saved' | 'error';

interface AutosaveStatusIndicatorProps {
  status: AutosaveStatus;
  lastSavedAt?: Date | null;
  onRetry?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

export function AutosaveStatusIndicator({
  status,
  lastSavedAt,
  onRetry,
  className = '',
}: AutosaveStatusIndicatorProps) {
  // Format the time as HH:mm:ss if available
  const formattedTime = lastSavedAt
    ? lastSavedAt.toLocaleTimeString([], {
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit',
        second: '2-digit',
      })
    : null;

  return (
    <div
      className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium transition-all ${
        status === 'saving'
          ? 'border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/80 text-indigo-700 shadow-2xs'
          : status === 'error'
            ? 'border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 text-amber-800'
            : status === 'saved'
              ? 'border-emerald-200/70 bg-emerald-50/60 text-emerald-800'
              : 'border-slate-200/80 bg-slate-50/80 text-slate-500'
      } ${className}`}
      title={
        formattedTime
          ? `Autosave active. Last saved to cloud at ${formattedTime}.`
          : 'Autosave active: changes are automatically saved to your cloud plan.'
      }
    >
      {status === 'saving' && (
        <>
          <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin text-indigo-600" />
          <span className="font-semibold text-indigo-600">Saving...</span>
        </>
      )}

      {status === 'saved' && (
        <>
          <span className="flex h-3 w-3 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-emerald-600 text-white">
            <Check className="h-2 w-2 stroke-[3]" />
          </span>
          <span className="text-emerald-800">
            Saved
            {formattedTime && (
              <span className="ml-1 hidden text-[10px] text-emerald-700/80 xl:inline">
                {formattedTime}
              </span>
            )}
          </span>
        </>
      )}

      {status === 'error' && (
        <>
          <AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3 text-amber-600" />
          <span className="text-amber-800">Save issue</span>
          {onRetry && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onRetry}
              className="ml-1 inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded px-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-900 underline hover:bg-amber-100"
            >
              <RefreshCw className="h-2.5 w-2.5" /> Retry
            </button>
          )}
        </>
      )}

      {status === 'idle' && (
        <>
          <Cloud className="h-3 w-3 text-slate-400" />
          <span className="hidden text-slate-500 sm:inline">Autosave on</span>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

}: ModuleLWorkspaceProps) {
  const isStep1Complete = Boolean(plan.moduleLData?.step1Mode?.lastSavedAt);
  const isStep2Complete = Boolean(plan.moduleLData?.step2Audit?.lastSavedAt);
  const isStep3Complete = Boolean(plan.moduleLData?.step3Compiler?.lastSavedAt);
  const isStep4Complete = Boolean(plan.moduleLData?.step4Appendices?.lastSavedAt);
  const isStep5Complete = Boolean(plan.moduleLData?.step5DossierBrief?.lastSavedAt);

  const defaultOpenStep =
    initialStep ??
    (!isStep1Complete
      ? 1
      : !isStep2Complete
        ? 2
        : !isStep3Complete
          ? 3
          : !isStep4Complete
            ? 4
            : 5);

  const [openStep, setOpenStep] = useState<number | 'ALL'>(defaultOpenStep);

  const trackCaps = getPlanTrackCapabilities(
    plan.hqCountryCode,
    plan.fundingTrackMode
  );
  const isUK = trackCaps.countryCode === 'GB';
  const isIreland = trackCaps.countryCode === 'IE';
  const isGrantsEnabled = trackCaps.isGrantsEnabled;
  const countryFlag = trackCaps.countryFlag;
  const countryName = trackCaps.countryName;
  const currency =
    plan.baseCurrency || (isUK ? 'GBP' : isIreland ? 'EUR' : 'USD');

  const completedCoreStepsCount =
    (isStep1Complete ? 1 : 0) +
    (isStep2Complete ? 1 : 0) +
    (isStep3Complete ? 1 : 0) +
    (isStep4Complete ? 1 : 0) +
    (isStep5Complete ? 1 : 0);

  const savedCompilerMode = plan.moduleLData?.step1Mode?.compilerMode;
  const activeCompilerMode = !isGrantsEnabled
    ? savedCompilerMode === 'OTHER'
      ? 'OTHER'
      : 'STANDARD_COMMERCIAL_PLAN'
    : savedCompilerMode ||
      (isIreland
        ? 'IE_LEO_OFFICIAL_FORM'
        : isUK
          ? 'UK_INNOVATE_UK_9Q'
          : 'STANDARD_COMMERCIAL_PLAN');

  const activeCatalogItem =
    MODULE_L_COMPILER_MODES.find((m) => m.mode === activeCompilerMode) ||
    MODULE_L_COMPILER_MODES[0];

  function scrollToStep(stepNum: number, targetId: string) {
    setOpenStep(stepNum);
    setTimeout(() => {
      const el = document.getElementById(targetId);
      if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
    }, 40);
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* 1. TOP HEADER MODULE CARD (Strict GEMINI.md Section 6.1 Standard)         */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-indigo-200 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-950 via-indigo-900 to-violet-900 p-6 text-white shadow-sm">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="space-y-1.5 min-w-0 flex-1">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <Badge className="border-indigo-400/40 bg-indigo-500/30 text-indigo-100 text-[10px] shrink-0">
                Module L • Capstone Official Compiler
              </Badge>
              <Badge className="border-emerald-400/30 bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-200 text-[10px] shrink-0">
                <Sparkles className="mr-1 h-3 w-3" />
                {countryFlag} {countryName}{' '}
                {isGrantsEnabled
                  ? 'Grant & Business Plan Compiler'
                  : 'Commercial & Investor Plan Compiler'}
              </Badge>
              <Badge className="border-violet-400/30 bg-violet-500/20 text-violet-100 text-[10px] shrink-0">
                {activeCatalogItem.badge}
              </Badge>
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white sm:text-2xl">
              {isGrantsEnabled
                ? 'Module L: Interactive Business Plan & Official Grant Compiler'
                : 'Module L: Interactive Commercial & Investor Business Plan Compiler'}
            </h1>
            <p className="max-w-2xl text-xs text-indigo-100/90 sm:text-sm">
              {isGrantsEnabled
                ? 'Transform your verified answers across Modules A–K into committee-ready IE LEO forms, UK Innovate UK 9-Question applications, Start Up Loan workbooks, or SEIS/EIS/EII investor packs with Appendices A–F.'
                : 'Transform your verified answers across Modules A–K into bank-ready commercial business plans, angel/seed investor memos, or custom accelerator applications with Appendices A–F.'}
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-2 shrink-0">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              {onBackToModuleK && (
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={onBackToModuleK}
                  className="border-indigo-400/40 bg-white/10 text-xs text-white hover:bg-white/20"
                >
                  <ArrowLeft className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  Back to Module K
                </Button>
              )}
              {onOpenMasterBlueprint && (
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={onOpenMasterBlueprint}
                  className="border-emerald-400/50 bg-emerald-500/20 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-100 hover:bg-emerald-500/30"
                >
                  <BookOpen className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-300" />
                  View Master Blueprint
                </Button>
              )}
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() =>
                  setOpenStep((prev) => (prev === 'ALL' ? 1 : 'ALL'))
                }
                className="border-indigo-400/40 bg-white/10 text-xs text-white hover:bg-white/20"
              >
                {openStep === 'ALL' ? 'Focus Step-by-Step' : 'Expand All Steps'}
              </Button>
            </div>
            <div className="text-right text-[11px] text-indigo-200">
              Module L Progress:{' '}
              <strong className="text-white">
                {Math.round((completedCoreStepsCount / 5) * 100)}%
              </strong>{' '}
              ({completedCoreStepsCount} of 5 Steps Ready)
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Step Navigation Strip (Tile Grid Standard) */}
        <div className="mt-5 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 border-t border-indigo-800/70 pt-4 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-5">
          {[
            {
              step: 'Step 1',
              title: '1. Compiler Mode & Rubric',
              done: isStep1Complete,
              targetId: 'module-l-step-1',
              stepNum: 1,
            },
            {
              step: 'Step 2',
              title: '2. Pre-Flight Grant Audit',
              done: isStep2Complete,
              targetId: 'module-l-step-2',
              stepNum: 2,
            },
            {
              step: 'Step 3',
              title: '3. Section Narrative Compiler',
              done: isStep3Complete,
              targetId: 'module-l-step-3',
              stepNum: 3,
            },
            {
              step: 'Step 4',
              title: '4. Appendices A–F Binder',
              done: isStep4Complete,
              targetId: 'module-l-step-4',
              stepNum: 4,
            },
            {
              step: 'Overview',
              title: 'Submission Dossier Brief',
              done: isStep5Complete,
              targetId: 'module-l-step-5',
              stepNum: 5,
            },
          ].map((item, idx, arr) => {
            const firstIncompleteIdx = arr.findIndex((s) => !s.done);
            const isStepOpen =
              openStep === 'ALL'
                ? firstIncompleteIdx === -1
                  ? idx === arr.length - 1
                  : idx === firstIncompleteIdx
                : openStep === item.stepNum;
            return (
              <button
                key={item.step}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => scrollToStep(item.stepNum, item.targetId)}
                className={`rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs transition-all hover:border-white/50 hover:bg-white/15 ${
                  isStepOpen
                    ? 'border-amber-300/80 bg-white/20 text-white shadow-xs ring-1 ring-amber-300/50'
                    : item.done
                      ? 'border-emerald-400/50 bg-emerald-500/20 text-white'
                      : 'border-indigo-700/60 bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-200'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-white/90 text-xs">
                    {item.step}
                  </span>
                  {item.done ? (
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400/25 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-200">
                      <Check className="h-2.5 w-2.5" /> Ready
                    </span>
                  ) : isStepOpen ? (
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-amber-400/25 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-200">
                      Open
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-indigo-300">Pending</span>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="mt-0.5 truncate text-[11px] text-indigo-100/80">
                  {item.title}
                </div>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* STEP 1: COMPILER MODE, TARGET COMMITTEE & SCORING RUBRIC                  */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      <ModuleLModeSelectorStep
        plan={plan}
        isOpen={openStep === 'ALL' || openStep === 1}
        onOpenStep={() => setOpenStep(1)}
        onToggleCollapse={() => setOpenStep(0)}
        isVaultReadonly={isVaultReadonly}
        onSaveStep1={async (step1Data, progress = 20) => {
          await onSaveStep1Mode?.(step1Data, progress);
        }}
        onAdvanceToStep2={() => scrollToStep(2, 'module-l-step-2')}
        onJumpToCompilerStep3={() => scrollToStep(3, 'module-l-step-3')}
        onParkQuestionInSession={onParkQuestionInSession}
      />

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* STEP 2: PRE-FLIGHT CONTRADICTION & GRANT AUDIT (Collapsed / Preview)      */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {openStep !== 'ALL' && openStep !== 2 ? (
        <div
          id="module-l-step-2"
          onClick={() => setOpenStep(2)}
          className="group scroll-mt-24 cursor-pointer rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-xs transition-all hover:border-indigo-300 hover:shadow-sm"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
              <div
                className={`flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-xs font-bold ${
                  isStep2Complete
                    ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                    : 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                }`}
              >
                {isStep2Complete ? <Check className="h-4 w-4" /> : '2'}
              </div>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <h2 className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 group-hover:text-indigo-600">
                    2. Cross-Module Contradiction &amp; Grant Audit (Pre-Flight Gatekeeper)
                  </h2>
                  <Badge
                    variant="outline"
                    className="shrink-0 border-slate-300 text-slate-600 text-[10px] font-medium"
                  >
                    {isStep2Complete ? 'Audit Complete' : 'Next Up'}
                  </Badge>
                </div>
                <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-xs text-slate-500">
                  Reconciles pricing vs. survey WTP, headcount vs. payroll, cashflow trough vs. capital stack, and 3-quote compliance across Modules A–K.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <Button
              type="button"
              size="sm"
              variant="ghost"
              className="h-8 shrink-0 px-2.5 text-xs font-medium text-indigo-600 group-hover:bg-indigo-50"
            >
              {isStep2Complete ? 'Edit Step' : 'Open Step'}
              <ChevronDown className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <Card
          id="module-l-step-2"
          className="scroll-mt-24 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-xs"
        >
          <CardHeader className="border-b border-slate-100 pb-4">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
              <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div className="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 text-xs font-bold text-white">
                  2
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <CardTitle className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
                      2. Cross-Module Contradiction &amp; Grant Audit (Pre-Flight Gatekeeper)
                    </CardTitle>
                    <Badge
                      variant="outline"
                      className="shrink-0 border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 text-[10px] font-medium"
                    >
                      Synced to {activeCatalogItem.badge}
                    </Badge>
                  </div>
                  <CardDescription className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-600">
                    Automated cross-examination of your numbers and narratives across Modules A–K before compiling your final submission sections.
                  </CardDescription>
                </div>
              </div>
              <Button
                type="button"
                size="sm"
                variant="ghost"
                onClick={() => setOpenStep(0)}
                className="shrink-0 text-xs text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-100"
              >
                Collapse Step
                <ChevronUp className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              </Button>
            </div>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="pt-5">
            <ModuleLContradictionAuditStep
              plan={plan}
              isVaultReadonly={isVaultReadonly}
              onSaveStep2Audit={async (data, progress = 40) => {
                if (onSaveStep2Audit) {
                  await onSaveStep2Audit(data, progress);
                }
              }}
              onBackToStep1={() => {
                setOpenStep(1);
                const el = document.getElementById('module-l-step-1');
                if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
              }}
              onContinueToStep3={() => {
                setOpenStep(3);
                const el = document.getElementById('module-l-step-3');
                if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
              }}
              onNavigateToModule={onNavigateToModule}
              onParkQuestionInSession={onParkQuestionInSession}
            />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* STEP 3: SECTION-BY-SECTION NARRATIVE COMPILER                             */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {openStep !== 3 && openStep !== 'ALL' ? (
        <div
          id="module-l-step-3"
          onClick={() => setOpenStep(3)}
          className="group scroll-mt-24 cursor-pointer rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-xs transition-all hover:border-indigo-300 hover:shadow-sm"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
              <div
                className={`flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-xs font-bold ${
                  isStep3Complete
                    ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                    : 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                }`}
              >
                {isStep3Complete ? <Check className="h-4 w-4" /> : '3'}
              </div>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <h2 className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 group-hover:text-indigo-600">
                    3. Interactive Section-by-Section Narrative &amp; Question Compiler
                  </h2>
                  <Badge
                    variant="outline"
                    className="shrink-0 border-slate-300 text-slate-600 text-[10px] font-medium"
                  >
                    {activeCatalogItem.sectionStructureLabel}
                  </Badge>
                </div>
                <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-xs text-slate-500">
                  Auto-assembles your official application responses from Modules A–K with live word-limit gauges, scoring rubrics, and inline AI calibration.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <Button
              type="button"
              size="sm"
              variant="ghost"
              className="h-8 shrink-0 px-2.5 text-xs font-medium text-indigo-600 group-hover:bg-indigo-50"
            >
              {isStep3Complete ? 'Edit Step' : 'Open Step'}
              <ChevronDown className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <Card
          id="module-l-step-3"
          className="scroll-mt-24 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-xs"
        >
          <CardHeader className="border-b border-slate-100 pb-4">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
              <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div className="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 text-xs font-bold text-white">
                  3
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <CardTitle className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
                      3. Interactive Section-by-Section Narrative &amp; Question Compiler
                    </CardTitle>
                    <Badge
                      variant="outline"
                      className="shrink-0 border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 text-[10px] font-medium"
                    >
                      {activeCatalogItem.sectionStructureLabel}
                    </Badge>
                  </div>
                  <CardDescription className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-600">
                    Auto-assembles your official application responses from Modules A–K with live word-limit gauges, scoring rubrics, and inline AI calibration.
                  </CardDescription>
                </div>
              </div>
              <Button
                type="button"
                size="sm"
                variant="ghost"
                onClick={() => setOpenStep(0)}
                className="shrink-0 text-xs text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-100"
              >
                Collapse Step
                <ChevronUp className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              </Button>
            </div>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="pt-5">
            <ModuleLNarrativeCompilerStep
              plan={plan}
              isVaultReadonly={isVaultReadonly}
              onSaveStep3Compiler={async (data, progress = 60) => {
                if (onSaveStep3Compiler) {
                  await onSaveStep3Compiler(data, progress);
                }
              }}
              onBackToStep2={() => {
                setOpenStep(2);
                const el = document.getElementById('module-l-step-2');
                if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
              }}
              onContinueToStep4={() => {
                setOpenStep(4);
                const el = document.getElementById('module-l-step-4');
                if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
              }}
              onNavigateToModule={onNavigateToModule}
              onParkQuestionInSession={onParkQuestionInSession}
            />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* STEP 4: MANDATORY APPENDICES A–F EVIDENCE BINDER                           */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {openStep !== 4 && openStep !== 'ALL' ? (
        <div
          id="module-l-step-4"
          onClick={() => setOpenStep(4)}
          className="group scroll-mt-24 cursor-pointer rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-xs transition-all hover:border-indigo-300 hover:shadow-sm"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
              <div
                className={`flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-xs font-bold ${
                  isStep4Complete
                    ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                    : 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                }`}
              >
                {isStep4Complete ? <Check className="h-4 w-4" /> : '4'}
              </div>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <h2 className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 group-hover:text-indigo-600">
                    4. Mandatory Appendices &amp; Verifiable Proof Binder (Appendices A–F)
                  </h2>
                  <Badge
                    variant="outline"
                    className="shrink-0 border-slate-300 text-slate-600 text-[10px] font-medium"
                  >
                    Appendices A–F
                  </Badge>
                </div>
                <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-xs text-slate-500">
                  Attaches 36-Month Financials (App A), Technical Work Packages (App B), 3-Quotes (App C), Promoter CVs (App D), Survey Proof (App E) &amp; Statutory Setup (App F).
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <Button
              type="button"
              size="sm"
              variant="ghost"
              className="h-8 shrink-0 px-2.5 text-xs font-medium text-indigo-600 group-hover:bg-indigo-50"
            >
              {isStep4Complete ? 'Edit Step' : 'Open Step'}
              <ChevronDown className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <Card
          id="module-l-step-4"
          className="scroll-mt-24 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-xs"
        >
          <CardHeader className="border-b border-slate-100 pb-4">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
              <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div className="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 text-xs font-bold text-white">
                  4
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <CardTitle className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
                      4. Mandatory Appendices &amp; Verifiable Proof Binder (Appendices A–F)
                    </CardTitle>
                    <Badge
                      variant="outline"
                      className="shrink-0 border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 text-[10px] font-medium"
                    >
                      Appendices A–F
                    </Badge>
                  </div>
                  <CardDescription className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-600">
                    Attaches 36-Month Financials (App A), Technical Work Packages (App B), 3-Quotes (App C), Promoter CVs (App D), Survey Proof (App E) &amp; Statutory Setup (App F).
                  </CardDescription>
                </div>
              </div>
              <Button
                type="button"
                size="sm"
                variant="ghost"
                onClick={() => setOpenStep(0)}
                className="shrink-0 text-xs text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-100"
              >
                Collapse Step
                <ChevronUp className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              </Button>
            </div>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="pt-5">
            <ModuleLAppendicesBinderStep
              plan={plan}
              isVaultReadonly={isVaultReadonly}
              onSaveStep4Appendices={async (data, progress = 80) => {
                if (onSaveStep4Appendices) {
                  await onSaveStep4Appendices(data, progress);
                }
              }}
              onBackToStep3={() => {
                setOpenStep(3);
                const el = document.getElementById('module-l-step-3');
                if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
              }}
              onContinueToStep5={() => {
                setOpenStep(5);
                const el = document.getElementById('module-l-step-5');
                if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
              }}
              onNavigateToModule={onNavigateToModule}
              onParkQuestionInSession={onParkQuestionInSession}
            />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* STEP 5 (OVERVIEW): OFFICIAL SUBMISSION DOSSIER BRIEF (Strict Section 6.4) */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {openStep !== 5 && openStep !== 'ALL' ? (
        <div
          id="module-l-step-5"
          onClick={() => setOpenStep(5)}
          className="group scroll-mt-24 cursor-pointer rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 bg-gradient-to-r from-white via-indigo-50/40 to-violet-50/40 p-4 shadow-xs transition-all hover:border-indigo-300 hover:shadow-sm"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
              <div
                className={`flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-xs font-bold ${
                  isStep5Complete
                    ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                    : 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                }`}
              >
                {isStep5Complete ? <Check className="h-4 w-4" /> : <FileText className="h-4 w-4" />}
              </div>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <h2 className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 group-hover:text-indigo-600">
                    5. Official Submission Dossier &amp; Executive Brief
                  </h2>
                  <Badge
                    variant="outline"
                    className="shrink-0 border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 text-[10px] font-medium"
                  >
                    {completedCoreStepsCount}/5 Sections Ready
                  </Badge>
                </div>
                <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-xs text-slate-500">
                  Final committee submission checklist, Things to Consider review, and 1-click PDF / Standalone HTML / Markdown dossier export.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <Button
              type="button"
              size="sm"
              variant="ghost"
              className="h-8 shrink-0 px-2.5 text-xs font-medium text-indigo-600 group-hover:bg-indigo-50"
            >
              <span>{isStep5Complete ? 'Open Overview' : 'Review Overview'}</span>
              <ChevronDown className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <Card
          id="module-l-step-5"
          className="scroll-mt-24 rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 bg-white shadow-xs"
        >
          <CardHeader className="border-b border-indigo-100 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-50/50 via-white to-violet-50/30 pb-4">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
              <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div className="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 text-xs font-bold text-white">
                  5
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <CardTitle className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
                      5. Official Submission Dossier &amp; Executive Brief
                    </CardTitle>
                    <Badge
                      variant="outline"
                      className="shrink-0 border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 text-[10px] font-medium"
                    >
                      Final Capstone &amp; Submission
                    </Badge>
                  </div>
                  <CardDescription className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-600">
                    Comprehensive final gatekeeper, assessor audit score, statutory checklist &amp; standalone printable dossier export.
                  </CardDescription>
                </div>
              </div>
              <Button
                type="button"
                size="sm"
                variant="ghost"
                onClick={() => setOpenStep(0)}
                className="shrink-0 text-xs text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-100"
              >
                Collapse Step
                <ChevronUp className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              </Button>
            </div>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="pt-5">
            <ModuleLSubmissionDossierStep
              plan={plan}
              isVaultReadonly={isVaultReadonly}
              onSaveStep5Brief={async (data, progress = 100) => {
                if (onSaveStep5Brief) {
                  await onSaveStep5Brief(data, progress);
                }
              }}
              onBackToStep4={() => {
                setOpenStep(4);
                const el = document.getElementById('module-l-step-4');
                if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
              }}
              onOpenMasterBlueprint={onOpenMasterBlueprint}
              onNavigateToModule={onNavigateToModule}
              onParkQuestionInSession={onParkQuestionInSession}
            />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
=== src/components/workspace/three-quote-concierge-modal.tsx ===
'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import {
  Zap,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  Building2,
  FileText,
  ExternalLink,
  Loader2,
  AlertCircle,
  X,
  Mail,
  User,
  ShieldCheck,
  Plus,
  Trash2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  submitThreeQuoteRfpAction,
  getPlanQuotesAction,
} from '@/app/actions/quote-concierge';
import type { QuoteSupplierCategory } from '@/lib/partners/partner-catalog-store';
import type { QuoteRfpWorkPackageItem } from '@/db/schema';
import { formatPlanCurrency } from '@/lib/localization';

interface ThreeQuoteConciergeModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  planId: string;
  planTitle: string;
  hqCountryCode?: string;
  baseCurrency?: string;
  sourceModule: 'MOD_D_PRODUCT_BUILD' | 'MOD_E_OPERATIONS';
  defaultCategory?: QuoteSupplierCategory;
  initialEquipmentName?: string;
  initialWorkPackages?: Array<{
    id?: string;
    name?: string;
    title?: string;
    scope?: string;
    description?: string;
    targetDays?: number;
  }>;
  initialBudgetEstimate?: number;
  initialFounderContact?: {
    name?: string;
    email?: string;
    phone?: string;
    companyName?: string;
  };
  onSuccess?: () => void;
}

export function ThreeQuoteConciergeModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  planId,
  planTitle,
  hqCountryCode = 'IE',
  baseCurrency = 'EUR',
  sourceModule,
  defaultCategory = 'DEV_AGENCY',
  initialEquipmentName,
  initialWorkPackages,
  initialBudgetEstimate,
  initialFounderContact,
  onSuccess,
}: ThreeQuoteConciergeModalProps) {
  const isUK = hqCountryCode === 'GB';
  const currencySymbol = isUK ? '£' : '€';

  const [rfpCategory, setRfpCategory] = useState<QuoteSupplierCategory>(
    sourceModule === 'MOD_E_OPERATIONS' ? 'EQUIPMENT_SUPPLIER' : defaultCategory
  );
  const [projectTitle, setProjectTitle] = useState(
    initialEquipmentName
      ? `3 Quotes for ${initialEquipmentName}`
      : `${planTitle} - V1 Build & Delivery RFP`
  );
  const [budgetRange, setBudgetRange] = useState(
    initialBudgetEstimate
      ? `${currencySymbol}${Math.round(initialBudgetEstimate * 0.8).toLocaleString()} – ${currencySymbol}${Math.round(initialBudgetEstimate * 1.2).toLocaleString()} ex-VAT`
      : isUK
        ? '£5,000 – £15,000 ex-VAT'
        : '€5,000 – €15,000 ex-VAT'
  );
  const [targetDeliveryTimeline, setTargetDeliveryTimeline] = useState('6–8 weeks');
  const [scopeSummary, setScopeSummary] = useState(
    sourceModule === 'MOD_E_OPERATIONS'
      ? `Formal equipment quotation needed for grant compliance (${isUK ? 'Innovate UK & BBB' : 'LEO & Enterprise Ireland Appendix C'}). Specification must include make, model, delivery terms, warranty, and net ex-VAT breakdown.`
      : `Complete V1 technical build scope broken down into distinct deliverable work packages. Requires formal itemized quotation for grant compliance (${isUK ? 'Innovate UK / SEIS' : 'LEO Priming / Feasibility Appendix C'}).`
  );

  const [workPackages, setWorkPackages] = useState<QuoteRfpWorkPackageItem[]>(() => {
    if (initialWorkPackages && initialWorkPackages.length > 0) {
      return initialWorkPackages.map((wp, idx) => ({
        id: wp.id || `wp_${idx + 1}`,
        name: wp.name || wp.title || `Work Package ${idx + 1}`,
        description: wp.description || wp.scope || '',
        targetDays: wp.targetDays || 14,
      }));
    }
    if (sourceModule === 'MOD_E_OPERATIONS' && initialEquipmentName) {
      return [
        {
          id: 'item_1',
          name: initialEquipmentName,
          description: 'Supplier itemized formal quote on company letterhead showing registration/VAT number, warranty, and lead time.',
          targetDays: 7,
        },
      ];
    }
    return [
      {
        id: 'wp_1',
        name: 'WP1: Core Architecture & Database Setup',
        description: 'Database schema, auth, hosting, and API scaffolding.',
        targetDays: 14,
      },
      {
        id: 'wp_2',
        name: 'WP2: Frontend UI & User Workflows',
        description: 'Interactive customer portal, responsive screens, and onboarding.',
        targetDays: 21,
      },
      {
        id: 'wp_3',
        name: 'WP3: Integration & End-to-End Testing',
        description: 'Payment gateways, third-party APIs, and security QA.',
        targetDays: 14,
      },
    ];
  });

  const [founderName, setFounderName] = useState(initialFounderContact?.name || '');
  const [founderEmail, setFounderEmail] = useState(initialFounderContact?.email || '');
  const [founderPhone, setFounderPhone] = useState(initialFounderContact?.phone || '');
  const [founderCompany, setFounderCompany] = useState(
    initialFounderContact?.companyName || planTitle
  );

  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [dispatchResult, setDispatchResult] = useState<{
    ok: boolean;
    partnerNames?: string[];
    error?: string;
  } | null>(null);

  // Reset category if default changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (sourceModule === 'MOD_E_OPERATIONS') {
      setRfpCategory('EQUIPMENT_SUPPLIER');
      if (initialEquipmentName) {
        setProjectTitle(`3 Quotes for ${initialEquipmentName}`);
      }
    } else {
      setRfpCategory(defaultCategory);
    }
  }, [sourceModule, defaultCategory, initialEquipmentName]);

  const handleAddWorkPackage = () => {
    const nextIdx = workPackages.length + 1;
    setWorkPackages([
      ...workPackages,
      {
        id: `wp_${nextIdx}`,
        name: `WP${nextIdx}: Work Package ${nextIdx}`,
        description: '',
        targetDays: 14,
      },
    ]);
  };

  const handleRemoveWorkPackage = (idx: number) => {
    setWorkPackages(workPackages.filter((_, i) => i !== idx));
  };

  const handleUpdateWp = (idx: number, field: keyof QuoteRfpWorkPackageItem, val: unknown) => {
    setWorkPackages((prev) =>
      prev.map((item, i) => (i === idx ? { ...item, [field]: val } : item))
    );
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!founderName.trim() || !founderEmail.trim()) {
      alert('Please provide your name and email address for supplier quote delivery.');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setDispatchResult(null);

    const res = await submitThreeQuoteRfpAction({
      planId,
      sourceModule,
      rfpCategory,
      projectTitle,
      budgetRange,
      targetDeliveryTimeline,
      scopeSummary,
      workPackages,
      founderContact: {
        name: founderName.trim(),
        email: founderEmail.trim(),
        phone: founderPhone.trim() || undefined,
        companyName: founderCompany.trim() || planTitle,
      },
      equipmentItemName: initialEquipmentName,
    });

    setIsSubmitting(false);

    if (res.ok) {
      setDispatchResult({
        ok: true,
        partnerNames: res.partnerNames,
      });
      if (onSuccess) {
        onSuccess();
      }
    } else {
      setDispatchResult({
        ok: false,
        error: res.error || 'Failed to dispatch quotation requests.',
      });
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-950/65 p-3 sm:p-4 backdrop-blur-xs">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-2xl max-h-[92vh] overflow-y-auto rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-2xl">
        {/* Modal Header */}
        <div className="sticky top-0 z-10 flex items-start justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-100 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-950 via-indigo-900 to-violet-900 px-6 py-4 text-white">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <span className="flex h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-indigo-500/30 text-white font-bold text-xs border border-indigo-400/40">
                ⚡
              </span>
              <Badge className="border-indigo-400/40 bg-indigo-500/30 text-[10px] text-indigo-100">
                {isUK ? '🇬🇧 UK Innovate & BBB Ready' : '🇮🇪 IE LEO Appendix C Ready'}
              </Badge>
              <Badge className="border-emerald-400/40 bg-emerald-500/30 text-[10px] text-emerald-100">
                Grant Compliant
              </Badge>
            </div>
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-white">
              3-Quote Concierge Marketplace
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-indigo-200/90 max-w-lg">
              {sourceModule === 'MOD_E_OPERATIONS'
                ? `State grant assessors (LEO / Enterprise Ireland / Innovate UK) mandate 3 written independent quotes. Our automated engine dispatches this brief to vetted suppliers.`
                : `Dispatches your Work Packages and technical requirements to vetted software studios. You will receive 3 standardized net ex-VAT quotes on company letterhead.`}
            </p>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="rounded-lg p-1.5 text-indigo-300 hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white transition"
          >
            <X className="h-5 w-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {dispatchResult?.ok ? (
          <div className="p-6 space-y-5 text-center">
            <div className="mx-auto flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-600">
              <CheckCircle2 className="h-8 w-8" />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">
                3-Quote Request Dispatched!
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 max-w-md mx-auto">
                We have notified our vetted partner network with secure Magic Links. A confirmation receipt has been sent to <strong>{founderEmail}</strong>.
              </p>
            </div>

            {dispatchResult.partnerNames && dispatchResult.partnerNames.length > 0 && (
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-indigo-100 bg-indigo-50/60 p-4 max-w-md mx-auto text-left">
                <div className="text-[11px] font-bold text-indigo-900 mb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Building2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-700" />
                  Invited Supplier Partners:
                </div>
                <ul className="space-y-1.5">
                  {dispatchResult.partnerNames.map((name, i) => (
                    <li key={i} className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
                      {name}
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 p-4 max-w-md mx-auto text-left text-xs text-slate-600 space-y-2">
              <div className="font-bold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <ShieldCheck className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600" />
                What happens next?
              </div>
              <p>
                1. Suppliers review your scope and upload official PDF quotes with net ex-VAT pricing.
              </p>
              <p>
                2. You receive an email alert the instant each quote lands.
              </p>
              <p>
                3. Received quotes automatically populate <strong>Module L Appendix C</strong> ready for your grant assessor.
              </p>
            </div>

            <Button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setDispatchResult(null);
                onClose();
              }}
              className="bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-700 text-xs px-6"
            >
              Done & Return to Workspace
            </Button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-6 space-y-5">
            {dispatchResult?.error && (
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 p-3.5 text-xs text-rose-800 flex items-start gap-2">
                <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-rose-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                <div>
                  <span className="font-bold">Error dispatching quotes: </span>
                  {dispatchResult.error}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Category Selector */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 mb-1.5">
                Supplier / Provider Category:
              </label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-4">
                {[
                  { id: 'DEV_AGENCY', label: 'Dev / Software Agency', icon: '💻' },
                  { id: 'ECOMMERCE_STUDIO', label: 'E-Commerce / Shopify', icon: '🛍️' },
                  { id: 'EQUIPMENT_SUPPLIER', label: 'Equipment & Machinery', icon: '⚙️' },
                  { id: 'PACKAGING_PRINTING', label: 'Packaging & Print', icon: '📦' },
                ].map((cat) => (
                  <button
                    key={cat.id}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setRfpCategory(cat.id as QuoteSupplierCategory)}
                    className={`rounded-lg border p-2 text-left text-xs transition ${
                      rfpCategory === cat.id
                        ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50 font-bold text-indigo-900 ring-2 ring-indigo-500/20'
                        : 'border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-700 hover:border-indigo-300'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="text-base">{cat.icon}</div>
                    <div className="mt-1 truncate font-semibold">{cat.label}</div>
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Project Title & Target Budget */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 mb-1">
                  Project / Equipment Title:
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={projectTitle}
                  onChange={(e) => setProjectTitle(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. V1 Mobile App MVP or 1325 CNC Router"
                  className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-base text-slate-900 focus:border-indigo-600 focus:outline-hidden sm:text-xs"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 mb-1">
                  Target Budget Range (Ex-VAT):
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={budgetRange}
                  onChange={(e) => setBudgetRange(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. €7,000 - €12,000 ex-VAT"
                  className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-base text-slate-900 focus:border-indigo-600 focus:outline-hidden sm:text-xs"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Target Delivery Timeline */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 mb-1">
                Target Timeline / Lead Time:
              </label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                {['2–4 weeks', '6–8 weeks', '3–4 months'].map((t) => (
                  <button
                    key={t}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setTargetDeliveryTimeline(t)}
                    className={`rounded-lg border px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-center transition ${
                      targetDeliveryTimeline === t
                        ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50 font-bold text-indigo-900'
                        : 'border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-700 hover:border-indigo-300'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {t}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Scope Summary */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 mb-1">
                Scope Summary & Technical Requirements:
              </label>
              <textarea
                rows={3}
                required
                value={scopeSummary}
                onChange={(e) => setScopeSummary(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Describe key features, technical requirements, materials, or required standards..."
                className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white p-3 text-base text-slate-900 focus:border-indigo-600 focus:outline-hidden sm:text-xs"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Work Packages / Line Items */}
            <div className="space-y-2.5">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
                  Itemized Work Packages / Procurement Schedule:
                </label>
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={handleAddWorkPackage}
                  className="h-6 border-indigo-200 text-[11px] text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-50"
                >
                  <Plus className="mr-1 h-3 w-3" />
                  Add Package / Item
                </Button>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                {workPackages.map((wp, idx) => (
                  <div
                    key={wp.id || idx}
                    className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 p-2.5"
                  >
                    <span className="rounded bg-indigo-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-indigo-800 shrink-0 mt-1">
                      {wp.name.split(':')[0] || `WP${idx + 1}`}
                    </span>
                    <div className="flex-1 space-y-1.5">
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={wp.name}
                        onChange={(e) => handleUpdateWp(idx, 'name', e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="Package title or item name"
                        className="w-full rounded border border-slate-300 bg-white px-2 py-1 text-base font-semibold text-slate-900 sm:text-xs"
                      />
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={wp.description}
                        onChange={(e) => handleUpdateWp(idx, 'description', e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="Deliverables or technical notes"
                        className="w-full rounded border border-slate-200 bg-white px-2 py-0.5 text-base text-slate-600 sm:text-[11px]"
                      />
                    </div>
                    {workPackages.length > 1 && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => handleRemoveWorkPackage(idx)}
                        className="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 p-1"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Founder Contact Information */}
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-indigo-100 bg-indigo-50/50 p-3.5 space-y-3">
              <div className="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-900 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <User className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-700" />
                Where should official quotes be delivered?
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2.5 sm:grid-cols-2">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    Founder Full Name:
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    value={founderName}
                    onChange={(e) => setFounderName(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. Sarah Conroy"
                    className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white px-2.5 py-1.5 text-base text-slate-900 sm:text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    Work / Official Email:
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="email"
                    required
                    value={founderEmail}
                    onChange={(e) => setFounderEmail(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="sarah@preflight.com"
                    className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white px-2.5 py-1.5 text-base text-slate-900 sm:text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    Company / Trading Name:
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    value={founderCompany}
                    onChange={(e) => setFounderCompany(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder={planTitle}
                    className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white px-2.5 py-1.5 text-base text-slate-900 sm:text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    Phone (Optional):
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="tel"
                    value={founderPhone}
                    onChange={(e) => setFounderPhone(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="+353 87 123 4567"
                    className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white px-2.5 py-1.5 text-base text-slate-900 sm:text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Bottom Actions */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-slate-200 pt-4">
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="ghost"
                size="sm"
                onClick={onClose}
                className="text-xs text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100"
              >
                Cancel
              </Button>

              <Button
                type="submit"
                size="sm"
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                className="bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-700 text-xs px-5 shadow-xs"
              >
                {isSubmitting ? (
                  <>
                    <Loader2 className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                    Dispatching 3-Quote Request...
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Zap className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    Dispatch 3-Quote Request
                  </>
                )}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Embedded Tracker Card for Module D and Module E.
 * Fetches and displays quotes received from suppliers with PDF links and grant compliance status.
 */
export function PlanQuotesTrackerCard({
  planId,
  baseCurrency = 'EUR',
  categoryFilter,
  onRequestNewQuotes,
}: {
  planId: string;
  baseCurrency?: string;
  categoryFilter?: QuoteSupplierCategory;
  onRequestNewQuotes?: () => void;
}) {
  const [rfps, setRfps] = useState<
    Array<{
      id: string;
      projectTitle: string;
      rfpCategory: string;
      budgetRange: string;
      targetTimeline: string;
      status: string;
      sourceModule: string;
      quotesReceivedCount: number;
      createdAt: string;
      responses: Array<{
        id: string;
        partnerId: string;
        partnerName: string;
        partnerLogo: string;
        status: string;
        quoteAmountNet?: string | null;
        quoteCurrency: string;
        estimatedWeeks?: number | null;
        quoteFileUrl?: string | null;
        quoteFileName?: string | null;
        quoteNotes?: string | null;
        submittedAt?: string | null;
      }>;
    }>
  >([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const loadQuotes = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    const res = await getPlanQuotesAction(planId);
    if (res.ok && res.rfps) {
      if (categoryFilter) {
        setRfps(res.rfps.filter((r) => r.rfpCategory === categoryFilter));
      } else {
        setRfps(res.rfps);
      }
    }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadQuotes();
  }, [planId, categoryFilter]);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-500">
        <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin text-indigo-600" />
        Checking active supplier quotes...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 bg-white shadow-xs overflow-hidden">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-indigo-100 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-50/70 via-white to-indigo-50/30 px-4 py-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="flex h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-indigo-600 text-white font-bold text-xs">
            ⚡
          </span>
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
                Active 3-Quote Concierge RFPs ({rfps.length})
              </h4>
              <Badge variant="outline" className="border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 text-[10px] text-indigo-700">
                Grant Compliance Bench
              </Badge>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
              Quotes automatically attach to Module L Appendix C
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {onRequestNewQuotes && (
          <Button
            type="button"
            size="sm"
            onClick={onRequestNewQuotes}
            className="h-7 border border-indigo-300 bg-white text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-50 shadow-xs"
          >
            <Plus className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            Request 3 Quotes
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="p-4">
        {rfps.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="text-center py-5 space-y-2">
            <Building2 className="mx-auto h-8 w-8 text-slate-300" />
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-600">
              No active 3-Quote requests dispatched yet for this plan.
            </p>
            {onRequestNewQuotes && (
              <Button
                type="button"
                size="sm"
                onClick={onRequestNewQuotes}
                className="bg-indigo-600 text-white text-xs hover:bg-indigo-700"
              >
                <Zap className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Request 3 Quotes Now
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {rfps.map((rfp) => {
              const submittedResponses = rfp.responses.filter(
                (r) => r.status === 'QUOTE_SUBMITTED'
              );
              const isComplete = submittedResponses.length >= 3;

              return (
                <div
                  key={rfp.id}
                  className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/50 p-3.5 space-y-3"
                >
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-2 border-b border-slate-200/80 pb-2.5">
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="font-bold text-xs text-slate-900">
                          {rfp.projectTitle}
                        </span>
                        <Badge
                          variant="outline"
                          className={
                            isComplete
                              ? 'border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 text-[10px] text-emerald-800'
                              : 'border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 text-[10px] text-amber-800'
                          }
                        >
                          {isComplete
                            ? '✅ 3/3 Quotes Received (Appendix C Ready)'
                            : `⏳ ${submittedResponses.length}/3 Quotes Received`}
                        </Badge>
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                        Budget: {rfp.budgetRange} • Target: {rfp.targetTimeline} • Dispatched{' '}
                        {new Date(rfp.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-indigo-700">
                      RFP ID: {rfp.id.slice(0, 8)}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Supplier Response Grid */}
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2.5 sm:grid-cols-3">
                    {rfp.responses.map((resp) => {
                      const hasQuote = resp.status === 'QUOTE_SUBMITTED';

                      return (
                        <div
                          key={resp.id}
                          className={`rounded-lg border p-3 flex flex-col justify-between transition ${
                            hasQuote
                              ? 'border-emerald-200 bg-white shadow-xs'
                              : 'border-slate-200 bg-white/70'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <div>
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5">
                              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 truncate">
                                {resp.partnerLogo} {resp.partnerName}
                              </span>
                              <Badge
                                variant="outline"
                                className={`text-[9px] ${
                                  hasQuote
                                    ? 'border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800'
                                    : 'border-slate-300 bg-slate-50 text-slate-600'
                                }`}
                              >
                                {hasQuote ? 'Quote In' : 'Pending'}
                              </Badge>
                            </div>

                            {hasQuote ? (
                              <div className="mt-2 space-y-1">
                                <div className="text-base font-extrabold text-emerald-700">
                                  {formatPlanCurrency(
                                    Number(resp.quoteAmountNet) || 0,
                                    resp.quoteCurrency || baseCurrency
                                  )}{' '}
                                  <span className="text-[10px] font-medium text-slate-500">
                                    ex-VAT
                                  </span>
                                </div>
                                {resp.estimatedWeeks && (
                                  <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-600 flex items-center gap-1">
                                    <Clock className="h-3 w-3 text-slate-400" />
                                    Est. {resp.estimatedWeeks} weeks
                                  </div>
                                )}
                                {resp.quoteNotes && (
                                  <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 italic line-clamp-2 mt-1">
                                    &ldquo;{resp.quoteNotes}&rdquo;
                                  </p>
                                )}
                              </div>
                            ) : (
                              <div className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-slate-400 italic flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                <Clock className="h-3 w-3 text-slate-300" />
                                Supplier reviewing brief...
                              </div>
                            )}
                          </div>

                          {hasQuote && resp.quoteFileUrl && (
                            <div className="mt-3 border-t border-slate-100 pt-2">
                              <a
                                href={resp.quoteFileUrl}
                                target="_blank"
                                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-800"
                              >
                                <FileText className="h-3 w-3" />
                                View Quote PDF
                                <ExternalLink className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
                              </a>
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

          assessorQuestionPrompt:
            'Detail the innovation, technical merit, and proprietary nature of the product/service. Explain why this solution is superior to incumbent alternatives.',
          scoringWeightPercent: 20,
          wordLimit: 450,
          sourceModules: ['MOD_D_PRODUCT_BUILD'],
          compiledResponseText: `The enterprise delivers an innovative solution built upon modern technical architecture.   const [sections, setSections] = useState<ModuleLCompiledSectionItem[]>(

      ? savedCompiler.sections
      : defaultSectionsForMode
  );

  const [executiveHook, setExecutiveHook] = useState<string>(
    savedCompiler?.executiveHookStatement ||

      `"${plan.title}" is an evidence-backed ${plan.industryCategory || 'venture'} engineered to satisfy statutory underwriting requirements in ${plan.hqCountryCode || 'Ireland'}. Cross-module validation confirms empirical customer willingness-to-pay, defensible unit economics, and verified additionality with zero unmitigated displacement.`
  );

  const [aiTip, setAiTip] = useState<string>(
    savedCompiler?.aiAssessorTip ||
      (isUK
        ? 'Assessor tip: Innovate UK and Start Up Loan underwriters cross-reference each written claim against your financial model. Ensure your words and numbers tell the exact same story.'
        : 'Assessor tip: LEO and Enterprise Ireland evaluators place highest weighting on Export Potential, Promoter Track Record, and Additionality. Keep your evidence quantitative and concise.')
  );

  // Toggle section accordion
  const toggleSection = (id: string) => {
    setExpandedSectionIds((prev) =>
      prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((x) => x !== id) : [...prev, id]
    );
  };

  const updateSectionText = (id: string, text: string) => {
    setSections((prev) =>
      prev.map((s) =>
        s.id === id ? { ...s, compiledResponseText: text, isCustomEdited: true } : s
      )
    );
  };

  // Re-synthesize an individual section with AI
  const handleCompileSectionAi = async (section: ModuleLCompiledSectionItem) => {
    setCompilingSectionId(section.id);
    try {
      const planContextSummary = `Title: ${plan.title}. Industry: ${plan.industryCategory}. HQ: ${plan.hqCountryCode}. One-Liner: ${plan.oneLinerSummary}. Export: ${plan.exportPotential}. Audit Score: ${plan.moduleLData?.step2Audit?.overallAuditScore ?? 88}/100. Defense: ${executiveHook}`;

      const res = await generateModuleLStep3SectionAction({
        planId: plan.id,
        planTitle: plan.title,
        hqCountryCode: plan.hqCountryCode || 'IE',
        baseCurrency: plan.baseCurrency || 'EUR',
        compilerMode,
        industryCategory: plan.industryCategory,
        sectionNumber: section.sectionNumber,
        sectionTitle: section.title,
        assessorPrompt: section.assessorQuestionPrompt,
        scoringWeightPercent: section.scoringWeightPercent,
        wordLimit: section.wordLimit,
        sourceModules: section.sourceModules,
        currentResponseText: section.compiledResponseText,
        planContextSummary,
      });

      if (res.compiledResponseText) {
        updateSectionText(section.id, res.compiledResponseText);
        if (res.aiAssessorTip) setAiTip(res.aiAssessorTip);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error compiling section with AI:', err);
    } finally {
      setCompilingSectionId(null);
    }
  };

  // Global compile all sections with AI
  const handleCompileAllSectionsAi = async () => {
    setIsCompilingAll(true);
    try {
      const planContextSummary = `Title: ${plan.title}. Industry: ${plan.industryCategory}. HQ: ${plan.hqCountryCode}. One-Liner: ${plan.oneLinerSummary}. Export: ${plan.exportPotential}. Defense: ${executiveHook}`;

      const updatedSections: ModuleLCompiledSectionItem[] = [];
      for (const section of sections) {
        const res = await generateModuleLStep3SectionAction({
          planId: plan.id,
          planTitle: plan.title,
          hqCountryCode: plan.hqCountryCode || 'IE',
          baseCurrency: plan.baseCurrency || 'EUR',
          compilerMode,
          industryCategory: plan.industryCategory,
          sectionNumber: section.sectionNumber,
          sectionTitle: section.title,
          assessorPrompt: section.assessorQuestionPrompt,
          scoringWeightPercent: section.scoringWeightPercent,
          wordLimit: section.wordLimit,
          sourceModules: section.sourceModules,
          currentResponseText: section.compiledResponseText,
          planContextSummary,
        });

        updatedSections.push({
          ...section,
          compiledResponseText: res.compiledResponseText || section.compiledResponseText,
          isCustomEdited: true,
        });
      }
      setSections(updatedSections);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error compiling all sections:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsCompilingAll(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopySection = (id: string, text: string) => {

    setCopiedSectionId(id);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedSectionId(null), 2000);

      modeCompiledFor: compilerMode,
      sections,
      executiveHookStatement: executiveHook,
      aiAssessorTip: aiTip,
      aiEngineUsed: 'gemini-2.5-flash',
      lastSavedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    try {
      if (onSaveStep3Compiler) {
        await onSaveStep3Compiler(payload, 60);
      }
      onContinueToStep4();
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  // Aggregate word count
  const totalWords = useMemo(() => {
    return sections.reduce((acc, s) => {
      const words = (s.compiledResponseText || '').trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
      return acc + words;
    }, 0);
  }, [sections]);

  const totalWordLimit = useMemo(() => {
    return sections.reduce((acc, s) => acc + (s.wordLimit || 400), 0);
  }, [sections]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* 4-Layer Support Strip (GEMINI.md Rule 1.1) */}

          <Badge variant="outline" className="border-slate-300 bg-white text-[11px] text-slate-700">
            {sections.length} Questions / Sections
          </Badge>
          <Badge
            variant="outline"
            className={`text-[11px] font-semibold ${

        <div className="rounded-lg border border-indigo-100 bg-indigo-50/70 p-3.5 text-xs text-indigo-900 space-y-1.5">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between font-bold text-indigo-950">
            <span>Why Section-by-Section Narrative Compilation Matters</span>
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveWhyCard(false)}
              className="text-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-600"
            >
              ✕
            </button>
          </div>
          <p>
            Grant committees and underwriter review panels do not read freeform essays. They score submissions against strict, numbered rubrics with explicit criteria and strict word limits. This step translates all your hard work from Modules A–K into the exact structure and tone expected by {isUK ? 'Innovate UK or Start Up Loan underwriters' : 'Local Enterprise Offices (LEO) and Enterprise Ireland'}.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Example Drawer */}
      {activeExampleCard && (
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-emerald-100 bg-emerald-50/70 p-3.5 text-xs text-emerald-950 space-y-1.5">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between font-bold text-emerald-950">
            <span>Example of Evidence-Led Assessor Copy</span>
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveExampleCard(false)}
              className="text-emerald-400 hover:text-emerald-600"
            >
              ✕
            </button>
          </div>
          <p className="font-mono text-[11px] bg-white/70 p-2.5 rounded border border-emerald-200">
            &quot;Rather than claiming &apos;we have huge market demand,&apos; write: &apos;Across 48 primary Mom-Test discovery interviews conducted in Module C, 73% of target operations managers reported €1,200/mo in recurring manual reporting waste, confirming willingness to pay for our €199/mo tier with zero local displacement.&apos;&quot;
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Assessor Tip Callout */}
      {aiTip && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50/60 p-4 shadow-xs">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
            <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <div className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-amber-900">
              <span className="font-bold">Assessor Scoring Guidance: </span>
              {aiTip}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Executive Hook / Opening Mandate */}
