        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Award className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-600" />
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">
              Master Executive Hook &amp; Opening Defense Statement
            </h3>
            <Badge variant="outline" className="border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 text-[10px] text-indigo-700">
              Header Statement
            </Badge>
          </div>
          <Button
            type="button"
            size="sm"
            variant="ghost"
            onClick={() =>
              setExecutiveHook(
                plan.moduleLData?.step2Audit?.preFlightDefenseSummary ||
                  `"${plan.title}" is an evidence-backed ${plan.industryCategory || 'venture'} engineered to satisfy statutory underwriting requirements in ${plan.hqCountryCode || 'Ireland'}. Cross-module validation confirms empirical customer willingness-to-pay, defensible unit economics, and verified additionality with zero unmitigated displacement.`
              )
            }
            className="h-7 text-xs text-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-50"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="mr-1 h-3 w-3" />
            Reset to Pre-Flight Defense
          </Button>
        </div>

        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
          This overarching narrative anchors your formal submission, bridging the cross-module audit from Step 2 into your official application overview:
        </p>

        <textarea
          rows={3}
          value={executiveHook}
          onChange={(e) => setExecutiveHook(e.target.value)}
          disabled={isVaultReadonly}
          className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/50 p-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-slate-800 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:bg-white focus:outline-hidden"
          placeholder="Enter master executive statement..."
        />
      </div>

      {/* Section-by-Section Interactive Accordion Cards */}
      <div className="space-y-4">

          const isOverLimit = wordCount > limit;
          const isNearLimit = wordCount >= limit * 0.9 && !isOverLimit;

                  <div className="flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-200 text-xs font-bold text-indigo-700">
                    {section.sectionNumber}
                  </div>

                      <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 truncate">
                        {section.title}
                      </h4>

                          variant="outline"
                          className="border-indigo-100 bg-indigo-50/50 text-indigo-700 text-[10px] font-medium"

                          Weight: {section.scoringWeightPercent}%
                        </Badge>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-slate-500 line-clamp-1">
                      {section.assessorQuestionPrompt}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                  <Badge
                    variant="outline"
                    className={`text-[10px] font-medium ${
                      isOverLimit
                        ? 'border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 text-rose-700'
                        : isNearLimit
                          ? 'border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-700'
                          : 'border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-slate-600'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {wordCount} / {limit}w
                  </Badge>

                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    size="sm"
                    variant="ghost"
                    className="h-7 w-7 p-0 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600"
                  >
                    {isExpanded ? (
                      <ChevronUp className="h-4 w-4" />
                    ) : (
                      <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4" />
                    )}
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Expanded Content Area */}
              {isExpanded && (
                <div className="border-t border-slate-100 p-4 pt-3 space-y-3 bg-slate-50/30">
                  {/* Assessor Rubric Callout */}
                  <div className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200/80 bg-white p-3 text-xs text-slate-600 space-y-1">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-slate-700 font-semibold">
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <Scale className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-600" />

                        Compiled Official Response
                      </label>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <Button
                          type="button"
                          size="sm"
                          variant="ghost"
                          onClick={() =>
                            handleCopySection(section.id, section.compiledResponseText)
                          }
                          className="h-6 px-2 text-[11px] text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100"
                        >
                          {copiedSectionId === section.id ? (
                            <>
                              <Check className="mr-1 h-3 w-3 text-emerald-600" />
                              Copied
                            </>
                          ) : (
                            <>
                              <Copy className="mr-1 h-3 w-3" />
                              Copy Text
                            </>
                          )}
                        </Button>

                        <Button
                          type="button"
                          size="sm"
                          variant="outline"
                          onClick={() => handleCompileSectionAi(section)}
                          disabled={isCompiling || isVaultReadonly}
                          className="h-6 border-violet-200 bg-violet-50 text-[11px] font-semibold text-violet-700 hover:bg-violet-100"
                        >
                          <Sparkles className="mr-1 h-3 w-3 text-violet-600" />
                          {isCompiling ? 'Polishing...' : 'AI Polish for Assessor'}
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <textarea
                      rows={6}
                      value={section.compiledResponseText}
                      onChange={(e) => updateSectionText(section.id, e.target.value)}
                      disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                      className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white p-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-slate-900 shadow-2xs focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-hidden"
                      placeholder="Write or refine the compiled answer for this section..."
                    />

                    {isOverLimit && (
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-600 flex items-center gap-1 font-medium">
                        <AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0" />
                        Warning: This section is {wordCount - limit} words over the {limit}
                        -word official limit. Trim text or use &apos;AI Polish for Assessor&apos; to condense.
                      </p>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Bottom Step Action Toolbar (GEMINI.md Rule 1.1) */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-slate-200 pt-5">
        <Button
          type="button"
          size="sm"
          variant="outline"
          onClick={onBackToStep2}
          className="text-xs text-slate-700"
        >
          <ArrowLeft className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          Back to Step 2 (Contradiction Audit)
        </Button>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {onParkQuestionInSession && (
            <Button
              type="button"
              size="sm"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => {
                const question = prompt(
                  'Park an open question or assumption for your grant narrative:'
                );
                if (question && question.trim()) {
                  onParkQuestionInSession(question.trim());
                }
              }}
              className="text-xs text-slate-600 border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50"
            >
              <BookmarkPlus className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              Park an Open Question
            </Button>
          )}

          <Button
            type="button"
            size="sm"
            onClick={handleSaveAndContinue}
            disabled={isSaving || isVaultReadonly}
            className="bg-indigo-600 text-xs font-semibold text-white hover:bg-indigo-700"
          >
            {isSaving ? 'Saving Sections...' : 'Save & Continue to Step 4'}
            <ArrowRight className="ml-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

  type ActiveStartupPlan,
  type CapitalStackPresetType,
  type CapitalAllocationTierItem,
  type ModuleKStep2CapitalStackSavedData,
} from '@/lib/auth/session-store';
import { SUPPORTED_GRANT_PROGRAMS } from '@/lib/grants/module-k-grant-audit';
import { getPlanTrackCapabilities } from '@/lib/localization';
import { generateModuleKCapitalStackNarrativeAction } from '@/app/actions/module-k';

export interface ModuleKCapitalStackStepProps {
  plan: ActiveStartupPlan;
  isVaultReadonly?: boolean;
  onSaveStep2?: (data: ModuleKStep2CapitalStackSavedData, progress?: number) => Promise<void> | void;
  onBackToStep1?: () => void;
  onContinueToNextStep?: () => void;
}

export function ModuleKCapitalStackStep({
  plan,
  isVaultReadonly,
  onSaveStep2,
  onBackToStep1,
  onContinueToNextStep,
}: ModuleKCapitalStackStepProps) {
  const trackCaps = getPlanTrackCapabilities(
    plan.hqCountryCode,
    plan.fundingTrackMode
  );
  const isUK = trackCaps.countryCode === 'GB';
  const isIreland = trackCaps.countryCode === 'IE';
  const isGrantsEnabled = trackCaps.isGrantsEnabled;
  const currencyCode =
    plan.baseCurrency || (isUK ? 'GBP' : isIreland ? 'EUR' : 'USD');
  const currencySymbol =
    currencyCode === 'GBP'
      ? '£'
      : currencyCode === 'EUR'
        ? '€'
        : currencyCode === 'AUD'
          ? 'A$'
          : currencyCode === 'CAD'
            ? 'C$'
            : '$';

  // Selected grant from Step 1 or fallback
  const selectedGrantKey =
    plan.moduleKData?.step1Audit?.selectedGrantKey ||
    (isUK ? 'GB_BBB_START_UP_LOAN' : 'IE_LEO_PRIMING');
  const targetGrantDef = SUPPORTED_GRANT_PROGRAMS[selectedGrantKey];

  // Derive target funding gap from Module J or default reasonable baseline
  const baselineGapFromModJ =
    plan.moduleJData?.step3CashflowGap?.fundingSources?.reduce(
      (acc, s) => acc + (Number(s.amount) || 0),
      0
    ) || (isUK ? 50000 : 60000);

  const existingStep2 = plan.moduleKData?.step2CapitalStack;

  const [totalTargetFundingGap, setTotalTargetFundingGap] = useState<number>(
    existingStep2?.totalTargetFundingGap || baselineGapFromModJ
  );

  const [activePreset, setActivePreset] = useState<CapitalStackPresetType>(
    existingStep2?.presetUsed || 'BALANCED_GRANT_PLUS_FOUNDER_SAVINGS'
  );

  // Initialize funding allocation lines
  const initialSources: CapitalAllocationTierItem[] = useMemo(() => {
    if (existingStep2?.fundingSources && existingStep2.fundingSources.length > 0) {
      return existingStep2.fundingSources;
    }

    const gap = baselineGapFromModJ;
    if (!isGrantsEnabled) {
      const founderAlloc = Math.round(gap * 0.4);
      const bankOrRbfAlloc = Math.round(gap * 0.3);
      const angelAlloc = Math.max(0, gap - founderAlloc - bankOrRbfAlloc);
      return [
        {
          id: 'tier_founder_cash',
          sourceKey: 'FOUNDER_SAVINGS_EQUITY',
          label: 'Founder Savings & Early Customer Pre-Sales',
          amount: founderAlloc,
          percentageOfGap: Math.round((founderAlloc / gap) * 100),
          isDilutive: false,
          description: 'Non-dilutive founder capital and early customer deposits.',
        },
        {
          id: 'tier_loan_or_debt',
          sourceKey: 'GOV_BACKED_LOAN',
          label: `Commercial Bank / Term Loan (${trackCaps.exampleBanksLabel.split(',')[0]})`,
          amount: bankOrRbfAlloc,
          percentageOfGap: Math.round((bankOrRbfAlloc / gap) * 100),
          isDilutive: false,
          description: 'Working capital credit line or revenue-based financing.',
        },
        {
          id: 'tier_angel_equity',
          sourceKey: 'ANGEL_INVESTOR_EQUITY',
          label: 'Angel Syndicate / Pre-Seed SAFE Round',
          amount: angelAlloc,
          percentageOfGap: Math.round((angelAlloc / gap) * 100),
          isDilutive: true,
          description: 'Strategic angel or pre-seed equity capital to accelerate growth.',
        },
      ];
    }

    const grantMax = targetGrantDef?.maxAmountNumeric || (isUK ? 25000 : 40000);
    const grantAlloc = Math.min(gap * 0.5, grantMax);
    const founderAlloc = Math.round(gap * 0.35);
    const loanOrAngelAlloc = Math.max(0, gap - grantAlloc - founderAlloc);

    return [
      {
        id: 'tier_founder_cash',
        sourceKey: 'FOUNDER_SAVINGS_EQUITY',
        label: 'Founder Savings & Skin-in-the-Game',
        amount: founderAlloc,
        percentageOfGap: Math.round((founderAlloc / gap) * 100),
        isDilutive: false,
        description: 'Personal matching funds satisfying state grant co-funding requirements.',
      },
      {
        id: 'tier_primary_grant',
        sourceKey: 'PRIMARY_GRANT',
        label: targetGrantDef?.name || (isUK ? 'Innovate UK Grant' : 'LEO Priming Grant'),
        amount: grantAlloc,
        percentageOfGap: Math.round((grantAlloc / gap) * 100),
        isDilutive: false,
        description: `${targetGrantDef?.fundingBadge || 'Non-Dilutive Cash Grant'} (${targetGrantDef?.matchRatePercent || 50}% co-funding).`,
      },
      {
        id: 'tier_loan_or_debt',
        sourceKey: 'GOV_BACKED_LOAN',
        label: isUK ? 'British Business Bank Start Up Loan' : 'Microfinance Ireland (MFI) Loan',
        amount: loanOrAngelAlloc,
        percentageOfGap: Math.round((loanOrAngelAlloc / gap) * 100),
        isDilutive: false,
        description: 'Unsecured government-backed lending bridge at fixed interest.',
      },
    ];
  }, [existingStep2, baselineGapFromModJ, targetGrantDef, isUK, isGrantsEnabled, trackCaps.exampleBanksLabel]);

  const [aiAssessorTip, setAiAssessorTip] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [aiEngineUsed, setAiEngineUsed] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Synchronize totals & metrics
  const totalAllocated = useMemo(() => {
    return fundingSources.reduce((acc, s) => acc + (Number(s.amount) || 0), 0);
  }, [fundingSources]);

  const skinInTheGame = useMemo(() => {
    const founderLine = fundingSources.find((s) => s.sourceKey === 'FOUNDER_SAVINGS_EQUITY');
    return founderLine ? Number(founderLine.amount) || 0 : 0;
  }, [fundingSources]);

  const skinInTheGamePercent = useMemo(() => {
    if (totalTargetFundingGap <= 0) return 0;
    return Math.round((skinInTheGame / totalTargetFundingGap) * 100);
  }, [skinInTheGame, totalTargetFundingGap]);

  const totalGrants = useMemo(() => {
    return fundingSources

      .reduce((acc, s) => acc + (Number(s.amount) || 0), 0);
  }, [fundingSources]);

  const totalLoans = useMemo(() => {
    return fundingSources
      .filter((s) => s.sourceKey === 'GOV_BACKED_LOAN')
      .reduce((acc, s) => acc + (Number(s.amount) || 0), 0);
  }, [fundingSources]);

  const totalAngel = useMemo(() => {
    return fundingSources
      .filter((s) => s.sourceKey === 'ANGEL_INVESTOR_EQUITY')
      .reduce((acc, s) => acc + (Number(s.amount) || 0), 0);
  }, [fundingSources]);

  // Projected Equity Dilution (assuming typical £/€300k–€750k post-money early valuation)
  const projectedEquityDilution = useMemo(() => {
    if (totalAngel <= 0) return 0;
    const assumedValuation = 500000;
    return Math.min(25, Math.round((totalAngel / assumedValuation) * 100));
  }, [totalAngel]);

  // Assessor Soundness Score (0-100)
  const assessorSoundnessScore = useMemo(() => {

    if (skinInTheGamePercent >= 25 && skinInTheGamePercent <= 60) score += 25;

    // Difference between target gap and total allocated
    const diff = Math.abs(totalTargetFundingGap - totalAllocated);

      setFundingSources([
        {
          id: 'tier_founder_cash',
          sourceKey: 'FOUNDER_SAVINGS_EQUITY',
          label: 'Founder Seed Capital',
          amount: founderAmt,
          percentageOfGap: Math.round((founderAmt / gap) * 100),
          isDilutive: false,
          description: 'Modest founder cash injection to meet minimum grant co-funding requirements.',
        },
        {
          id: 'tier_primary_grant',
          sourceKey: 'PRIMARY_GRANT',
          label: targetGrantDef?.name || 'Primary Government Grant',
          amount: grantAmt,
          percentageOfGap: Math.round((grantAmt / gap) * 100),
          isDilutive: false,
          description: 'Non-dilutive grant drawdown on vouched milestones.',
        },
        {
          id: 'tier_loan_or_debt',
          sourceKey: 'GOV_BACKED_LOAN',
          label: isUK ? 'British Business Bank Start Up Loan' : 'Microfinance Ireland (MFI) Loan',
          amount: loanAmt,
          percentageOfGap: Math.round((loanAmt / gap) * 100),
          isDilutive: false,
          description: 'Fixed 6% government-backed debt preserving complete founder equity.',

    } else if (preset === 'ANGEL_MATCH_ACCELERATOR') {
      const angelAmt = Math.round(gap * 0.45);

        {
          id: 'tier_primary_grant',
          sourceKey: 'PRIMARY_GRANT',
          label: targetGrantDef?.name || 'Primary Government Grant',
          amount: grantAmt,
          percentageOfGap: Math.round((grantAmt / gap) * 100),
          isDilutive: false,
          description: 'State co-funding backing private angel round.',
        },
        {
          id: 'tier_angel_equity',
          sourceKey: 'ANGEL_INVESTOR_EQUITY',
          label: isUK ? 'SEIS Angel Round (50% Tax Relief)' : 'EII / Angel Seed Investment',
          amount: angelAmt,
          percentageOfGap: Math.round((angelAmt / gap) * 100),
          isDilutive: true,
          equityDilutionPercent: 8,
          description: 'Private angel investor capital accelerated by state investor tax relief.',
        },
      ]);
    }
  };

  const handleGenerateAiNarrative = async () => {
    if (isVaultReadonly || isGeneratingAi) return;
    setIsGeneratingAi(true);
    try {
      const breakdown = fundingSources.map((s) => ({
        label: s.label,
        amount: Number(s.amount) || 0,
        percentage:
          totalTargetFundingGap > 0
            ? Math.round(((Number(s.amount) || 0) / totalTargetFundingGap) * 100)
            : 0,
      }));

      const res = await generateModuleKCapitalStackNarrativeAction({
        planId: plan.id,
        planTitle: plan.title,
        industryCategory: plan.industryCategory || 'Startup',
        hqCountryCode: (plan.hqCountryCode as any) || 'IE',
        targetGrantName: targetGrantDef?.name || 'Primary State Grant',
        targetGrantAgency: targetGrantDef?.agency || 'State Enterprise Agency',
        totalTargetFundingGap,
        totalGrants,
        skinInTheGame,
        totalLoans,
        totalAngel,
        currencySymbol,
        grantMatchPercentage: targetGrantDef?.matchRatePercent || 50,
        strategyPreset: activePreset,
        sourcesBreakdown: breakdown,
      });

      if (res?.narrative) {
        setFundingStrategyNarrative(res.narrative);
        if (res.assessorStrategyTip) {
          setAiAssessorTip(res.assessorStrategyTip);
        }
        setAiEngineUsed(res.engineMode || 'gemini-2.5-flash');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[Module K] AI narrative generation failed:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsGeneratingAi(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSaveStep2 = async () => {
    if (isVaultReadonly) return;
    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      const payload: ModuleKStep2CapitalStackSavedData = {
        presetUsed: activePreset,
        totalTargetFundingGap,
        fundingSources,
        skinInTheGameCash: skinInTheGame,
        totalGrantsAllocated: totalGrants,
        totalLoansAllocated: totalLoans,
        totalAngelAllocated: totalAngel,
        skinInTheGamePercent,
        projectedEquityDilutionPercent: projectedEquityDilution,
        assessorSoundnessScore,
        fundingStrategyNarrative,
      };

      if (onSaveStep2) {
        await onSaveStep2(payload, 50);
      }
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* 4-Layer Support Strip: Why & Example */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 pt-1">
        <Button
          type="button"
          size="sm"
          variant="outline"
          onClick={() => setActiveWhyCard((prev) => !prev)}
          className="h-7 border-indigo-200 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-50"
        >
          <HelpCircle className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          Why Are We Asking This?
        </Button>
        <Button
          type="button"
          size="sm"
          variant="outline"

        >
          <Lightbulb className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          Show Me an Assessor Example
        </Button>
        <Button
          type="button"
          size="sm"
          variant="outline"
          onClick={handleGenerateAiNarrative}
          disabled={isGeneratingAi || isVaultReadonly}
          className="h-7 border-violet-200 bg-violet-50/60 text-[11px] font-medium text-violet-700 hover:bg-violet-100"
        >
          <Sparkles className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-violet-600" />
          {isGeneratingAi ? 'Synthesizing with AI...' : 'Auto-Generate Narrative with AI'}
        </Button>
      </div>

      {activeWhyCard && (
        <div className="relative rounded-lg border border-indigo-100 bg-indigo-50/70 p-3.5 text-xs text-indigo-900">
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveWhyCard(false)}
            className="absolute right-2 top-2 text-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-600"
          >
            ✕
          </button>
          <p className="font-semibold text-indigo-950">Why Capital Stacking Decides Grant Approval:</p>
          <p className="mt-1 leading-relaxed">
            Government grant assessors (LEO, Enterprise Ireland, Innovate UK) do not fund 100% of a company.
            They operate on strict <strong>co-funding ratios</strong> (usually 50% or 70%). If your application does not
            clearly demonstrate where the remaining 50% of the money will come from (founder savings, low-interest startup loan,
            or angel investment), your grant will be rejected on "unviable match funding." Step 2 mathematically locks your matching stack.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {activeExampleCard && (
        <div className="relative rounded-lg border border-emerald-100 bg-emerald-50/70 p-3.5 text-xs text-emerald-950">
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveExampleCard(false)}
            className="absolute right-2 top-2 text-emerald-400 hover:text-emerald-600"
          >
            ✕
          </button>
          <p className="font-semibold text-emerald-950">Real Underwriter Capital Stack Breakdown:</p>
          <p className="mt-1 leading-relaxed">
            “For an €80,000 first-year budget: LEO Priming Grant provides €40,000 (50% non-dilutive). The founder provides €15,000

            zero equity dilution, passing all assessor match tests.”
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* 1. TOP SECTION: CAPITAL STACK DIAGNOSTIC SCORECARD                          */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      <Card className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 bg-gradient-to-b from-slate-50/80 via-white to-slate-50/40 p-5 shadow-xs">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="flex h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-emerald-600 text-xs font-bold text-white">
                K2
              </span>
              <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
                Capital Stack &amp; Skin-in-the-Game Blend
              </h3>
              <Badge variant="outline" className="border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-[10px] font-semibold text-emerald-700">
                Co-Funding Architect
              </Badge>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 max-w-2xl">
              Target Funding Gap inherited from Module J:{' '}
              <strong className="text-slate-900">
                {currencySymbol}
                {totalTargetFundingGap.toLocaleString()}
              </strong>
              . Match government grants with personal skin-in-the-game and loans.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Metric Badges Cluster */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-3.5 shadow-xs shrink-0">

              Underwriter Strategy &amp; Matching Funds Narrative
            </label>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
              Feeds directly into Module L Appendices A &amp; B, explaining to grant assessors how your co-funding capital will be drawn down safely without cashflow defaults.
            </p>
          </div>
          <Button
            type="button"
            size="sm"
            variant="outline"
            onClick={handleGenerateAiNarrative}
            disabled={isGeneratingAi || isVaultReadonly}
            className="h-7 border-violet-200 bg-violet-50 text-[11px] font-semibold text-violet-700 hover:bg-violet-100"
          >
            <Sparkles className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-violet-600" />
            {isGeneratingAi ? 'Synthesizing...' : 'Calibrate Narrative with AI'}

        </div>

        <textarea
          value={fundingStrategyNarrative}

          placeholder={`e.g., The total project development cost of ${currencySymbol}${totalTargetFundingGap.toLocaleString()} will be co-funded via ${targetGrantDef?.name || 'LEO Priming Grant'} (${currencySymbol}${totalGrants.toLocaleString()}), backed by ${currencySymbol}${skinInTheGame.toLocaleString()} in committed founder personal savings and an approved government-backed loan. Bank statements evidencing matching funds are attached.`}
          className="flex min-h-[90px] w-full rounded-md border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-900 shadow-xs placeholder:text-slate-400 focus-visible:outline-hidden focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 resize-y"
          disabled={isVaultReadonly}
        />

        {aiAssessorTip && (
          <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-amber-200/80 bg-amber-50/70 p-3 text-[11px] text-amber-900">
            <Info className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-amber-600 mt-0.5" />
            <div className="space-y-0.5">
              <span className="font-semibold text-amber-950">Grant Underwriter Insider Tip:</span>
              <p className="leading-relaxed text-amber-900/90">{aiAssessorTip}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* 5. BOTTOM TOOLBAR: SAVE & ADVANCE                                         */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-slate-100 pt-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {onBackToStep1 && (
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={onBackToStep1}
              className="text-xs font-semibold"
            >
              ← Back to Step 1 Audit
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            onClick={handleSaveStep2}
            disabled={isSaving || isVaultReadonly}
            className="text-xs font-semibold"
          >
            {isSaving ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Capital Stack'}
          </Button>

          {onContinueToNextStep && (
            <Button
              type="button"
              size="sm"
              onClick={async () => {
                await handleSaveStep2();
                onContinueToNextStep();
              }}
              className="bg-indigo-600 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-indigo-700"
            >
              Continue to Step 3: Reimbursement Bridge
              <ArrowRight className="ml-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  FileCheck2,
  CheckCircle2,
  Sparkles,
  ArrowRight,
  ArrowLeft,

  Printer,
  Check,

import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';

import type {
  ActiveStartupPlan,
  ModuleKStep5FundingBriefSavedData,
  GrantRoadmapPhaseItem,
} from '@/lib/auth/session-store';
import {
  buildModuleKStandaloneHtmlDocument,
  type ModuleKBriefExportData,
} from '@/lib/export/module-k-brief';
import {
  generateModuleKStep5FundingBriefAction,
  saveModuleKStep5FundingBriefAction,
} from '@/app/actions/module-k';
import { getPlanTrackCapabilities } from '@/lib/localization';

interface ModuleKFundingBriefStepProps {
  plan: ActiveStartupPlan;
  isVaultReadonly?: boolean;
  onSaveStep5: (data: ModuleKStep5FundingBriefSavedData, progress?: number) => Promise<void> | void;
  onBackToStep4: () => void;
  onContinueToModuleL: () => void;
}

export function ModuleKFundingBriefStep({
  plan,
  isVaultReadonly = false,
  onSaveStep5,
  onBackToStep4,
  onContinueToModuleL,
}: ModuleKFundingBriefStepProps) {
  const trackCaps = getPlanTrackCapabilities(plan.hqCountryCode, plan.fundingTrackMode);
  const { isIreland, isUK, isGrantsEnabled } = trackCaps;
  const currencySymbol =
    plan.baseCurrency === 'GBP'
      ? '£'
      : plan.baseCurrency === 'USD' || plan.baseCurrency === 'CAD' || plan.baseCurrency === 'AUD'
        ? '$'
        : '€';
  const grantAgency = !isGrantsEnabled
    ? 'Commercial Lenders & Institutional Investors'
    : isUK
      ? 'Innovate UK & British Business Bank'
      : 'Local Enterprise Office (LEO) & Enterprise Ireland';

  // Step 1 to 4 derived data
  const step1 = plan.moduleKData?.step1Audit;
  const step2 = plan.moduleKData?.step2CapitalStack;
  const step3 = plan.moduleKData?.step3ReimbursementBridge;
  const step4 = plan.moduleKData?.step4TaxRelief;
  const savedStep5 = plan.moduleKData?.step5FundingBrief;

  // Local state
  const [activeWhyCard, setActiveWhyCard] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [activeExampleCard, setActiveExampleCard] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isGeneratingAi, setIsGeneratingAi] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [copiedBrief, setCopiedBrief] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [executiveSummary, setExecutiveSummary] = useState<string>(
    savedStep5?.executiveSummary ||
      (isGrantsEnabled
        ? `${plan.title} has assembled an integrated non-dilutive capital stack engineered to withstand ${grantAgency} underwriting scrutiny. By pairing confirmed founder equity with public grant awards, working capital is protected against in-arrears drawdown timing lag.`
        : `${plan.title} has architected a balanced commercial capital stack designed to fund early product execution, initial customer acquisition, and working capital runway through to cashflow breakeven.`)
  );

  const defaultRoadmap: GrantRoadmapPhaseItem[] = !isGrantsEnabled
    ? [
        {
          phaseNumber: 1,
          grantOrFundingName: 'Founder Capital & Pre-Launch Customer Deposits',
          agency: 'Internal Equity & Early Commercial Validation',
          amountFormatted: `${currencySymbol}10,000 – ${currencySymbol}25,000`,
          timingTrigger: 'Immediate (Months 1–3) — MVP Build & Pilot Validation',
          prerequisites: 'Entity incorporation, business bank account, and validated customer problem.',
          unlocksNext: 'Proves early unit economics and commercial demand without premature equity dilution.',
        },
        {
          phaseNumber: 2,
          grantOrFundingName: 'Commercial Working Capital / Startup Term Facility',
          agency: 'Commercial Bank / Revenue-Based Financing',
          amountFormatted: `${currencySymbol}25,000 – ${currencySymbol}100,000`,
          timingTrigger: 'Months 4–9 — Early Revenue & Repeatable Sales',
          prerequisites: '3–6 months of operating history, unit economics ledger, and 36-month cashflow projection.',
          unlocksNext: 'Funds inventory, marketing scale, and key operational hires with non-dilutive credit.',
        },
        {
          phaseNumber: 3,
          grantOrFundingName: 'Angel Syndicate / Pre-Seed Equity Round',
          agency: 'Private Angel Investors / Seed Micro-VCs',
          amountFormatted: `${currencySymbol}100,000 – ${currencySymbol}500,000`,
          timingTrigger: 'Months 9–18 — Commercial Scale-Up & Market Expansion',
          prerequisites: 'Proven CAC-to-LTV payback, clean cap table, and investor-ready business plan.',
          unlocksNext: 'Accelerates multi-market expansion and institutional Series A readiness.',
        },
      ]
    : isUK
      ? [
          {
            phaseNumber: 1,
            grantOrFundingName: 'British Business Bank Start Up Loan',
            agency: 'British Business Bank',
            amountFormatted: `Up to ${currencySymbol}25,000 (per founder)`,
            timingTrigger: 'Immediate (Months 1–3) — Pre-Trading / MVP Stage',
            prerequisites: 'Credit check, personal survival budget, and business plan outline.',
            unlocksNext: 'Injects unencumbered working capital to build MVP and self-fund early customer acquisition.',
          },
          {
            phaseNumber: 2,
            grantOrFundingName: 'Innovate UK Smart Grant / Growth Hub Match',
            agency: 'Innovate UK / Regional Growth Hub',
            amountFormatted: `${currencySymbol}50,000 – ${currencySymbol}250,000 (70% co-funded)`,
            timingTrigger: 'Months 4–9 — Post-MVP Commercial Validation',
            prerequisites: 'Prototype proof of concept, Freedom to Operate (FTO), and 30% matching cash.',
            unlocksNext: 'Funds deep technical R&D and work packages (WP1–WP4) without founder dilution.',
          },
          {
            phaseNumber: 3,
            grantOrFundingName: 'HMRC SEIS Advance Assurance & Angel Syndicate',
            agency: 'HM Revenue & Customs (HMRC)',
            amountFormatted: `Up to ${currencySymbol}250,000 (50% Investor Tax Relief)`,
            timingTrigger: 'Months 9–15 — Seed Commercial Scale-Up',
            prerequisites: 'HMRC Advance Assurance approval, gross assets < £350k, qualifying trading activity.',
            unlocksNext: 'Catalyzes private angel capital with 50% tax write-offs to bridge into Series A.',
          },
        ]
      : [
          {
            phaseNumber: 1,
            grantOrFundingName: 'LEO Feasibility Study Grant / Grow Digital Voucher',
            agency: 'Local Enterprise Office (LEO Ireland)',
            amountFormatted: `Up to ${currencySymbol}15,000 (Feasibility) + ${currencySymbol}5,000 (Digital)`,
            timingTrigger: 'Immediate (Months 1–3) — Concept & Prototype Validation',
            prerequisites: 'CRO company registration, tax clearance certificate, 50% founder matching cash.',
            unlocksNext: 'De-risks prototype and market viability to qualify for LEO Priming or Enterprise Ireland.',
          },
          {
            phaseNumber: 2,
            grantOrFundingName: 'LEO Priming Grant',
            agency: 'Local Enterprise Office (LEO Ireland)',
            amountFormatted: `Up to ${currencySymbol}80,000 (50% match, max €150k in Gaeltacht/BMW)`,
            timingTrigger: 'Months 4–12 — Early Commercial Trading & Hiring',
            prerequisites: 'Trading under 18 months, internationally traded or high-potential service, 3 supplier quotes.',
            unlocksNext: 'Subsidizes first 2–4 full-time PAYE hires, marketing expansion, and capital expenditure.',
          },
          {
            phaseNumber: 3,
            grantOrFundingName: 'Enterprise Ireland Pre-Seed Start Fund (PSSF) / Revenue SURE',
            agency: 'Enterprise Ireland / Irish Revenue Commissioners',
            amountFormatted: `${currencySymbol}50,000 – ${currencySymbol}100,000 (CLN) + PAYE Refund`,
            timingTrigger: 'Months 12–24 — Export Scaling & Seed Acceleration',
            prerequisites: 'HPSU export commitment, 10+ jobs target within 3 years, founder prior PAYE history.',
            unlocksNext: 'Institutional-grade validation unlocking follow-on Seed VC and European Horizon grants.',
          },
        ];

  const [fundingRoadmap, setFundingRoadmap] = useState<GrantRoadmapPhaseItem[]>(
    savedStep5?.fundingRoadmap && savedStep5.fundingRoadmap.length > 0
      ? savedStep5.fundingRoadmap
      : defaultRoadmap
  );

  const [assessorReadinessScore, setAssessorReadinessScore] = useState<number>(
    savedStep5?.assessorReadinessScore ??
      Math.min(95, Math.max(50, (step1?.overallAssessorReadinessScore || 75) + (step2?.skinInTheGameCash ? 10 : 0)))
  );

  const [underwriterContradictionFlags, setUnderwriterContradictionFlags] = useState<string[]>(
    savedStep5?.underwriterContradictionFlags ||
      (isGrantsEnabled
        ? [
            step3 && step3.liquiditySafetySurplusOrDeficit < 0
              ? `⚠️ Working Capital Deficit: Arrears float exposes a ${currencySymbol}${Math.abs(step3.liquiditySafetySurplusOrDeficit).toLocaleString()} liquidity trough before grant drawdown dispatches.`
              : `✅ Working Capital Buffer: Confirmed liquidity buffer insulates payroll against standard 8-to-16 week claim audit lag.`,
            step2 && step2.skinInTheGameCash > 0
              ? `✅ Skin-in-the-Game: Verified founder cash equity satisfies the 50% matching ratio expectation.`
              : `⚠️ Founder Equity: Zero skin-in-the-game cash declared; evaluators require verifiable matching proof.`,
            step4 && step4.advanceAssuranceStatus === 'NOT_STARTED'
              ? `💡 Advance Assurance Pending: File tax relief application early to de-risk angel investor commitments.`
              : `✅ Tax Relief Clearance: Angel incentives structured to accelerate private match fundraising.`,
          ]
        : [
            step2 && step2.skinInTheGameCash > 0
              ? `✅ Founder Skin-in-the-Game: Verified founder capital contribution (${currencySymbol}${step2.skinInTheGameCash.toLocaleString()}) demonstrates strong alignment to lenders and investors.`
              : `⚠️ Founder Capital Commitment: Consider documenting a baseline founder equity contribution to strengthen bank and investor confidence.`,
            `✅ Working Capital Runway: Capital stack is calibrated against your Module J 36-month cashflow trough.`,
            `✅ Milestone-Driven Deployment: Capital tranches are tied directly to Module D product delivery and Module H revenue breakeven.`,
          ])
  );

  const [recommendedActionChecklist, setRecommendedActionChecklist] = useState<string[]>(
    savedStep5?.recommendedActionChecklist ||
      (isGrantsEnabled
        ? [
            'Collate 3 formal supplier quotes for all capital assets & dev line items (mandatory for voucher/grant claims).',
            `File pre-application enquiry with your regional development executive (${isUK ? 'Innovate UK KTN / Growth Hub' : 'Local Enterprise Office Business Advisor'}).`,
            'Submit formal Advance Assurance or tax relief certification pack to lock in private co-funding interest.',
            'Verify business bank account has separate earmarked ledger line for the mandatory matching funds ratio.',
          ]
        : [
            'Verify corporate entity registration and dedicated business bank account setup in Module G.',
            'Reconcile total target capital stack against the 36-month cashflow trough in Module J.',
            'Prepare vendor and development cost benchmarks from Module D & Module E for investor/lender due diligence.',
            'Compile the Executive Business Plan & Financial Pack in Module L for prospective lenders or angel investors.',
          ])
  );

  const [moduleLGrantMode, setModuleLGrantMode] = useState<
    'IE_LEO' | 'UK_INNOVATE_UK' | 'UK_START_UP_LOANS' | 'HMRC_SEIS' | 'STANDARD'
  >(
    !isGrantsEnabled
      ? 'STANDARD'
      : savedStep5?.moduleLGrantMode ||
          (isUK
            ? step1?.selectedGrantKey === 'GB_BBB_START_UP_LOAN'
              ? 'UK_START_UP_LOANS'
              : step1?.selectedGrantKey === 'GB_HMRC_SEIS_ASSURANCE'
                ? 'HMRC_SEIS'
                : 'UK_INNOVATE_UK'
            : 'IE_LEO')
  );

  const [aiAssessorTip, setAiAssessorTip] = useState<string>(
    savedStep5?.aiAssessorTip ||
      (isGrantsEnabled
        ? 'Evaluator Golden Rule: Grant committees never fund ideas—they fund specific, time-bounded work packages executed by credible operators. Ensure every pound/euro in Module K matches line-by-line with Module D work packages and Module J overheads.'
        : 'Investor & Lender Golden Rule: Underwriters never fund generic projections—they fund specific, milestone-bound execution plans backed by validated unit economics. Ensure your capital stack in Module K matches your Module D build roadmap and Module J cashflow trough.')
  );

  const handleGenerateAi = async () => {
    if (isVaultReadonly || isGeneratingAi) return;
    setIsGeneratingAi(true);
    try {
      const res = await generateModuleKStep5FundingBriefAction({
        planId: plan.id,
        planTitle: plan.title,
        industryCategory: plan.industryCategory || 'Startup',
        hqCountryCode: (plan.hqCountryCode as any) || 'IE',
        baseCurrency: plan.baseCurrency,
        step1Audit: step1
          ? {
              selectedGrantKey: step1.selectedGrantKey,
              overallAssessorReadinessScore: step1.overallAssessorReadinessScore,
            }
          : undefined,
        step2CapitalStack: step2
          ? {
              totalTargetFundingGap: step2.totalTargetFundingGap,
              skinInTheGameCash: step2.skinInTheGameCash,
              fundingSources: step2.fundingSources.map((s) => ({
                sourceKey: s.sourceKey,
                label: s.label,
                amount: s.amount,
                percentageOfGap: s.percentageOfGap,
              })),
            }
          : undefined,
        step3Bridge: step3
          ? {
              grantEligibleVouchedBudget: step3.grantEligibleVouchedBudget,
              expectedGrantDrawdownAmount: step3.expectedGrantDrawdownAmount,
              estimatedClaimTurnaroundWeeks: step3.estimatedClaimTurnaroundWeeks,
              actualConfirmedBridgeLiquidity: step3.actualConfirmedBridgeLiquidity,
              liquiditySafetySurplusOrDeficit: step3.liquiditySafetySurplusOrDeficit,
              bridgeStrategy: step3.bridgeStrategy,
            }
          : undefined,
        step4TaxRelief: step4
          ? {
              primaryTaxScheme: step4.primaryTaxScheme,
              targetReliefRaiseAmount: step4.targetReliefRaiseAmount,
              advanceAssuranceStatus: step4.advanceAssuranceStatus,
              estimatedInvestorTaxSavings: step4.estimatedInvestorTaxSavings,
              founderEstimatedPayeRefundForSure: step4.founderEstimatedPayeRefundForSure,
            }
          : undefined,
      });

      if (res?.executiveSummary) {
        setExecutiveSummary(res.executiveSummary);
        if (res.fundingRoadmap && res.fundingRoadmap.length > 0) {
          setFundingRoadmap(res.fundingRoadmap);
        }
        setAssessorReadinessScore(res.assessorReadinessScore);
        setUnderwriterContradictionFlags(res.underwriterContradictionFlags);
        setRecommendedActionChecklist(res.recommendedActionChecklist);
        setModuleLGrantMode(res.moduleLGrantMode);
        if (res.assessorStrategyTip) {
          setAiAssessorTip(res.assessorStrategyTip);
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[Module K] AI Step 5 funding brief failed:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsGeneratingAi(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSaveStep5 = async () => {
    if (isVaultReadonly) return;
    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      const dataToSave: ModuleKStep5FundingBriefSavedData = {
        executiveSummary,
        fundingRoadmap,
        assessorReadinessScore,
        underwriterContradictionFlags,
        recommendedActionChecklist,
        moduleLGrantMode,
        aiAssessorTip,
        aiEngineUsed: 'gemini-2.5-flash',
        lastSavedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };

      if (onSaveStep5) {
        await onSaveStep5(dataToSave, 100);
      } else {
        await saveModuleKStep5FundingBriefAction({
          planId: plan.id,
          step5FundingBrief: dataToSave,
          completionPercentage: 100,
        });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[Module K] Save step 5 error:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopyBrief = () => {
    const textToCopy = `EXECUTIVE FUNDING STRATEGY DOSSIER: ${plan.title.toUpperCase()}
Jurisdiction: ${isUK ? 'United Kingdom' : 'Ireland'} (${plan.baseCurrency})
Overall Assessor Readiness Score: ${assessorReadinessScore}%

1. EXECUTIVE NARRATIVE:
${executiveSummary}

2. PHASED GRANT & FUNDING ROADMAP:
${fundingRoadmap.map((p) => `Phase ${p.phaseNumber}: ${p.grantOrFundingName} (${p.amountFormatted})\n  • Agency: ${p.agency}\n  • Timing: ${p.timingTrigger}\n  • Prerequisites: ${p.prerequisites}\n  • Unlocks: ${p.unlocksNext}`).join('\n')}

3. CAPITAL & CASHFLOW ARCHITECTURE:
- Target Runway: ${currencySymbol}${(step2?.totalTargetFundingGap || 0).toLocaleString()}
- Confirmed Founder Skin-in-the-Game: ${currencySymbol}${(step2?.skinInTheGameCash || 0).toLocaleString()}
- Non-Dilutive Grant Target: ${currencySymbol}${(step3?.expectedGrantDrawdownAmount || 0).toLocaleString()}
- Reimbursement Float Buffer: ${currencySymbol}${(step3?.actualConfirmedBridgeLiquidity || 0).toLocaleString()} (${step3?.bridgeStrategy || 'Staged Buffer'})
- Investor Tax Relief: ${step4?.primaryTaxScheme || 'State Tax Relief'} (${currencySymbol}${(step4?.targetReliefRaiseAmount || 0).toLocaleString()} target)

4. PRE-FLIGHT UNDERWRITER CONTRADICTION AUDIT:
${underwriterContradictionFlags.map((flag) => `• ${flag}`).join('\n')}

5. PRE-SUBMISSION ACTION CHECKLIST:
${recommendedActionChecklist.map((act) => `[ ] ${act}`).join('\n')}

Assessor Strategic Insight:
${aiAssessorTip}
`;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(textToCopy);
    setCopiedBrief(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedBrief(false), 2500);
  };

  const getExportData = (): ModuleKBriefExportData => ({
    planTitle: plan.title,
    founderName:
      plan.moduleFData?.promoterProfiles?.teamMembers?.[0]?.fullName || 'Founder',
    industryCategory: plan.industryCategory || 'Startup Venture',
    hqCountryCode: plan.hqCountryCode || 'IE',
    baseCurrency: plan.baseCurrency || 'EUR',
    brief: {
      assessorReadinessScore,
      executiveSummary,
      fundingRoadmap,
      underwriterContradictionFlags,
      recommendedActionChecklist,
      aiAssessorTip,
      moduleLGrantMode,
    },
    step1SelectedGrantName: step1?.selectedGrantKey?.replace(/_/g, ' '),
    step1ReadinessScore: step1?.overallAssessorReadinessScore,
    step2TotalGap: step2?.totalTargetFundingGap,
    step2SkinInTheGame: step2?.skinInTheGameCash,
    step3ReimbursementBuffer: step3?.actualConfirmedBridgeLiquidity,
    step3BridgeStrategy: step3?.bridgeStrategy,
    step4TaxScheme: step4?.primaryTaxScheme?.replace(/_/g, ' '),
    step4AdvanceStatus: step4?.advanceAssuranceStatus?.replace(/_/g, ' '),
  });

  const handleDownloadHtmlBrief = () => {
    const htmlContent = buildModuleKStandaloneHtmlDocument(getExportData());
    const blob = new Blob([htmlContent], { type: 'text/html;charset=utf-8' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    const safeSlug =
      plan.title
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
        .replace(/^-|-$/g, '') || 'funding-strategy';
    link.href = url;
    link.download = `${safeSlug}-executive-funding-strategy-brief.html`;
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const handlePrintPdfBrief = () => {
    const htmlContent = buildModuleKStandaloneHtmlDocument(getExportData());
    const printWindow = window.open('', '_blank', 'width=960,height=800');
    if (!printWindow) {
      handleDownloadHtmlBrief();
      return;
    }
    printWindow.document.open();
    printWindow.document.write(htmlContent);
    printWindow.document.close();
    printWindow.focus();
    setTimeout(() => {
      printWindow.print();
    }, 250);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      {/* 4-Layer Support Strip */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-100 pb-4">
        <Button
          type="button"
          size="sm"
          variant="outline"
          onClick={() => setActiveWhyCard((prev) => !prev)}
          className="h-7 border-indigo-200 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-50"
        >
          <HelpCircle className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          Why Are We Asking This?
        </Button>
        <Button
          type="button"
          size="sm"
          variant="outline"
          onClick={() => setActiveExampleCard((prev) => !prev)}
          className="h-7 border-emerald-200 text-[11px] font-medium text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-50"
        >
          <Lightbulb className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          Show Me an Example
        </Button>
        <Button
          type="button"
          size="sm"
          variant="outline"
          onClick={handleGenerateAi}
          disabled={isGeneratingAi || isVaultReadonly}
          className="h-7 border-violet-200 bg-violet-50/60 text-[11px] font-medium text-violet-700 hover:bg-violet-100"
        >
          <Sparkles className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-violet-600" />
          {isGeneratingAi ? 'Synthesizing Assessor Dossier...' : 'AI Pre-Flight Audit & Brief Synthesis'}
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Collapsible Micro-Coaching Drawers */}
      {activeWhyCard && (
        <div className="relative rounded-lg border border-indigo-100 bg-indigo-50/70 p-4 text-xs text-indigo-900 shadow-xs">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveWhyCard(false)}
            className="absolute right-2.5 top-2.5 text-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-700"
          >
            ✕
          </button>
          <p className="font-semibold text-indigo-950">Why an Executive Funding Dossier Matters:</p>
          <p className="mt-1 leading-relaxed">
            Public grant committees ({isUK ? 'Innovate UK assessors' : 'LEO evaluation committees'}) review dozens of applications in each batch. They do not have time to dig through fragmented tables to reconcile if your matching money is real, if your grant reimbursement float is funded, or if your private investors have tax assurance. This final brief combines all 4 previous steps into a clean, unassailable 1-page commercial dossier ready for Module L.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {activeExampleCard && (
        <div className="relative rounded-lg border border-emerald-100 bg-emerald-50/70 p-4 text-xs text-emerald-950 shadow-xs">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveExampleCard(false)}
            className="absolute right-2.5 top-2.5 text-emerald-500 hover:text-emerald-800"
          >
            ✕
          </button>
          <p className="font-semibold text-emerald-950">Example Assessor Strategy Brief:</p>
          <p className="mt-1 font-mono text-[11px] leading-relaxed">
            &quot;Acme AI secures {currencySymbol}60,000 in early runway via {currencySymbol}30,000 LEO Priming (50% match) paired with {currencySymbol}15,000 founder savings and {currencySymbol}15,000 Revenue SURE tax refund. In-arrears claim float (8 weeks) is bridged via 60-day vendor payment terms, protecting payroll and ensuring zero equity dilution at launch.&quot;
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Hero Diagnostic Grid */}
      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 bg-gradient-to-b from-slate-50/70 via-white to-slate-50/40 p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-xs space-y-5">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-200/60 text-indigo-700">
              <Scale className="h-4 w-4" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">
                Statutory Underwriting &amp; Capital Alignment Scorecard
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                Consolidated assessment synthesized from Steps 1–4 cross-checks.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <Badge
            className={
              assessorReadinessScore >= 80
                ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300'
                : assessorReadinessScore >= 60
                  ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border-amber-300'
                  : 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border-rose-300'
            }
          >
            {assessorReadinessScore >= 80 ? 'Committee Ready' : 'Optimization Required'}
          </Badge>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
          {/* Card 1: Assessor Score */}
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4.5 shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
                  Readiness Score
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-600">{assessorReadinessScore}%</span>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-2 text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900">
                {assessorReadinessScore}
                <span className="text-base font-normal text-slate-500"> / 100</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-3 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 border border-slate-100 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-600 truncate">
              {step1 ? `${step1.selectedGrantKey.replace(/_/g, ' ')}` : 'Target Grant Evaluated'}
            </div>
            <p className="mt-3 border-t border-slate-100 pt-2 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
              Based on official statutory evaluation guidelines.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Card 2: Total Target Runway */}
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4.5 shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
                  Target Capital Stack
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-600">Step 2</span>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-2 text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900">
                {currencySymbol}
                {(step2?.totalTargetFundingGap || 50000).toLocaleString()}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-3 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 border border-slate-100 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-600">
              Founder Cash: {currencySymbol}{(step2?.skinInTheGameCash || 0).toLocaleString()} (
              {step2 && step2.totalTargetFundingGap > 0
                ? Math.round((step2.skinInTheGameCash / step2.totalTargetFundingGap) * 100)
                : 0}
              %)
            </div>
            <p className="mt-3 border-t border-slate-100 pt-2 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
              Non-dilutive match ratio satisfied.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Card 3: Arrears Reimbursement Buffer */}
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4.5 shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
                  Arrears Float Buffer
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-violet-600">Step 3</span>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-2 text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900">
                {currencySymbol}
                {(step3?.actualConfirmedBridgeLiquidity || 0).toLocaleString()}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-3 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 border border-slate-100 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-600">
              {step3 && step3.liquiditySafetySurplusOrDeficit >= 0
                ? `Surplus: +${currencySymbol}${step3.liquiditySafetySurplusOrDeficit.toLocaleString()}`
                : `Deficit: -${currencySymbol}${Math.abs(step3?.liquiditySafetySurplusOrDeficit || 0).toLocaleString()}`}
            </div>
            <p className="mt-3 border-t border-slate-100 pt-2 text-[11px] text-slate-500 truncate">
              Strategy: {step3?.bridgeStrategy?.replace(/_/g, ' ') || 'Buffer & Terms'}
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Card 4: Investor Tax Catalyst */}
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4.5 shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
                  Angel Tax Catalyst
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-amber-600">Step 4</span>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-2 text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900">
                {currencySymbol}
                {(step4?.estimatedInvestorTaxSavings || 0).toLocaleString()}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-3 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 border border-slate-100 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-600 truncate">
              {step4 ? step4.primaryTaxScheme.replace(/_/g, ' ') : 'SEIS / SURE Relief'}
            </div>
            <p className="mt-3 border-t border-slate-100 pt-2 text-[11px] text-slate-500 truncate">
              Advance: {step4?.advanceAssuranceStatus?.replace(/_/g, ' ') || 'Pending'}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

            <ArrowRight className="ml-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
