                          ? 'Zero ad media burn; only grant-eligible software & content tools are exported to Module J financials.'
                          : 'Populates Module J operating expenses directly.'}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* ============================================================= */}
            {/* SECTION 3: AUDIT READINESS POSTURE SELECTOR                   */}
            {/* ============================================================= */}
            <div className="space-y-3 border-t border-indigo-100/80 pt-4">
              <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-1 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
                <label className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-800">
                  3. Marketing &amp; GTM Readiness Posture (Grant &amp; Investor Diligence)
                </label>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                  Includes &ldquo;Other&rdquo; custom posture option
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2.5 sm:grid-cols-2">
                {[
                  {
                    value: 'ORGANIC_FIRST_10_READY' as const,
                    label: 'Organic & First 10 Pipeline Ready',
                    badge: 'High Conviction',
                    subtitle: 'Strong warm pipeline and clear advisory outreach scripts ready to close initial paying pilot cohort without upfront ad burn.',
                  },
                  {
                    value: 'SCALABLE_HYBRID_FUNNEL' as const,
                    label: 'Scalable Hybrid Acquisition Funnel',
                    badge: 'Unit Economics Positive',
                    subtitle: 'Balanced organic and performance channels with healthy LTV:CAC (>3.0x) and sub-6-month payback timeline.',
                  },
                  {
                    value: 'BOOTSTRAPPED_ZERO_AD_SPEND' as const,
                    label: 'Bootstrapped / Zero Paid Ad Spend',
                    badge: 'Paid Ads Formally Excluded',
                    subtitle: 'Performance ads deemed uneconomic at current price point. Strategy focuses strictly on direct outreach, partnerships, and SEO.',
                  },
                  {
                    value: 'NEEDS_CONVERSION_TESTING' as const,
                    label: 'Conversion Testing & Lead Qualification Required',
                    badge: 'Top-of-Funnel Testing',
                    subtitle: 'Funnel mechanics are modeled, but visitor and lead conversion rates require real-world validation through initial pilot batch.',
                  },
                  {
                    value: 'OTHER' as const,
                    label: 'Other Commercial Posture',
                    badge: 'Custom Context',
                    subtitle: 'Institutional procurement, enterprise tender, partner referral program, or bespoke distribution model.',
                  },
                ].map((opt) => {
                  const isSelected = step5Data.marketingReadinessConfidence === opt.value;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={opt.value}
                      type="button"
                      disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                      onClick={() =>
                        setStep5Data((prev) => ({
                          ...prev,
                          marketingReadinessConfidence: opt.value,
                        }))
                      }
                      className={`flex flex-col justify-between rounded-xl border p-3 text-left transition ${
                        isSelected
                          ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50/70 ring-2 ring-indigo-600/20'
                          : 'border-slate-200 bg-white hover:border-indigo-200 hover:bg-slate-50/60'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
                            {opt.label}
                          </span>
                          <Badge
                            variant="outline"
                            className={
                              isSelected
                                ? 'border-indigo-300 bg-indigo-100 text-[10px] text-indigo-900 font-bold'
                                : 'border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-[10px] text-slate-600'
                            }
                          >
                            {opt.badge}
                          </Badge>
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-slate-600">
                          {opt.subtitle}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>

              {step5Data.marketingReadinessConfidence === 'OTHER' && (
                <div className="rounded-lg border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/40 p-3 space-y-1.5">
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-950">
                    Describe Your Custom Marketing Posture:
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                    value={step5Data.otherReadinessConfidenceText || ''}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setStep5Data((prev) => ({
                        ...prev,
                        otherReadinessConfidenceText: e.target.value,
                      }))
                    }
                    placeholder="e.g. Exclusive university distribution partnership or government procurement pilot..."
                    className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-base text-slate-900 sm:text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* ============================================================= */}
            {/* SECTION 4: CONSTRUCTIVE "THINGS TO CONSIDER" BLIND-SPOT AUDIT */}
            {/* ============================================================= */}
            <div className="space-y-3 border-t border-indigo-100/80 pt-4">
              <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-800">
                    4. Constructive &ldquo;Things to Consider&rdquo; Marketing Blind-Spot Review
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                    Channel vulnerabilities, payback risks, and assessor questions to address prior to grant and investor submission.
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    size="sm"
                    variant="outline"
                    disabled={isGeneratingAiBrief || isVaultReadonly}
                    onClick={handleGenerateAiMarketingBrief}
                    className="h-8 text-xs font-semibold border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/50 text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-100/80"
                  >
                    {isGeneratingAiBrief ? (
                      <>
                        <RefreshCw className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin text-indigo-600" />
                        Auditing Marketing Blind Spots...
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <Sparkles className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-600" />
                        Audit Marketing Blind Spots with AI
                      </>
                    )}
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    size="sm"
                    variant="outline"
                    disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                    onClick={handleAddCustomBlindSpot}
                    className="h-8 text-xs border-slate-300 text-slate-700"
                  >
                    <Plus className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    Add Consideration
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Blind Spot Cards List */}
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {step5Data.blindSpots.map((item, idx) => {
                  const isCritical = item.severity === 'CRITICAL';
                  const isWarning = item.severity === 'WARNING';

                  return (
                    <div
                      key={item.id}
                      className={`rounded-xl border p-3.5 transition ${
                        isCritical
                          ? 'border-rose-200 bg-rose-50/30'
                          : isWarning
                          ? 'border-amber-200 bg-amber-50/30'
                          : 'border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/30'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-md bg-slate-900 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-white">
                            Consideration #{idx + 1}
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">{item.title}</span>
                          <Badge
                            variant="outline"
                            className={`text-[10px] font-bold ${
                              isCritical
                                ? 'border-rose-300 bg-rose-100 text-rose-800'
                                : isWarning
                                ? 'border-amber-300 bg-amber-100 text-amber-800'
                                : 'border-indigo-300 bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800'
                            }`}
                          >
                            {item.severity}
                          </Badge>
                        </div>

                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <Button
                            type="button"
                            size="sm"
                            variant="ghost"
                            onClick={() => handleParkBlindSpotInOpenQuestions(item)}
                            className="h-7 text-[11px] text-slate-600 hover:text-indigo-600 hover:bg-slate-100"
                          >
                            Park in Open Questions
                          </Button>
                          <Button
                            type="button"
                            size="sm"
                            variant="ghost"
                            onClick={() =>
                              setStep5Data((prev) => ({
                                ...prev,
                                blindSpots: prev.blindSpots.filter((b) => b.id !== item.id),
                              }))
                            }
                            className="h-7 text-[11px] text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-700 leading-relaxed">
                        {item.explanation}
                      </p>

                      <div className="mt-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200/80 bg-white/80 p-2.5 text-xs">
                        <span className="font-semibold text-indigo-950">Recommended Action: </span>
                        <span className="text-slate-700">{item.suggestedAction}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* ============================================================= */}
            {/* SECTION 5: EXECUTIVE MARKETING DEFENSE NARRATIVE (3 PARAS)    */}
            {/* ============================================================= */}
            <div className="space-y-3 border-t border-indigo-100/80 pt-4">
              <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-800">
                    5. Executive Commercial Defense Narrative (3 Structured Paragraphs)
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                    Formal narrative covering brand positioning, First 10 conversion, and CAC/LTV unit economics defense for Module L grant appendices.
                  </p>
                </div>

                {/* Section 5 Action Toolbar: Generate with AI + Document Exports */}
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    size="sm"
                    variant="outline"
                    onClick={handleGenerateAiMarketingBrief}
                    disabled={isGeneratingAiBrief || isVaultReadonly}
                    className="h-7.5 border-violet-200 bg-violet-50/70 text-xs font-semibold text-violet-700 hover:bg-violet-100"
                  >
                    {isGeneratingAiBrief ? (
                      <>
                        <RefreshCw className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin text-violet-600" />
                        Generating Narrative...
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <Sparkles className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-violet-600" />
                        Generate with AI
                      </>
                    )}
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    size="sm"
                    variant="outline"
                    onClick={handlePrintModuleIBriefPdf}
                    className="h-7.5 border-indigo-200 bg-white text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-50"
                    title="Print or save PDF of this complete brief"
                  >
                    <Printer className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-600" />
                    Print / Save PDF
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    size="sm"
                    variant="outline"
                    onClick={handleDownloadModuleIBriefHtml}
                    className="h-7.5 border-slate-300 bg-white text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
                    title="Download standalone executive HTML document"
                  >
                    <Download className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-600" />
                    Download HTML
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Assessor Tip Callout */}
              {(aiBriefAssessorTip || step5Data.aiAssessorTip) && (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/60 p-3.5 text-xs text-indigo-950 flex items-start gap-2.5">
                  <Lightbulb className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                  <div>
                    <span className="font-bold text-indigo-900">Assessor Tip: </span>
                    <span className="text-slate-700">{aiBriefAssessorTip || step5Data.aiAssessorTip}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Acquisition Strategy & Reversible Paid Media Mode Toggle */}
              <div
                className={`rounded-xl border p-4 text-xs shadow-xs space-y-3 transition-all ${
                  isOptedOutOfPaid
                    ? 'border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50/90 text-emerald-950'
                    : 'border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-slate-800'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 min-w-0 flex-1">
                    {isOptedOutOfPaid ? (
                      <CheckCircle2 className="h-5 w-5 text-emerald-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                    ) : (
                      <Zap className="h-5 w-5 text-indigo-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                    )}
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="font-bold text-sm">
                          {isOptedOutOfPaid
                            ? 'Paid Media Opt-Out Active — 100% Organic & Outbound Acquisition Model'
                            : `Paid Advertising Active — Blended Acquisition Model (${step4Data.paidTrafficSharePercent}% Paid)`}
                        </span>
                        <Badge
                          className={`text-[10px] font-semibold ${
                            isOptedOutOfPaid
                              ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-900 border-emerald-300'
                              : 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-900 border-indigo-300'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {isOptedOutOfPaid ? '100% Organic Strategy' : 'Blended Paid & Organic'}
                        </Badge>
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-[11px] mt-1 leading-relaxed opacity-90">
                        {isOptedOutOfPaid
                          ? 'Performance ad spend is excluded from downstream financial overheads (Module J) to conserve cash and protect trading margins. Paragraph 3 below documents this capital-efficient defense for grant assessors and investors.'
                          : `Performance marketing clicks are active alongside founder-led outreach. You can toggle this off anytime to switch to a 100% organic, grant-safe model.`}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Reversible Toggle Switch & 2-Segment Control */}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                    <div className="inline-flex rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white p-1 shadow-xs">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                        onClick={() => handleTogglePaidAdsStrategy(true)}
                        className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${
                          !isOptedOutOfPaid
                            ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-2xs'
                            : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <Zap className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        Paid Active
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                        onClick={() => handleTogglePaidAdsStrategy(false)}
                        className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${
                          isOptedOutOfPaid
                            ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-2xs'
                            : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <ShieldCheck className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        Opt Out (Organic)
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Status Bar with AI Regeneration CTA */}
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-t border-slate-200/60 pt-2.5 text-[11px]">
                  <span className="text-slate-600">
                    {isOptedOutOfPaid
                      ? 'Paragraph 3 reflects your formal Year 1 paid advertising opt-out justification.'
                      : 'Paragraph 3 reflects your balanced paid performance + organic acquisition funnel.'}
                  </span>
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    size="sm"
                    variant="outline"
                    disabled={isGeneratingAiBrief || isVaultReadonly}
                    onClick={handleGenerateAiMarketingBrief}
                    className="h-7 text-xs border-indigo-200 bg-white font-medium text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-50"
                  >
                    <Sparkles className="mr-1.5 h-3 w-3 text-indigo-600" />
                    {isOptedOutOfPaid ? 'Regenerate Brief (Opt-Out Mode)' : 'Regenerate Brief (Blended Mode)'}
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <textarea
                  rows={9}
                  disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                  value={step5Data.executiveMarketingSummaryNarrative}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setStep5Data((prev) => ({
                      ...prev,
                      executiveMarketingSummaryNarrative: e.target.value,
                    }))
                  }
                  placeholder="Click 'Generate with AI' above or compose your 3 structured defense paragraphs..."
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-3 text-base sm:text-xs text-slate-800 leading-relaxed shadow-2xs focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                />
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span>
                      Directly populates Module L Go-To-Market section and LEO / Innovate UK Appendices.
                    </span>
                    {isOptedOutOfPaid ? (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          const isIE = (plan.hqCountryCode || 'IE') !== 'GB';
                          const optOutParagraph = `Commercial Viability & Paid Ads Opt-Out Defense: After evaluating direct customer acquisition unit economics, the venture has formally opted out of paid advertising for Year 1. Paid performance clicks at current price points risk negative contribution margins and are strictly ineligible under grant co-funding guidelines (${isIE ? 'LEO Feasibility/Priming' : 'Innovate UK / Start Up Loans'}). Consequently, ongoing ad spend is 100% excluded from Module J financial overheads, preserving runway and protecting trading cashflow. Customer acquisition is driven entirely by founder-led organic outreach, high-intent pilot conversion, strategic partner integrations, and compounding customer referrals. This reverse-engineered funnel comfortably supports our monthly target of ${step4Data.targetMonthlyNewCustomers} new paying customers while keeping weekly founder marketing commitment manageable at ~${step4LiveMetrics.weeklyFounderHours} hours/week alongside product development.`;

                          setStep5Data((prev) => {
                            const cur = prev.executiveMarketingSummaryNarrative.trim();
                            if (!cur) {
                              return { ...prev, executiveMarketingSummaryNarrative: optOutParagraph };
                            }
                            const parts = cur.split(/\n\n+/);
                            if (parts.length >= 3) {
                              parts[2] = optOutParagraph;
                              return { ...prev, executiveMarketingSummaryNarrative: parts.join('\n\n') };
                            }
                            return { ...prev, executiveMarketingSummaryNarrative: `${cur}\n\n${optOutParagraph}` };
                          });
                        }}
                        className="text-emerald-700 hover:text-emerald-800 font-semibold underline decoration-emerald-300"
                      >
                        Sync Opt-Out Defense into Paragraph 3
                      </button>
                    ) : (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          const activePaidParagraph = `Commercial Viability & Acquisition Strategy: Customer acquisition operates on a disciplined blended engine, pairing ${100 - step4Data.paidTrafficSharePercent}% founder-led organic outreach, customer referral loops, and strategic content with a controlled ${step4Data.paidTrafficSharePercent}% paid acquisition allocation. Paid ad spend is strictly monitored against our Pocket-Profit contribution margin, ensuring every marketing dollar invested generates a sustainable return and stays within healthy underwriting thresholds.`;

                          setStep5Data((prev) => {
                            const cur = prev.executiveMarketingSummaryNarrative.trim();
                            if (!cur) {
                              return { ...prev, executiveMarketingSummaryNarrative: activePaidParagraph };
                            }
                            const parts = cur.split(/\n\n+/);
                            if (parts.length >= 3) {
                              parts[2] = activePaidParagraph;
                              return { ...prev, executiveMarketingSummaryNarrative: parts.join('\n\n') };
                            }
                            return { ...prev, executiveMarketingSummaryNarrative: `${cur}\n\n${activePaidParagraph}` };
                          });
                        }}
                        className="text-indigo-700 hover:text-indigo-800 font-semibold underline decoration-indigo-300"
                      >
                        Sync Blended Paid Strategy into Paragraph 3
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <span>{step5Data.executiveMarketingSummaryNarrative.length} characters</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Save Overview Action */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-indigo-100/80 pt-4">
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => setOpenStep(4)}
                className="text-xs text-slate-600"
              >
                <ArrowLeft className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Back to Step 4 (Budget &amp; CAC)
              </Button>

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  size="sm"
                  variant="outline"
                  onClick={handleCopyMarkdownBrief}
                  className="h-8 text-xs border-indigo-200 bg-white text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-50 font-semibold"
                >
                  {copiedBrief ? (
                    <>
                      <Check className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                      Copied Dossier!
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <Copy className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      Copy Markdown Dossier
                    </>
                  )}
                </Button>

                <Button
                  type="button"
                  size="sm"
                  variant="outline"
                  onClick={handleDownloadModuleIBriefHtml}
                  className="h-8 text-xs border-slate-300 bg-white text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 font-semibold"
                  title="Download standalone executive HTML document"
                >
                  <Download className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-600" />
                  Download HTML
                </Button>

                <Button
                  type="button"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={handlePrintModuleIBriefPdf}
                  className="h-8 text-xs bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-700 font-semibold shadow-xs"
                  title="Open formatted printable Module I Executive Brief"
                >
                  <Printer className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  Print / Save as PDF
                </Button>

                {saveStatusStep5 === 'saved' && (
                  <span className="flex items-center text-xs font-medium text-emerald-600">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    Saved
                  </span>
                )}
                {saveStatusStep5 === 'error' && (
                  <span className="flex items-center text-xs font-medium text-rose-600">
                    <AlertTriangle className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    Save Failed
                  </span>
                )}

                <Button
                  type="button"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={handleSaveStep5}
                  disabled={saveStatusStep5 === 'saving' || isVaultReadonly}
                  className="bg-emerald-600 text-white hover:bg-emerald-700 text-xs font-semibold"
                >
                  {saveStatusStep5 === 'saving' ? (
                    <>
                      <RefreshCw className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                      Saving Brief...
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <CheckCircle2 className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      Save Marketing Brief (Complete Module I)
                    </>
                  )}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Conversion / Handoff CTA Bar into Module J */}
            {onContinueToModuleJ && (
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 px-4 py-3.5 text-white">
                <div className="text-xs min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-indigo-300">
                    Module I Complete! Go-To-Market strategy, First 10 Playbook, and acquisition unit economics verified for {planTitle}.
                  </span>{' '}
                  <span className="text-slate-300">
                    Ready to build your 3-year integrated financial model? Advance to Module J: Financial Projections &amp; Cashflow.
                  </span>
                </div>
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  size="sm"
                  disabled={isVaultReadonly || saveStatusStep5 === 'saving'}
                  onClick={async () => {
                    await handleSaveStep5();
                    onContinueToModuleJ();
                  }}
                  className="shrink-0 bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-500 text-xs font-semibold"
                >
                  Advance to Module J: Finance
                  <ArrowRight className="ml-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                </Button>
              </div>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

  AlertTriangle,
  HelpCircle,
  Lightbulb,
  Sparkles,
  ArrowRight,
  TrendingDown,
  TrendingUp,
  RotateCcw,
  Info,
  Calendar,
  CheckCircle2,
  DollarSign,
  Briefcase,
  Layers,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import {
  type ActiveStartupPlan,
  type ReimbursementBridgeStrategyType,
  type ModuleKStep3ReimbursementBridgeSavedData,
} from '@/lib/auth/session-store';
import { SUPPORTED_GRANT_PROGRAMS } from '@/lib/grants/module-k-grant-audit';
import { generateModuleKStep3ReimbursementBridgeAction } from '@/app/actions/module-k';

export interface ModuleKReimbursementBridgeStepProps {
  plan: ActiveStartupPlan;
  isVaultReadonly?: boolean;
  onSaveStep3?: (data: ModuleKStep3ReimbursementBridgeSavedData, progress?: number) => Promise<void> | void;
  onBackToStep2?: () => void;
  onContinueToNextStep?: () => void;
}

export function ModuleKReimbursementBridgeStep({
  plan,
  isVaultReadonly,
  onSaveStep3,
  onBackToStep2,
  onContinueToNextStep,
}: ModuleKReimbursementBridgeStepProps) {
  const isUK = plan.hqCountryCode === 'GB';
  const currencySymbol = isUK ? '£' : '€';

  // Inherit grant context from Step 1 or fallback
  const selectedGrantKey =
    plan.moduleKData?.step1Audit?.selectedGrantKey ||
    (isUK ? 'GB_BBB_START_UP_LOAN' : 'IE_LEO_PRIMING');
  const targetGrantDef = SUPPORTED_GRANT_PROGRAMS[selectedGrantKey];

  // Inherit total budget and grant allocation from Step 2
  const step2 = plan.moduleKData?.step2CapitalStack;
  const initialVouchedBudget =
    step2?.totalTargetFundingGap && step2.totalTargetFundingGap > 0
      ? step2.totalTargetFundingGap
      : 50000;
  const initialGrantDrawdown =
    step2?.totalGrantsAllocated && step2.totalGrantsAllocated > 0
      ? step2.totalGrantsAllocated
      : Math.round(initialVouchedBudget * 0.5);

  const existingStep3 = plan.moduleKData?.step3ReimbursementBridge;

  // Local state
  const [grantEligibleVouchedBudget, setGrantEligibleVouchedBudget] = useState<number>(
    existingStep3?.grantEligibleVouchedBudget || initialVouchedBudget
  );
  const [expectedGrantDrawdownAmount, setExpectedGrantDrawdownAmount] = useState<number>(
    existingStep3?.expectedGrantDrawdownAmount || initialGrantDrawdown
  );
  const [estimatedClaimTurnaroundWeeks, setEstimatedClaimTurnaroundWeeks] = useState<number>(
    existingStep3?.estimatedClaimTurnaroundWeeks || (isUK ? 10 : 12)
  );
  const [bridgeStrategy, setBridgeStrategy] = useState<ReimbursementBridgeStrategyType>(
    existingStep3?.bridgeStrategy || 'FOUNDER_DIRECTOR_LOAN_BUFFER'
  );
  const [otherBridgeStrategyText, setOtherBridgeStrategyText] = useState<string>(
    existingStep3?.otherBridgeStrategyText || ''
  );
  const [vendorPaymentTermsDays, setVendorPaymentTermsDays] = useState<30 | 60 | 90>(
    (existingStep3?.vendorPaymentTermsDays as 30 | 60 | 90) || 60
  );

  // Confirmed liquid capital available to bridge
  const defaultConfirmedBridge =
    step2?.skinInTheGameCash && step2.skinInTheGameCash > 0
      ? step2.skinInTheGameCash + (step2.totalLoansAllocated || 0)
      : Math.round(initialVouchedBudget * 0.5);

  const [actualConfirmedBridgeLiquidity, setActualConfirmedBridgeLiquidity] = useState<number>(
    existingStep3?.actualConfirmedBridgeLiquidity || defaultConfirmedBridge
  );
  const [bridgeRiskMitigationNarrative, setBridgeRiskMitigationNarrative] = useState<string>(
    existingStep3?.bridgeRiskMitigationNarrative || ''
  );
  const [aiAssessorTip, setAiAssessorTip] = useState<string | null>(
    existingStep3?.aiAssessorTip || null
  );

  const [activeWhyCard, setActiveWhyCard] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [activeExampleCard, setActiveExampleCard] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isGeneratingAi, setIsGeneratingAi] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Core Underwriting Calculations:
  // How much cash must be disbursed before grant reimbursement check clears?
  // If vendor terms are 60 days and turnaround is 12 weeks (~84 days), company floats invoices for ~24 days.
  // Peak liquidity required is the vouched milestone cost that must be paid upfront to get stamped receipt.
  const minimumLiquidityBufferRequired = useMemo(() => {
    // Under assessor guidelines, companies must clear 100% of the invoice before submitting claim
    // The peak cash required is at least the grant amount itself plus milestone operating buffer
    return Math.round(expectedGrantDrawdownAmount * 1.15);
  }, [expectedGrantDrawdownAmount]);

  const liquiditySafetySurplusOrDeficit = useMemo(() => {
    return actualConfirmedBridgeLiquidity - minimumLiquidityBufferRequired;
  }, [actualConfirmedBridgeLiquidity, minimumLiquidityBufferRequired]);

  const isAssessorLiquidityCompliant = liquiditySafetySurplusOrDeficit >= 0;

  // Timeline phases
  const claimLagDays = estimatedClaimTurnaroundWeeks * 7;
  const netFloatLagDays = Math.max(0, claimLagDays - vendorPaymentTermsDays);

  const handleGenerateAiNarrative = async () => {
    if (isVaultReadonly || isGeneratingAi) return;
    setIsGeneratingAi(true);
    try {
      const res = await generateModuleKStep3ReimbursementBridgeAction({
        planId: plan.id,
        planTitle: plan.title,
        industryCategory: plan.industryCategory || 'Startup',
        hqCountryCode: (plan.hqCountryCode as any) || 'IE',
        targetGrantName: targetGrantDef?.name || 'Primary State Grant',
        targetGrantAgency: targetGrantDef?.agency || 'State Enterprise Agency',
        grantEligibleVouchedBudget,
        expectedGrantDrawdownAmount,
        estimatedClaimTurnaroundWeeks,
        minimumLiquidityBufferRequired,
        actualConfirmedBridgeLiquidity,
        liquiditySafetySurplusOrDeficit,
        bridgeStrategy:
          bridgeStrategy === 'OTHER' ? otherBridgeStrategyText || 'Custom Bridge' : bridgeStrategy,
        vendorPaymentTermsDays,
        currencySymbol,
      });

      if (res?.narrative) {
        setBridgeRiskMitigationNarrative(res.narrative);
        if (res.assessorStrategyTip) {
          setAiAssessorTip(res.assessorStrategyTip);
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[Module K] AI Step 3 bridge narrative failed:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsGeneratingAi(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSaveStep3 = async () => {
    if (isVaultReadonly) return;
    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      const payload: ModuleKStep3ReimbursementBridgeSavedData = {
        grantEligibleVouchedBudget,
        expectedGrantDrawdownAmount,
        estimatedClaimTurnaroundWeeks,
        bridgeStrategy,
        otherBridgeStrategyText: bridgeStrategy === 'OTHER' ? otherBridgeStrategyText : undefined,
        minimumLiquidityBufferRequired,
        actualConfirmedBridgeLiquidity,
        liquiditySafetySurplusOrDeficit,
        isAssessorLiquidityCompliant,
        vendorPaymentTermsDays,
        bridgeRiskMitigationNarrative,
        aiAssessorTip: aiAssessorTip || undefined,
      };

      if (onSaveStep3) {
        await onSaveStep3(payload, 65);
      }
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* 4-Layer Support Strip: Why & Example */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 pt-1">
        <Button
          type="button"
          size="sm"
          variant="outline"
          onClick={() => setActiveWhyCard((prev) => !prev)}
          className="h-7 border-indigo-200 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-50"
        >
          <HelpCircle className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          Why Are We Asking This?
        </Button>
        <Button
          type="button"
          size="sm"
          variant="outline"
          onClick={() => setActiveExampleCard((prev) => !prev)}
          className="h-7 border-emerald-200 text-[11px] font-medium text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-50"
        >
          <Lightbulb className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          Show Me an Assessor Example
        </Button>
        <Button
          type="button"
          size="sm"
          variant="outline"
          onClick={handleGenerateAiNarrative}
          disabled={isGeneratingAi || isVaultReadonly}
          className="h-7 border-violet-200 bg-violet-50/60 text-[11px] font-medium text-violet-700 hover:bg-violet-100"
        >
          <Sparkles className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-violet-600" />
          {isGeneratingAi ? 'Synthesizing Bridge Plan...' : 'Auto-Generate Bridge Plan with AI'}
        </Button>
      </div>

      {activeWhyCard && (
        <div className="relative rounded-lg border border-indigo-100 bg-indigo-50/70 p-3.5 text-xs text-indigo-900">
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveWhyCard(false)}
            className="absolute right-2 top-2 text-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-600"
          >
            ✕
          </button>
          <p className="font-semibold text-indigo-950">
            The #1 Reason Funded Startups Fail: The Arrears Reimbursement Lag
          </p>
          <p className="mt-1 leading-relaxed">
            Government grants (LEO Ireland, Innovate UK, Scottish Enterprise) <strong>never pay upfront</strong>.
            You must first spend the money, wait for the supplier invoice to clear your bank account, submit paid bank statements,
            and wait <strong>60 to 120 days</strong> for the claim officer to verify and wire the reimbursement check.
            If you do not have a committed liquidity bridge, your startup will run out of cash and face insolvency while waiting for approved grant money.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {activeExampleCard && (
        <div className="relative rounded-lg border border-emerald-100 bg-emerald-50/70 p-3.5 text-xs text-emerald-950">
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveExampleCard(false)}
            className="absolute right-2 top-2 text-emerald-400 hover:text-emerald-600"
          >
            ✕
          </button>
          <p className="font-semibold text-emerald-950">Assessor Example: €40,000 LEO Priming Grant</p>
          <p className="mt-1 leading-relaxed">
            <strong>The Situation:</strong> A software startup is awarded a €40,000 LEO Priming Grant (50% match on an €80,000 project).
            <br />
            <strong>The Trap:</strong> In Month 3, they incur €40,000 in agency and developer invoices. To claim their €20,000 first tranche, they must prove the €40,000 left their bank account. If their bank balance only has €10,000, they cannot pay the developer, cannot produce cleared bank statements, and the claim is frozen.
            <br />
            <strong>The Solution:</strong> The founder pairs a €25,000 Microfinance Ireland (MFI) 6-month interest-only bridge with 60-day agency payment terms. Invoices are paid, bank statement clears, LEO reimburses €20,000 within 8 weeks, and the MFI bridge is repaid.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* 1. VISUAL REIMBURSEMENT TIMING TIMELINE (THE CASH CHASM)                   */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      <Card className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-xs">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-100 pb-3">
          <div className="space-y-0.5">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
              <Clock className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-600" />
              Grant Reimbursement Timing Timeline ({claimLagDays} Days Cash Lag)
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
              Visualizing the cash-float gap between incurring milestone invoices and receiving cleared state grant funds.
            </p>
          </div>
          <Badge
            variant="outline"
            className={
              isAssessorLiquidityCompliant
                ? 'border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 text-[11px]'
                : 'border-rose-300 bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 text-[11px]'
            }
          >
            {isAssessorLiquidityCompliant ? '✓ Liquidity Bridge Solvent' : '⚠ Cash Pinch-Point Risk'}
          </Badge>
        </div>

        {/* 4-Stage Horizontal Flow */}
        <div className="mt-6 grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-4">
          <div className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-3 space-y-1">
            <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">Phase 1: Day 0</div>
            <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">Incur Milestone Cost</div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-600">
              Developer/Vendor starts work package. Invoices issued on {vendorPaymentTermsDays}-day terms.
            </p>
            <div className="pt-1 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800">
              Total: {currencySymbol}{grantEligibleVouchedBudget.toLocaleString()}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="rounded-lg border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50/60 p-3 space-y-1">
            <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-700">
              Phase 2: Day {vendorPaymentTermsDays}
            </div>
            <div className="text-xs font-bold text-amber-950">Peak Cash Drawdown</div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-amber-900">
              Invoice due. Must clear your bank account in full to generate vouched proof for the grant officer.
            </p>
            <div className="pt-1 text-xs font-bold text-amber-800">
              Outflow: {currencySymbol}{minimumLiquidityBufferRequired.toLocaleString()}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="rounded-lg border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/60 p-3 space-y-1">
            <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-700">
              Phase 3: Days {vendorPaymentTermsDays}–{claimLagDays}
            </div>
            <div className="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-950">Assessor Review Float</div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-indigo-900">
              {targetGrantDef?.agency || 'Agency'} reviews tax clearance, timesheets, and cleared bank lines.
            </p>
            <div className="pt-1 text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-800">
              Wait: ~{netFloatLagDays} Days Float
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="rounded-lg border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50/60 p-3 space-y-1">
            <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-700">
              Phase 4: Day {claimLagDays}
            </div>
            <div className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-950">Grant Reimbursement</div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-emerald-900">
              Reimbursement check wires directly into startup bank account, replenishing working capital.
            </p>
            <div className="pt-1 text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700">
              + {currencySymbol}{expectedGrantDrawdownAmount.toLocaleString()} Cash Arrives
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Card>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* 2. UNDERWRITING LIQUIDITY METRICS GRID                                    */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 bg-gradient-to-b from-slate-50/70 via-white to-slate-50/40 p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-xs space-y-5">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <div className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-200/60 text-indigo-700">
            <Layers className="h-4 w-4" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">
              Assessor Working Capital &amp; Liquidity Diagnostics
            </h4>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
              Underwriting checks verified by evaluation committees prior to grant sanction.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-3">
          {/* Minimum Required Liquidity */}
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between">
            <div className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
              Peak Cash Required
            </div>
            <div className="my-2">
              <div className="text-2xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900">
                {currencySymbol}{minimumLiquidityBufferRequired.toLocaleString()}
              </div>
              <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                Upfront invoice capital + 15% buffer
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="rounded-lg bg-slate-50 border border-slate-100 p-2 text-[11px] text-slate-600">
              Must clear bank account before claim filing
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Confirmed Liquid Buffer */}
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between">
            <div className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
              Confirmed Liquid Buffer
            </div>
            <div className="my-2">
              <div className="text-2xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900">
                {currencySymbol}{actualConfirmedBridgeLiquidity.toLocaleString()}
              </div>
              <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                Founder Cash + Gov Loan commitments
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="rounded-lg bg-slate-50 border border-slate-100 p-2 text-[11px] text-slate-600">
              Verified from Step 2 Capital Stack
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Safety Surplus or Deficit */}
          <div
            className={`rounded-xl border p-4 shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between ${
              isAssessorLiquidityCompliant
                ? 'border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50/40'
                : 'border-rose-200 bg-rose-50/40'
            }`}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
                Liquidity Safety Margin
              </span>
              <Badge
                className={
                  isAssessorLiquidityCompliant
                    ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300 text-[10px]'
                    : 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border-rose-300 text-[10px]'
                }
              >
                {isAssessorLiquidityCompliant ? 'SOLVENT' : 'DEFICIT'}
              </Badge>
            </div>
            <div className="my-2">
              <div
                className={`text-2xl font-extrabold tracking-tight ${
                  isAssessorLiquidityCompliant ? 'text-emerald-700' : 'text-rose-700'
                }`}
              >
                {liquiditySafetySurplusOrDeficit >= 0 ? '+' : ''}
                {currencySymbol}{liquiditySafetySurplusOrDeficit.toLocaleString()}
              </div>
              <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                {isAssessorLiquidityCompliant
                  ? 'Surplus cushion to absorb claim delays'
                  : 'Cash shortfall risking unpaid invoices'}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-600 pt-1">
              Assessor Rating:{' '}
              <strong>{isAssessorLiquidityCompliant ? 'Approved (Green Flag)' : 'High Risk (Requires Remedy)'}</strong>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* 3. INPUT CONFIGURATION: BUDGET, TURNAROUND & STRATEGY                     */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      <div className="space-y-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-xs">
        <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">
          Reimbursement Bridge Configuration &amp; Vendor Terms
        </h4>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
          {/* Vouched Project Budget */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
              Vouched Milestone Budget ({currencySymbol})
            </Label>
            <Input
              type="number"
              value={grantEligibleVouchedBudget}
              onChange={(e) => setGrantEligibleVouchedBudget(Number(e.target.value) || 0)}
              disabled={isVaultReadonly}
              className="text-xs font-semibold"
            />
            <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">
              Total invoiced cost for this grant milestone.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Expected Grant Drawdown */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
              Expected Grant Claim ({currencySymbol})
            </Label>
            <Input
              type="number"
              value={expectedGrantDrawdownAmount}
              onChange={(e) => setExpectedGrantDrawdownAmount(Number(e.target.value) || 0)}
              disabled={isVaultReadonly}
              className="text-xs font-semibold"
            />
            <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">
              Amount reimbursed after invoice clearance (usually 50%).
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Claim Turnaround Weeks */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
              Claim Processing Turnaround (Weeks)
            </Label>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Input
                type="number"
                min={4}
                max={24}
                value={estimatedClaimTurnaroundWeeks}
                onChange={(e) => setEstimatedClaimTurnaroundWeeks(Number(e.target.value) || 8)}
                disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                className="text-xs font-semibold"
              />
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 whitespace-nowrap">
                (~{claimLagDays} days)
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">
              Official agency SLA (typically 8–12 weeks).
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Strategy Selector (With Mandatory OTHER Option) */}
        <div className="pt-2 space-y-2">
          <Label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
            Primary Reimbursement Bridge Strategy
          </Label>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2.5 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
            {[
              {
                id: 'FOUNDER_DIRECTOR_LOAN_BUFFER' as const,
                title: 'Director / Founder Cash Float',
                desc: 'Committed personal savings in business account floating invoice until check clears.',
              },
              {
                id: 'MICROFINANCE_OR_STARTUP_LOAN_BRIDGE' as const,
                title: isUK ? 'BBB Start Up Loan Bridge' : 'Microfinance Ireland (MFI) Loan',
                desc: 'Low-interest state loan providing immediate liquidity to pay suppliers.',
              },
              {
                id: 'SUPPLIER_60_DAY_STAGGERED_TERMS' as const,
                title: '60/90-Day Vendor Stagger',
                desc: 'Agreed phased agency milestones aligning payments closely with claim submission.',
              },
              {
                id: 'OTHER' as const,
                title: 'Other Custom Bridging Structure',
                desc: 'Specify overdraft, invoice financing, or custom angel bridge arrangement.',
              },
            ].map((st) => {
              const isSelected = bridgeStrategy === st.id;
              return (
                <div
                  key={st.id}
                  onClick={() => !isVaultReadonly && setBridgeStrategy(st.id)}
                  className={`cursor-pointer rounded-xl border p-3 transition-all ${
                    isSelected
                      ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50/60 ring-1 ring-indigo-600'
                      : 'border-slate-200 bg-white hover:border-slate-300'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">{st.title}</span>
                    {isSelected && <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-600" />}
                  </div>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-slate-600">{st.desc}</p>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {/* Conditional "Other" Input */}
          {bridgeStrategy === 'OTHER' && (
            <div className="pt-2">
              <Label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                Custom Bridging Facility Description
              </Label>
              <Input
                type="text"
                value={otherBridgeStrategyText}
                onChange={(e) => setOtherBridgeStrategyText(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g., A €20,000 convertible bridge note from an existing advisor to cover contractor milestones..."
                className="mt-1 text-xs"
                disabled={isVaultReadonly}
              />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Vendor Terms Selector */}
        <div className="pt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          <Label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
            Contractor &amp; Vendor Invoice Payment Terms:
          </Label>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            {[30, 60, 90].map((days) => (
              <button
                key={days}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setVendorPaymentTermsDays(days as 30 | 60 | 90)}
                disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                className={`rounded-lg px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${
                  vendorPaymentTermsDays === days
                    ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white'
                    : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200'
                }`}
              >
                {days} Days Net
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* 4. AI BRIDGE PLAN NARRATIVE & ASSESSOR MITIGATION                         */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      <div className="space-y-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800">
              Grant Reimbursement Bridge &amp; Liquidity Survival Narrative
            </label>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
              Feeds directly into Module L Appendix D, providing the formal underwriter justification that this business will not fail during claim reimbursement lag.
            </p>
          </div>
          <Button
            type="button"
            size="sm"
            variant="outline"
            onClick={handleGenerateAiNarrative}
            disabled={isGeneratingAi || isVaultReadonly}
            className="h-7 border-violet-200 bg-violet-50 text-[11px] font-semibold text-violet-700 hover:bg-violet-100"
          >
            <Sparkles className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-violet-600" />
            {isGeneratingAi ? 'Synthesizing...' : 'Calibrate Bridge Plan with AI'}
          </Button>
        </div>

        <textarea
          value={bridgeRiskMitigationNarrative}
          onChange={(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) =>
            setBridgeRiskMitigationNarrative(e.target.value)
          }
          placeholder={`e.g., Grant reimbursement for the ${targetGrantDef?.name || 'LEO Priming Grant'} operates on an arrears basis with an estimated ${claimLagDays}-day turnaround post-milestone delivery. To eliminate liquidity strain, ${plan.title} maintains a dedicated ${currencySymbol}${actualConfirmedBridgeLiquidity.toLocaleString()} working capital buffer backed by ${bridgeStrategy.replace(/_/g, ' ').toLowerCase()}, comfortably absorbing invoice clearance cycles prior to claim release...`}
          className="flex min-h-[90px] w-full rounded-md border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-900 shadow-xs placeholder:text-slate-400 focus-visible:outline-hidden focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 resize-y"
          disabled={isVaultReadonly}
        />

        {aiAssessorTip && (
          <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-amber-200/80 bg-amber-50/70 p-3 text-[11px] text-amber-900">
            <Info className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-amber-600 mt-0.5" />
            <div className="space-y-0.5">
              <span className="font-semibold text-amber-950">Grant Assessor Liquidity Rule:</span>
              <p className="leading-relaxed text-amber-900/90">{aiAssessorTip}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* 5. BOTTOM TOOLBAR: SAVE & NEXT STEP                                       */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-slate-100 pt-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {onBackToStep2 && (
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={onBackToStep2}
              className="text-xs font-semibold"
            >
              ← Back to Step 2: Capital Stack
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            onClick={handleSaveStep3}
            disabled={isSaving || isVaultReadonly}
            className="text-xs font-semibold"
          >
            {isSaving ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Reimbursement Bridge'}
          </Button>

          {onContinueToNextStep && (
            <Button
              type="button"
              size="sm"
              onClick={async () => {
                await handleSaveStep3();
                onContinueToNextStep();
              }}
              className="bg-indigo-600 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-indigo-700"
            >
              Continue to Step 4: Angel Tax Relief
              <ArrowRight className="ml-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function buildLiveCallCheatSheetPrompts(
  plan: ActiveStartupPlan,
  survey?: SavedValidationSurvey
): Array<{ title: string; question: string; whyItWorks: string }> {
  const { audiencePhrase, topicPhrase } = deriveNaturalTopicForOutreach(
    plan,
    survey || {
      id: 'default',
      planId: plan.id,
      title: plan.title,
      publicSlug: 'survey',
      introDescription: '',
      focusAreas: [],
