                  <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                    Keep this open during Zoom or coffee chats
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2.5 md:grid-cols-5">
                  {buildLiveCallCheatSheetPrompts(plan, activeSurvey).map(
                    (item, idx) => (
                      <div
                        key={idx}
                        className="flex flex-col justify-between rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/80 p-3 text-xs"
                      >
                        <div className="space-y-1.5">
                          <div className="font-bold text-indigo-950">
                            {item.title}
                          </div>
                          <p className="font-medium italic leading-relaxed text-slate-800">
                            {item.question}
                          </p>
                        </div>
                        <p className="mt-2 border-t border-slate-200/80 pt-1.5 text-[10px] leading-snug text-slate-500">
                          💡 {item.whyItWorks}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    )
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* 1-ON-1 INTERVIEWS OVERVIEW TILES GRID */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
              {interviewLogs.map((log) => {
                const channelLabel =
                  log.channel === 'OTHER'
                    ? log.otherChannelText || 'Custom Channel'
                    : INTERVIEW_CHANNEL_OPTIONS.find(
                        (c) => c.code === log.channel
                      )?.label || log.channel;
                const commitmentLabel =
                  log.commitmentOutcome === 'OTHER'
                    ? `✨ ${log.otherCommitmentText || 'Custom Outcome'}`
                    : INTERVIEW_COMMITMENT_OPTIONS.find(
                        (c) => c.code === log.commitmentOutcome
                      )?.label || log.commitmentOutcome;

                return (
                  <div
                    key={log.id}
                    className="flex flex-col justify-between rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-2xs transition-all hover:border-indigo-300 hover:shadow-md"
                  >
                    <div className="space-y-2.5">
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-2">
                        <div>
                          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                            <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">
                              {log.intervieweeNameOrRole}
                            </span>
                            {log.isSimulated && (
                              <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px]">
                                Simulated
                              </Badge>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                            {channelLabel} • {log.date}
                            {log.intervieweeEmail
                              ? ` • ${log.intervieweeEmail}`
                              : ''}
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <Badge
                            className={`text-[10px] font-bold ${
                              log.signalBadge === 'STRONG_SIGNAL'
                                ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-900'
                                : log.signalBadge === 'POLITE_FLUFF'
                                  ? 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-900'
                                  : 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-900'
                            }`}
                          >
                            {log.signalBadge === 'STRONG_SIGNAL'
                              ? '🔥 Strong Signal'
                              : log.signalBadge === 'POLITE_FLUFF'
                                ? '⚠️ Polite Fluff'
                                : '⚖️ Mixed Signal'}
                          </Badge>
                          <Badge className="bg-indigo-50 text-[10px] font-bold text-indigo-800">
                            Pain: {log.painScore1To5}/5
                          </Badge>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <p className="text-xs font-medium leading-relaxed text-slate-800">
                        {log.keyTakeaway}
                      </p>

                      {log.verbatimQuote && (
                        <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200/90 bg-slate-50 p-2.5 text-[11px] italic text-slate-700">
                          &ldquo;{log.verbatimQuote}&rdquo;
                        </div>
                      )}

                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[11px] text-slate-600">
                        <span>
                          <strong>Workaround/Spend:</strong>{' '}
                          {log.workaroundAndSpend}
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      {log.momTestCoachingNote && (
                        <div className="rounded-lg border border-indigo-100 bg-indigo-50/60 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[11px] text-indigo-950">
                          💡 {log.momTestCoachingNote}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-t border-slate-100 pt-2.5">
                      <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-indigo-900">
                        {commitmentLabel}
                      </span>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <Button
                          type="button"
                          variant="outline"
                          size="sm"
                          disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                          onClick={() => handleEditInterviewLog(log)}
                          className="h-7 px-2.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-50"
                        >
                          Edit in Logger
                        </Button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                          onClick={() => handleDeleteInterviewLog(log.id)}
                          className="rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50"
                        >
                          Delete
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}

              {/* + LOG NEW 1-ON-1 INTERVIEW TILE */}
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                onClick={() => {
                  resetInterviewForm();
                  setIsInterviewModalOpen(true);
                }}
                className="flex min-h-[200px] flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-slate-50/60 p-6 text-center transition-all hover:border-indigo-400 hover:bg-indigo-50/40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
              >
                <div className="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700">
                  <Mic className="h-6 w-6" />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <div className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">
                    + Log a 1-on-1 Customer Interview
                  </div>
                  <p className="max-w-xs text-xs leading-relaxed text-slate-500">
                    Open the focused Interview Logger window to paste raw call
                    notes and let AI extract Mom-Test signal, quotes, and pain
                    scores.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Step 2 Bottom Toolbar */}
          <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-slate-100 pt-4">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => scrollToStep(1)}
              className="text-xs font-semibold"
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              Previous: Step 1 (Customer Surveys)
            </Button>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              {activeSurvey && interviewLogs.length > 0 && (
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => {
                    openSurveyInStudio(activeSurvey, 'INSIGHTS', false);
                    void handleRunAiAnalysis();
                  }}
                  className="border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/70 text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-800 hover:bg-indigo-100"
                >
                  <Sparkles className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-600" />
                  Synthesize Calls in Survey Insights
                </Button>
              )}

              <Button
                type="button"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => scrollToStep(3)}
                className="bg-indigo-600 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-indigo-700"
              >
                Next Step: Validation Brief &amp; Blind Spots
                <ArrowRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* =================================================================== */}
      {/* FOCUSED 1-ON-1 INTERVIEW LOGGER MODAL WINDOW                        */}
      {/* =================================================================== */}
      {isInterviewModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-950/75 p-2 backdrop-blur-xs sm:p-4 lg:p-6">
          <div className="relative flex max-h-[94vh] w-full max-w-4xl flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-indigo-200 bg-white shadow-2xl">
            {/* Modal Sticky Header */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-5 py-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <div className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 text-white">
                  <Mic className="h-4 w-4" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
                    {editingInterviewId
                      ? 'Edit 1-on-1 Customer Interview Log'
                      : 'Log a 1-on-1 Customer Conversation'}
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-600">
                    Paste raw notes or voice-memo transcripts first, then click{' '}
                    <strong>&ldquo;Extract with AI Mom-Test Filter&rdquo;</strong>{' '}
                    to auto-fill the structured fields.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => {
                    resetInterviewForm();
                    setIsInterviewModalOpen(false);
                  }}
                  className="text-xs font-semibold"
                >
                  Cancel
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Modal Scrollable Body */}
            <div className="flex-1 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto p-5 sm:p-6">
              {/* Row 1: Name/Role, Email, Date */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                    Person Name &amp; Role *
                  </label>
                  <Input
                    disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                    value={intervieweeNameOrRole}
                    onChange={(e) => setIntervieweeNameOrRole(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g., Sarah Jenkins (Clinic Owner)"
                    className="text-base sm:text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                    Email / Contact (Optional)
                  </label>
                  <Input
                    disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                    value={intervieweeEmail}
                    onChange={(e) => setIntervieweeEmail(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="sarah@example.com"
                    className="text-base sm:text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                    Conversation Date
                  </label>
                  <Input
                    type="date"
                    disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                    value={interviewDate}
                    onChange={(e) => setInterviewDate(e.target.value)}
                    className="text-base sm:text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Row 2: Conversation Channel Selector (with OTHER per GEMINI.md Rule 1.5) */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                  Conversation Channel:
                </label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-5">
                  {INTERVIEW_CHANNEL_OPTIONS.map((ch) => {
                    const isSelected = interviewChannel === ch.code;
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={ch.code}
                        type="button"
                        disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                        onClick={() => setInterviewChannel(ch.code)}
                        className={`flex flex-col items-start rounded-xl border p-2.5 text-left transition-all ${
                          isSelected
                            ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50/90 text-indigo-950 ring-1 ring-indigo-600'
                            : 'border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-700 hover:border-indigo-300'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <span className="text-xs font-bold">{ch.label}</span>
                        <span className="mt-0.5 text-[10px] leading-tight text-slate-500">
                          {ch.subtitle}
                        </span>
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>

                {interviewChannel === 'OTHER' && (
                  <div className="pt-1">
                    <Input
                      disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                      value={otherInterviewChannelText}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setOtherInterviewChannelText(e.target.value)
                      }
                      placeholder="Specify custom channel (e.g., Trade Show Floor, WhatsApp Call, Slack Huddle)..."
                      className="border-indigo-300 bg-indigo-50/30 text-base sm:text-xs"
                    />
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Row 3: Raw Messy Call Notes + AI Mom-Test Extractor Button */}
              <div className="space-y-2 rounded-2xl border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/40 p-3.5">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-indigo-950">
                      1. Brain-Dump Raw Call Notes or Transcript
                    </label>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-600">
                      Jot down messy bullet points from the conversation—what
                      broke last week, what tools they pay for today, and what
                      they said at the end.
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    size="sm"
                    disabled={
                      isVaultReadonly ||
                      !interviewRawNotes.trim() ||
                      isExtractingInterviewAi
                    }
                    onClick={handleExtractInterviewWithAi}
                    className="bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-violet-600 text-xs text-white hover:from-indigo-700 hover:to-violet-700"
                  >
                    {isExtractingInterviewAi ? (
                      <>
                        <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                        Extracting Mom-Test Signal...
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <Sparkles className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        Extract with AI Mom-Test Filter
                      </>
                    )}
                  </Button>
                </div>

                <textarea
                  rows={5}
                  disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                  value={interviewRawNotes}
                  onChange={(e) => setInterviewRawNotes(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g., Spoke with Sarah for 15 mins. Last Tuesday her clinic lost 3 hours chasing patient intake forms across email and Excel. They pay €140/mo for an older tool but staff hate using it. She asked if she can test our V1 next month with 2 receptionists..."
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 bg-white p-3 text-base leading-relaxed text-slate-900 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-hidden sm:text-xs"
                />
              </div>

              {/* Row 4: Structured Takeaways (Auto-filled by AI or manually editable) */}
              <div className="space-y-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 p-3.5">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
                    2. Structured Mom-Test Proof (Auto-Filled by AI or Edit
                    Directly)
                  </span>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    {(
                      [
                        {
                          code: 'STRONG_SIGNAL',
                          label: '🔥 Strong Signal',
                          activeCls:
                            'bg-emerald-600 text-white border-emerald-600',
                        },
                        {
                          code: 'MIXED_SIGNAL',
                          label: '⚖️ Mixed Signal',
                          activeCls:
                            'bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 border-amber-500',
                        },
                        {
                          code: 'POLITE_FLUFF',
                          label: '⚠️ Polite Fluff',
                          activeCls: 'bg-rose-600 text-white border-rose-600',
                        },
                      ] as const
                    ).map((b) => (
                      <button
                        key={b.code}
                        type="button"
                        disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                        onClick={() => setInterviewSignalBadge(b.code)}
                        className={`rounded-lg border px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold transition-all ${
                          interviewSignalBadge === b.code
                            ? b.activeCls
                            : 'border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {b.label}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                    Key Takeaway (1-Sentence Summary of Past Behavior &amp;
                    Pain):
                  </label>
                  <Input
                    disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                    value={interviewKeyTakeaway}
                    onChange={(e) => setInterviewKeyTakeaway(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g., Loses 3 hours every week chasing intake forms manually despite paying €140/mo for legacy software."
                    className="bg-white text-base sm:text-xs"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                  <div>
                    <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                      Best Verbatim Customer Quote:
                    </label>
                    <textarea
                      rows={2}
                      disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                      value={interviewVerbatimQuote}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setInterviewVerbatimQuote(e.target.value)
                      }
                      placeholder='"Last Tuesday we spent 3 hours fixing a single batch by hand..."'
                      className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 bg-white p-2.5 text-base text-slate-900 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-hidden sm:text-xs"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                      Current Workaround &amp; Monthly Spend:
                    </label>
                    <textarea
                      rows={2}
                      disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                      value={interviewWorkaroundAndSpend}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setInterviewWorkaroundAndSpend(e.target.value)
                      }
                      placeholder="e.g., Shared Excel tracker + €140/mo legacy software + 3 hrs/wk admin."
                      className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 bg-white p-2.5 text-base text-slate-900 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-hidden sm:text-xs"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Pain / Urgency 1-5 Selector */}
                <div>
                  <label className="mb-1.5 block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                    Observed Pain / Urgency Level (1 = Minor annoyance, 5 =
                    Hair-on-fire problem):
                  </label>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-5 gap-2">
                    {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((score) => (
                      <button
                        key={score}
                        type="button"
                        disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                        onClick={() => setInterviewPainScore(score)}
                        className={`rounded-xl border py-2 text-center text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                          interviewPainScore === score
                            ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-2xs'
                            : 'border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-700 hover:border-indigo-300'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {score} / 5
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Commitment / Next-Step Outcome Selector (with OTHER per GEMINI.md Rule 1.5) */}
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                    Commitment / Call Outcome (Skin in the Game):
                  </label>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">
                    {INTERVIEW_COMMITMENT_OPTIONS.map((opt) => {
                      const isSelected = interviewCommitment === opt.code;
                      return (
                        <button
                          key={opt.code}
                          type="button"
                          disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                          onClick={() => {
                            setInterviewCommitment(opt.code);
                            setInterviewSignalBadge(opt.defaultSignal);
                          }}
                          className={`flex flex-col items-start rounded-xl border p-2.5 text-left transition-all ${
                            isSelected
                              ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50/90 text-indigo-950 ring-1 ring-indigo-600'
                              : 'border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-700 hover:border-indigo-300'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <span className="text-xs font-bold">{opt.label}</span>
                          <span className="mt-0.5 text-[10px] leading-snug text-slate-500">
                            {opt.subtitle}
                          </span>
                        </button>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>

                  {interviewCommitment === 'OTHER' && (
                    <div className="pt-1">
                      <Input
                        disabled={isVaultReadonly}
                        value={otherInterviewCommitmentText}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          setOtherInterviewCommitmentText(e.target.value)
                        }
                        placeholder="Describe custom outcome or commitment (e.g., Invited us to observe their team workflow next Tuesday)..."
                        className="border-indigo-300 bg-white text-base sm:text-xs"
                      />
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {interviewMomTestCoachingNote && (
                  <div className="rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/80 p-3 text-xs text-indigo-950">
                    <span className="font-bold">
                      💡 AI Mom-Test Coaching Note:{' '}
                    </span>
                    {interviewMomTestCoachingNote}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Modal Sticky Footer */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-5 py-3.5">
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"

              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="ghost"

                className="h-8 shrink-0 px-2.5 text-xs font-medium text-indigo-600 group-hover:bg-indigo-50"

                Edit Step

        <div
          id="module-c-step-3"

              variant="outline"

                type="button"
                size="sm"

            </div>
            <div className="ml-3 flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="ghost"
                size="sm"
                className="h-8 shrink-0 px-2.5 text-xs font-medium text-indigo-600 group-hover:bg-indigo-50"

                Open Overview
                <ChevronDown className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />

              <span
                className={`mt-0.5 flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-xs font-bold text-white ${

                    ? 'bg-emerald-600'

                }`}

                      <div className="py-5">

                                        {survey.responses.length} Responses (
                                        {sReal} Real) • {sWaitlist} Waitlist
                                      </Badge>
                                    </div>
                                  </div>

                                  {survey.aiInsightsSummary && (
                                    <div className="mt-2.5 rounded-lg border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/70 p-2.5 text-[11px] text-indigo-950">
                                      <div>
                                        <strong>
                                          AI Signal Score (
                                          {
                                            survey.aiInsightsSummary
                                              .signalScoreOutOf100
                                          }
                                          /100):
                                        </strong>{' '}
                                        {
                                          survey.aiInsightsSummary
                                            .headlineTakeaway
                                        }
                                      </div>
                                      <div className="mt-1 text-indigo-900/90">
                                        <strong>
                                          Recommended V1 Action (Feeds Module D):
                                        </strong>{' '}
                                        {
                                          survey.aiInsightsSummary
                                            .recommendedNextAction
                                        }
                                      </div>
                                    </div>
                                  )}
                                </div>
                              );
                            })}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      {/* Section 3: 1-on-1 Customer Discovery Interviews */}
                      <div className="py-5">
                        <div className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-600">
                          3. 1-on-1 Customer Discovery Interview Log (
                          {interviewLogs.length})
                        </div>
                        {interviewLogs.length === 0 ? (
                          <div className="mt-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/60 p-3 text-slate-500">
                            No 1-on-1 customer interviews logged yet.
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <div className="mt-2.5 grid grid-cols-1 gap-2.5 md:grid-cols-2">
                            {interviewLogs.map((log) => (
                              <div
                                key={log.id}
                                className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 p-3"
                              >
                                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                                  <div>
                                    <div className="font-bold text-slate-900">
                                      {log.intervieweeNameOrRole}
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                                      {log.date} • {formatInterviewChannel(log)}
                                    </div>
                                  </div>
                                  <Badge
                                    variant={
                                      log.signalBadge === 'STRONG_SIGNAL'
                                        ? 'success'
                                        : log.signalBadge === 'MIXED_SIGNAL'
                                          ? 'warning'
                                          : 'secondary'
                                    }
                                    className="text-[10px]"
                                  >
                                    Pain {log.painScore1To5}/5 •{' '}
                                    {INTERVIEW_SIGNAL_LABELS[log.signalBadge]}
                                  </Badge>
                                </div>
                                <p className="mt-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-800">
                                  {log.keyTakeaway}
                                </p>
                                {log.verbatimQuote?.trim() && (
                                  <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] italic text-slate-600">
                                    &ldquo;{log.verbatimQuote.trim()}&rdquo;
                                  </p>
                                )}
                                <div className="mt-1.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-indigo-700">
                                  Outcome: {formatInterviewCommitment(log)}
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            ))}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      {/* Section 4: Co-Founder Blind-Spot Takeaways */}
                      <div className="pt-5">
                        <div className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-600">
                          4. Co-Founder Blind-Spot Review (&ldquo;Things to
                          Consider&rdquo;)
                        </div>
                        <div className="mt-2.5 grid grid-cols-1 gap-2.5 md:grid-cols-2">
                          {liveThingsToConsider.map((item) => (
                            <div
                              key={item.id}
                              className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/60 p-3"
                            >
                              <div className="font-bold text-slate-900">
                                {item.title}
                              </div>
                              <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-slate-600">
                                {item.suggestedAction || item.explanation}
                              </p>
                            </div>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Bottom Action Bar: Copy, Download HTML, Print/Save PDF */}
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 bg-white px-4 py-3.5 shadow-2xs">
                  <div className="text-xs text-slate-600">
                    📥{' '}
                    <strong>
                      Take your Customer Validation &amp; Interview Brief with
                      you:
                    </strong>{' '}
                    Download a standalone file, print/save as PDF, or copy for
                    grant &amp; accelerator applications.
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <Button
                      type="button"
                      variant="outline"
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={handleCopyModuleCBrief}
                    >
                      {briefCopied ? (
                        <>
                          <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                          Copied to Clipboard!
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          <Copy className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-600" />
                          Copy Summary
                        </>
                      )}
                    </Button>

                    <Button
                      type="button"
                      variant="outline"
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={handleDownloadModuleCBriefHtml}
                    >
                      <Download className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-600" />
                      Download Brief (.html)
                    </Button>

                    <Button
                      type="button"
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={handlePrintModuleCBriefPdf}
                      className="bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-700"
                    >
                      <Printer className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      Print / Save as PDF
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </>
            )}

            {/* Handoff Footer CTA into Module D (Matches Module B Dark Footer Bar 100%) */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 px-4 py-3.5 text-white">
              <div className="text-xs">
                <span className="font-semibold text-indigo-300">
                  Ready to scope V1 of {plan.title} based on real customer
                  evidence?
                </span>{' '}
                Your validated pain points, workaround spend, and{' '}
                <strong>{waitlistAcrossSurveys.length} waitlist leads</strong>{' '}
                will automatically feed into{' '}
                <strong>
                  Module D (Product Vehicle &amp; Ruthless V1 Feature Filter)
                </strong>
                .
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={onBackToModuleB}
                  className="border-slate-700 bg-slate-800 text-xs text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-700"
                >
                  <ArrowLeft className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  Back to Module B
                </Button>
                {onContinueToModuleD && (
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    size="sm"
                    onClick={async () => {
                      await handleSaveModuleCComplete();
                      onContinueToModuleD();
                    }}
                    className="bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-500"
                  >
                    Continue to Module D
                    <ArrowRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import type {

  ModuleLContradictionAuditItem,
} from '@/lib/auth/session-store';
import {

interface ModuleLContradictionAuditStepProps {
  plan: ActiveStartupPlan;
  isVaultReadonly?: boolean;
  onSaveStep2Audit: (
    data: ModuleLStep2ContradictionAuditSavedData,
    progress?: number
  ) => Promise<void> | void;
  onBackToStep1: () => void;
  onContinueToStep3: () => void;
  onNavigateToModule?: (
    moduleCode:
      | 'MOD_A_IDEATION'
      | 'MOD_B_MARKET'
      | 'MOD_C_SURVEYS_FEEDBACK'
      | 'MOD_D_PRODUCT_BUILD'
      | 'MOD_E_OPERATIONS'
      | 'MOD_F_COFOUNDER_TEAM'
      | 'MOD_G_LAUNCHPAD'
      | 'MOD_H_REVENUE'
      | 'MOD_I_MARKETING'
      | 'MOD_J_FINANCE'
      | 'MOD_K_GRANTS_FUNDING'
      | 'MOD_L_BUSINESS_PLAN',
    targetStep?: number,
    highlightId?: string
  ) => void;
  onParkQuestionInSession?: (questionText: string) => void;
}

export function ModuleLContradictionAuditStep({

  onSaveStep2Audit,
  onBackToStep1,
  onContinueToStep3,
  onNavigateToModule,
  onParkQuestionInSession,

  const isUK = plan.hqCountryCode === 'GB';
  const currencySymbol = isUK ? '£' : '€';

  const savedAudit = plan.moduleLData?.step2Audit;
  const compilerMode = plan.moduleLData?.step1Mode?.compilerMode || 'IE_LEO_OFFICIAL_FORM';

  // Audit state
  const defaultItems: ModuleLContradictionAuditItem[] = [

  const handleRunAiAudit = async () => {

They actively compare your written claims against your financial schedules. If your customer survey says users will only pay {currencySymbol}20, but your revenue model in Module H assumes {currencySymbol}99, or if you schedule hires in Module F without employer payroll taxes in Module J, assessors immediately deduct points for lack of commercial realism.

                  : 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border-rose-300'

            </p>
          </div>

              </div>
              <div className="mt-2 text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-emerald-700">
                {passedCount}
                <span className="text-base font-normal text-slate-500"> / {auditItems.length}</span>

            </div>
            <div className="mt-3 rounded-lg bg-emerald-50/60 border border-emerald-100 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-emerald-800 truncate">

            onClick={() => setFilterTab('WARNING')}
            className={`h-8 text-xs ${filterTab === 'WARNING' ? 'bg-amber-600 text-white' : 'text-slate-600'}`}
          >
            Warnings ({warningCount})

          <Button
            type="button"

                        <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4" />

                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                      <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">{item.title}</h4>
                      <Badge
                        variant="outline"
                        className={`text-[10px] font-semibold ${

                            ? 'border-rose-300 bg-rose-100 text-rose-800'
                            : item.status === 'WARNING'
                              ? 'border-amber-300 bg-amber-100 text-amber-800'
                              : 'border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                        }`}

                        {item.status}
                      </Badge>
                      <Badge variant="outline" className="border-slate-200 text-slate-500 text-[10px]">
                        {item.category.replace(/_/g, ' ')}

                    </Button>
                  )}

              size="sm"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={handleGenerateDefenseAi}
              disabled={isGeneratingDefense || isVaultReadonly}
              className="h-7 border-violet-200 bg-violet-50/80 text-xs font-semibold text-violet-700 hover:bg-violet-100"
            >
              <Sparkles className="mr-1.5 h-3 w-3 text-violet-600" />
              {isGeneratingDefense ? 'Calibrating Defense...' : 'AI Calibrate Defense'}
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="button"
              size="sm"
              variant="ghost"
              onClick={() =>
                setDefenseSummary(
                  `"${plan.title}" has undergone cross-module reconciliation across Modules A through K. Pricing models are calibrated to empirical customer discovery from Module C, statutory employer payroll burdens are provisioned across Year 1–3 forecasts, and grant reimbursement drawdown timing lag is fully cushioned by confirmed founder equity and unencumbered working capital reserves. All equipment requests adhere strictly to statutory eligibility guidelines with no deadweight displacement.`
                )
              }
              className="h-7 text-xs text-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-50"
            >
              <RotateCcw className="mr-1 h-3 w-3" />
              Reset
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
          This defense statement reconciles potential assessor objections into a single defensible narrative paragraph that gets compiled directly into your final submission:
        </p>

        <textarea
          rows={4}
          value={defenseSummary}
          onChange={(e) => setDefenseSummary(e.target.value)}
          disabled={isVaultReadonly}
          className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/50 p-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-slate-800 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:bg-white focus:outline-hidden"
          placeholder="Enter pre-flight defense statement..."
        />
      </div>

      {/* Assessor Tip Callout */}
      {aiTip && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50/60 p-4 shadow-xs">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
            <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <div className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-amber-900">
              <span className="font-semibold text-amber-950">Underwriter Insider Tip: </span>
              {aiTip}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Bottom Step Toolbar */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-slate-100 pt-5">
        <Button
          type="button"
          variant="outline"
          size="sm"
          onClick={onBackToStep1}
          className="text-xs text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50"
        >
          <ArrowLeft className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          Back to Step 1 (Compiler Mode)
        </Button>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {onParkQuestionInSession && (
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => onParkQuestionInSession('Step 2 Pre-Flight Audit Reconciliation Flag')}
              className="border-slate-200 text-xs text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50"
            >
              <BookmarkPlus className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-400" />
              Park in Open Questions
            </Button>
          )}

          <Button
            type="button"
            size="sm"
            onClick={handleSaveAndContinue}
            disabled={isSaving || isVaultReadonly}
            className="bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white text-xs font-semibold"
          >
            {isSaving ? 'Saving Audit...' : 'Save & Proceed to Step 3 (Narrative Compiler)'}
            <ArrowRight className="ml-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import type {

  SavedFounderMotivation,
  SavedFounderRealityCheck,
  SavedTeamAndBudget,
} from '@/lib/auth/session-store';

interface ModuleAGrantCheckerStepProps {
  planTitle: string;
  hqCountryCode: SupportedCountryCode;
  exportPotential: 'DOMESTIC_ONLY' | 'EXPORTING_INTERNATIONALLY';
  industryCategory: string;
  brainDumpText: string;
  conceptCanvas: SavedConceptCanvas;
  founderMotivation: SavedFounderMotivation;
  teamAndBudget: SavedTeamAndBudget;
  founderRealityCheck: SavedFounderRealityCheck;
  grantCheck: SavedGrantEligibilityCheck;
  onChangeGrantCheck: (next: SavedGrantEligibilityCheck) => void;
  onSaveGrantCheck: (overrideCheck?: SavedGrantEligibilityCheck) => Promise<void>;
  onRunAiGrantPositioning: (
    overrideCheck?: SavedGrantEligibilityCheck
  ) => Promise<void>;
  onParkOpenQuestion: (questionText: string) => void;

  isSaving: boolean;
  isRunningAiAdvisor: boolean;
  isVaultReadonly: boolean;
  isOpen: boolean;
  isAllExpanded: boolean;
  onExpandStep: () => void;
  onCollapseStep: () => void;
}

export function ModuleAGrantCheckerStep({
  planTitle,
  hqCountryCode,
  exportPotential,
  industryCategory,
  brainDumpText,
  conceptCanvas,
  founderMotivation,
  teamAndBudget,

  isOpen,
  isAllExpanded,
  onExpandStep,
  onCollapseStep,
}: ModuleAGrantCheckerStepProps) {
  const [showWhyAsking, setShowWhyAsking] = useState(false);
  const [showExample, setShowExample] = useState(false);
  const [showNotEligible, setShowNotEligible] = useState(false);
  const [parkedConfirm, setParkedConfirm] = useState(false);

  // Pop-Out 4-Step Micro-Question Wizard Modal State
  const [isWizardModalOpen, setIsWizardModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [wizardStep, setWizardStep] = useState<1 | 2 | 3 | 4>(1);
  const [draftCheck, setDraftCheck] =
    useState<SavedGrantEligibilityCheck>(grantCheck);
  const [hasRevealedGrants, setHasRevealedGrants] = useState<boolean>(() =>
    Boolean(grantCheck.lastCheckedAt)
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    setHasRevealedGrants(Boolean(grantCheck.lastCheckedAt));
  }, [grantCheck.lastCheckedAt]);

  const isGrantsRevealed = hasRevealedGrants || Boolean(grantCheck.lastCheckedAt);

  const evaluation = evaluateModuleAGrantEligibility({
    hqCountryCode,
    exportPotential,
    industryCategory,
    brainDumpText,
    conceptCanvas,
    founderMotivation,
    teamAndBudget,
    founderRealityCheck,
    grantCheck,
  });

  const isIreland = evaluation.countryCode === 'IE';
  const countryFlag = isIreland ? '🇮🇪' : '🇬🇧';
  const countryLabel = isIreland
    ? 'Ireland (LEO, Enterprise Ireland & Revenue)'
    : 'United Kingdom (Start Up Loans, Innovate UK & HMRC)';

        'IE_STANDARD_50_MATCH',
        'IE_BMW_REGIONAL_60_MATCH',
        'IE_GAELTACHT_UDARAS',
        'OTHER',
      ]
    : [
        'GB_ENGLAND_GROWTH_HUB',
        'GB_SCOTLAND_SE',
        'GB_WALES_DBW',
        'GB_NORTHERN_IRELAND_INVEST_NI',

  }

      ? grantCheck.aiGrantPositioningAdvice
      : evaluation.strategicPositioningTips;

  if (!isOpen && !isAllExpanded) {

        id="mod-a-step-7"
        onClick={onExpandStep}
        className="group scroll-mt-24 cursor-pointer rounded-xl border border-emerald-200 bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-50/60 via-white to-indigo-50/40 p-4 shadow-xs transition-all hover:border-emerald-400 hover:shadow-sm"
      >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-3">
            <span
              className={`flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-xs font-bold ${
                isGrantsRevealed
                  ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                  : 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
              }`}
            >
              {isGrantsRevealed ? <Check className="h-4 w-4" /> : '7'}
            </span>
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <h2 className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">
                  Step 7: {countryFlag} Instant Grant &amp; Funding Eligibility Checker

                {isGrantsRevealed ? (
                  <Badge variant="success" className="shrink-0 text-[10px]">

                    {evaluation.immediateQualifiedPoolFormatted}

                ) : (
                  <Badge variant="outline" className="shrink-0 border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 text-[10px] text-emerald-800">
                    Ready to Check Eligibility
                  </Badge>
                )}
              </div>
              <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-xs text-slate-500">
                {isGrantsRevealed
                  ? `Revealed ${evaluation.qualifiesNowGrants.length} immediate grants & ${evaluation.unlockableNextGrants.length} Phase 2 schemes for ${planTitle}.`
                  : `Answer 4 quick micro-questions to see which ${isIreland ? 'Irish' : 'UK'} grants, loans, and tax reliefs you qualify for.`}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="ml-3 flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="ghost"
              className="h-8 shrink-0 px-2.5 text-xs font-medium text-emerald-700 group-hover:bg-emerald-50"
            >
              <span>{isGrantsRevealed ? 'View Grants' : 'Check Grants'}</span>
              <ChevronDown className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div
      id="mod-a-step-7"
      className="scroll-mt-24 rounded-xl border border-emerald-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-xs sm:p-6"
    >
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4 border-b border-slate-100 pb-4">
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <span className="flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-emerald-600 text-xs font-bold text-white">
              7
            </span>
            <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
              Step 7: {countryFlag} Instant Grant &amp; Non-Dilutive Funding Checker
            </h2>
            <Badge variant="success" className="shrink-0 text-[10px]">
              {countryLabel}
            </Badge>
          </div>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-600">
            {isGrantsRevealed ? (

                Here is your personalized {isIreland ? 'Irish' : 'UK'} grant &amp; funding breakdown for{' '}

              size="sm"
              variant="ghost"
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                onCollapseStep();
              }}
              className="h-8 shrink-0 text-xs text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900"

                      Save Grant Check
                    </>
                  )}
                </Button>
              )}

              <Button
                type="button"
                size="sm"
                onClick={onContinueToBrief}
                className="bg-emerald-600 text-xs font-semibold text-white hover:bg-emerald-700"
              >
                View Startup Overview &amp; Summary Brief
                <ArrowRight className="ml-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      {/* ================================================================= */}
      {isWizardModalOpen && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-950/65 p-3 backdrop-blur-xs sm:p-6"
          onClick={() => setIsWizardModalOpen(false)}

            className="relative flex max-h-[90vh] w-full max-w-2xl flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-2xl"

                <div>
                  <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400/20 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-300">
                    {countryFlag} Step {wizardStep} of 4 • High-Accuracy Grant Check
                  </div>
                  <h3 className="mt-1.5 text-base font-bold text-white sm:text-lg">
                    {countryFlag} {isIreland ? 'Ireland' : 'UK'} Grant &amp; Funding Eligibility Check
                  </h3>
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsWizardModalOpen(false)}
                  className="rounded-lg p-1.5 text-slate-300 transition-colors hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white"
                  aria-label="Close modal"
                >
                  <X className="h-4 w-4" />
                </button>

                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2.5">
                    {(
                      [

                      return (

                        </button>
                      );

                      <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-800">

                      </label>

                        onChange={(e) =>

                            otherRegionalLocationText: e.target.value,
                          }))
                        }

                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

                    type="button"
                    size="sm"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setWizardStep(
                        (prev) => Math.min(4, prev + 1) as 1 | 2 | 3 | 4
                      )
                    }
                    className="bg-indigo-600 text-xs font-semibold text-white hover:bg-indigo-700"
                  >
                    Next Question ({wizardStep + 1} of 4)
                    <ArrowRight className="ml-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  </Button>
                ) : (
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    size="sm"
                    onClick={handleSaveWizardAndRevealGrants}
                    className="bg-emerald-600 px-4 text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-xs hover:bg-emerald-700"
                  >
                    <Sparkles className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    Save Answers &amp; Show My Grants
                    <ArrowRight className="ml-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function GrantMatchCard({ grant }: { grant: EvaluatedGrantMatch }) {
  const isNow = grant.matchTier === 'QUALIFIES_NOW';

  return (
    <div
      className={`flex flex-col justify-between rounded-2xl border p-4 shadow-2xs transition-all ${
        isNow
          ? 'border-emerald-200 bg-gradient-to-b from-emerald-50/40 to-white'
          : 'border-amber-200 bg-gradient-to-b from-amber-50/40 to-white'
      }`}
    >
      <div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <span
            className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide ${
              isNow
                ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-900'
                : 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-900'
            }`}
          >
            {isNow ? '🟢 Qualifies Now' : '🟡 Unlockable Next'} •{' '}
            {grant.matchScorePercent}% Fit
          </span>
          <span className="rounded-md bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-700">
            {grant.fundingTypeBadge}
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-2.5 flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
          <div>
            <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">
              {grant.grantName}
            </h4>
            <div className="text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-500">
              {grant.providerAgency}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Potential Value Callout */}
        <div
          className={`mt-2.5 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 ${
            isNow
              ? 'border-emerald-200/80 bg-emerald-50/70 text-emerald-950'
              : 'border-amber-200/80 bg-amber-50/70 text-amber-950'
          }`}
        >
          <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider opacity-75">
            Potential Grant / Support Value
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs font-extrabold sm:text-sm">
            {grant.potentialValueFormatted}
          </div>
          <div className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] opacity-90">
            {grant.coFundingOrMatchRequirement}
          </div>
        </div>

        <p className="mt-2.5 text-xs leading-relaxed text-slate-700">
          <strong className="text-slate-900">Why you match: </strong>
          {grant.whyYouMatchOrMiss}
        </p>

        {grant.unlockRequirement && (
          <div className="mt-2 rounded-xl border border-amber-300/80 bg-amber-50/90 p-2.5 text-xs text-amber-950">
            <strong>🔑 Milestone to Unlock: </strong>
            {grant.unlockRequirement}
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="mt-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-slate-50 p-2.5 text-[11px] text-slate-600">
          <span className="font-bold text-slate-800">
            ⚠️ Reimbursement &amp; Rule Watch-Out:{' '}
          </span>
          {grant.reimbursementAndTrapWarning}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-3 border-t border-slate-100 pt-2.5">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1">
            <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-slate-400">
              Built in:
            </span>
            {grant.preflightModulesToWin.map((mod) => (
              <span
                key={mod}
                className="rounded-md bg-indigo-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-indigo-800"
              >
                {mod}
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>
          <a
            href={grant.officialUrl}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-800 hover:underline"
          >
            Official Guide
            <ExternalLink className="h-3 w-3" />
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

  moduleHProgressPercent: number;
  onEnterWorkspace: (targetModule?: ModuleCode, targetStep?: number) => void;
  onOpenMasterDocument: () => void;
  onOpenBusinessPlanStudio: () => void;
  onOpenGrantCenter?: () => void;
  onOpenAskStartup?: (initialQuery?: string) => void;
  onOpenGuide?: () => void;
  onCreateNewPlan?: () => void;
  onClonePlan?: () => void;
  isCloningPlan?: boolean;
}
