export function ProjectDashboardView({
  founderName,
  planId,
  planTitle,
  oneLinerSummary,
  industryCategory,
  hqCountryCode,
  countryName,
  currencyCode,
  isPivot,
  activeModule,
  activeModuleTitle,
  moduleProgressList,
  masterDocSyncedChaptersCount,
  masterDocTotalChaptersCount,
  masterDocOverallProgressPercent,
  savedDossiersCount,
  surveyResponsesCount,
  waitlistLeadsCount,
  publicSurveySlug,
  matchedGrantsCount,
  grantReadinessPercent,
  grantReadinessCompletedCount,
  grantReadinessTotalCriteria,
  launchpadStepsCompletedCount,
  launchpadProgressPercent,
  openQuestionsCount,
  openQuestionsPreview,
  moduleAProgressPercent,
  moduleHProgressPercent,
  onEnterWorkspace,
  onOpenMasterDocument,
  onOpenBusinessPlanStudio,
  onOpenGrantCenter,
  onOpenAskStartup,
  onOpenGuide,
}: ProjectDashboardViewProps) {
  const [dashboardQuery, setDashboardQuery] = useState('');
  const [notifiedFeatures, setNotifiedFeatures] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [copiedSurveyLink, setCopiedSurveyLink] = useState(false);
  const [isVentureMapOpen, setIsVentureMapOpen] = useState(true);
  const [activeStageDetail, setActiveStageDetail] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const isGrantSupported = isGrantCheckerSupportedForCountry(hqCountryCode);

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const savedMapState = localStorage.getItem('spf_venture_map_open');
      if (savedMapState !== null) {
        setIsVentureMapOpen(savedMapState === 'true');
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore storage errors
    }
  }, []);

  function handleToggleVentureMap() {
    setIsVentureMapOpen((prev) => {
      const next = !prev;
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('spf_venture_map_open', String(next));
      } catch {
        // Ignore storage errors
      }
      return next;
    });
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('spf_coming_soon_waitlist');
      if (saved) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
          setNotifiedFeatures(parsed);
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore storage errors
    }
  }, []);

  function handleToggleNotifyFeature(featureId: string) {
    setNotifiedFeatures((prev) => {
      const next = prev.includes(featureId)
        ? prev.filter((id) => id !== featureId)
        : [...prev, featureId];
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('spf_coming_soon_waitlist', JSON.stringify(next));
      } catch {
        // Ignore storage errors
      }
      return next;
    });
  }

  async function handleCopySurveyLink(e: React.MouseEvent) {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!publicSurveySlug || typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    const url = `${window.location.origin}/v/${publicSurveySlug}`;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
      setCopiedSurveyLink(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedSurveyLink(false), 2500);
    } catch {
      // Ignore clipboard fallback
    }
  }

  const startedModulesCount = moduleProgressList.filter(
    (m) => m.progress > 0
  ).length;
  const completedModulesCount = moduleProgressList.filter(
    (m) => m.progress >= 100
  ).length;
  const overallVentureReadiness = Math.round(
    moduleProgressList.reduce((acc, m) => acc + m.progress, 0) /
      Math.max(1, moduleProgressList.length)
  );

  const firstName = founderName?.trim().split(' ')[0] || 'Founder';

  return (
    <div className="space-y-7 pb-10">
      {/* =================================================================== */}
      {/* TOP HERO BANNER: Signature Platform Indigo-to-Violet Gradient Card  */}
      {/* =================================================================== */}
      <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-indigo-900/60 bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-950 via-indigo-900 to-violet-900 p-5 text-white shadow-md sm:p-7">
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-16 -top-16 h-64 w-64 rounded-full bg-violet-500/15 blur-3xl" />
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -bottom-16 left-1/3 h-48 w-48 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 blur-3xl" />

        <div className="relative flex flex-col justify-between gap-5 lg:flex-row lg:items-center">
          <div className="space-y-2.5 max-w-2xl">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <Badge className="border-indigo-400/40 bg-indigo-500/25 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-100">
                Founder Command Center
              </Badge>
              <Badge className="border-white/20 bg-white/10 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-indigo-100">
                {countryName} ({currencyCode}) • {industryCategory}
              </Badge>
              {isPivot && (
                <Badge className="border-violet-300/40 bg-violet-500/30 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-violet-100">
                  Pivot Branch
                </Badge>
              )}
            </div>

            <h1 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white sm:text-2xl lg:text-3xl">
              Welcome back, {firstName}. Here is your project hub for{' '}
              <span className="underline decoration-emerald-400/70 decoration-2 underline-offset-4">
                {planTitle}
              </span>
              .
            </h1>

            <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-indigo-100/90 sm:text-sm">
              {oneLinerSummary?.trim()
                ? oneLinerSummary
                : 'Build your venture step-by-step in the Founder Workspace, review your whole-picture Master Document, or launch any standalone tool below.'}
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Right Vitals & Primary Resume CTA */}
          <div className="flex flex-col items-stretch gap-3 rounded-xl border border-white/15 bg-white/10 p-4 backdrop-blur-xs sm:flex-row sm:items-center lg:flex-col lg:items-end lg:min-w-[290px]">
            <div className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-4">
              <div>
                <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-200">
                  Venture Preflight Readiness
                </div>
                <div className="mt-0.5 flex items-baseline gap-2">
                  <span className="text-2xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-white">
                    {overallVentureReadiness}%
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-xs text-indigo-200">
                    ({startedModulesCount} of {moduleProgressList.length}{' '}
                    Modules Active)
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/20 ring-1 ring-emerald-400/40">
                <ShieldCheck className="h-5 w-5 text-emerald-300" />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="h-1.5 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-white/15">
              <div
                className="h-full rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-400 to-teal-300 transition-all duration-300"
                style={{ width: `${Math.max(6, overallVentureReadiness)}%` }}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="flex w-full flex-wrap items-center gap-2 pt-1">
              <Button
                type="button"
                size="sm"
                variant="outline"
                onClick={handleToggleVentureMap}
                className="w-full sm:w-auto border-white/25 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition shadow-xs"
              >
                <Map className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-300" />
                {isVentureMapOpen ? 'Hide Venture Map' : 'What to Expect Map'}
                {isVentureMapOpen ? (
                  <ChevronUp className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                ) : (
                  <ChevronDown className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                )}
              </Button>
              <Button
                type="button"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => onEnterWorkspace(activeModule)}
                className="w-full bg-emerald-500 text-xs font-bold text-slate-950 shadow-xs hover:bg-emerald-400 sm:flex-1"
              >
                Resume {activeModuleTitle}
                <ArrowRight className="ml-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Collapsible 4-Stage "What to Expect" Venture Map */}
        {isVentureMapOpen && (
          <div className="mt-5 border-t border-white/15 pt-4 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs text-indigo-200">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Map className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-300" />
                  What to Expect: Your 4-Stage Venture Map
                </span>
                <span className="hidden sm:inline text-indigo-300/80">•</span>
                <span className="hidden sm:inline text-indigo-200/80">
                  Jump into any stage at your own pace
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                {onOpenGuide && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={onOpenGuide}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-amber-300/40 bg-amber-400/20 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-amber-200 transition-colors hover:bg-amber-400/30"
                  >
                    <Lightbulb className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-amber-300" />
                    <span>How-To &amp; Visual Guide</span>
                  </button>
                )}
                <span className="text-[11px] text-indigo-200/90">
                  {completedModulesCount} of {moduleProgressList.length} Modules Completed • {openQuestionsCount} Parked Question{openQuestionsCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2.5 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
              {/* STAGE 1 */}
              {(() => {
                const stage1Mods = moduleProgressList.filter((m) =>
                  ['MOD_A_IDEATION', 'MOD_B_MARKET', 'MOD_C_SURVEYS_FEEDBACK'].includes(m.code)
                );
                const avgProgress = Math.round(
                  stage1Mods.reduce((acc, m) => acc + m.progress, 0) / Math.max(1, stage1Mods.length)
                );
                const isComplete = avgProgress >= 100;
                const isStarted = avgProgress > 0;
                const isSelected = activeStageDetail === 1;

                return (
                  <div
                    onClick={() => {
                      setActiveStageDetail((prev) => (prev === 1 ? null : 1));
                    }}
                    className={`group cursor-pointer rounded-xl border p-3 transition-all ${
                      isSelected
                        ? 'border-emerald-400/80 bg-white/20 shadow-xs'
                        : isStarted
                          ? 'border-white/20 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/15'
                          : 'border-white/10 bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                      <span className="font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-300">
                        Stage 1
                      </span>
                      <span
                        className={`rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${
                          isComplete
                            ? 'bg-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-200'
                            : isStarted
                              ? 'bg-indigo-500/30 text-indigo-200'
                              : 'bg-white/10 text-indigo-200/80'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {isComplete ? 'Complete' : isStarted ? `${avgProgress}%` : 'Ready'}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <h4 className="mt-1 text-xs font-bold text-white group-hover:text-emerald-300">
                      Idea, Market &amp; Validation
                    </h4>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-indigo-100/85">
                      Shape your concept, scout competitors, and launch your bias-free customer survey &amp; waitlist.
                    </p>

                    <div className="mt-2.5 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-white/10 pt-2 text-[10px]">
                      <span className="text-emerald-300 font-medium">✓ Concept &amp; Survey Proof</span>
                      <Button
                        type="button"
                        size="sm"
                        variant="ghost"
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          onEnterWorkspace('MOD_A_IDEATION');
                        }}
                        className="h-6 px-1.5 text-[10px] text-white hover:bg-white/20 hover:text-white"
                      >
                        Enter Stage →
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })()}

              {/* STAGE 2 */}
              {(() => {
                const stage2Mods = moduleProgressList.filter((m) =>
                  ['MOD_D_PRODUCT_BUILD', 'MOD_E_OPERATIONS', 'MOD_F_COFOUNDER_TEAM', 'MOD_G_LAUNCHPAD'].includes(m.code)
                );
                const avgProgress = Math.round(
                  stage2Mods.reduce((acc, m) => acc + m.progress, 0) / Math.max(1, stage2Mods.length)
                );
                const isComplete = avgProgress >= 100;
                const isStarted = avgProgress > 0;
                const isSelected = activeStageDetail === 2;

                return (
                  <div
                    onClick={() => {
                      setActiveStageDetail((prev) => (prev === 2 ? null : 2));
                    }}
                    className={`group cursor-pointer rounded-xl border p-3 transition-all ${
                      isSelected
                        ? 'border-emerald-400/80 bg-white/20 shadow-xs'
                        : isStarted
                          ? 'border-white/20 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/15'
                          : 'border-white/10 bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                      <span className="font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-200">
                        Stage 2
                      </span>
                      <span
                        className={`rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${
                          isComplete
                            ? 'bg-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-200'
                            : isStarted
                              ? 'bg-indigo-500/30 text-indigo-200'
                              : 'bg-white/10 text-indigo-200/80'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {isComplete ? 'Complete' : isStarted ? `${avgProgress}%` : 'Ready'}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <h4 className="mt-1 text-xs font-bold text-white group-hover:text-emerald-300">
                      Product, Team &amp; Setup
                    </h4>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-indigo-100/85">
                      {isGrantSupported
                        ? 'Scope your V1 build, request 3 supplier quotes, align co-founders & complete launchpad.'
                        : 'Scope your lean V1 build, align co-founders & tick off your company launchpad checklist.'}
                    </p>

                    <div className="mt-2.5 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-white/10 pt-2 text-[10px]">
                      <span className="text-emerald-300 font-medium">✓ Scope &amp; Launchpad Hub</span>
                      <Button
                        type="button"
                        size="sm"
                        variant="ghost"
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          onEnterWorkspace('MOD_D_PRODUCT_BUILD');
                        }}
                        className="h-6 px-1.5 text-[10px] text-white hover:bg-white/20 hover:text-white"
                      >
                        Enter Stage →
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })()}

              {/* STAGE 3 */}
              {(() => {
                const stage3Mods = moduleProgressList.filter((m) =>
                  ['MOD_H_REVENUE', 'MOD_I_MARKETING', 'MOD_J_FINANCE'].includes(m.code)
                );
                const avgProgress = Math.round(
                  stage3Mods.reduce((acc, m) => acc + m.progress, 0) / Math.max(1, stage3Mods.length)
                );
                const isComplete = avgProgress >= 100;
                const isStarted = avgProgress > 0;
                const isSelected = activeStageDetail === 3;

                return (
                  <div
                    onClick={() => {
                      setActiveStageDetail((prev) => (prev === 3 ? null : 3));
                    }}
                    className={`group cursor-pointer rounded-xl border p-3 transition-all ${
                      isSelected
                        ? 'border-emerald-400/80 bg-white/20 shadow-xs'
                        : isStarted
                          ? 'border-white/20 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/15'
                          : 'border-white/10 bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                      <span className="font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-200">
                        Stage 3
                      </span>
                      <span
                        className={`rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${
                          isComplete
                            ? 'bg-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-200'
                            : isStarted
                              ? 'bg-indigo-500/30 text-indigo-200'
                              : 'bg-white/10 text-indigo-200/80'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {isComplete ? 'Complete' : isStarted ? `${avgProgress}%` : 'Ready'}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <h4 className="mt-1 text-xs font-bold text-white group-hover:text-emerald-300">
                      Pricing, Growth &amp; Finance
                    </h4>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-indigo-100/85">
                      Stress-test breakeven in the Pocket Profit sandbox, plan marketing &amp; build 3-year cashflows.
                    </p>

                    <div className="mt-2.5 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-white/10 pt-2 text-[10px]">
                      <span className="text-emerald-300 font-medium">✓ Pocket Profit &amp; Forecast</span>
                      <Button
                        type="button"
                        size="sm"
                        variant="ghost"
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          onEnterWorkspace('MOD_H_REVENUE', 3);
                        }}
                        className="h-6 px-1.5 text-[10px] text-white hover:bg-white/20 hover:text-white"
                      >
                        Enter Stage →
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })()}

              {/* STAGE 4 */}
              {(() => {
                const stage4Mods = moduleProgressList.filter((m) =>
                  ['MOD_K_GRANTS_FUNDING', 'MOD_L_BUSINESS_PLAN'].includes(m.code)
                );
                const avgProgress = Math.round(
                  stage4Mods.reduce((acc, m) => acc + m.progress, 0) / Math.max(1, stage4Mods.length)
                );
                const isComplete = avgProgress >= 100;
                const isStarted = avgProgress > 0;
                const isSelected = activeStageDetail === 4;

                return (
                  <div
                    onClick={() => {
                      setActiveStageDetail((prev) => (prev === 4 ? null : 4));
                    }}
                    className={`group cursor-pointer rounded-xl border p-3 transition-all ${
                      isSelected
                        ? 'border-emerald-400/80 bg-white/20 shadow-xs'
                        : isStarted
                          ? 'border-white/20 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/15'
                          : 'border-white/10 bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                      <span className="font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-200">
                        Stage 4
                      </span>
                      <span
                        className={`rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${
                          isComplete
                            ? 'bg-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-200'
                            : isStarted
                              ? 'bg-indigo-500/30 text-indigo-200'
                              : 'bg-white/10 text-indigo-200/80'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {isGrantSupported ? (isComplete ? 'Complete' : isStarted ? `${avgProgress}%` : 'Ready') : 'Auto-Synced'}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <h4 className="mt-1 text-xs font-bold text-white group-hover:text-emerald-300">
                      {isGrantSupported
                        ? 'Grants, Master Doc & Plan'
                        : 'Master Blueprint & Plan Studio'}
                    </h4>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-indigo-100/85">
                      {isGrantSupported
                        ? 'Match with non-dilutive grants and compile your official grant & investor-ready dossiers.'
                        : 'Review your living master blueprint and compile investor-ready pitch & commercial plans.'}
                    </p>

                    <div className="mt-2.5 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-white/10 pt-2 text-[10px]">
                      <span className="text-emerald-300 font-medium">✓ 1-Click Master Dossier</span>
                      <Button
                        type="button"
                        size="sm"
                        variant="ghost"
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          if (isGrantSupported) {
                            onEnterWorkspace('MOD_K_GRANTS_FUNDING');
                          } else {
                            onOpenBusinessPlanStudio();
                          }
                        }}
                        className="h-6 px-1.5 text-[10px] text-white hover:bg-white/20 hover:text-white"
                      >
                        {isGrantSupported ? 'Explore Grants →' : 'Open Studio →'}
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })()}
            </div>

            {/* Expandable Stage Details Bar */}
            {activeStageDetail && (
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-white/20 bg-white/10 p-3 text-xs text-white backdrop-blur-xs flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <div>
                  <span className="font-bold text-emerald-300">
                    Stage {activeStageDetail} Inside Focus:
                  </span>
                  <span className="ml-1.5 text-indigo-100/90">
                    {activeStageDetail === 1 &&
                      'Founder Motivations & Fit • Beachhead Persona & Competitor Scout • Bias-Free Mom-Test Customer Survey & QR Kit.'}
                    {activeStageDetail === 2 &&
                      (isGrantSupported
                        ? 'Product Vehicle & V1 Scope • Premises, Equipment & 3-Quote Concierge • Co-Founder Alignment • 6 Launchpad Setup Cards.'
                        : 'Product Vehicle & Lean V1 Scope • Operational Blueprint & Supplier Quotes • Co-Founder Alignment • 6 Launchpad Setup Cards.')}
                    {activeStageDetail === 3 &&
                      'Pocket Profit Breakeven Sandbox • First 10 Customers Marketing Strategy • No-Spreadsheet 36-Month Financial Forecast.'}
                    {activeStageDetail === 4 &&
                      (isGrantSupported
                        ? 'LEO & Innovate UK Grant Matcher • Continuous Living Master Document • Official 5-Mode Business Plan & Grant Compiler.'
                        : 'Continuous Living Master Document • Ask My Startup AI Intelligence • Investor & Commercial Business Plan Studio.')}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  size="sm"
                  variant="ghost"
                  onClick={() => setActiveStageDetail(null)}
                  className="h-6 px-2 text-[11px] text-indigo-200 hover:bg-white/20 hover:text-white"
                >
                  Close Detail ✕
                </Button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* =================================================================== */}

'use client';

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Sparkles,
  HelpCircle,
  Lightbulb,
  ArrowRight,
  ShieldCheck,
  CheckCircle2,
  DollarSign,
  Info,
  Scale,
  Award,
  FileCheck,
  Percent,
  Check,
  Building2,
  RotateCcw,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import {
  type ActiveStartupPlan,
  type InvestorTaxReliefSchemeType,
  type ModuleKStep4TaxReliefSavedData,
} from '@/lib/auth/session-store';
import { generateModuleKStep4TaxReliefAction } from '@/app/actions/module-k';

export interface ModuleKTaxReliefStepProps {
  plan: ActiveStartupPlan;
  isVaultReadonly?: boolean;
  onSaveStep4?: (data: ModuleKStep4TaxReliefSavedData, progress?: number) => Promise<void> | void;
  onBackToStep3?: () => void;
  onContinueToNextStep?: () => void;
}

export function ModuleKTaxReliefStep({
  plan,
  isVaultReadonly,
  onSaveStep4,
  onBackToStep3,
  onContinueToNextStep,
}: ModuleKTaxReliefStepProps) {
  const isUK = plan.hqCountryCode === 'GB';
  const currencySymbol = isUK ? '£' : '€';

  const existingStep4 = plan.moduleKData?.step4TaxRelief;
  const step2 = plan.moduleKData?.step2CapitalStack;

  // Initial scheme selection
  const defaultScheme: InvestorTaxReliefSchemeType = isUK
    ? 'GB_SEIS_SEED_ENTERPRISE'
    : 'IE_EII_EMPLOYMENT_INVESTMENT_INCENTIVE';

  const [primaryTaxScheme, setPrimaryTaxScheme] = useState<InvestorTaxReliefSchemeType>(
    existingStep4?.primaryTaxScheme || defaultScheme
  );
  const [otherTaxSchemeText, setOtherTaxSchemeText] = useState<string>(
    existingStep4?.otherTaxSchemeText || ''
  );

  // Target raise under relief
  const defaultRaise =
    step2?.totalAngelAllocated && step2.totalAngelAllocated > 0
      ? step2.totalAngelAllocated
      : isUK
      ? 150000
      : 100000;

  const [targetReliefRaiseAmount, setTargetReliefRaiseAmount] = useState<number>(
    existingStep4?.targetReliefRaiseAmount || defaultRaise
  );

  // Dynamic relief percentage by scheme
  const investorReliefPercentage = useMemo(() => {
    switch (primaryTaxScheme) {
      case 'GB_SEIS_SEED_ENTERPRISE':
        return 50; // HMRC 50% income tax relief
      case 'GB_EIS_ENTERPRISE_INVESTMENT':
        return 30; // HMRC 30% relief
      case 'IE_SURE_FOUNDER_PAYE_REFUND':
        return 41; // Irish Revenue up to 41% PAYE refund
      case 'IE_EII_EMPLOYMENT_INVESTMENT_INCENTIVE':
        return 50; // Irish Revenue up to 50% relief
      case 'IE_SCIS_SMALL_COMPANY_INVESTMENT':
        return 35;
      default:
        return 50;
    }
  }, [primaryTaxScheme]);

  // Tax savings calculated
  const estimatedInvestorTaxSavings = useMemo(() => {
    return Math.round(targetReliefRaiseAmount * (investorReliefPercentage / 100));
  }, [targetReliefRaiseAmount, investorReliefPercentage]);

  // Irish SURE specific fields
  const [founderPriorEmploymentYearsForSure, setFounderPriorEmploymentYearsForSure] = useState<number>(
    existingStep4?.founderPriorEmploymentYearsForSure || 4
  );
  const [founderEstimatedPayeRefundForSure, setFounderEstimatedPayeRefundForSure] = useState<number>(
    existingStep4?.founderEstimatedPayeRefundForSure || 35000
  );

  // Statutory Qualification Gates
  const [advanceAssuranceStatus, setAdvanceAssuranceStatus] = useState<
    'NOT_STARTED' | 'PREPARING_PACK' | 'SUBMITTED' | 'APPROVED'
  >(existingStep4?.advanceAssuranceStatus || 'PREPARING_PACK');

  const [grossAssetsWithinThreshold, setGrossAssetsWithinThreshold] = useState<boolean>(
    existingStep4?.grossAssetsWithinThreshold ?? true
  );
  const [lessThan250Employees, setLessThan250Employees] = useState<boolean>(
    existingStep4?.lessThan250Employees ?? true
  );
  const [qualifyingTradeStatus, setQualifyingTradeStatus] = useState<
    'QUALIFYING' | 'EXCLUDED_TRADE_CHECK_REQUIRED'
  >(existingStep4?.qualifyingTradeStatus || 'QUALIFYING');

  const [taxCatalystPitchNarrative, setTaxCatalystPitchNarrative] = useState<string>(
    existingStep4?.taxCatalystPitchNarrative || ''
  );
  const [aiAssessorTip, setAiAssessorTip] = useState<string | null>(
    existingStep4?.aiAssessorTip || null
  );

  const [activeWhyCard, setActiveWhyCard] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [activeExampleCard, setActiveExampleCard] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isGeneratingAi, setIsGeneratingAi] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const handleGenerateAiNarrative = async () => {
    if (isVaultReadonly || isGeneratingAi) return;
    setIsGeneratingAi(true);
    try {
      const res = await generateModuleKStep4TaxReliefAction({
        planId: plan.id,
        planTitle: plan.title,
        industryCategory: plan.industryCategory || 'Startup',
        hqCountryCode: (plan.hqCountryCode as any) || 'IE',
        primaryTaxScheme,
        targetReliefRaiseAmount,
        investorReliefPercentage,
        estimatedInvestorTaxSavings:
          primaryTaxScheme === 'IE_SURE_FOUNDER_PAYE_REFUND'
            ? founderEstimatedPayeRefundForSure
            : estimatedInvestorTaxSavings,
        founderPriorEmploymentYearsForSure:
          primaryTaxScheme === 'IE_SURE_FOUNDER_PAYE_REFUND'
            ? founderPriorEmploymentYearsForSure
            : undefined,
        founderEstimatedPayeRefundForSure:
          primaryTaxScheme === 'IE_SURE_FOUNDER_PAYE_REFUND'
            ? founderEstimatedPayeRefundForSure
            : undefined,
        advanceAssuranceStatus,
        currencySymbol,
      });

      if (res?.narrative) {
        setTaxCatalystPitchNarrative(res.narrative);
        if (res.assessorStrategyTip) {
          setAiAssessorTip(res.assessorStrategyTip);
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[Module K] AI Step 4 tax relief narrative failed:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsGeneratingAi(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSaveStep4 = async () => {
    if (isVaultReadonly) return;
    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      const payload: ModuleKStep4TaxReliefSavedData = {
        primaryTaxScheme,
        otherTaxSchemeText: primaryTaxScheme === 'OTHER' ? otherTaxSchemeText : undefined,
        targetReliefRaiseAmount,
        investorReliefPercentage,
        estimatedInvestorTaxSavings,
        founderPriorEmploymentYearsForSure:
          primaryTaxScheme === 'IE_SURE_FOUNDER_PAYE_REFUND'
            ? founderPriorEmploymentYearsForSure
            : undefined,
        founderEstimatedPayeRefundForSure:
          primaryTaxScheme === 'IE_SURE_FOUNDER_PAYE_REFUND'
            ? founderEstimatedPayeRefundForSure
            : undefined,
        advanceAssuranceStatus,
        grossAssetsWithinThreshold,
        lessThan250Employees,
        qualifyingTradeStatus,
        taxCatalystPitchNarrative,
        aiAssessorTip: aiAssessorTip || undefined,
      };

      if (onSaveStep4) {
        await onSaveStep4(payload, 80);
      }
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* 4-Layer Support Strip: Why & Example */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 pt-1">
        <Button
          type="button"
          size="sm"
          variant="outline"
          onClick={() => setActiveWhyCard((prev) => !prev)}
          className="h-7 border-indigo-200 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-50"
        >
          <HelpCircle className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          Why Are We Asking This?
        </Button>
        <Button
          type="button"
          size="sm"
          variant="outline"
          onClick={() => setActiveExampleCard((prev) => !prev)}
          className="h-7 border-emerald-200 text-[11px] font-medium text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-50"
        >
          <Lightbulb className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          Show Me an Investor Pitch Example
        </Button>
        <Button
          type="button"
          size="sm"
          variant="outline"
          onClick={handleGenerateAiNarrative}
          disabled={isGeneratingAi || isVaultReadonly}
          className="h-7 border-violet-200 bg-violet-50/60 text-[11px] font-medium text-violet-700 hover:bg-violet-100"
        >
          <Sparkles className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-violet-600" />
          {isGeneratingAi ? 'Synthesizing Tax Strategy...' : 'Auto-Generate Tax Pitch with AI'}
        </Button>
      </div>

      {activeWhyCard && (
        <div className="relative rounded-lg border border-indigo-100 bg-indigo-50/70 p-3.5 text-xs text-indigo-900">
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveWhyCard(false)}
            className="absolute right-2 top-2 text-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-600"
          >
            ✕
          </button>
          <p className="font-semibold text-indigo-950">
            How State Tax Relief Turns "Maybe" Angels into Immediate "Yes":
          </p>
          <p className="mt-1 leading-relaxed">
            In the UK and Ireland, government tax relief is the single most powerful fundraising catalyst.
            Under <strong>UK SEIS</strong>, an angel investing £10,000 immediately gets £5,000 refunded by HMRC off their income tax bill,
            reducing their actual downside risk to just 27.5p per £1.
            In Ireland, <strong>Revenue SURE</strong> allows founders leaving a job to reclaim up to 41% of prior PAYE income tax, injecting

              <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">
                {primaryTaxScheme === 'IE_SURE_FOUNDER_PAYE_REFUND'

                  : 'Investor Value Catalyst & Tax Savings Engine'}

      <div className="space-y-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">

            <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800">

            variant="outline"
            onClick={handleGenerateAiNarrative}
            disabled={isGeneratingAi || isVaultReadonly}
            className="h-7 border-violet-200 bg-violet-50 text-[11px] font-semibold text-violet-700 hover:bg-violet-100"
          >
            <Sparkles className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-violet-600" />
            {isGeneratingAi ? 'Synthesizing...' : 'Calibrate Tax Pitch with AI'}
          </Button>
        </div>

        <textarea
          value={taxCatalystPitchNarrative}
          onChange={(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) =>
            setTaxCatalystPitchNarrative(e.target.value)
          }
          placeholder={`e.g., To accelerate private angel participation, ${plan.title} is raising ${currencySymbol}${targetReliefRaiseAmount.toLocaleString()} under ${primaryTaxScheme.replace(/_/g, ' ')}. Qualifying investors receive ${investorReliefPercentage}% upfront income tax relief (${currencySymbol}${estimatedInvestorTaxSavings.toLocaleString()} in immediate tax deduction), alongside 0% capital gains tax and downside loss relief...`}
          className="flex min-h-[90px] w-full rounded-md border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-900 shadow-xs placeholder:text-slate-400 focus-visible:outline-hidden focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 resize-y"
          disabled={isVaultReadonly}
        />

        {aiAssessorTip && (
          <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-amber-200/80 bg-amber-50/70 p-3 text-[11px] text-amber-900">
            <Info className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-amber-600 mt-0.5" />
            <div className="space-y-0.5">
              <span className="font-semibold text-amber-950">Angel Underwriting Insider Tip:</span>
              <p className="leading-relaxed text-amber-900/90">{aiAssessorTip}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* 5. BOTTOM TOOLBAR: SAVE & ADVANCE                                         */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-slate-100 pt-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {onBackToStep3 && (
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={onBackToStep3}
              className="text-xs font-semibold"
            >
              ← Back to Step 3: Reimbursement Bridge
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            onClick={handleSaveStep4}
            disabled={isSaving || isVaultReadonly}
            className="text-xs font-semibold"
          >
            {isSaving ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Tax Relief Strategy'}
          </Button>

          {onContinueToNextStep && (
            <Button
              type="button"
              size="sm"
              onClick={async () => {
                await handleSaveStep4();
                onContinueToNextStep();
              }}
              className="bg-indigo-600 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-indigo-700"
            >
              Continue to Step 5: Funding Brief
              <ArrowRight className="ml-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export interface ModuleGWorkspaceProps {
  plan: {
    id: string;
    title?: string;
    name?: string;
    oneLinerSummary?: string;
    elevatorPitch?: string;
    conceptCanvas?: SavedConceptCanvas;
  };
  selectedCountry?: string; // 'IE' | 'GB' | 'OTHER'
  isVaultReadonly?: boolean;
  initialData?: ModuleGData;
  onSave?: (data: ModuleGData) => Promise<void>;
  onBackToModuleF?: () => void;
  onContinueToModuleH?: () => void;
  initialStep?: number;
  highlightTarget?: string;
}

export function ModuleGWorkspace({
  plan,
  selectedCountry = 'IE',
  isVaultReadonly = false,
  initialData,
  onSave,
  onBackToModuleF,
  onContinueToModuleH,
  initialStep,
  highlightTarget,
}: ModuleGWorkspaceProps) {
  const [data, setData] = useState<ModuleGData>(() => {
    const defaults = getDefaultModuleGData();
    if (!initialData) return defaults;
    return {
      ...defaults,
      ...initialData,
      step1: { ...defaults.step1, ...(initialData.step1 || {}) },
      step2: { ...defaults.step2, ...(initialData.step2 || {}) },
      step3: { ...defaults.step3, ...(initialData.step3 || {}) },
      step4: { ...defaults.step4, ...(initialData.step4 || {}) },
      step5: { ...defaults.step5, ...(initialData.step5 || {}) },
      step6: { ...defaults.step6, ...(initialData.step6 || {}) },
    };
  });
  const isFirstRenderRef = React.useRef(true);
  // Step Accordion View State: 0 = all collapsed by default, 1..7, or 'ALL'
  const [openStep, setOpenStep] = useState<number | 'ALL'>(() => {
    if (initialStep && initialStep >= 1 && initialStep <= 7) {
      return initialStep;
    }
    return 0;
  });

  // Handle deep-link scrolling and highlight
  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialStep && initialStep >= 1 && initialStep <= 7) {
      setOpenStep(initialStep);
      setTimeout(() => {
        const targetId = highlightTarget || `mod-g-step-${initialStep}`;
        const el = document.getElementById(targetId);
        if (el) {
          el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
          el.classList.remove('attention-highlight');
          void el.offsetWidth;
          el.classList.add('attention-highlight');
          setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('attention-highlight'), 3000);
        }
      }, 250);
    }
  }, [initialStep, highlightTarget]);
  const [isCopiedBrief, setIsCopiedBrief] = useState(false);
  const [activeWhyCard, setActiveWhyCard] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [activeExampleCard, setActiveExampleCard] = useState<number | null>(null);

  // Step 2: Live Domain Availability Checker -> Referral Claim -> Save Back State
  const [domainSearchInput, setDomainSearchInput] = useState<string>(() => {
    const raw =
      initialData?.step2?.primaryDomain ||
      plan.title ||
      plan.name ||
      '';
    return raw
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/^https?:\/\//, '')
      .replace(/^www\./, '')
      .split('.')[0]
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9-]/g, '');
  });
  const [isCheckingDomains, setIsCheckingDomains] = useState(false);
  const [domainCheckResults, setDomainCheckResults] = useState<
    Array<{
      domain: string;
      tld: string;
      status?: 'AVAILABLE' | 'TAKEN';
      available?: boolean;
      statusLabel?: string;
      reason?: string;
      notes?: string;
    }>
  >([]);
  const [selectedDomainForClaim, setSelectedDomainForClaim] = useState<string>(
    () => initialData?.step2?.primaryDomain || ''
  );
  const [domainSavedConfirmation, setDomainSavedConfirmation] = useState<string | null>(
    null
  );

  const handleCheckDomainAvailability = async (customQuery?: string) => {
    const queryToUse = (customQuery ?? domainSearchInput).trim();
    if (!queryToUse || queryToUse.length < 2) return;
    setIsCheckingDomains(true);
    setDomainSavedConfirmation(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(
        `/api/domains/check?q=${encodeURIComponent(queryToUse)}`
      );
      const json = await res.json();
      if (Array.isArray(json.results)) {
        setDomainCheckResults(json.results);
        const preferredTld = normalizedCountry === 'GB' ? '.co.uk' : '.ie';
        const isItemAvail = (r: { status?: string; available?: boolean }) =>
          r.status === 'AVAILABLE' || r.available === true;
        const availablePreferred = json.results.find(
          (r: { status?: string; available?: boolean; tld: string; domain: string }) =>
            isItemAvail(r) && r.tld === preferredTld
        );
        const firstAvailable =
          availablePreferred ||
          json.results.find(
            (r: { status?: string; available?: boolean; domain: string }) =>
              isItemAvail(r)
          );
        if (firstAvailable && !selectedDomainForClaim) {
          setSelectedDomainForClaim(firstAvailable.domain);
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // Fallback deterministic local preview if offline
      const base = queryToUse
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(/[^a-z0-9-]/g, '')
        .slice(0, 32);
      const fallback = ['.ie', '.co.uk', '.com', '.io'].map((tld) => ({
        domain: `${base}${tld}`,
        tld,
        status: 'AVAILABLE' as const,
        reason: 'No active DNS SOA/A records found (Likely Available)',
      }));
      setDomainCheckResults(fallback);
      if (!selectedDomainForClaim && fallback[0]) {
        setSelectedDomainForClaim(fallback[0].domain);
      }
    } finally {
      setIsCheckingDomains(false);
    }
  };

  const handleConfirmAndSaveClaimedDomain = (domainToSave?: string) => {
    const cleanDomain = (domainToSave || selectedDomainForClaim || '')
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/^https?:\/\//, '')
      .replace(/^www\./, '');
    if (!cleanDomain) return;

    const currentEmail = data.step2.officialBusinessEmail.trim();
    const shouldSuggestOfficialEmail =
      !currentEmail ||
      currentEmail.includes('@gmail.com') ||
      currentEmail.includes('@hotmail.com') ||
      currentEmail.includes('@yahoo.com');

    setData((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      step2: {
        ...prev.step2,
        state: 'ALREADY_HAVE',
        primaryDomain: cleanDomain,
        isDomainLive: true,
        officialBusinessEmail: shouldSuggestOfficialEmail
          ? `founder@${cleanDomain}`
          : prev.step2.officialBusinessEmail,
      },
    }));
    setSelectedDomainForClaim(cleanDomain);
    setDomainSavedConfirmation(cleanDomain);
    setTimeout(() => setDomainSavedConfirmation(null), 4500);
  };

  // Auto-detect country code normalize
  const normalizedCountry = selectedCountry === 'GB' || selectedCountry === 'UK' ? 'GB' : selectedCountry === 'IE' ? 'IE' : 'ALL';

  // Active Formation In-Progress Flag (User placed concierge order, awaiting CRO/CRN issue)
  const hasActiveIncorporationOrder =
    Boolean(data.step1.incorporationOrder) && data.step1.state !== 'ALREADY_HAVE';

  // Step 1: Legal Readiness Check
  const isStep1Done =
    data.step1.state === 'ALREADY_HAVE'
      ? !!data.step1.registeredEntityName.trim() && !!data.step1.registrationNumber.trim()
      : !!data.step1.incorporationOrder || !!data.step1.targetFormationTimeline;

  // Step 2: Domain & Email Readiness Check
  const isGmailDetected =
    data.step2.officialBusinessEmail.toLowerCase().includes('@gmail.com') ||
    data.step2.officialBusinessEmail.toLowerCase().includes('@hotmail.com') ||
    data.step2.officialBusinessEmail.toLowerCase().includes('@yahoo.com');

  const isStep2Done =
    data.step2.state === 'ALREADY_HAVE'
      ? !!data.step2.primaryDomain.trim() && !!data.step2.officialBusinessEmail.trim()
      : !!data.step2.primaryDomain.trim() || !!data.step2.emailProvider;

  // Step 3: Bank Readiness Check
  const isStep3Done =
    data.step3.state === 'ALREADY_HAVE'
      ? !!data.step3.bankProvider && (data.step3.hasDedicatedIban || !!data.step3.ibanLast4.trim())
      : !!data.step3.targetOpeningTimeline;

  // Step 4: Accounting & VAT Readiness Check
  const isStep4Done =
    data.step4.state === 'ALREADY_HAVE'
      ? !!data.step4.softwareChoice || data.step4.hasAccountant
      : !!data.step4.vatStatus;

  // Step 5: Insurance Readiness Check
  const isStep5Done =
    data.step5.state === 'ALREADY_HAVE'
      ? data.step5.hasPublicLiability || data.step5.hasProfessionalIndemnity || !!data.step5.currentInsurerName.trim()
      : !!data.step5.targetCoverageTimeline;

  // Step 6: Legal & IP Readiness Check
  const isStep6Done =
    data.step6.state === 'ALREADY_HAVE'
      ? data.step6.hasIpAssignmentSigned || data.step6.hasPrivacyPolicy
      : !!data.step6.legalAdvisorOrPlatform || data.step6.hasIpAssignmentSigned;

  const readinessChecks = [
    { num: 1, title: 'Legal Entity & Registration', done: isStep1Done, state: data.step1.state, inProgress: hasActiveIncorporationOrder },
    { num: 2, title: 'Domain & Official Email', done: isStep2Done, state: data.step2.state, inProgress: false },
    { num: 3, title: 'Dedicated Business Banking', done: isStep3Done, state: data.step3.state, inProgress: false },
    { num: 4, title: 'Bookkeeping, VAT & Payroll', done: isStep4Done, state: data.step4.state, inProgress: false },
    { num: 5, title: 'Statutory Startup Insurance', done: isStep5Done, state: data.step5.state, inProgress: false },
    { num: 6, title: 'Baseline IP & GDPR Compliance', done: isStep6Done, state: data.step6.state, inProgress: false },
  ];

  const completedCoreStepsCount = readinessChecks.filter((s) => s.done).length;
  // Calculate an Operations Readiness percentage (0 - 100%)
  const opsReadinessScore = Math.round((completedCoreStepsCount / 6) * 100);

  // Auto-persist Module G Launchpad edits to session & Cloud SQL via parent onSave
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isFirstRenderRef.current) {
      isFirstRenderRef.current = false;
      return;
    }
    if (isVaultReadonly || !onSave) return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      onSave(data);
    }, 450);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [data, isVaultReadonly, onSave]);

  const handleCopyOperationsBrief = () => {
    const brief = `### STARTUP PREFLIGHT — MODULE G: LAUNCHPAD & OPERATIONS BRIEF
**Company Name:** ${data.step1.registeredEntityName || plan.name || 'Startup'}
**HQ Jurisdiction:** ${normalizedCountry === 'IE' ? 'Ireland (CRO)' : normalizedCountry === 'GB' ? 'United Kingdom (Companies House)' : 'International'}
**Operations Readiness Score:** ${opsReadinessScore}% (${completedCoreStepsCount}/6 Setup Pillars Ready)

1. LEGAL ENTITY & REGISTRATION:
- Status: ${data.step1.state === 'ALREADY_HAVE' ? 'Already Registered' : 'Formation In Progress'}
- Entity Structure: ${data.step1.legalStructure === 'OTHER' ? data.step1.customLegalStructure : data.step1.legalStructure}
- Registration Number: ${data.step1.registrationNumber || 'Pending'}
- Timeline: ${data.step1.targetFormationTimeline}

2. DOMAIN & OFFICIAL EMAIL:
- Web Domain: ${data.step2.primaryDomain || 'Pending purchase'}
- Official Email: ${data.step2.officialBusinessEmail || 'Pending setup'}
- Mail Provider: ${data.step2.emailProvider}

3. DEDICATED BUSINESS BANKING:
- Provider: ${data.step3.bankProvider === 'OTHER' ? data.step3.customBankProvider : data.step3.bankProvider}
- Dedicated Account/IBAN: ${data.step3.hasDedicatedIban ? 'Yes' : 'In Setup'}

4. BOOKKEEPING, VAT & PAYROLL:
- Software: ${data.step4.softwareChoice}
- Dedicated Accountant: ${data.step4.hasAccountant ? data.step4.accountantFirmName || 'Yes' : 'DIY Software'}
- VAT Registration Status: ${data.step4.vatStatus}

5. STATUTORY INSURANCE:
- Public Liability: ${data.step5.hasPublicLiability ? 'Active' : 'Pending'}
- Professional Indemnity: ${data.step5.hasProfessionalIndemnity ? 'Active' : 'Pending'}
- Target Coverage: ${data.step5.targetCoverageTimeline}

6. IP & GDPR COMPLIANCE:
- Founder IP Assignment: ${data.step6.hasIpAssignmentSigned ? 'Signed & Assigned' : 'Action Required'}
- Website Privacy & Terms: ${data.step6.hasPrivacyPolicy ? 'Active' : 'Pending'}
`;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(brief);
    setIsCopiedBrief(true);
    setTimeout(() => setIsCopiedBrief(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 pb-20">
      {/* Top Header Module Card */}
      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-indigo-200 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-950 via-indigo-900 to-violet-900 p-6 text-white shadow-sm">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="space-y-1.5 min-w-0 flex-1">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <Badge className="border-indigo-400/40 bg-indigo-500/30 text-indigo-100">
                Module G • Getting Set Up (Launchpad &amp; Operations Hub)
              </Badge>
              <Badge className="border-emerald-400/30 bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-200">
                <Sparkles className="mr-1 h-3 w-3" />
                From Concept to Legally Operational Firm
              </Badge>
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white sm:text-2xl">
              Getting Set Up: Launchpad &amp; Operations Hub
            </h1>
            <p className="max-w-2xl text-xs text-indigo-100/90 sm:text-sm">
              Establish the 6 statutory operational foundations required by state grant bodies, investors, and banking institutions before taking paying customer revenue.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => setOpenStep((prev) => (prev === 'ALL' ? 0 : 'ALL'))}
                className="border-indigo-400/40 bg-white/10 text-xs text-white hover:bg-white/20"
              >
                {openStep === 'ALL' ? 'Collapse All Steps' : 'Expand All Steps'}
              </Button>
              {onBackToModuleF && (
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={onBackToModuleF}
                  className="border-indigo-400/40 bg-white/10 text-xs text-white hover:bg-white/20"
                >
                  <ArrowLeft className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  Back to Module F
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
            <div className="text-right text-[11px] text-indigo-200">
              Operations Readiness: <strong className="text-emerald-300">{opsReadinessScore}%</strong> ({completedCoreStepsCount} of 6 Setup Pillars Ready)
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 7-Step Navigation Strip */}
        <div className="mt-5 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 border-t border-indigo-800/70 pt-4 sm:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-7">
          {[
            { step: 'Step 1', title: 'Legal Entity', targetId: 'mod-g-step-1', stepNum: 1, done: isStep1Done },
            { step: 'Step 2', title: 'Domain & Email', targetId: 'mod-g-step-2', stepNum: 2, done: isStep2Done },
            { step: 'Step 3', title: 'Business Banking', targetId: 'mod-g-step-3', stepNum: 3, done: isStep3Done },
            { step: 'Step 4', title: 'VAT & Accounts', targetId: 'mod-g-step-4', stepNum: 4, done: isStep4Done },
            { step: 'Step 5', title: 'Insurance', targetId: 'mod-g-step-5', stepNum: 5, done: isStep5Done },
            { step: 'Step 6', title: 'Legal & IP', targetId: 'mod-g-step-6', stepNum: 6, done: isStep6Done },
            { step: 'Overview', title: 'Operations Brief', targetId: 'mod-g-step-7', stepNum: 7, done: opsReadinessScore >= 80 },
          ].map((item) => {
            const isStepOpen = openStep === 'ALL' || openStep === item.stepNum;
            return (
              <button
                key={item.step}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setOpenStep(item.stepNum);
                  setTimeout(() => {
                    const el = document.getElementById(item.targetId);
                    if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                  }, 40);
                }}
                className={`rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs transition-all hover:border-white/50 hover:bg-white/15 ${
                  isStepOpen
                    ? 'border-amber-300/80 bg-white/20 text-white shadow-xs ring-1 ring-amber-300/50'
                    : item.stepNum === 1 && hasActiveIncorporationOrder
                      ? 'border-amber-400/50 bg-amber-950/40 text-amber-200'
                      : item.done
                        ? 'border-emerald-400/40 bg-emerald-950/30 text-emerald-100'
                        : 'border-indigo-800/60 bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-300/70'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-white/90 text-xs">{item.step}</span>
                  {item.stepNum === 1 && hasActiveIncorporationOrder ? (
                    <span className="rounded-full bg-amber-400/20 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-300">
                      In Progress
                    </span>
                  ) : item.done ? (
                    <Check className="h-3 w-3 text-emerald-400" />
                  ) : (
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-indigo-300/60">Pending</span>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="mt-0.5 truncate text-[11px] text-indigo-100/80">{item.title}</div>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* STEP 1: LEGAL ENTITY & REGISTRATION */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      <section id="mod-g-step-1" className="scroll-mt-24">
        {openStep !== 'ALL' && openStep !== 1 ? (
          <div
            onClick={() => setOpenStep(1)}
            className="group scroll-mt-24 cursor-pointer rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-xs transition-all hover:border-indigo-300 hover:shadow-sm"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div
                  className={`flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-xs font-bold ${
                    data.step1.state === 'ALREADY_HAVE'
                      ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                      : hasActiveIncorporationOrder
                        ? 'bg-amber-500 text-white shadow-2xs'
                        : isStep1Done
                          ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                          : 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                  }`}
                >
                  {data.step1.state === 'ALREADY_HAVE' ? (
                    <Check className="h-4 w-4" />
                  ) : hasActiveIncorporationOrder ? (
                    <Clock className="h-4 w-4" />
                  ) : isStep1Done ? (
                    <Check className="h-4 w-4" />
                  ) : (
                    '1'
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <h2 className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 group-hover:text-indigo-600">
                    Step 1: Legal Entity &amp; Company Registration
                  </h2>
                  <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-xs text-slate-500">
                    {data.step1.state === 'ALREADY_HAVE'
                      ? `Registered ${data.step1.legalStructure} • ${data.step1.registeredEntityName || 'Entity on file'} (${data.step1.registrationNumber || 'CRN recorded'})`
                      : hasActiveIncorporationOrder
                        ? `Setup In Progress • Formation Order with ${data.step1.incorporationOrder?.partnerName || 'Partner'} • Awaiting CRO/CRN Number`
                        : `Setting Up • Target: ${data.step1.targetFormationTimeline.replace(/_/g, ' ')}`}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                <Badge
                  variant="outline"
                  className={
                    data.step1.state === 'ALREADY_HAVE'
                      ? 'border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 text-[10px] text-emerald-800'
                      : hasActiveIncorporationOrder
                        ? 'border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-900 flex items-center gap-1.5'
                        : isStep1Done
                          ? 'border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 text-[10px] text-emerald-800'
                          : 'border-slate-300 text-[10px] text-slate-600'
                  }
                >
                  {hasActiveIncorporationOrder && (
                    <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500 animate-pulse" />
                  )}
                  {data.step1.state === 'ALREADY_HAVE'
                    ? 'Registered'
                    : hasActiveIncorporationOrder
                      ? 'Setup In Progress'
                      : isStep1Done
                        ? 'Configured'
                        : 'Needs Setup'}
                </Badge>
                <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="h-8 shrink-0 px-2.5 text-xs font-medium text-indigo-600 group-hover:bg-indigo-50">
                  <span>{hasActiveIncorporationOrder ? 'Track Status & Add CRN' : isStep1Done ? 'Edit Step' : 'Open Step'}</span>
                  <ChevronDown className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <Card className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-xs">
            <CardHeader className="border-b border-slate-100 pb-4">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div
                    className={`flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-xs font-bold ${
                      isStep1Done ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white' : 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {isStep1Done ? <Check className="h-4 w-4" /> : '1'}
                  </div>
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <CardTitle className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
                        Step 1: Legal Entity &amp; Company Registration
                      </CardTitle>
                      <Badge className="shrink-0 text-[10px] font-medium border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700">
                        {normalizedCountry === 'IE' ? 'CRO (Ireland)' : normalizedCountry === 'GB' ? 'Companies House (UK)' : 'Corporate Registry'}
                      </Badge>
                    </div>
                    <CardDescription className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-600">
                      Determine whether you are operating as an incorporated entity (LTD/DAC) or sole trader. Mandatory for Irish LEO/EI grants and UK tax relief (SEIS).
                    </CardDescription>
                  </div>
                </div>
                {openStep !== 'ALL' && (
                  <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setOpenStep(0)} className="text-xs text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-100">
                    <span>Collapse Step</span>
                    <ChevronUp className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-6 pt-5">
              {/* Two-State Pill Selector */}
              <div>
                <Label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">Current Status of this Entity</Label>
                <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setData({ ...data, step1: { ...data.step1, state: 'ALREADY_HAVE' } })}
                    className={`flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border p-3.5 text-left transition-all ${
                      data.step1.state === 'ALREADY_HAVE'
                        ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50/60 ring-1 ring-indigo-600'
                        : 'border-slate-200 bg-white hover:border-slate-300'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="mt-0.5 rounded-full p-1 bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700">
                      <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">I Already Have This Registered</div>
                      <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">I have a registered company number (CRO / Companies House CRN)</div>
                    </div>
                  </button>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setData({ ...data, step1: { ...data.step1, state: 'HELP_SETUP' } })}
                    className={`flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border p-3.5 text-left transition-all ${
                      data.step1.state === 'HELP_SETUP'
                        ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50/60 ring-1 ring-indigo-600'
                        : 'border-slate-200 bg-white hover:border-slate-300'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className={`mt-0.5 rounded-full p-1 ${hasActiveIncorporationOrder ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800' : 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700'}`}>
                      {hasActiveIncorporationOrder ? <Clock className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> : <Sparkles className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
                        {hasActiveIncorporationOrder ? 'Setup In Progress (Paid Order)' : 'Help Me Set This Up'}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                        {hasActiveIncorporationOrder
                          ? `Order dispatched to ${data.step1.incorporationOrder?.partnerName || 'Partner'} • Awaiting CRO/CRN`
                          : 'Guide me through incorporation options, timelines and official registrars'}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* State A: Already Have This */}
              {data.step1.state === 'ALREADY_HAVE' ? (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-emerald-100 bg-emerald-50/20 p-4 space-y-4">
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                    <div className="space-y-1.5">
                      <Label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">Legal Entity Type</Label>
                      <select
                        value={data.step1.legalStructure}
                        onChange={(e) => setData({ ...data, step1: { ...data.step1, legalStructure: e.target.value as any } })}
                        className="w-full rounded-md border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-900 shadow-2xs focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-hidden"
                      >
                        <option value="LTD">Private Limited Company (LTD)</option>
                        <option value="DAC">Designated Activity Company (DAC - IE)</option>
                        <option value="SOLE_TRADER">Sole Trader / Partnership</option>
                        <option value="LLP">Limited Liability Partnership (LLP - UK)</option>
                        <option value="OTHER">Other / Hybrid Structure</option>
                      </select>
                    </div>

                    <div className="space-y-1.5 sm:col-span-2">
                      <Label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">Official Registered Name</Label>
                      <Input
                        value={data.step1.registeredEntityName}
                        onChange={(e) => setData({ ...data, step1: { ...data.step1, registeredEntityName: e.target.value } })}
                        placeholder="e.g. Acme Innovations Technologies Limited"
                        className="text-xs"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {data.step1.legalStructure === 'OTHER' && (
                    <div className="space-y-1.5">
                      <Label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">Specify Custom Structure</Label>
                      <Input
                        value={data.step1.customLegalStructure || ''}
                        onChange={(e) => setData({ ...data, step1: { ...data.step1, customLegalStructure: e.target.value } })}
                        placeholder="e.g. Community Interest Company (CIC) or CLG"
                        className="text-xs"
                      />
                    </div>
                  )}

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                    <div className="space-y-1.5">
                      <Label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                        {normalizedCountry === 'IE' ? 'CRO Registration Number' : 'Companies House Number (CRN)'}
                      </Label>
                      <Input
                        value={data.step1.registrationNumber}
                        onChange={(e) => setData({ ...data, step1: { ...data.step1, registrationNumber: e.target.value } })}
                        placeholder={normalizedCountry === 'IE' ? 'e.g. 712345' : 'e.g. 14598210'}
                        className="text-xs font-mono"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-1.5">
                      <Label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">Date of Incorporation</Label>
                      <Input
                        type="date"
                        value={data.step1.registrationDate}
                        onChange={(e) => setData({ ...data, step1: { ...data.step1, registrationDate: e.target.value } })}
                        className="text-xs"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {data.step1.incorporationOrder && (
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg border border-emerald-200/70 bg-emerald-50/60 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-emerald-900">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
                        <span>
                          Incorporation fulfilled via <strong>{data.step1.incorporationOrder.partnerName}</strong> • Stripe Ref: <span className="font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold">{data.step1.incorporationOrder.stripePaymentRef}</span>
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <span className="font-semibold text-emerald-700">
                        {data.step1.incorporationOrder.currency === 'GBP' ? '£' : '€'}
                        {data.step1.incorporationOrder.totalPaidAmount} Paid
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              ) : hasActiveIncorporationOrder && data.step1.incorporationOrder ? (
                /* State B1: Formation Order In Progress (Clutter Removed) */
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <div className="rounded-2xl border-2 border-amber-300 bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-50/80 via-white to-orange-50/30 p-5 shadow-xs space-y-4">
                    {/* Header Banner */}
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3 border-b border-amber-200/70 pb-3.5">
                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                          <Badge className="bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-600 text-[10px] font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-2xs">
                            <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-white animate-pulse" />
                            Setup In Progress
                          </Badge>
                          <Badge
                            variant="outline"
                            className="border-amber-300 bg-white font-mono text-[10px] text-amber-900"
                          >
                            Stripe Ref: {data.step1.incorporationOrder.stripePaymentRef}
                          </Badge>
                        </div>
                        <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
                          Company Formation Dispatched to {data.step1.incorporationOrder.partnerName}
                        </h3>
                        <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">
                          Your filing dossier has been emailed to the formation desk. Once your Certificate of Incorporation is issued by the registrar, enter your official number below to complete this setup pillar.
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-right">
                        <div className="text-lg font-extrabold text-slate-900">
                          {data.step1.incorporationOrder.currency === 'GBP' ? '£' : '€'}
                          {data.step1.incorporationOrder.totalPaidAmount} Paid
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                          {new Date(data.step1.incorporationOrder.paidAt).toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
                            year: 'numeric',
                            month: 'short',
                            day: 'numeric',
                          })}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Order Snapshot Cards */}
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200/90 bg-white/90 p-3 shadow-2xs">
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">1st Choice Company Name</span>
                        <div className="mt-0.5 truncate text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
                          {data.step1.incorporationOrder.companyChoice1}
                        </div>
                        {data.step1.incorporationOrder.companyChoice2 && (
                          <div className="mt-0.5 truncate text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                            Backup: {data.step1.incorporationOrder.companyChoice2}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200/90 bg-white/90 p-3 shadow-2xs">
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">Formation Desk</span>
                        <div className="mt-0.5 truncate text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
                          {data.step1.incorporationOrder.partnerName}
                        </div>
                        <div className="mt-0.5 truncate font-mono text-[11px] text-indigo-700">
                          {data.step1.incorporationOrder.recipientEmail}
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200/90 bg-white/90 p-3 shadow-2xs">
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">Applicant Contact</span>
                        <div className="mt-0.5 truncate text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
                          {data.step1.incorporationOrder.founderName}
                        </div>
                        <div className="mt-0.5 truncate font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                          {data.step1.incorporationOrder.founderEmail}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* 3-Stage Visual Progress Tracker */}
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3 pt-1">
                      {/* Stage 1: Payment */}
                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-emerald-200 bg-white p-3.5 space-y-1.5 shadow-2xs">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-700">
                            Stage 1 • Payment
                          </span>
                          <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
                          Stripe Payment Confirmed
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-600 leading-snug">
                          {data.step1.incorporationOrder.currency === 'GBP' ? '£' : '€'}
                          {data.step1.incorporationOrder.totalPaidAmount} paid in full. Confirmation email sent to your inbox.
                        </p>
                      </div>

                      {/* Stage 2: Partner Filing */}
                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-emerald-200 bg-white p-3.5 space-y-1.5 shadow-2xs">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-700">
                            Stage 2 • Filing Desk
                          </span>
                          <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
                          Dossier Dispatched
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-600 leading-snug">
                          Emailed to {data.step1.incorporationOrder.partnerName} desk (CC: {data.step1.incorporationOrder.founderEmail}).
                        </p>
                      </div>

                      {/* Stage 3: Registry Number */}
                      <div className="rounded-xl border-2 border-indigo-400 bg-indigo-50/70 p-3.5 space-y-2 shadow-2xs ring-1 ring-indigo-200">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-700">
                            Stage 3 • Official CRN
                          </span>
                          <Clock className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-600 shrink-0" />
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
                          Awaiting Registry CRN
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-600 leading-snug">
                          {normalizedCountry === 'IE'
                            ? 'CRO turnaround is typically 3–5 working days.'
                            : 'Companies House turnaround is typically 24–48 hours.'}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Stage 3 Action Form: Record Official CRN */}
