                >
                  <span>Next: Legal &amp; IP</span>
                  <ArrowRight className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                </Button>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        )}
      </section>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* STEP 6: BASELINE LEGAL, IP & GDPR ESSENTIALS */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      <section id="mod-g-step-6" className="scroll-mt-24">
        {openStep !== 'ALL' && openStep !== 6 ? (
          <div
            onClick={() => setOpenStep(6)}
            className="group scroll-mt-24 cursor-pointer rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-xs transition-all hover:border-indigo-300 hover:shadow-sm"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div
                  className={`flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-xs font-bold ${
                    isStep6Done ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white' : 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                  }`}
                >
                  {isStep6Done ? <Check className="h-4 w-4" /> : '6'}
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <h2 className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 group-hover:text-indigo-600">
                    Step 6: Baseline Legal, IP &amp; GDPR Essentials
                  </h2>
                  <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-xs text-slate-500">
                    {data.step6.hasIpAssignmentSigned ? 'Founder IP Assignment Signed' : 'IP Assignment pending'} • GDPR: {data.step6.hasPrivacyPolicy ? 'Privacy policy live' : 'In setup'}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                <Badge
                  variant="outline"
                  className={
                    isStep6Done
                      ? 'border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 text-[10px] text-emerald-800'
                      : 'border-slate-300 text-[10px] text-slate-600'
                  }
                >
                  {isStep6Done ? 'Configured' : 'Needs Setup'}
                </Badge>
                <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="h-8 shrink-0 px-2.5 text-xs font-medium text-indigo-600 group-hover:bg-indigo-50">
                  <span>{isStep6Done ? 'Edit Step' : 'Open Step'}</span>
                  <ChevronDown className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <Card className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-xs">
            <CardHeader className="border-b border-slate-100 pb-4">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div
                    className={`flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-xs font-bold ${
                      isStep6Done ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white' : 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {isStep6Done ? <Check className="h-4 w-4" /> : '6'}
                  </div>
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <CardTitle className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
                      Step 6: Baseline Legal, IP &amp; GDPR Essentials
                    </CardTitle>
                    <CardDescription className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-600">
                      Secure intellectual property ownership, customer privacy policies, and non-disclosure standards to make the company diligence-ready.
                    </CardDescription>
                  </div>
                </div>
                {openStep !== 'ALL' && (
                  <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setOpenStep(0)} className="text-xs text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-100">
                    <span>Collapse Step</span>
                    <ChevronUp className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-6 pt-5">
              {/* Founder IP Assignment Callout */}
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/40 p-4 space-y-2">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <ShieldCheck className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-700" />
                  <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-950">
                    The #1 Diligence Showstopper: Founder IP Assignment
                  </h4>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-700 leading-relaxed">
                  Even if you are the sole creator, code, branding, and designs created before incorporation remain your <em>personal</em> property unless assigned in writing to the company. Enterprise Ireland, Innovate UK, and angels will halt term sheets if IP isn't formally assigned.
                </p>
                <div className="pt-2">
                  <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={data.step6.hasIpAssignmentSigned}
                      onChange={(e) => setData({ ...data, step6: { ...data.step6, hasIpAssignmentSigned: e.target.checked } })}
                      className="rounded border-slate-300 text-indigo-600 focus:ring-indigo-500 h-4 w-4"
                    />
                    <span>Founder IP Assignment Agreement has been executed / is confirmed</span>
                  </label>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Legal Documentation Grid */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-4 space-y-3">
                  <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">Statutory Digital Documents</h4>
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer text-xs text-slate-700">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        checked={data.step6.hasPrivacyPolicy}
                        onChange={(e) => setData({ ...data, step6: { ...data.step6, hasPrivacyPolicy: e.target.checked } })}
                        className="rounded border-slate-300 text-indigo-600 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                      />
                      <span>GDPR-Compliant Website Privacy Policy</span>
                    </label>

                    <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer text-xs text-slate-700">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        checked={data.step6.hasTermsOfService}
                        onChange={(e) => setData({ ...data, step6: { ...data.step6, hasTermsOfService: e.target.checked } })}
                        className="rounded border-slate-300 text-indigo-600 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                      />
                      <span>Terms of Service / End-User License Agreement</span>
                    </label>

                    <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer text-xs text-slate-700">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        checked={data.step6.hasStandardNda}
                        onChange={(e) => setData({ ...data, step6: { ...data.step6, hasStandardNda: e.target.checked } })}
                        className="rounded border-slate-300 text-indigo-600 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                      />
                      <span>Standard Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA)</span>
                    </label>
                  </div>

                  {/* Micro-Coaching: Customer Service & Promised Reply Speed (SLA) */}
                  <div className="mt-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-2.5 text-[11px] text-slate-600">
                    <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800">
                      Promised Delivery &amp; Reply Speed (SLA):
                    </span>{' '}
                    SLA (Service Level Agreement) means how quickly you promise to deliver an order or reply when a customer has a problem. You can outline your support speed policy in your customer terms.

                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <PartnerSlot
                    slot="OPS_STEP_6_LEGAL_IP"

                    countryCode={normalizedCountry}
                    planTitle={data.step1.registeredEntityName || plan.title || plan.name}
                    oneLinerSummary={plan.oneLinerSummary || plan.elevatorPitch}
                    founderEmail={data.step2.officialBusinessEmail}

                    description="Access venture-standard contracts, IP assignment deed templates, and digital company secretarial tools."

                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Bottom Step Bar */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-slate-100 pt-4">
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant="outline"
                  onClick={() => setOpenStep(5)}
                  className="text-xs text-slate-600"
                >
                  <ArrowLeft className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  <span>Previous: Insurance</span>
                </Button>

                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => {

                    const el = document.getElementById('mod-g-step-7');
                    if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });

                >
                  <span>Open Operations Readiness Brief</span>
                  <ArrowRight className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                </Button>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        )}
      </section>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* STEP 7: FINAL OVERVIEW & OPERATIONS READINESS BRIEF */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      <section id="mod-g-step-7" className="scroll-mt-24">
        {openStep !== 'ALL' && openStep !== 7 ? (
          <div
            onClick={() => setOpenStep(7)}
            className="group scroll-mt-24 cursor-pointer rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 bg-gradient-to-r from-white via-indigo-50/40 to-violet-50/40 p-4 shadow-xs transition-all hover:border-indigo-300 hover:shadow-sm"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div
                  className={`flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-xs font-bold ${
                    completedCoreStepsCount === 6 ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white' : 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                  }`}
                >
                  <FileText className="h-4 w-4" />
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <h2 className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 group-hover:text-indigo-600">
                    Module G Brief: Operations Readiness &amp; Launchpad Schedule
                  </h2>
                  <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-xs text-slate-500">
                    Readiness Score: {opsReadinessScore}% • {completedCoreStepsCount} of 6 Operational Pillars Resolved
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                <Badge className="shrink-0 text-[10px] font-medium border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800">
                  {completedCoreStepsCount}/6 Pillars Ready
                </Badge>
                <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="h-8 shrink-0 px-2.5 text-xs font-medium text-indigo-600 group-hover:bg-indigo-50">
                  <span>Open Overview</span>
                  <ChevronDown className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 bg-gradient-to-br from-white via-indigo-50/30 to-violet-50/40 p-6 shadow-sm space-y-6">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4 border-b border-indigo-100 pb-4">
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <FileText className="h-5 w-5 text-indigo-600" />
                  <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
                    Operations Readiness &amp; Launchpad Schedule
                  </h3>
                  <Badge className="text-[10px] font-medium border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800">
                    Score: {opsReadinessScore}%
                  </Badge>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-600">
                  Executive overview of legal, banking, accounting, insurance and compliance pillars ready for export or grant appendix compilation.
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant="outline"
                  onClick={handleCopyOperationsBrief}
                  className="text-xs bg-white text-slate-700"
                >
                  {isCopiedBrief ? (
                    <>
                      <CheckCheck className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                      <span>Copied!</span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <Copy className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      <span>Copy Brief</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </Button>
                {openStep !== 'ALL' && (
                  <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setOpenStep(0)} className="text-xs text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-100">
                    <span>Collapse Brief</span>
                    <ChevronUp className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* 6-Card Readiness Matrix Grid */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
              {readinessChecks.map((check) => (
                <div
                  key={check.num}
                  className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white p-3 shadow-2xs"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500">Pillar {check.num}</span>
                    {check.done ? (
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-emerald-700">
                        <CheckCircle2 className="h-3 w-3 text-emerald-600" /> Ready
                      </span>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-amber-700">
                        <Clock className="h-3 w-3 text-amber-500" /> Action Required
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 mt-1">{check.title}</h4>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-1 truncate">
                    {check.state === 'ALREADY_HAVE' ? 'Registered & active' : 'Guided setup in progress'}
                  </p>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* Supportive "Things to Consider" Blind-Spot Review */}
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50/40 p-4 space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-700" />
                <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-amber-950">
                  Constructive Blind-Spot Review ("Things to Consider")
                </h4>
              </div>
              <ul className="text-xs text-amber-900 space-y-1.5 list-disc pl-4">
                <li>
                  <strong>Grant Banking Invariant:</strong> Irish LEO and Enterprise Ireland grants are paid by electronic fund transfer directly into the applicant company's registered IBAN. Personal accounts are strictly non-compliant.
                </li>
                <li>
                  <strong>Director Residency:</strong> If incorporating in Ireland, at least one director must be an EEA resident (or you must hold an Irish Section 137 Non-Resident Director Bond).
                </li>
                <li>
                  <strong>Founder IP Assignment Date:</strong> Ensure your IP Assignment Agreement is dated immediately upon incorporation so any prior source code or trade secrets belong to the corporate entity.
                </li>
              </ul>
            </div>

            {/* Dark Footer Handoff Bar */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 px-5 py-4 text-white shadow-md">
              <div>
                <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-white">
                  Operational Foundations Configured
                </h4>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                  Ready to move on to <strong>Module H: Selling, Sales Assumptions &amp; Pocket Profit</strong>?
                </p>
              </div>
              <Button
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => {
                  if (!isVaultReadonly && onSave) {
                    onSave(data);
                  }
                  onContinueToModuleH?.();
                }}
                className="bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-xs font-semibold text-white shrink-0"
              >
                <span>Continue to Module H</span>
                <ArrowRight className="ml-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
=== src/components/workspace/cohort-milestone-claim-modal.tsx ===
'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  Sparkles,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  Globe,
  Mail,
  ShieldCheck,
  Loader2,
  X,
  Building2,
  FileText,
  Send,
  ExternalLink,
  Search,
  Check,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { PartnerSlot } from '@/components/workspace/partner-slot';
import {
  claimCohortMilestoneRewardAction,
  type CohortMilestoneClaimDossier,
  type CohortMilestoneExecutiveSummary,
  type CohortMilestonePlanState,
} from '@/app/actions/cohort-milestone-claim';

const CONSUMER_DOMAINS = new Set([
  'gmail.com',
  'googlemail.com',
  'yahoo.com',
  'yahoo.co.uk',
  'yahoo.ie',
  'hotmail.com',
  'hotmail.co.uk',
  'outlook.com',
  'live.com',
  'msn.com',
  'icloud.com',
  'me.com',
  'mac.com',
  'aol.com',
  'protonmail.com',
  'proton.me',
]);

interface DomainAvailabilityItem {
  domain: string;
  tld: string;
  available: boolean;
  statusLabel: string;
}

interface CohortMilestoneClaimModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  planId: string;
  hqCountryCode: string;
  founderName: string;
  founderEmail: string;
  cohortCode?: string;
  cohort: NonNullable<CohortMilestonePlanState['cohort']>;
  existingClaimDossier?: CohortMilestoneClaimDossier | null;
  initialDomain?: string;
  initialWorkEmail?: string;
  overallProgressPercent: number;
  moduleProgressMap: Record<string, number>;
  executiveSummary: CohortMilestoneExecutiveSummary;
  onClaimSuccess: (dossier: CohortMilestoneClaimDossier) => void;
}

const MODULE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  MOD_A_IDEATION: 'Module A: Ideation & Concept',
  MOD_B_MARKET: 'Module B: Market & Competitors',
  MOD_C_SURVEYS_FEEDBACK: 'Module C: Customer Surveys',
  MOD_D_PRODUCT_BUILD: 'Module D: Product & MVP Spec',
  MOD_E_OPERATIONS: 'Module E: Operations & Risk',
  MOD_F_COFOUNDER_TEAM: 'Module F: Team & Alignment',
  MOD_G_LAUNCHPAD: 'Module G: Launchpad Setup',
  MOD_H_REVENUE: 'Module H: Pricing & Breakeven',
  MOD_I_MARKETING: 'Module I: Go-To-Market',
  MOD_J_FINANCE: 'Module J: 3-Year Finance',
  MOD_K_GRANTS_FUNDING: 'Module K: Grants & Funding',
  MOD_L_BUSINESS_PLAN: 'Module L: Business Plan Studio',
};

export function CohortMilestoneClaimModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  planId,
  hqCountryCode,
  founderName,
  founderEmail,
  cohortCode,
  cohort,
  existingClaimDossier,
  initialDomain = '',
  initialWorkEmail = '',
  overallProgressPercent,
  moduleProgressMap,
  executiveSummary,
  onClaimSuccess,
}: CohortMilestoneClaimModalProps) {
  const [domainInput, setDomainInput] = useState(
    existingClaimDossier?.verifiedDomain || initialDomain
  );
  const [workEmailInput, setWorkEmailInput] = useState(
    existingClaimDossier?.verifiedWorkEmail || initialWorkEmail || founderEmail
  );
  const [founderNotes, setFounderNotes] = useState(
    existingClaimDossier?.founderNotes || ''
  );

  const [isCheckingDomain, setIsCheckingDomain] = useState(false);
  const [domainResults, setDomainResults] = useState<DomainAvailabilityItem[]>(
    []
  );
  const [showDomainPartnerHelp, setShowDomainPartnerHelp] = useState(false);
  const [showEmailPartnerHelp, setShowEmailPartnerHelp] = useState(false);

  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [submittedDossier, setSubmittedDossier] =
    useState<CohortMilestoneClaimDossier | null>(existingClaimDossier || null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const { milestoneConfig } = cohort;

  const cleanEmailLower = (workEmailInput || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const emailDomainPart = cleanEmailLower.split('@')[1] || '';
  const isConsumerEmailWarning =
    milestoneConfig.requireWorkEmail &&
    Boolean(emailDomainPart) &&
    CONSUMER_DOMAINS.has(emailDomainPart);

  async function handleCheckDomainAvailability() {
    const query = domainInput.trim() || executiveSummary.startupTitle.trim();
    if (!query) return;

    setIsCheckingDomain(true);
    setDomainResults([]);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(
        `/api/domains/check?name=${encodeURIComponent(query)}&country=${encodeURIComponent(hqCountryCode)}`
      );
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        if (Array.isArray(data.results)) {
          setDomainResults(data.results);
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // Non-fatal
    } finally {
      setIsCheckingDomain(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleSubmitClaim(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMsg(null);

    if (milestoneConfig.requireOfficialDomain && !domainInput.trim()) {
      setErrorMsg(
        'Please enter your official company domain (e.g. yourstartup.com or yourstartup.ie).'
      );
      return;
    }

    if (isConsumerEmailWarning) {
      setErrorMsg(
        `${cohort.organizationName} requires an official @company domain work email rather than @${emailDomainPart} to activate ${milestoneConfig.rewardLabel}.`
      );
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const res = await claimCohortMilestoneRewardAction({
        planId,
        verifiedDomain: domainInput,
        verifiedWorkEmail: workEmailInput,
        founderNotes,
        clientFallback: {
          cohortCode: cohortCode || cohort.inviteCode,
          userEmail: founderEmail,
          founderName,
        },
        clientProgressSnapshot: {
          overallProgressPercent,
          moduleProgressMap,
          executiveSummary,
        },
      });

      if (!res.ok || !res.dossier) {
        setErrorMsg(
          res.error ||
            'Could not submit your milestone claim. Please check your details and try again.'
        );
        setIsSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }

      setSubmittedDossier(res.dossier);
      onClaimSuccess(res.dossier);
    } catch (err) {
      setErrorMsg(
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : 'An unexpected error occurred while submitting your claim.'
      );
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-950/70 p-3 backdrop-blur-xs sm:p-6">
      <div className="relative flex max-h-[92vh] w-full max-w-2xl flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-2xl">
        {/* Top Gradient Header */}
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-950 via-indigo-900 to-slate-900 px-5 py-4 text-white sm:px-6 sm:py-5">
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <Badge className="border-emerald-400/40 bg-emerald-500/20 text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-200">
                {submittedDossier
                  ? '✓ Partner Verification Dispatched'
                  : '✓ Milestone Gate Unlocked'}
              </Badge>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-200">
                {cohort.organizationName} • {cohort.name}
              </span>
            </div>
            <h2 className="mt-1.5 text-lg font-bold tracking-tight text-white sm:text-xl">
              {milestoneConfig.rewardLabel}
            </h2>
            <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-indigo-100/90">
              {submittedDossier
                ? `Your verified venture dossier has been sent to the ${cohort.organizationName} partner team.`
                : `Verify your official company domain & work email to dispatch your readiness dossier to ${cohort.organizationName}.`}
            </p>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="rounded-lg p-1.5 text-indigo-200 transition-colors hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white"
            aria-label="Close modal"
          >
            <X className="h-5 w-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Scrollable Modal Body */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-5 sm:p-6">
          {submittedDossier ? (
            <div className="space-y-5">
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50/80 p-4">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                  <CheckCircle2 className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-emerald-600" />
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-950">
                      Claim Submitted &amp; Partner Team Notified!
                    </h3>
                    <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-emerald-900">
                      We have dispatched your verified startup dossier for{' '}
                      <strong>
                        {submittedDossier.executiveSummary.startupTitle}
                      </strong>{' '}
                      to <strong>{cohort.organizationName}</strong> and sent a
                      copy to{' '}
                      <strong>{submittedDossier.verifiedWorkEmail}</strong>.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {milestoneConfig.instructionNotes && (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/70 p-4">
                  <div className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-800">
                    Next Steps from {cohort.organizationName}
                  </div>
                  <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs leading-relaxed text-indigo-950">
                    {milestoneConfig.instructionNotes}
                  </p>
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-4 space-y-2.5 text-xs">
                <div className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
                  Submitted Verification Summary
                </div>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-slate-500">Startup Venture:</span>{' '}
                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-900">
                      {submittedDossier.executiveSummary.startupTitle}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-slate-500">Readiness Score:</span>{' '}
                    <span className="font-bold text-emerald-700">
                      {submittedDossier.overallProgressPercent}% Verified
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-slate-500">Official Domain:</span>{' '}
                    <span className="font-mono font-semibold text-indigo-700">
                      https://{submittedDossier.verifiedDomain}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-slate-500">Verified Work Email:</span>{' '}
                    <span className="font-mono font-semibold text-slate-900">
                      {submittedDossier.verifiedWorkEmail}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="border-t border-slate-200/80 pt-2 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                  Submitted on{' '}
                  {new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-IE', {
                    dateStyle: 'medium',
                    timeStyle: 'short',
                  }).format(new Date(submittedDossier.claimedAtIso))}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex justify-end pt-2">
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={onClose}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-900 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-slate-800 sm:w-auto"
                >
                  Return to Founder Workspace
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <form onSubmit={handleSubmitClaim} className="space-y-5">
              {/* Section 1: Corporate Domain & Work Email Verification */}
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 p-4 space-y-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-slate-200/80 pb-2.5">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <ShieldCheck className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-600" />
                    <h3 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-800">
                      Step 1: Corporate Domain &amp; Work Email Verification
                    </h3>
                  </div>
                  <Badge
                    variant="outline"
                    className="border-indigo-200 bg-white text-[10px] font-semibold text-indigo-700"
                  >
                    Mandatory Partner Check
                  </Badge>
                </div>

                {/* Official Company Website Domain */}
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-1">
                    <Label
                      htmlFor="claim-company-domain"
                      className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800"
                    >
                      Official Company Domain{' '}
                      {milestoneConfig.requireOfficialDomain && (
                        <span className="text-red-600">*</span>
                      )}
                    </Label>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() =>
                        setShowDomainPartnerHelp(!showDomainPartnerHelp)
                      }
                      className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-indigo-600 hover:underline"
                    >
                      {showDomainPartnerHelp
                        ? 'Hide Domain Setup Perks'
                        : "Don't have a domain yet? Check availability →"}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row">
                    <div className="relative flex-1">
                      <Globe className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-2.5 h-4 w-4 text-slate-400" />
                      <Input
                        id="claim-company-domain"
                        placeholder="e.g. yourstartup.com or yourstartup.ie"
                        value={domainInput}
                        onChange={(e) => setDomainInput(e.target.value)}
                        className="bg-white pl-9 text-base sm:text-xs"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <Button
                      type="button"
                      variant="outline"
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={handleCheckDomainAvailability}
                      disabled={isCheckingDomain}
                      className="h-9 shrink-0 border-slate-300 bg-white text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700"
                    >
                      {isCheckingDomain ? (
                        <>
                          <Loader2 className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                          Checking DNS...
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          <Search className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-600" />
                          Verify / Check DNS
                        </>
                      )}
                    </Button>
                  </div>

                  {domainResults.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="mt-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white p-2.5">
                      <div className="mb-1.5 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
                        Live Domain DNS Check — Click to Select
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                        {domainResults.map((item) => (
                          <button
                            key={item.domain}
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setDomainInput(item.domain)}
                            className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors ${
                              domainInput === item.domain
                                ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-950'
                                : item.available
                                  ? 'border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50/60 text-emerald-900 hover:bg-emerald-100/70'
                                  : 'border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100'
                            }`}
                          >
                            <span className="font-mono font-bold">
                              {item.domain}
                            </span>
                            <span
                              className={`text-[10px] ${
                                item.available
                                  ? 'text-emerald-700'
                                  : 'text-indigo-700'
                              }`}
                            >
                              {item.available
                                ? '• Available to Register'
                                : '• Registered (Active DNS)'}
                            </span>
                          </button>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {showDomainPartnerHelp && (
                    <div className="mt-2 rounded-xl border border-indigo-200/80 bg-white p-3">
                      <PartnerSlot
                        slot="OPS_STEP_2_DOMAIN"
                        countryCode={hqCountryCode}
                        projectId={planId}
                        planTitle={executiveSummary.startupTitle}
                        founderName={founderName}
                        founderEmail={founderEmail}
                        selectedDomain={domainInput}
                        compact
                      />
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Official @company Work Email */}
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-1">
                    <Label
                      htmlFor="claim-work-email"
                      className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800"
                    >
                      Official @company Work Email{' '}
                      {milestoneConfig.requireWorkEmail && (
                        <span className="text-red-600">*</span>
                      )}
                    </Label>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() =>
                        setShowEmailPartnerHelp(!showEmailPartnerHelp)
                      }
                      className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-indigo-600 hover:underline"
                    >
                      {showEmailPartnerHelp
                        ? 'Hide Work Email Perks'
                        : 'Need a Google Workspace @company email? →'}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <div className="relative">
                    <Mail className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-2.5 h-4 w-4 text-slate-400" />
                    <Input
                      id="claim-work-email"
                      type="email"
                      placeholder="founder@yourstartup.com"
                      value={workEmailInput}
                      onChange={(e) => setWorkEmailInput(e.target.value)}
                      className={`bg-white pl-9 text-base sm:text-xs ${
                        isConsumerEmailWarning
                          ? 'border-amber-400 ring-1 ring-amber-200'
                          : ''

                          {cohort.organizationName} underwriting requires an

                          <code className="font-mono">
                            founder@{domainInput || 'yourstartup.com'}

                        slot="OPS_STEP_2_EMAIL"
                        countryCode={hqCountryCode}
                        projectId={planId}
                        planTitle={executiveSummary.startupTitle}
                        founderName={founderName}
                        founderEmail={founderEmail}
                        selectedDomain={domainInput}
                        compact
                      />

                    id="claim-founder-notes"

                    value={founderNotes}
                    onChange={(e) => setFounderNotes(e.target.value)}
                    className="bg-white text-base sm:text-xs"
                  />

              <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 space-y-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-slate-100 pb-2.5">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <FileText className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600" />
                    <h3 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-800">
                      Step 2: Verified Venture Dossier Preview
                    </h3>
                  </div>
                  <Badge className="bg-emerald-100 text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-800">
                    {overallProgressPercent}% Readiness Verified
                  </Badge>
                </div>

                <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                  This executive snapshot is automatically compiled from your
                  completed modules and attached to your partner verification
                  email:
                </p>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/80 p-3 text-xs sm:grid-cols-2">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">Venture:</span>{' '}
                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-900">
                      {executiveSummary.startupTitle}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                      HQ &amp; Sector:
                    </span>{' '}
                    <span className="font-medium text-slate-800">
                      {executiveSummary.hqCountryCode} •{' '}
                      {executiveSummary.industryCategory}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                      One-Liner:
                    </span>{' '}
                    <span className="text-slate-800">
                      {executiveSummary.oneLiner || '—'}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  {executiveSummary.beachheadPersona && (
                    <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                      <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                        Beachhead Customer:
                      </span>{' '}
                      <span className="text-slate-800">
                        {executiveSummary.beachheadPersona}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  )}
                  <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                      Validation Traction (Module C):
                    </span>{' '}
                    <span className="font-semibold text-indigo-700">
                      {executiveSummary.surveyRespondentsCount ?? 0} Survey
                      Responses • {executiveSummary.waitlistLeadsCount ?? 0}{' '}
                      Waitlist Leads
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 pt-1">
                  {milestoneConfig.requiredModules.map((modCode) => {
                    const pct = moduleProgressMap[modCode] ?? 0;
                    return (
                      <span
                        key={modCode}
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-800"
                      >
                        <Check className="h-3 w-3 text-emerald-600" />
                        {MODULE_LABELS[modCode] || modCode} ({pct}%)
                      </span>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>

              {errorMsg && (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-3 text-xs font-medium text-red-800">
                  {errorMsg}
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Bottom Action Bar */}
              <div className="flex flex-col-reverse items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-slate-200 pt-4 sm:flex-row">
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="ghost"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={onClose}
                  className="w-full text-xs text-slate-600 sm:w-auto"
                >
                  Cancel
                </Button>
                <Button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                  className="w-full bg-emerald-600 px-5 text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-sm hover:bg-emerald-700 sm:w-auto"
                >
                  {isSubmitting ? (
                    <>
                      <Loader2 className="mr-1.5 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                      Verifying &amp; Dispatching Dossier...
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <Send className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      Verify &amp; Claim: {milestoneConfig.rewardLabel}
                    </>
                  )}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </form>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  ShieldCheck,
  Check,
  AlertTriangle,
  XCircle,
  HelpCircle,
  Lightbulb,
  ExternalLink,
  ArrowRight,
  Sparkles,
  Info,
  ChevronRight,
  TrendingUp,
  FileCheck,
  Layers,
  Award,
  Clock,
  RotateCcw,
  Building2,
  DollarSign,
  BookmarkCheck,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import type {
  ActiveStartupPlan,
  ModuleKGrantKey,
  ModuleKStep1AuditSavedData,
} from '@/lib/auth/session-store';
import {
  SUPPORTED_GRANT_PROGRAMS,
  evaluateAllEligibleGrantsForPlan,
  evaluatePlanGrantCheckpoints,
  type SupportedGrantProgramKey,
  type EvaluatedGrantProgramAudit,
  type GrantAuditCheckpoint,
} from '@/lib/grants/module-k-grant-audit';
import { generateModuleKStep1AuditOverviewAction } from '@/app/actions/module-k';

export interface ModuleKGrantAuditStepProps {
  plan: ActiveStartupPlan;
  isVaultReadonly?: boolean;
  onSaveStep1?: (data: ModuleKStep1AuditSavedData, progress?: number) => Promise<void> | void;
  onContinueToNextStep?: () => void;
  onNavigateToModule?: (
    moduleCode:
      | 'MOD_A_IDEATION'
      | 'MOD_B_MARKET'
      | 'MOD_C_SURVEYS_FEEDBACK'
      | 'MOD_D_PRODUCT_BUILD'
      | 'MOD_E_OPERATIONS'
      | 'MOD_F_COFOUNDER_TEAM'
      | 'MOD_G_LAUNCHPAD'
      | 'MOD_H_REVENUE'
      | 'MOD_I_MARKETING'
      | 'MOD_J_FINANCE'
      | 'MOD_K_GRANTS_FUNDING'
      | 'MOD_L_BUSINESS_PLAN',
    targetStep?: number,
    highlightId?: string
  ) => void;
}

export function ModuleKGrantAuditStep({
  plan,
  isVaultReadonly,
  onSaveStep1,
  onContinueToNextStep,
  onNavigateToModule,
}: ModuleKGrantAuditStepProps) {
  const isUK = plan.hqCountryCode === 'GB';
  const targetCountry = isUK ? 'GB' : 'IE';

  // Evaluate all grants for the country
  const allEvaluations = useMemo(() => {
    return evaluateAllEligibleGrantsForPlan(plan);
  }, [plan]);

  const defaultKey: SupportedGrantProgramKey =
    plan.moduleKData?.step1Audit?.selectedGrantKey ||
    (allEvaluations.length > 0 ? allEvaluations[0].programKey : isUK ? 'GB_BBB_START_UP_LOAN' : 'IE_LEO_PRIMING');

  const [selectedGrantKey, setSelectedGrantKey] = useState<SupportedGrantProgramKey>(defaultKey);
  const [filterTab, setFilterTab] = useState<'ALL' | 'NEEDS_ACTION' | 'PASSED'>('ALL');
  const [activeWhyCard, setActiveWhyCard] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [activeExampleCard, setActiveExampleCard] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [founderNotes, setFounderNotes] = useState<string>(
    plan.moduleKData?.step1Audit?.founderNotes || ''
  );
  const [aiAuditOverview, setAiAuditOverview] = useState<string>(
    plan.moduleKData?.step1Audit?.aiAuditOverview || ''
  );
  const [aiAssessorTip, setAiAssessorTip] = useState<string | null>(
    plan.moduleKData?.step1Audit?.aiAssessorTip || null
  );
  const [isGeneratingAi, setIsGeneratingAi] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Active evaluation audit for the selected grant
  const activeAudit: EvaluatedGrantProgramAudit = useMemo(() => {
    const found = allEvaluations.find((e) => e.programKey === selectedGrantKey);
    if (found) return found;
    return evaluatePlanGrantCheckpoints(plan, selectedGrantKey);
  }, [allEvaluations, selectedGrantKey, plan]);

  // Filtered checkpoints
  const filteredCheckpoints = useMemo(() => {
    if (filterTab === 'NEEDS_ACTION') {
      return activeAudit.checkpoints.filter((c) => c.status === 'WARNING' || c.status === 'FAIL');
    }
    if (filterTab === 'PASSED') {
      return activeAudit.checkpoints.filter((c) => c.status === 'PASS');
    }
    return activeAudit.checkpoints;
  }, [activeAudit, filterTab]);

  const handleGenerateAiOverview = async () => {
    if (isVaultReadonly || isGeneratingAi) return;
    setIsGeneratingAi(true);
    try {
      const blockers = activeAudit.checkpoints
        .filter((c) => c.status === 'FAIL')
        .map((c) => `${c.title}: ${c.assessorRuleDescription}`);
      const warnings = activeAudit.checkpoints
        .filter((c) => c.status === 'WARNING')
        .map((c) => `${c.title}: ${c.assessorRuleDescription}`);
      const passedHighlights = activeAudit.checkpoints
        .filter((c) => c.status === 'PASS')
        .slice(0, 3)
        .map((c) => c.title);

      const res = await generateModuleKStep1AuditOverviewAction({
        planId: plan.id,
        planTitle: plan.title,
        industryCategory: plan.industryCategory || 'Startup',
        hqCountryCode: (plan.hqCountryCode as any) || 'IE',
        selectedGrantName: activeAudit.programDefinition.name,
        selectedGrantAgency: activeAudit.programDefinition.agency,
        readinessScorePercent: activeAudit.readinessScorePercent,
        passedCount: activeAudit.passCount,
        warningCount: activeAudit.warningCount,
        blockerCount: activeAudit.failCount,
        criticalBlockers: blockers,
        warnings,
        passedHighlights,
        founderNotes,
      });

      if (res?.auditOverview) {
        setAiAuditOverview(res.auditOverview);
        if (res.assessorStrategyTip) {
          setAiAssessorTip(res.assessorStrategyTip);
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[Module K] AI audit overview failed:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsGeneratingAi(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSaveAudit = async () => {
    if (isVaultReadonly) return;
    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      const payload: ModuleKStep1AuditSavedData = {
        selectedGrantKey,
        targetCountry,
        overallAssessorReadinessScore: activeAudit.readinessScorePercent,
        stackedFundingRoadmapSelected: false,
        activeFilterTab: filterTab,
        founderNotes,
        aiAuditOverview,
        aiAssessorTip: aiAssessorTip || undefined,
      };
      if (onSaveStep1) {
        await onSaveStep1(payload, 25);
      }
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* 4-Layer Support Strip: Why & Example */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 pt-1">
        <Button
          type="button"
          size="sm"
          variant="outline"
          onClick={() => setActiveWhyCard((prev) => !prev)}
          className="h-7 border-indigo-200 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-50"
        >
          <HelpCircle className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          Why Are We Asking This?
        </Button>
        <Button
          type="button"
          size="sm"
          variant="outline"
          onClick={() => setActiveExampleCard((prev) => !prev)}
          className="h-7 border-emerald-200 text-[11px] font-medium text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-50"
        >
          <Lightbulb className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          Show Me an Assessor Example
        </Button>
        <Button
          type="button"
          size="sm"
          variant="outline"
          onClick={handleGenerateAiOverview}
          disabled={isGeneratingAi || isVaultReadonly}
          className="h-7 border-violet-200 bg-violet-50/60 text-[11px] font-medium text-violet-700 hover:bg-violet-100"
        >
          <Sparkles className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-violet-600" />
          {isGeneratingAi ? 'Synthesizing Audit with AI...' : 'Generate AI Audit Overview'}
        </Button>
      </div>

      {activeWhyCard && (
        <div className="relative rounded-lg border border-indigo-100 bg-indigo-50/70 p-3.5 text-xs text-indigo-900">
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveWhyCard(false)}
            className="absolute right-2 top-2 text-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-600"
          >
            ✕
          </button>
          <p className="font-semibold text-indigo-950">Why Grant Pre-Auditing is Essential:</p>
          <p className="mt-1 leading-relaxed">
            Over 60% of grant applications are rejected at the preliminary screening committee—not because
            the idea is bad, but because of technical disqualifiers (e.g., missing 3 quotes over €5k, claiming
            for standard laptops, or applying for an entity type that isn’t eligible). By scanning your entire
            business plan across Modules A through J before you apply, we de-risk your application so you pass the
            official assessor review on your first attempt.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {activeExampleCard && (
        <div className="relative rounded-lg border border-emerald-100 bg-emerald-50/70 p-3.5 text-xs text-emerald-950">
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveExampleCard(false)}
            className="absolute right-2 top-2 text-emerald-400 hover:text-emerald-600"
          >
            ✕
          </button>
          <p className="font-semibold text-emerald-950">Real Assessor Evaluation Insight:</p>
          <p className="mt-1 leading-relaxed">
            “An Irish LEO or Innovate UK assessor spends an average of 18 minutes reviewing an early-stage application.
            They look for 3 immediate green lights: (1) Does this company export or create net-new value? (2) Has the founder
            committed cash skin-in-the-game? (3) Are the quotes real and transparent? When they see these pre-verified,
            your likelihood of scoring &gt; 80/100 jumps fourfold.”
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* 1. TOP SECTION: MULTI-GRANT COMPARISON CAROUSEL / GRID                     */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">
              Target Grant &amp; Funding Programs ({targetCountry === 'IE' ? '🇮🇪 Ireland' : '🇬🇧 United Kingdom'})
            </h3>

          <Badge variant="outline" className="border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/50 text-[11px] font-semibold text-indigo-700">
            {allEvaluations.length} Programs Evaluated
          </Badge>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
          {allEvaluations.map((audit) => {
            const isSelected = audit.programKey === selectedGrantKey;
            const isHighMatch = audit.readinessScorePercent >= 80;
            const isMediumMatch = audit.readinessScorePercent >= 60 && audit.readinessScorePercent < 80;

            return (
              <div
                key={audit.programKey}
                onClick={() => setSelectedGrantKey(audit.programKey)}
                className={`group relative cursor-pointer rounded-xl border p-4 transition-all duration-200 ${
                  isSelected
                    ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50/20 shadow-md ring-2 ring-indigo-600/20'
                    : 'border-slate-200 bg-white hover:border-slate-300 hover:shadow-xs'
                }`}
              >
                {/* Header with Score Badge & Match Tag */}
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                  <Badge
                    variant="outline"
                    className={`text-[10px] font-bold ${
                      isHighMatch
                        ? 'border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800'
                        : isMediumMatch
                        ? 'border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 text-amber-800'
                        : 'border-rose-300 bg-rose-50 text-rose-800'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {audit.readinessScorePercent}% Ready
                  </Badge>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-medium text-slate-400">
                    {audit.programDefinition.turnaroundLabel}
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* Grant Name & Agency */}
                <div className="mt-2.5">
                  <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 group-hover:text-indigo-600">
                    {audit.programDefinition.name}
                  </h4>
                  <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-slate-500 line-clamp-1">
                    {audit.programDefinition.agency}
                  </p>

                <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg bg-slate-50 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs">
                  <span className="font-bold text-slate-800">

                  <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">

                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* Selected Indicator */}
                <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 text-[11px]">
                  <span className="text-slate-500 truncate max-w-[180px]">
                    {audit.programDefinition.stageFit}
                  </span>
                  <span
                    className={`font-semibold ${
                      isSelected ? 'text-indigo-600' : 'text-slate-400 group-hover:text-slate-700'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {isSelected ? '✓ Active Audit' : 'Audit This →'}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            );

      <Card className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 bg-gradient-to-b from-slate-50/80 via-white to-slate-50/40 p-5 shadow-xs">

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

              </span>
              <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">

                {activeAudit.programDefinition.fundingBadge}
              </Badge>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 max-w-2xl">
              {activeAudit.programDefinition.underwritingSummary}
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Large Readiness Score Meter */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-3.5 shadow-xs shrink-0">
            <div>
              <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
                Assessor Readiness Index
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1.5">
                <span className="text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900">
                  {activeAudit.readinessScorePercent}%
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">
                  {activeAudit.readinessScorePercent >= 80
                    ? 'Assessor Ready'
                    : activeAudit.readinessScorePercent >= 60
                    ? 'Minor Fixes Needed'
                    : 'Critical Blockers'}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="h-10 w-px bg-slate-200" />
            <div className="flex flex-col text-xs font-medium space-y-0.5">
              <span className="text-emerald-700">✓ {activeAudit.passCount} Passed</span>
              <span className="text-amber-700">⚠️ {activeAudit.warningCount} Warnings</span>
              {activeAudit.failCount > 0 && (
                <span className="text-rose-700">✕ {activeAudit.failCount} Blockers</span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-slate-200/80 pt-3 text-xs">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-slate-600">
            <Info className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-500 shrink-0" />
            <span>
              Official Program Provider: <strong>{activeAudit.programDefinition.agency}</strong>
            </span>
          </div>
          <a
            href={activeAudit.programDefinition.officialUrl}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-800"
          >
            Official Guidelines &amp; Form <ExternalLink className="h-3 w-3" />
          </a>
        </div>
      </Card>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* 3. CHECKPOINTS AUDIT TABLE & FIX-IT ACTIONS                                */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">
              Cross-Platform Prerequisite Checklist ({filteredCheckpoints.length})
            </h4>
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">
              Scanned across Modules A through J
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* Filter Tabs */}
          <div className="inline-flex rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-0.5 text-xs">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setFilterTab('ALL')}
              className={`rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 font-medium transition-all ${
                filterTab === 'ALL'
                  ? 'bg-white font-bold text-slate-900 shadow-xs'
                  : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
              }`}
            >
              All ({activeAudit.checkpoints.length})
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setFilterTab('NEEDS_ACTION')}
              className={`rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 font-medium transition-all ${
                filterTab === 'NEEDS_ACTION'
                  ? 'bg-white font-bold text-amber-700 shadow-xs'
                  : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
              }`}
            >
              Needs Action ({activeAudit.warningCount + activeAudit.failCount})
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setFilterTab('PASSED')}
              className={`rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 font-medium transition-all ${
                filterTab === 'PASSED'
                  ? 'bg-white font-bold text-emerald-700 shadow-xs'
                  : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
              }`}
            >
              Passed ({activeAudit.passCount})
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Checkpoint Cards List */}
        <div className="space-y-2.5">
          {filteredCheckpoints.map((chk) => {
            const isPass = chk.status === 'PASS';
            const isWarning = chk.status === 'WARNING';
            const isFail = chk.status === 'FAIL';

            return (
              <div
                key={chk.id}
                className={`rounded-xl border p-4 transition-all ${
                  isPass
                    ? 'border-emerald-100 bg-white hover:border-emerald-200'
                    : isWarning
                    ? 'border-amber-200 bg-amber-50/20 hover:border-amber-300'
                    : 'border-rose-200 bg-rose-50/20 hover:border-rose-300'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:justify-between">
                  {/* Left Column: Status Icon + Title + Finding */}
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <div
                      className={`mt-0.5 flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg ${
                        isPass
                          ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700'
                          : isWarning
                          ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700'
                          : 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-700'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {isPass ? (
                        <Check className="h-4 w-4" />
                      ) : isWarning ? (
                        <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4" />
                      ) : (
                        <XCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
                      )}
                    </div>

                    <div className="min-w-0 space-y-1">
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                        <h5 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">
                          {chk.title}
                        </h5>
                        <Badge
                          variant="outline"
                          className={`text-[10px] font-semibold ${
                            isPass
                              ? 'border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800'
                              : isWarning
                              ? 'border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-800'
                              : 'border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 text-rose-800'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {chk.statusBadge}
                        </Badge>
                      </div>

                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-600">
                        {chk.findingSummary}
                      </p>

                      <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 italic">
                        Assessor Rule: {chk.assessorRuleDescription}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Right Column: Source Module Badge + Action Button */}
                  <div className="flex flex-row items-center gap-2 shrink-0 sm:flex-col sm:items-end">
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-medium text-slate-500">
                      Found in {chk.sourceModule}
                    </span>
                    <Button
                      type="button"
                      size="sm"
                      variant={isPass ? 'ghost' : 'outline'}
                      onClick={() => {
                        if (onNavigateToModule) {
                          onNavigateToModule(
                            chk.sourceModuleCode,
                            chk.targetStepNumber,
                            chk.highlightTargetId
                          );
                        }
                      }}
                      className={`h-7 px-2.5 text-xs font-semibold ${
                        isPass
                          ? 'text-slate-600 hover:text-indigo-600'
                          : isWarning
                          ? 'border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 text-amber-900 hover:bg-amber-100'
                          : 'border-rose-300 bg-rose-50 text-rose-900 hover:bg-rose-100'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {chk.remedyActionLabel}
                      <ChevronRight className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* 4. AI AUDIT OVERVIEW & PRE-FLIGHT ROADMAP                                  */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      <div className="space-y-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800">
              Executive Grant Audit Overview &amp; Pre-Flight Roadmap
            </label>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
              Assessor-grade diagnostic synthesizing your venture's strengths, critical compliance blockers, and remediation priority.
            </p>
          </div>
          <Button
            type="button"
            size="sm"
            variant="outline"
            onClick={handleGenerateAiOverview}
            disabled={isGeneratingAi || isVaultReadonly}
            className="h-7 border-violet-200 bg-violet-50 text-[11px] font-semibold text-violet-700 hover:bg-violet-100"
          >
            <Sparkles className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-violet-600" />
            {isGeneratingAi ? 'Synthesizing...' : 'Calibrate Audit Overview'}
          </Button>
        </div>

        <textarea
          value={aiAuditOverview}
          onChange={(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => setAiAuditOverview(e.target.value)}
          placeholder={`e.g., Based on our cross-platform pre-flight audit for ${activeAudit.programDefinition.name}, ${plan.title} achieves a strong ${activeAudit.readinessScorePercent}% readiness score. The venture satisfies foundational export and entity requirements. However, 3 formal supplier quotes must be gathered in Module E prior to application submission to prevent automatic desk rejection...`}
          className="flex min-h-[90px] w-full rounded-md border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-900 shadow-xs placeholder:text-slate-400 focus-visible:outline-hidden focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 resize-y"
          disabled={isVaultReadonly}
        />

        {aiAssessorTip && (
          <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-amber-200/80 bg-amber-50/70 p-3 text-[11px] text-amber-900">
            <Info className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-amber-600 mt-0.5" />
            <div className="space-y-0.5">
              <span className="font-semibold text-amber-950">Grant Assessor Committee Tip:</span>
              <p className="leading-relaxed text-amber-900/90">{aiAssessorTip}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* 5. FOUNDER NOTES & CUSTOM CONTEXT                                         */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      <div className="space-y-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4">
        <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800">
          Founder Grant Strategy Notes (Optional)
        </label>
        <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
          Record any preliminary conversations with your local LEO Development Advisor, Innovate UK Innovation Champion, or university tech-transfer office.
        </p>
        <textarea
          value={founderNotes}
          onChange={(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => setFounderNotes(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="e.g., Spoke with Siobhan at Galway LEO on Tuesday. She advised submitting the Feasibility study first for €12,500 prototype testing, then follow up with Priming once the MVP has 50 active users..."
          className="flex min-h-[70px] w-full rounded-md border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-900 shadow-xs placeholder:text-slate-400 focus-visible:outline-hidden focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 resize-y"
          disabled={isVaultReadonly}
        />
      </div>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* 6. BOTTOM TOOLBAR: SAVE & NEXT STEP                                       */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-slate-100 pt-4">
        <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">
          Target Grant Locked:{' '}
          <strong className="text-slate-800">
            {activeAudit.programDefinition.name}
          </strong>{' '}
          ({activeAudit.readinessScorePercent}% Readiness Score)
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            onClick={handleSaveAudit}
            disabled={isSaving || isVaultReadonly}
            className="text-xs font-semibold"
          >
            {isSaving ? 'Saving Audit...' : 'Save Audit Progress'}
          </Button>

          {onContinueToNextStep && (
            <Button
              type="button"
              size="sm"
              onClick={async () => {
                await handleSaveAudit();
                onContinueToNextStep();
              }}
              className="bg-indigo-600 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-indigo-700"
            >
              Continue to Step 2: Capital Stack
              <ArrowRight className="ml-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
