  Tablet,
  ExternalLink,
  User,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import {
  SUPPORT_TICKET_TYPE_OPTIONS,
  SUPPORT_PRIORITY_OPTIONS,
  SUPPORT_MODULE_SCOPE_OPTIONS,
  getModuleScopeLabel,
  getTicketTypeBadgeLabel,
  formatSupportTicketAsAiPrompt,
  formatBatchSupportTicketsAsAiPrompt,
  type SupportTicketRecord,
  type SupportTicketType,
  type SupportTicketPriority,
  type SupportTicketStatus,
  type SupportModuleScope,
} from '@/lib/support-tracker-store';

type StatusFilterSubTab =
  | 'ACTIVE_BACKLOG'
  | 'OPEN'
  | 'IN_PROGRESS'
  | 'RESOLVED'
  | 'ARCHIVED';

type OriginFilterMode = 'ALL' | 'LIVE_USERS' | 'ADMIN_QA';

type TrackerViewMode = 'LIST' | 'BOARD';

interface SupportBugTrackerTabProps {
  tickets: SupportTicketRecord[];
  adminEmail: string;
  onCreateTicket: (input: {
    ticketType: SupportTicketType;
    customTypeText?: string | null;
    priority: SupportTicketPriority;
    moduleScope: SupportModuleScope;
    stepContext?: string | null;
    pageUrl?: string | null;
    title: string;
    description: string;
    expectedBehavior?: string | null;
    adminNotes?: string | null;
  }) => Promise<void>;
  onUpdateTicket: (input: {
    id: string;
    status?: SupportTicketStatus;
    priority?: SupportTicketPriority;
    ticketType?: SupportTicketType;
    customTypeText?: string | null;
    moduleScope?: SupportModuleScope;
    stepContext?: string | null;
    title?: string;
    description?: string;
    expectedBehavior?: string | null;
    adminNotes?: string | null;
  }) => Promise<void>;
  onDeleteTicket: (id: string) => Promise<void>;
  onNotify: (type: 'success' | 'warning', text: string) => void;
}

export function SupportBugTrackerTab({
  tickets,
  onCreateTicket,
  onUpdateTicket,
  onDeleteTicket,
  onNotify,
}: SupportBugTrackerTabProps) {
  // Quick-Create Form State
  const [showCreateForm, setShowCreateForm] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [newType, setNewType] = useState<SupportTicketType>('BUG');
  const [newCustomTypeText, setNewCustomTypeText] = useState<string>('');
  const [newPriority, setNewPriority] =
    useState<SupportTicketPriority>('MEDIUM');
  const [newModuleScope, setNewModuleScope] =
    useState<SupportModuleScope>('GLOBAL');
  const [newStepContext, setNewStepContext] = useState<string>('');
  const [newTitle, setNewTitle] = useState<string>('');
  const [newDescription, setNewDescription] = useState<string>('');
  const [newExpectedBehavior, setNewExpectedBehavior] = useState<string>('');
  const [newAdminNotes, setNewAdminNotes] = useState<string>('');
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Filter & View State
  const [statusTab, setStatusTab] =
    useState<StatusFilterSubTab>('ACTIVE_BACKLOG');
  const [originFilter, setOriginFilter] = useState<OriginFilterMode>('ALL');
  const [typeFilter, setTypeFilter] = useState<SupportTicketType | 'ALL'>(
    'ALL'
  );
  const [moduleFilter, setModuleFilter] = useState<SupportModuleScope | 'ALL'>(
    'ALL'
  );
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<TrackerViewMode>('LIST');
  const [copiedId, setCopiedId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Edit / Resolution Drawer Modal State
  const [editingTicket, setEditingTicket] =
    useState<SupportTicketRecord | null>(null);
  const [editTitle, setEditTitle] = useState<string>('');
  const [editDescription, setEditDescription] = useState<string>('');
  const [editExpectedBehavior, setEditExpectedBehavior] = useState<string>('');
  const [editAdminNotes, setEditAdminNotes] = useState<string>('');
  const [editPriority, setEditPriority] =
    useState<SupportTicketPriority>('MEDIUM');
  const [editStatus, setEditStatus] = useState<SupportTicketStatus>('OPEN');
  const [editType, setEditType] = useState<SupportTicketType>('BUG');
  const [editCustomTypeText, setEditCustomTypeText] = useState<string>('');
  const [editModuleScope, setEditModuleScope] =
    useState<SupportModuleScope>('GLOBAL');
  const [editStepContext, setEditStepContext] = useState<string>('');

  // Compute Summary KPIs
  const counts = useMemo(() => {
    const open = tickets.filter((t) => t.status === 'OPEN').length;
    const inProgress = tickets.filter((t) => t.status === 'IN_PROGRESS').length;
    const resolved = tickets.filter((t) => t.status === 'RESOLVED').length;
    const archived = tickets.filter((t) => t.status === 'ARCHIVED').length;
    const activeBacklog = open + inProgress;

    const liveUsersCount = tickets.filter(
      (t) => t.source === 'FOUNDER_SUPPORT' || t.source === 'PUBLIC_VISITOR'
    ).length;
    const activeLiveUsersCount = tickets.filter(
      (t) =>
        (t.source === 'FOUNDER_SUPPORT' || t.source === 'PUBLIC_VISITOR') &&
        (t.status === 'OPEN' || t.status === 'IN_PROGRESS')
    ).length;
    const adminQaCount = tickets.filter(
      (t) => t.source === 'ADMIN_TRACKER'
    ).length;

    const activeItems = tickets.filter(
      (t) => t.status === 'OPEN' || t.status === 'IN_PROGRESS'
    );
    const activeBugs = activeItems.filter((t) => t.ticketType === 'BUG').length;
    const activeImprovements = activeItems.filter(
      (t) =>
        t.ticketType === 'IMPROVEMENT' || t.ticketType === 'AI_PROMPT_TUNING'
    ).length;
    const activeHighCritical = activeItems.filter(
      (t) => t.priority === 'CRITICAL' || t.priority === 'HIGH'
    ).length;
    const founderSupportCount = activeItems.filter(
      (t) =>
        t.ticketType === 'USER_SUPPORT' || t.source === 'FOUNDER_SUPPORT'
    ).length;

    return {
      open,
      inProgress,
      resolved,
      archived,
      activeBacklog,
      activeBugs,
      activeImprovements,
      activeHighCritical,
      founderSupportCount,
      liveUsersCount,
      activeLiveUsersCount,
      adminQaCount,
    };
  }, [tickets]);

  // Filter Tickets
  const filteredTickets = useMemo(() => {
    return tickets.filter((t) => {
      // Origin filter
      if (
        originFilter === 'LIVE_USERS' &&
        t.source !== 'FOUNDER_SUPPORT' &&
        t.source !== 'PUBLIC_VISITOR'
      ) {
        return false;
      }
      if (originFilter === 'ADMIN_QA' && t.source !== 'ADMIN_TRACKER') {
        return false;
      }

      // Status filter (only applied in LIST view; BOARD view shows Open, In Progress, Resolved columns)
      if (viewMode === 'LIST') {
        if (
          statusTab === 'ACTIVE_BACKLOG' &&
          t.status !== 'OPEN' &&
          t.status !== 'IN_PROGRESS'
        ) {
          return false;
        }
        if (statusTab === 'OPEN' && t.status !== 'OPEN') return false;
        if (statusTab === 'IN_PROGRESS' && t.status !== 'IN_PROGRESS')
          return false;
        if (statusTab === 'RESOLVED' && t.status !== 'RESOLVED') return false;
        if (statusTab === 'ARCHIVED' && t.status !== 'ARCHIVED') return false;
      } else {
        // In Kanban Board mode, exclude ARCHIVED unless explicitly viewing Archive
        if (t.status === 'ARCHIVED') return false;
      }

      if (typeFilter !== 'ALL' && t.ticketType !== typeFilter) {
        return false;
      }
      if (moduleFilter !== 'ALL' && t.moduleScope !== moduleFilter) {
        return false;
      }

      if (searchQuery.trim().length > 0) {
        const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
        const hay = [
          t.title,
          t.description,
          t.expectedBehavior || '',
          t.adminNotes || '',
          t.stepContext || '',
          t.planTitle || '',
          t.reporterEmail || '',
          t.reporterName || '',
          t.deviceInfo || '',
          t.pageUrl || '',
          t.moduleScope,
          t.customTypeText || '',
        ]
          .join(' ')
          .toLowerCase();
        if (!hay.includes(q)) return false;
      }

      return true;
    });
  }, [tickets, statusTab, typeFilter, moduleFilter, searchQuery, viewMode]);

  async function handleSubmitCreate(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newTitle.trim() || !newDescription.trim()) {
      onNotify(
        'warning',
        'Please enter both a short title and description to log an item.'
      );
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await onCreateTicket({
        ticketType: newType,
        customTypeText:
          newType === 'OTHER' ? newCustomTypeText.trim() || null : null,
        priority: newPriority,
        moduleScope: newModuleScope,
        stepContext: newStepContext.trim() || null,
        title: newTitle.trim(),
        description: newDescription.trim(),
        expectedBehavior: newExpectedBehavior.trim() || null,
        adminNotes: newAdminNotes.trim() || null,
      });

      setNewTitle('');
      setNewDescription('');
      setNewExpectedBehavior('');
      setNewAdminNotes('');
      setNewStepContext('');
      if (newType === 'OTHER') {
        setNewCustomTypeText('');
      }
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  function openEditModal(ticket: SupportTicketRecord) {
    setEditingTicket(ticket);
    setEditTitle(ticket.title);
    setEditDescription(ticket.description);
    setEditExpectedBehavior(ticket.expectedBehavior || '');
    setEditAdminNotes(ticket.adminNotes || '');
    setEditPriority(ticket.priority);
    setEditStatus(ticket.status);
    setEditType(ticket.ticketType);
    setEditCustomTypeText(ticket.customTypeText || '');
    setEditModuleScope(ticket.moduleScope);
    setEditStepContext(ticket.stepContext || '');
  }

  async function handleSaveEdit() {
    if (!editingTicket) return;
    const id = editingTicket.id;
    setEditingTicket(null);

    await onUpdateTicket({
      id,
      title: editTitle.trim() || editingTicket.title,
      description: editDescription.trim() || editingTicket.description,
      expectedBehavior: editExpectedBehavior.trim() || null,
      adminNotes: editAdminNotes.trim() || null,
      priority: editPriority,
      status: editStatus,
      ticketType: editType,
      customTypeText:
        editType === 'OTHER' ? editCustomTypeText.trim() || null : null,
      moduleScope: editModuleScope,
      stepContext: editStepContext.trim() || null,
    });
  }

  async function handleCopySinglePrompt(ticket: SupportTicketRecord) {
    const promptText = formatSupportTicketAsAiPrompt(ticket);
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(promptText);
      setCopiedId(ticket.id);
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedId(null), 2000);
      onNotify(
        'success',
        `Copied AI Fix Prompt for "${ticket.title}" to clipboard. Paste it into Antigravity anytime!`
      );
    } catch {
      onNotify('warning', 'Unable to copy to clipboard automatically.');
    }
  }

  async function handleCopyBatchOpenPrompt() {
    const targetList = filteredTickets.filter(
      (t) => t.status === 'OPEN' || t.status === 'IN_PROGRESS'
    );
    const listToCopy = targetList.length > 0 ? targetList : filteredTickets;
    if (listToCopy.length === 0) {
      onNotify('warning', 'No tickets match the current filter to copy.');
      return;
    }

    const promptText = formatBatchSupportTicketsAsAiPrompt(listToCopy);
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(promptText);
      onNotify(
        'success',
        `Copied batch AI Fix Prompt (${listToCopy.length} issue${
          listToCopy.length === 1 ? '' : 's'
        }) to clipboard!`
      );
    } catch {
      onNotify('warning', 'Unable to copy batch prompt to clipboard.');
    }
  }

  function handleExportCsv() {
    if (tickets.length === 0) return;
    const header =
      'id,status,priority,type,module_scope,step_context,title,description,expected_behavior,admin_notes,plan_title,created_at\n';
    const rows = tickets
      .map((t) => {
        const esc = (v: string | null | undefined) =>
          `"${(v || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
        return [
          esc(t.id),
          esc(t.status),
          esc(t.priority),
          esc(getTicketTypeBadgeLabel(t)),
          esc(t.moduleScope),
          esc(t.stepContext),
          esc(t.title),
          esc(t.description),
          esc(t.expectedBehavior),
          esc(t.adminNotes),
          esc(t.planTitle),
          esc(t.createdAt),
        ].join(',');
      })
      .join('\n');

    const blob = new Blob([header + rows], {
      type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;',
    });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `bmu-bug-tracker-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }

  function renderPriorityBadge(priority: SupportTicketPriority) {
    if (priority === 'CRITICAL') {
      return (
        <Badge variant="destructive" className="text-[10px]">
          🔥 CRITICAL
        </Badge>
      );
    }
    if (priority === 'HIGH') {
      return (
        <Badge variant="warning" className="text-[10px]">
          HIGH
        </Badge>
      );
    }
    if (priority === 'MEDIUM') {
      return (
        <Badge variant="default" className="text-[10px]">
          MEDIUM
        </Badge>
      );
    }
    return (
      <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px]">
        LOW
      </Badge>
    );
  }

  function renderTypeBadge(ticket: SupportTicketRecord) {
    const label = getTicketTypeBadgeLabel(ticket);
    if (ticket.ticketType === 'BUG') {
      return (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-rose-700">
          <Bug className="h-3 w-3" />
          {label}
        </span>
      );
    }
    if (ticket.ticketType === 'IMPROVEMENT') {
      return (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-indigo-700">
          <Sparkles className="h-3 w-3" />
          {label}
        </span>
      );
    }
    if (ticket.ticketType === 'AI_PROMPT_TUNING') {
      return (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md border border-violet-200 bg-violet-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-violet-700">
          <Bot className="h-3 w-3" />
          {label}
        </span>
      );
    }
    if (ticket.ticketType === 'USER_SUPPORT') {
      return (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-amber-800">
          <MessageSquare className="h-3 w-3" />
          {label}
        </span>
      );
    }
    return (
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md border border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-700">
        <Wrench className="h-3 w-3" />
        {label}
      </span>
    );
  }

  function renderStatusBadge(status: SupportTicketStatus) {
    if (status === 'OPEN') {
      return (
        <Badge variant="warning" className="text-[10px]">
          OPEN
        </Badge>
      );
    }
    if (status === 'IN_PROGRESS') {
      return (
        <Badge variant="default" className="text-[10px]">
          IN PROGRESS
        </Badge>
      );
    }
    if (status === 'RESOLVED') {
      return (
        <Badge variant="success" className="text-[10px]">
          RESOLVED
        </Badge>
      );
    }
    return (
      <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px]">
        ARCHIVED
      </Badge>
    );
  }

  function renderSourceBadge(source?: string | null) {
    if (source === 'FOUNDER_SUPPORT') {
      return (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md border border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-800 shadow-2xs">
          <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-600 animate-pulse" />
          LIVE FOUNDER
        </span>
      );
    }
    if (source === 'PUBLIC_VISITOR') {
      return (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md border border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-800 shadow-2xs">
          <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500" />
          PUBLIC VISITOR
        </span>
      );
    }
    return (
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md border border-violet-200 bg-violet-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-violet-700">
        <Wrench className="h-3 w-3" />
        ADMIN QA
      </span>
    );
  }

  function renderDeviceBadge(deviceInfo?: string | null) {
    if (!deviceInfo) return null;
    const isMobile = deviceInfo.includes('Mobile');
    const isTablet = deviceInfo.includes('Tablet');
    return (
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-700">
        {isMobile ? (
          <Smartphone className="h-3 w-3 text-indigo-600 shrink-0" />
        ) : isTablet ? (
          <Tablet className="h-3 w-3 text-indigo-600 shrink-0" />
        ) : (
          <Laptop className="h-3 w-3 text-indigo-600 shrink-0" />
        )}
        <span className="truncate max-w-[240px] sm:max-w-md">{deviceInfo}</span>
      </span>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* 4 KPI Summary Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <Card className="border-indigo-200 bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-50/60 to-white">
          <CardContent className="p-5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-700">
                Active Backlog
              </span>
              <Bug className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-600" />
            </div>
            <div className="mt-2 flex items-baseline gap-2">
              <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900">
                {counts.activeBacklog}
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                ({counts.open} Open • {counts.inProgress} In Progress)
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-600">
              {counts.activeBugs} Bugs • {counts.activeImprovements}{' '}
              Improvements
            </p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
                High &amp; Critical Priority
              </span>
              <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-rose-600" />
            </div>
            <div className="mt-2 flex items-baseline gap-2">
              <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900">
                {counts.activeHighCritical}
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">need attention</span>
            </div>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
              Use &ldquo;Copy Batch AI Prompt&rdquo; to fix in 1 go
            </p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
                Resolved &amp; Shipped
              </span>
              <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600" />
            </div>
            <div className="mt-2 flex items-baseline gap-2">
              <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900">
                {counts.resolved}
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">completed</span>
            </div>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
              {counts.archived} archived in history
            </p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card className="border-emerald-200 bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-50/50 to-white">
          <CardContent className="p-5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-800">
                Live User Reports
              </span>
              <MessageSquare className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600" />
            </div>
            <div className="mt-2 flex items-baseline gap-2">
              <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900">
                {counts.liveUsersCount}
              </span>
              <Badge className="border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-100 text-[10px] text-emerald-800">
                {counts.activeLiveUsersCount} Active
              </Badge>
            </div>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-600">
              {counts.adminQaCount} Internal QA backlog items
            </p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Quick-Capture Form Card Inside Admin */}
      <Card className="border-indigo-200/80 shadow-xs">
        <CardHeader className="border-b border-slate-100 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-50/60 via-white to-violet-50/40 pb-4">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Plus className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-600" />
                <CardTitle className="text-base sm:text-lg">
                  Log a Bug, UX Improvement, or AI Prompt Note
                </CardTitle>
              </div>
              <CardDescription className="mt-0.5">
                Log issues directly here, or use the local{' '}
                <strong>&ldquo;Log Bug / Idea&rdquo;</strong> button inside the{' '}
                <code>/workspace</code> header while testing Modules A–K.
              </CardDescription>
            </div>
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => setShowCreateForm(!showCreateForm)}
              className="text-xs"
            >
              {showCreateForm ? 'Collapse Form' : '+ Expand Logger Form'}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>

        {showCreateForm && (
          <CardContent className="p-5">
            <form onSubmit={handleSubmitCreate} className="space-y-4">
              {/* Row 1: Type Pills (including OTHER) */}
              <div>
                <Label className="mb-1.5 block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                  1. What are you logging?
                </Label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-5">
                  {SUPPORT_TICKET_TYPE_OPTIONS.map((opt) => {
                    const active = newType === opt.value;
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={opt.value}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setNewType(opt.value)}
                        className={`flex flex-col items-start rounded-xl border p-2.5 text-left transition-all ${
                          active
                            ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50/70 ring-2 ring-indigo-500/20'
                            : 'border-slate-200 bg-white hover:border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
                          {opt.label}
                        </span>
                        <span className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] leading-snug text-slate-500">
                          {opt.description}
                        </span>
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>

                {newType === 'OTHER' && (
                  <div className="mt-2.5">
                    <Label className="mb-1 block text-xs text-slate-600">
                      Custom Issue / Note Category
                    </Label>
                    <Input
                      type="text"
                      value={newCustomTypeText}
                      onChange={(e) => setNewCustomTypeText(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="e.g., Copywriting, Grant Rule Update, Mobile Layout..."
                      className="text-base sm:text-xs"
                    />
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Row 2: Module Scope, Step Context, Priority */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
                <div>
                  <Label className="mb-1.5 block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                    2. Module / Platform Area
                  </Label>
                  <select
                    value={newModuleScope}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setNewModuleScope(e.target.value as SupportModuleScope)
                    }
                    className="h-9 w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 text-base text-slate-900 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-hidden sm:text-xs"
                  >
                    {SUPPORT_MODULE_SCOPE_OPTIONS.map((m) => (
                      <option key={m.value} value={m.value}>
                        {m.label}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <Label className="mb-1.5 block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                    3. Specific Step / Tab (Optional)
                  </Label>
                  <Input
                    type="text"
                    value={newStepContext}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewStepContext(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g., Step 3: Pricing Architect or Appendix C"
                    className="text-base sm:text-xs"
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <Label className="mb-1.5 block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                    4. Priority Level
                  </Label>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-1.5">
                    {SUPPORT_PRIORITY_OPTIONS.map((p) => {
                      const active = newPriority === p.value;
                      return (
                        <button
                          key={p.value}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setNewPriority(p.value)}
                          className={`rounded-lg border px-2 py-2 text-center text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors ${
                            active
                              ? p.value === 'CRITICAL'
                                ? 'border-rose-600 bg-rose-600 text-white'
                                : p.value === 'HIGH'
                                  ? 'border-amber-500 bg-amber-500 text-white'
                                  : 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                              : 'border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {p.value}
                        </button>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Row 3: Title & Description */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  <div>
                    <Label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                      Short Issue / Idea Title *
                    </Label>
                    <Input
                      type="text"
                      required
                      value={newTitle}
                      onChange={(e) => setNewTitle(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="e.g., Module G unit economics margin doesn't include packaging cost"
                      className="text-base sm:text-xs"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <Label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                      Expected / Ideal Behavior (Optional)
                    </Label>
                    <Input
                      type="text"
                      value={newExpectedBehavior}
                      onChange={(e) => setNewExpectedBehavior(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="e.g., Should subtract packaging cost from gross pocket profit"
                      className="text-base sm:text-xs"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <Label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                    Details / Steps to Reproduce / Improvement Notes *
                  </Label>
                  <textarea
                    required
                    rows={4}
                    value={newDescription}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewDescription(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Write what happened, what felt clunky during testing, or what you want changed when we come back to this..."
                    className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white p-3 text-base text-slate-900 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-hidden sm:text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-slate-100 pt-3">
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                  Tip: Once logged, you can click{' '}
                  <strong>&ldquo;Copy AI Prompt&rdquo;</strong> on any item to
                  paste it straight into Antigravity for an instant fix.
                </p>
                <Button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                  className="bg-indigo-600 text-xs text-white hover:bg-indigo-700"
                >
                  <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
                  {isSubmitting ? 'Saving...' : 'Save to Tracker Backlog'}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </CardContent>
        )}
      </Card>

      {/* Main Backlog Directory & Kanban Card */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader className="border-b border-slate-100 pb-4">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div>
              <CardTitle className="text-lg">
                Support &amp; Bug Tracker Backlog ({filteredTickets.length})
              </CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>
                Filter by module, type, or status, switch between List and
                Kanban views, or copy ready-to-paste AI fix prompts.
              </CardDescription>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onClick={handleCopyBatchOpenPrompt}
                disabled={filteredTickets.length === 0}
                className="border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/70 text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-100"
              >
                <Copy className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Copy Batch AI Fix Prompt
              </Button>

              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onClick={handleExportCsv}
                disabled={tickets.length === 0}
                className="text-xs"
              >
                <Download className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Export CSV
              </Button>

              {/* View Mode Toggle: List vs Kanban Board */}
              <div className="inline-flex rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 p-0.5">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setViewMode('LIST')}
                  className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors ${
                    viewMode === 'LIST'
                      ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-2xs'
                      : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
                  }`}
                >
                  <LayoutList className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  List
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setViewMode('BOARD')}
                  className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors ${
                    viewMode === 'BOARD'
                      ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-2xs'
                      : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
                  }`}
                >
                  <Columns3 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  Kanban
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Filter & Search Bar */}
          <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
            {/* Origin & Status Sub-Tabs */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              {/* Origin Mode Switcher */}
              <div className="inline-flex rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 p-0.5">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setOriginFilter('ALL')}
                  className={`rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors ${
                    originFilter === 'ALL'
                      ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-2xs'
                      : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
                  }`}
                >
                  All ({tickets.length})
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setOriginFilter('LIVE_USERS')}
                  className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors ${
                    originFilter === 'LIVE_USERS'
                      ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-2xs'
                      : 'text-emerald-800 hover:bg-emerald-50'
                  }`}
                >
                  <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400" />
                  Live Users ({counts.liveUsersCount})
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setOriginFilter('ADMIN_QA')}
                  className={`rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors ${
                    originFilter === 'ADMIN_QA'
                      ? 'bg-violet-600 text-white shadow-2xs'
                      : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
                  }`}
                >
                  Admin QA ({counts.adminQaCount})
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Status Sub-Tabs (visible in List mode) */}
              {viewMode === 'LIST' ? (
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                  {(
                    [
                      {
                        id: 'ACTIVE_BACKLOG',
                        label: `Active Backlog (${counts.activeBacklog})`,
                      },
                      { id: 'OPEN', label: `Open (${counts.open})` },
                      {
                        id: 'IN_PROGRESS',
                        label: `In Progress (${counts.inProgress})`,
                      },
                      {
                        id: 'RESOLVED',
                        label: `Resolved (${counts.resolved})`,
                      },
                      {
                        id: 'ARCHIVED',
                        label: `Archived (${counts.archived})`,
                      },
                    ] as Array<{ id: StatusFilterSubTab; label: string }>
                  ).map((tab) => (
                    <button
                      key={tab.id}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setStatusTab(tab.id)}
                      className={`rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors ${
                        statusTab === tab.id
                          ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-2xs'
                          : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {tab.label}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">
                  <Filter className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-600" />
                  Kanban Board View
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Module, Type & Text Search Filters */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <select
                value={typeFilter}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setTypeFilter(e.target.value as SupportTicketType | 'ALL')
                }
                className="h-9 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white px-2.5 text-base text-slate-700 sm:text-xs"
              >
                <option value="ALL">All Types</option>
                {SUPPORT_TICKET_TYPE_OPTIONS.map((t) => (
                  <option key={t.value} value={t.value}>
                    {t.shortLabel}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>

              <select
                value={moduleFilter}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setModuleFilter(e.target.value as SupportModuleScope | 'ALL')
                }
                className="h-9 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white px-2.5 text-base text-slate-700 sm:text-xs"
              >
                <option value="ALL">All Modules (A–K &amp; Global)</option>
                {SUPPORT_MODULE_SCOPE_OPTIONS.map((m) => (
                  <option key={m.value} value={m.value}>
                    {m.shortBadge}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>

              <div className="relative w-full sm:w-64">
                <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-2.5 h-4 w-4 text-slate-400" />
                <Input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Search bugs, modules, notes..."
                  value={searchQuery}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                  className="pl-9 text-base sm:text-xs"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>

        <CardContent className="p-0">
          {filteredTickets.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-10 text-center">
              <div className="mx-auto flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-slate-100 text-slate-500">
                <CheckCircle2 className="h-5 w-5" />
              </div>
              <p className="mt-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800">
                No issues or improvements in this view
              </p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
                Log a bug or feature idea above, or use the local{' '}
                <strong>&ldquo;Log Bug / Idea&rdquo;</strong> button inside{' '}
                <code>/workspace</code> while testing.
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : viewMode === 'LIST' ? (
            <div className="divide-y divide-slate-200">
              {filteredTickets.map((ticket) => (
                <div
                  key={ticket.id}
                  className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 p-5 transition-colors hover:bg-slate-50/70 lg:flex-row lg:items-start"
                >
                  {/* Left Details Column */}
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                      {renderSourceBadge(ticket.source)}
                      {renderStatusBadge(ticket.status)}
                      {renderPriorityBadge(ticket.priority)}
                      {renderTypeBadge(ticket)}

                      <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-md border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-700">
                        {getModuleScopeLabel(ticket.moduleScope)}
                        {ticket.stepContext ? ` • ${ticket.stepContext}` : ''}
                      </span>

                      {ticket.planTitle && (
                        <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                          Plan: <strong>{ticket.planTitle}</strong>
                        </span>
                      )}

                      {ticket.pageUrl && (
                        <a

              >

export function GlobalFeedbackButton({
  variant = 'header-pill',
  activeModule = 'GLOBAL',
  activeStepContext,
  planId,
  planTitle,
  userEmail,
  userName,

}: GlobalFeedbackTriggerProps) {

        </Button>

        <button

          onClick={() => setIsOpen(true)}

        >

          type="button"

          title="Give Feedback"

        >
          <MessageSquare className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          Feedback

      )}

          type="button"

interface GlobalFeedbackModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  activeModule?: string;
  activeStepContext?: string;
  planId?: string;
  planTitle?: string;
  userEmail?: string;
  userName?: string;
}

export function GlobalFeedbackModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  activeModule = 'GLOBAL',
  activeStepContext,
  planId,
  planTitle,
  userEmail,
  userName,
}: GlobalFeedbackModalProps) {
  const [ticketType, setTicketType] = useState<SupportTicketType>('BUG');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [expectedBehavior, setExpectedBehavior] = useState('');
  const [customEmail, setCustomEmail] = useState('');
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [isSubmitted, setIsSubmitted] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [telemetry, setTelemetry] = useState<DeviceTelemetry | null>(null);
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setTelemetry(detectDeviceTelemetry());
      setIsSubmitted(false);
      setErrorMessage(null);
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const originalOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        onClose();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = originalOverflow;
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  if (!isOpen || !mounted) return null;

  const currentPath =
    typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.pathname : '/';

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!description.trim()) {
      setErrorMessage('Please describe what happened or what you would like to see.');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    try {
      const res = await submitFeedbackAction({
        ticketType,
        priority: ticketType === 'BUG' ? 'HIGH' : 'MEDIUM',
        moduleScope: (activeModule as SupportModuleScope) || 'GLOBAL',
        stepContext: activeStepContext || null,
        pageUrl: currentPath,
        planId: planId || null,
        planTitle: planTitle || null,
        title: `${ticketType === 'BUG' ? 'Bug Report' : ticketType === 'IMPROVEMENT' ? 'Feature Idea' : 'Feedback'}: ${description.trim().slice(0, 50)}...`,
        description: description.trim(),
        expectedBehavior: expectedBehavior.trim() || null,
        reporterEmail: userEmail || customEmail.trim() || null,
        reporterName: userName || null,
        deviceInfo: telemetry?.summary || null,
        deviceMetadata: telemetry
          ? {
              deviceType: telemetry.deviceType,
              os: telemetry.os,
              browser: telemetry.browser,
              screenResolution: telemetry.screenResolution,
              viewport: telemetry.viewport,
              isTouch: telemetry.isTouch,
              pixelRatio: telemetry.pixelRatio,
              orientation: telemetry.orientation,
            }
          : null,
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        setErrorMessage(res.error || 'Failed to send feedback. Please try again.');
        setIsSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }

      setIsSubmitted(true);
      setTimeout(() => {
        setDescription('');
        setExpectedBehavior('');
        setCustomEmail('');
        onClose();
      }, 1800);
    } catch {
      setErrorMessage('Network error submitting feedback. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  const categoryOptions: Array<{
    type: SupportTicketType;
    label: string;
    icon: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>;
    color: string;
    description: string;
  }> = [
    {
      type: 'BUG',
      label: 'Bug / Broken',
      icon: Bug,
      color: 'rose',
      description: 'Something didn’t work or looked broken',
    },
    {
      type: 'IMPROVEMENT',
      label: 'Idea / Feature',
      icon: Sparkles,
      color: 'indigo',
      description: 'A feature or workflow you’d love to see',
    },
    {
      type: 'USER_SUPPORT',
      label: 'Confusing / Help',
      icon: HelpCircle,
      color: 'amber',
      description: 'A question or confusing instruction',
    },
    {
      type: 'OTHER',
      label: 'General Note',
      icon: Heart,
      color: 'emerald',
      description: 'Love something or general feedback',
    },
  ];

  return createPortal(
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[9999] flex items-center justify-center overflow-y-auto bg-slate-950/60 p-4 sm:p-6 backdrop-blur-xs"
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) {
          onClose();
        }
      }}
    >
      <div
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        className="relative my-auto w-full max-w-lg max-h-[88vh] overflow-y-auto rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-2xl sm:p-6"
      >
        {/* Close Button */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onClose}
          className="absolute right-4 top-4 rounded-lg p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-600 transition"
        >
          <X className="h-4 w-4" />
        </button>

        {isSubmitted ? (
          <div className="py-10 text-center">
            <div className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-600">
              <CheckCircle2 className="h-6 w-6" />
            </div>
            <h3 className="mt-3 text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">
              Feedback Received!
            </h3>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-600">
              Thank you for helping us polish Startup Preflight. We review and
              act on every note directly.
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
            {/* Header */}
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700">
                  <MessageSquare className="h-4 w-4" />
                </span>
                <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
                  Give Feedback or Report a Bug
                </h3>
              </div>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
                Found a glitch or have an idea? Let us know so we can fix or
                improve it right away.
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Category Selector */}
            <div>
              <Label className="mb-1.5 block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                What type of feedback is this?
              </Label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-4">
                {categoryOptions.map((opt) => {
                  const Icon = opt.icon;
                  const active = ticketType === opt.type;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={opt.type}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setTicketType(opt.type)}
                      className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-xl border p-2.5 text-center transition-all ${
                        active
                          ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50/70 ring-2 ring-indigo-500/20'
                          : 'border-slate-200 bg-white hover:border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <Icon
                        className={`h-4 w-4 ${
                          active ? 'text-indigo-600' : 'text-slate-500'
                        }`}
                      />
                      <span
                        className={`mt-1 text-xs font-bold ${
                          active ? 'text-indigo-950' : 'text-slate-700'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {opt.label}
                      </span>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Description Textarea */}
            <div>
              <Label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                {ticketType === 'BUG'
                  ? 'What happened?'
                  : ticketType === 'IMPROVEMENT'
                    ? 'What would you like to see?'
                    : 'What’s on your mind?'}
              </Label>
              <textarea
                rows={3}
                required
                value={description}
                onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
                placeholder={
                  ticketType === 'BUG'
                    ? 'e.g., When I clicked "Calculate Breakeven" on my phone, the button stayed spinning and didn’t update the table...'
                    : ticketType === 'IMPROVEMENT'
                      ? 'e.g., It would be great to export this specific table as a CSV or have a dark mode toggle...'
                      : 'Share your questions, feedback, or thoughts...'
                }
                className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-3 text-base text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-hidden sm:text-xs"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Expected Behavior (Shown for bugs) */}
            {ticketType === 'BUG' && (
              <div>
                <Label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                  What did you expect to happen?{' '}
                  <span className="font-normal text-slate-400">(Optional)</span>
                </Label>
                <Input
                  type="text"
                  value={expectedBehavior}
                  onChange={(e) => setExpectedBehavior(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g., The table should refresh with Year 1 numbers"
                  className="text-base sm:text-xs"
                />
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Optional Email (if user not logged in) */}
            {!userEmail && (
              <div>
                <Label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                  Your Email{' '}
                  <span className="font-normal text-slate-400">
                    (Optional — so we can follow up with you)
                  </span>
                </Label>
                <Input
                  type="email"
                  value={customEmail}
                  onChange={(e) => setCustomEmail(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="founder@example.com"
                  className="text-base sm:text-xs"
                />
              </div>
            )}

            {errorMessage && (
              <div className="rounded-lg border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 p-2.5 text-xs font-medium text-rose-700">
                {errorMessage}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Modal Actions */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-2">
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="ghost"
                size="sm"
                onClick={onClose}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                className="text-xs"
              >
                Cancel
              </Button>
              <Button
                type="submit"
                size="sm"
                disabled={isSubmitting || !description.trim()}
                className="bg-indigo-600 text-xs font-semibold text-white shadow-2xs hover:bg-indigo-700"
              >
                {isSubmitting ? (
                  <>
                    <Loader2 className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                    Sending...
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Send className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    Send Feedback
                  </>
                )}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>,
    document.body
  );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import {
  GraduationCap,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  TrendingUp,
  Users,
  Target,
  Copy,
  ExternalLink,
  FileText,
  Check,
  Gift,
  Search,
  MessageSquare,
  ShieldCheck,
  ArrowUpRight,
  RefreshCw,
  Building2,
  Globe,
  Mail,
  HelpCircle,
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import type {
  CohortPortalData,
  CohortPortalStartup,
} from '@/app/actions/cohort-portal';
import {
  updateCohortStartupMentorNoteAction,
  reviewCohortMilestoneClaimAction,
} from '@/app/actions/cohort-portal';

interface CohortPortalDashboardProps {
  initialData: CohortPortalData;
}

export function CohortPortalDashboard({ initialData }: CohortPortalDashboardProps) {
  const [data, setData] = useState<CohortPortalData>(initialData);
  const [isPreviewMode, setIsPreviewMode] = useState(false);

  const isCohortEmpty = data.startups.length === 0;
  const currentStartups =
    isCohortEmpty && isPreviewMode && data.sampleStartups
      ? data.sampleStartups
      : data.startups;

  const [selectedStartupId, setSelectedStartupId] = useState<string>(
    currentStartups[0]?.id || ''
  );

  // Sync selected startup if preview mode toggles
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (currentStartups.length > 0 && !currentStartups.some((s) => s.id === selectedStartupId)) {
      setSelectedStartupId(currentStartups[0]?.id || '');
    }
  }, [currentStartups, selectedStartupId]);

  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<
    'ALL' | 'GRANT_READY' | 'ON_TRACK' | 'NEEDS_ATTENTION' | 'MILESTONE_CLAIMED'
  >('ALL');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');

  // Mentor Note state
  const [editingNote, setEditingNote] = useState(false);
  const [noteText, setNoteText] = useState('');
  const [isSavingNote, setIsSavingNote] = useState(false);

  // Approval state
  const [isApproving, setIsApproving] = useState(false);
  const [notification, setNotification] = useState<{
    type: 'success' | 'error';
    message: string;
  } | null>(null);

  // Dynamic Aggregates based on active view
  const effectiveAggregates =
    isCohortEmpty && isPreviewMode && data.sampleStartups
      ? {
          totalStartups: data.sampleStartups.length,
          averageBatchProgress: Math.round(
            data.sampleStartups.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.overallProgress, 0) /
              data.sampleStartups.length
          ),
          grantReadyCount: data.sampleStartups.filter((s) => s.overallProgress >= 80).length,
          customerSignalsTotal: data.sampleStartups.reduce(
            (sum, s) => sum + s.surveyResponsesCount,
            0
          ),
          milestoneClaimsPendingCount: data.sampleStartups.filter(
            (s) => s.milestoneStatus === 'CLAIMED_PARTNER_NOTIFIED'
          ).length,
          milestoneClaimsApprovedCount: data.sampleStartups.filter(
            (s) => s.milestoneStatus === 'REWARD_ACTIVATED'
          ).length,
          attentionNeededCount: data.sampleStartups.filter(
            (s) => s.status === 'NEEDS_ATTENTION'
          ).length,
        }
      : data.aggregates;

  // Filtered Startups
  const filteredStartups = currentStartups.filter((s) => {
    // Category / Status Filter
    if (filter === 'GRANT_READY' && s.status !== 'GRANT_READY') return false;
    if (filter === 'ON_TRACK' && s.status !== 'ON_TRACK') return false;
    if (filter === 'NEEDS_ATTENTION' && s.status !== 'NEEDS_ATTENTION') return false;
    if (
      filter === 'MILESTONE_CLAIMED' &&
      s.milestoneStatus !== 'CLAIMED_PARTNER_NOTIFIED' &&
      s.milestoneStatus !== 'REWARD_ACTIVATED'
    ) {
      return false;
    }

    // Search query
    if (searchQuery.trim()) {
      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
      const matchName = s.name.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const matchFounders = s.founders.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const matchCategory = s.category.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const matchOneLiner = s.oneLiner.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      return matchName || matchFounders || matchCategory || matchOneLiner;
    }

    return true;
  });

  // Active Startup (prefers selected startup within filtered list, falling back to first visible)
  const activeStartup =
    filteredStartups.find((s) => s.id === selectedStartupId) ||
    filteredStartups[0] ||
    currentStartups[0];

  // Set note text when startup changes
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (activeStartup) {
      setNoteText(activeStartup.mentorNotes || '');
      setEditingNote(false);
    }
  }, [activeStartup?.id]);

  const magicOnboardingUrl = `https://startuppreflight.com/register?cohort=${data.cohort.inviteCode}`;

  function triggerNotify(type: 'success' | 'error', message: string) {
    setNotification({ type, message });
    setTimeout(() => {
      setNotification(null);
    }, 4500);
  }

  // Handle Save Mentor Note
  async function handleSaveMentorNote() {
    if (!activeStartup) return;
    setIsSavingNote(true);
    try {
      const res = await updateCohortStartupMentorNoteAction({
        planId: activeStartup.id,
        mentorNote: noteText,
      });

      if (res.success) {
        // Update local state
        setData((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          startups: prev.startups.map((s) =>
            s.id === activeStartup.id ? { ...s, mentorNotes: noteText } : s
          ),
        }));
        setEditingNote(false);
        triggerNotify('success', 'Mentor intelligence note saved successfully.');
      } else {
        triggerNotify('error', res.error || 'Failed to save mentor note.');
      }
    } catch {
      triggerNotify('error', 'An unexpected error occurred while saving.');
    } finally {
      setIsSavingNote(false);
    }
  }

  // Handle Milestone Approval
  async function handleApproveMilestone(planId: string) {
    setIsApproving(true);
    try {
      const res = await reviewCohortMilestoneClaimAction({
        planId,
        decision: 'APPROVE',
        approvalNotes: 'Approved by Cohort Director via Institutional Command Center.',
      });

      if (res.success) {
        setData((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          startups: prev.startups.map((s) =>
            s.id === planId
              ? {
                  ...s,
                  milestoneStatus: 'REWARD_ACTIVATED',
                  status: 'MILESTONE_CLAIMED',
                  statusBadge: {
                    label: 'Milestone Activated 🎁',
                    bg: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300',
                    dot: 'bg-emerald-500',
                  },
                }
              : s
          ),
        }));
        triggerNotify('success', 'Milestone Reward approved & activated! Founder has been notified.');
      } else {
        triggerNotify('error', res.error || 'Failed to approve milestone.');
      }
    } catch {
      triggerNotify('error', 'Unexpected error approving milestone.');
    } finally {
      setIsApproving(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-white font-sans selection:bg-indigo-600 selection:text-white">
      {/* Toast Notification */}
      {notification && (
        <div className="fixed top-4 right-4 z-50 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-900/95 px-4 py-3 text-xs shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-md animate-in slide-in-from-top-2">
          {notification.type === 'success' ? (
            <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
          ) : (
            <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-rose-400 shrink-0" />
          )}
          <span className="text-slate-200 font-medium">{notification.message}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Top Banner if Demo Route */}
      {data.isSampleData && (
        <div className="border-b border-indigo-500/30 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-950/80 via-slate-900 to-indigo-950/80 px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-indigo-200 sm:px-6">
          <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="flex h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-indigo-400 animate-ping" />
              <span className="font-semibold text-white">Interactive Demo Mode:</span>
              <span>
                Simulated NovaUCD &amp; Trinity Tangent venture batch command center.
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="outline"
                onClick={() => {
                  navigator.clipboard.writeText(magicOnboardingUrl);
                  triggerNotify('success', `Copied registration link: ${magicOnboardingUrl}`);
                }}
                className="h-7 text-[11px] border-indigo-400/40 bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-200 hover:bg-indigo-500/20"
              >
                <Copy className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
                Copy Batch Onboarding Link
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Top Banner if User explicitly toggled Preview Mode on an empty cohort */}
      {isCohortEmpty && isPreviewMode && (
        <div className="border-b border-purple-500/30 bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-950/90 via-slate-900 to-purple-950/90 px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-purple-200 sm:px-6">
          <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Eye className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-purple-400 shrink-0" />
              <span className="font-semibold text-white">Sample Batch Preview Active:</span>

              <GraduationCap className="h-6 w-6" />

                <Badge

                >
                  {data.cohort.intakeType === 'ROLLING' ? '⚡ Rolling Intake' : '📅 Fixed Batch'}

                            className={`h-full rounded-full ${
                              activeStartup.modulesBreakdown.team < 60
                                ? 'bg-amber-500'
                                : 'bg-emerald-500'
                            }`}
                            style={{ width: `${activeStartup.modulesBreakdown.team}%` }}
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div>
                        <div className="flex justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-300">
                          <span>5. Pocket Profit 3-Yr Financials &amp; Cashflow (H–J)</span>
                          <span className="font-mono text-violet-400">
                            {activeStartup.modulesBreakdown.financials}%
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="h-1.5 w-full bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                          <div
                            className="h-full bg-violet-500 rounded-full"
                            style={{ width: `${activeStartup.modulesBreakdown.financials}%` }}
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div>
                        <div className="flex justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-300">
                          <span>6. Official Grant Mode &amp; Audit (K–L)</span>
                          <span className="font-mono text-purple-400">
                            {activeStartup.modulesBreakdown.grantPack}%
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="h-1.5 w-full bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                          <div
                            className="h-full bg-purple-500 rounded-full"
                            style={{ width: `${activeStartup.modulesBreakdown.grantPack}%` }}
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Customer Validation Proof Box */}
                  <div className="mt-5 space-y-2.5">
                    <div className="rounded-lg border border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/50 p-2.5 text-xs">
                      <div className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase">
                        Customer Validation Proof
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-0.5 text-slate-200">
                        <strong>{activeStartup.surveyResponsesCount} verified responses</strong> ·{' '}
                        {activeStartup.willingnessToPay}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Mentor Intelligence Note / Edit Box */}
                    <div
                      className={`rounded-lg border p-2.5 text-xs ${
                        activeStartup.status === 'NEEDS_ATTENTION'
                          ? 'border-amber-700/60 bg-amber-950/40 text-amber-200'
                          : 'border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/50 text-slate-300'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
                        <span>Director &amp; Mentor Intelligence Note</span>
                        {!editingNote && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setEditingNote(true)}
                            className="text-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-300 lowercase text-[10px] font-sans"
                          >
                            [edit note]
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      {editingNote ? (
                        <div className="mt-2 space-y-2">
                          <Textarea
                            value={noteText}
                            onChange={(e) => setNoteText(e.target.value)}
                            placeholder="Add your mentor observation or next step for this startup..."
                            rows={3}
                            className="text-xs bg-slate-950 border-slate-700 text-white placeholder-slate-500"
                          />
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                            <Button
                              type="button"
                              size="sm"
                              variant="ghost"
                              onClick={() => setEditingNote(false)}
                              className="h-6 text-[10px] text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
                            >
                              Cancel
                            </Button>
                            <Button
                              type="button"
                              size="sm"
                              disabled={isSavingNote}
                              onClick={handleSaveMentorNote}
                              className="h-6 text-[10px] bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white"
                            >
                              {isSavingNote ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Note'}
                            </Button>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="mt-1 leading-relaxed">
                          {activeStartup.mentorNotes ||
                            activeStartup.mentorFlag ||
                            'No notes logged yet. Click [edit note] to record mentor observations or actions.'}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Footer Action */}
                <div className="pt-4 border-t border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                  <div className="text-slate-400 text-[11px]">
                    Founder: <span className="text-slate-200">{activeStartup.founderEmail || activeStartup.founders}</span>
                  </div>
                  <Link href={`/workspace?planId=${activeStartup.id}`} target="_blank">
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      variant="outline"
                      className="h-7 text-xs border-slate-700 bg-slate-900 text-indigo-300 hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white"
                    >
                      <span>Open Startup Plan</span>
                      <ArrowUpRight className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    </Button>
                  </Link>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="lg:col-span-5 p-8 text-center text-xs text-slate-400">
                Select a startup to inspect its dossier.
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
  );
}

export function CohortsPageClient() {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: '',
    email: '',
    organizationName: '',
    organizationType: 'UNIVERSITY',
    customOrganizationType: '',
    cohortSize: '25_50',
    regionalFocus: 'IE_UK',
    targetStartDate: 'NEXT_QUARTER',
    notes: '',
  });

  const [selectedGoals, setSelectedGoals] = useState<string[]>([
    'Standardize business plans across all teams',
    'Pre-qualify founders for regional grants (LEO / Innovate UK)',
    'Free up mentor hours from repetitive document reviews',
  ]);

  const [selectedStartupId, setSelectedStartupId] = useState('startup-1');
  const [cohortFilter, setCohortFilter] = useState<'ALL' | 'GRANT_READY' | 'VALIDATING' | 'NEEDS_ATTENTION'>('ALL');
  const [searchFilter, setSearchFilter] = useState('');

  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [submissionSuccess, setSubmissionSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [openFaqIndex, setOpenFaqIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const filteredStartups = STARTUPS_DATA.filter((s) => {
    if (cohortFilter === 'GRANT_READY' && s.status !== 'GRANT_READY') return false;
    if (cohortFilter === 'VALIDATING' && s.status !== 'VALIDATING' && s.status !== 'ON_TRACK') return false;
    if (cohortFilter === 'NEEDS_ATTENTION' && s.status !== 'NEEDS_ATTENTION') return false;
    if (searchFilter) {
      const q = searchFilter.toLowerCase();
      return (
        s.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        s.founders.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        s.category.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        s.grantFocus.toLowerCase().includes(q)
      );
    }
    return true;
  });

  const activeStartup =
    STARTUPS_DATA.find((s) => s.id === selectedStartupId) || STARTUPS_DATA[0];

  function toggleGoal(goal: string) {
    setSelectedGoals((prev) =>
      prev.includes(goal) ? prev.filter((g) => g !== goal) : [...prev, goal]
    );
  }

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const res = await submitCohortInquiryAction({
        name: formData.name,
        email: formData.email,
        organizationName: formData.organizationName,
        organizationType: formData.organizationType,
        customOrganizationType: formData.customOrganizationType,
        cohortSize: formData.cohortSize,
        regionalFocus: formData.regionalFocus,
        targetStartDate: formData.targetStartDate,
        goals: selectedGoals,
        notes: formData.notes,
      });

      if (res.ok) {
        setSubmissionSuccess(true);
      } else {
        setErrorMessage(res.error || 'Failed to submit inquiry. Please try again.');
      }
    } catch {
      setErrorMessage('A network error occurred. Please try again or email us directly.');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 text-slate-900 selection:bg-indigo-600 selection:text-white">
      <MarketingHeader active="cohorts" />

      {/* ===================================================================== */}
      {/* 1. HERO SECTION                                                       */}
      {/* ===================================================================== */}
      <section className="relative overflow-hidden border-b border-slate-200/80 bg-linear-to-b from-white via-indigo-50/25 to-slate-50 pt-16 pb-20 sm:pt-24 sm:pb-28">
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[linear-gradient(to_right,#e2e8f0_1px,transparent_1px),gradient(to_bottom,#e2e8f0_1px,transparent_1px)] bg-[size:4rem_4rem] [mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse_60%_50%_at_50%_0%,#000_70%,transparent_100%)] opacity-35" />

        <div className="relative mx-auto max-w-5xl px-4 text-center sm:px-6">
          {/* Eyebrow Pill */}
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-indigo-200/80 bg-indigo-50/90 px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-700 shadow-2xs backdrop-blur-sm">
            <GraduationCap className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-600" />
            <span>Preflight for Accelerators &amp; Cohorts</span>
            <span className="hidden text-slate-400 sm:inline">•</span>
            <span className="hidden font-normal text-indigo-900 sm:inline">
              For Universities, Incubators, LEOs &amp; Growth Hubs
            </span>
          </div>

          <h1 className="mt-6 text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl">
            Turn Raw Founder Ideas Into{' '}
            <span className="bg-linear-to-r from-indigo-600 via-indigo-700 to-violet-700 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
              Investment &amp; Grant-Ready
            </span>{' '}
            Businesses.
          </h1>

          <p className="mx-auto mt-6 max-w-3xl text-base leading-relaxed text-slate-600 sm:text-lg">

Equip every founder in your batch with a self-guided AI co-founder across ideation, customer validation, financial modeling, and grant prep — while your mentors track clean, standardized plans without wading through messy spreadsheets.
          </p>

          {/* CTA Cluster */}
          <div className="mt-8 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 sm:flex-row">
            <a href="#cohort-panel-preview" className="w-full sm:w-auto">
              <Button
                size="lg"
                className="w-full h-12 rounded-full bg-indigo-600 px-7 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-md shadow-indigo-200 transition hover:bg-indigo-700 sm:w-auto"
              >
                Explore Cohort Command Center
                <ArrowRight className="ml-2 h-4 w-4" />
              </Button>
            </a>
            <a href="#inquiry-form" className="w-full sm:w-auto">
              <Button
