'use client';

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import {
  CheckCircle2,
  Circle,
  Printer,
  Sparkles,
  ArrowRight,
  ArrowLeft,
  Building2,
  ShieldCheck,
  AlertTriangle,
  RotateCcw,
  Check,
  FileCheck2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { ShareGrantButton } from '@/components/marketing/share-grant-button';

export interface ChecklistItem {
  id: string;
  category: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  isCrucial?: boolean;
}

interface GrantChecklistClientProps {
  grant: {
    slug: string;
    countryCode: string;
    grantName: string;
    providerAgency: string;
    fundingType: string;
    maxAmountFormatted: string;
    leoThreeQuoteEnforced?: boolean | null;
    reimbursementWarning: string;
  };
  checklistItems: ChecklistItem[];
}

export function GrantChecklistClient({
  grant,
  checklistItems,
}: GrantChecklistClientProps) {
  const [checkedIds, setCheckedIds] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});

  // Group items by category
  const categories = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, ChecklistItem[]>();
    for (const item of checklistItems) {
      const list = map.get(item.category) || [];
      list.push(item);
      map.set(item.category, list);
    }
    return Array.from(map.entries());
  }, [checklistItems]);

  const totalCount = checklistItems.length;
  const completedCount = useMemo(() => {
    return checklistItems.filter((item) => checkedIds[item.id]).length;
  }, [checklistItems, checkedIds]);

  const percentage = totalCount > 0 ? Math.round((completedCount / totalCount) * 100) : 0;

  const toggleItem = (id: string) => {
    setCheckedIds((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [id]: !prev[id],
    }));
  };

  const handlePrint = () => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      window.print();
    }
  };

  const handleReset = () => {
    setCheckedIds({});
  };

  const flagEmoji = grant.countryCode === 'IE' ? '🇮🇪' : grant.countryCode === 'GB' ? '🇬🇧' : '🌍';
  const countrySegment = grant.countryCode.toLowerCase();
  const grantDetailHref = `/grants/${countrySegment}/${grant.slug}`;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      {/* 1. PROGRESS TRACKER & QUICK ACTIONS */}
      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-xs print:hidden">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
                Application Readiness Score
              </span>
              <Badge
                variant="outline"
                className={`text-[10px] font-bold ${
                  percentage === 100
                    ? 'border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800'
                    : percentage >= 50
                    ? 'border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700'
                    : 'border-slate-200 text-slate-600'
                }`}
              >
                {percentage === 100
                  ? 'Assessor Ready'
                  : `${completedCount} of ${totalCount} Checked`}
              </Badge>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-1.5 flex items-baseline gap-2">
              <span className="text-3xl font-extrabold text-slate-900">{percentage}%</span>
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                {percentage === 100
                  ? 'All crucial compliance documents and eligibility criteria verified.'
                  : 'Check each item as you gather documents to ensure a zero-defect submission.'}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <ShareGrantButton
              title={`${grant.grantName} (${grant.countryCode}) Checklist`}
              description={`Zero-defect application checklist for ${grant.grantName} from ${grant.providerAgency}.`}
              slug={grant.slug}
              countryCode={grant.countryCode}
              pathType="checklist"
              size="sm"
              variant="outline"
              className="h-9 border-slate-200 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
              buttonText="Share"
            />
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={handlePrint}
              className="h-9 border-slate-200 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
            >
              <Printer className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-500" />
              Print / Save PDF
            </Button>
            {completedCount > 0 && (
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="ghost"
                size="sm"
                onClick={handleReset}
                className="h-9 text-xs text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900"
              >
                <RotateCcw className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Reset
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Progress Bar */}
        <div className="mt-4 h-2 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-slate-100">
          <div
            className={`h-full transition-all duration-300 ${
              percentage === 100
                ? 'bg-emerald-500'
                : percentage >= 50
                ? 'bg-indigo-600'
                : 'bg-indigo-400'
            }`}
            style={{ width: `${percentage}%` }}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. PRINT-ONLY HEADER */}
      <div className="hidden print:block border-b border-slate-300 pb-4 mb-6">
        <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900">
          {grant.grantName} — Official Application Checklist
        </h1>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 mt-1">
          Provider: {grant.providerAgency} • Region: {grant.countryCode} • Generated via Startup Preflight
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* 3. GROUPED CHECKLIST CATEGORIES */}
      <div className="space-y-6">
        {categories.map(([category, items]) => {
          const categoryCompleted = items.filter((it) => checkedIds[it.id]).length;

          return (
            <div
              key={category}
              className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-xs"
            >
              {/* Category Header */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/70 px-5 py-3 sm:px-6">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <FileCheck2 className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-600" />
                  <h2 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-800">
                    {category}
                  </h2>
                </div>
                <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500">
                  {categoryCompleted}/{items.length} verified
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Items List */}
              <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                {items.map((item) => {
                  const isChecked = !!checkedIds[item.id];

                  return (
                    <div
                      key={item.id}
                      onClick={() => toggleItem(item.id)}
                      className={`group flex items-start gap-4 p-4.5 sm:px-6 cursor-pointer transition-colors ${
                        isChecked
                          ? 'bg-emerald-50/30'
                          : 'hover:bg-slate-50/60'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {/* Checkbox Trigger */}
                      <div className="pt-0.5 shrink-0">
                        {isChecked ? (
                          <div className="flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-2xs">
                            <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5 stroke-[3]" />
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <div className="h-5 w-5 rounded-md border border-slate-300 bg-white group-hover:border-indigo-400 transition" />
                        )}
                      </div>

                      {/* Content */}
                      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                          <h3
                            className={`text-sm font-semibold transition ${
                              isChecked
                                ? 'text-slate-500 line-through'
                                : 'text-slate-900 group-hover:text-indigo-600'
                            }`}
                          >
                            {item.title}
                          </h3>
                          {item.isCrucial && (
                            <span className="rounded bg-rose-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-rose-700 border border-rose-200">
                              Assessor Mandatory
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <p
                          className={`mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed ${
                            isChecked ? 'text-slate-400' : 'text-slate-600'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {item.description}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* 4. REIMBURSEMENT WARNING CALLOUT */}
      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-xs flex items-start gap-3.5">
        <div className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-amber-50 text-amber-600">
          <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4" />
        </div>
        <div>
          <h3 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-900">
            Assessor Timing &amp; Retrospective Warning
          </h3>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-slate-600">
            {grant.reimbursementWarning}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 5. NEXT STEPS / FOOTER CONVERSION */}
      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-indigo-200 bg-gradient-to-b from-indigo-50/70 via-white to-indigo-50/30 p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-xs flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-6 print:hidden">
        <div className="space-y-1 max-w-xl">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-indigo-700">
            <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4" />
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
              Ready to assemble your grant pack?
            </span>
          </div>
          <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">
            Use Startup Preflight to draft, audit and compile your application.
          </h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">
            Module A and K auto-generate the written concept, hiring schedule, financial forecast, and 3-quote supplier schedule in the exact format assessors expect.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center gap-2.5 shrink-0">
          <Link href={grantDetailHref}>
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              className="w-full sm:w-auto h-10 rounded-xl border-slate-200 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              Full Grant Scheme Details
            </Button>
          </Link>
          <Link href="/register">
            <Button className="w-full sm:w-auto h-10 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 text-xs font-semibold text-white shadow-sm hover:bg-indigo-600 transition">
              Prepare with Preflight Free
              <ArrowRight className="ml-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </Button>
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import {
  getFaqsForEdition,
  type FaqItem,
} from '@/components/marketing/landing-faqs';
import type { LandingEdition } from '@/components/marketing/platform-ui-previews';

export function LandingSeoJsonLd({ edition }: { edition: LandingEdition }) {
  const faqs: FaqItem[] = getFaqsForEdition(edition);

  const currency =
    edition === 'IE' ? 'EUR' : edition === 'UK' ? 'GBP' : 'USD';
  const soloPrice =
    edition === 'IE' ? '129.00' : edition === 'UK' ? '109.00' : '139.00';
  const pageUrl =
    edition === 'IE'
      ? 'https://startuppreflight.com/ie'
      : edition === 'UK'
        ? 'https://startuppreflight.com/uk'
        : 'https://startuppreflight.com/';

  const softwareSchema = {
    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    '@type': 'SoftwareApplication',
    name:
      edition === 'IE'

        : edition === 'UK'

=== src/components/marketing/share-grant-button.tsx ===
'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Share2,
  Copy,
  Check,
  Linkedin,
  Twitter,
  Mail,
  MessageCircle,
  ExternalLink,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';

export interface ShareGrantButtonProps {
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  slug: string;
  countryCode: string;
  pathType?: 'detail' | 'checklist';
  variant?: 'default' | 'outline' | 'ghost' | 'secondary';
  size?: 'default' | 'sm' | 'lg' | 'icon';
  className?: string;
  buttonText?: string;
  showLabel?: boolean;
}

export function ShareGrantButton({
  title,
  description,
  slug,
  countryCode,
  pathType = 'detail',
  variant = 'outline',
  size = 'default',
  className = '',
  buttonText = 'Share Grant',
  showLabel = true,
}: ShareGrantButtonProps) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [canNativeShare, setCanNativeShare] = useState(false);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const countrySegment = countryCode.toLowerCase();
  const relativePath = `/grants/${countrySegment}/${slug}${pathType === 'checklist' ? '/checklist' : ''}`;
  const canonicalUrl = `https://startuppreflight.com${relativePath}`;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && typeof navigator.share === 'function') {
      setCanNativeShare(true);
    }
  }, []);

  // Close when clicking outside
  useEffect(() => {
    function handleClickOutside(event: MouseEvent) {
      if (containerRef.current && !containerRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    }

    function handleKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    }

    if (isOpen) {
      document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    }

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [isOpen]);

  const getShareUrl = () => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      return window.location.href;
    }
    return canonicalUrl;
  };

  const handleCopyLink = async () => {
    const url = getShareUrl();
    try {
      if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
      } else {
        const textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
        textarea.value = url;
        document.body.appendChild(textarea);
        textarea.select();
        document.execCommand('copy');
        document.body.removeChild(textarea);
      }
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Copy link failed:', err);
    }
  };

  const handleNativeShare = async () => {
    const url = getShareUrl();
    try {
      if (navigator.share) {
        await navigator.share({
          title,
          text: description || `Check out ${title} on Startup Preflight`,
          url,
        });
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    } catch {
      // User cancelled native share
    }
  };

  const currentUrl = getShareUrl();
  const shareText = `${title} — Non-dilutive startup funding & eligibility guide`;

  const shareLinks = [
    {
      name: 'LinkedIn',
      icon: Linkedin,
      iconColor: 'text-[#0A66C2]',
      bgColor: 'hover:bg-blue-50 hover:border-blue-200',
      href: `https://www.linkedin.com/sharing/share-offsite/?url=${encodeURIComponent(currentUrl)}`,
    },
    {
      name: 'X (Twitter)',
      icon: Twitter,
      iconColor: 'text-slate-900',
      bgColor: 'hover:bg-slate-100 hover:border-slate-300',
      href: `https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=${encodeURIComponent(currentUrl)}&text=${encodeURIComponent(shareText)}`,
    },
    {
      name: 'WhatsApp',
      icon: MessageCircle,
      iconColor: 'text-[#25D366]',
      bgColor: 'hover:bg-emerald-50 hover:border-emerald-200',
      href: `https://api.whatsapp.com/send?text=${encodeURIComponent(`${shareText}\n${currentUrl}`)}`,
    },
    {
      name: 'Email',
      icon: Mail,
      iconColor: 'text-indigo-600',
      bgColor: 'hover:bg-indigo-50 hover:border-indigo-200',
      href: `mailto:?subject=${encodeURIComponent(title)}&body=${encodeURIComponent(
        `Hi,\n\nI wanted to share this startup grant with you:\n\n${title}\n${description ? `${description}\n\n` : ''}${currentUrl}`
      )}`,
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="relative inline-block text-left" ref={containerRef}>
      <Button
        type="button"
        variant={variant}
        size={size}
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        aria-haspopup="true"
        aria-expanded={isOpen}
        className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 transition ${className}`}
      >
        <Share2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-500" />
        {showLabel && buttonText && <span>{buttonText}</span>}
      </Button>

      {isOpen && (
        <div className="absolute right-0 z-50 mt-2 w-72 sm:w-80 origin-top-right rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-3.5 shadow-xl ring-1 ring-black/5 animate-in fade-in-0 zoom-in-95 focus:outline-hidden">
          {/* Header */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 pb-2.5">
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">Share Grant Scheme</p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 truncate max-w-[210px]">{title}</p>
            </div>
            <span className="rounded bg-slate-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-600 uppercase">
              {countryCode}
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* Copy Link Input Bar */}
          <div className="mt-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/80 p-1.5">
              <input
                type="text"
                readOnly
                value={currentUrl}
                aria-label="Grant page shareable link"
                className="w-full truncate bg-transparent px-2 text-xs text-slate-600 select-all focus:outline-hidden"
              />
              <Button
                type="button"
                size="sm"
                onClick={handleCopyLink}
                className={`h-7 px-2.5 text-xs font-semibold shrink-0 transition-all ${
                  copied
                    ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white hover:bg-emerald-700'
                    : 'bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-700'
                }`}
              >
                {copied ? (
                  <>
                    <Check className="mr-1 h-3 w-3" />
                    Copied
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Copy className="mr-1 h-3 w-3" />
                    Copy
                  </>
                )}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Quick Share Targets */}
          <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
            {shareLinks.map((item) => (
              <a
                key={item.name}
                href={item.href}
                target="_blank"
                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
                className={`flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-100 p-2 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 transition ${item.bgColor}`}
              >
                <item.icon className={`h-4 w-4 shrink-0 ${item.iconColor}`} />
                <span className="truncate">{item.name}</span>
                <ExternalLink className="ml-auto h-2.5 w-2.5 text-slate-400" />
              </a>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Native Share Option on Mobile / Supported Desktops */}
          {canNativeShare && (
            <div className="mt-2.5 pt-2.5 border-t border-slate-100">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleNativeShare}
                className="flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 transition"
              >
                <Share2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-600" />
                <span>More options... (AirDrop, Apps)</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function LandingPageExperience({
  edition,
}: {
  edition: LandingEdition;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [showAllModules, setShowAllModules] = useState(false);
  const [openFaqIndex, setOpenFaqIndex] = useState<number | null>(0);

  const modulesList = getModulesForEdition(edition);
  const faqs = getFaqsForEdition(edition);

  // Sync region cookie + auto-detect browser timezone/locale on first visit
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;

    // 1. Persist explicit region cookie when visiting /ie or /uk so Onboarding pre-selects it
    if (edition === 'IE') {
      document.cookie =
        'spf_region=IE; path=/; max-age=7776000; SameSite=Lax';
      window.localStorage.setItem('spf_region', 'IE');
      return;
    }
    if (edition === 'UK') {
      document.cookie =
        'spf_region=GB; path=/; max-age=7776000; SameSite=Lax';
      window.localStorage.setItem('spf_region', 'GB');
      return;
    }

    // 2. When on Global ('/'), inspect browser timezone & locale if user hasn't manually chosen Global
    const manualChoice = window.sessionStorage.getItem('spf_edition_manual');
    if (manualChoice) return;

    try {
      const tz =
        Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone?.toLowerCase() || '';
      const lang = (navigator.language || '').toLowerCase();

      if (tz === 'europe/dublin' || lang === 'en-ie' || lang === 'ga-ie') {
        document.cookie =
          'spf_region=IE; path=/; max-age=7776000; SameSite=Lax';
        window.localStorage.setItem('spf_region', 'IE');
        router.replace('/ie');
      } else if (
        tz === 'europe/london' ||
        tz === 'europe/belfast' ||
        lang === 'en-gb'
      ) {
        document.cookie =
          'spf_region=GB; path=/; max-age=7776000; SameSite=Lax';
        window.localStorage.setItem('spf_region', 'GB');
        router.replace('/uk');
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore Intl errors in restricted environments
    }
  }, [edition, router]);

  const handleSwitchEdition = (target: LandingEdition) => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      window.sessionStorage.setItem('spf_edition_manual', target);
      if (target === 'IE') {
        document.cookie =
          'spf_region=IE; path=/; max-age=7776000; SameSite=Lax';
        window.localStorage.setItem('spf_region', 'IE');
      } else if (target === 'UK') {
        document.cookie =
          'spf_region=GB; path=/; max-age=7776000; SameSite=Lax';
        window.localStorage.setItem('spf_region', 'GB');
      } else {
        document.cookie =
          'spf_region=US; path=/; max-age=7776000; SameSite=Lax';
        window.localStorage.setItem('spf_region', 'US');
      }
    }
  };

  // Pricing values per edition
  const pricingCurrency =
    edition === 'IE'
      ? { symbol: '€', solo: '129', cofounder: '199', vault: '9' }
      : edition === 'UK'
        ? { symbol: '£', solo: '109', cofounder: '169', vault: '8' }
        : { symbol: '$', solo: '139', cofounder: '219', vault: '9' };

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-slate-50 text-slate-900">
      {/* Clean, Single-Bar Modern SaaS Navbar */}
      <MarketingHeader
        edition={edition}
        onSwitchEdition={handleSwitchEdition}
      />

      <main className="flex-1">
        {/* SECTION 1: HERO + INTERACTIVE LIVE UI PRODUCT SHOWCASE (OPTION 1) */}
        <section
          id="platform-preview"
          className="relative overflow-hidden border-b border-slate-200 bg-gradient-to-b from-white via-indigo-50/35 to-slate-50 px-4 pt-12 pb-16 sm:px-6 lg:pt-16 lg:pb-20"
        >
          <div className="mx-auto max-w-4xl text-center">
            {/* Edition Pill Badge */}
            <div className="inline-flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-indigo-200 bg-white px-3.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-950 shadow-2xs">
              <span className="relative flex h-2 w-2">
                <span className="absolute inline-flex h-full w-full animate-ping rounded-full bg-emerald-500 opacity-75" />
                <span className="relative inline-flex h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-600" />
              </span>
              {edition === 'GLOBAL' && (
                <span>
                  Capture First, Expand Second • Zero Blank Spreadsheets
                </span>
              )}
              {edition === 'IE' && (
                <span>
                  🇮🇪 Built for Ireland Founders • LEO, Enterprise Ireland &amp;
                  SURE Ready
                </span>
              )}
              {edition === 'UK' && (

                  🇬🇧 Built for UK Founders • Start Up Loans, Innovate UK &amp;
                  SEIS Ready
                </span>
              )}
            </div>

'use client';

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import {
  Search,
  Filter,
  Sparkles,
  ArrowRight,
  ExternalLink,
  Building2,
  Euro,
  Coins,
  ShieldCheck,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  ChevronRight,
  Award,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { ShareGrantButton } from '@/components/marketing/share-grant-button';
import type { GrantDirectoryRecord } from '@/app/actions/admin-grants';

interface GrantsDirectoryClientProps {
  initialGrants: GrantDirectoryRecord[];
}

export function GrantsDirectoryClient({ initialGrants }: GrantsDirectoryClientProps) {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [countryFilter, setCountryFilter] = useState<'ALL' | 'IE' | 'GB'>('ALL');
  const [fundingTypeFilter, setFundingTypeFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');

  const filteredGrants = useMemo(() => {
    return initialGrants.filter((grant) => {
      const matchesCountry = countryFilter === 'ALL' || grant.countryCode === countryFilter;
      const matchesType = fundingTypeFilter === 'ALL' || grant.fundingType === fundingTypeFilter;
      const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
      const matchesSearch =
        !query ||
        grant.grantName.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
        grant.providerAgency.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
        (grant.summary && grant.summary.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ||
        grant.slug.toLowerCase().includes(query);
      return matchesCountry && matchesType && matchesSearch;
    });
  }, [initialGrants, countryFilter, fundingTypeFilter, searchQuery]);

  const uniqueTypes = useMemo(() => {
    const types = new Set<string>();
    initialGrants.forEach((g) => {
      if (g.fundingType) types.add(g.fundingType);
    });
    return Array.from(types);
  }, [initialGrants]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      {/* 1. FILTER CONTROLS BAR */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-xs sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between sm:p-5">
        {/* Country Selector Pills */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pb-1 sm:pb-0">
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant={countryFilter === 'ALL' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            onClick={() => setCountryFilter('ALL')}
            className="h-8 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold"
          >
            All Regions ({initialGrants.length})
          </Button>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant={countryFilter === 'IE' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            onClick={() => setCountryFilter('IE')}
            className={`h-8 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold ${
              countryFilter === 'IE' ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white' : 'text-slate-700 hover:bg-emerald-50'
            }`}
          >
            🇮🇪 Ireland ({initialGrants.filter((g) => g.countryCode === 'IE').length})
          </Button>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant={countryFilter === 'GB' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            onClick={() => setCountryFilter('GB')}
            className={`h-8 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold ${
              countryFilter === 'GB' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white' : 'text-slate-700 hover:bg-blue-50'
            }`}
          >
            🇬🇧 UK ({initialGrants.filter((g) => g.countryCode === 'GB').length})
          </Button>
        </div>

        {/* Search Input & Funding Type Filter */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <div className="relative flex-1 sm:w-64">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-2.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-400" />
            <Input
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search grants, vouchers, LEO..."
              className="h-9 w-full rounded-lg pl-8 text-xs focus:ring-indigo-600"
            />
          </div>

          <select
            value={fundingTypeFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setFundingTypeFilter(e.target.value)}
            className="h-9 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 shadow-2xs focus:border-indigo-600 focus:outline-hidden"
          >
            <option value="ALL">All Funding Types</option>
            {uniqueTypes.map((type) => (
              <option key={type} value={type}>
                {type.replace(/_/g, ' ')}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. GRANTS CARDS GRID */}
      {filteredGrants.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-white p-12 text-center">
          <Building2 className="mx-auto h-10 w-10 text-slate-300" />
          <h3 className="mt-3 text-base font-bold text-slate-800">No grant schemes found</h3>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
            Try adjusting your search keywords, region, or funding type filters.
          </p>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant="outline"
            onClick={() => {
              setSearchQuery('');
              setCountryFilter('ALL');
              setFundingTypeFilter('ALL');
            }}
            className="mt-4 text-xs"
          >
            Clear All Filters
          </Button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
          {filteredGrants.map((grant) => {
            const countrySegment = grant.countryCode.toLowerCase();
            const detailHref = `/grants/${countrySegment}/${grant.slug}`;

            return (
              <Card
                key={grant.id}
                className="group flex flex-col justify-between rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white transition-all duration-200 hover:border-indigo-300 hover:shadow-md"
              >
                <CardContent className="p-5">
                  {/* Badge cluster */}
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-slate-100 pb-3">
                    <Badge
                      variant="outline"
                      className={`text-[11px] font-semibold ${
                        grant.countryCode === 'IE'
                          ? 'border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800'
                          : grant.countryCode === 'GB'
                          ? 'border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 text-blue-800'
                          : 'border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-slate-700'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {grant.countryCode === 'IE'
                        ? '🇮🇪 Ireland'
                        : grant.countryCode === 'GB'
                        ? '🇬🇧 United Kingdom'
                        : grant.countryCode}
                    </Badge>

                    <span className="rounded bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-slate-600">
                      {grant.fundingType.replace(/_/g, ' ')}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Title & Agency */}
                  <div className="mt-3">
                    <Link href={detailHref} className="focus:outline-hidden">
                      <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 group-hover:text-indigo-600 transition-colors line-clamp-1">
                        {grant.grantName}
                      </h3>
                    </Link>
                    <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-slate-500 line-clamp-1">
                      {grant.providerAgency}
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  {/* Metric Highlight Box */}
                  <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/70 p-3">
                    <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between">
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
                        Maximum Funding
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700">
                        {grant.matchRatePercentage ? `${grant.matchRatePercentage}% Match` : 'Non-Dilutive'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="mt-1 text-lg font-black text-slate-900">
                      {grant.maxAmountFormatted}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Summary */}
                  <p className="mt-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-slate-600 line-clamp-2">
                    {grant.summary || 'Comprehensive grant funding support for qualified startup ventures.'}
                  </p>

                  {/* Tags */}
                  {grant.stageFit && (
                    <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                      <Clock className="h-3 w-3 text-slate-400" />
                      <span>{grant.stageFit}</span>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </CardContent>

                {/* Card Footer Actions */}
                <div className="border-t border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/50 p-3.5 px-5 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Link
                      href={detailHref}
                      className="inline-flex items-center text-xs font-bold text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-700"
                    >
                      View Scheme Criteria
                      <ChevronRight className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    </Link>
                    <ShareGrantButton
                      title={`${grant.grantName} (${grant.countryCode})`}
                      description={grant.summary || `Non-dilutive startup funding from ${grant.providerAgency}`}
                      slug={grant.slug}
                      countryCode={grant.countryCode}
                      size="sm"
                      variant="ghost"
                      className="h-7 w-7 p-0 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-200/60"
                      buttonText=""
                      showLabel={false}
                    />
                  </div>

                  <Link href="/register">
                    <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="h-7 text-[11px] font-semibold border-indigo-200 text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-50">
                      Prepare with Preflight
                    </Button>
                  </Link>
                </div>
              </Card>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
=== src/components/marketing/marketing-layout-nav.tsx ===
'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import { Globe2, ArrowRight, Menu, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { BrandLogo } from '@/components/ui/brand-logo';
import { GlobalFeedbackButton } from '@/components/feedback/global-feedback-dialog';
import { logoutFounderAction } from '@/app/actions/auth';
import { clearActiveBmuSession } from '@/lib/auth/session-store';

export type RegionalEdition = 'GLOBAL' | 'IE' | 'UK';

export interface MarketingHeaderProps {
  active?: 'product' | 'grants-covered' | 'tools' | 'modules' | 'pricing' | 'grants' | 'founder' | 'cohorts' | string;
  edition?: RegionalEdition;
  onSwitchEdition?: (edition: RegionalEdition) => void;
}

export function MarketingHeader({
  active: activeProp,
  edition: editionProp,
  onSwitchEdition,
}: MarketingHeaderProps = {}) {
  const pathname = usePathname() || '/';
  const [activeItem, setActiveItem] = useState<string>(activeProp || '');
  const [mobileMenuOpen, setMobileMenuOpen] = useState(false);

  // Regional edition state
  const [currentEdition, setCurrentEdition] = useState<RegionalEdition>(() => {
    if (editionProp) return editionProp;
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const path = window.location.pathname;
      if (path === '/ie' || path.startsWith('/ie/')) return 'IE';
      if (path === '/uk' || path.startsWith('/uk/')) return 'UK';
      const match = document.cookie.match(/(?:^|; )spf_region=([^;]*)/);
      const val = match ? decodeURIComponent(match[1]) : window.localStorage.getItem('spf_region');
      if (val === 'IE') return 'IE';
      if (val === 'GB' || val === 'UK') return 'UK';
    }
    return 'GLOBAL';
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (editionProp) {
      setCurrentEdition(editionProp);
    }
  }, [editionProp]);

  // Synchronize active navigation item
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeProp) {
      setActiveItem(activeProp);
      return;
    }

    if (pathname.startsWith('/grants')) {
      setActiveItem('grants');
      return;
    }
    if (pathname === '/about-founder') {
      setActiveItem('founder');
      return;
    }
    if (pathname === '/cohorts') {
      setActiveItem('cohorts');
      return;
    }

    const isLanding = pathname === '/' || pathname === '/ie' || pathname === '/uk';
    if (!isLanding) {
      setActiveItem('');
      return;
    }

    const sectionIds = [
      { id: 'pricing', key: 'pricing' },
      { id: 'how-it-works', key: 'modules' },
      { id: 'flagship-tools', key: 'tools' },
      { id: 'why-preflight', key: 'grants-covered' },
      { id: 'platform-preview', key: 'product' },
    ];

    const handleScroll = () => {
      const scrollPosition = window.scrollY + 200;
      let matched = '';

      for (const section of sectionIds) {
        const el = document.getElementById(section.id);
        if (el) {
          const top = el.offsetTop;
          const height = el.offsetHeight;
          if (scrollPosition >= top && scrollPosition < top + height) {
            matched = section.key;
            break;
          }
        }
      }

      setActiveItem(matched);
    };

    window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll, { passive: true });
    handleScroll();

    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);
  }, [pathname, activeProp]);

  const handleEditionClick = (target: RegionalEdition) => {
    setCurrentEdition(target);
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      window.sessionStorage.setItem('spf_edition_manual', target);
      const regionCode = target === 'IE' ? 'IE' : target === 'UK' ? 'GB' : 'US';
      document.cookie = `spf_region=${regionCode}; path=/; max-age=7776000; SameSite=Lax`;
      document.cookie = `bmu_region=${regionCode}; path=/; max-age=7776000; SameSite=Lax`;
      window.localStorage.setItem('spf_region', regionCode);
    }
    if (onSwitchEdition) {
      onSwitchEdition(target);
    }
  };

  const isLandingPage = pathname === '/' || pathname === '/ie' || pathname === '/uk';
  const homePrefix = currentEdition === 'IE' ? '/ie' : currentEdition === 'UK' ? '/uk' : '/';

  const getSectionHref = (sectionId: string) => {
    if (isLandingPage) {
      return `#${sectionId}`;
    }
    return `${homePrefix === '/' ? '' : homePrefix}/#${sectionId}`;
  };

  const grantsCoveredLabel =
    currentEdition === 'IE'
      ? 'Irish Grants'
      : currentEdition === 'UK'
        ? 'UK Grants & Loans'
        : 'Why Preflight';

  const navItems = [
    { key: 'product', label: 'Product', href: getSectionHref('platform-preview'), isAnchor: isLandingPage },
    { key: 'grants-covered', label: grantsCoveredLabel, href: getSectionHref('why-preflight'), isAnchor: isLandingPage },
    { key: 'tools', label: 'Tools', href: getSectionHref('flagship-tools'), isAnchor: isLandingPage },
    { key: 'modules', label: '12 Modules', href: getSectionHref('how-it-works'), isAnchor: isLandingPage },
    { key: 'pricing', label: 'Pricing', href: getSectionHref('pricing'), isAnchor: isLandingPage },
    { key: 'grants', label: 'Grants Directory', href: '/grants', isAnchor: false },
    { key: 'founder', label: 'Founder', href: '/about-founder', isAnchor: false },
    { key: 'cohorts', label: 'Cohorts', href: '/cohorts', isAnchor: false },
  ];

  return (
    <header className="sticky top-0 z-40 w-full border-b border-slate-200/70 bg-white/85 backdrop-blur-md">
      <div className="flex h-16 w-full items-center justify-between gap-3 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 xl:px-12">
        {/* Left: Clean Brand Wordmark */}
        <Link href={homePrefix} className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2.5">
          <BrandLogo variant="full" size="sm" theme="light" />
        </Link>

        {/* Center: Modern Floating Pill Nav (Desktop) */}
        <nav className="hidden items-center gap-1 rounded-full border border-slate-200/80 bg-slate-100/70 p-1 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 lg:flex">
          {navItems.map((item) => {
            const isActive = activeItem === item.key;
            const className = `rounded-full px-2.5 py-1.5 xl:px-3.5 transition text-xs ${
              isActive
                ? 'bg-white font-semibold text-slate-900 shadow-2xs'
                : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-white hover:text-slate-900 hover:shadow-2xs'
            }`;

            if (item.isAnchor) {
              return (
                <a key={item.key} href={item.href} className={className}>
                  {item.label}
                </a>
              );
            }

            return (
              <Link key={item.key} href={item.href} className={className}>
                {item.label}
              </Link>
            );
          })}
        </nav>

        {/* Right: Edition Switcher + Feedback + Auth Actions */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {/* Compact Regional Edition Switcher */}
          <div
            className="hidden items-center rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-100/80 p-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold sm:flex"
            aria-label="Select regional edition"
          >
            <Link
              href="/"
              onClick={() => handleEditionClick('GLOBAL')}
              className={`rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 transition ${
                currentEdition === 'GLOBAL'
                  ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-2xs'
                  : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900'
              }`}
              title="Global Edition (Business Plan Builder)"
            >
              🌍 Global
            </Link>
            <Link
              href="/ie"
              onClick={() => handleEditionClick('IE')}
              className={`rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 transition ${
                currentEdition === 'IE'
                  ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-2xs'
                  : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900'
              }`}
              title="Ireland Edition (LEO & Enterprise Ireland Grants)"
            >
              🇮🇪 IE
            </Link>
            <Link
              href="/uk"
              onClick={() => handleEditionClick('UK')}
              className={`rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 transition ${
                currentEdition === 'UK'
                  ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-2xs'
                  : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900'
              }`}
              title="UK Edition (Start Up Loans, Innovate UK & SEIS)"
            >
              🇬🇧 UK
            </Link>
          </div>

          <GlobalFeedbackButton variant="nav-link" />

          <Link
            href="/login"
            onClick={() => {
              clearActiveBmuSession();
              logoutFounderAction().catch(() => {});
            }}
            className="hidden px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 transition hover:text-slate-900 sm:inline-block"

=== src/hooks/use-autosave.ts ===
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import type { AutosaveStatus } from '@/components/workspace/autosave-status-indicator';

export interface UseAutosaveOptions<T> {
  data: T;
  onSave: (data: T) => Promise<void> | void;
  debounceMs?: number;
  isReadonly?: boolean;
  storageKey?: string;
  onStatusChange?: (status: AutosaveStatus, lastSavedAt?: Date) => void;
  enabled?: boolean;
}

export interface UseAutosaveResult {
  saveStatus: AutosaveStatus;
  lastSavedAt: Date | null;
  flush: () => Promise<void>;
  isDirty: boolean;
}

export function useAutosave<T>({
  data,
  onSave,
  debounceMs = 1200,
  isReadonly = false,
  storageKey,
  onStatusChange,
  enabled = true,
}: UseAutosaveOptions<T>): UseAutosaveResult {
  const [saveStatus, setSaveStatus] = useState<AutosaveStatus>('idle');
  const [lastSavedAt, setLastSavedAt] = useState<Date | null>(null);
  const [isDirty, setIsDirty] = useState(false);

  const isFirstRender = useRef(true);
  const isDirtyRef = useRef(false);
  const isSavingRef = useRef(false);
  const dataRef = useRef(data);
  dataRef.current = data;

  const onSaveRef = useRef(onSave);
  onSaveRef.current = onSave;

  const onStatusChangeRef = useRef(onStatusChange);
  onStatusChangeRef.current = onStatusChange;

  const updateStatus = useCallback((status: AutosaveStatus, date?: Date) => {
    setSaveStatus(status);
    if (date) setLastSavedAt(date);
    if (onStatusChangeRef.current) {
      onStatusChangeRef.current(status, date);
    }
  }, []);

  const flush = useCallback(async () => {
    if (isReadonly || !enabled || !isDirtyRef.current || isSavingRef.current) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      isSavingRef.current = true;
      updateStatus('saving');

      await onSaveRef.current(dataRef.current);

      isDirtyRef.current = false;
      setIsDirty(false);
      const now = new Date();
      updateStatus('saved', now);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Autosave flush failed:', err);
      updateStatus('error');
    } finally {
      isSavingRef.current = false;
    }
  }, [isReadonly, enabled, updateStatus]);

  // Handle data updates and debounced save
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isFirstRender.current) {
      isFirstRender.current = false;
      return;
    }

    if (isReadonly || !enabled) return;

    // Mark as dirty
    isDirtyRef.current = true;
    setIsDirty(true);

    // Immediate local storage backup
    if (storageKey && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        window.localStorage.setItem(
          storageKey,
          JSON.stringify({
            data,
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
          })
        );
      } catch {
        // Safe quota ignore
      }
    }

    updateStatus('saving');

    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      flush();
    }, debounceMs);

    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [data, debounceMs, isReadonly, enabled, storageKey, updateStatus, flush]);

  // Flush on unmount so switching modules/steps never loses in-flight edits
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (isDirtyRef.current && !isSavingRef.current && !isReadonly && enabled) {
        // Fire and forget on unmount
        void onSaveRef.current(dataRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, [isReadonly, enabled]);

  return {
    saveStatus,
    lastSavedAt,
    flush,
    isDirty,
  };
}
=== src/scripts/backup-db.ts ===
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import { Client } from 'pg';
import 'dotenv/config';

const TABLES_IN_ORDER = [
  'tenants',
  'cohorts',
  'users',
  'user_entitlements',
  'vouchers',
  'startup_plans',
  'plan_collaborators',
  'plan_modules_data',
  'open_questions_parking_lot',
  'validation_surveys',
  'survey_responses',
  'early_access_waitlist',
  'support_tickets',
  'ai_usage_logs',
  'country_rules',
  'grants_directory',
  'ai_prompts',
];

async function backup() {
  const dbUrl = process.env.DATABASE_URL;
  if (!dbUrl) {
    console.error('DATABASE_URL is not set in environment.');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  console.log('📦 Starting database backup from:', dbUrl.replace(/:[^:@]+@/, ':***@'));

  const client = new Client({
    connectionString: dbUrl,
    connectionTimeoutMillis: 15000,
  });

  await client.connect();

  const backupData: Record<string, unknown[]> = {};
  let totalRows = 0;

  for (const table of TABLES_IN_ORDER) {
    try {
      const res = await client.query(`SELECT * FROM "${table}";`);
      backupData[table] = res.rows;
      totalRows += res.rows.length;
      console.log(`  ✓ ${table.padEnd(28)} : ${res.rows.length} rows`);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn(`  ⚠️ Could not export table "${table}":`, (err as Error).message);
    }
  }

  await client.end();

  const backupDir = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'backups');
  if (!fs.existsSync(backupDir)) {
    fs.mkdirSync(backupDir, { recursive: true });
  }

  const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-');
  const filename = `db_backup_${timestamp}.json`;
  const latestFilename = `latest_backup.json`;

  const backupPath = path.join(backupDir, filename);
  const latestPath = path.join(backupDir, latestFilename);

  const payload = JSON.stringify(
    {
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      sourceDatabaseUrl: dbUrl.replace(/:[^:@]+@/, ':***@'),
      totalRows,
      tables: backupData,
    },
    null,
    2
  );

  fs.writeFileSync(backupPath, payload, 'utf-8');
  fs.writeFileSync(latestPath, payload, 'utf-8');

  console.log(`\n✅ Backup successfully saved!`);
  console.log(`  File: ${backupPath}`);
  console.log(`  Latest symlink copy: ${latestPath}`);
  console.log(`  Total rows exported: ${totalRows}`);
}

backup().catch((err) => {
  console.error('❌ Backup failed:', err);
  process.exit(1);
});
=== src/scripts/restore-db.ts ===
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import { Client } from 'pg';
import 'dotenv/config';

const TABLES_IN_ORDER = [
  'tenants',
  'cohorts',
  'users',
  'user_entitlements',
  'vouchers',
  'startup_plans',
  'plan_collaborators',
  'plan_modules_data',
  'open_questions_parking_lot',
  'validation_surveys',
  'survey_responses',
  'early_access_waitlist',
  'support_tickets',
  'ai_usage_logs',
  'country_rules',
  'grants_directory',
  'ai_prompts',
];

async function restore() {
  const dbUrl = process.env.DATABASE_URL;
  if (!dbUrl) {
    console.error('DATABASE_URL is not set in environment.');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const customBackupFile = process.argv[2];
  const backupPath = customBackupFile
    ? path.resolve(process.cwd(), customBackupFile)
    : path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'backups', 'latest_backup.json');

  if (!fs.existsSync(backupPath)) {
    console.error(`❌ Backup file not found at: ${backupPath}`);
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const raw = fs.readFileSync(backupPath, 'utf-8');
  const backup = JSON.parse(raw);

  console.log(`📥 Starting restore into: ${dbUrl.replace(/:[^:@]+@/, ':***@')}`);
  console.log(`   Source backup created at: ${backup.createdAt}`);
  console.log(`   Total rows in backup: ${backup.totalRows}\n`);

  const client = new Client({
    connectionString: dbUrl,
    connectionTimeoutMillis: 15000,
  });

  await client.connect();

  let restoredTotal = 0;

  for (const table of TABLES_IN_ORDER) {
    const rows: Record<string, unknown>[] = backup.tables[table] || [];
    if (!rows.length) {
      console.log(`  - ${table.padEnd(28)} : 0 rows (skipped)`);
      continue;
    }

    try {
      // Use transaction per table or per row with ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE
      for (const rawRow of rows) {
        const row = { ...rawRow };
        // Handle enum migration from V1 (MOD_K_BUSINESS_PLAN -> MOD_L_BUSINESS_PLAN)
        if (table === 'plan_modules_data' && row.module_code === 'MOD_K_BUSINESS_PLAN') {
          row.module_code = 'MOD_L_BUSINESS_PLAN';
        }
        if (table === 'ai_prompts') {
          if (row.module_code === 'MOD_G_BUSINESS_PLAN' || row.module_code === 'MOD_K_BUSINESS_PLAN') {
            row.module_code = 'MOD_L_BUSINESS_PLAN';
          }
        }
        if (table === 'grants_directory' && !row.slug && row.grant_name) {
          row.slug = String(row.grant_name).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-');
        }

        const columns = Object.keys(row);
        const values = Object.values(row).map((v) => {
          // If object or array and not date, JSON stringify for jsonb columns
          if (v !== null && typeof v === 'object' && !(v instanceof Date)) {
            return JSON.stringify(v);
          }
          return v;
        });

        const quotedCols = columns.map((c) => `"${c}"`).join(', ');
        const placeholders = values.map((_, i) => `$${i + 1}`).join(', ');

        // Determine conflict target (primary key 'id' for most tables, prompt_key for ai_prompts, etc.)
        let conflictClause = 'ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING';
        if (columns.includes('id')) {
          const updateAssignments = columns
            .filter((c) => c !== 'id' && c !== 'created_at')
            .map((c) => `"${c}" = EXCLUDED."${c}"`)
            .join(', ');
          if (updateAssignments.length > 0) {
            conflictClause = `ON CONFLICT ("id") DO UPDATE SET ${updateAssignments}`;
          }
        } else if (table === 'ai_prompts' && columns.includes('prompt_key')) {
          conflictClause = `ON CONFLICT ("prompt_key") DO NOTHING`;
        } else if (table === 'country_rules' && columns.includes('country_code')) {
          conflictClause = `ON CONFLICT ("country_code") DO NOTHING`;
        }

        const query = `
          INSERT INTO "${table}" (${quotedCols})
          VALUES (${placeholders})
          ${conflictClause};
        `;

        await client.query(query, values);
      }

      console.log(`  ✓ ${table.padEnd(28)} : ${rows.length} rows restored/synced`);
      restoredTotal += rows.length;
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`  ❌ Failed restoring table "${table}":`, (err as Error).message);
    }
  }

  await client.end();
  console.log(`\n🎉 Restore complete! Restored/synced ${restoredTotal} records.`);
}

restore().catch((err) => {
  console.error('❌ Restore failed:', err);
  process.exit(1);
});
=== src/lib/qr-code.ts ===
/**
 * Pure TypeScript ISO/IEC 18004 QR Code Matrix Generator (Byte Mode, ECC Level L/M)
 * Zero external dependencies — works offline & online, renders crisp vector SVG and Canvas PNGs.
 */

// Galois Field GF(256) with primitive polynomial 0x11D
const GF_EXP = new Uint8Array(512);
const GF_LOG = new Uint8Array(256);

(() => {
  let x = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < 255; i++) {
    GF_EXP[i] = x;
    GF_LOG[x] = i;
    x <<= 1;
    if (x & 0x100) {
      x ^= 0x11d;
    }
  }
  for (let i = 255; i < 512; i++) {
    GF_EXP[i] = GF_EXP[i - 255];
  }
})();

function gfMul(a: number, b: number): number {
  if (a === 0 || b === 0) return 0;
  return GF_EXP[GF_LOG[a] + GF_LOG[b]];
}

function rsGeneratorPoly(degree: number): Uint8Array {
  let poly = new Uint8Array([1]);
  for (let i = 0; i < degree; i++) {
    const next = new Uint8Array(poly.length + 1);
    const root = GF_EXP[i];
    for (let j = 0; j < poly.length; j++) {
      next[j] ^= poly[j];
      next[j + 1] ^= gfMul(poly[j], root);
    }
    poly = next;
  }
  return poly;
}

function rsComputeRemainder(data: Uint8Array, ecCount: number): Uint8Array {
  const gen = rsGeneratorPoly(ecCount);
  const rem = new Uint8Array(ecCount);
  for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
    const factor = data[i] ^ rem[0];
    rem.copyWithin(0, 1);
    rem[ecCount - 1] = 0;
    if (factor !== 0) {
      for (let j = 0; j < ecCount; j++) {
        rem[j] ^= gfMul(gen[j + 1], factor);
      }
    }
  }
  return rem;
}

// QR Version 1–6 specifications at Error Correction Level L (format bits: 01)
// Supports URLs up to 134 bytes without needing Version 7+ 6x3 version info blocks
interface VersionSpec {
  version: number;
  totalDataBytes: number;
  ecBytesPerBlock: number;
  numBlocksGroup1: number;
  dataBytesGroup1: number;
  numBlocksGroup2: number;
  dataBytesGroup2: number;
  alignmentCenters: number[];
}

const VERSION_SPECS_L: VersionSpec[] = [
  { version: 1, totalDataBytes: 19, ecBytesPerBlock: 7, numBlocksGroup1: 1, dataBytesGroup1: 19, numBlocksGroup2: 0, dataBytesGroup2: 0, alignmentCenters: [] },
  { version: 2, totalDataBytes: 34, ecBytesPerBlock: 10, numBlocksGroup1: 1, dataBytesGroup1: 34, numBlocksGroup2: 0, dataBytesGroup2: 0, alignmentCenters: [6, 18] },
  { version: 3, totalDataBytes: 55, ecBytesPerBlock: 15, numBlocksGroup1: 1, dataBytesGroup1: 55, numBlocksGroup2: 0, dataBytesGroup2: 0, alignmentCenters: [6, 22] },
  { version: 4, totalDataBytes: 80, ecBytesPerBlock: 20, numBlocksGroup1: 1, dataBytesGroup1: 80, numBlocksGroup2: 0, dataBytesGroup2: 0, alignmentCenters: [6, 26] },
  { version: 5, totalDataBytes: 108, ecBytesPerBlock: 26, numBlocksGroup1: 1, dataBytesGroup1: 108, numBlocksGroup2: 0, dataBytesGroup2: 0, alignmentCenters: [6, 30] },
  { version: 6, totalDataBytes: 136, ecBytesPerBlock: 18, numBlocksGroup1: 2, dataBytesGroup1: 68, numBlocksGroup2: 0, dataBytesGroup2: 0, alignmentCenters: [6, 34] },
];

function selectVersion(byteLength: number): VersionSpec {
  for (const spec of VERSION_SPECS_L) {
    // Byte mode overhead: 4 bits mode + (8 or 16 bits length) = 2 or 3 bytes
    const overheadBytes = spec.version <= 9 ? 2 : 3;
    if (byteLength + overheadBytes <= spec.totalDataBytes) {
      return spec;
    }
  }
  return VERSION_SPECS_L[VERSION_SPECS_L.length - 1];
}

function encodeDataBits(bytes: Uint8Array, spec: VersionSpec): Uint8Array {
  const bits: number[] = [];
  const pushBits = (val: number, len: number) => {
    for (let i = len - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      bits.push((val >>> i) & 1);
    }
  };

  // Mode indicator for Byte Mode: 0100
  pushBits(0b0100, 4);
  // Character count indicator: 8 bits for versions 1-9, 16 bits for version 10+
  const countBits = spec.version <= 9 ? 8 : 16;
  const maxLen = Math.min(bytes.length, spec.totalDataBytes - 3);
  pushBits(maxLen, countBits);

  for (let i = 0; i < maxLen; i++) {
    pushBits(bytes[i], 8);
  }

  // Terminator (up to 4 zeros)
  const totalDataBits = spec.totalDataBytes * 8;
  const terminatorLen = Math.min(4, totalDataBits - bits.length);
  pushBits(0, terminatorLen);

  // Pad to byte boundary
  while (bits.length % 8 !== 0) {
    bits.push(0);
  }

  // Pad with alternating 0xEC, 0x11
  let padToggle = true;
  while (bits.length < totalDataBits) {
    pushBits(padToggle ? 0xec : 0x11, 8);
    padToggle = !padToggle;
  }

  const dataCodewords = new Uint8Array(spec.totalDataBytes);
  for (let i = 0; i < spec.totalDataBytes; i++) {
    let b = 0;
    for (let j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
      b = (b << 1) | bits[i * 8 + j];
    }
    dataCodewords[i] = b;
  }

  // Split into blocks and compute Reed-Solomon EC codewords
  const dataBlocks: Uint8Array[] = [];
  const ecBlocks: Uint8Array[] = [];
  let offset = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < spec.numBlocksGroup1; i++) {
    const block = dataCodewords.slice(offset, offset + spec.dataBytesGroup1);
    offset += spec.dataBytesGroup1;
    dataBlocks.push(block);
    ecBlocks.push(rsComputeRemainder(block, spec.ecBytesPerBlock));
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < spec.numBlocksGroup2; i++) {
    const block = dataCodewords.slice(offset, offset + spec.dataBytesGroup2);
    offset += spec.dataBytesGroup2;
    dataBlocks.push(block);
    ecBlocks.push(rsComputeRemainder(block, spec.ecBytesPerBlock));
  }

  // Interleave data codewords, then EC codewords
  const interleaved: number[] = [];
  const maxDataBlockLen = Math.max(spec.dataBytesGroup1, spec.dataBytesGroup2);
  for (let col = 0; col < maxDataBlockLen; col++) {
    for (const block of dataBlocks) {
      if (col < block.length) {
        interleaved.push(block[col]);
      }
    }
  }
  for (let col = 0; col < spec.ecBytesPerBlock; col++) {
    for (const block of ecBlocks) {
      interleaved.push(block[col]);
    }
  }

  return new Uint8Array(interleaved);
}

// Precomputed 15-bit format info strings for ECC Level L (01) and Mask 0..7
const FORMAT_INFO_L = [
  0x77c4, 0x72f3, 0x7daa, 0x789d, 0x662f, 0x6318, 0x6c41, 0x6976,
];

function applyMask(mask: number, r: number, c: number): boolean {
  switch (mask) {
    case 0:
      return (r + c) % 2 === 0;
    case 1:
      return r % 2 === 0;
    case 2:
      return c % 3 === 0;
    case 3:
      return (r + c) % 3 === 0;
    case 4:
      return (Math.floor(r / 2) + Math.floor(c / 3)) % 2 === 0;
    case 5:
      return ((r * c) % 2) + ((r * c) % 3) === 0;
    case 6:
      return (((r * c) % 2) + ((r * c) % 3)) % 2 === 0;
    case 7:
    default:
      return (((r + c) % 2) + ((r * c) % 3)) % 2 === 0;
  }
}

/**
 * Generates a 2D boolean matrix (`true` = dark module, `false` = light module) for any string.
 */
export function generateQrCodeMatrix(text: string): boolean[][] {
  const encoder = new TextEncoder();
  const bytes = encoder.encode(text || 'https://startuppreflight.com');
  const spec = selectVersion(bytes.length);
  const size = spec.version * 4 + 17;

  const modules: boolean[][] = Array.from({ length: size }, () =>
    Array(size).fill(false)
  );
  const isFunction: boolean[][] = Array.from({ length: size }, () =>
    Array(size).fill(false)
  );

  // 1. Place Finder Patterns + Separators
  const placeFinder = (row: number, col: number) => {
    for (let dr = -1; dr <= 7; dr++) {
      for (let dc = -1; dc <= 7; dc++) {
        const r = row + dr;
        const c = col + dc;
        if (r < 0 || r >= size || c < 0 || c >= size) continue;
        const inOuter =
          dr >= 0 && dr <= 6 && (dc === 0 || dc === 6) ||
          dc >= 0 && dc <= 6 && (dr === 0 || dr === 6);
        const inInner = dr >= 2 && dr <= 4 && dc >= 2 && dc <= 4;
        modules[r][c] = inOuter || inInner;
        isFunction[r][c] = true;
      }
    }
  };

  placeFinder(0, 0);
  placeFinder(0, size - 7);
  placeFinder(size - 7, 0);

  // 2. Timing Patterns
  for (let i = 8; i < size - 8; i++) {
    modules[6][i] = i % 2 === 0;
    isFunction[6][i] = true;
    modules[i][6] = i % 2 === 0;
    isFunction[i][6] = true;
  }

  // 3. Alignment Patterns
  const centers = spec.alignmentCenters;
  for (const rCenter of centers) {
    for (const cCenter of centers) {
      // Skip if overlapping with finder patterns
      if (
        (rCenter === 6 && cCenter === 6) ||
        (rCenter === 6 && cCenter === size - 7) ||
        (rCenter === size - 7 && cCenter === 6)
      ) {
        continue;
      }
      for (let dr = -2; dr <= 2; dr++) {
        for (let dc = -2; dc <= 2; dc++) {
          const r = rCenter + dr;
          const c = cCenter + dc;
          const dark =
            Math.max(Math.abs(dr), Math.abs(dc)) === 2 || (dr === 0 && dc === 0);
          modules[r][c] = dark;
          isFunction[r][c] = true;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // 4. Dark Module & Reserve Format Info Areas
  modules[4 * spec.version + 9][8] = true;
  isFunction[4 * spec.version + 9][8] = true;

  for (let i = 0; i <= 8; i++) {
    if (i !== 6) {
      isFunction[8][i] = true;
      isFunction[i][8] = true;
    }
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    isFunction[8][size - 1 - i] = true;
    isFunction[size - 1 - i][8] = true;
  }

  // 5. Place Interleaved Codewords in Zig-Zag Order
  const codewords = encodeDataBits(bytes, spec);
  let bitIdx = 0;
  const totalBits = codewords.length * 8;

  for (let right = size - 1; right >= 1; right -= 2) {
    if (right === 6) right = 5; // Skip vertical timing pattern column
    for (let vert = 0; vert < size; vert++) {
      const upward = ((right + 1) & 2) === 0;
      const r = upward ? size - 1 - vert : vert;
      for (let j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
        const c = right - j;
        if (!isFunction[r][c]) {
          let bit = false;
          if (bitIdx < totalBits) {
            bit = ((codewords[bitIdx >>> 3] >>> (7 - (bitIdx & 7))) & 1) === 1;
            bitIdx++;
          }
          modules[r][c] = bit;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // 6. Apply Mask 0 and Write Format Info Bits
  const maskIndex = 0;
  for (let r = 0; r < size; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < size; c++) {
      if (!isFunction[r][c] && applyMask(maskIndex, r, c)) {
        modules[r][c] = !modules[r][c];
      }
    }
  }

  const formatBits = FORMAT_INFO_L[maskIndex];
  const getBit = (bitPosFromLsb: number) =>
    ((formatBits >>> bitPosFromLsb) & 1) === 1;

  // Top-left format info: b14 at (8,0) .. b8 at (8,7), b7 at (8,8), b6 at (7,8), b5..b0 at (5,8)..(0,8)
  modules[8][0] = getBit(14);
  modules[8][1] = getBit(13);
  modules[8][2] = getBit(12);
  modules[8][3] = getBit(11);
  modules[8][4] = getBit(10);
  modules[8][5] = getBit(9);
  modules[8][7] = getBit(8);
  modules[8][8] = getBit(7);
  modules[7][8] = getBit(6);
  modules[5][8] = getBit(5);
  modules[4][8] = getBit(4);
  modules[3][8] = getBit(3);
  modules[2][8] = getBit(2);
  modules[1][8] = getBit(1);
  modules[0][8] = getBit(0);

  // Bottom-left vertical (b14..b8 at rows size-1 .. size-7, col 8)
  for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
    modules[size - 1 - i][8] = getBit(14 - i);
  }
  // Top-right horizontal (b7..b0 at row 8, cols size-8 .. size-1)
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    modules[8][size - 8 + i] = getBit(7 - i);
  }

  return modules;
}

/**
 * Generates a standalone SVG string for a QR code so it can be downloaded as `.svg` or rendered cleanly.
 */
export function generateQrCodeSvgString(
  url: string,
  options?: {
    sizePx?: number;
    quietZoneModules?: number;
    darkColor?: string;
    lightColor?: string;
  }
): string {
  const matrix = generateQrCodeMatrix(url);
  const n = matrix.length;
  const quiet = options?.quietZoneModules ?? 3;
  const totalModules = n + quiet * 2;
  const sizePx = options?.sizePx ?? 512;
  const darkColor = options?.darkColor ?? '#0f172a';
  const lightColor = options?.lightColor ?? '#ffffff';

  const rects: string[] = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < n; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < n; c++) {
      if (matrix[r][c]) {
        rects.push(
          `<rect x="${c + quiet}" y="${r + quiet}" width="1.03" height="1.03" fill="${darkColor}" />`
        );
      }
    }
  }

  return `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 ${totalModules} ${totalModules}" width="${sizePx}" height="${sizePx}" shape-rendering="crispEdges">
  <rect width="${totalModules}" height="${totalModules}" fill="${lightColor}" />
  ${rects.join('\n  ')}
</svg>`;
}

const LOCAL_STORAGE_SUPPORT_TICKETS_KEY = 'spf_v2_support_tickets_v1';
const LEGACY_LOCAL_STORAGE_SUPPORT_TICKETS_KEY = 'bmu_v2_support_tickets_v1';

/**
 * Checks whether the current browser environment is running locally.
 * Used to strictly hide the in-workspace "Log Bug / Idea" quick-capture button on public production deployments.
 */
export function isLocalTestingEnvironment(): boolean {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    return process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production';
  }
  const host = window.location.hostname.toLowerCase();
  return (
    host === 'localhost' ||
    host === '127.0.0.1' ||
    host === '0.0.0.0' ||
    host.endsWith('.local')
  );
}

export function loadLocalSupportTickets(): SupportTicketRecord[] {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return [];
  try {
    const raw =
      window.localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_STORAGE_SUPPORT_TICKETS_KEY) ||
      window.localStorage.getItem(LEGACY_LOCAL_STORAGE_SUPPORT_TICKETS_KEY);
    if (!raw) return [];
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

export function saveLocalSupportTickets(tickets: SupportTicketRecord[]): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(
      LOCAL_STORAGE_SUPPORT_TICKETS_KEY,
      JSON.stringify(tickets)
    );
  } catch {
    // Ignore storage quota errors
  }
}

export function upsertLocalSupportTicket(
  ticket: SupportTicketRecord
): SupportTicketRecord[] {
  const existing = loadLocalSupportTickets();
  const idx = existing.findIndex((t) => t.id === ticket.id);
  const updated =
    idx >= 0
      ? existing.map((t, i) => (i === idx ? ticket : t))
      : [ticket, ...existing];
  saveLocalSupportTickets(updated);
  return updated;
}

export function removeLocalSupportTicket(id: string): SupportTicketRecord[] {
  const existing = loadLocalSupportTickets();
  const updated = existing.filter((t) => t.id !== id);
  saveLocalSupportTickets(updated);
  return updated;
}

/**
 * Merges server-side tickets with any locally cached tickets (by id) sorted newest-first.
 */
export function mergeSupportTickets(
  serverTickets: SupportTicketRecord[],
  localTickets: SupportTicketRecord[]
): SupportTicketRecord[] {
  const byId = new Map<string, SupportTicketRecord>();
  for (const item of localTickets) {
    byId.set(item.id, item);
  }
  for (const item of serverTickets) {
    byId.set(item.id, item);
  }
  return Array.from(byId.values()).sort(
    (a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime()
  );
}

export function getModuleScopeLabel(scope: SupportModuleScope | string): string {
  const found = SUPPORT_MODULE_SCOPE_OPTIONS.find((o) => o.value === scope);
  return found ? found.shortBadge : scope;
}

export function getTicketTypeBadgeLabel(ticket: SupportTicketRecord): string {
  if (ticket.ticketType === 'OTHER' && ticket.customTypeText) {
    return `Other: ${ticket.customTypeText}`;
  }
  const found = SUPPORT_TICKET_TYPE_OPTIONS.find(
    (o) => o.value === ticket.ticketType
  );
  return found ? found.shortLabel : ticket.ticketType;
}

/**
 * Formats a single ticket into a structured prompt ready to paste into Antigravity.
 */
export function formatSupportTicketAsAiPrompt(
  ticket: SupportTicketRecord
): string {
  const typeLabel = getTicketTypeBadgeLabel(ticket);
  const moduleLabel =
    SUPPORT_MODULE_SCOPE_OPTIONS.find((m) => m.value === ticket.moduleScope)
      ?.label || ticket.moduleScope;

  const lines = [
    `Please resolve the following ${typeLabel.toUpperCase()} logged in Startup Preflight:`,
    ``,
    `- **Title:** ${ticket.title}`,
    `- **Type:** ${typeLabel} | **Priority:** ${ticket.priority}`,
    `- **Module / Area:** ${moduleLabel}${
      ticket.stepContext ? ` (${ticket.stepContext})` : ''
    }`,
  ];

  if (ticket.source) {
    const originLabel =
      ticket.source === 'FOUNDER_SUPPORT'
        ? 'LIVE REGISTERED FOUNDER'
        : ticket.source === 'PUBLIC_VISITOR'
          ? 'PUBLIC VISITOR'
          : 'INTERNAL ADMIN QA';
    lines.push(`- **Origin:** ${originLabel}`);
  }
  if (ticket.reporterEmail) {
    lines.push(
      `- **Reporter:** ${ticket.reporterName ? `${ticket.reporterName} <${ticket.reporterEmail}>` : ticket.reporterEmail}${
        ticket.userPlanType ? ` (${ticket.userPlanType})` : ''
      }`
    );
  }
  if (ticket.deviceInfo) {
    lines.push(`- **Device & Environment:** ${ticket.deviceInfo}`);
  }
  if (ticket.pageUrl) {
    lines.push(`- **Route / URL:** ${ticket.pageUrl}`);
  }
  if (ticket.planTitle) {
    lines.push(
      `- **Test Plan Context:** ${ticket.planTitle}${
        ticket.planId ? ` (${ticket.planId})` : ''
      }`
    );
  }

  lines.push(``, `### Issue / Improvement Details`, ticket.description);

  if (ticket.expectedBehavior) {
    lines.push(``, `### Expected / Desired Behavior`, ticket.expectedBehavior);
  }
  if (ticket.adminNotes) {
    lines.push(``, `### Additional Admin Notes`, ticket.adminNotes);
  }

  return lines.join('\n');
}

/**
 * Formats multiple tickets into a numbered batch prompt ready to paste into Antigravity.
 */
export function formatBatchSupportTicketsAsAiPrompt(
  tickets: SupportTicketRecord[]
): string {
  if (tickets.length === 0) return '';
  if (tickets.length === 1) return formatSupportTicketAsAiPrompt(tickets[0]);

  const header = `Please resolve the following ${tickets.length} logged bugs/improvements in Startup Preflight:\n`;
  const blocks = tickets.map((t, index) => {
    const typeLabel = getTicketTypeBadgeLabel(t);
    const moduleLabel = getModuleScopeLabel(t.moduleScope);
    return [
      `### ${index + 1}. [${typeLabel} • ${t.priority}] ${t.title}`,
      `- **Location:** ${moduleLabel}${
        t.stepContext ? ` — ${t.stepContext}` : ''
      }${t.pageUrl ? ` (${t.pageUrl})` : ''}`,
      `- **Details:** ${t.description}`,
      t.expectedBehavior ? `- **Expected:** ${t.expectedBehavior}` : null,
      t.adminNotes ? `- **Admin Notes:** ${t.adminNotes}` : null,
    ]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join('\n');
  });

  return `${header}\n${blocks.join('\n\n---\n\n')}`;
}

    DETAILED_GRANT_PORTALS.find((g) => g.slug === grantSlug) ||
    DETAILED_GRANT_PORTALS[0];

    plan.conceptCanvas?.targetCustomer?.trim() &&

    plan.exportPotential === 'EXPORTING_INTERNATIONALLY' ||

    plan.moduleDData?.workPackagesAndFlow?.workPackages?.length || 0;

      Boolean(e.supplierQuotesSummary?.trim()) ||

    plan.moduleFData?.promoterProfiles?.teamMembers?.length || 0;

  // 7. Job Creation Schedule (Module F Step 5)
  const plannedHiresCount =
    plan.moduleFData?.step5HiringPlanData?.roles?.length || 0;
  const hasJobSchedule = plannedHiresCount > 0;

  // 8. Personal Survival Budget (Module F Step 3 - UK Start Up Loans requirement)
  const founderBudgets = plan.moduleFData?.step3SurvivalBudgetData?.founderBudgets || [];
  const personalExpensesTotal = founderBudgets.reduce(
    (acc, b) =>

    0
  );
  const hasPersonalSurvivalBudget = personalExpensesTotal > 0 || founderBudgets.length > 0;

  // 9. LTD Incorporated (Module G Launchpad Step 1 or Module J Step 4)
  const hasLtdIncorporated =
    plan.moduleGData?.step1?.state === 'ALREADY_HAVE' ||
    plan.moduleJData?.step4Statements?.corporateIpReadinessStatus ===
      'LTD_INCORPORATED_IP_ASSIGNED';

  // 10. Tax Clearance / Bank Account (Module G Launchpad Steps 3 & 5)
  const hasTaxClearance =
    plan.moduleGData?.step3?.state === 'ALREADY_HAVE' ||
    plan.moduleGData?.step5?.state === 'ALREADY_HAVE';

  // 11. 3-Year Financial Projections (Module J or Module H)
  const hasFinancialProjections = Boolean(
    plan.moduleJData?.step1OverheadsTax?.lastSavedAt ||
    plan.moduleHData?.step3BreakevenCalculator?.lastSavedAt
  );

  // 12. Co-Funding Proof / Capital Stack (Module K Step 2)
  const hasCoFundingProof = Boolean(
    plan.moduleKData?.step2CapitalStack?.lastSavedAt ||
    plan.teamAndBudget?.startingBudgetBracket
  );

  const allPossibleItems: Record<string, GrantReadinessChecklistItem> = {
    CONCEPT_CANVAS: {
      key: 'CONCEPT_CANVAS',
      title: '1-Page Concept Canvas & Solution Definition',
      moduleCode: 'MOD_A_IDEATION',
      stepNumber: 2,
      isComplete: hasConceptCanvas,
      summary: hasConceptCanvas
        ? `Canvas complete: "${plan.conceptCanvas?.proposedSolution?.slice(0, 48)}..."`
        : 'Target customer and proposed solution are not clearly defined yet.',
      actionPrompt: 'Open Module A Step 2 to finish your Concept Canvas',
    },
    EXPORT_NON_DISPLACEMENT: {
      key: 'EXPORT_NON_DISPLACEMENT',
      title: 'Export Focus & Non-Displacement Case',
      moduleCode: 'MOD_B_MARKET',
      stepNumber: 5,
      isComplete: hasExportFocus,
      summary: hasExportFocus
        ? 'Export potential verified; target market does not displace local domestic trade.'
        : 'Grant assessors will reject businesses that only compete with existing local retail.',
      actionPrompt: 'Open Module B Step 5 to articulate your export wedge',
    },
    CUSTOMER_VALIDATION: {
      key: 'CUSTOMER_VALIDATION',

      moduleCode: 'MOD_C_SURVEYS_FEEDBACK',
      stepNumber: 4,
      isComplete: hasValidationProof,
      summary:
        totalSurveyResponses > 0 || totalInterviews > 0
          ? `${totalSurveyResponses} survey response(s) and ${totalInterviews} customer interview(s) logged.`
          : 'Evaluators want proof real customers will pay, not just founder opinions.',
      actionPrompt: 'Open Module C to share your survey link or log customer interviews',
    },
    WORK_PACKAGES: {
      key: 'WORK_PACKAGES',

      moduleCode: 'MOD_D_PRODUCT_BUILD',
      stepNumber: 5,
      isComplete: hasWorkPackages,
      summary: hasWorkPackages
        ? `${workPackagesCount} formal Work Packages defined with deliverables and milestones.`
        : 'R&D grants require engineering work to be split into measurable Work Packages.',
      actionPrompt: 'Open Module D Step 5 to define your Work Packages',
    },
    THREE_SUPPLIER_QUOTES: {
      key: 'THREE_SUPPLIER_QUOTES',
      title: 'Eligible Equipment & 3-Quote Procurement Rule',
      moduleCode: 'MOD_E_OPERATIONS',
      stepNumber: 2,
      isComplete: hasThreeQuotes,
      summary: hasThreeQuotes
        ? 'Equipment schedule audited; quotes attached or exemption verified.'
        : 'LEO / Innovate UK require 3 independent supplier quotes for capital items > €5k.',
      actionPrompt: 'Open Module E Step 2 to attach quotes or request via Concierge',
    },
    PROMOTER_PROFILES: {
