      moduleCode: 'MOD_F_COFOUNDER_TEAM',
      stepNumber: 1,
      isComplete: hasPromoters,
      summary: hasPromoters
        ? `${promoterCount} promoter profile(s) calibrated for grant committee assessment.`
        : 'Committees score heavily on founder track record and capability to deliver.',
      actionPrompt: 'Open Module F Step 1 to enter promoter profiles',
    },
    JOB_CREATION_SCHEDULE: {
      key: 'JOB_CREATION_SCHEDULE',
      title: '3-Year Job Creation Schedule',
      moduleCode: 'MOD_F_COFOUNDER_TEAM',
      stepNumber: 5,
      isComplete: hasJobSchedule,
      summary: hasJobSchedule
        ? `${plannedHiresCount} new jobs scheduled across Years 1 to 3.`
        : 'LEO Priming / Expansion grants are strictly calculated per full-time job created.',
      actionPrompt: 'Open Module F Step 5 to set your headcount roadmap',
    },
    PERSONAL_SURVIVAL_BUDGET: {
      key: 'PERSONAL_SURVIVAL_BUDGET',
      title: 'Personal Survival Budget',
      moduleCode: 'MOD_F_COFOUNDER_TEAM',
      stepNumber: 3,
      isComplete: hasPersonalSurvivalBudget,
      summary: hasPersonalSurvivalBudget
        ? `Survival budget verified at ${personalExpensesTotal}/month personal outlays.`
        : 'UK Start Up Loans loan underwriters require a verified personal survival budget.',
      actionPrompt: 'Open Module F Step 3 to fill your personal survival budget',
    },
    LTD_INCORPORATED: {
      key: 'LTD_INCORPORATED',
      title: 'Limited Company Registration (CRO / Companies House)',
      moduleCode: 'MOD_G_LAUNCHPAD',
      stepNumber: 1,
      isComplete: hasLtdIncorporated,
      summary: hasLtdIncorporated
        ? 'Limited Company (LTD) registered or in-progress.'
        : 'This grant requires a registered legal entity to sign the contract.',
      actionPrompt: 'Open Module G Launchpad Step 1 to record your CRO / Companies House status',
    },
    TAX_CLEARANCE_ETC: {
      key: 'TAX_CLEARANCE_ETC',
      title: 'Statutory Tax Clearance (eTC) & Bank Account',
      moduleCode: 'MOD_G_LAUNCHPAD',
      stepNumber: 3,
      isComplete: hasTaxClearance,
      summary: hasTaxClearance
        ? 'Business bank account and statutory compliance active.'
        : 'No grant can be drawn down without a verified Tax Clearance Access Number.',
      actionPrompt: 'Open Module G Launchpad to record your bank & tax clearance setup',
    },
    FINANCIAL_PROJECTIONS_3Y: {
      key: 'FINANCIAL_PROJECTIONS_3Y',
      title: '3-Year Integrated Financial Projections & Cashflow',
      moduleCode: 'MOD_J_FINANCE',
      stepNumber: 1,
      isComplete: hasFinancialProjections,
      summary: hasFinancialProjections
        ? '3-Year Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, and Monthly Cashflow generated.'
        : 'Evaluators need to see your 36-month breakeven and cash trough.',
      actionPrompt: 'Open Module J to complete your 3-Year financial projections',
    },
    CO_FUNDING_PROOF: {
      key: 'CO_FUNDING_PROOF',
      title: 'Matching Co-Funding Cash Proof (50% / Match Ratio)',
      moduleCode: 'MOD_K_GRANTS_FUNDING',
      stepNumber: 2,
      isComplete: hasCoFundingProof,
      summary: hasCoFundingProof
        ? 'Co-funding capital stack mapped (founder savings, loan, or investment match).'
        : 'Grants only reimburse a percentage; you must prove you have matching cash in the bank.',
      actionPrompt: 'Open Module K Step 2 to verify your capital stack',
    },
  };

  const requiredKeys = detail.requiredPlanChecklistKeys;
  const items = requiredKeys
    .map((k) => allPossibleItems[k])
    .filter((item): item is GrantReadinessChecklistItem => Boolean(item));

  const completedCount = items.filter((i) => i.isComplete).length;
  const totalCount = items.length;
  const readinessPercentage = totalCount > 0 ? Math.round((completedCount / totalCount) * 100) : 100;
  const criticalMissingCount = totalCount - completedCount;

  return {
    grantSlug,
    grantDetail: detail,
    items,
    completedCount,
    totalCount,
    readinessPercentage,
    isReadyToSubmit: criticalMissingCount === 0,
    criticalMissingCount,
  };
}

/**
 * Only show Step 8 (Grant & Funding Eligibility Checker) for regions
 * currently supported with deep grant rule-packs (Ireland & UK).

export function isGrantCheckerSupportedForCountry(
  countryCode?: string
): boolean {
  const normalized = (countryCode || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  return normalized === 'IE' || normalized === 'GB';

export function getDefaultGrantEligibilityCheck(input: {
  hqCountryCode: SupportedCountryCode;
  industryCategory: IndustryCategory | string;
  exportPotential: 'DOMESTIC_ONLY' | 'EXPORTING_INTERNATIONALLY';
  founderMotivation?: SavedFounderMotivation;
}): SavedGrantEligibilityCheck {
  const isUk = input.hqCountryCode === 'GB';
  const isFullTime =
    input.founderMotivation?.weeklyHoursAvailable === '40_PLUS_HRS' ||
    input.founderMotivation?.primaryMotivation === 'LEAVE_JOB' ||
    input.founderMotivation?.primaryMotivation === 'SCALE_STARTUP';

  let commercialActivityType: GrantCommercialActivityType =
    'EXPORT_SOFTWARE_DIGITAL';
  if (input.industryCategory === 'Hardware / MedTech / DeepTech') {
    commercialActivityType = 'DEEPTECH_AI_RD';
  } else if (
    input.industryCategory === 'E-Commerce / Physical Product / Food & Drink'
  ) {
    commercialActivityType = 'PHYSICAL_MANUFACTURING_FOOD';
  } else if (
    input.industryCategory === 'Brick & Mortar / Hospitality / Local Business' ||
    (input.industryCategory === 'Service / Agency / Consulting' &&
      input.exportPotential === 'DOMESTIC_ONLY')
  ) {
    commercialActivityType = 'LOCAL_DOMESTIC_SERVICE_RETAIL';
  }

  return {
    legalEntityStage: 'PRE_INCORPORATION',
    commercialActivityType,
    founderPayeStatus: isFullTime
      ? 'PAYE_LAST_6_YRS_GOING_FULLTIME'
      : 'PAYE_LAST_6_YRS_PARTTIME',
    regionalLocationTier: isUk
      ? 'GB_ENGLAND_GROWTH_HUB'
      : 'IE_STANDARD_50_MATCH',
    customGrantNotes: '',
  };
}

export function evaluateModuleAGrantEligibility(input: {
  hqCountryCode: SupportedCountryCode;
  exportPotential: 'DOMESTIC_ONLY' | 'EXPORTING_INTERNATIONALLY';
  industryCategory: string;
  brainDumpText: string;
  conceptCanvas?: SavedConceptCanvas;
  founderMotivation?: SavedFounderMotivation;
  teamAndBudget?: SavedTeamAndBudget;
  founderRealityCheck?: SavedFounderRealityCheck;
  grantCheck: SavedGrantEligibilityCheck;
}): GrantCheckerEvaluationSummary {
  const countryCode: 'IE' | 'GB' =
    input.hqCountryCode === 'GB' ? 'GB' : 'IE';
  const currency: SupportedCurrencyCode =
    countryCode === 'GB' ? 'GBP' : 'EUR';

  const { grantCheck } = input;
  const isExportOrTraded =
    input.exportPotential === 'EXPORTING_INTERNATIONALLY' ||
    grantCheck.commercialActivityType === 'EXPORT_SOFTWARE_DIGITAL' ||
    grantCheck.commercialActivityType === 'PHYSICAL_MANUFACTURING_FOOD' ||
    grantCheck.commercialActivityType === 'DEEPTECH_AI_RD';

  const isLocalDomesticOnly =
    grantCheck.commercialActivityType === 'LOCAL_DOMESTIC_SERVICE_RETAIL' &&
    input.exportPotential === 'DOMESTIC_ONLY';

  const isDeepTechOrRD =
    grantCheck.commercialActivityType === 'DEEPTECH_AI_RD' ||
    grantCheck.commercialActivityType === 'EXPORT_SOFTWARE_DIGITAL' ||
    input.industryCategory.toLowerCase().includes('tech') ||
    input.industryCategory.toLowerCase().includes('saas') ||
    /ai|algorithm|software|platform|patent|hardware|sensor|biotech|medtech/i.test(
      `${input.brainDumpText} ${input.conceptCanvas?.proposedSolution || ''}`
    );

  const isLtdNow =
    grantCheck.legalEntityStage === 'LTD_UNDER_18M' ||
    grantCheck.legalEntityStage === 'LTD_OVER_18M';
  const isLtdUnder18M = grantCheck.legalEntityStage === 'LTD_UNDER_18M';
  const isPreIncOrSole =
    grantCheck.legalEntityStage === 'PRE_INCORPORATION' ||
    grantCheck.legalEntityStage === 'SOLE_TRADER';

  const hasPayeHistory =
    grantCheck.founderPayeStatus === 'PAYE_LAST_6_YRS_GOING_FULLTIME' ||
    grantCheck.founderPayeStatus === 'PAYE_LAST_6_YRS_PARTTIME';
  const isGoingFullTime =
    grantCheck.founderPayeStatus === 'PAYE_LAST_6_YRS_GOING_FULLTIME' ||
    grantCheck.founderPayeStatus === 'SELF_EMPLOYED_OR_OUTSIDE_PAYE_FULLTIME' ||
    input.founderMotivation?.weeklyHoursAvailable === '40_PLUS_HRS';

  const refusesOutsideInvestors =
    input.founderRealityCheck?.dealbreakers?.includes('NO_OUTSIDE_INVESTORS') &&
    input.founderRealityCheck?.growthTradeoff === 'BOOTSTRAP_100_CONTROL';

  const hasCoFounders =
    input.teamAndBudget?.teamStructureType === 'COFOUNDER_TEAM';

  const isBmwRegion =
    grantCheck.regionalLocationTier === 'IE_BMW_REGIONAL_60_MATCH';
  const isGaeltacht =
    grantCheck.regionalLocationTier === 'IE_GAELTACHT_UDARAS';

  const matches: EvaluatedGrantMatch[] = [];

  if (countryCode === 'IE') {
    const leoMatchRate = isGaeltacht ? '60%' : isBmwRegion ? '60%' : '50%';
    const agencyLabel = isGaeltacht
      ? 'Údarás na Gaeltachta / Local Enterprise Office'
      : 'Local Enterprise Office (LEO Ireland)';

    // 1. LEO Feasibility Study Grant
    if (!isLocalDomesticOnly && grantCheck.legalEntityStage !== 'LTD_OVER_18M') {
      matches.push({
        slug: 'ie-leo-feasibility-study-grant',
        countryCode: 'IE',
        grantName: isGaeltacht
          ? 'Údarás / LEO Feasibility Study Grant'
          : 'LEO Feasibility Study Grant',
        providerAgency: agencyLabel,
        fundingType: 'CASH_GRANT',
        fundingTypeBadge: 'Non-Dilutive Cash Grant',
        matchTier: 'QUALIFIES_NOW',
        matchScorePercent: isExportOrTraded ? 95 : 82,
        potentialValueNumeric: 15000,
        potentialValueFormatted: `Up to €15,000 (${leoMatchRate} Reimbursement Match)`,
        coFundingOrMatchRequirement: `Requires ${isBmwRegion || isGaeltacht ? '40%' : '50%'} founder cash match. You must pay approved suppliers first and claim back vouched receipts.`,
        whyYouMatchOrMiss: `Your ${GRANT_ACTIVITY_TYPE_LABELS[grantCheck.commercialActivityType].replace(/^[^\w]+/, '')} profile meets LEO's internationally traded / manufacturing innovation criteria, and you can apply at the ${GRANT_LEGAL_ENTITY_LABELS[grantCheck.legalEntityStage].replace(/^[^\w]+/, '')} stage.`,
        reimbursementAndTrapWarning:
          'Never spend a cent before receiving your signed Letter of Offer—retrospective invoices are 100% disqualified. General laptops and iPhones are excluded.',
        preflightModulesToWin: [
          'Module B (Non-Displacement & Market Sizing)',
          'Module C (Customer Survey Validation Proof)',
          'Module D/E (3 Vetted Prototype/Consultancy Quotes)',
          'Module K (Official LEO Form & Appendices)',
        ],
        officialUrl: 'https://www.localenterprise.ie/discover-business-supports/funding-and-grants/financial-supports/feasibility-grant/',
      });
    } else if (isLocalDomesticOnly) {
      matches.push({
        slug: 'ie-leo-feasibility-study-grant',
        countryCode: 'IE',
        grantName: 'LEO Feasibility Study Grant',
        providerAgency: agencyLabel,
        fundingType: 'CASH_GRANT',
        fundingTypeBadge: 'Non-Dilutive Cash Grant',
        matchTier: 'UNLOCKABLE_NEXT',
        matchScorePercent: 55,
        potentialValueNumeric: 15000,
        potentialValueFormatted: `Up to €15,000 (${leoMatchRate} Reimbursement Match)`,
        coFundingOrMatchRequirement: `${leoMatchRate} grant reimbursement on prototype, market research, and consultancy costs.`,
        whyYouMatchOrMiss:
          'LEO Feasibility Grants exclude purely local retail, hospitality, or domestic-only services that displace existing local businesses.',
        unlockRequirement:
          'Add an exportable SaaS/digital product layer or internationally traded angle in Module B to pass LEO’s "Non-Displacement & Export" test.',
        reimbursementAndTrapWarning:
          'Paid strictly in arrears on vouched receipts after formal LEO Evaluation Committee approval.',
        preflightModulesToWin: [
          'Module B (Export Wedge & Non-Displacement Matrix)',
          'Module K (LEO Official Application Compiler)',
        ],
        officialUrl: 'https://www.localenterprise.ie/discover-business-supports/funding-and-grants/financial-supports/feasibility-grant/',
      });
    } else {
      matches.push({
        slug: 'ie-leo-feasibility-study-grant',
        countryCode: 'IE',
        grantName: 'LEO Feasibility Study Grant / Technical Assistance',
        providerAgency: agencyLabel,
        fundingType: 'CASH_GRANT',
        fundingTypeBadge: 'Non-Dilutive Cash Grant',
        matchTier: 'QUALIFIES_NOW',
        matchScorePercent: 84,
        potentialValueNumeric: 15000,
        potentialValueFormatted: `Up to €15,000 (${leoMatchRate} Reimbursement Match)`,
        coFundingOrMatchRequirement: `${leoMatchRate} reimbursement match on new product/prototype feasibility expenditure.`,
        whyYouMatchOrMiss:
          'Even as an established LTD (18+ months), you can apply for Feasibility funding when researching a genuinely new export product line or R&D pivot.',
        reimbursementAndTrapWarning:
          'Must be scoped as a new R&D/export product feasibility study rather than routine business-as-usual operations.',
        preflightModulesToWin: [
          'Module D (Work Packages WP1..n)',
          'Module K (LEO Appendix Pack)',
        ],
        officialUrl: 'https://www.localenterprise.ie/discover-business-supports/funding-and-grants/financial-supports/feasibility-grant/',
      });
    }

    // 2. Enterprise Ireland New Frontiers (Phase 1 & Phase 2 €15,000 Stipend)
    if (!isLocalDomesticOnly) {
      const nfReadyNow =
        grantCheck.legalEntityStage === 'PRE_INCORPORATION' ||
        grantCheck.legalEntityStage === 'SOLE_TRADER' ||
        grantCheck.legalEntityStage === 'LTD_UNDER_18M';
      matches.push({
        slug: 'ie-enterprise-ireland-new-frontiers',
        countryCode: 'IE',
        grantName: 'Enterprise Ireland New Frontiers (Phase 1 & Phase 2)',
        providerAgency: 'Enterprise Ireland (via Technological Universities)',
        fundingType: 'STIPEND_PROGRAMME',
        fundingTypeBadge: '€15k Tax-Free Stipend (0% Equity)',
        matchTier: nfReadyNow && isGoingFullTime ? 'QUALIFIES_NOW' : 'UNLOCKABLE_NEXT',
        matchScorePercent: nfReadyNow && isGoingFullTime ? 92 : 76,
        potentialValueNumeric: 15000,
        potentialValueFormatted: '€15,000 Tax-Free Founder Stipend (0% Equity Taken)',
        coFundingOrMatchRequirement:
          'No cash match required! Phase 1 is part-time (evenings/weekends); Phase 2 pays €15,000 tax-free over 6 months full-time.',
        whyYouMatchOrMiss:
          nfReadyNow && isGoingFullTime
            ? 'You have an export-capable concept and full-time founder bandwidth—making you an ideal candidate for Phase 2 (€15k tax-free stipend).'
            : 'Phase 1 is open part-time right now while keeping your day job; unlocking the €15,000 Phase 2 stipend requires committing full-time for 6 months.',

Start with Enterprise Ireland New Frontiers (€15,000 stipend with €0 match required) or pair your LEO grant with a Microfinance Ireland loan.'
        : 'Cashflow Match Alert: Because your starting cash budget is under £1,000, prioritize British Business Bank Start Up Loans (up to £25,000 paid upfront into your account) before applying for reimbursement-based regional grants.';
  } else if (budgetBracket === '1K_TO_5K') {
    budgetCashflowRealityWarning =
      countryCode === 'IE'
        ? 'Smart Co-Funding Tip: With €1,000–€5,000 in starting cash, you can comfortably cashflow €2,000–€10,000 in staged LEO Feasibility or Grow Digital milestones (claiming back 50%–60% on each tranche) without running dry.'
        : 'Smart Co-Funding Tip: With £1,000–£5,000 in starting cash, you can match a £2,500–£5,000 regional Growth Hub voucher right away and layer a British Business Bank Start Up Loan for main working capital.';
  } else {
    budgetCashflowRealityWarning =
      countryCode === 'IE'
        ? 'Strong Co-Funding Position: Your starting budget of €5,000+ gives you the upfront working capital needed to unlock full LEO Feasibility (€15k), Enterprise Ireland PSSF (€50k–€100k with 10% match), and Revenue SURE tax refunds.'
        : 'Strong Co-Funding Position: Your starting budget of £5,000+ positions you well to cover legal incorporation, HMRC SEIS Advance Assurance, and the 30%–50% match on UK innovation grants.';
  }

  const strategicPositioningTips: string[] =
    input.grantCheck.aiGrantPositioningAdvice &&
    input.grantCheck.aiGrantPositioningAdvice.length > 0
      ? input.grantCheck.aiGrantPositioningAdvice
      : countryCode === 'IE'
        ? [
            isLocalDomesticOnly
              ? '1. Solve the "Displacement Test": To unlock LEO Feasibility (€15k) and Priming (€150k), frame how your business either exports outside your county/country or replaces imports rather than taking customers from local cafés/shops.'
              : '1. Lead with Export & Non-Displacement: In your LEO/EI application, emphasize how your solution serves B2B or international buyers and does not displace existing local main-street businesses.',
            hasPayeHistory
              ? '2. Stack Non-Dilutive Grants with Revenue SURE: Before investing your personal savings into startup costs, incorporate your Irish LTD properly so your investment triggers up to a 41% income tax refund via SURE.'
              : '2. Prove Primary Market Demand First: Grant committees reject pure "build it and they will come" ideas—use Module C to collect 15–25 real survey responses and 3 customer interviews before submitting.',
            '3. Follow the 3-Quote & Letter-of-Offer Rule: Never pay a developer or supplier before receiving your formal Letter of Offer, and gather 3 independent quotes for any item ≥ €5,000 in Modules D & E.',
          ]
        : [
            '1. Pair Start Up Loans with SEIS Advance Assurance: Use British Business Bank Start Up Loans (£25k/founder) for Day-1 non-dilutive working capital while securing HMRC SEIS Advance Assurance for angel readiness.',
            isDeepTechOrRD
              ? '2. Frame Technical Uncertainty for HMRC & Innovate UK: Document why your software/engineering architecture cannot be easily solved by a competent developer using off-the-shelf tools (Module D Work Packages).'
              : '2. Back Every Forecast with Written Sales Assumptions: UK Start Up Loans evaluators scrutinize *how* you calculated Month 1–12 unit sales—use Module C survey proof and Module G pricing tiers to prove demand.',
            '3. Check Your Local Growth Hub Early: Before buying software or equipment, check your regional Growth Hub / devolved agency voucher scheme since retrospective purchases cannot be reimbursed.',
          ];

  return {
    countryCode,
    currency,
    qualifiesNowGrants,
    unlockableNextGrants,
    notEligibleGrants,
    immediateQualifiedPoolValue,
    immediateQualifiedPoolFormatted: formatPlanCurrency(
      immediateQualifiedPoolValue,
      currency,
      countryCode
    ),
    unlockableScalePoolValue,
    unlockableScalePoolFormatted: formatPlanCurrency(
      unlockableScalePoolValue,
      currency,
      countryCode
    ),
    totalCombinedPotentialValue,
    totalCombinedPotentialFormatted: formatPlanCurrency(
      totalCombinedPotentialValue,
      currency,
      countryCode
    ),
    budgetCashflowRealityWarning,
    strategicPositioningTips,
  };
}

/**
 * Returns deterministic in-memory GrantDirectoryRecord objects.
 * Used for zero-latency instant rendering and reliable offline/unseeded fallback.
 */
export function getFallbackGrantRecords(): GrantDirectoryRecord[] {
  const fallbackDate = new Date('2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z');
  return FULL_DEFAULT_GRANTS_CATALOG.map((g, idx) => ({
    ...g,
    id: `seed-grant-${idx + 1}-${g.slug}`,
    createdAt: fallbackDate,
    updatedAt: fallbackDate,
  })) as GrantDirectoryRecord[];
}

let seedPromise: Promise<void> | null = null;

/**
 * Idempotently checks if the grants_directory table has records in PostgreSQL.
 * If empty or missing core schemes, automatically seeds all default grants.
 */
export async function ensureDefaultGrantsSeededInDb(): Promise<void> {
  if (seedPromise) {
    return seedPromise;
  }

  seedPromise = (async () => {
    try {
      await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

      // Fetch existing slugs to insert any missing seeds idempotently
      const existing = await db
        .select({ slug: grantsDirectory.slug })
        .from(grantsDirectory);

      const existingSlugs = new Set(existing.map((e) => e.slug));

      for (const grant of FULL_DEFAULT_GRANTS_CATALOG) {
        if (!existingSlugs.has(grant.slug)) {
          try {
            await db
              .insert(grantsDirectory)
              .values(grant)
              .onConflictDoNothing({ target: grantsDirectory.slug });
          } catch (insertErr) {
            console.warn(`[GrantsSeed] Failed to insert seed grant ${grant.slug}:`, insertErr);
          }
        } else {
          try {
            await db
              .update(grantsDirectory)
              .set({
                officialUrl: grant.officialUrl,
                updatedAt: new Date(),
              })
              .where(eq(grantsDirectory.slug, grant.slug));
          } catch (updateErr) {
            console.warn(`[GrantsSeed] Failed to sync officialUrl for grant ${grant.slug}:`, updateErr);
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      // Non-fatal warning so client fallbacks can kick in cleanly
      console.warn('[GrantsSeed] Non-fatal ensureDefaultGrantsSeededInDb error:', err);
    } finally {
      // Clear promise so it can be retried on next request if it encountered transient network issue
      seedPromise = null;
    }
  })();

  return seedPromise;
}

    fundingBadge: 'Angel Tax Catalyst (Up to 50%)',
    maxAmountFormatted: 'Up to €500,000/yr per Angel',
    maxAmountNumeric: 500000,
    matchRatePercent: 100,
    turnaroundSpeed: 'STANDARD_6_TO_8_WEEKS',
    turnaroundLabel: '4–6 Weeks Certification',
    stageFit: 'Angel / Seed Funding Round',
    description:
      'Gives private Irish investors up to 50% income tax relief on qualifying risk capital investments, dramatically speeding up angel round closes.',
    officialUrl: 'https://www.revenue.ie/en/personal-tax-credits-reliefs-and-exemptions/investment/relief-corporate/employment-investment-incentive.aspx',
    underwritingSummary:
      'Company must be an SME with a qualifying trading activity. Enables founders to raise rounds locally with lower valuation friction.',
  },
  GB_BBB_START_UP_LOAN: {
    key: 'GB_BBB_START_UP_LOAN',
    country: 'GB',
    name: 'British Business Bank Start Up Loan',
    agency: 'British Business Bank (Gov-Backed)',
    fundingBadge: 'Unsecured 6% Fixed Loan',
    maxAmountFormatted: 'Up to £25,000 per Founder',
    maxAmountNumeric: 25000,
    matchRatePercent: 100,
    turnaroundSpeed: 'FAST_2_TO_4_WEEKS',
    turnaroundLabel: '2–4 Weeks Turnaround',
    stageFit: 'Trading < 36 Months / Pre-Trading',
    description:
      'Government-backed personal loan for business purposes. Fixed 6% interest rate, 1–5 year term, zero early repayment penalties, 12 months free mentoring.',
    officialUrl: 'https://www.gov.uk/apply-start-up-loan',
    underwritingSummary:
      'Underwritten on the founder’s personal credit and Module F Personal Survival Budget. Up to 4 co-founders can borrow up to £100,000 collectively.',
  },
  GB_INNOVATE_UK_SMART: {
    key: 'GB_INNOVATE_UK_SMART',
    country: 'GB',
    name: 'Innovate UK Smart Grant',
    agency: 'Innovate UK / UKRI',
    fundingBadge: 'Competitive R&D Cash Grant',
    maxAmountFormatted: '£100,000 to £500,000 (70% match)',
    maxAmountNumeric: 250000,
    matchRatePercent: 70,
    turnaroundSpeed: 'HEAVY_10_TO_16_WEEKS',
    turnaroundLabel: '12–16 Weeks Competitive',
    stageFit: 'R&D / High-Tech Innovation',
    description:
      'Co-funds game-changing, highly disruptive R&D innovations with substantial technical risk and major UK economic export potential.',
    officialUrl: 'https://www.ukri.org/councils/innovate-uk/',
    underwritingSummary:
      'Scored on a rigorous 9-question IFS rubric. Requires proven technical merit, Freedom to Operate (FTO), and structured work packages.',
  },
  GB_HMRC_SEIS_ASSURANCE: {
    key: 'GB_HMRC_SEIS_ASSURANCE',
    country: 'GB',
    name: 'HMRC SEIS (Seed Enterprise Investment Scheme)',
    agency: 'HM Revenue & Customs (UK)',
    fundingBadge: 'Angel Tax Catalyst (50% Relief)',
    maxAmountFormatted: 'Up to £250,000 Company Cap',
    maxAmountNumeric: 250000,
    matchRatePercent: 100,
    turnaroundSpeed: 'STANDARD_6_TO_8_WEEKS',
    turnaroundLabel: '4–6 Weeks Advance Assurance',
    stageFit: 'Trading < 3 Years / Seed Round',
    description:
      'Gives UK angel investors 50% income tax relief plus complete Capital Gains Tax exemption. Advance Assurance is required by 90% of UK angels.',
    officialUrl: 'https://www.gov.uk/guidance/venture-capital-schemes-apply-to-use-the-seed-enterprise-investment-scheme',
    underwritingSummary:
      'Requires a UK permanent establishment, qualifying trade, gross assets < £350k, and fewer than 25 employees.',
  },
  GB_GROWTH_HUB_MATCH: {
    key: 'GB_GROWTH_HUB_MATCH',
    country: 'GB',
    name: 'Local Growth Hub Match Grant',
    agency: 'Local Enterprise Partnerships / Growth Hubs',
    fundingBadge: 'Regional Match Grant',
    maxAmountFormatted: '£2,500 to £10,000 (50% match)',
    maxAmountNumeric: 10000,
    matchRatePercent: 50,
    turnaroundSpeed: 'FAST_2_TO_4_WEEKS',
    turnaroundLabel: '3–5 Weeks Turnaround',
    stageFit: 'Pre-Trading or Early Growth',
    description:
      'Regional capital and business support grants administered through England, Scotland (SE), Wales (DBW), or Invest NI for local micro-enterprises.',
    officialUrl: 'https://www.gov.uk/business-finance-support',
    underwritingSummary:
      'Varies by county council / Growth Hub. Strong preference for digital adoption, clean tech, and local employment.',
  },
};

export interface GrantAuditCheckpoint {
  id: string;
  category: 'LEGAL' | 'COMMERCIAL' | 'EQUIPMENT' | 'FINANCIAL' | 'VALIDATION' | 'TEAM';
  title: string;
  sourceModule: string;
  sourceModuleCode:
    | 'MOD_A_IDEATION'
    | 'MOD_B_MARKET'
    | 'MOD_C_SURVEYS_FEEDBACK'
    | 'MOD_D_PRODUCT_BUILD'
    | 'MOD_E_OPERATIONS'
    | 'MOD_F_COFOUNDER_TEAM'
    | 'MOD_G_LAUNCHPAD'
    | 'MOD_H_REVENUE'
    | 'MOD_I_MARKETING'
    | 'MOD_J_FINANCE';
  targetStepNumber: number;
  highlightTargetId: string;
  status: GrantAuditStatus;
  statusBadge: string;
  findingSummary: string;
  assessorRuleDescription: string;
  remedyActionLabel: string;
  canQuickFixWithAi?: boolean;
}

export interface EvaluatedGrantProgramAudit {
  programKey: SupportedGrantProgramKey;
  programDefinition: GrantProgramDefinition;
  readinessScorePercent: number;
  isRecommendedPrimary: boolean;
  passCount: number;
  warningCount: number;
  failCount: number;
  checkpoints: GrantAuditCheckpoint[];
  criticalBlockers: string[];
  keyStrengths: string[];
}

export interface ModuleKStep1AuditData {
  selectedGrantKey: SupportedGrantProgramKey;
  country: 'IE' | 'GB';
  currency: string;
  evaluatedPrograms: EvaluatedGrantProgramAudit[];
  overallAssessorReadinessScore: number;
  stackedFundingRoadmapSelected: boolean;
  founderNotes: string;
  lastAuditedAt?: string;
}

/**
 * Helper to audit an active startup plan across all existing modules A-J
 * against a specific grant program's official criteria.
 */
export function evaluatePlanGrantCheckpoints(
  plan: ActiveStartupPlan,
  programKey: SupportedGrantProgramKey
): EvaluatedGrantProgramAudit {
  const program = SUPPORTED_GRANT_PROGRAMS[programKey];
  const isIE = program.country === 'IE';
  const checkpoints: GrantAuditCheckpoint[] = [];

  // Scanned modules data
  const modG = plan.moduleGData;
  const modF = plan.moduleFData;
  const modE = plan.moduleEData;
  const modD = plan.moduleDData;
  const modC = plan.moduleCData;
  const modB = plan.moduleBData;
  const modA = plan.grantEligibilityCheck;
  const modJ = plan.moduleJData;

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // 1. LEGAL ENTITY & AGE CHECKPOINT
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const legalStatus = modG?.step1?.legalStructure || modA?.legalEntityStage;
  const isIncorporated =
    legalStatus === 'LTD' ||
    legalStatus === 'DAC' ||
    legalStatus === 'LLP' ||
    legalStatus === 'LTD_UNDER_18M' ||
    legalStatus === 'LTD_OVER_18M';

  if (programKey === 'IE_LEO_PRIMING' || programKey === 'IE_EI_PSSF' || programKey === 'IE_REVENUE_SURE_TAX_RELIEF' || programKey === 'GB_HMRC_SEIS_ASSURANCE') {
    if (isIncorporated) {
      checkpoints.push({
        id: 'chk_legal_entity',
        category: 'LEGAL',
        title: 'Incorporated LTD Entity & Age Requirement',
        sourceModule: 'Module G (Launchpad Step 1)',
        sourceModuleCode: 'MOD_G_LAUNCHPAD',
        targetStepNumber: 1,
        highlightTargetId: 'ops-step-1-incorporation',
        status: 'PASS',
        statusBadge: 'Verified LTD',
        findingSummary: 'Registered limited company structure identified.',
        assessorRuleDescription:
          'Grant guidelines mandate a registered Private Limited Company (< 18–36 months trading) to receive drawdowns or issue tax relief shares.',
        remedyActionLabel: 'Review Company Details',
      });
    } else {
      checkpoints.push({
        id: 'chk_legal_entity',
        category: 'LEGAL',
        title: 'Incorporated LTD Entity Required',
        sourceModule: 'Module G (Launchpad Step 1)',
        sourceModuleCode: 'MOD_G_LAUNCHPAD',
        targetStepNumber: 1,
        highlightTargetId: 'ops-step-1-incorporation',
        status: 'FAIL',
        statusBadge: 'Pre-Inc / Sole Trader',
        findingSummary: 'Currently registered as Sole Trader or Pre-Incorporation.',
        assessorRuleDescription:
          `${program.name} requires a formally registered Private Limited Company before the evaluation committee signs off.`,
        remedyActionLabel: 'Incorporate in Module G',
      });
    }
  } else {
    checkpoints.push({
      id: 'chk_legal_entity',
      category: 'LEGAL',
      title: 'Legal Entity Stage Flexibility',
      sourceModule: 'Module G (Launchpad Step 1)',
      sourceModuleCode: 'MOD_G_LAUNCHPAD',
      targetStepNumber: 1,
      highlightTargetId: 'ops-step-1-incorporation',
      status: 'PASS',
      statusBadge: 'Flexible Entity Allowed',
      findingSummary: 'This program accepts pre-incorporation ideas, sole traders, or new companies.',
      assessorRuleDescription:
        `${program.name} does not require immediate LTD status. Sole traders and pre-trading founders are eligible.`,
      remedyActionLabel: 'View Entity in Module G',
    });
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // 2. 3-QUOTE RULE ON CAPITAL & DEV ITEMS (> €5k / £5k)
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const equipmentItems: EquipmentAssetItem[] = modE?.premisesAndEquipment?.equipmentItems || [];
  const highValueWithout3Quotes = equipmentItems.filter(
    (item) => Number(item.totalCostExVat || 0) >= 5000 && item.quoteComplianceStatus !== 'HAVE_3_WRITTEN_QUOTES' && item.quoteComplianceStatus !== 'THREE_QUOTES_UPLOADED_READY'
  );

  if (isIE && (programKey === 'IE_LEO_FEASIBILITY' || programKey === 'IE_LEO_PRIMING')) {
    if (highValueWithout3Quotes.length > 0) {
      checkpoints.push({
        id: 'chk_three_quotes',
        category: 'EQUIPMENT',
        title: '3-Quote Rule for Purchases > €5,000',
        sourceModule: 'Module E (Equipment Schedule Step 2)',
        sourceModuleCode: 'MOD_E_OPERATIONS',
        targetStepNumber: 2,
        highlightTargetId: 'ops-step-2-equipment',
        status: 'WARNING',
        statusBadge: `${highValueWithout3Quotes.length} Item(s) Need 3 Quotes`,
        findingSummary: `Found items over €5,000 without 3 independent supplier quotes logged (e.g., "${highValueWithout3Quotes[0].assetName}").`,
        assessorRuleDescription:
          'LEO financial committees automatically disqualify items exceeding €5,000 unless 3 comparable supplier quotations are submitted with the form.',
        remedyActionLabel: 'Add Quotes in Module E',
      });
    } else {
      checkpoints.push({
        id: 'chk_three_quotes',
        category: 'EQUIPMENT',
        title: '3-Quote Compliance Verified',
        sourceModule: 'Module E (Equipment Schedule Step 2)',
        sourceModuleCode: 'MOD_E_OPERATIONS',
        targetStepNumber: 2,
        highlightTargetId: 'ops-step-2-equipment',
        status: 'PASS',
        statusBadge: 'Quotes Compliant',
        findingSummary: 'All high-value equipment or technical packages satisfy procurement guidelines.',
        assessorRuleDescription:
          'All capital expenditure lines adhere to the government procurement quote threshold.',
        remedyActionLabel: 'Review Schedule in Module E',
      });
    }
  } else {
    checkpoints.push({
      id: 'chk_three_quotes',
      category: 'EQUIPMENT',
      title: 'Supplier Procurement Benchmarks',
      sourceModule: 'Module E (Equipment Schedule Step 2)',
      sourceModuleCode: 'MOD_E_OPERATIONS',
      targetStepNumber: 2,
      highlightTargetId: 'ops-step-2-equipment',
      status: 'PASS',
      statusBadge: 'Verified Costs',
      findingSummary: 'Budgeted vendor costs align with market rate benchmarks.',
      assessorRuleDescription: 'No strict statutory 3-quote requirement on this specific funding line.',
      remedyActionLabel: 'Check Costs in Module E',
    });
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // 3. INELIGIBLE CAPITAL BAN (LAPTOP / GENERIC HARDWARE)
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const hasLaptopOrStandardGadget = equipmentItems.some((item) =>
    item.isMobileOrLaptopIneligibleForLeoGrant ||
    item.isFlaggedLaptopOrMobileAsset ||
    /laptop|macbook|notebook|iphone|ipad|smartphone|personal computer/i.test(item.assetName || '')
  );

  if (isIE && (programKey === 'IE_LEO_FEASIBILITY' || programKey === 'IE_LEO_PRIMING')) {
    if (hasLaptopOrStandardGadget) {
      checkpoints.push({
        id: 'chk_laptop_ban',
        category: 'EQUIPMENT',
        title: 'Disqualified Asset Detection (Standard Laptop Ban)',
        sourceModule: 'Module E (Equipment Schedule Step 2)',
        sourceModuleCode: 'MOD_E_OPERATIONS',
        targetStepNumber: 2,
        highlightTargetId: 'ops-step-2-equipment',
        status: 'FAIL',
        statusBadge: 'Laptop / Mobile Detected',
        findingSummary: 'Capital schedule includes standard laptops or consumer smartphones.',
        assessorRuleDescription:
          'LEO explicitly excludes standard laptops, desktops, and mobile phones from grant assistance under national aid guidelines.',
        remedyActionLabel: 'Reclassify in Module E',
      });
    } else {
      checkpoints.push({
        id: 'chk_laptop_ban',
        category: 'EQUIPMENT',
        title: 'Zero Ineligible Capital Assets',
        sourceModule: 'Module E (Equipment Schedule Step 2)',
        sourceModuleCode: 'MOD_E_OPERATIONS',
        targetStepNumber: 2,
        highlightTargetId: 'ops-step-2-equipment',
        status: 'PASS',
        statusBadge: '100% Eligible Assets',
        findingSummary: 'No disqualified standard office laptops or consumer phones logged in grant schedule.',
        assessorRuleDescription:
          'Clean capital equipment schedule satisfying Enterprise Ireland / LEO exclusion guidelines.',
        remedyActionLabel: 'View Schedule in Module E',
      });
    }
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // 4. EXPORT / NON-DISPLACEMENT TEST
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const isExportOriented =
    plan.exportPotential === 'EXPORTING_INTERNATIONALLY' ||
    (plan.targetMarketsArray && plan.targetMarketsArray.length > 1) ||
    modB?.beachhead?.beachheadSegment;

  if (programKey === 'IE_LEO_PRIMING' || programKey === 'IE_EI_PSSF' || programKey === 'GB_INNOVATE_UK_SMART') {
    if (isExportOriented) {
      checkpoints.push({
        id: 'chk_export_displacement',
        category: 'COMMERCIAL',
        title: 'Export Potential & Non-Displacement Test',
        sourceModule: 'Module B (Competitive Wedge Step 5)',
        sourceModuleCode: 'MOD_B_MARKET',
        targetStepNumber: 5,
        highlightTargetId: 'market-step-5-wedge',
        status: 'PASS',
        statusBadge: 'Export Verified',
        findingSummary: 'International expansion roadmap and export wedge identified.',
        assessorRuleDescription:
          'State aid rules prohibit funding businesses that solely displace existing domestic local shops or services.',
        remedyActionLabel: 'Review Wedge in Module B',
      });
    } else {
      checkpoints.push({
        id: 'chk_export_displacement',
        category: 'COMMERCIAL',
        title: 'Export / Non-Displacement Risk',
        sourceModule: 'Module B (Competitive Wedge Step 5)',
        sourceModuleCode: 'MOD_B_MARKET',
        targetStepNumber: 5,
        highlightTargetId: 'market-step-5-wedge',
        status: 'WARNING',
        statusBadge: 'Domestic-Only Risk',
        findingSummary: 'Plan appears focused on domestic local trade only.',
        assessorRuleDescription:
          `${program.name} prioritises internationally traded services or products that generate net-new wealth and do not cannibalise local competitors.`,
        remedyActionLabel: 'Refine Export in Module B',
        canQuickFixWithAi: true,
      });
    }
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // 5. MATCHING FUNDS & WORKING CAPITAL PROOF
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const founderEquity = modJ?.step3CashflowGap?.fundingSources?.find(
    (l: FundingSourceLineItem) => l.sourceType === 'FOUNDER_SAVINGS_EQUITY'
  );
  const founderAmount = founderEquity ? Number(founderEquity.amount || 0) : 0;
  const matchRequired = program.maxAmountNumeric * (program.matchRatePercent / 100);

  if (program.matchRatePercent < 100) {
    if (founderAmount > 0) {
      checkpoints.push({
        id: 'chk_matching_funds',
        category: 'FINANCIAL',
        title: `Matching Funds Proof (${100 - program.matchRatePercent}% Required)`,
        sourceModule: 'Module J (Funding Sources Step 3)',
        sourceModuleCode: 'MOD_J_FINANCE',
        targetStepNumber: 3,
        highlightTargetId: 'finance-step-3-cashflow',
        status: 'PASS',
        statusBadge: 'Match Funds Pledged',
        findingSummary: `Found €/£${founderAmount.toLocaleString()} committed from founder savings/equity.`,
        assessorRuleDescription:
          'Assessors require concrete bank statement proof of co-funding matching capital before releasing a formal Letter of Offer.',
        remedyActionLabel: 'Check Match in Module J',
      });
    } else {
      checkpoints.push({
        id: 'chk_matching_funds',
        category: 'FINANCIAL',
        title: `Founder Matching Funds Missing`,
        sourceModule: 'Module J (Funding Sources Step 3)',
        sourceModuleCode: 'MOD_J_FINANCE',
        targetStepNumber: 3,
        highlightTargetId: 'finance-step-3-cashflow',
        status: 'WARNING',
        statusBadge: 'No Match Funds Logged',
        findingSummary: 'No founder cash match or private funding source registered in Module J.',
        assessorRuleDescription:
          `Grants are co-funded. You need at least ${100 - program.matchRatePercent}% cash match to claim this support.`,
        remedyActionLabel: 'Pledge Funds in Module J',
      });
    }
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // 6. JOB CREATION / HEADCOUNT COMMITMENT
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const jobRoles: PlannedRoleItem[] = modF?.step5HiringPlanData?.roles || [];
  const totalJobsCount = jobRoles.length;

  if (programKey === 'IE_LEO_PRIMING' || programKey === 'IE_EI_PSSF') {
    if (totalJobsCount >= 1) {
      checkpoints.push({
        id: 'chk_job_creation',
        category: 'TEAM',
        title: '3-Year Job Creation Target',
        sourceModule: 'Module F (Headcount Plan Step 5)',
        sourceModuleCode: 'MOD_F_COFOUNDER_TEAM',
        targetStepNumber: 5,
        highlightTargetId: 'team-step-5-hiring',
        status: 'PASS',
        statusBadge: `${totalJobsCount} Jobs Scheduled`,
        findingSummary: `${totalJobsCount} job roles mapped with estimated salaries and start dates.`,
        assessorRuleDescription:
          'Priming and PSSF underwrite grants heavily on sustainable payroll job creation over 12–36 months.',
        remedyActionLabel: 'View Roles in Module F',
      });
    } else {
      checkpoints.push({
        id: 'chk_job_creation',
        category: 'TEAM',
        title: 'Zero New Jobs Scheduled',
        sourceModule: 'Module F (Headcount Plan Step 5)',
        sourceModuleCode: 'MOD_F_COFOUNDER_TEAM',
        targetStepNumber: 5,
        highlightTargetId: 'team-step-5-hiring',
        status: 'WARNING',
        statusBadge: 'No Jobs Scheduled',
        findingSummary: 'No forward hiring plan detected in Module F Step 5.',
        assessorRuleDescription:
          `${program.name} specifically evaluates economic impact. Schedule at least 1–2 prospective roles.`,
        remedyActionLabel: 'Add Roles in Module F',
      });
    }
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // 7. FOUNDER COMMITMENT & SURVIVAL BUDGET
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const survivalBudgetItems = modF?.step3SurvivalBudgetData?.founderBudgets || [];
  const survivalBudget = survivalBudgetItems.reduce((acc, curr) => acc + (curr.housingAndUtilities + curr.groceriesAndEssentials + curr.debtAndLoanCommitments), 0);
  const isFounderFullTime = plan.founderMotivation?.weeklyHoursAvailable === '40_PLUS_HRS';

  if (programKey === 'GB_BBB_START_UP_LOAN') {
    if (survivalBudget > 0) {
      checkpoints.push({
        id: 'chk_survival_budget',
        category: 'FINANCIAL',
        title: 'Personal Survival Budget Form Completed',
        sourceModule: 'Module F (Survival Budget Step 2)',
        sourceModuleCode: 'MOD_F_COFOUNDER_TEAM',
        targetStepNumber: 2,
        highlightTargetId: 'team-step-2-survival-budget',
        status: 'PASS',
        statusBadge: 'Budget Ready',
        findingSummary: `Personal net monthly survival calculated at £${Number(survivalBudget).toLocaleString()}/mo.`,
        assessorRuleDescription:
          'British Business Bank underwriters mandate a comprehensive Personal Survival Budget to confirm loan affordability.',
        remedyActionLabel: 'Check Budget in Module F',
      });
    } else {
      checkpoints.push({
        id: 'chk_survival_budget',
        category: 'FINANCIAL',
        title: 'Personal Survival Budget Incomplete',
        sourceModule: 'Module F (Survival Budget Step 2)',
        sourceModuleCode: 'MOD_F_COFOUNDER_TEAM',
        targetStepNumber: 2,
        highlightTargetId: 'team-step-2-survival-budget',
        status: 'FAIL',
        statusBadge: 'Missing Survival Budget',
        findingSummary: 'Survival budget numbers are missing or zero in Module F.',
        assessorRuleDescription:
          'Start Up Loans underwriters reject applications without an itemised personal living budget.',
        remedyActionLabel: 'Complete in Module F',
      });
    }
  } else {
    checkpoints.push({
      id: 'chk_founder_commitment',
      category: 'TEAM',
      title: 'Founder Time & Capacity Commitment',
      sourceModule: 'Module A (Motivation Step 2)',
      sourceModuleCode: 'MOD_A_IDEATION',
      targetStepNumber: 2,
      highlightTargetId: 'ideation-step-2-motivation',
      status: isFounderFullTime ? 'PASS' : 'WARNING',
      statusBadge: isFounderFullTime ? 'Full-Time (40+ hrs)' : 'Part-Time / Side-Hustle',
      findingSummary: isFounderFullTime
        ? 'Founder committed full-time to project execution.'
        : 'Founder currently logged as part-time or moonlighting.',
      assessorRuleDescription:
        'State agencies prefer or mandate at least one key promoter transitioning to full-time within 6–12 months.',
      remedyActionLabel: 'Adjust Hours in Module A',
    });
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // 8. CUSTOMER VALIDATION & PROOF POINTS
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const surveys = modC?.surveys || [];
  const interviewLogs = modC?.interviewLogs || [];
  const hasValidationProof = surveys.length > 0 || interviewLogs.length > 0;

  if (hasValidationProof) {
    checkpoints.push({
      id: 'chk_customer_validation',
      category: 'VALIDATION',
      title: 'Mom-Test Survey & Market Validation Evidence',
      sourceModule: 'Module C (Feedback & Survey Kit)',
      sourceModuleCode: 'MOD_C_SURVEYS_FEEDBACK',
      targetStepNumber: 3,
      highlightTargetId: 'survey-step-3-builder',
      status: 'PASS',
      statusBadge: 'Validated Demand',
      findingSummary: 'Structured customer survey data and early interview evidence available.',
      assessorRuleDescription:
        'Grant evaluation panels prioritise applications that present primary data over theoretical market assumptions.',
      remedyActionLabel: 'View Proof in Module C',
    });
  } else {
    checkpoints.push({
      id: 'chk_customer_validation',
      category: 'VALIDATION',
      title: 'Customer Validation Evidence Needed',
      sourceModule: 'Module C (Feedback & Survey Kit)',
      sourceModuleCode: 'MOD_C_SURVEYS_FEEDBACK',
      targetStepNumber: 3,
      highlightTargetId: 'survey-step-3-builder',
      status: 'WARNING',
      statusBadge: 'Needs Primary Proof',
      findingSummary: 'No structured customer interviews or survey responses compiled.',
      assessorRuleDescription:
        'Assessors frequently downgrade applications lacking genuine customer willingness-to-pay interviews.',
      remedyActionLabel: 'Build Survey in Module C',
    });
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // 9. TECHNICAL MERIT & WORK PACKAGES (WP1..WPn)
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const workPackages = modD?.workPackagesAndFlow?.workPackages || [];
  const hasWorkPackages = workPackages.length > 0;

  if (programKey === 'GB_INNOVATE_UK_SMART' || programKey === 'IE_EI_PSSF' || programKey === 'IE_LEO_FEASIBILITY') {
    if (hasWorkPackages) {
      checkpoints.push({
        id: 'chk_work_packages',
        category: 'COMMERCIAL',
        title: 'Work Package Breakdown (WP1..WPn)',
        sourceModule: 'Module D (Technical Merit Step 5)',
        sourceModuleCode: 'MOD_D_PRODUCT_BUILD',
        targetStepNumber: 5,
        highlightTargetId: 'build-step-5-merit',
        status: 'PASS',
        statusBadge: `${workPackages.length} Work Packages Defined`,
        findingSummary: `${workPackages.length} structured milestones with clear technical deliverables.`,
        assessorRuleDescription:
          'Formal research and feasibility grants require structured work packages with deliverables, timelines, and risks.',
        remedyActionLabel: 'Review WPs in Module D',
      });
    } else {
      checkpoints.push({
        id: 'chk_work_packages',
        category: 'COMMERCIAL',
        title: 'Work Packages Not Structured',
        sourceModule: 'Module D (Technical Merit Step 5)',
        sourceModuleCode: 'MOD_D_PRODUCT_BUILD',
        targetStepNumber: 5,
        highlightTargetId: 'build-step-5-merit',
        status: 'WARNING',
        statusBadge: 'No Work Packages',
        findingSummary: 'No formal technical work packages compiled in Module D.',
        assessorRuleDescription:
          `${program.name} assessors score applications on methodology clarity. Break your build into 3–4 discrete work packages.`,
        remedyActionLabel: 'Generate WPs in Module D',
        canQuickFixWithAi: true,
      });
    }
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // 10. BUSINESS BANK ACCOUNT OPENED
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const bankCard = modG?.step3?.hasDedicatedIban || modG?.step3?.state === 'ALREADY_HAVE';
  if (bankCard) {
    checkpoints.push({
      id: 'chk_bank_account',
      category: 'LEGAL',
      title: 'Dedicated Business Bank Account',
      sourceModule: 'Module G (Launchpad Step 3)',
      sourceModuleCode: 'MOD_G_LAUNCHPAD',
      targetStepNumber: 3,
      highlightTargetId: 'ops-step-3-banking',
      status: 'PASS',
      statusBadge: 'Account Active',
      findingSummary: 'Business bank account confirmed for official electronic transfers.',
      assessorRuleDescription:
        'State agencies and BBB lenders cannot release funds into personal savings or current accounts.',
      remedyActionLabel: 'Review Bank in Module G',
    });
  } else {
    checkpoints.push({
      id: 'chk_bank_account',
      category: 'LEGAL',
      title: 'Business Bank Account Pending',
      sourceModule: 'Module G (Launchpad Step 3)',
      sourceModuleCode: 'MOD_G_LAUNCHPAD',
      targetStepNumber: 3,
      highlightTargetId: 'ops-step-3-banking',
      status: 'WARNING',
      statusBadge: 'Action Required',
      findingSummary: 'No dedicated business bank account registered.',
      assessorRuleDescription:
        'Grant reimbursements and startup loan drawdowns are paid exclusively to a verified company account.',
      remedyActionLabel: 'Unlock Bank in Module G',
    });
  }

  // Calculate scores
  const passCount = checkpoints.filter((c) => c.status === 'PASS').length;
  const warningCount = checkpoints.filter((c) => c.status === 'WARNING').length;
  const failCount = checkpoints.filter((c) => c.status === 'FAIL').length;
  const total = checkpoints.length;

  // Weighting: Pass = 100%, Warning = 50%, Fail = 0%
  const weightedScore = Math.round(
    ((passCount * 100 + warningCount * 50) / (total * 100)) * 100
  );

  const criticalBlockers = checkpoints
    .filter((c) => c.status === 'FAIL')
    .map((c) => c.title);

  const keyStrengths = checkpoints
    .filter((c) => c.status === 'PASS')
    .map((c) => c.title);

  return {
    programKey,
    programDefinition: program,
    readinessScorePercent: weightedScore,
    isRecommendedPrimary: false,
    passCount,
    warningCount,
    failCount,
    checkpoints,
    criticalBlockers,
    keyStrengths,
  };
}

/**
 * Returns all evaluated grant programs for the startup's country (IE or GB).
 */
export function evaluateAllEligibleGrantsForPlan(
  plan: ActiveStartupPlan
): EvaluatedGrantProgramAudit[] {
  const isUK = plan.hqCountryCode === 'GB';
  const targetCountry = isUK ? 'GB' : 'IE';

  const relevantKeys = (
    Object.keys(SUPPORTED_GRANT_PROGRAMS) as SupportedGrantProgramKey[]
  ).filter((key) => SUPPORTED_GRANT_PROGRAMS[key].country === targetCountry);

  const evaluated = relevantKeys.map((key) =>
    evaluatePlanGrantCheckpoints(plan, key)
  );

  // Sort by highest readiness score first
  evaluated.sort((a, b) => b.readinessScorePercent - a.readinessScorePercent);

  if (evaluated.length > 0) {
    evaluated[0].isRecommendedPrimary = true;
  }

  return evaluated;
}

import crypto from 'crypto';
import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { db, ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced } from '@/db';
import { startupPlans, users } from '@/db/schema';

const SESSION_COOKIE_NAME = 'spf_session_token';
const LEGACY_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME = 'bmu_session_token';
const ADMIN_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME = 'spf_super_admin_token';
const LEGACY_ADMIN_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME = 'bmu_super_admin_token';

// Never fall back to a static public secret in production.
// If BETTER_AUTH_SECRET is missing in production, generate an ephemeral per-instance secret
// and log a critical warning so tokens cannot be forged externally.
const EPHEMERAL_FALLBACK_SECRET = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');

function getSessionSecret(): string {
  const configured =
    process.env.BETTER_AUTH_SECRET?.trim() || process.env.AUTH_SECRET?.trim();
  if (configured && configured.length >= 16) {
    return configured;
  }
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
    console.error(
      '[Startup Preflight SECURITY WARNING] BETTER_AUTH_SECRET is missing or too short in production! Using ephemeral secret.'
    );
    return EPHEMERAL_FALLBACK_SECRET;
  }
  return 'bmu-v2-local-dev-only-secret-do-not-use-in-prod-2026';
}

const FOUNDER_TOKEN_TTL_MS = 1000 * 60 * 60 * 24 * 30; // 30 days
const ADMIN_TOKEN_TTL_MS = 1000 * 60 * 60 * 12; // 12 hours

const UUID_REGEX =
  /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

export interface SessionTokenPayload {
  userId: string;
  email: string;
  role?: 'SUPER_ADMIN' | 'FOUNDER';
  iat: number;
}

/**
 * Hash a plaintext password with a random 16-byte salt using Node's native scrypt.
 * Zero native C++ dependencies required inside Docker / Cloud Run.
 */
export function hashPassword(password: string): string {
  const salt = crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
  const derivedKey = crypto.scryptSync(password, salt, 64).toString('hex');
  return `${salt}:${derivedKey}`;
}

/**
 * Verify a plaintext password against a stored `salt:hash` string using constant-time comparison.
 */
export function verifyPassword(password: string, storedHash: string): boolean {
  const parts = storedHash.split(':');
  if (parts.length !== 2) return false;
  const [salt, keyHex] = parts;
  const keyBuffer = Buffer.from(keyHex, 'hex');
  const derivedBuffer = crypto.scryptSync(password, salt, 64);
  if (keyBuffer.length !== derivedBuffer.length) return false;
  return crypto.timingSafeEqual(keyBuffer, derivedBuffer);
}

/**
 * AES-256-GCM encryption for Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) Gemini API keys at rest.
 * Format: `enc:v1:<ivHex>:<authTagHex>:<ciphertextHex>`
 */
function getByokEncryptionKey(): Buffer {
  const rawSecret =
    process.env.BYOK_ENCRYPTION_KEY?.trim() || getSessionSecret();
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(`bmu-byok-v1:${rawSecret}`).digest();
}

export function encryptByokApiKey(rawApiKey: string): string {
  const trimmed = rawApiKey.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return '';
  if (trimmed.startsWith('enc:v1:')) return trimmed;
  const key = getByokEncryptionKey();
  const iv = crypto.randomBytes(12);
  const cipher = crypto.createCipheriv('aes-256-gcm', key, iv);
  const encrypted = Buffer.concat([
    cipher.update(trimmed, 'utf8'),
    cipher.final(),
  ]);
  const authTag = cipher.getAuthTag();
  return `enc:v1:${iv.toString('hex')}:${authTag.toString('hex')}:${encrypted.toString('hex')}`;
}

export function decryptByokApiKey(storedValue: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (!storedValue) return null;
  const trimmed = storedValue.trim();
  if (!trimmed || trimmed === 'enc_gemini_byok_active') return null;
  if (!trimmed.startsWith('enc:v1:')) {
    // Legacy plaintext key compatibility (only if it looks like a valid Gemini API key)
    return trimmed.length >= 20 ? trimmed : null;
  }
  try {
    const parts = trimmed.split(':');
    if (parts.length !== 5) return null;
    const [, , ivHex, authTagHex, cipherHex] = parts;
    const key = getByokEncryptionKey();
    const iv = Buffer.from(ivHex, 'hex');
    const authTag = Buffer.from(authTagHex, 'hex');
    const encrypted = Buffer.from(cipherHex, 'hex');
    const decipher = crypto.createDecipheriv('aes-256-gcm', key, iv);
    decipher.setAuthTag(authTag);
    const decrypted = Buffer.concat([
      decipher.update(encrypted),
      decipher.final(),
    ]).toString('utf8');
    return decrypted.trim() || null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function signPayload(payload: SessionTokenPayload): string {
  const secret = getSessionSecret();
  const data = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(payload)).toString('base64url');
  const signature = crypto
    .createHmac('sha256', secret)
    .update(data)
    .digest('base64url');
  return `${data}.${signature}`;
}

function verifyPayload(token: string, maxAgeMs: number = FOUNDER_TOKEN_TTL_MS): SessionTokenPayload | null {
  try {
    const [data, signature] = token.split('.');
    if (!data || !signature) return null;
    const secret = getSessionSecret();
    const expectedSig = crypto
      .createHmac('sha256', secret)
      .update(data)
      .digest('base64url');
    const sigBuf = Buffer.from(signature, 'utf8');
    const expectedBuf = Buffer.from(expectedSig, 'utf8');
    if (
      sigBuf.length !== expectedBuf.length ||
      !crypto.timingSafeEqual(sigBuf, expectedBuf)
    ) {
      return null;
    }
    const decoded = JSON.parse(
      Buffer.from(data, 'base64url').toString('utf8')
    ) as SessionTokenPayload;
    if (!decoded || typeof decoded.iat !== 'number' || !decoded.userId) {
      return null;
    }
    const ageMs = Date.now() - decoded.iat;
    if (ageMs < -60_000 || ageMs > maxAgeMs) {
      return null;
    }
    return decoded;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export async function setServerSessionCookie(payload: {
  userId: string;
  email: string;
}): Promise<void> {
  const token = signPayload({
    userId: payload.userId,
    email: payload.email,
    iat: Date.now(),
  });
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  cookieStore.set(SESSION_COOKIE_NAME, token, {
    httpOnly: true,
    sameSite: 'lax',
    secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
    path: '/',
    maxAge: 60 * 60 * 24 * 30, // 30 days
  });
}

export async function getServerSessionCookie(): Promise<SessionTokenPayload | null> {
  try {
    const cookieStore = await cookies();
    const token =
      cookieStore.get(SESSION_COOKIE_NAME)?.value ||
      cookieStore.get(LEGACY_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME)?.value;
    if (!token) return null;
    return verifyPayload(token, FOUNDER_TOKEN_TTL_MS);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export async function clearServerSessionCookie(): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const cookieStore = await cookies();
    cookieStore.delete(SESSION_COOKIE_NAME);
    cookieStore.delete(LEGACY_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME);
  } catch {
    // Ignore if called outside request context
  }
}

export async function setAdminSessionCookie(payload: {
  userId: string;
  email: string;
}): Promise<void> {
  const token = signPayload({
    userId: payload.userId,
    email: payload.email,
    role: 'SUPER_ADMIN',
    iat: Date.now(),
  });
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  cookieStore.set(ADMIN_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME, token, {
    httpOnly: true,
    sameSite: 'lax',
    secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
    path: '/',
    maxAge: 60 * 60 * 12, // 12 hours for admin session security
  });
}

export async function getAdminSessionCookie(): Promise<SessionTokenPayload | null> {
  try {
    const cookieStore = await cookies();
    const token =
      cookieStore.get(ADMIN_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME)?.value ||
      cookieStore.get(LEGACY_ADMIN_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME)?.value;
    if (!token) return null;
    const payload = verifyPayload(token, ADMIN_TOKEN_TTL_MS);
    if (!payload || payload.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN') return null;
    return payload;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export async function clearAdminSessionCookie(): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const cookieStore = await cookies();
    cookieStore.delete(ADMIN_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME);
    cookieStore.delete(LEGACY_ADMIN_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME);
  } catch {
    // Ignore if called outside request context
  }
}

/**
 * Lightweight in-memory sliding-window rate limiter to protect auth endpoints,
 * public survey submissions, and per-user AI burst calls.
 */
const rateLimitBuckets = new Map<string, number[]>();

export function checkRateLimit(
  bucketKey: string,
  maxRequests: number,
  windowMs: number
): { allowed: boolean; remaining: number; retryAfterSeconds: number } {
  const now = Date.now();
  const windowStart = now - windowMs;
  const existing = rateLimitBuckets.get(bucketKey) ?? [];
  const activeTimestamps = existing.filter((ts) => ts > windowStart);

  if (activeTimestamps.length >= maxRequests) {
    rateLimitBuckets.set(bucketKey, activeTimestamps);
    const oldest = activeTimestamps[0] ?? now;
    const retryAfterSeconds = Math.max(
      1,
      Math.ceil((oldest + windowMs - now) / 1000)
    );
    return {
      allowed: false,
      remaining: 0,
      retryAfterSeconds,
    };
  }

  activeTimestamps.push(now);
  rateLimitBuckets.set(bucketKey, activeTimestamps);

  // Periodic cleanup to prevent unbounded Map growth
  if (rateLimitBuckets.size > 5000) {
    for (const [key, timestamps] of rateLimitBuckets.entries()) {
      const filtered = timestamps.filter((ts) => ts > now - 3600_000);
      if (filtered.length === 0) {
        rateLimitBuckets.delete(key);
      } else {
        rateLimitBuckets.set(key, filtered);
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    allowed: true,
    remaining: Math.max(0, maxRequests - activeTimestamps.length),
    retryAfterSeconds: 0,
  };
}

/**
 * Strict server-side authorization & IDOR prevention helper.
 * Verifies:
 * 1. The request has a valid signed HttpOnly session cookie (founder or super_admin).
 * 2. The user exists in PostgreSQL and has status === 'ACTIVE'.
 * 3. If a real database `planId` is supplied, the plan belongs to `session.userId` (or caller is SUPER_ADMIN).
 */
export async function verifyActiveSessionAndPlanOwnership(planId?: string): Promise<{
  authorized: boolean;
  isLocalPreview: boolean;
  userId: string | null;
  email: string | null;
  isSuperAdmin: boolean;
  reason?: string;
}> {
  const isLocalPlanId =
    !planId ||
    planId.startsWith('demo-') ||
    planId.startsWith('local-') ||
    planId.startsWith('plan-') ||
    !UUID_REGEX.test(planId);

  const founderSession = await getServerSessionCookie();
  const adminSession = await getAdminSessionCookie();
  const activeSession = founderSession || adminSession;

  if (!activeSession) {
    return {
      authorized: false,
      isLocalPreview: isLocalPlanId,
      userId: null,
      email: null,
      isSuperAdmin: false,
      reason: 'UNAUTHENTICATED_SESSION',
    };
  }

  // Super-admin virtual session (master env credentials) or DB user check
  let isSuperAdmin = Boolean(adminSession && adminSession.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN');

  if (
    activeSession.userId === 'super-admin-root' ||
    activeSession.userId === 'super-admin-local'
  ) {
    isSuperAdmin = true;
  } else if (
    activeSession.userId === 'local-founder-session' ||
    activeSession.userId.startsWith('local-') ||
    activeSession.userId.startsWith('demo-') ||
    !UUID_REGEX.test(activeSession.userId)
  ) {
    return {
      authorized: true,
      isLocalPreview: true,
      userId: activeSession.userId,
      email: activeSession.email,
      isSuperAdmin: false,
    };
  }

  try {
    await ensureDatabaseSchemaSynced();

    if (!isSuperAdmin) {
      const [dbUser] = await db
        .select({
          id: users.id,
          status: users.status,
          role: users.role,
        })
        .from(users)
        .where(eq(users.id, activeSession.userId))
        .limit(1);

      if (!dbUser || dbUser.status !== 'ACTIVE') {
        return {
          authorized: false,
          isLocalPreview: false,
          userId: activeSession.userId,
          email: activeSession.email,
          isSuperAdmin: false,
          reason: 'USER_SUSPENDED_OR_NOT_FOUND',
        };
      }
      if (dbUser.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
        isSuperAdmin = true;
      }
    }

    if (planId && !isLocalPlanId && !isSuperAdmin) {
      const [planRow] = await db
        .select({
          id: startupPlans.id,
          ownerUserId: startupPlans.ownerUserId,
        })
        .from(startupPlans)
        .where(eq(startupPlans.id, planId))
        .limit(1);

      if (!planRow) {
        return {
          authorized: false,
          isLocalPreview: false,
          userId: activeSession.userId,
          email: activeSession.email,
          isSuperAdmin,
          reason: 'PLAN_NOT_FOUND',
        };
      }

      if (planRow.ownerUserId !== activeSession.userId) {
        return {
          authorized: false,
          isLocalPreview: false,
          userId: activeSession.userId,
          email: activeSession.email,
          isSuperAdmin,
          reason: 'PLAN_OWNERSHIP_MISMATCH',
        };
      }
    }

    return {
      authorized: true,
      isLocalPreview: isLocalPlanId,
      userId: activeSession.userId,
      email: activeSession.email,
      isSuperAdmin,
    };
  } catch {
    return {
      authorized: false,
      isLocalPreview: isLocalPlanId,
      userId: activeSession.userId,
      email: activeSession.email,
      isSuperAdmin: false,
      reason: 'DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE',
    };
  }
}

import { NextRequest } from 'next/server';

/**
 * Resolves the true public origin (protocol + host) of the application,
 * reliably handling Cloud Run, Docker containers, reverse proxies (Nginx, Cloudflare),
 * and local development without ever leaking internal container addresses (0.0.0.0 / 127.0.0.1).
 */
export function resolvePublicOrigin(req: NextRequest): string {
  // 1. Check if user configured an explicit public production URL in env
  const envUrl = (
    process.env.APP_URL?.trim() ||
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL?.trim() ||
    ''
  ).replace(/\/$/, '');

  // If envUrl is set to a real production domain, prioritize it
  if (
    envUrl &&
    !envUrl.includes('localhost') &&
    !envUrl.includes('0.0.0.0') &&
    !envUrl.includes('127.0.0.1')
  ) {
    return envUrl;
  }

  // 2. Extract from standard reverse proxy headers (Cloud Run, Cloudflare, App Engine, AWS, Nginx)
  const xForwardedHost = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-host');
  const host = xForwardedHost || req.headers.get('host');
  const xForwardedProto = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-proto');

  // If host is a real public domain or hostname (not internal container 0.0.0.0 or 127.0.0.1)
  if (host && !host.startsWith('0.0.0.0') && !host.startsWith('127.0.0.1')) {
    const isLocalhost = host.includes('localhost');
    const proto = xForwardedProto || (isLocalhost ? 'http' : 'https');
    return `${proto}://${host}`;
  }

  // 3. If running locally with an explicit envUrl (e.g. http://localhost:3000)
  if (envUrl) {
    return envUrl;
  }

  // 4. Safe fallback: if request nextUrl host is internal, default to localhost:3000
  const proto = req.nextUrl.protocol.startsWith('https') ? 'https' : 'http';
  const finalHost =
    req.nextUrl.host.startsWith('0.0.0.0') || req.nextUrl.host.startsWith('127.0.0.1')
      ? 'localhost:3000'
      : req.nextUrl.host;

  return `${proto}://${finalHost}`;
}

const RESPONSE_UUID_REGEX =
  /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

/**
 * Produces a canonical signature for a survey response that is invariant to
 * PostgreSQL `jsonb` key sorting vs JavaScript insertion order.
 */
export function getCanonicalResponseSignature(r: SavedSurveyResponse): string {
  const answersObj = r.answers || {};
  const sortedQuestionKeys = Object.keys(answersObj).sort();
  const normalizedAnswers: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> = {};

  for (const qId of sortedQuestionKeys) {
    const val = answersObj[qId];
    if (!val) continue;
    const entry: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    if (val.selectedOption !== undefined) {
      entry.selectedOption = val.selectedOption;
    }
    if (Array.isArray(val.selectedOptions) && val.selectedOptions.length > 0) {
      entry.selectedOptions = [...val.selectedOptions].sort();
    }
    if (val.otherText !== undefined && val.otherText.trim() !== '') {
      entry.otherText = val.otherText.trim();
    }
    if (typeof val.scaleValue === 'number') {
      entry.scaleValue = val.scaleValue;
    }
    if (val.openText !== undefined && val.openText.trim() !== '') {
      entry.openText = val.openText.trim();
    }
    normalizedAnswers[qId] = entry;
  }

  const emailKey = (r.respondentEmail || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const nameKey = (r.respondentNameOrRole || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const simKey = Boolean(r.isSimulated) ? 'sim' : 'real';

  return `${simKey}::${emailKey}::${nameKey}::${JSON.stringify(normalizedAnswers)}`;
}

/**
 * Deduplicates survey responses across localStorage (`resp-...`) and Cloud SQL (`uuid`),
 * preferring UUID-backed database rows so a single submission is never counted twice.
 */
export function deduplicateSurveyResponses(
  responses: SavedSurveyResponse[]
): SavedSurveyResponse[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(responses) || responses.length === 0) return [];

  // Put UUID-backed DB rows first so their authoritative IDs win over local `resp-...` IDs
  const prioritized = [...responses].sort((a, b) => {
    const aIsUuid = RESPONSE_UUID_REGEX.test(a.id) ? 1 : 0;
    const bIsUuid = RESPONSE_UUID_REGEX.test(b.id) ? 1 : 0;
    if (bIsUuid !== aIsUuid) return bIsUuid - aIsUuid;
    return (
      new Date(b.submittedAt).getTime() - new Date(a.submittedAt).getTime()
    );
  });

  const seenIds = new Set<string>();
  const seenSignatures = new Set<string>();
  const unique: SavedSurveyResponse[] = [];

  for (const r of prioritized) {
    if (!r || !r.id) continue;
    const sig = getCanonicalResponseSignature(r);

    if (
      seenIds.has(r.id) ||
      (r.clientResponseId && seenIds.has(r.clientResponseId)) ||
      seenSignatures.has(sig)
    ) {
      seenIds.add(r.id);
      if (r.clientResponseId) seenIds.add(r.clientResponseId);
      continue;
    }

    seenIds.add(r.id);
    if (r.clientResponseId) seenIds.add(r.clientResponseId);
    seenSignatures.add(sig);
    unique.push(r);
  }

  return unique.sort(
    (a, b) =>
      new Date(b.submittedAt).getTime() - new Date(a.submittedAt).getTime()
  );
}
