const STORAGE_KEY = 'spf_v2_session_state_v1';
const LEGACY_STORAGE_KEY = 'bmu_v2_session_state_v1';
const PER_USER_STORAGE_PREFIX = 'spf_v2_session_by_email_v1::';
const LEGACY_PER_USER_STORAGE_PREFIX = 'bmu_v2_session_by_email_v1::';
const PUBLIC_SURVEYS_REGISTRY_KEY = 'spf_v2_public_surveys_registry_v1';
const LEGACY_PUBLIC_SURVEYS_REGISTRY_KEY = 'bmu_v2_public_surveys_registry_v1';
const REAL_PLANS_VAULT_KEY = 'spf_v2_real_founder_plans_vault_v1';
const DELETED_PLAN_IDS_KEY = 'spf_v2_deleted_plan_ids_vault_v1';

export function getDeletedPlanIdsFromStorage(): Set<string> {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return new Set();
  try {
    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(DELETED_PLAN_IDS_KEY);
    if (!raw) return new Set();
    const arr = JSON.parse(raw);
    return new Set(Array.isArray(arr) ? arr : []);
  } catch {
    return new Set();
  }
}

export function markPlanAsDeletedInBrowserStorage(planId: string): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !planId) return;
  try {
    const deletedSet = getDeletedPlanIdsFromStorage();
    deletedSet.add(planId);
    window.localStorage.setItem(
      DELETED_PLAN_IDS_KEY,
      JSON.stringify(Array.from(deletedSet))
    );

    // Remove from REAL_PLANS_VAULT_KEY
    const rawVault = window.localStorage.getItem(REAL_PLANS_VAULT_KEY);
    if (rawVault) {
      const existingVault: ActiveStartupPlan[] = JSON.parse(rawVault);
      const filtered = (existingVault || []).filter((p) => p.id !== planId);
      window.localStorage.setItem(REAL_PLANS_VAULT_KEY, JSON.stringify(filtered));
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignore storage errors
  }
}

export function isSyntheticPersonaPlan(
  plan?: Partial<ActiveStartupPlan> | null
): boolean {
  if (!plan?.id) return false;
  return plan.id.startsWith('plan-persona-');
}

export function hasRealFounderContent(
  plan?: Partial<ActiveStartupPlan> | null
): boolean {
  if (!plan || isSyntheticPersonaPlan(plan)) return false;
  if (plan.brainDumpText && plan.brainDumpText.trim().length > 0) return true;
  if (
    plan.title &&
    plan.title.trim().length > 0 &&
    plan.title.trim() !== 'My Startup Plan'
  ) {
    return true;
  }
  if (plan.oneLinerSummary && plan.oneLinerSummary.trim().length > 0) {
    return true;
  }
  if (
    plan.conceptCanvas?.coreProblem ||
    plan.conceptCanvas?.proposedSolution ||
    plan.conceptCanvas?.targetCustomer
  ) {
    return true;
  }
  if (plan.founderMotivation?.twelveMonthSuccessVision?.trim()) return true;
  if (
    plan.moduleBData ||
    plan.moduleCData ||
    plan.moduleDData ||
    plan.moduleEData ||
    plan.moduleFData ||
    plan.moduleGData ||
    plan.moduleHData ||
    plan.moduleIData ||
    plan.moduleJData ||
    plan.masterDocumentData
  ) {
    return true;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(plan.openQuestions) && plan.openQuestions.length > 0) {
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

function scorePlanRichness(plan: ActiveStartupPlan): number {
  if (isSyntheticPersonaPlan(plan)) return -1;
  let score = 0;
  if (plan.title && plan.title !== 'My Startup Plan') score += 10;
  if (plan.brainDumpText?.trim()) score += 15 + Math.min(plan.brainDumpText.length, 500) / 50;
  if (plan.oneLinerSummary?.trim()) score += 5;
  if (plan.conceptCanvas?.coreProblem) score += 15;
  if (plan.founderMotivation?.twelveMonthSuccessVision) score += 10;
  if (plan.teamAndBudget) score += 5;
  if (plan.founderRealityCheck) score += 5;
  if (plan.grantEligibilityCheck) score += 10;
  if (plan.moduleBData) score += 20;
  if (plan.moduleCData?.surveys?.length) score += 25;
  if (plan.moduleDData) score += 20;
  if (plan.moduleEData) score += 20;
  if (plan.moduleFData) score += 20;
  if (plan.moduleGData) score += 20;
  if (plan.moduleHData) score += 20;
  if (plan.moduleIData) score += 20;
  if (plan.moduleJData) score += 20;
  if (plan.masterDocumentData) score += 20;
  return score;
}

function backupRealPlansToVault(plans: ActiveStartupPlan[]): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    const deletedSet = getDeletedPlanIdsFromStorage();
    const realCandidates = (plans || []).filter(
      (p) => hasRealFounderContent(p) && !deletedSet.has(p.id)
    );
    if (realCandidates.length === 0) return;

    const rawVault = window.localStorage.getItem(REAL_PLANS_VAULT_KEY);
    const existingVault: ActiveStartupPlan[] = rawVault
      ? JSON.parse(rawVault)
      : [];
    const byId = new Map<string, ActiveStartupPlan>();

    for (const existing of existingVault) {
      if (existing?.id && !isSyntheticPersonaPlan(existing) && !deletedSet.has(existing.id)) {
        byId.set(existing.id, existing);
      }
    }
    for (const candidate of realCandidates) {
      const prev = byId.get(candidate.id);
      if (!prev || scorePlanRichness(candidate) >= scorePlanRichness(prev)) {
        byId.set(candidate.id, candidate);
      }
    }

    window.localStorage.setItem(
      REAL_PLANS_VAULT_KEY,
      JSON.stringify(Array.from(byId.values()))
    );
  } catch {
    // Ignore storage quota errors
  }
}

export function recoverAllRealPlansFromBrowserStorage(): ActiveStartupPlan[] {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return [];
  const deletedSet = getDeletedPlanIdsFromStorage();
  const byId = new Map<string, ActiveStartupPlan>();

  const considerPlans = (plans?: ActiveStartupPlan[]) => {
    if (!Array.isArray(plans)) return;
    for (const p of plans) {
      if (!p?.id || isSyntheticPersonaPlan(p)) continue;
      if (deletedSet.has(p.id)) continue;
      if (!hasRealFounderContent(p)) continue;
      const existing = byId.get(p.id);
      if (!existing || scorePlanRichness(p) >= scorePlanRichness(existing)) {
        byId.set(p.id, p);
      }
    }
  };

  try {
    const rawVault = window.localStorage.getItem(REAL_PLANS_VAULT_KEY);
    if (rawVault) {
      considerPlans(JSON.parse(rawVault) as ActiveStartupPlan[]);
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignore parse error
  }

  try {
    for (let i = 0; i < window.localStorage.length; i++) {
      const key = window.localStorage.key(i);
      if (!key) continue;
      if (
        key === STORAGE_KEY ||
        key === LEGACY_STORAGE_KEY ||
        key.startsWith(PER_USER_STORAGE_PREFIX) ||
        key.startsWith(LEGACY_PER_USER_STORAGE_PREFIX)
      ) {
        try {
          const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(key);
          if (!raw) continue;
          const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as BmuLocalSession;
          considerPlans(parsed?.plans);
        } catch {
          // Ignore malformed entry
        }
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignore storage enumeration errors
  }

  const recovered = Array.from(byId.values()).sort(
    (a, b) => scorePlanRichness(b) - scorePlanRichness(a)
  );
  return recovered;
}

function isPersonaPreviewUrlActive(): boolean {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
  try {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    return params.get('persona_preview') === '1';
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function sanitizeAndRestoreRealPlansInSession(
  session: BmuLocalSession,
  allowPersonaPreview: boolean
): BmuLocalSession {
  const deletedSet = getDeletedPlanIdsFromStorage();
  const rawPlans = (Array.isArray(session.plans) ? session.plans : []).filter(
    (p) => !p?.id || !deletedSet.has(p.id)
  );
  const recoveredRealPlans = recoverAllRealPlansFromBrowserStorage();

  // Merge non-persona plans from session with recovered real plans from browser storage
  const realById = new Map<string, ActiveStartupPlan>();
  for (const p of rawPlans) {
    if (p?.id && !isSyntheticPersonaPlan(p)) {
      realById.set(p.id, p);
    }
  }
  for (const rec of recoveredRealPlans) {
    const existing = realById.get(rec.id);
    if (!existing || scorePlanRichness(rec) > scorePlanRichness(existing)) {
      realById.set(rec.id, rec);
    }
  }

  let realPlans = Array.from(realById.values());
  const populatedRealPlans = realPlans.filter((p) => hasRealFounderContent(p));
  if (populatedRealPlans.length > 0) {
    // Drop blank default placeholder if user has real populated plan(s)
    realPlans = [
      ...populatedRealPlans,
      ...realPlans.filter(
        (p) => !hasRealFounderContent(p) && p.id !== 'plan-greencart-1'
      ),
    ];
  }

  if (allowPersonaPreview) {
    const personaPlans = rawPlans.filter((p) => isSyntheticPersonaPlan(p));
    const combined = [...personaPlans, ...realPlans];
    return {
      ...session,
      plans: combined.length > 0 ? combined : getDefaultDemoSession().plans,
      activePlanId:
        session.activePlanId ||
        combined[0]?.id ||
        'plan-greencart-1',
    };
  }

  const finalPlans =
    realPlans.length > 0 ? realPlans : getDefaultDemoSession().plans;
  const currentActiveIsReal = finalPlans.some(
    (p) => p.id === session.activePlanId && !isSyntheticPersonaPlan(p)
  );

  return {
    ...session,
    plans: finalPlans,
    activePlanId: currentActiveIsReal
      ? session.activePlanId
      : finalPlans[0]?.id || 'plan-greencart-1',
  };
}

function getPerUserStorageKey(email: string): string {
  return `${PER_USER_STORAGE_PREFIX}${email.trim().toLowerCase()}`;
}

function getLegacyPerUserStorageKey(email: string): string {
  return `${LEGACY_PER_USER_STORAGE_PREFIX}${email.trim().toLowerCase()}`;
}

export function loadBmuSessionForEmail(email: string): BmuLocalSession | null {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !email?.trim()) return null;
  try {
    const cleanEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();
    const raw =
      window.localStorage.getItem(getPerUserStorageKey(cleanEmail)) ||
      window.localStorage.getItem(getLegacyPerUserStorageKey(cleanEmail));
    if (!raw) {
      // Also check if the active STORAGE_KEY currently belongs to this email
      const activeRaw =
        window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) ||
        window.localStorage.getItem(LEGACY_STORAGE_KEY);
      if (activeRaw) {
        const activeParsed = JSON.parse(activeRaw) as BmuLocalSession;
        if (activeParsed?.user?.email?.trim().toLowerCase() === cleanEmail) {
          return sanitizeAndRestoreRealPlansInSession(activeParsed, false);
        }
      }
      return null;
    }
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as BmuLocalSession;
    if (parsed.entitlement?.accessExpiresAt) {
      parsed.entitlement.accessExpiresAt = new Date(
        parsed.entitlement.accessExpiresAt
      );
    }
    if (Array.isArray(parsed.plans)) {
      parsed.plans = parsed.plans.map((p) => {
        if (!p.moduleCData?.surveys) return p;
        return {
          ...p,
          moduleCData: {
            ...p.moduleCData,
            surveys: p.moduleCData.surveys.map((s) => ({
              ...s,
              responses: deduplicateSurveyResponses(s.responses || []),
            })),
          },
        };
      });
    }
    return sanitizeAndRestoreRealPlansInSession(parsed, false);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function createFreshStartupPlan(
  hqCountryCode: SupportedCountryCode = 'IE'
): ActiveStartupPlan {
  const pack = getCountryRulePack(hqCountryCode);
  const isGrantRegion = hqCountryCode === 'IE' || hqCountryCode === 'GB';
  return {
    id: `plan-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`,
    title: 'My Startup Plan',
    oneLinerSummary: '',
    industryCategory: 'B2B SaaS / AI App',
    hqCountryCode,
    baseCurrency: pack.defaultCurrency,
    targetMarketsArray: [hqCountryCode],
    exportPotential: 'DOMESTIC_ONLY',
    fundingTrackMode: isGrantRegion ? 'GRANT_AND_INVESTOR' : 'COMMERCIAL_ONLY',
    currentModuleStep: 'MOD_A_STEP_1',
    brainDumpText: '',
    openQuestions: [],
  };
}

export function hasActiveBmuSession(): boolean {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
  try {
    const raw =
      window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) ||
      window.localStorage.getItem(LEGACY_STORAGE_KEY);
    return Boolean(raw);
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export function clearActiveBmuSession(): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    window.localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    window.localStorage.removeItem(LEGACY_STORAGE_KEY);
  } catch {
    // Ignore storage removal errors
  }
}

export function loadBmuSession(): BmuLocalSession {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    return getDefaultDemoSession();
  }
  try {
    const raw =
      window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) ||
      window.localStorage.getItem(LEGACY_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) {
      const fallback = getDefaultDemoSession();
      return sanitizeAndRestoreRealPlansInSession(fallback, false);
    }
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as BmuLocalSession;
    if (parsed.entitlement.accessExpiresAt) {
      parsed.entitlement.accessExpiresAt = new Date(
        parsed.entitlement.accessExpiresAt
      );
    }
    if (Array.isArray(parsed.plans)) {
      parsed.plans = parsed.plans.map((p) => {
        if (!p.moduleCData?.surveys) return p;
        return {
          ...p,
          moduleCData: {
            ...p.moduleCData,
            surveys: p.moduleCData.surveys.map((s) => ({
              ...s,
              responses: deduplicateSurveyResponses(s.responses || []),
            })),
          },
        };
      });
    }
    const allowPersonaPreview = isPersonaPreviewUrlActive();
    const restored = sanitizeAndRestoreRealPlansInSession(
      parsed,
      allowPersonaPreview
    );
    // Persist the cleaned/restored session if a synthetic persona plan was stripped
    if (
      !allowPersonaPreview &&
      (parsed.activePlanId !== restored.activePlanId ||
        (parsed.plans || []).length !== restored.plans.length)
    ) {
      saveBmuSession(restored);
    }
    return restored;
  } catch {
    return getDefaultDemoSession();
  }
}

export function exitPersonaPreviewAndRestoreRealPlans(): BmuLocalSession {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    return getDefaultDemoSession();
  }
  try {
    const raw =
      window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) ||
      window.localStorage.getItem(LEGACY_STORAGE_KEY);
    const base = raw
      ? (JSON.parse(raw) as BmuLocalSession)
      : getDefaultDemoSession();
    const restored = sanitizeAndRestoreRealPlansInSession(base, false);
    saveBmuSession(restored);
    return restored;
  } catch {
    return getDefaultDemoSession();
  }
}

export function saveBmuSession(session: BmuLocalSession): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;

  // Before overwriting STORAGE_KEY, always preserve any real founder plans currently in STORAGE_KEY or incoming session
  try {
    const existingRaw =
      window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) ||
      window.localStorage.getItem(LEGACY_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (existingRaw) {
      const existingParsed = JSON.parse(existingRaw) as BmuLocalSession;
      if (Array.isArray(existingParsed?.plans)) {
        backupRealPlansToVault(existingParsed.plans);
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignore parse issues
  }
  backupRealPlansToVault(session.plans || []);

  const cleanedSession: BmuLocalSession = {
    ...session,
    entitlement: {
      ...session.entitlement,
      // Security Invariant: Never store raw BYOK API keys in browser localStorage
      customApiKeyEncrypted: session.entitlement?.customApiKeyEncrypted
        ? 'enc_gemini_byok_active'
        : undefined,
    },
    plans: (session.plans || []).map((p) => {
      if (!p.moduleCData?.surveys) return p;
      return {
        ...p,
        moduleCData: {
          ...p.moduleCData,
          surveys: p.moduleCData.surveys.map((s) => ({
            ...s,
            responses: deduplicateSurveyResponses(s.responses || []),
          })),
        },
      };
    }),
  };
  window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(cleanedSession));
  try {
    const cleanEmail = cleanedSession.user?.email?.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (
      cleanEmail &&
      cleanEmail !== 'founder@startuppreflight.com' &&
      cleanEmail !== 'founder@buildmyunicorn.com'
    ) {
      const perUserKey = getPerUserStorageKey(cleanEmail);
      // Never pollute a user's per-email account vault with synthetic test persona plans
      const realUserPlans = cleanedSession.plans.filter(
        (p) => !isSyntheticPersonaPlan(p)
      );
      const isBlankDemoFallback =
        cleanedSession.user.id === 'user-default-1' &&
        realUserPlans.length === 1 &&
        realUserPlans[0]?.id === 'plan-greencart-1' &&
        !realUserPlans[0]?.brainDumpText;

      if (!isBlankDemoFallback && realUserPlans.length > 0) {
        const realActiveId = realUserPlans.some(
          (p) => p.id === cleanedSession.activePlanId
        )
          ? cleanedSession.activePlanId
          : realUserPlans[0].id;
        const perUserSession: BmuLocalSession = {
          ...cleanedSession,
          plans: realUserPlans,
          activePlanId: realActiveId,
        };
        window.localStorage.setItem(perUserKey, JSON.stringify(perUserSession));
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignore localStorage quota issues
  }
  try {
    const rawRegistry =
      window.localStorage.getItem(PUBLIC_SURVEYS_REGISTRY_KEY) ||
      window.localStorage.getItem(LEGACY_PUBLIC_SURVEYS_REGISTRY_KEY);
    const registry: Record<string, SavedValidationSurvey & { planTitle?: string }> =
      rawRegistry ? JSON.parse(rawRegistry) : {};
    for (const plan of cleanedSession.plans) {
      const surveys = plan.moduleCData?.surveys || [];
      for (const survey of surveys) {
        if (survey.publicSlug) {
          registry[survey.publicSlug] = {
            ...survey,
            responses: deduplicateSurveyResponses(survey.responses || []),
            planTitle: plan.title,
          };
        }
      }
    }
    window.localStorage.setItem(
      PUBLIC_SURVEYS_REGISTRY_KEY,
      JSON.stringify(registry)
    );
  } catch {
    // Ignore localStorage quota/parse issues
  }
}

export function removePublicSurveyFromLocalRegistry(publicSlug: string): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    const cleanSlug = decodeURIComponent(publicSlug).trim();
    const rawRegistry =
      window.localStorage.getItem(PUBLIC_SURVEYS_REGISTRY_KEY) ||
      window.localStorage.getItem(LEGACY_PUBLIC_SURVEYS_REGISTRY_KEY);
    if (!rawRegistry) return;
    const registry = JSON.parse(rawRegistry) as Record<
      string,
      SavedValidationSurvey & { planTitle?: string }
    >;
    if (registry[cleanSlug]) {
      delete registry[cleanSlug];
      window.localStorage.setItem(
        PUBLIC_SURVEYS_REGISTRY_KEY,
        JSON.stringify(registry)
      );
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignore localStorage issues
  }
}

export function loadPublicSurveyFromLocalRegistry(
  publicSlug: string
): (SavedValidationSurvey & { planTitle?: string }) | null {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  try {
    const cleanSlug = decodeURIComponent(publicSlug).trim();
    const rawRegistry =
      window.localStorage.getItem(PUBLIC_SURVEYS_REGISTRY_KEY) ||
      window.localStorage.getItem(LEGACY_PUBLIC_SURVEYS_REGISTRY_KEY);
    if (rawRegistry) {
      const registry = JSON.parse(rawRegistry) as Record<
        string,
        SavedValidationSurvey & { planTitle?: string }
      >;
      if (registry[cleanSlug]) {
        const match = registry[cleanSlug];
        return {
          ...match,
          responses: deduplicateSurveyResponses(match.responses || []),
        };
      }
    }
    // Fallback: scan current session
    const session = loadBmuSession();
    for (const plan of session.plans) {
      const found = (plan.moduleCData?.surveys || []).find(
        (s) => s.publicSlug === cleanSlug
      );
      if (found) {
        return {
          ...found,
          responses: deduplicateSurveyResponses(found.responses || []),
          planTitle: plan.title,
        };
      }
    }
    return null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function appendResponseToLocalRegistryAndSession(
  publicSlug: string,
  response: SavedSurveyResponse
): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  const cleanSlug = decodeURIComponent(publicSlug).trim();
  try {
    const rawRegistry =
      window.localStorage.getItem(PUBLIC_SURVEYS_REGISTRY_KEY) ||
      window.localStorage.getItem(LEGACY_PUBLIC_SURVEYS_REGISTRY_KEY);
    if (rawRegistry) {
      const registry = JSON.parse(rawRegistry) as Record<
        string,
        SavedValidationSurvey & { planTitle?: string }
      >;
      const existing = registry[cleanSlug];
      if (existing) {
        existing.responses = deduplicateSurveyResponses([
          response,
          ...(existing.responses || []),
        ]);
        existing.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        registry[cleanSlug] = existing;
        window.localStorage.setItem(
          PUBLIC_SURVEYS_REGISTRY_KEY,
          JSON.stringify(registry)
        );
      }
    }

    const session = loadBmuSession();
    let changed = false;
    const nextPlans = session.plans.map((plan) => {
      const surveys = plan.moduleCData?.surveys || [];
      const hasMatch = surveys.some((s) => s.publicSlug === cleanSlug);
      if (!hasMatch) return plan;
      changed = true;
      return {
        ...plan,
        moduleCData: {
          ...plan.moduleCData,
          surveys: surveys.map((s) => {
            if (s.publicSlug !== cleanSlug) return s;
            return {
              ...s,
              responses: deduplicateSurveyResponses([
                response,
                ...(s.responses || []),
              ]),
              updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            };
          }),
        },
      };
    });
    if (changed) {
      saveBmuSession({
        ...session,
        plans: nextPlans,
      });
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignore storage error
  }
}

export function registerNewFounderSession(params: {
  name: string;
  email: string;
  voucherOrCohortCode?: string;
}): BmuLocalSession {
  const userId = `user-${Date.now()}`;
  const cleanCode = params.voucherOrCohortCode?.trim().toUpperCase() || '';

  let entitlement: EntitlementSnapshot;
  const redeemedCodes: string[] = [];

  if (cleanCode.startsWith('SUMO-')) {
    const sumo = calculateAppSumoTierLimits(1);
    redeemedCodes.push(cleanCode);
    entitlement = {
      userId,
      planType: 'APPSUMO_LTD',
      stackedCodesCount: 1,
      maxStartupPlans: sumo.maxStartupPlans,
      maxSeatsPerPlan: sumo.maxSeatsPerPlan,
      monthlyAiCreditsLimit: sumo.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
      aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: 0,
      whiteLabelExportEnabled: sumo.whiteLabelExportEnabled,
      isVaultReadonly: false,
    };
  } else if (cleanCode) {
    // If a non-Sumo code was provided (e.g. GOOGLE-TESTERS-2006, SPF-..., BMU-..., or custom cohort)
    const cohortLimits = calculatePassLimits('COHORT_PASS', 6);
    redeemedCodes.push(cleanCode);
    entitlement = {
      userId,
      planType: 'COHORT_PASS',
      stackedCodesCount: 0,
      maxStartupPlans: cohortLimits.maxStartupPlans,
      maxSeatsPerPlan: cohortLimits.maxSeatsPerPlan,
      monthlyAiCreditsLimit: cohortLimits.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
      aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: 0,
      whiteLabelExportEnabled: false,
      accessExpiresAt: cohortLimits.accessExpiresAt,
      isVaultReadonly: false,
    };
  } else {
    const freeLimits = calculatePassLimits('FREE_HOOK');
    entitlement = {
      userId,
      planType: 'FREE_HOOK',
      stackedCodesCount: 0,
      maxStartupPlans: freeLimits.maxStartupPlans,
      maxSeatsPerPlan: freeLimits.maxSeatsPerPlan,
      monthlyAiCreditsLimit: freeLimits.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
      aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: 0,
      whiteLabelExportEnabled: false,
      isVaultReadonly: false,
    };
  }

  const newSession: BmuLocalSession = {
    user: {
      id: userId,
      name: params.name.trim() || 'New Founder',
      email: params.email.trim().toLowerCase(),
      role: 'FOUNDER',
      cohortCode: cleanCode || undefined,
      onboardingCompleted: false,
    },
    entitlement,
    redeemedCodes,
    plans: [],
    activePlanId: '',
  };

  saveBmuSession(newSession);
  return newSession;
}

export function completeFounderOnboarding(params: {
  founderStage: FounderStage;
  teamStructure: TeamStructure;
  primaryHat: StartupHat;
  regionOrCounty: string;
  planTitle: string;
  oneLinerSummary: string;
  hqCountryCode: SupportedCountryCode;
  industryCategory: IndustryCategory;
  exportPotential: 'DOMESTIC_ONLY' | 'EXPORTING_INTERNATIONALLY';
  fundingTrackMode?: 'GRANT_AND_INVESTOR' | 'COMMERCIAL_ONLY';
}): BmuLocalSession {
  const current = loadBmuSession();
  const countryPack = getCountryRulePack(params.hqCountryCode);
  const planId = `plan-${Date.now()}`;

  const targetMarkets =
    params.exportPotential === 'EXPORTING_INTERNATIONALLY'
      ? [params.hqCountryCode, 'GB', 'EU', 'US']
      : [params.hqCountryCode];

  const initialTeamType: PlanTeamStructureType =
    params.teamStructure === 'CO_FOUNDERS'
      ? 'COFOUNDER_TEAM'
      : params.teamStructure === 'LOOKING_FOR_COFOUNDER'
        ? 'SEEKING_COFOUNDER'
        : 'SOLO_FOUNDER';

  const isGrantRegion =
    params.hqCountryCode === 'IE' || params.hqCountryCode === 'GB';
  const resolvedTrack: 'GRANT_AND_INVESTOR' | 'COMMERCIAL_ONLY' = isGrantRegion
    ? params.fundingTrackMode === 'COMMERCIAL_ONLY'
      ? 'COMMERCIAL_ONLY'
      : 'GRANT_AND_INVESTOR'
    : 'COMMERCIAL_ONLY';

  const firstPlan: ActiveStartupPlan = {
    id: planId,
    title: params.planTitle.trim() || 'My First Startup Plan',
    oneLinerSummary: params.oneLinerSummary.trim(),
    industryCategory: params.industryCategory,
    hqCountryCode: params.hqCountryCode,
    baseCurrency: countryPack.defaultCurrency,
    targetMarketsArray: Array.from(new Set(targetMarkets)),
    exportPotential: params.exportPotential,
    fundingTrackMode: resolvedTrack,
    currentModuleStep: 'MOD_A_STEP_1',
    brainDumpText: params.oneLinerSummary.trim(),
    teamAndBudget: {
      teamStructureType: initialTeamType,
      skillCoverage: 'BUILD_IN_HOUSE',
      startingBudgetBracket: '1K_TO_5K',
      teamAndFundingNotes: '',
    },
    openQuestions: [],
  };

  const updated: BmuLocalSession = {
    ...current,
    user: {
      ...current.user,
      founderStage: params.founderStage,
      teamStructure: params.teamStructure,
      primaryHat: params.primaryHat,
      regionOrCounty: params.regionOrCounty,
      onboardingCompleted: true,
    },
    plans: [firstPlan, ...current.plans],
    activePlanId: firstPlan.id,
  };

  saveBmuSession(updated);
  return updated;
}
=== src/lib/panels/prolific-service.ts ===
/**
 * Prolific REST API Client & Automation Bridge
 * Handles study creation, status checking, and automatic participant routing.
 */

const PROLIFIC_API_BASE = 'https://api.prolific.com/api/v1';

export interface ProlificStudyInput {
  name: string;
  description: string;
  externalStudyUrl: string; // e.g. https://startuppreflight.com/v/my-survey?prolific_pid={{%PROLIFIC_PID%}}&boost_id=...
  totalAvailablePlaces: number; // e.g. 50
  estimatedCompletionTimeMinutes?: number; // defaults to 3 mins
  rewardPence?: number; // in pence GBP, e.g. 50 = £0.50 (at 3 mins = £10.00/hr)
  targetCountryCode?: 'IE' | 'GB' | 'US' | 'ALL';
  completionCode?: string;
  ageMin?: number;
  ageMax?: number;
}

export interface ProlificStudyResponse {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  status: string; // 'UNPUBLISHED' | 'ACTIVE' | 'COMPLETED' | 'PAUSED'
  totalAvailablePlaces: number;
  placesTaken: number;
  reward: number;
  averageTimeTaken?: number;
  createdAt: string;
  publishedAt?: string;
}

export class ProlificService {
  private static getApiToken(): string | null {
    return process.env.PROLIFIC_API_TOKEN || null;
  }

  private static getDefaultWorkspaceId(): string {
    return process.env.PROLIFIC_DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_ID || '6aeb567b587ae49b75bc6305';
  }

  private static getDefaultProjectId(): string {
    return process.env.PROLIFIC_DEFAULT_PROJECT_ID || '6aeb567c587ae49b75bc6309';
  }

  /**
   * Test current connection and return researcher account info
   */
  static async getAccountDetails() {
    const token = this.getApiToken();
    if (!token) {
      return { success: false, error: 'PROLIFIC_API_TOKEN is not configured in server environment.' };
    }

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${PROLIFIC_API_BASE}/users/me/`, {
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Token ${token}`,
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        cache: 'no-store',
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errText = await res.text();
        return { success: false, error: `Prolific API returned ${res.status}: ${errText}` };
      }

      const data = await res.json();
      return {
        success: true,
        account: {
          id: data.id,
          name: data.name,
          email: data.email,
          balance: data.balance / 100, // converted from pence
          availableBalance: data.available_balance / 100,
          currency: data.currency_code,
          feesPercentage: data.fees_percentage,
        },
      };
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      return { success: false, error: `Network error connecting to Prolific: ${msg}` };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Programmatically create a Draft study on Prolific
   */
  static async createStudy(input: ProlificStudyInput): Promise<{
    success: boolean;
    study?: ProlificStudyResponse;
    error?: string;
  }> {
    const token = this.getApiToken();
    if (!token) {
      return { success: false, error: 'PROLIFIC_API_TOKEN is not configured.' };
    }

    const projectId = this.getDefaultProjectId();
    const completionCode = input.completionCode || 'SPF_SURVEY_VERIFIED';
    const estimatedMins = input.estimatedCompletionTimeMinutes || 3;
    // Base reward: £0.50 (50p) for 3 mins corresponds to £10.00/hr, well above Prolific's £6.00/hr baseline
    const rewardPence = input.rewardPence || Math.max(45, estimatedMins * 17);

    // Build filters for location if specified
    const filters: any[] = [];
    if (input.targetCountryCode === 'IE') {
      filters.push({
        filter_id: 'current_country_of_residence',
        selected_values: ['IE'],
      });
    } else if (input.targetCountryCode === 'GB') {
      filters.push({
        filter_id: 'current_country_of_residence',
        selected_values: ['GB'],
      });
    }

    if (input.ageMin || input.ageMax) {
      filters.push({
        filter_id: 'age',
        selected_range: {
          min: input.ageMin || 18,
          max: input.ageMax || 75,
        },
      });
    }

    const payload = {
      project: projectId,
      name: input.name,
      internal_name: `SPF Boost: ${input.name}`,
      description: input.description,
      external_study_url: input.externalStudyUrl,
      prolific_id_option: 'url_parameters',
      total_available_places: input.totalAvailablePlaces,
      estimated_completion_time: estimatedMins,
      reward: rewardPence,
      completion_codes: [
        {
          code: completionCode,
          code_type: 'completed',
          action: 'AUTOMATICALLY_APPROVE',
        },
      ],
      filters: filters.length > 0 ? filters : undefined,
    };

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${PROLIFIC_API_BASE}/projects/${projectId}/studies/`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Token ${token}`,
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errText = await res.text();
        return { success: false, error: `Prolific study creation failed (${res.status}): ${errText}` };
      }

      const data = await res.json();
      return {
        success: true,
        study: {
          id: data.id,
          name: data.name,
          status: data.status,
          totalAvailablePlaces: data.total_available_places,
          placesTaken: data.places_taken || 0,
          reward: data.reward,
          createdAt: data.created_at,
        },
      };
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      return { success: false, error: `Failed to create Prolific study: ${msg}` };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Publish a draft study to begin collecting responses immediately
   */
  static async publishStudy(studyId: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
    const token = this.getApiToken();
    if (!token) return { success: false, error: 'PROLIFIC_API_TOKEN is not configured.' };

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${PROLIFIC_API_BASE}/studies/${studyId}/transition/`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Token ${token}`,
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ action: 'PUBLISH' }),
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errText = await res.text();
        return { success: false, error: `Failed to publish study (${res.status}): ${errText}` };
      }

      return { success: true };
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      return { success: false, error: `Network error publishing study: ${msg}` };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Fetch study progress (places taken, status)
   */
  static async getStudyStatus(studyId: string): Promise<{
    success: boolean;
    study?: ProlificStudyResponse;
    error?: string;
  }> {
    const token = this.getApiToken();
    if (!token) return { success: false, error: 'PROLIFIC_API_TOKEN is not configured.' };

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${PROLIFIC_API_BASE}/studies/${studyId}/`, {
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Token ${token}`,
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        cache: 'no-store',
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errText = await res.text();
        return { success: false, error: `Failed to fetch study status (${res.status}): ${errText}` };
      }

      const data = await res.json();
      return {
        success: true,
        study: {
          id: data.id,
          name: data.name,
          status: data.status,
          totalAvailablePlaces: data.total_available_places,
          placesTaken: data.places_taken || 0,
          reward: data.reward,
          averageTimeTaken: data.average_time_taken,
          createdAt: data.created_at,
          publishedAt: data.published_at,
        },
      };
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      return { success: false, error: `Error checking study status: ${msg}` };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Check real-time participant availability for demographic criteria before purchase
   */
  static async checkEligibilityCount(params: {
    countryCode?: 'IE' | 'GB' | 'US' | 'ALL';
    ageMin?: number;
    ageMax?: number;
    gender?: 'ANY' | 'FEMALE' | 'MALE';
    employmentStatus?: 'ANY' | 'FULL_TIME' | 'PART_TIME' | 'UNEMPLOYED';
  }): Promise<{ success: boolean; count?: number; error?: string }> {
    const token = this.getApiToken();
    if (!token) return { success: false, error: 'PROLIFIC_API_TOKEN is not configured.' };

    const workspaceId = this.getDefaultWorkspaceId();
    const filters: any[] = [];

    // Country Filter (current-country-of-residence: "0" = UK, "1" = US, "2" = Ireland)
    if (params.countryCode === 'IE') {
      filters.push({
        filter_id: 'current-country-of-residence',
        selected_values: ['2'],
      });
    } else if (params.countryCode === 'GB') {
      filters.push({
        filter_id: 'current-country-of-residence',
        selected_values: ['0'],
      });
    } else if (params.countryCode === 'US') {
      filters.push({
        filter_id: 'current-country-of-residence',
        selected_values: ['1'],
      });
    } else if (params.countryCode === 'ALL') {
      filters.push({
        filter_id: 'current-country-of-residence',
        selected_values: ['0', '2'], // UK + Ireland
      });
    }

    // Age Filter (range)
    if (params.ageMin || params.ageMax) {
      filters.push({
        filter_id: 'age',
        selected_range: {
          lower: Math.max(18, params.ageMin || 18),
          upper: Math.min(100, params.ageMax || 99),
        },
      });
    }

    // Sex Filter ("0" = Male, "1" = Female)
    if (params.gender === 'FEMALE') {
      filters.push({
        filter_id: 'sex',
        selected_values: ['1'],
      });
    } else if (params.gender === 'MALE') {
      filters.push({
        filter_id: 'sex',
        selected_values: ['0'],
      });
    }

    // Employment Status Filter ("0" = Full-Time, "1" = Part-Time, "3" = Unemployed)
    if (params.employmentStatus === 'FULL_TIME') {
      filters.push({
        filter_id: 'employment-status',
        selected_values: ['0'],
      });
    } else if (params.employmentStatus === 'PART_TIME') {
      filters.push({
        filter_id: 'employment-status',
        selected_values: ['1'],
      });
    }

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${PROLIFIC_API_BASE}/eligibility-count/`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Token ${token}`,
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          workspace_id: workspaceId,
          filters,
        }),
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errText = await res.text();
        return { success: false, error: `Eligibility API error (${res.status}): ${errText}` };
      }

      const data = await res.json();
      return { success: true, count: typeof data.count === 'number' ? data.count : 0 };
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      return { success: false, error: `Failed to calculate eligibility: ${msg}` };
    }
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// 6. REALISTIC SEEDED STARTUP PLAN BUILDER (VOICE CALIBRATED TO L1–L4)
// ============================================================================

function adaptTextToComprehensionVoice(
  level: ComprehensionLevelId,
  variants: {
    L1: string;
    L2: string;
    L3: string;
    L4: string;
  }
): string {
  switch (level) {
    case 'L1_EVERYDAY':
      return variants.L1;
    case 'L2_PRACTICAL_SMB':
      return variants.L2;
    case 'L3_STARTUP_FLUENT':
      return variants.L3;
    case 'L4_EXPERT_ASSESSOR':
      return variants.L4;
  }
}

export function buildSeededPersonaStartupPlan(
  personaId: PersonaArchetypeId,
  comprehensionId: ComprehensionLevelId
): ActiveStartupPlan {
  const persona =
    PERSONA_ARCHETYPES.find((p) => p.id === personaId) || PERSONA_ARCHETYPES[0];
  const levelInfo =
    COMPREHENSION_LEVELS.find((l) => l.id === comprehensionId) ||
    COMPREHENSION_LEVELS[0];

  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
  const currency = persona.baseCurrency;
  const isFood = persona.id === 'AOIFE_IE_FOOD';
  const isUkSaas = persona.id === 'LIAM_UK_SAAS';
  const isDeepTech = persona.id === 'PRIYA_SAM_UK_DEEPTECH';
  const isHybrid = persona.id === 'MARCO_IE_HYBRID';

  const brainDumpText = adaptTextToComprehensionVoice(comprehensionId, {
    L1: `${persona.oneLinerSummary} I want to build this because I see people struggling with this every week and there isn't a simple, honest option that just works without costing a fortune.`,
    L2: `${persona.oneLinerSummary} My goal over the next 12 months is to get the product tested with real paying customers in ${persona.regionOrCounty}, cover my monthly bills, and make sure the unit profit works after paying suppliers and tax.`,
    L3: `${persona.oneLinerSummary} We are targeting an underserved beachhead in ${persona.hqCountryCode} with a lean V1, validating willingness-to-pay through direct customer interviews and pre-orders before scaling distribution.`,
    L4: `${persona.oneLinerSummary} Strategic commercial objective: establish defensible domestic traction in ${persona.regionOrCounty} (${persona.hqCountryCode}) within Q1–Q2 while structuring R&D and operational capacity for international export compliance and non-dilutive grant co-funding.`,
  });

  const coreProblem = adaptTextToComprehensionVoice(comprehensionId, {
    L1: isFood
      ? 'People want a healthy afternoon energy drink without 8 spoons of sugar or fake chemicals, but current healthy drinks taste terrible.'
      : isUkSaas
        ? 'Small builders waste Friday afternoons chasing plumbers and electricians on WhatsApp for expired insurance papers.'
        : 'Customers are stuck doing things the slow, expensive way because existing options are too complicated.',
    L2: `Customers in ${persona.regionOrCounty} currently waste hours and money on clunky workarounds because existing suppliers ignore smaller buyers or charge hidden fees.`,
    L3: `High-friction status quo workflow causing measurable weekly time loss and compliance/margin leakage for our target beachhead segment in ${persona.hqCountryCode}.`,
    L4: `Systemic operational inefficiency and regulatory/margin exposure across the target ${persona.industryCategory} value chain, where incumbent legacy solutions fail to serve SMEs cost-effectively.`,
  });

  const proposedSolution = adaptTextToComprehensionVoice(comprehensionId, {
    L1: `${persona.businessTitle}: ${persona.oneLinerSummary}`,
    L2: `A straightforward, reliable solution (${persona.businessTitle}) that customers can buy and start using immediately with clear upfront pricing in ${currency}.`,
    L3: `${persona.businessTitle} delivers a focused V1 product vehicle with automated onboarding, clear unit economics, and low switching friction.`,
    L4: `${persona.businessTitle}: A modular, export-ready ${persona.industryCategory} solution engineered for high gross margin retention, low customer acquisition payback, and full statutory compliance in ${persona.hqCountryCode}.`,
  });

  const baseUnitPriceNet = isFood
    ? 28
    : isUkSaas
      ? 99
      : isDeepTech
        ? 450
        : isHybrid
          ? 65
          : 180;

  const unitCogs = isFood
    ? 9.5
    : isUkSaas
      ? 6.0
      : isDeepTech
        ? 110.0
        : isHybrid
          ? 14.0
          : 45.0;

  const monthlyPayrollY1 = isFood
    ? 2400
    : isUkSaas
      ? 2200
      : isDeepTech
        ? 5500
        : isHybrid
          ? 2600
          : 2000;

  const vatRate = persona.hqCountryCode === 'GB' ? 20 : 23;

  return {
    id: `plan-persona-${persona.id.toLowerCase()}-${comprehensionId.toLowerCase()}`,
    title: `[${levelInfo.shortBadge}] ${persona.businessTitle}`,
    oneLinerSummary: persona.oneLinerSummary,
    industryCategory: persona.industryCategory,
    hqCountryCode: persona.hqCountryCode,
    baseCurrency: persona.baseCurrency,
    targetMarketsArray:
      persona.id === 'SARAH_IE_STUCK'
        ? [persona.hqCountryCode]
        : [persona.hqCountryCode, 'GB', 'EU'],
    exportPotential:
      persona.id === 'SARAH_IE_STUCK'
        ? 'DOMESTIC_ONLY'
        : 'EXPORTING_INTERNATIONALLY',
    currentModuleStep: 'MOD_A_STEP_8',
    brainDumpText,
    founderMotivation: {
      primaryMotivation: isHybrid ? 'OTHER' : 'LEAVE_JOB',
      otherMotivationText: isHybrid
        ? 'Build a profitable regional trade network that combines digital booking with physical locker depots'
        : undefined,
      weeklyHoursAvailable: isDeepTech ? '40_PLUS_HRS' : '15_TO_25_HRS',
      twelveMonthSuccessVision: adaptTextToComprehensionVoice(comprehensionId, {
        L1: `Have 50 regular paying customers, cover my own wages every month, and not be stressed about bills.`,
        L2: `Reach steady monthly profit in ${persona.regionOrCounty}, prove repeat orders, and secure matching startup support without taking bad debt.`,
        L3: `Reach €8k–€12k MRR / monthly turnover with validated unit economics, <5% churn, and grant-backed product milestones completed.`,
        L4: `Achieve cashflow-positive unit breakeven across Year 1 targets with audited gross margins >65% and export readiness for Enterprise Ireland / Innovate UK progression.`,
      }),
    },
    teamAndBudget: {
      teamStructureType:
        persona.teamStructure === 'CO_FOUNDERS'
          ? 'COFOUNDER_TEAM'
          : persona.teamStructure === 'LOOKING_FOR_COFOUNDER'
            ? 'SEEKING_COFOUNDER'
            : 'SOLO_FOUNDER',
      skillCoverage: isFood || isUkSaas ? 'BUILD_IN_HOUSE' : 'PARTIAL_SKILLS',
      startingBudgetBracket: isDeepTech ? 'OVER_25K' : '1K_TO_5K',
      teamAndFundingNotes: `Seeded via Admin Persona Lab (${persona.name} • ${levelInfo.label}).`,
    },
    founderRealityCheck: {
      industryConnection: 'LIVED_IT_INSIDER',
      personalIncomeUrgency: 'MEDIUM_6_TO_12M',
      dealbreakers: isUkSaas ? ['NO_PHYSICAL_PREMISES'] : ['NO_BIG_TEAM'],
      growthTradeoff: 'NON_DILUTIVE_GRANTS',
      biggestWorryPreset: isHybrid ? 'OTHER' : 'FINDING_FIRST_10',
      biggestWorryNotes: adaptTextToComprehensionVoice(comprehensionId, {
        L1: 'Making sure people actually pay real money and don’t just say "nice idea".',
        L2: 'Keeping upfront equipment and setup costs low until the first 20 customers pay on time.',
        L3: 'Validating repeatable customer acquisition before committing to fixed monthly overheads.',
        L4: 'Managing working capital cashflow troughs between supplier/R&D outlay, debtor collection days, and retrospective grant drawdowns.',
      }),
    },
    conceptCanvas: {
      coreProblem,
      targetCustomer: `${persona.regionOrCounty} & ${persona.hqCountryCode} early adopters for ${persona.businessTitle}`,
      proposedSolution,
      unfairAdvantage: `${persona.name} — direct insider experience + rapid local customer access in ${persona.regionOrCounty}.`,
      revenueAndGrantFit: `Priced at ${currency} ${baseUnitPriceNet} net per unit/month with ${persona.hqCountryCode} grant alignment.`,
      lastSynthesizedAt: nowIso,
      aiEngineUsed: 'smart-synthesizer',
    },
    moduleBData: {
      beachhead: {
        buyerType: isHybrid
          ? 'OTHER'
          : isFood
            ? 'B2C_CONSUMERS'
            : 'B2B_BUSINESSES',
        otherBuyerModelText: isHybrid
          ? 'Hybrid B2B Tradespeople + Local Hardware Locker Host Partners'
          : undefined,
        beachheadSegment: `Independent customers and businesses in ${persona.regionOrCounty} needing ${persona.businessTitle}`,
        endUserVsDecisionMaker: 'SAME_PERSON',
        decisionMakerRole: 'Owner / Founder / Direct Buyer',
        buyingTriggerPreset: 'LOSING_MONEY_WASTE',
        buyingTriggerNotes: coreProblem,
        targetMarketsArray: [persona.hqCountryCode, 'GB'],
        lastSavedAt: nowIso,

export function generateAntigravityFixPromptForFinding(
  finding: PersonaAuditFinding,
  persona: PersonaArchetypeDefinition,
  comprehension: ComprehensionLevelDefinition
): string {
  const viewportMeta =
    finding.viewport === 'ALL_VIEWPORTS'
      ? 'All Viewports (Mobile 375px, Tablet 768px, Laptop 1366px)'
      : AUDIT_VIEWPORTS.find((v) => v.id === finding.viewport)?.label ||
        finding.viewport;

  const lines: string[] = [
    `### Antigravity UX & Formatting Fix Request — ${finding.moduleShortName} (${finding.moduleCode})`,
    `- **Target File:** \`${finding.targetFilePath}\``,
    `- **Step / Section:** ${finding.stepLabel}`,
    `- **Issue Category:** \`${finding.category}\` (\`${finding.severity}\`)`,
    `- **Discovered By Persona:** ${persona.name} (${persona.shortLabel})`,
    `- **Comprehension / Intelligence Lever:** ${comprehension.label}`,
    `- **Target Viewport:** ${viewportMeta}`,
    ``,
    `#### 1. Founder Persona Experience (Why This Needs Fixing)`,
    `> "${finding.personaFirstPersonQuote}"`,
    ``,
    `#### 2. Technical & UX Audit Finding`,
    `${finding.technicalFinding}`,
    ``,
    `#### 3. Required Code & Copy Changes`,
    `${finding.recommendedFix}`,
  ];

  if (finding.suggestedPlainEnglishCopy) {
    lines.push(
      ``,
      `#### 4. Suggested Plain-English Copy / Micro-Coaching Upgrade (${comprehension.shortBadge})`,
      `\`\`\`text`,
      finding.suggestedPlainEnglishCopy,
      `\`\`\``
    );
  }

  lines.push(
    ``,
    `#### 5. GEMINI.md Verification Invariants`,
    `- Preserve Desktop-first layout (\`sm:\` / \`lg:\` breakpoints) while fixing \`Mobile (375px)\`, \`Tablet (768px)\`, and \`Laptop (1366px)\` responsiveness.`,
    `- Keep Collapsible Step header typography strict (\`text-sm font-bold text-slate-900\` when collapsed; \`text-base font-bold text-slate-900\` when expanded; \`min-w-0 flex-1\` on title wrapper; \`shrink-0\` on badges/buttons).`,
    `- Ensure every tile/pill selector group includes an \`"OTHER"\` option with inline custom text persistence.`,
    `- Run \`npx tsc --noEmit\` after editing to confirm zero TypeScript errors.`
  );

  return lines.join('\n');
}

export function generateAntigravityBatchFixPrompt(params: {
  report: PersonaAuditReport;
  moduleFilter?: ModuleCode | 'ALL';
  categoryFilter?: AuditIssueCategory | 'ALL';
}): string {
  const { report, moduleFilter = 'ALL', categoryFilter = 'ALL' } = params;
  const filteredFindings = report.findings.filter((f) => {
    if (moduleFilter !== 'ALL' && f.moduleCode !== moduleFilter) return false;
    if (categoryFilter !== 'ALL' && f.category !== categoryFilter) return false;
    return true;
  });

  const scopeTitle =
    moduleFilter === 'ALL'
      ? 'All Audited Modules (A–L)'
      : `${moduleFilter}`;

  const lines: string[] = [
    `# Antigravity Batch UX, Comprehension & Viewport Fix Prompt — ${scopeTitle}`,
    `- **Persona Lens:** ${report.persona.name} (${report.persona.shortLabel} — ${report.persona.industryCategory})`,
    `- **Comprehension / Intelligence Level:** ${report.comprehension.label}`,
    `- **Viewports Checked:** Mobile (375×812), Tablet (768×1024), Laptop (1366×768)`,
    `- **Total Issues to Resolve:** ${filteredFindings.length}`,
    ``,
    `Please apply the following targeted UX, plain-English copy, and responsive formatting fixes across the workspace components:`,
    ``,
  ];

  filteredFindings.forEach((f, idx) => {
    lines.push(
      `## ${idx + 1}. [${f.severity}] ${f.moduleShortName} (${f.stepLabel}) — ${f.title}`,
      `- **File:** \`${f.targetFilePath}\``,
      `- **Category:** \`${f.category}\` | **Viewport:** \`${f.viewport}\` | **Comprehension:** \`${f.comprehensionLevel}\``,
      `- **Founder Feedback:** *"${f.personaFirstPersonQuote}"*`,
      `- **Technical Issue:** ${f.technicalFinding}`,
      `- **Actionable Fix:** ${f.recommendedFix}`
    );
    if (f.suggestedPlainEnglishCopy) {
      lines.push(`- **Suggested Plain-English Copy:** \`${f.suggestedPlainEnglishCopy}\``);
    }
    lines.push(``);
  });

  lines.push(
    `---`,
    `### Final Verification Checklist`,
    `1. Follow all \`GEMINI.md\` Section 5 (Mobile/Tablet/Laptop Responsive UX) and Section 6 (Collapsible Step + Final Overview Brief) invariants.`,
    `2. Do not break any unfinished/scaffold modules—keep module handoffs defensive with optional chaining.`,
    `3. Run \`npx tsc --noEmit\` to verify zero TypeScript errors across the monorepo.`
  );

  return lines.join('\n');
}

    ``,

    `   - Manage \`const [openStep, setOpenStep] = useState<number | 'ALL'>(...)\` with an \`Expand All Steps\` / \`Focus Step-by-Step\` button in the top dark-indigo header card.`,

    `5. **Verification:** Run \`npx tsc --noEmit\` when finished.`,
  ].join('\n');
}
