import type {
  entitlementPlanTypeEnum,
  moduleCodeEnum,
} from '@/db/schema';

export type EntitlementPlanType =
  (typeof entitlementPlanTypeEnum.enumValues)[number];
export type ModuleCode = (typeof moduleCodeEnum.enumValues)[number];

export interface EntitlementSnapshot {
  userId: string;
  planType: EntitlementPlanType;
  stackedCodesCount: number;
  maxStartupPlans: number;
  maxSeatsPerPlan: number;
  monthlyAiCreditsLimit: number;
  aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: number;
  whiteLabelExportEnabled: boolean;
  customApiKeyEncrypted?: string | null;
  accessExpiresAt?: Date | null;
  isVaultReadonly: boolean;
}

export type PaywallFeature =
  | 'MODULE_A_IDEATION'
  | 'MODULE_B_THROUGH_G'
  | 'MODULE_B_THROUGH_I'
  | 'PUBLIC_SURVEY_PUBLISH'
  | 'MULTI_PLAN_CREATE'
  | 'CLONE_AND_PIVOT'
  | 'IDEA_COMPARATOR'
  | 'COFOUNDER_INVITE'
  | 'COFOUNDER_ALIGNMENT_INTERVIEW'
  | 'GRANT_MATCHER'
  | 'DOCUMENT_EXPORT'
  | 'WHITE_LABEL_EXPORT'
  | 'BYOK_API_KEY';

export interface EntitlementCheckResult {
  allowed: boolean;
  reason?: string;
  upgradeRequired?: 'SIX_MONTH_SOLO' | 'SIX_MONTH_COFOUNDER' | 'APPSUMO_STACK' | 'RENEW_VAULT';
  currentLimit?: number;
}

/**
 * Calculates the exact AppSumo Lifetime Deal (LTD) tier entitlements
 * based on how many voucher codes a user has stacked (1, 2, or 3+).
 */
export function calculateAppSumoTierLimits(stackedCodesCount: number): {
  tierName: string;
  stackedCodesCount: number;
  maxStartupPlans: number;
  maxSeatsPerPlan: number;
  monthlyAiCreditsLimit: number;
  whiteLabelExportEnabled: boolean;
  byokAllowed: boolean;
} {
  const count = Math.max(1, stackedCodesCount);

  if (count === 1) {
    return {
      tierName: 'Lifetime Tier 1 — Solo Founder',
      stackedCodesCount: 1,
      maxStartupPlans: 1,
      maxSeatsPerPlan: 1,
      monthlyAiCreditsLimit: 150,
      whiteLabelExportEnabled: false,
      byokAllowed: false,
    };
  }

  if (count === 2) {
    return {
      tierName: 'Lifetime Tier 2 — Co-Founder & Pivot Tier',
      stackedCodesCount: 2,
      maxStartupPlans: 3,
      maxSeatsPerPlan: 3,
      monthlyAiCreditsLimit: 450,
      whiteLabelExportEnabled: false,
      byokAllowed: false,
    };
  }

  // 3+ Codes (Tier 3: Serial Entrepreneur / Advisor Tier)
  return {
    tierName: `Lifetime Tier 3 — Serial Entrepreneur (${count} Codes)`,
    stackedCodesCount: count,
    maxStartupPlans: count >= 5 ? 25 : 10,
    maxSeatsPerPlan: 5,
    monthlyAiCreditsLimit: 1500,
    whiteLabelExportEnabled: true,
    byokAllowed: true,
  };
}

/**
 * Calculates default entitlements for Direct 6-Month Passes and Institutional Cohort Passes.
 */
export function calculatePassLimits(
  planType: 'FREE_HOOK' | 'SIX_MONTH_SOLO' | 'SIX_MONTH_COFOUNDER' | 'COHORT_PASS',
  durationMonths = 6
) {
  const now = new Date();
  const expiresAt = new Date(now);
  expiresAt.setMonth(expiresAt.getMonth() + durationMonths);

  switch (planType) {
    case 'FREE_HOOK':
      return {
        planType: 'FREE_HOOK' as const,
        maxStartupPlans: 1,
        maxSeatsPerPlan: 1,
        monthlyAiCreditsLimit: 50,
        whiteLabelExportEnabled: false,
        accessExpiresAt: null,
      };
    case 'SIX_MONTH_SOLO':
      return {
        planType: 'SIX_MONTH_SOLO' as const,
        maxStartupPlans: 1,
        maxSeatsPerPlan: 1,
        monthlyAiCreditsLimit: 250,
        whiteLabelExportEnabled: false,
        accessExpiresAt: expiresAt,
      };
    case 'SIX_MONTH_COFOUNDER':
    case 'COHORT_PASS':
      return {
        planType,
        maxStartupPlans: 3,
        maxSeatsPerPlan: 3,
        monthlyAiCreditsLimit: 500,
        whiteLabelExportEnabled: false,
        accessExpiresAt: expiresAt,
      };
  }
}

/**
 * Checks whether a time-limited pass (6-Month Pass or Cohort Pass) has expired
 * and should drop into Read-Only "Vault Mode".
 */
export function isEntitlementInVaultMode(
  entitlement: Pick<
    EntitlementSnapshot,
    'planType' | 'accessExpiresAt' | 'isVaultReadonly'
  >,
  referenceDate: Date = new Date()
): boolean {
  if (entitlement.isVaultReadonly) {
    return true;
  }
  if (entitlement.planType === 'APPSUMO_LTD' || entitlement.planType === 'FREE_HOOK') {
    return false;
  }
  if (
    entitlement.accessExpiresAt &&
    entitlement.accessExpiresAt.getTime() < referenceDate.getTime()
  ) {
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

/**
 * Checks if a user can access a specific Startup Preflight Module (MOD_A through MOD_I).
 * FREE_HOOK has full access to Module A (Steps 1-8), and triggers the paywall on Modules B-I.
 */
export function canAccessModule(
  entitlement: EntitlementSnapshot,
  moduleCode: ModuleCode
): EntitlementCheckResult {
  if (moduleCode === 'MOD_A_IDEATION') {
    return { allowed: true };
  }

  if (entitlement.planType === 'FREE_HOOK') {
    return {
      allowed: false,
      reason:
        'Module A (Ideation) is free forever. Upgrade to a 6-Month Launch Pass or redeem a Cohort/Partner voucher code to unlock Modules B–L, Hosted Customer Surveys & Waitlist, Product Build Architecture, Financial Builder, and Grant Matcher.',
      upgradeRequired: 'SIX_MONTH_SOLO',
    };
  }

  return { allowed: true };
}

/**
 * Checks if the user can create an additional Startup Plan or Clone/Pivot an existing plan.
 */
export function canCreateStartupPlan(
  entitlement: EntitlementSnapshot,
  currentActivePlansCount: number
): EntitlementCheckResult {
  if (isEntitlementInVaultMode(entitlement)) {
    return {
      allowed: false,
      reason:
        'Your workspace is currently in Read-Only Vault Mode. Renew your pass or activate the $9/mo Keep-Warm extension to create or edit plans.',
      upgradeRequired: 'RENEW_VAULT',
      currentLimit: entitlement.maxStartupPlans,
    };
  }

  if (currentActivePlansCount >= entitlement.maxStartupPlans) {
    if (entitlement.planType === 'FREE_HOOK') {
      return {
        allowed: false,
        reason:
          'Free accounts include 1 Startup Plan. Upgrade to the Co-Founder & Pivot Pass to manage up to 3 Startup Plans and use Clone & Pivot.',
        upgradeRequired: 'SIX_MONTH_COFOUNDER',
        currentLimit: entitlement.maxStartupPlans,
      };
    }

    if (entitlement.planType === 'APPSUMO_LTD') {
      return {
        allowed: false,
        reason: `You have reached your limit of ${entitlement.maxStartupPlans} active Startup Plan(s). Stack an additional voucher code in Settings to unlock up to ${
          entitlement.stackedCodesCount === 1 ? 3 : 10
        } plans!`,
        upgradeRequired: 'APPSUMO_STACK',
        currentLimit: entitlement.maxStartupPlans,
      };
    }

    return {
      allowed: false,
      reason: `You have reached your plan limit (${entitlement.maxStartupPlans} active Startup Plans). Upgrade to the Co-Founder & Pivot Pass to unlock Multi-Plan workspaces.`,
      upgradeRequired: 'SIX_MONTH_COFOUNDER',
      currentLimit: entitlement.maxStartupPlans,
    };
  }

  return { allowed: true, currentLimit: entitlement.maxStartupPlans };
}

/**
 * Checks if the user can invite another collaborator / co-founder to a specific Startup Plan,
 * and whether the Blind-Reveal Co-Founder Alignment Interview (Module C Step 4) is unlocked.
 */
export function canInviteCollaborator(
  entitlement: EntitlementSnapshot,
  currentPlanSeatsUsed: number
): EntitlementCheckResult {
  if (isEntitlementInVaultMode(entitlement)) {
    return {
      allowed: false,
      reason: 'Workspace is in Read-Only Vault Mode. Renew your pass to invite collaborators.',
      upgradeRequired: 'RENEW_VAULT',
      currentLimit: entitlement.maxSeatsPerPlan,
    };
  }

  if (entitlement.maxSeatsPerPlan <= 1) {
    return {
      allowed: false,
      reason:
        entitlement.planType === 'APPSUMO_LTD'
          ? 'Lifetime Tier 1 includes 1 founder seat. Stack a 2nd voucher code to invite up to 3 Co-Founders and unlock the Blind-Reveal Co-Founder Alignment Interview.'
          : 'Solo plans include 1 founder seat. Upgrade to the Co-Founder & Pivot Pass to invite up to 3 Co-Founders and unlock the Blind-Reveal Co-Founder Alignment Interview.',
      upgradeRequired:
        entitlement.planType === 'APPSUMO_LTD'
          ? 'APPSUMO_STACK'
          : 'SIX_MONTH_COFOUNDER',
      currentLimit: entitlement.maxSeatsPerPlan,
    };
  }

  if (currentPlanSeatsUsed >= entitlement.maxSeatsPerPlan) {
    return {
      allowed: false,
      reason: `This plan has reached its maximum of ${entitlement.maxSeatsPerPlan} team seats.`,
      upgradeRequired:
        entitlement.planType === 'APPSUMO_LTD'
          ? 'APPSUMO_STACK'
          : 'SIX_MONTH_COFOUNDER',
      currentLimit: entitlement.maxSeatsPerPlan,
    };
  }

  return { allowed: true, currentLimit: entitlement.maxSeatsPerPlan };
}

/**
 * Checks if the user has available AI credits this month (or a valid BYOK API key configured).
 */
export function canConsumeAiCredits(
  entitlement: EntitlementSnapshot,
  estimatedCreditsCost = 1
): EntitlementCheckResult & { useByok: boolean; remainingCredits: number } {
  if (isEntitlementInVaultMode(entitlement)) {
    return {
      allowed: false,
      useByok: false,
      remainingCredits: 0,
      reason:
        'Your pass has expired and your workspace is in Read-Only Vault Mode. Renew your pass to re-enable Ask Preflight AI and editing.',
      upgradeRequired: 'RENEW_VAULT',
    };
  }

  const trimmedByok = entitlement.customApiKeyEncrypted?.trim() || '';
  const hasByok = Boolean(
    /^AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{31,}$/.test(trimmedByok) &&
      entitlement.planType === 'APPSUMO_LTD' &&
      entitlement.stackedCodesCount >= 3
  );

  if (hasByok) {
    return {
      allowed: true,
      useByok: true,
      remainingCredits: Math.max(
        0,
        entitlement.monthlyAiCreditsLimit - entitlement.aiCreditsUsedThisMonth
      ),
    };
  }

  const remaining =
    entitlement.monthlyAiCreditsLimit - entitlement.aiCreditsUsedThisMonth;

  if (remaining < estimatedCreditsCost) {
    return {
      allowed: false,
      useByok: false,
      remainingCredits: Math.max(0, remaining),
      reason:
        entitlement.planType === 'APPSUMO_LTD'
          ? 'You have used all of your monthly Preflight AI Credits. Stack an additional AppSumo code or connect your own Gemini API key (BYOK on Tier 3).'
          : 'You have used all of your monthly Preflight AI Credits. Upgrade your pass tier to increase your monthly AI allowance.',
      upgradeRequired:
        entitlement.planType === 'APPSUMO_LTD'
          ? 'APPSUMO_STACK'
          : 'SIX_MONTH_COFOUNDER',
    };
  }

  return {
    allowed: true,
    useByok: false,
    remainingCredits: remaining,
  };
}

/**
 * Unified feature gate helper for UI components and Server Actions.
 */
export function checkFeatureEntitlement(
  entitlement: EntitlementSnapshot,
  feature: PaywallFeature,
  context?: {
    currentPlansCount?: number;
    currentSeatsCount?: number;
  }
): EntitlementCheckResult {
  switch (feature) {
    case 'MODULE_A_IDEATION':
      return { allowed: true };

    case 'MODULE_B_THROUGH_G':
    case 'MODULE_B_THROUGH_I':
    case 'PUBLIC_SURVEY_PUBLISH':
    case 'GRANT_MATCHER':
    case 'DOCUMENT_EXPORT':
      return canAccessModule(entitlement, 'MOD_B_MARKET');

    case 'MULTI_PLAN_CREATE':
    case 'CLONE_AND_PIVOT':
      return canCreateStartupPlan(
        entitlement,
        context?.currentPlansCount ?? 1
      );

    case 'IDEA_COMPARATOR':
      if (entitlement.maxStartupPlans < 2) {
        return {
          allowed: false,
          reason:
            entitlement.planType === 'APPSUMO_LTD'
              ? 'The Multi-Plan Idea Comparator requires Lifetime Tier 2+ (2+ Stacked Codes).'
              : 'The Multi-Plan Idea Comparator requires a Multi-Plan tier (Co-Founder & Pivot Pass).',
          upgradeRequired:
            entitlement.planType === 'APPSUMO_LTD'
              ? 'APPSUMO_STACK'
              : 'SIX_MONTH_COFOUNDER',
        };
      }
      return { allowed: true };

    case 'COFOUNDER_INVITE':
    case 'COFOUNDER_ALIGNMENT_INTERVIEW':
      return canInviteCollaborator(
        entitlement,
        context?.currentSeatsCount ?? 1
      );

    case 'WHITE_LABEL_EXPORT':
      if (!entitlement.whiteLabelExportEnabled) {
        return {
          allowed: false,
          reason:
            entitlement.planType === 'APPSUMO_LTD'
              ? 'Removing the "Powered by Startup Preflight" watermark requires Lifetime Tier 3 (3+ Stacked Codes).'
              : 'Removing the "Powered by Startup Preflight" watermark requires an Agency / White-Label tier.',
          upgradeRequired:
            entitlement.planType === 'APPSUMO_LTD'
              ? 'APPSUMO_STACK'
              : 'SIX_MONTH_COFOUNDER',
        };
      }
      return { allowed: true };

    case 'BYOK_API_KEY':
      if (
        entitlement.planType !== 'APPSUMO_LTD' ||
        entitlement.stackedCodesCount < 3
      ) {
        return {
          allowed: false,
          reason:
            entitlement.planType === 'APPSUMO_LTD'
              ? 'Bring Your Own API Key (BYOK) is unlocked on Lifetime Tier 3 (3+ Stacked Codes).'
              : 'Bring Your Own API Key (BYOK) requires an Enterprise / Advisor tier.',
          upgradeRequired:
            entitlement.planType === 'APPSUMO_LTD'
              ? 'APPSUMO_STACK'
              : 'SIX_MONTH_COFOUNDER',
        };
      }
      return { allowed: true };
  }
}

/**
 * Returns a human-friendly display name for an internal entitlement planType.
 * Replaces developer codes like 'FREE_HOOK' with user-friendly names like 'Free Plan'.
 */
export function getPlanTypeDisplayName(
  planType: string | null | undefined,
  options?: {
    stackedCodesCount?: number;
    isVaultReadonly?: boolean;
    short?: boolean;
  }
): string {
  if (options?.isVaultReadonly) {
    return options.short ? 'Read-Only' : 'Vault (Read-Only)';
  }

  switch (planType) {
    case 'FREE_HOOK':
      return options?.short ? 'Free' : 'Free Plan';
    case 'SIX_MONTH_SOLO':
      return options?.short ? 'Solo' : 'Solo Pass';
    case 'SIX_MONTH_COFOUNDER':
      return options?.short ? 'Co-Founder' : 'Co-Founder Pass';
    case 'APPSUMO_LTD':
      if (options?.stackedCodesCount && options.stackedCodesCount > 1) {
        return `Lifetime Tier ${options.stackedCodesCount >= 3 ? 3 : options.stackedCodesCount}`;
      }
      return options?.short ? 'Lifetime' : 'Lifetime Pass';
    case 'COHORT_PASS':
      return options?.short ? 'Cohort' : 'Cohort Pass';
    case 'LIVING_VAULT_MONTHLY':
      return 'Living Vault';
    default:
      if (!planType) return 'Free Plan';
      return planType
        .replace(/_/g, ' ')
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(/\b\w/g, (c) => c.toUpperCase());
  }
}

/**
 * Returns human-friendly label and styling badge classes for an entitlement planType.
 */
export function getPlanTypeBadgeProps(
  planType: string | null | undefined,
  isVaultReadonly?: boolean
): {
  label: string;
  className: string;
} {
  if (isVaultReadonly) {
    return {
      label: 'Vault (Read-Only)',
      className: 'border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 font-medium',
    };
  }

  switch (planType) {
    case 'FREE_HOOK':
      return {
        label: 'Free Plan',
        className: 'border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 font-medium',
      };
    case 'SIX_MONTH_SOLO':
      return {
        label: 'Solo Pass',
        className: 'border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 font-semibold',
      };
    case 'SIX_MONTH_COFOUNDER':
      return {
        label: 'Co-Founder Pass',
        className: 'border-violet-200 bg-violet-50 text-violet-700 font-semibold',
      };
    case 'APPSUMO_LTD':
      return {
        label: 'AppSumo Lifetime',
        className: 'border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 text-amber-900 font-semibold',
      };
    case 'COHORT_PASS':
      return {
        label: 'Cohort Pass',
        className: 'border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 font-semibold',
      };
    default:
      return {
        label: planType ? getPlanTypeDisplayName(planType) : 'Free Plan',
        className: 'border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 font-medium',
      };
  }
}
=== src/lib/ai/module-b-blindspots.ts ===
import type { BlindSpotItem } from '@/db/schema';
import {
  getCountryRulePack,
  getGrantsForCountry,
  formatPlanCurrency,
  type SupportedCountryCode,
} from '@/lib/localization';
import type {
  BeachheadMarketData,
  CompetitorsAndStatusQuoData,
  MarketSizingData,
  CompetitiveWedgeData,
} from '@/lib/auth/session-store';

export interface DynamicModuleBBlindSpotsInput {
  planTitle: string;
  industryCategory: string;
  hqCountryCode: SupportedCountryCode;
  targetMarketsArray: string[];
  beachhead?: Partial<BeachheadMarketData>;
  competitorsAndStatusQuo?: Partial<CompetitorsAndStatusQuoData>;
  marketSizing?: Partial<MarketSizingData>;
  competitiveWedge?: Partial<CompetitiveWedgeData>;
}

/**
 * Generates 6 live, constructive "Things to Consider" blind-spot cards for Module B
 * that react immediately as the founder fills out Steps 1–4 (Target Customers,
 * Competitors & Habits, Market Sizing, and Competitive Edge).
 */
export function buildDynamicModuleBBlindSpots(
  input: DynamicModuleBBlindSpotsInput
): BlindSpotItem[] {
  const countryPack = getCountryRulePack(input.hqCountryCode);
  const grants = getGrantsForCountry(input.hqCountryCode);
  const topGrant =
    grants[0]?.grantName || 'Local Enterprise Feasibility Support';
  const currency = countryPack.defaultCurrency;

  const targetMarkets =
    input.targetMarketsArray.length > 0
      ? input.targetMarketsArray
      : [input.hqCountryCode];
  const marketsText = targetMarkets.join(' & ');

  const buyerTypes = input.beachhead?.buyerTypes?.length
    ? input.beachhead.buyerTypes
    : input.beachhead?.buyerType
      ? [input.beachhead.buyerType]
      : ['B2B_BUSINESSES'];

  const customerDesc = input.beachhead?.beachheadSegment?.trim()
    ? input.beachhead.beachheadSegment.trim().replace(/\.$/, '')
    : `target customers in ${marketsText}`;

  // ============================================================================
  // CARD 1: MULTI-GROUP SEQUENCE vs. SPLITTING FOCUS (STEP 1)
  // ============================================================================
  const hasMultipleBuyerModels =
    buyerTypes.length > 1 ||
    (input.marketSizing?.segments?.length ?? 0) > 1;

  const card1: BlindSpotItem = hasMultipleBuyerModels
    ? {
        id: 'mod-b-bs-1-sequence',
        category: 'MARKET_REALITY',
        severity: 'WARNING',
        title:
          '🎯 1. Sequencing Your Customer Groups (Don’t Sell to Both on Day 1)',
        explanation: `You serve multiple customer groups (${customerDesc}). Selling to individual self-serve users requires fast onboarding, while selling to universities, accelerators, or businesses requires relationship building and longer sign-off cycles.`,
        suggestedAction:
          'Pick ONE group to win your first 10 customers in Month 1 (usually individual users or warm pilot partners) and use their traction as proof to close larger institutional/business accounts in Month 3.',
      }
    : {
        id: 'mod-b-bs-1-focus',
        category: 'MARKET_REALITY',
        severity: 'INFO',
        title: '🎯 1. Sharpening Your First 10 Customer List (Step 1)',
        explanation: `You are focusing on "${customerDesc}". The fastest way to test if this group is specific enough is the Monday Morning Test: could you write down the names or LinkedIn profiles of 10 real buyers in ${marketsText} today?`,
        suggestedAction:
          'Before building features, list 10 real people or organisations matching this exact profile whom you will invite to your Module C validation survey.',
      };

  // ============================================================================
  // CARD 2: DECISION MAKER vs. END USER & BUYING TRIGGER (STEP 1)
  // ============================================================================
  const differentDecisionMaker =
    input.beachhead?.endUserVsDecisionMaker === 'DIFFERENT_DECISION_MAKER';
  const decisionMakerRole = input.beachhead?.decisionMakerRole?.trim();

  const card2: BlindSpotItem = differentDecisionMaker
    ? {
        id: 'mod-b-bs-2-decision-maker',
        category: 'OPERATIONAL_REALITY',
        severity: 'WARNING',
        title:
          '🔐 2. Winning Both the Daily User and the Budget Holder (Step 1)',
        explanation: `In your model, the daily user and the person signing off the payment (${decisionMakerRole || 'the budget holder'}) are often different people. Daily users care about ease of use, while budget holders care about cost savings, compliance, or measurable outcomes.`,
        suggestedAction:
          'Give your daily users a 1-page "ROI / Business Case Summary" they can forward to their director or procurement team to get budget approved quickly.',
      }
    : {
        id: 'mod-b-bs-2-trigger',
        category: 'MARKET_REALITY',
        severity: 'INFO',
        title: '⚡ 2. Catching Customers at the Exact Buying Trigger (Step 1)',
        explanation: `Your user and buyer are the same person (${decisionMakerRole || 'direct buyer'}). Individual buyers rarely shop for new tools on a random Tuesday — they act when an urgent trigger hits (${input.beachhead?.buyingTriggerNotes?.trim() || 'a deadline, cost spike, or milestone'}).`,
        suggestedAction:
          'Place your outreach and survey link right where customers go the moment that urgent trigger happens.',
      };

  // ============================================================================
  // CARD 3: BEATING "DOING NOTHING" & CURRENT HABITS (STEP 2)
  // ============================================================================
  const workarounds = input.competitorsAndStatusQuo?.currentWorkarounds ?? [];
  const compCount =
    input.competitorsAndStatusQuo?.competitors?.filter(
      (c) => c.name.trim().length > 0
    ).length ?? 0;

  const card3: BlindSpotItem = {
    id: 'mod-b-bs-3-habits',
    category: 'MARKET_REALITY',
    severity: compCount === 0 ? 'WARNING' : 'INFO',
    title:
      '📊 3. Your #1 Competitor Is Usually "Stick With Spreadsheets / Do Nothing" (Step 2)',
    explanation:
      compCount === 0
        ? `You haven't listed named competitors yet. Remember: investors and grant boards never believe "we have zero competition" because customers are already dealing with the problem via spreadsheets, WhatsApp, or consultants.`
        : `You mapped ${compCount} competitor(s) alongside everyday habits (${workarounds.length > 0 ? `${workarounds.length} workaround habits selected` : 'manual workarounds'}). Even when customers hate their current spreadsheet or agency, habit inertia is strong.`,
    suggestedAction:
      compCount === 0
        ? 'Use the "Find Competitors with AI" button in Step 2 to map at least 2–3 direct or indirect alternatives.'
        : 'Quantify the hidden cost of their current habit (e.g., "4 hours wasted every Friday" or "€2,500 consultant fee") so paying for your solution feels like an instant saving.',
  };

  // ============================================================================
  // CARD 4: MARKET SIZING & ANNUAL PRICING REALITY CHECK (STEP 3)
  // ============================================================================
  const segments = input.marketSizing?.segments ?? [];
  let totalYear1Revenue = 0;
  let totalYear1Customers = 0;
  segments.forEach((seg) => {
    const rawPrice =
      parseFloat((seg.pricePerCustomerInput || '').replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '')) ||
      0;
    const annualPrice =
      seg.billingCadence === 'MONTHLY_SUBSCRIPTION' ? rawPrice * 12 : rawPrice;
    const goalCust =
      parseInt((seg.year1To2CustomerGoalInput || '').replace(/[^0-9]/g, ''), 10) ||
      0;
    totalYear1Revenue += annualPrice * goalCust;
    totalYear1Customers += goalCust;
  });

  const avgAnnualPerCustomer =
    totalYear1Customers > 0 ? totalYear1Revenue / totalYear1Customers : 0;

  const card4: BlindSpotItem =
    totalYear1Revenue === 0
      ? {
          id: 'mod-b-bs-4-sizing-missing',
          category: 'FINANCIAL_REALITY',
          severity: 'WARNING',
          title: '🧮 4. Add Your Bottom-Up Customer Numbers in Step 3',
          explanation:
            'You have not entered your customer count and pricing numbers in Step 3 yet. Grant boards and investors reject vague billion-dollar claims — they want to see Price × Reachable Customers.',
          suggestedAction:
            'Click "Estimate Customer Counts with AI" or "Use Industry Benchmark" in Step 3 to generate a realistic bottom-up calculation.',
        }
      : avgAnnualPerCustomer > 0 && avgAnnualPerCustomer < 100
        ? {
            id: 'mod-b-bs-4-low-arpu',
            category: 'FINANCIAL_REALITY',
            severity: 'WARNING',
            title: `💷 4. Low-Ticket Pricing (${formatPlanCurrency(Math.round(avgAnnualPerCustomer), currency)}/yr Average) Needs High Volume or B2B Bundles (Step 3)`,
            explanation: `Your Year 1–2 goal is ${totalYear1Customers.toLocaleString()} customers generating ${formatPlanCurrency(totalYear1Revenue, currency)}/year. At an average of ${formatPlanCurrency(Math.round(avgAnnualPerCustomer), currency)}/year per customer, you cannot afford expensive 1-on-1 sales calls for individual buyers.`,
            suggestedAction:
              'Keep individual onboarding 100% self-serve, or add a higher-ticket B2B / University / Accelerator bundle (e.g., €1,500–€3,000/yr) to reach profitability faster.',
          }
        : {
            id: 'mod-b-bs-4-healthy-som',
            category: 'FINANCIAL_REALITY',
            severity: 'INFO',
            title: `📈 4. Realistic Year 1–2 Target: ${totalYear1Customers.toLocaleString()} Customers = ${formatPlanCurrency(totalYear1Revenue, currency)}/yr (Step 3)`,
            explanation: `Breaking your Year 1–2 revenue goal (${formatPlanCurrency(totalYear1Revenue, currency)}/yr) down to ${totalYear1Customers.toLocaleString()} real customers (approx. ${Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalYear1Customers / 12))} new customers per month) makes your plan credible to both grant assessors and investors.`,
            suggestedAction:
              'Test your proposed price point in Module C (Customer Surveys) before locking in your final pricing tiers in Module F.',
          };

  // ============================================================================
  // CARD 5: OVERCOMING SWITCHING FRICTION & COPYCAT PROTECTION (STEP 4)
  // ============================================================================
  const switchReducers =
    input.competitiveWedge?.switchingFrictionReducers ?? [];
  const moats = input.competitiveWedge?.unfairAdvantages ?? [];

  const card5: BlindSpotItem = {
    id: 'mod-b-bs-5-wedge',
    category: 'OPERATIONAL_REALITY',
    severity:
      switchReducers.length === 0 || moats.length === 0 ? 'WARNING' : 'INFO',
    title:
      '🛡️ 5. Lowering Switching Friction & Protecting Your Lead (Step 4)',
    explanation:
      switchReducers.length === 0
        ? 'Even if your product is 5x better, customers hesitate if switching feels risky or time-consuming. Defining a zero-risk "First Step" removes that hesitation.'
        : `You selected ${switchReducers.length} switching-friction reducer(s) and ${moats.length} long-term unfair advantage(s). Remember: features can be copied in months, but local compliance, community cohorts, and trusted relationships compound over years.`,
    suggestedAction:
      input.competitiveWedge?.switchingFrictionPlanNotes?.trim()
        ? `Lead your pitch with your easy first step: "${input.competitiveWedge.switchingFrictionPlanNotes.trim().replace(/\.$/, '')}".`
        : 'Define a 10-minute free first step or pilot in Step 4 so customers can experience value before committing budget.',
  };

  // ============================================================================
  // CARD 6: EXPORT & GRANT READINESS + MODULE C VALIDATION HANDOFF
  // ============================================================================
  const isExporting =
    targetMarkets.some((m) => m !== input.hqCountryCode) ||
    targetMarkets.includes('EU') ||
    targetMarkets.includes('ROW');

  const card6: BlindSpotItem = {
    id: 'mod-b-bs-6-validation-handoff',
    category: 'LOCAL_GRANT_MATCH',
    severity: 'INFO',
    title: `🌍 6. Proving Demand in ${marketsText} for ${topGrant} (Next: Module C)`,
    explanation: isExporting
      ? `Because you selected international selling markets (${marketsText}), you align strongly with export-focused supports like ${topGrant}. However, grant assessors will ask: "How many real target customers have you actually surveyed or interviewed?"`
      : `You are launching in ${countryPack.countryName} first. Whether you apply for ${topGrant} or bootstrap from customer sales, real customer survey data is the strongest proof you can show.`,
    suggestedAction:
      'Proceed to Module C (Customer Surveys & Feedback) to publish your unbiased customer validation survey link and collect your first 15+ real buyer responses and waitlist signups.',
  };

  return [card1, card2, card3, card4, card5, card6];
}

export interface ConceptCanvasBlocks {
  coreProblem: string;
  targetCustomer: string;
  proposedSolution: string;
  unfairAdvantage: string;
  revenueAndGrantFit: string;
  lastSynthesizedAt?: string;
  aiEngineUsed?: 'gemini-2.5-flash' | 'smart-synthesizer';
}

export interface ModuleASynthesisResult {
  allowed: boolean;
  reason?: string;
  canvas: ConceptCanvasBlocks;
  thingsToConsider: BlindSpotItem[];
  creditsUsedAfter?: number;
  engineMode: 'gemini-2.5-flash' | 'smart-synthesizer';
}

const DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT = `You are the Startup Preflight Supportive Co-Founder & Blind-Spot Engine.
Always follow the "Capture First, Expand Second" philosophy:
1. Never criticize the founder's raw idea upfront. When tidying up the founder's Step 2 Concept Canvas notes, preserve their exact core ideas and voice while making their notes clear, well-structured, and easy to read. Remember there are no right or wrong answers.
2. Second, generate 3 constructive, encouraging "Things to Consider" blind spots (operational realities, industry traps, or validation questions) framed as supportive coaching prompts.`;

/**
 * Global Daily Platform AI Call Ceiling (Circuit Breaker).
 * Protects the platform GEMINI_API_KEY from runaway scripts or unexpected spikes.
 * Defaults to 500 platform-key Gemini calls per 24 hours (configurable via MAX_DAILY_PLATFORM_AI_CALLS).
 * When reached, the router fails closed to the zero-cost `smart-synthesizer` fallback.
 */
const DEFAULT_MAX_DAILY_PLATFORM_AI_CALLS = 500;
const MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS_PER_CALL = 2048;

let cachedDailyPlatformCallCount = 0;
let cachedDailyCountFetchedAt = 0;

function getMaxDailyPlatformAiCalls(): number {
  const parsed = Number(process.env.MAX_DAILY_PLATFORM_AI_CALLS);
  if (Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0) {
    return Math.floor(parsed);
  }
  return DEFAULT_MAX_DAILY_PLATFORM_AI_CALLS;
}

/**
 * Sanitizes and truncates untrusted user text before embedding into an AI prompt
 * so a malicious payload cannot burn tens of thousands of input tokens in a single call.
 */
export function sanitizePromptInput(
  raw: string | undefined | null,
  maxChars: number = 3000
): string {
  if (!raw) return '';
  return raw
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u0008\u000B\u000C\u000E-\u001F\u007F]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxChars);
}

function isValidUuid(val: string | undefined | null): val is string {
  return Boolean(
    val &&
      /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(
        val
      )
  );
}

function isValidByokGeminiKey(customKey?: string | null): customKey is string {
  if (!customKey) return false;
  const trimmed = customKey.trim();
  // Real Google AI Studio keys begin with AIza (~39 chars) or Vertex Express API keys begin with AQ.
  return /^(AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{31,}|AQ\.[0-9A-Za-z_-]{20,})$/.test(trimmed);
}

function isVertexExpressApiKey(key?: string | null): boolean {
  return Boolean(key && key.trim().startsWith('AQ.'));
}

function hasConfiguredGeminiKey(customKey?: string | null): string | null {
  if (isValidByokGeminiKey(customKey)) {
    return customKey.trim();
  }
  const vertexKey = process.env.VERTEX_API_KEY?.trim();
  if (vertexKey && isVertexExpressApiKey(vertexKey)) {
    return vertexKey;
  }
  const envKey = process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY?.trim();
  if (envKey && isVertexExpressApiKey(envKey)) {
    return envKey;
  }
  if (
    envKey &&
    envKey.length > 15 &&
    envKey !== 'your_gemini_api_key_here' &&
    process.env.GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI !== 'true'
  ) {
    return envKey;
  }
  if (
    process.env.GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI === 'true' ||
    process.env.VERTEX_AI === 'true'
  ) {
    return 'VERTEX_AI_ACTIVE';
  }
  if (envKey && envKey.length > 15 && envKey !== 'your_gemini_api_key_here') {
    return envKey;
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * Resolves the active Vertex AI Gemini model name.
 * In GCP project `startuppreflight`, legacy `gemini-2.5-*` models return 404 on Vertex AI,
 * while `gemini-3.8-flash` and `gemini-3.5-flash` are provisioned and active.
 */
function resolveVertexModelName(requestedModel?: string): string {
  const override = process.env.VERTEX_GEMINI_MODEL?.trim();
  if (override) return override;
  if (!requestedModel || requestedModel.startsWith('gemini-2.5') || requestedModel.startsWith('gemini-2.0') || requestedModel.startsWith('gemini-1.5')) {
    return 'gemini-3.8-flash';
  }
  return requestedModel;
}

export function getGenAiClient(activeApiKey: string | null): GoogleGenAI {
  const useVertex =
    process.env.GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI === 'true' ||
    process.env.VERTEX_AI === 'true' ||
    isVertexExpressApiKey(activeApiKey) ||
    isVertexExpressApiKey(process.env.VERTEX_API_KEY) ||
    isVertexExpressApiKey(process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY);

  // If founder provided a verified AIza... BYOK key from AI Studio, use direct AI Studio client
  if (activeApiKey && activeApiKey.startsWith('AIza') && process.env.GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI !== 'true') {
    return new GoogleGenAI({ apiKey: activeApiKey });
  }

  if (useVertex) {
    const vertexApiKey = activeApiKey && isVertexExpressApiKey(activeApiKey)
      ? activeApiKey.trim()
      : isVertexExpressApiKey(process.env.VERTEX_API_KEY)
        ? process.env.VERTEX_API_KEY!.trim()
        : isVertexExpressApiKey(process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY)
          ? process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY!.trim()
          : null;

    const primaryClient = vertexApiKey
      ? new GoogleGenAI({ vertexai: true, apiKey: vertexApiKey })
      : new GoogleGenAI({
          vertexai: true,
          project: process.env.GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT || 'startuppreflight',
          location: process.env.GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION || 'global',
        });

    const adcGlobalFallbackClient = new GoogleGenAI({
      vertexai: true,
      project: process.env.GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT || 'startuppreflight',
      location: 'global',
    });

    const originalGenerateContent = primaryClient.models.generateContent.bind(primaryClient.models);
    const fallbackGenerateContent = adcGlobalFallbackClient.models.generateContent.bind(adcGlobalFallbackClient.models);

    primaryClient.models.generateContent = async (params: any) => {
      const upgradedParams = {
        ...params,
        model: resolveVertexModelName(params?.model),
      };
      try {
        return await originalGenerateContent(upgradedParams);
      } catch (primaryErr) {
        if (vertexApiKey) {
          return await fallbackGenerateContent(upgradedParams);
        }
        throw primaryErr;
      }
    };

    return primaryClient;
  }

  return new GoogleGenAI({ apiKey: activeApiKey || process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY || '' });
}

export interface AuthorizedGeminiCallContext {
  canCallLiveGemini: boolean;
  creditCheckBlocked: boolean;
  blockReason?: string;
  activeApiKey: string | null;
  verifiedUserId: string | null;
  usedByokKey: boolean;
  planType?: string;
  currentCreditsUsed: number;
  systemInstruction: string;
}

/**
 * Strict Server-Side AI Billing Firewall (`authorizeAndPrepareGeminiCall`).
 * Enforces:
 * 1. Never trusts client-passed `userId` — resolves authenticated session strictly from signed HttpOnly cookie.
 * 2. Fails closed to zero-cost `smart-synthesizer` if unauthenticated, suspended, or DB is unreachable.
 * 3. Checks `user_entitlements.ai_credits_used_this_month` against `monthly_ai_credits_limit`.
 * 4. Enforces per-user burst rate limits (max 8 calls/minute, 60 calls/hour).
 * 5. Decrypts BYOK key in server memory only, or enforces the 500/day Global Platform Circuit Breaker on the platform key.
 */
export async function authorizeAndPrepareGeminiCall(
  promptKey: string,
  defaultSystemInstruction: string = DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT
): Promise<AuthorizedGeminiCallContext> {
  const founderSession = await getServerSessionCookie();
  const adminSession = await getAdminSessionCookie();
  const session = founderSession || adminSession;

  if (!session || !isValidUuid(session.userId)) {
    // Unauthenticated or local demo preview: NEVER touch live GEMINI_API_KEY.
    return {
      canCallLiveGemini: false,
      creditCheckBlocked: false,
      activeApiKey: null,
      verifiedUserId: null,
      usedByokKey: false,
      currentCreditsUsed: 0,
      systemInstruction: defaultSystemInstruction,
    };
  }

  const verifiedUserId = session.userId;

  try {
    // Verify user is ACTIVE in PostgreSQL
    const [dbUser] = await db
      .select({ id: users.id, status: users.status })
      .from(users)
      .where(eq(users.id, verifiedUserId))
      .limit(1);

    if (!dbUser || dbUser.status !== 'ACTIVE') {
      return {
        canCallLiveGemini: false,
        creditCheckBlocked: true,
        blockReason: 'Account is not active.',
        activeApiKey: null,
        verifiedUserId,
        usedByokKey: false,
        currentCreditsUsed: 0,
        systemInstruction: defaultSystemInstruction,
      };
    }

    const [entRow] = await db
      .select()
      .from(userEntitlements)
      .where(eq(userEntitlements.userId, verifiedUserId))
      .limit(1);

    if (!entRow) {
      // Fail closed if entitlement row is missing
      return {
        canCallLiveGemini: false,
        creditCheckBlocked: false,
        activeApiKey: null,
        verifiedUserId,
        usedByokKey: false,
        currentCreditsUsed: 0,
        systemInstruction: defaultSystemInstruction,
      };
    }

    const rawDecryptedByok = decryptByokApiKey(entRow.customApiKeyEncrypted);
    const isByokTierEligible =
      entRow.planType === 'APPSUMO_LTD' && entRow.stackedCodesCount >= 3;
    const validByokKey =
      isByokTierEligible && isValidByokGeminiKey(rawDecryptedByok)
        ? rawDecryptedByok.trim()
        : null;

    const snapshot: EntitlementSnapshot = {
      userId: entRow.userId,
      planType: entRow.planType,
      stackedCodesCount: entRow.stackedCodesCount,
      maxStartupPlans: entRow.maxStartupPlans,
      maxSeatsPerPlan: entRow.maxSeatsPerPlan,
      monthlyAiCreditsLimit: entRow.monthlyAiCreditsLimit,
      aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: entRow.aiCreditsUsedThisMonth,
      whiteLabelExportEnabled: entRow.whiteLabelExportEnabled,
      customApiKeyEncrypted: validByokKey,
      accessExpiresAt: entRow.accessExpiresAt,
      isVaultReadonly: entRow.isVaultReadonly,
    };

    const creditCheck = canConsumeAiCredits(snapshot, 1);
    if (!creditCheck.allowed) {
      return {
        canCallLiveGemini: false,
        creditCheckBlocked: true,
        blockReason: creditCheck.reason,
        activeApiKey: null,
        verifiedUserId,
        usedByokKey: false,
        planType: entRow.planType,
        currentCreditsUsed: entRow.aiCreditsUsedThisMonth,
        systemInstruction: defaultSystemInstruction,
      };
    }

    // Per-user burst rate limiting (max 8 calls/minute, max 60 calls/hour)
    const minuteLimit = checkRateLimit(`ai:min:${verifiedUserId}`, 8, 60_000);
    const hourLimit = checkRateLimit(`ai:hr:${verifiedUserId}`, 60, 3_600_000);
    if (!minuteLimit.allowed || !hourLimit.allowed) {
      console.warn(
        `[SPF AI Billing Firewall] Per-user burst rate limit reached for user ${verifiedUserId} on ${promptKey}. Using smart-synthesizer.`
      );
      return {
        canCallLiveGemini: false,
        creditCheckBlocked: false,
        activeApiKey: null,
        verifiedUserId,
        usedByokKey: false,
        planType: entRow.planType,
        currentCreditsUsed: entRow.aiCreditsUsedThisMonth,
        systemInstruction: defaultSystemInstruction,
      };
    }

    const usedByokKey = Boolean(validByokKey);
    const activeApiKey = hasConfiguredGeminiKey(validByokKey);

    if (!activeApiKey) {
      return {
        canCallLiveGemini: false,
        creditCheckBlocked: false,
        activeApiKey: null,
        verifiedUserId,
        usedByokKey: false,
        planType: entRow.planType,
        currentCreditsUsed: entRow.aiCreditsUsedThisMonth,
        systemInstruction: defaultSystemInstruction,
      };
    }

    // Global Daily Platform Circuit Breaker (500 calls/24h on platform key)
    if (!usedByokKey) {
      const maxDailyCalls = getMaxDailyPlatformAiCalls();
      const now = Date.now();
      if (now - cachedDailyCountFetchedAt > 60_000) {
        const [countRow] = await db
          .select({
            count: sql<number>`count(*)::int`,
          })
          .from(aiUsageLogs)
          .where(
            sql`${aiUsageLogs.usedByokKey} = false AND ${aiUsageLogs.modelUsed} != 'smart-synthesizer' AND ${aiUsageLogs.createdAt} >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'`
          );
        cachedDailyPlatformCallCount = Number(countRow?.count ?? 0);
        cachedDailyCountFetchedAt = now;
      }

      if (cachedDailyPlatformCallCount >= maxDailyCalls) {
        console.warn(
          `[SPF AI Billing Firewall] Global daily platform ceiling (${cachedDailyPlatformCallCount}/${maxDailyCalls} calls in 24h) reached. Failing closed to smart-synthesizer.`
        );
        return {
          canCallLiveGemini: false,
          creditCheckBlocked: false,
          activeApiKey: null,
          verifiedUserId,
          usedByokKey: false,
          planType: entRow.planType,
          currentCreditsUsed: entRow.aiCreditsUsedThisMonth,
          systemInstruction: defaultSystemInstruction,
        };
      }

      // Pre-increment in-memory daily counter immediately upon authorization
      // so concurrent requests or failed parses cannot bypass the ceiling.
      cachedDailyPlatformCallCount += 1;
    }

    let systemInstruction = defaultSystemInstruction;
    try {
      const [promptRow] = await db
        .select()
        .from(aiPrompts)
        .where(eq(aiPrompts.promptKey, promptKey))
        .limit(1);
      if (promptRow?.systemInstruction) {
        systemInstruction = promptRow.systemInstruction;
      }
    } catch {
      // Keep default system instruction
    }

    return {
      canCallLiveGemini: true,
      creditCheckBlocked: false,
      activeApiKey,
      verifiedUserId,
      usedByokKey,
      planType: entRow.planType,
      currentCreditsUsed: entRow.aiCreditsUsedThisMonth,
      systemInstruction,
    };
  } catch {
    // CRITICAL BILLING PROTECTION: If PostgreSQL is unreachable, NEVER call live Gemini API.
    return {
      canCallLiveGemini: false,
      creditCheckBlocked: false,
      activeApiKey: null,
      verifiedUserId: null,
      usedByokKey: false,
      currentCreditsUsed: 0,
      systemInstruction: defaultSystemInstruction,
    };
  }
}

export async function recordGeminiUsageAndIncrementCredits(params: {
  verifiedUserId: string | null;
  planId?: string;
  promptKey: string;
  modelUsed: string;
  inputTokens: number;
  outputTokens: number;
  usedByokKey: boolean;
  fallbackCreditsUsed: number;
}): Promise<number> {
  if (!params.verifiedUserId || !isValidUuid(params.verifiedUserId)) {
    return params.fallbackCreditsUsed;
  }

  let creditsUsedAfter = params.fallbackCreditsUsed + 1;
  try {
    const [updatedEnt] = await db
      .update(userEntitlements)
      .set({
        aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: sql`${userEntitlements.aiCreditsUsedThisMonth} + 1`,
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(userEntitlements.userId, params.verifiedUserId))
      .returning();

    if (updatedEnt) {
      creditsUsedAfter = updatedEnt.aiCreditsUsedThisMonth;
    }

    await db.insert(aiUsageLogs).values({
      userId: params.verifiedUserId,
      planId: isValidUuid(params.planId) ? params.planId : null,
      promptKey: params.promptKey,
      modelUsed: params.modelUsed,
      inputTokens: params.inputTokens,
      outputTokens: params.outputTokens,
      usedByokKey: params.usedByokKey,
    });
  } catch {
    // Ignore logging error in offline fallback
  }

  return creditsUsedAfter;
}

function tidyFounderSentence(rawText: string | undefined, fallbackText: string): string {
  const cleaned = (rawText || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  if (!cleaned) return fallbackText;
  // Capitalize the first letter of each sentence and ensure ending punctuation
  const capitalized = cleaned.replace(/(^\s*[a-z]|[.!?]\s+[a-z])/g, (match) =>
    match.toUpperCase()
  );
  return /[.!?]$/.test(capitalized) ? capitalized : `${capitalized}.`;
}

/**
 * Smart deterministic note-tidier used when GEMINI_API_KEY is not yet set in .env,
 * preserving the founder's own typed Step 2 notes while tidying grammar and punctuation.
 */
function buildSmartFallbackSynthesis(params: {
  planTitle: string;
  brainDumpText: string;
  industryCategory: string;
  hqCountryCode: SupportedCountryCode;
  exportPotential: 'DOMESTIC_ONLY' | 'EXPORTING_INTERNATIONALLY';
  draftCanvas?: Partial<ConceptCanvasBlocks>;
  founderMotivation?: SavedFounderMotivation;
  teamAndBudget?: SavedTeamAndBudget;
  founderRealityCheck?: SavedFounderRealityCheck;
}): { canvas: ConceptCanvasBlocks; thingsToConsider: BlindSpotItem[] } {
  const countryPack = getCountryRulePack(params.hqCountryCode);
  const grants = getGrantsForCountry(params.hqCountryCode);
  const topGrant = grants[0]?.grantName || 'National Innovation Support';
  const raw = params.brainDumpText.trim();

  // Extract sentences from the founder's raw brain dump as helpful fallbacks only if a box was left blank
  const sentences = raw
    .split(/(?<=[.!?])\s+/)
    .map((s) => s.trim())
    .filter(Boolean);

  const firstSentence =
    sentences[0] ||
    `Customers in ${params.industryCategory} face manual workflow bottlenecks, wasted time, and hidden margin loss.`;
  const secondSentence =
    sentences.slice(1).join(' ') ||
    `${params.planTitle} solves this problem simply and saves customers time and money.`;

  const benchmarkPrice =
    params.industryCategory.includes('SaaS') ||
    params.industryCategory.includes('Service')
      ? formatPlanCurrency(299, countryPack.defaultCurrency) + '/month recurring'
      : formatPlanCurrency(85, countryPack.defaultCurrency) +
        ' average order value';

  const draft = params.draftCanvas || {};

  const canvas: ConceptCanvasBlocks = {
    coreProblem: tidyFounderSentence(draft.coreProblem, firstSentence),
    targetCustomer: tidyFounderSentence(
      draft.targetCustomer,
      `Customers in ${countryPack.countryName} within ${params.industryCategory} (${
        params.exportPotential === 'EXPORTING_INTERNATIONALLY'
          ? 'with international export potential'
          : `focused on the ${countryPack.countryName} market`
      }).`
    ),
    proposedSolution: tidyFounderSentence(draft.proposedSolution, secondSentence),
    unfairAdvantage: tidyFounderSentence(
      draft.unfairAdvantage,
      `Simple to adopt for ${params.industryCategory} customers with fast, measurable results.`
    ),
    revenueAndGrantFit: tidyFounderSentence(
      draft.revenueAndGrantFit,
      `Charged in ${countryPack.defaultCurrency} (e.g., ${benchmarkPrice}), with potential to explore ${topGrant}.`
    ),
    lastSynthesizedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    aiEngineUsed: 'smart-synthesizer',
  };

  const thingsToConsider = buildDynamicModuleABlindSpots({
    planTitle: params.planTitle,
    brainDumpText: params.brainDumpText,
    industryCategory: params.industryCategory,
    hqCountryCode: params.hqCountryCode,
    exportPotential: params.exportPotential,
    conceptCanvas: canvas,
    founderMotivation: params.founderMotivation,
    teamAndBudget: params.teamAndBudget,
    founderRealityCheck: params.founderRealityCheck,
  });

  return { canvas, thingsToConsider };
}

/**
 * Central AI Router (`src/lib/ai/router.ts`) required by GEMINI.md Rule 2.
 * Verifies authenticated server session, checks `user_entitlements.ai_credits_used_this_month` and
 * the 500/day platform circuit breaker, calls Gemini 2.5 Flash (or smart synthesizer fallback),
 * and logs token usage to `ai_usage_logs`.
 */
export async function synthesizeModuleAConceptCanvasViaRouter(params: {
  userId?: string;
  planId?: string;
  planTitle: string;
  brainDumpText: string;
  industryCategory: string;
  hqCountryCode: SupportedCountryCode;
  exportPotential: 'DOMESTIC_ONLY' | 'EXPORTING_INTERNATIONALLY';
  draftCanvas?: Partial<ConceptCanvasBlocks>;
  founderMotivation?: SavedFounderMotivation;
  teamAndBudget?: SavedTeamAndBudget;
  founderRealityCheck?: SavedFounderRealityCheck;
}): Promise<ModuleASynthesisResult> {
  const countryPack = getCountryRulePack(params.hqCountryCode);
  const grants = getGrantsForCountry(params.hqCountryCode);

  const authCtx = await authorizeAndPrepareGeminiCall(
    'MOD_A_CONCEPT_CANVAS',
    DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT
  );

  if (authCtx.creditCheckBlocked) {
    const fallback = buildSmartFallbackSynthesis(params);
    return {
      allowed: false,
      reason: authCtx.blockReason,
      canvas: fallback.canvas,
      thingsToConsider: fallback.thingsToConsider,
      creditsUsedAfter: authCtx.currentCreditsUsed,
      engineMode: 'smart-synthesizer',
    };
  }

  let canvasResult: ConceptCanvasBlocks | null = null;
  let blindSpotsResult: BlindSpotItem[] | null = null;
  let engineMode: 'gemini-2.5-flash' | 'smart-synthesizer' = 'smart-synthesizer';
  let inputTokensCount = 240;
  let outputTokensCount = 380;

  if (authCtx.canCallLiveGemini && authCtx.activeApiKey) {
    try {
      const ai = getGenAiClient(authCtx.activeApiKey);
      const draft = params.draftCanvas || {};
      const userPrompt = `
Founder Startup Title: ${sanitizePromptInput(params.planTitle, 200)}
Industry Category: ${sanitizePromptInput(params.industryCategory, 120)}
Home Country & Currency: ${countryPack.countryName} (${countryPack.defaultCurrency})
Indirect Tax: ${countryPack.taxName} (${countryPack.standardTaxRatePercent}%)
Export Ambition: ${params.exportPotential}
Matched Local Grants: ${grants.map((g) => `${g.grantName} (${g.maxAmountFormatted})`).join('; ')}

Founder's Raw Idea (Step 1):
"""
${sanitizePromptInput(params.brainDumpText, 3000)}
"""

Founder's Draft Notes in Step 2 (Tidy up their grammar and clarity while keeping their own meaning and voice; if a field is empty, helpfully suggest a simple starting note based on their raw idea):
- 1. Core Problem: ${sanitizePromptInput(draft.coreProblem, 800) || '(not filled in yet)'}
- 2. Target Customer: ${sanitizePromptInput(draft.targetCustomer, 800) || '(not filled in yet)'}
- 3. Your Solution: ${sanitizePromptInput(draft.proposedSolution, 800) || '(not filled in yet)'}
- 4. Why You Win: ${sanitizePromptInput(draft.unfairAdvantage, 800) || '(not filled in yet)'}
- 5. Revenue & Grant Fit: ${sanitizePromptInput(draft.revenueAndGrantFit, 800) || '(not filled in yet)'}

Founder's Motivation (Step 3):
- Primary Motivation: ${params.founderMotivation?.primaryMotivation || 'LEAVE_JOB'}
- Weekly Hours Available: ${params.founderMotivation?.weeklyHoursAvailable || '15_TO_25_HRS'}
- 12-Month Success Vision: ${sanitizePromptInput(params.founderMotivation?.twelveMonthSuccessVision, 600) || '(not filled in yet)'}

Founder's Team & Starting Budget (Step 4):
- Team Structure: ${params.teamAndBudget?.teamStructureType || 'SOLO_FOUNDER'}
- In-House Skill Coverage to Build V1: ${params.teamAndBudget?.skillCoverage || 'BUILD_IN_HOUSE'}
- Starting Capital to Invest (${countryPack.defaultCurrency}): ${params.teamAndBudget?.startingBudgetBracket || '1K_TO_5K'}
- Team & Funding Notes: ${sanitizePromptInput(params.teamAndBudget?.teamAndFundingNotes, 600) || '(not filled in yet)'}

Founder Fit, Dealbreakers & Reality Check (Step 5):
- Industry Connection (Monday Morning Test): ${params.founderRealityCheck?.industryConnection || 'WARM_CONNECTIONS'}
- Personal Income Urgency: ${params.founderRealityCheck?.personalIncomeUrgency || 'MEDIUM_6_TO_12M'}
- Lifestyle Dealbreakers (Anti-Goals): ${params.founderRealityCheck?.dealbreakers?.join(', ') || 'None selected'}
- Growth vs Control Tradeoff: ${params.founderRealityCheck?.growthTradeoff || 'BOOTSTRAP_100_CONTROL'}
- #1 Secret Worry: ${params.founderRealityCheck?.biggestWorryPreset || 'WILL_THEY_PAY'} (${sanitizePromptInput(params.founderRealityCheck?.biggestWorryNotes, 600) || 'no extra notes'})

Return STRICT JSON matching this exact shape (no markdown fences):
{
  "coreProblem": "Tidied, clear version of the founder's Core Problem note in plain English.",
  "targetCustomer": "Tidied, clear version of the founder's Target Customer note in plain English.",
  "proposedSolution": "Tidied, clear version of the founder's Solution note in plain English.",
  "unfairAdvantage": "Tidied, clear version of the founder's Why You Win note in plain English.",
  "revenueAndGrantFit": "Tidied, clear version of the founder's Revenue & Grant Fit note in plain English.",
  "thingsToConsider": [
    {
      "category": "OPERATIONAL_REALITY",
      "title": "Short constructive title",
      "observation": "Supportive 2-sentence operational question or blind spot to consider."
    },
    {
      "category": "INDUSTRY_TRAP",
      "title": "Short constructive title",
      "observation": "Supportive 2-sentence industry trap to watch out for."
    },
    {
      "category": "OPEN_QUESTION",
      "title": "Short constructive title",
      "observation": "Supportive 2-sentence validation question to test with 5 customers."
    }
  ]
}`.trim();

      const response = await ai.models.generateContent({
        model: 'gemini-2.5-flash',
        contents: userPrompt,
        config: {
          systemInstruction: authCtx.systemInstruction,
          responseMimeType: 'application/json',
          temperature: 0.4,
          maxOutputTokens: MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS_PER_CALL,
        },
      });

      const rawText = response.text || '';
      const parsed = JSON.parse(rawText) as {
        coreProblem?: string;
        targetCustomer?: string;
        proposedSolution?: string;
        unfairAdvantage?: string;
        revenueAndGrantFit?: string;
        thingsToConsider?: Array<{
          category?: 'OPERATIONAL_REALITY' | 'INDUSTRY_TRAP' | 'OPEN_QUESTION';
          title?: string;
          observation?: string;
        }>;
      };

      if (parsed.coreProblem && parsed.proposedSolution) {
        engineMode = 'gemini-2.5-flash';
        canvasResult = {
          coreProblem: parsed.coreProblem,
          targetCustomer:
            parsed.targetCustomer ||
            `Primary buyers in ${countryPack.countryName} (${params.industryCategory}).`,
          proposedSolution: parsed.proposedSolution,
          unfairAdvantage:
            parsed.unfairAdvantage ||
            'Fast onboarding with measurable ROI in the first 30 days.',
          revenueAndGrantFit:
            parsed.revenueAndGrantFit ||
            `Priced in ${countryPack.defaultCurrency} with eligibility for ${grants[0]?.grantName || 'regional support'}.`,
          lastSynthesizedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          aiEngineUsed: 'gemini-2.5-flash',
        };

        if (
          Array.isArray(parsed.thingsToConsider) &&
          parsed.thingsToConsider.length > 0
        ) {
          blindSpotsResult = parsed.thingsToConsider.map((item, idx) => ({
            id: `bs-${Date.now()}-${idx + 1}`,
            category: item.category || 'OPEN_QUESTION',
            severity: 'INFO' as const,
            title: item.title || `Key Consideration #${idx + 1}`,
            explanation:
              item.observation ||
              'Verify this assumption with 5 target customers.',
            suggestedAction:
              'Test this question in your Module B Customer Validation Survey.',
          }));
        }

        inputTokensCount = response.usageMetadata?.promptTokenCount || 280;
        outputTokensCount =
          response.usageMetadata?.candidatesTokenCount || 420;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn(
        '[SPF AI Router] Gemini API call failed, using smart synthesizer fallback:',
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : err
      );
    }
  }

  if (!canvasResult || !blindSpotsResult) {
    const fallback = buildSmartFallbackSynthesis(params);
    canvasResult = fallback.canvas;
    blindSpotsResult = fallback.thingsToConsider;
  }

  const creditsUsedAfter = await recordGeminiUsageAndIncrementCredits({
    verifiedUserId: authCtx.verifiedUserId,
    planId: params.planId,
    promptKey: 'MOD_A_CONCEPT_CANVAS',
    modelUsed: engineMode,
    inputTokens: inputTokensCount,
    outputTokens: outputTokensCount,
    usedByokKey: authCtx.usedByokKey,
    fallbackCreditsUsed: authCtx.currentCreditsUsed,
  });

  return {
    allowed: true,
    canvas: canvasResult,
    thingsToConsider: blindSpotsResult,
    creditsUsedAfter,
    engineMode,
  };
}

export interface ModuleBMarketScoutResult {

  reason?: string;
  competitors: CompetitorEntry[];
  suggestedWhySwitchSentence?: string;
  creditsUsedAfter?: number;

}

  const isStartupOrBusinessPlanTool =
    combinedContext.includes('unicorn') ||

  if (isStartupOrBusinessPlanTool) {
    return {

  switch (params.industryCategory) {

          {
            id: `comp-${Date.now()}-2`,
            name: 'Local Facebook Groups, WhatsApp & Word-of-Mouth',

    case 'E-Commerce / Physical Product / Food & Drink':
      return {
