}

export interface PolishBusinessPlanTextResult {
  allowed: boolean;
  polishedText: string;
  summaryOfChanges?: string;
  engineMode: 'gemini-2.5-pro' | 'gemini-2.5-flash' | 'smart-synthesizer';
}

export async function polishBusinessPlanTextViaRouter(
  params: PolishBusinessPlanTextParams
): Promise<PolishBusinessPlanTextResult> {
  const fallbackDraft = params.currentText?.trim() || '';
  const fallback: PolishBusinessPlanTextResult = {
    allowed: true,
    polishedText: fallbackDraft,
    summaryOfChanges: 'Text preserved.',
    engineMode: 'smart-synthesizer',
  };

  const authCtx = await authorizeAndPrepareGeminiCall(
    'MOD_L_STEP3_SECTION',
    'You are an expert Executive Business Plan Editor and Underwriter.'
  );

  if (authCtx.canCallLiveGemini && authCtx.activeApiKey) {
    try {
      const ai = getGenAiClient(authCtx.activeApiKey);
      const prompt = `You are a world-class Executive Business Plan Editor, Institutional Credit Underwriter, and Grant Assessor.
Company: "${params.planTitle}"
Industry: ${params.industryCategory || 'Startup Venture'}
Country: ${params.hqCountryCode} (${params.baseCurrency})
Audience Tone / Register: ${params.targetTone}

CHAPTER TITLE: "${params.chapterTitle}"

CURRENT DRAFT PROSE:
"""
${sanitizePromptInput(params.currentText, 2500)}
"""

EDITOR INSTRUCTION / POLISH MANDATE:
"""
${sanitizePromptInput(params.instruction, 500)}
"""

TASK:
Rewrite and polish this specific chapter's prose strictly adhering to the user's instruction and tone mandate.
Keep all verified numbers, metric claims, and operational facts intact unless specifically asked to adjust.
Ensure smooth, professional executive flow without generic marketing hype.

Return strictly a JSON object:
{
  "polishedText": "The refined, flowing chapter prose text",
  "summaryOfChanges": "Brief 1-sentence note on what was sharpened"
}`;

      const modelUsed: 'gemini-2.5-flash' = 'gemini-2.5-flash';
      const response = await ai.models.generateContent({
        model: modelUsed,
        contents: prompt,
        config: {
          responseMimeType: 'application/json',
          temperature: 0.25,
          maxOutputTokens: MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS_PER_CALL,
        },
      });

      const rawText = response.text?.trim() || '';
      if (rawText) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(rawText);
        if (
          parsed &&
          typeof parsed.polishedText === 'string' &&
          parsed.polishedText.trim().length > 15
        ) {
          await recordGeminiUsageAndIncrementCredits({
            verifiedUserId: authCtx.verifiedUserId,
            planId: params.planId,
            promptKey: 'MOD_L_STEP3_SECTION',
            modelUsed: modelUsed,
            inputTokens: response.usageMetadata?.promptTokenCount || 380,
            outputTokens: response.usageMetadata?.candidatesTokenCount || 300,
            usedByokKey: authCtx.usedByokKey,
            fallbackCreditsUsed: authCtx.currentCreditsUsed,
          });

          return {
            allowed: true,
            polishedText: parsed.polishedText.trim(),
            summaryOfChanges:
              typeof parsed.summaryOfChanges === 'string'
                ? parsed.summaryOfChanges.trim()
                : undefined,
            engineMode: modelUsed,
          };
        }
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.warn(
        '[AI Router] Polish Business Plan Text Gemini call fallback:',
        err?.message || err
      );
    }
  }

  return fallback;
}
=== src/lib/ai/module-a-blindspots.ts ===
import type { BlindSpotItem } from '@/db/schema';
import {
  getCountryRulePack,
  getGrantsForCountry,
  formatPlanCurrency,
  type SupportedCountryCode,
} from '@/lib/localization';
import type {
  SavedConceptCanvas,
  SavedFounderMotivation,
  SavedTeamAndBudget,
  SavedFounderRealityCheck,
  FounderDealbreakerType,
} from '@/lib/auth/session-store';

export interface DynamicBlindSpotsInput {
  planTitle: string;
  brainDumpText: string;
  industryCategory: string;
  hqCountryCode: SupportedCountryCode;
  exportPotential: 'DOMESTIC_ONLY' | 'EXPORTING_INTERNATIONALLY';
  conceptCanvas?: Partial<SavedConceptCanvas> | null;
  founderMotivation?: SavedFounderMotivation;
  teamAndBudget?: SavedTeamAndBudget;
  founderRealityCheck?: SavedFounderRealityCheck;
}

const DEALBREAKER_SHORT_LABELS: Record<FounderDealbreakerType, string> = {
  NO_BIG_TEAM: 'managing a large staff team',
  NO_PHYSICAL_PREMISES: 'taking on a physical shop/warehouse lease',
  NO_COLD_SALES: 'doing cold-calling or high-pressure enterprise sales',
  NO_OUTSIDE_INVESTORS: 'answering to outside VCs/investors',
  NO_WEEKEND_SUPPORT: 'handling 24/7 weekend customer emergencies',
  OTHER: 'custom lifestyle dealbreakers',
};

/**
 * Generates 6 live, deeply personalized "Things to Consider" blind-spot cards
 * that react immediately as the founder adds or edits information across Steps 1–5.
 */
export function buildDynamicModuleABlindSpots(
  input: DynamicBlindSpotsInput
): BlindSpotItem[] {
  const countryPack = getCountryRulePack(input.hqCountryCode);
  const grants = getGrantsForCountry(input.hqCountryCode);
  const topGrant = grants[0]?.grantName || 'Local Enterprise Feasibility Support';
  const currency = countryPack.defaultCurrency;

  const benchmarkPrice =
    input.industryCategory.includes('SaaS') ||
    input.industryCategory.includes('Service')
      ? `${formatPlanCurrency(299, currency)}/month`
      : `${formatPlanCurrency(85, currency)} per order`;

  const canvas = input.conceptCanvas || {};
  const motivation = {
    primaryMotivation: input.founderMotivation?.primaryMotivation || 'LEAVE_JOB',
    weeklyHoursAvailable: input.founderMotivation?.weeklyHoursAvailable || '15_TO_25_HRS',
    twelveMonthSuccessVision: input.founderMotivation?.twelveMonthSuccessVision || '',
    otherMotivationText: input.founderMotivation?.otherMotivationText,
    otherWeeklyHoursText: input.founderMotivation?.otherWeeklyHoursText,
  };
  const team = {
    teamStructureType: input.teamAndBudget?.teamStructureType || 'SOLO_FOUNDER',
    skillCoverage: input.teamAndBudget?.skillCoverage || 'BUILD_IN_HOUSE',
    startingBudgetBracket: input.teamAndBudget?.startingBudgetBracket || '1K_TO_5K',
    teamAndFundingNotes: input.teamAndBudget?.teamAndFundingNotes || '',
    otherTeamStructureText: input.teamAndBudget?.otherTeamStructureText,
    otherSkillCoverageText: input.teamAndBudget?.otherSkillCoverageText,
    otherStartingBudgetText: input.teamAndBudget?.otherStartingBudgetText,
    otherBudgetText: input.teamAndBudget?.otherBudgetText,
  };
  const reality = {
    industryConnection: input.founderRealityCheck?.industryConnection || 'WARM_CONNECTIONS',
    personalIncomeUrgency: input.founderRealityCheck?.personalIncomeUrgency || 'MEDIUM_6_TO_12M',
    dealbreakers: Array.isArray(input.founderRealityCheck?.dealbreakers)
      ? input.founderRealityCheck.dealbreakers
      : [],
    growthTradeoff: input.founderRealityCheck?.growthTradeoff || 'NON_DILUTIVE_GRANTS',
    biggestWorryPreset: input.founderRealityCheck?.biggestWorryPreset || 'FINDING_FIRST_10',
    biggestWorryNotes: input.founderRealityCheck?.biggestWorryNotes || '',
    otherDealbreakerText: input.founderRealityCheck?.otherDealbreakerText,
    otherIncomeUrgencyText: input.founderRealityCheck?.otherIncomeUrgencyText,
    otherIndustryConnectionText: input.founderRealityCheck?.otherIndustryConnectionText,
    otherGrowthTradeoffText: input.founderRealityCheck?.otherGrowthTradeoffText,
  };

  // ============================================================================
  // CARD 1: STEPS 1 & 2 — CONCEPT, CUSTOMER & VERSION 1 SCOPE
  // ============================================================================
  const customerSnippet = canvas.targetCustomer?.trim()
    ? canvas.targetCustomer.trim().replace(/\.$/, '')
    : `${input.industryCategory} buyers in ${countryPack.countryName}`;
  const solutionSnippet = canvas.proposedSolution?.trim()
    ? canvas.proposedSolution.trim().replace(/\.$/, '')
    : input.planTitle;
  const advantageSnippet = canvas.unfairAdvantage?.trim();

  const card1: BlindSpotItem = {
    id: 'live-bs-1-concept',
    category: 'OPERATIONAL_REALITY',
    severity: 'INFO',
    title: `🔌 1. Simplifying Version 1 for Your Target Buyers (Steps 1–2)`,
    explanation: `You are building "${solutionSnippet}" for "${customerSnippet}".${
      advantageSnippet
        ? ` To prove your unfair advantage ("${advantageSnippet.replace(/\.$/, '')}"),`
        : ' In this sector,'
    } busy customers rarely rip-and-replace their existing workflow on Day 1. Can a customer test your core value in under 15 minutes before you build complex integrations?`,
    suggestedAction:
      canvas.revenueAndGrantFit?.trim()
        ? `Test whether 5 buyers will commit to your pricing model ("${canvas.revenueAndGrantFit.trim().replace(/\.$/, '')}") using a simple pilot first.`
        : `Offer a zero-friction pilot at ${benchmarkPrice} before building advanced features.`,
  };

  // ============================================================================
  // CARD 2: STEP 3 — PERSONAL MOTIVATION, WEEKLY HOURS & 12-MONTH VISION
  // ============================================================================
  const hoursLabel =
    motivation.weeklyHoursAvailable === '5_TO_10_HRS'
      ? '5–10 hrs/week (evenings & weekends)'
      : motivation.weeklyHoursAvailable === '15_TO_25_HRS'
        ? '15–25 hrs/week (part-time focus)'
        : motivation.weeklyHoursAvailable === 'OTHER' &&
            motivation.otherWeeklyHoursText?.trim()
          ? motivation.otherWeeklyHoursText.trim()
          : '40+ hrs/week (full-time all-in)';

  const visionNote = motivation.twelveMonthSuccessVision?.trim();
  const visionSentence = visionNote
    ? ` You defined 12-month success as: "${visionNote.replace(/\.$/, '')}".`
    : '';

  let card2Title = '💼 2. Your "Leave the 9-to-5" Freedom Number (Step 3)';
  let card2Explanation = `You are committing ${hoursLabel} to replace your job income.${visionSentence} To hand in your notice safely, recurring monthly revenue is your best friend — focus on how many customers at ${benchmarkPrice} cover your core living costs.`;
  let card2Action =
    motivation.weeklyHoursAvailable === '5_TO_10_HRS'
      ? 'With 5–10 hrs/week, spend 80% of your time talking to buyers and pre-selling rather than coding alone at night.'
      : 'Prioritize fast-paying customers with a short sales cycle in Module B.';

  if (motivation.primaryMotivation === 'SIDE_HUSTLE') {
    card2Title = `🌙 2. Protecting Your ${hoursLabel} Side-Hustle Schedule (Step 3)`;
    card2Explanation = `Because you are building this as a side hustle on ${hoursLabel}, you cannot afford high-maintenance clients or daytime emergencies.${visionSentence} Make sure customers can onboard and get results asynchronously.`;
    card2Action =
      'Automate onboarding or package your offer as a fixed-scope productized service.';
  } else if (motivation.primaryMotivation === 'SAVE_THE_WORLD') {
    card2Title = '🌍 2. Fueling Your Mission with Sustainable Margin (Step 3)';
    card2Explanation = `You are putting in ${hoursLabel} toward a mission you care deeply about.${visionSentence} Mission-led startups make the biggest impact when they generate self-sustaining profit rather than relying purely on grants or founder burnout.`;
    card2Action = `Identify which customer segment has the budget to pay ${benchmarkPrice} today to fund your impact.`;
  } else if (motivation.primaryMotivation === 'SCALE_STARTUP') {
    card2Title = `🚀 2. High-Growth Pace vs. Your ${hoursLabel} Bandwidth (Step 3)`;
    card2Explanation = `You want to scale a high-growth startup (${
      input.exportPotential === 'EXPORTING_INTERNATIONALLY'
        ? `exporting beyond ${countryPack.countryName}`
        : `in ${countryPack.countryName}`
    }) while working ${hoursLabel}.${visionSentence} State agencies (${topGrant}) and investors will look for repeatable acquisition and early traction.`;
    card2Action =
      'Line up 5–10 Letters of Intent or paid pilots in Module B to prove scalable demand.';
  } else if (motivation.primaryMotivation === 'BUILD_TO_SELL') {
    card2Title = '🏆 2. Designing a Sellable Business Asset from Day 1 (Step 3)';
    card2Explanation = `Your goal is to build a valuable asset you can eventually sell while committing ${hoursLabel}.${visionSentence} Acquirers pay a multiple for recurring contracts and documented systems that run without the founder doing every job personally.`;
    card2Action =
      'Avoid one-off custom projects; lock in repeatable monthly or annual customer agreements.';
  } else if (motivation.primaryMotivation === 'OTHER') {
    const customMot = motivation.otherMotivationText?.trim() || 'your personal goals';
    card2Title = `✨ 2. Aligning Your ${hoursLabel} Schedule With Your Ambition (Step 3)`;
    card2Explanation = `You are committing ${hoursLabel} toward ${customMot}.${visionSentence} Make sure your Version 1 business model fits your weekly schedule and personal priorities.`;
    card2Action = `Validate 5 target buyers at ${benchmarkPrice} in Module B to confirm demand.`;
  }

  const card2: BlindSpotItem = {
    id: 'live-bs-2-motivation',
    category: 'OPERATIONAL_REALITY',
    severity:
      motivation.primaryMotivation === 'SCALE_STARTUP' &&
      motivation.weeklyHoursAvailable === '5_TO_10_HRS'
        ? 'WARNING'
        : 'INFO',
    title: card2Title,
    explanation: card2Explanation,
    suggestedAction: card2Action,
  };

  // ============================================================================
  // CARD 3: STEP 4 — TEAM SETUP, SKILL COVERAGE & MISSING ROLES
  // ============================================================================
  const teamLabel =
    team.teamStructureType === 'SOLO_FOUNDER'
      ? 'a Solo Founder'
      : team.teamStructureType === 'SEEKING_COFOUNDER'
        ? 'Solo (Looking for a Co-Founder)'
        : team.teamStructureType === 'COFOUNDER_TEAM'
          ? 'a Co-Founder Team (2+ Founders)'
          : team.teamStructureType === 'OTHER' &&
              team.otherTeamStructureText?.trim()
            ? team.otherTeamStructureText.trim()
            : 'Solo + Freelancers/Contractors';

  const teamNotes = team.teamAndFundingNotes?.trim();
  const teamNotesSentence = teamNotes
    ? ` You noted: "${teamNotes.replace(/\.$/, '')}".`
    : '';

  let card3Title = `👤 3. Team & Build Execution (${teamLabel} • Step 4)`;
  let card3Explanation = '';
  let card3Action = '';
  let card3Severity: 'INFO' | 'WARNING' = 'INFO';

  if (team.skillCoverage === 'NEED_EXTERNAL_BUILDER') {
    card3Severity = 'WARNING';
    card3Title = `🛠️ 3. Bridging Your Build Gap as ${teamLabel} (Step 4)`;
    card3Explanation = `You indicated you are ${teamLabel} and will need an external builder or technical partner to build Version 1.${teamNotesSentence} The #1 trap here is paying an agency thousands upfront or giving away 50% equity before proving customers will pay.`;
    card3Action =
      'Validate demand using a clickable mockup or manual "Concierge MVP" in Module B first — 5 pre-orders will make recruiting a builder 10x easier.';
  } else if (
    team.skillCoverage === 'PARTIAL_SKILLS' ||
    team.skillCoverage === 'OTHER'
  ) {
    card3Title = `🧩 3. Covering Your Missing Skill Gaps (${teamLabel} • Step 4)`;
    card3Explanation = `You are operating as ${teamLabel}${team.skillCoverage === 'OTHER' && team.otherSkillCoverageText?.trim() ? ` (${team.otherSkillCoverageText.trim()})` : ' with strong domain/commercial skills, but need support on part of the build'}.${teamNotesSentence} Keep Version 1 lean using no-code/off-the-shelf tools for the parts outside your core skillset.`;
    card3Action =
      team.teamStructureType === 'SEEKING_COFOUNDER'
        ? 'Use Module C to define the exact Startup Hats your future co-founder must own.'
        : 'Only pay specialists for narrow, fixed-price milestones after customer validation.';
  } else {
    card3Title = `✅ 3. In-House Build Advantage (${teamLabel} • Step 4)`;
    card3Explanation = `Because you are ${teamLabel} and have the skills in-house to build Version 1 yourself, you save huge upfront cash.${teamNotesSentence} However, the biggest blind spot for self-sufficient builders is spending months perfecting the product in isolation before talking to buyers.`;
    card3Action =
      team.teamStructureType === 'COFOUNDER_TEAM'
        ? 'Split roles clearly: one co-founder builds Version 1 while the other runs customer interviews in Module B.'
        : 'Follow a strict 50/50 rule: spend half your weekly hours talking to customers before adding new features.';
  }

  const card3: BlindSpotItem = {
    id: 'live-bs-3-team',
    category: 'OPERATIONAL_REALITY',
    severity: card3Severity,
    title: card3Title,
    explanation: card3Explanation,
    suggestedAction: card3Action,
  };

  // ============================================================================
  // CARD 4: STEP 4 & STEP 5 — STARTING CAPITAL, GRANT MATCHING & EQUITY CONTROL
  // ============================================================================
  const budgetLabel =
    team.startingBudgetBracket === 'ZERO_SWEAT_EQUITY'
      ? `${formatPlanCurrency(0, currency)} (Sweat Equity only)`
      : team.startingBudgetBracket === 'UNDER_1K'
        ? `Under ${formatPlanCurrency(1000, currency)}`
        : team.startingBudgetBracket === '1K_TO_5K'
          ? `${formatPlanCurrency(1000, currency)}–${formatPlanCurrency(5000, currency)}`
          : team.startingBudgetBracket === '5K_TO_25K'
            ? `${formatPlanCurrency(5000, currency)}–${formatPlanCurrency(25000, currency)}`
            : team.startingBudgetBracket === 'OTHER' &&
                team.otherBudgetText?.trim()
              ? team.otherBudgetText.trim()
              : `${formatPlanCurrency(25000, currency)}+`;

  const tradeoffLabel =
    reality.growthTradeoff === 'BOOTSTRAP_100_CONTROL'
      ? 'bootstrapping with 100% ownership'
      : reality.growthTradeoff === 'NON_DILUTIVE_GRANTS'
        ? `combining customer sales with non-dilutive ${countryPack.countryName} grants`
        : reality.growthTradeoff === 'SHARE_EQUITY_COFOUNDER'
          ? 'sharing equity with a co-founder'
          : reality.growthTradeoff === 'OTHER' &&
              reality.otherGrowthTradeoffText?.trim()
            ? reality.otherGrowthTradeoffText.trim()
            : 'raising Angel/VC investment';

  const isLeanBudget =
    team.startingBudgetBracket === 'ZERO_SWEAT_EQUITY' ||
    team.startingBudgetBracket === 'UNDER_1K';

  const card4: BlindSpotItem = {
    id: 'live-bs-4-budget',
    category: 'INDUSTRY_TRAP',
    severity:
      isLeanBudget && reality.growthTradeoff === 'NON_DILUTIVE_GRANTS'
        ? 'WARNING'
        : 'INFO',
    title: `💶 4. Your ${budgetLabel} Budget & Funding Strategy (Steps 4–5)`,
    explanation: isLeanBudget
      ? `You are starting with ${budgetLabel} and prefer ${tradeoffLabel}. Keep in mind that in ${countryPack.countryName}, state grants like ${topGrant} are usually paid on reimbursement — meaning you must pay supplier invoices upfront before claiming the grant back.`
      : `You have ${budgetLabel} available to invest and prefer ${tradeoffLabel}. Having savings ready gives you real runway (including upfront match-funding for ${topGrant}), but protect your capital fiercely before proving willingness-to-pay.`,
    suggestedAction: isLeanBudget
      ? `Use early customer pre-sales or paid deposits in ${currency} to generate your initial working capital.`
      : `Gate your ${budgetLabel} budget: spend no more than 15% until 5 target buyers confirm your pricing in Module B.`,
  };

  // ============================================================================
  // CARD 5: STEP 5 — INDUSTRY ACCESS, INCOME TIMELINE & YOUR DEALBREAKERS
  // ============================================================================
  const connectionText =
    reality.industryConnection === 'LIVED_IT_INSIDER'
      ? 'an Industry Insider with firsthand experience'
      : reality.industryConnection === 'WARM_CONNECTIONS'
        ? 'connected to 3–5 warm industry contacts'
        : reality.industryConnection === 'OTHER' &&
            reality.otherIndustryConnectionText?.trim()
          ? reality.otherIndustryConnectionText.trim()
          : 'starting cold as an industry outsider';

  const urgencyText =
    reality.personalIncomeUrgency === 'URGENT_1_TO_3M'
      ? 'need personal income within 1–3 months'
      : reality.personalIncomeUrgency === 'MEDIUM_6_TO_12M'
        ? 'aim to draw a personal wage within 6–12 months'
        : reality.personalIncomeUrgency === 'OTHER' &&
            reality.otherIncomeUrgencyText?.trim()
          ? reality.otherIncomeUrgencyText.trim()
          : 'have 12+ months of personal runway with no immediate wage pressure';

  const dealbreakersArr = Array.isArray(reality.dealbreakers) ? reality.dealbreakers : [];
  const dealbreakerList =
    dealbreakersArr.length > 0
      ? dealbreakersArr
          .map((d) =>
            d === 'OTHER' && reality.otherDealbreakerText?.trim()
              ? reality.otherDealbreakerText.trim()
              : DEALBREAKER_SHORT_LABELS[d]
          )
          .join(', ')
      : 'no strict lifestyle dealbreakers selected yet';

  const card5: BlindSpotItem = {
    id: 'live-bs-5-reality',
    category: 'OPERATIONAL_REALITY',
    severity:
      reality.personalIncomeUrgency === 'URGENT_1_TO_3M' ||
      reality.industryConnection === 'STARTING_COLD'
        ? 'WARNING'
        : 'INFO',
    title:
      reality.personalIncomeUrgency === 'URGENT_1_TO_3M'
        ? '⚡ 5. Urgent 1–3 Month Wage Timeline & Boundaries (Step 5)'
        : reality.industryConnection === 'STARTING_COLD'
          ? '🧭 5. Breaking In Cold & Respecting Your Boundaries (Step 5)'
          : '🛡️ 5. Aligning Industry Access, Wage Timeline & Dealbreakers (Step 5)',
    explanation: `You are ${connectionText}, ${urgencyText}, and want to avoid: ${dealbreakerList}. ${
      reality.personalIncomeUrgency === 'URGENT_1_TO_3M'
        ? 'Because you need cashflow in 1–3 months, skip slow builds and offer a paid pilot or service-first solution immediately.'
        : reality.industryConnection === 'STARTING_COLD'
          ? 'Because you are starting without warm contacts, do not build in secret — use your Module B Validation Survey as a research icebreaker to meet 10 insiders.'
          : 'Your industry access and timeline give you a strong foundation to validate pricing while designing the business around your lifestyle boundaries.'
    }`,
    suggestedAction: dealbreakersArr.includes('NO_COLD_SALES')
      ? 'Since you ruled out cold sales, focus Module B & E on warm referrals, local partnerships, or self-serve signups.'
      : dealbreakersArr.includes('NO_BIG_TEAM')
        ? 'Since you don’t want a large staff team, prioritize automation and repeatable digital delivery from Day 1.'
        : 'Message your first 5 target buyers this week to validate the problem before spending budget.',
  };

  // ============================================================================
  // CARD 6: STEP 5 — ACTION PLAN FOR YOUR #1 SECRET WORRY
  // ============================================================================
  const worryNotes = reality.biggestWorryNotes?.trim();
  const customWorrySuffix = worryNotes
    ? ` You also noted: "${worryNotes.replace(/\.$/, '')}".`
    : '';

  const worryPresets: Record<
    SavedFounderRealityCheck['biggestWorryPreset'],
    { title: string; explanation: string; action: string }
  > = {
    WILL_THEY_PAY: {
      title: '💳 6. Tackling Your #1 Worry: "Will Anyone Actually Pay?" (Step 5)',
      explanation: `It is completely normal to worry that buyers will say "nice idea" but stick with spreadsheets or doing nothing.${customWorrySuffix} The antidote is testing willingness-to-pay before you build.`,
      action: `In Module B, ask buyers what the problem currently costs them in ${currency} and test a concrete price point (${benchmarkPrice}).`,
    },
    FINDING_FIRST_10: {
      title:
        '📣 6. Tackling Your #1 Worry: "Finding My First 10 Customers" (Step 5)',
      explanation: `Most founders worry about how to get their first 10 customers without spending a fortune on ads.${customWorrySuffix} Your first 10 customers never come from scale marketing — they come from direct, helpful conversations.`,
      action: `Use the Module B shareable survey (/v/my-startup) to start 15 non-sales conversations in ${countryPack.countryName} this week.`,
    },
    HOW_TO_BUILD: {
      title:
        '🛠️ 6. Tackling Your #1 Worry: "How to Actually Build It" (Step 5)',
      explanation: `Feeling daunted by the technical or operational build is a healthy signal to simplify Version 1.${customWorrySuffix} Customers care about the outcome, not how complex the code is behind the scenes.`,
      action:
        'Strip Version 1 down to the single "Must-Have" workflow in Module C and deliver the first 3 pilots manually if needed.',
    },
    COMPETITION_OR_AI: {
      title:
        '🦈 6. Tackling Your #1 Worry: "Competitors or AI Copying Us" (Step 5)',
      explanation: `Worrying about larger competitors or generic AI tools is smart.${customWorrySuffix} Big incumbents move slowly and build bloated generic software — your edge is local trust, speed, and specialized workflow fit in ${countryPack.countryName}.`,
      action:
        'Lock in niche customer relationships and local compliance/workflow advantages that generic AI tools ignore.',
    },
    TIME_AND_ENERGY: {
      title:
        '🔋 6. Tackling Your #1 Worry: "Running Out of Time or Cash" (Step 5)',
      explanation: `Founder burnout happens when you try to do 20 things at once without clear validation milestones.${customWorrySuffix} With ${hoursLabel} and ${budgetLabel}, your superpower is ruthless focus.`,
      action:
        'Focus on one milestone at a time: validate 5 buyers in Module B before spending cash or late nights building.',
    },
    OTHER: {
      title: '✨ 6. Tackling Your Custom #1 Worry (Step 5)',
      explanation: `Every founder carries a specific question mark around their idea.${customWorrySuffix} The fastest way to de-risk an unknown is to test it directly with 5 real target buyers before committing major budget.`,
      action:
        'Turn your #1 worry into a specific validation question in Module B and test it with 5 target customers this week.',
    },
  };

  const chosenWorry =
    worryPresets[reality.biggestWorryPreset] || worryPresets.FINDING_FIRST_10;

  const card6: BlindSpotItem = {
    id: 'live-bs-6-worry',
    category: 'OPEN_QUESTION',
    severity: 'INFO',
    title: chosenWorry.title,
    explanation: chosenWorry.explanation,
    suggestedAction: chosenWorry.action,
  };

  return [card1, card2, card3, card4, card5, card6];
}
=== src/lib/ai/module-c-blindspots.ts ===
import type { BlindSpotItem } from '@/db/schema';
import type {
  SavedConceptCanvas,
  SavedCustomerInterviewLog,
  SavedModuleBData,
  SavedValidationSurvey,
} from '@/lib/auth/session-store';
import {
  getCountryRulePack,
  getGrantsForCountry,
  type SupportedCountryCode,
} from '@/lib/localization';

export interface DynamicModuleCBlindSpotInput {
  planTitle: string;
  industryCategory: string;
  hqCountryCode: SupportedCountryCode;
  exportPotential?: 'DOMESTIC_ONLY' | 'EXPORTING_INTERNATIONALLY' | boolean;
  conceptCanvas?: SavedConceptCanvas;
  moduleBData?: SavedModuleBData;
  surveys: SavedValidationSurvey[];
  activeSurvey?: SavedValidationSurvey;
  interviewLogs: SavedCustomerInterviewLog[];
}

/**
 * Strict guard: Module C Blind-Spot Checker & Validation Brief are ONLY unlocked
 * when the founder has at least one Customer Survey (with questions) OR at least
 * one logged 1-on-1 Customer Interview.
 */
export function hasModuleCValidationData(
  surveys: SavedValidationSurvey[] = [],
  interviewLogs: SavedCustomerInterviewLog[] = []
): boolean {
  const hasActiveSurvey = surveys.some(
    (s) => Array.isArray(s.questions) && s.questions.length > 0
  );
  const hasLoggedInterviews =
    Array.isArray(interviewLogs) && interviewLogs.length > 0;
  return hasActiveSurvey || hasLoggedInterviews;
}

/**
 * Generates 6 live, dynamic Module C ("Things to Consider") blind-spot cards
 * auditing the founder's Customer Surveys, "Mom Test" question quality,
 * real vs. simulated sample size, 1-on-1 Customer Interviews, politeness bias,
 * and early-bird waitlist conversion for Module D & Grant readiness.
 *
 * Returns `[]` if there are no surveys and no 1-on-1 interviews.
 */
export function buildDynamicModuleCBlindSpots(
  input: DynamicModuleCBlindSpotInput
): BlindSpotItem[] {
  const surveys = input.surveys || [];
  const interviewLogs = input.interviewLogs || [];

  if (!hasModuleCValidationData(surveys, interviewLogs)) {
    return [];
  }

  const countryPack = getCountryRulePack(input.hqCountryCode);
  const matchedGrants = getGrantsForCountry(input.hqCountryCode);
  const topGrant = matchedGrants[0];

  const validSurveys = surveys.filter((s) => s.questions.length > 0);
  const primarySurvey =
    input.activeSurvey && input.activeSurvey.questions.length > 0
      ? input.activeSurvey
      : validSurveys[0];

  const allQuestions = validSurveys.flatMap((s) => s.questions || []);
  const allResponses = validSurveys.flatMap((s) => s.responses || []);
  const realResponses = allResponses.filter((r) => !r.isSimulated);
  const simulatedResponses = allResponses.filter((r) => r.isSimulated);
  const waitlistResponses = allResponses.filter(
    (r) => r.joinedWaitlist && Boolean(r.respondentEmail?.trim())
  );
  const realWaitlistLeads = waitlistResponses.filter((r) => !r.isSimulated);

  const beachheadLabel =
    input.moduleBData?.beachhead?.beachheadSegment?.trim() ||
    input.conceptCanvas?.targetCustomer?.trim() ||
    'your target customer segment';

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // CARD 1: Sample Size & Real vs. Simulated Evidence Check
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const totalRealTouchpoints = realResponses.length + interviewLogs.length;

  const card1: BlindSpotItem =
    totalRealTouchpoints === 0
      ? {
          id: 'mod-c-bs-sample-size',
          category: 'Sample Size & Real-World Evidence',
          severity: 'WARNING',
          title:
            simulatedResponses.length > 0
              ? `Only Simulated Sample Responses Logged So Far (${simulatedResponses.length} Simulated, 0 Real)`
              : 'Zero Real Customer Responses or 1-on-1 Calls Logged Yet',
          explanation:
            simulatedResponses.length > 0
              ? `You have ${simulatedResponses.length} simulated test response(s) in your survey, which is great for previewing charts, but you have 0 real customer responses and 0 logged 1-on-1 interviews for ${input.planTitle}. Building Module D's product scope on unvalidated assumptions is the #1 cause of wasted V1 spend.`
              : `You have drafted your validation questions for ${input.planTitle}, but haven't collected any real survey responses or logged any 1-on-1 customer interviews yet.`,
          suggestedAction: primarySurvey
            ? `Publish & lock your "${primarySurvey.title || 'customer validation'}" survey link, send it to 15–20 people matching "${beachheadLabel}" using the Outreach Kit, or log at least 3–5 real 1-on-1 discovery calls before locking your V1 feature list in Module D.`
            : `Log at least 5 real 1-on-1 customer discovery calls with "${beachheadLabel}" or publish a public validation survey link to gather baseline evidence.`,
        }
      : totalRealTouchpoints < 10
        ? {
            id: 'mod-c-bs-sample-size',
            category: 'Sample Size & Statistical Signal',
            severity: 'WARNING',
            title: `Early Sample Size (${realResponses.length} Real Survey Response${realResponses.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} + ${interviewLogs.length} 1-on-1 Call${interviewLogs.length === 1 ? '' : 's'})`,
            explanation: `You have ${totalRealTouchpoints} real customer data point(s) across ${validSurveys.length} survey(s) and ${interviewLogs.length} 1-on-1 interview(s). Below 10–15 total touchpoints, a single vocal outlier can skew your feature and pricing decisions.`,
            suggestedAction: `Aim for at least 15 real survey responses and 5 logged 1-on-1 calls with "${beachheadLabel}" so recurring pain patterns become undeniable before Module D.`,
          }
        : {
            id: 'mod-c-bs-sample-size',
            category: 'Sample Size & Statistical Signal',
            severity: 'INFO',
            title: `Strong Primary Evidence Base (${realResponses.length} Real Survey Responses + ${interviewLogs.length} 1-on-1 Calls)`,
            explanation: `You have collected ${realResponses.length} real survey response(s) and ${interviewLogs.length} 1-on-1 customer interview(s) (${totalRealTouchpoints} real customer touchpoints total). This puts ${input.planTitle} ahead of 90% of early-stage founders who build in the dark.`,
            suggestedAction: `Segment your top respondents by pain severity so you only design your V1 product (Module D) around the highest-urgency buyers, not casual browsers.`,
          };

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // CARD 2: Quantitative Survey vs. Qualitative 1-on-1 Balance
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const card2: BlindSpotItem =
    validSurveys.length > 0 && interviewLogs.length === 0
      ? {
          id: 'mod-c-bs-method-balance',
          category: 'Surveys vs. 1-on-1 Discovery Balance',
          severity: 'WARNING',
          title: `Surveys Created (${validSurveys.length}), But 0 1-on-1 Customer Interviews Logged`,
          explanation: `Multiple-choice surveys tell you WHAT percentage of people experience a problem, but they rarely reveal the emotional trigger, internal approval politics, or exact workaround workflow behind WHY they would switch to ${input.planTitle}.`,
          suggestedAction:
            waitlistResponses.length > 0
              ? `You already have ${waitlistResponses.length} waitlist lead(s)! Click "Log 1-on-1 Call" next to 3 of those leads in your Waitlist tab and run a 10-minute Mom-Test chat.`
              : `Switch to the "1-on-1 Customer Interviews" section in Module C and log at least 3 live 10-minute calls (Phone, Zoom, or Coffee Chat) alongside your survey.`,
        }
      : validSurveys.length === 0 && interviewLogs.length > 0
        ? {
            id: 'mod-c-bs-method-balance',
            category: 'Surveys vs. 1-on-1 Discovery Balance',
            severity: 'INFO',
            title: `${interviewLogs.length} 1-on-1 Interview${interviewLogs.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} Logged Without a Broad Survey Funnel`,
            explanation: `Your ${interviewLogs.length} 1-on-1 interview(s) provide rich qualitative quotes and deep context, which is fantastic. However, without an async public validation survey, you may miss broader quantitative pattern matching and automated waitlist email capture.`,
            suggestedAction: `Consider launching a 5-question Mom-Test survey in Module C using the problems uncovered in your 1-on-1 calls to test if the same pain holds true across 25+ people in "${beachheadLabel}".`,
          }
        : {
            id: 'mod-c-bs-method-balance',
            category: 'Surveys vs. 1-on-1 Discovery Balance',
            severity: 'INFO',
            title: `Balanced Hybrid Validation (${validSurveys.length} Survey${validSurveys.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} + ${interviewLogs.length} 1-on-1 Interview${interviewLogs.length === 1 ? '' : 's'})`,
            explanation: `Combining async survey data (${allResponses.length} total responses) with ${interviewLogs.length} 1-on-1 interview(s) gives you both statistical breadth and verbatim qualitative depth.`,
            suggestedAction: `Cross-check whether the #1 frustration selected in your survey matches the exact stories shared in your 1-on-1 calls. Any mismatch is a high-value positioning insight for Module G.`,
          };

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // CARD 3: "Mom Test" Bias & Tamper-Proof Integrity Audit
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const failedMomTestQuestions = allQuestions.filter((q) => !q.momTestPassed);
  const openTextQuestions = allQuestions.filter((q) => q.type === 'OPEN_TEXT');
  const unpublishedSurveys = validSurveys.filter((s) => !s.isPublished);

  const card3: BlindSpotItem =
    allQuestions.length > 0 && failedMomTestQuestions.length > 0
      ? {
          id: 'mod-c-bs-mom-test-bias',
          category: 'Mom-Test Bias & Question Integrity',
          severity: 'WARNING',
          title: `${failedMomTestQuestions.length} of ${allQuestions.length} Survey Question${failedMomTestQuestions.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} Flagged for Hypothetical / Pitch Bias`,
          explanation: `Questions like "Would you buy X?" or leading feature pitches invite polite compliments rather than factual truth. ${failedMomTestQuestions.length} question(s) in your survey have not passed the Mom Test check yet.`,
          suggestedAction: `Use the "Mom-Test Check & Rewrite" button in the Survey Builder to reframe flagged questions around past behavior ("When was the last time you dealt with...") before sharing your link.`,
        }
      : validSurveys.length > 0 && unpublishedSurveys.length > 0
        ? {
            id: 'mod-c-bs-mom-test-bias',
            category: 'Mom-Test Bias & Survey Lock Integrity',
            severity: 'INFO',
            title: `${unpublishedSurveys.length} Survey${unpublishedSurveys.length === 1 ? ' Is' : 's Are'} Still in Editable Draft Mode`,
            explanation: `All ${allQuestions.length} survey questions pass the Mom Test (${openTextQuestions.length} open-text question${openTextQuestions.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} included), but ${unpublishedSurveys.map((s) => `"${s.title}"`).join(', ')} has not been Published & Locked yet.`,
            suggestedAction: `Click "Publish & Lock Survey" before distributing your link externally so investors, accelerators, and grant assessors can trust that questions were never altered after responses arrived.`,
          }
        : {
            id: 'mod-c-bs-mom-test-bias',
            category: 'Mom-Test Bias & Evidence Integrity',
            severity: 'INFO',
            title:
              validSurveys.length > 0
                ? `100% Mom-Test Checked & Tamper-Proof Published Survey`
                : `1-on-1 Discovery Anchored in Past Customer Behavior`,
            explanation:
              validSurveys.length > 0
                ? `Your survey questions focus on concrete past behavior rather than hypotheticals, and your published survey is locked against retroactive edits.`
                : `Logging structured 1-on-1 interviews with concrete workaround notes and pain scores protects ${input.planTitle} from "false positive" politeness.`,
            suggestedAction: `Keep capturing exact verbatim customer phrases — those raw words will become your highest-converting landing page headline in Module G.`,
          };

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // CARD 4: "Polite Compliments" vs. Concrete Commitment Signal
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const politeFluffInterviews = interviewLogs.filter(
    (i) =>
      i.signalBadge === 'POLITE_FLUFF' ||
      i.commitmentOutcome === 'POLITE_COMPLIMENTS_ONLY'
  );
  const highSignalInterviews = interviewLogs.filter(
    (i) =>
      i.signalBadge === 'STRONG_SIGNAL' ||
      i.commitmentOutcome === 'ASKED_TO_PILOT_OR_BUY' ||
      i.commitmentOutcome === 'SHARED_DEEP_WORKFLOW_PAIN' ||
      i.commitmentOutcome === 'INTRODUCED_PEERS'
  );
  const avgInterviewPain =
    interviewLogs.length > 0
      ? Number(
          (
            interviewLogs.reduce((acc, i) => acc + i.painScore1To5, 0) /
            interviewLogs.length
          ).toFixed(1)
        )
      : null;
  const aiSignalScore = primarySurvey?.aiInsightsSummary?.signalScoreOutOf100;

  const card4: BlindSpotItem =
    interviewLogs.length > 0 &&
    politeFluffInterviews.length >= Math.ceil(interviewLogs.length / 2)
      ? {
          id: 'mod-c-bs-politeness-trap',
          category: 'Polite Compliments vs. Real Commitment',
          severity: 'WARNING',
          title: `High "Polite Fluff" Ratio (${politeFluffInterviews.length} of ${interviewLogs.length} Interviews Ended in Compliments Only)`,
          explanation: `In ${politeFluffInterviews.length} of your ${interviewLogs.length} logged interviews (Avg Pain: ${avgInterviewPain}/5), interviewees said nice things about ${input.planTitle} without offering a concrete next step (waitlist signup, intro, or pilot commitment). In The Mom Test, compliments without commitment are a polite "no".`,
          suggestedAction: `End every 1-on-1 call with a concrete commitment test: ask for a warm intro to a peer, a 15-minute workflow shadow session, or a paid beta reservation. If they hesitate, ask what makes the problem a "nice-to-solve" instead of a "must-solve".`,
        }
      : typeof aiSignalScore === 'number' && aiSignalScore < 55
        ? {
            id: 'mod-c-bs-politeness-trap',
            category: 'Polite Compliments vs. Real Commitment',
            severity: 'WARNING',
            title: `Moderate Validation Signal Score (${aiSignalScore}/100) — Watch for Lukewarm Interest`,
            explanation: `Your AI Survey Synthesis scored customer urgency at ${aiSignalScore}/100 (${primarySurvey?.aiInsightsSummary?.politenessAlertOrRisks?.[0] || 'Several respondents reported mild inconvenience rather than hair-on-fire urgency'}).`,
            suggestedAction: `Narrow your target persona in Module B/D to the specific sub-segment of respondents who reported weekly/daily pain and opted into your early-bird waitlist.`,
          }
        : {
            id: 'mod-c-bs-politeness-trap',
            category: 'Polite Compliments vs. Real Commitment',
            severity: 'INFO',
            title:
              highSignalInterviews.length > 0
                ? `${highSignalInterviews.length} High-Intent Interview Commitment${highSignalInterviews.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} Logged${avgInterviewPain ? ` (Avg Pain ${avgInterviewPain}/5)` : ''}`
                : typeof aiSignalScore === 'number'
                  ? `Strong Customer Urgency Signal (${aiSignalScore}/100 AI Validation Score)`
                  : 'Run AI Signal Synthesis to Audit Politeness Risk',
            explanation:
              highSignalInterviews.length > 0
                ? `${highSignalInterviews.length} of your ${interviewLogs.length} 1-on-1 interviewees backed up their words with real skin in the game (asking to pilot/buy, joining the waitlist, or introducing peers).`
                : typeof aiSignalScore === 'number'
                  ? `Your survey responses show genuine problem frequency and concrete workarounds rather than passive compliments.`
                  : `Once you have collected responses, run the AI Sentiment Synthesizer on Tab 3 to separate genuine problem urgency from polite compliments.`,
            suggestedAction: `Prioritize the exact workflow bottleneck described by your highest-pain respondents when filtering your V1 feature list in Module D.`,
          };

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // CARD 5: Workaround Spend & Willingness-to-Pay Evidence (Feeds Module D & F)
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const hasSpendSurveyQuestion =
    validSurveys.some((s) =>
      s.focusAreas?.includes('PAST_SPENDING_BUDGET')
    ) ||
    allQuestions.some((q) =>
      /spend|cost|pay|budget|price|money|hour|time/i.test(q.questionText)
    );
  const interviewsWithWorkaroundSpend = interviewLogs.filter(
    (i) => i.workaroundAndSpend && i.workaroundAndSpend.trim().length > 8
  );

  const card5: BlindSpotItem =
    !hasSpendSurveyQuestion && interviewsWithWorkaroundSpend.length === 0
      ? {
          id: 'mod-c-bs-workaround-spend',
          category: 'Willingness-to-Pay & Workaround Spend',
          severity: 'WARNING',
          title:
            'Missing Evidence on What Customers Currently Spend (Money or Hours)',
          explanation: `Neither your survey questions nor your 1-on-1 interview logs currently capture what "${beachheadLabel}" already spends (in money or wasted staff hours) on duct-tape workarounds. Without a baseline cost of the status quo, pricing ${input.planTitle} in Module F will be guesswork.`,
          suggestedAction: `Ask in your survey or next 1-on-1 call: "What are you currently using to handle this today, and roughly how much money or time does that workaround cost you each month?"`,
        }
      : {
          id: 'mod-c-bs-workaround-spend',
          category: 'Willingness-to-Pay & Workaround Spend',
          severity: 'INFO',
          title: `Status-Quo Workaround & Budget Anchors Captured (${interviewsWithWorkaroundSpend.length} Interview Log${interviewsWithWorkaroundSpend.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}${hasSpendSurveyQuestion ? ' + Survey Spend Question' : ''})`,
          explanation: `You are actively tracking what customers already spend in time and money on existing workarounds. This gives you a factual anchor for both V1 scope (Module D) and Pocket Profit pricing (Module F).`,
          suggestedAction: `When you move to Module F (Pricing Architect), anchor your price against the monthly cost or time wasted on the customer's current workaround rather than pricing based on your build costs.`,
        };

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // CARD 6: Waitlist Conversion & Non-Dilutive Grant Evidence (`countryPack`)
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const pilotCallLeads = interviewLogs.filter(
    (i) =>
      i.commitmentOutcome === 'ASKED_TO_PILOT_OR_BUY' ||
      i.commitmentOutcome === 'INTRODUCED_PEERS'
  );
  const totalWarmLeads = realWaitlistLeads.length + pilotCallLeads.length;

  // Also check if any custom "OTHER" channel or outcome was used (GEMINI.md Rule 1.5)
  const customChannelInterviews = interviewLogs.filter(
    (i) => i.channel === 'OTHER' && i.otherChannelText?.trim()
  );
  const customOutcomeInterviews = interviewLogs.filter(
    (i) =>
      i.commitmentOutcome === 'OTHER' && i.otherCommitmentText?.trim()
  );
  const customEdgeNote =
    customChannelInterviews.length > 0 || customOutcomeInterviews.length > 0
      ? ` (including custom discovery channels/outcomes: ${[
          ...customChannelInterviews.map((i) => i.otherChannelText?.trim()),
          ...customOutcomeInterviews.map((i) =>
            i.otherCommitmentText?.trim()
          ),
        ]
          .filter(Boolean)
          .slice(0, 2)
          .join(', ')})`
      : '';

  const card6: BlindSpotItem = {
    id: 'mod-c-bs-waitlist-grant-fit',
    category: `${countryPack.countryName} Grant & First-10-Customers Pipeline`,
    severity: totalWarmLeads === 0 ? 'WARNING' : 'INFO',
    title:
      totalWarmLeads === 0
        ? `0 Early-Bird Waitlist Emails or Pilot Commitments Captured Yet`
        : `${totalWarmLeads} Warm Early-Bird / Pilot Lead${totalWarmLeads === 1 ? '' : 's'} Ready for Module D & G${customEdgeNote}`,
    explanation:
      totalWarmLeads === 0
        ? `Validation shouldn't just produce charts — it should build your first pipeline of beta buyers. In ${countryPack.countryName}, programs like ${topGrant ? topGrant.grantName : 'local feasibility grants'} and angel investors look for documented primary market research and named early-adopter interest.`
        : `You have captured ${realWaitlistLeads.length} real survey waitlist lead(s) (${waitlistResponses.length} including samples) and ${pilotCallLeads.length} high-intent 1-on-1 interview lead(s)${customEdgeNote}. In ${countryPack.countryName}, this primary validation log directly strengthens ${topGrant ? topGrant.grantName : 'grant & investor'} applications in Module H & Module I.`,
    suggestedAction:
      totalWarmLeads === 0
        ? `Enable "Collect Early-Bird Waitlist Emails" on your survey with a clear beta incentive, and ask every 1-on-1 interviewee if they want early access when your V1 launches.`
        : `Export your Module C Customer Validation Brief below as proof of primary market demand, then carry these ${totalWarmLeads} warm lead(s) into Module D (V1 Scope) and Module G (First 10 Customers Playbook).`,
  };

  return [card1, card2, card3, card4, card5, card6];
}

export function getSlotDefinition(slotKey: PartnerSlotKey): PartnerSlotDefinition {
  return (
    PARTNER_SLOT_DEFINITIONS.find((s) => s.slotKey === slotKey) ||
    PARTNER_SLOT_DEFINITIONS[0]
  );
}

export function getWarmIntroQuestionsForPartner(
  partner: PartnerOfferRecord
): WarmIntroQuestionField[] {
  if (
    Array.isArray(partner.warmIntroQuestionsJson) &&
    partner.warmIntroQuestionsJson.length > 0
  ) {
    return partner.warmIntroQuestionsJson;
  }
  return getSlotDefinition(partner.slotKey).defaultWarmIntroQuestions;
}

// =========================================================================
// BROWSER LOCALSTORAGE CACHE & OFFLINE FALLBACK HELPERS
// =========================================================================
const LOCAL_PARTNER_OFFERS_KEY = 'spf_admin_partner_offers_v2';
const LOCAL_REFERRAL_EVENTS_KEY = 'spf_admin_partner_referral_events_v2';

export function loadLocalPartnerOffers(): PartnerOfferRecord[] {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return DEFAULT_PARTNER_OFFERS;
  try {
    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_PARTNER_OFFERS_KEY);
    if (!raw) return DEFAULT_PARTNER_OFFERS;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0
      ? parsed
      : DEFAULT_PARTNER_OFFERS;
  } catch {
    return DEFAULT_PARTNER_OFFERS;
  }
}

export function saveLocalPartnerOffers(offers: PartnerOfferRecord[]): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(LOCAL_PARTNER_OFFERS_KEY, JSON.stringify(offers));
  } catch {
    // ignore storage quota errors
  }
}

export function loadLocalReferralEvents(): PartnerReferralEventRecord[] {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return [];
  try {
    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_REFERRAL_EVENTS_KEY);
    if (!raw) return [];
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

export function saveLocalReferralEvents(events: PartnerReferralEventRecord[]): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(LOCAL_REFERRAL_EVENTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(events));
  } catch {
    // ignore storage quota errors
  }
}

/**
 * Resolves dynamic macros ({domain}, {planId}, {country}) in a partner's referralUrl.
 */
export function resolvePartnerReferralUrl(
  rawUrl: string,
  context?: {
    planId?: string;
    domain?: string;
    countryCode?: string;
  }
): string {
  let url = (rawUrl || '').trim();
  if (!url) return 'https://startuppreflight.com';

  const cleanDomain = (context?.domain || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const cleanPlanId = (context?.planId || 'direct').trim();
  const cleanCountry = (context?.countryCode || 'IE').trim().toUpperCase();

  url = url
    .replace(/\{domain\}/gi, encodeURIComponent(cleanDomain))
    .replace(/\{planId\}/gi, encodeURIComponent(cleanPlanId))
    .replace(/\{projectId\}/gi, encodeURIComponent(cleanPlanId))
    .replace(/\{country\}/gi, encodeURIComponent(cleanCountry));

  return url;
}
=== src/lib/telemetry/device-detector.ts ===
/**
 * Zero-dependency client-side device & environment telemetry detector.
 * Extracts hardware form-factor, OS, browser, viewport, pixel ratio, and touch capability.
 */

export interface DeviceTelemetry {
  deviceType: 'Desktop' | 'Mobile' | 'Tablet';
  os: string;
  browser: string;
  screenResolution: string;
  viewport: string;
  pixelRatio: number;
  isTouch: boolean;
  orientation: 'Portrait' | 'Landscape';
  summary: string;
  rawUserAgent: string;
}

export function detectDeviceTelemetry(): DeviceTelemetry {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof navigator === 'undefined') {
    return {
      deviceType: 'Desktop',
      os: 'Unknown (Server)',
      browser: 'Unknown',
      screenResolution: 'N/A',
      viewport: 'N/A',
      pixelRatio: 1,
      isTouch: false,
      orientation: 'Landscape',
      summary: 'Server Environment',
      rawUserAgent: '',
    };
  }

  const ua = navigator.userAgent || '';
  const width = window.innerWidth || 0;
  const height = window.innerHeight || 0;
  const screenWidth = window.screen?.width || width;
  const screenHeight = window.screen?.height || height;
  const pixelRatio = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  const isTouch =
    'ontouchstart' in window ||
    navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0 ||
    ((navigator as unknown as { msMaxTouchPoints?: number }).msMaxTouchPoints || 0) > 0;

  const orientation: 'Portrait' | 'Landscape' = height > width ? 'Portrait' : 'Landscape';

  // 1. Detect Operating System
  let os = 'Unknown OS';
  if (/iPhone/i.test(ua)) {
    const match = ua.match(/OS (\d+[_\.]\d+)/);
    os = match ? `iOS ${match[1].replace('_', '.')}` : 'iOS';
  } else if (/iPad/i.test(ua)) {
    const match = ua.match(/OS (\d+[_\.]\d+)/);
    os = match ? `iPadOS ${match[1].replace('_', '.')}` : 'iPadOS';
  } else if (/Macintosh|Mac OS X/i.test(ua)) {
    // Note: iPads on iPadOS 13+ report as Mac by default with touch points > 1
    if (isTouch && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1) {
      os = 'iPadOS (Mac WebKit)';
    } else {
      os = 'macOS';
    }
  } else if (/Android/i.test(ua)) {
    const match = ua.match(/Android (\d+(\.\d+)?)/);
    os = match ? `Android ${match[1]}` : 'Android';
  } else if (/Windows NT 10.0/i.test(ua)) {
    os = 'Windows 10/11';
  } else if (/Windows/i.test(ua)) {
    os = 'Windows';
  } else if (/Linux/i.test(ua)) {
    os = 'Linux';
  } else if (/CrOS/i.test(ua)) {
    os = 'ChromeOS';
  }

  // 2. Detect Browser
  let browser = 'Unknown Browser';
  if (/Edg\//i.test(ua)) {
    const match = ua.match(/Edg\/(\d+)/);
    browser = match ? `Edge ${match[1]}` : 'Edge';
  } else if (/OPR\//i.test(ua) || /Opera/i.test(ua)) {
    browser = 'Opera';
  } else if (/SamsungBrowser/i.test(ua)) {
    const match = ua.match(/SamsungBrowser\/(\d+)/);
    browser = match ? `Samsung Internet ${match[1]}` : 'Samsung Internet';
  } else if (/Chrome\//i.test(ua) && !/Edg/i.test(ua)) {
    const match = ua.match(/Chrome\/(\d+)/);
    browser = match ? `Chrome ${match[1]}` : 'Chrome';
  } else if (/CriOS\//i.test(ua)) {
    const match = ua.match(/CriOS\/(\d+)/);
    browser = match ? `Chrome iOS ${match[1]}` : 'Chrome iOS';
  } else if (/FxiOS\//i.test(ua)) {
    const match = ua.match(/FxiOS\/(\d+)/);
    browser = match ? `Firefox iOS ${match[1]}` : 'Firefox iOS';
  } else if (/Firefox\//i.test(ua)) {
    const match = ua.match(/Firefox\/(\d+)/);
    browser = match ? `Firefox ${match[1]}` : 'Firefox';
  } else if (/Version\/(\d+).*Safari/i.test(ua) || (/Safari/i.test(ua) && /Apple/i.test(navigator.vendor))) {
    const match = ua.match(/Version\/(\d+)/);
    browser = match ? `Safari ${match[1]}` : 'Safari';
  }

  // 3. Detect Device Type (Desktop vs Mobile vs Tablet)
  let deviceType: 'Desktop' | 'Mobile' | 'Tablet' = 'Desktop';
  const isTabletUa = /iPad|Tablet|PlayBook|Silk/i.test(ua) || (os.includes('iPadOS'));
  const isMobileUa = /iPhone|iPod|Android.*Mobile|BlackBerry|IEMobile|Opera Mini|webOS/i.test(ua);

  if (isTabletUa || (isTouch && Math.min(width, height) >= 600 && Math.max(width, height) <= 1366)) {
    deviceType = 'Tablet';
  } else if (isMobileUa || (isTouch && Math.min(width, height) < 600)) {
    deviceType = 'Mobile';
  } else {
    deviceType = 'Desktop';
  }

  const viewport = `${width}×${height}px`;
  const screenResolution = `${screenWidth}×${screenHeight}px`;

  // Build high-density human readable summary
  const touchTag = isTouch ? 'Touch' : 'Pointer';
  const retinaTag = pixelRatio > 1 ? `@${pixelRatio.toFixed(1)}x` : '';
  const summary = `${deviceType} (${os} · ${browser} · ${viewport} ${retinaTag} · ${touchTag})`
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();

  return {
    deviceType,
    os,
    browser,
    screenResolution,
    viewport,
    pixelRatio,
    isTouch,
    orientation,
    summary,
    rawUserAgent: ua,
  };
}

/**
 * Formal Executive Letter of Intent (LOI) & Pilot Agreement Document Generator.
 * Formats a clean, executive, printable HTML document tailored for
 * prospective customer sign-off and Irish LEO / UK Innovate UK grant evaluators.
 */

import { escapeDocumentHtml as escapeHtml } from '@/lib/export/document-shell';

export interface LetterOfIntentDocumentData {
  startupName: string;
  targetCompanyName: string;
  targetContactName: string;
  pilotDurationWeeks: number;
  pilotPricePoint: string;
  primarySuccessKpi: string;
  customTermsText?: string;
  hqCountryCode?: string;
  baseCurrency?: string;
  dateStr?: string;
}

export function generateLetterOfIntentMarkdown(params: {
  startupName: string;
  targetCompanyName: string;
  targetContactName: string;
  pilotDurationWeeks: number;
  pilotPricePoint: string;
  primarySuccessKpi: string;
  customTermsText?: string;
  hqCountryCode?: string;
  baseCurrency?: string;
}): string {
  const startup = params.startupName?.trim() || 'Our Startup';
  const company = params.targetCompanyName?.trim() || '[Prospective Customer Company]';
  const contact = params.targetContactName?.trim() || '[Decision Maker Name / Title]';
  const duration = params.pilotDurationWeeks || 4;
  const price = params.pilotPricePoint?.trim() || 'Agreed Preferential Early Adopter Rate';
  const kpi =
    params.primarySuccessKpi?.trim() ||
    'Measurable reduction in operational turnaround time and overhead cost';
  const jurisdictionText =
    params.hqCountryCode === 'GB'
      ? 'recognized under UK commercial standards (aligned with Innovate UK / British Business Bank customer validation benchmarks)'
      : 'recognized under Irish commercial standards (aligned with Enterprise Ireland & LEO Feasibility/Priming validation benchmarks)';
  const extra = params.customTermsText?.trim()
    ? `\n\n### 5. Specific Pilot Governance & Addenda\n${params.customTermsText.trim()}`
    : '';

  return `# NON-BINDING EARLY ADOPTER LETTER OF INTENT (LOI)

**Date:** ${new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' })}  
**Between:** **${startup}** ("Provider")  
**And:** **${company}** ("Prospective Early Adopter Partner")  
**Attention:** ${contact}

---

### 1. Statement of Commercial Intent
This Letter of Intent ("LOI") confirms that **${company}** intends to participate in a structured commercial pilot program evaluating the proprietary solution provided by **${startup}**, aimed directly at resolving acute workflow friction, operational overhead, and efficiency constraints.

### 2. Pilot Scope & Evaluation Period
- **Pilot Duration:** ${duration} Weeks from production deployment / onboarding.
- **Scope:** Evaluated across agreed representative end-users or active workflow instances within ${company}.
- **Primary Success KPI Benchmark:** ${kpi}.

### 3. Early Adopter Commercial Pricing Terms
- **Preferential Pilot / First-Year Fee:** **${price}** (guaranteed locked-in rate for Early Adopter Cohort).
- **No-Obligation Clause:** This LOI represents a statement of genuine commercial interest and mutual commitment to test, evaluate, and provide qualitative feedback. It is not an irrevocable commitment to purchase until the defined pilot success metrics are verified and formal service contracts are executed.

### 4. Mutual Commercial Benefit & Assessment
Both parties agree to conduct bi-weekly checkpoint reviews during the pilot. Upon successful demonstration that the primary KPI benchmark (${kpi}) has been achieved, **${company}** will explore transitioning into a recurring enterprise commercial agreement under the terms established above.

This document is ${jurisdictionText}.${extra}

---

**For Prospective Partner (${company}):**  
Signature: ___________________________  
Name / Title: ${contact}  
Date: _______________________________  

**For Provider (${startup}):**  
Signature: ___________________________  
Founder / Executive: _________________  
Date: _______________________________  
`;
}

                  ? '🇬🇧 British Business Bank Start Up Loans 4-Part Workbook'

  return renderBmuStandaloneHtmlDocument({
    documentTitle: `${data.planTitle} — Grants & Funding Strategy Dossier`,
    eyebrow: data.whiteLabelEnabled
      ? `${data.planTitle.toUpperCase()} • GRANTS &amp; FUNDING STRATEGY DOSSIER`
      : 'STARTUP PREFLIGHT • MODULE K NON-DILUTIVE FUNDING DOSSIER',
    planTitle: data.planTitle,
    founderName: data.founderName,
    countryName: isUK ? 'United Kingdom' : 'Ireland',
    currency: isUK ? '£' : '€',
    industryCategory: data.industryCategory,
    dateStr: new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-GB', {
      day: 'numeric',
      month: 'short',
      year: 'numeric',
    }),
    scopeValue: isUK ? 'Innovate UK & SEIS' : 'LEO & Enterprise Ireland',
    sectionsHtml: bodyContentHtml,
    footerCtaHtml: `<strong>Ready for Module L (Official Business Plan &amp; Grant Compiler)?</strong>
      Your Module K Non-Dilutive Grants &amp; Funding Strategy Dossier is complete. Proceed to Module L inside Startup Preflight to compile your official grant applications, append matching bank verification, and generate assessor-ready PDF packs.`,
  });
}

import type { BlindSpotItem } from '@/db/schema';

export interface ModuleABriefData {

export function formatStartingBudgetBracket(
  bracket: StartingBudgetBracket,
  currency: 'EUR' | 'GBP' | 'USD' | 'AUD' | 'CAD',
  otherBudgetText?: string
): string {
  switch (bracket) {
    case 'ZERO_SWEAT_EQUITY':
      return `🌱 ${formatPlanCurrency(0, currency)} (Sweat Equity Only)`;
    case 'UNDER_1K':
      return `☕ Under ${formatPlanCurrency(1000, currency)}`;
    case '1K_TO_5K':
      return `🧱 ${formatPlanCurrency(1000, currency)} – ${formatPlanCurrency(5000, currency)}`;
    case '5K_TO_25K':
      return `🚀 ${formatPlanCurrency(5000, currency)} – ${formatPlanCurrency(25000, currency)}`;
    case 'OVER_25K':
      return `🏦 ${formatPlanCurrency(25000, currency)}+`;
    case 'OTHER':
      return otherBudgetText?.trim()
        ? `✨ Other: ${otherBudgetText.trim()}`
        : `✨ Other (${currency} Custom Budget)`;
  }
}

/**
 * Generates a clean Markdown / Plain-Text summary for "Copy to Clipboard".
 */
export function buildModuleAMarkdownBrief(data: ModuleABriefData): string {
  const countryPack = getCountryRulePack(data.hqCountryCode);
  const grants = getGrantsForCountry(data.hqCountryCode);
  const topGrant = grants[0]?.grantName || 'Local Enterprise Support';
  const currency = countryPack.defaultCurrency;
  const dateStr = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-IE', {
    day: 'numeric',
    month: 'short',
    year: 'numeric',
  });

  const budgetText = formatStartingBudgetBracket(
    data.teamAndBudget.startingBudgetBracket,
    currency,
    data.teamAndBudget.otherBudgetText
  );
  const motivationText =
    data.founderMotivation.primaryMotivation === 'OTHER' &&
    data.founderMotivation.otherMotivationText?.trim()
      ? `✨ Other: ${data.founderMotivation.otherMotivationText.trim()}`
      : MOTIVATION_LABELS[data.founderMotivation.primaryMotivation];
  const weeklyHoursText =
    data.founderMotivation.weeklyHoursAvailable === 'OTHER' &&
    data.founderMotivation.otherWeeklyHoursText?.trim()
      ? `✨ Other: ${data.founderMotivation.otherWeeklyHoursText.trim()}`
      : WEEKLY_HOURS_LABELS[data.founderMotivation.weeklyHoursAvailable];
  const teamSetupText =
    data.teamAndBudget.teamStructureType === 'OTHER' &&
    data.teamAndBudget.otherTeamStructureText?.trim()
      ? `✨ Other: ${data.teamAndBudget.otherTeamStructureText.trim()}`
      : TEAM_STRUCTURE_LABELS[data.teamAndBudget.teamStructureType];
  const skillCoverageText =
    data.teamAndBudget.skillCoverage === 'OTHER' &&
    data.teamAndBudget.otherSkillCoverageText?.trim()
      ? `✨ Other: ${data.teamAndBudget.otherSkillCoverageText.trim()}`
      : SKILL_COVERAGE_LABELS[data.teamAndBudget.skillCoverage];
  const industryConnectionText =
    data.founderRealityCheck.industryConnection === 'OTHER' &&
    data.founderRealityCheck.otherIndustryConnectionText?.trim()
      ? `✨ Other: ${data.founderRealityCheck.otherIndustryConnectionText.trim()}`
      : INDUSTRY_CONNECTION_LABELS[data.founderRealityCheck.industryConnection];
  const incomeUrgencyText =
    data.founderRealityCheck.personalIncomeUrgency === 'OTHER' &&
    data.founderRealityCheck.otherIncomeUrgencyText?.trim()
      ? `✨ Other: ${data.founderRealityCheck.otherIncomeUrgencyText.trim()}`
      : INCOME_URGENCY_LABELS[data.founderRealityCheck.personalIncomeUrgency];
  const growthTradeoffText =
    data.founderRealityCheck.growthTradeoff === 'OTHER' &&
    data.founderRealityCheck.otherGrowthTradeoffText?.trim()
      ? `✨ Other: ${data.founderRealityCheck.otherGrowthTradeoffText.trim()}`
      : GROWTH_TRADEOFF_LABELS[data.founderRealityCheck.growthTradeoff];
  const dealbreakersArr = Array.isArray(data.founderRealityCheck?.dealbreakers)
    ? data.founderRealityCheck.dealbreakers
    : [];
  const dealbreakersText =
    dealbreakersArr.length > 0
      ? dealbreakersArr
          .map((d) =>
            d === 'OTHER' && data.founderRealityCheck.otherDealbreakerText?.trim()
              ? `  - ✨ Other: ${data.founderRealityCheck.otherDealbreakerText.trim()}`
              : `  - ${DEALBREAKER_LABELS[d]}`
          )
          .join('\n')
      : '  - None selected';

  return `# ${data.planTitle} — Founder Concept & Readiness Brief (Module A)
Prepared for: ${data.founderName} | Date: ${dateStr}
HQ Country: ${countryPack.countryName} (${currency}) | Industry: ${data.industryCategory}
Market Scope: ${data.exportPotential === 'EXPORTING_INTERNATIONALLY' ? 'International Export Potential' : `Domestic Focus (${countryPack.countryName})`}

---

## 1. Raw Startup Idea (Step 1)
${data.brainDumpText.trim() || 'Not yet entered.'}

---

## 2. 1-Page Mirror Concept Canvas (Step 2)
- **Core Problem:** ${data.conceptCanvas.coreProblem || 'Not yet specified.'}
- **Target Customer:** ${data.conceptCanvas.targetCustomer || 'Not yet specified.'}
- **Proposed Solution:** ${data.conceptCanvas.proposedSolution || 'Not yet specified.'}
- **Unfair Advantage:** ${data.conceptCanvas.unfairAdvantage || 'Not yet specified.'}
- **Revenue & Grant Fit (${currency}):** ${data.conceptCanvas.revenueAndGrantFit || `Pricing in ${currency}; exploring ${topGrant}.`}

---

## 3. Personal Ambition & Weekly Commitment (Step 3)
- **Primary Motivation:** ${motivationText}
- **Weekly Time Commitment:** ${weeklyHoursText}
- **12-Month Success Vision:** ${data.founderMotivation.twelveMonthSuccessVision?.trim() || 'Build a validated, sustainable business with paying customers.'}

---

## 4. Day-1 Team & Starting Budget (Step 4)
- **Team Setup:** ${teamSetupText}
- **In-House V1 Build Skills:** ${skillCoverageText}
- **Starting Capital Bucket (${currency}):** ${budgetText}
- **Team & Funding Notes:** ${data.teamAndBudget.teamAndFundingNotes?.trim() || 'No extra notes added.'}

---

## 5. Founder Reality Check & Dealbreakers (Step 5)
- **Industry Access (Monday Morning Test):** ${industryConnectionText}
- **Personal Income Pressure:** ${incomeUrgencyText}
- **Ownership & Funding Philosophy:** ${growthTradeoffText}
- **#1 Secret Worry:** ${BIGGEST_WORRY_LABELS[data.founderRealityCheck.biggestWorryPreset]}${data.founderRealityCheck.biggestWorryNotes?.trim() ? ` — "${data.founderRealityCheck.biggestWorryNotes.trim()}"` : ''}
- **Lifestyle Dealbreakers (What I Refuse To Do):**
${dealbreakersText}

---

## 6. Constructive "Things to Consider" (Blind-Spot Review — Step 6)
${data.thingsToConsider
  .map(
    (item) =>
      `### ${item.title}\n- **Why it matters:** ${item.explanation}\n- **Action Step:** ${item.suggestedAction || 'Validate in Module B.'}`
  )
  .join('\n\n')}

${
  isGrantCheckerSupportedForCountry(data.hqCountryCode) &&
  data.grantEligibilityCheck
    ? (() => {
        const grantEval = evaluateModuleAGrantEligibility({
          hqCountryCode: data.hqCountryCode,
          exportPotential: data.exportPotential,
          industryCategory: data.industryCategory,
          brainDumpText: data.brainDumpText,
          conceptCanvas: data.conceptCanvas,
          founderMotivation: data.founderMotivation,
          teamAndBudget: data.teamAndBudget,
          founderRealityCheck: data.founderRealityCheck,
          grantCheck: data.grantEligibilityCheck,
        });
        const positioningTips =
          data.grantEligibilityCheck.aiGrantPositioningAdvice &&
          data.grantEligibilityCheck.aiGrantPositioningAdvice.length > 0
            ? data.grantEligibilityCheck.aiGrantPositioningAdvice
            : grantEval.strategicPositioningTips;
        return `---

## 7. Grants & Non-Dilutive Funding You Qualify For Right Now (Step 7)
- **Immediate Qualified Grant & Loan Pool:** ${grantEval.immediateQualifiedPoolFormatted} (${grantEval.qualifiesNowGrants.length} schemes ready now)
- **Unlockable Phase 2 Scale Pool:** ${grantEval.unlockableScalePoolFormatted} (${grantEval.unlockableNextGrants.length} schemes unlockable next)
- **🟢 Grants You Qualify For Right Now:**
${grantEval.qualifiesNowGrants.map((g) => `  - **${g.grantName}** (${g.providerAgency} • ${g.potentialValueFormatted}) — ${g.whyYouMatchOrMiss} *(Match Rule: ${g.coFundingOrMatchRequirement})*`).join('\n') || '  - Complete Step 7 micro-questions to view immediate matches.'}
- **🟡 Unlockable Next (Phase 2):**
${grantEval.unlockableNextGrants.map((g) => `  - **${g.grantName}** (${g.potentialValueFormatted}) — Unlock Step: ${g.unlockRequirement || g.whyYouMatchOrMiss}`).join('\n') || '  - None'}
- **Grant Positioning Strategy:**
${positioningTips.map((t) => `  - ${t}`).join('\n')}
`;
      })()
    : ''
}---

## Next Milestone (Module B)
- [ ] Launch Module B Market & Competitor Intelligence and Module C Customer Validation Survey to test willingness-to-pay with 10 target buyers in ${countryPack.countryName}.
`;
}

      : TEAM_STRUCTURE_LABELS[data.teamAndBudget.teamStructureType];

    data.teamAndBudget.skillCoverage === 'OTHER' &&

      ? `✨ Other: ${data.founderRealityCheck.otherIndustryConnectionText.trim()}`
      : INDUSTRY_CONNECTION_LABELS[data.founderRealityCheck.industryConnection];
  const incomeUrgencyText =
    data.founderRealityCheck.personalIncomeUrgency === 'OTHER' &&
    data.founderRealityCheck.otherIncomeUrgencyText?.trim()
      ? `✨ Other: ${data.founderRealityCheck.otherIncomeUrgencyText.trim()}`
      : INCOME_URGENCY_LABELS[data.founderRealityCheck.personalIncomeUrgency];
  const growthTradeoffText =
    data.founderRealityCheck.growthTradeoff === 'OTHER' &&
    data.founderRealityCheck.otherGrowthTradeoffText?.trim()
      ? `✨ Other: ${data.founderRealityCheck.otherGrowthTradeoffText.trim()}`
      : GROWTH_TRADEOFF_LABELS[data.founderRealityCheck.growthTradeoff];

  const brandHeader = data.whiteLabelEnabled
    ? 'CONFIDENTIAL STARTUP CONCEPT & READINESS BRIEF'
    : 'STARTUP PREFLIGHT • MODULE A CONCEPT & READINESS BRIEF';

  const sectionsHtml = `

    </div>

        </div>
        <div class="card">

      </div>
    </div>

      <div class="section-title">3. Founder Ambition &amp; Weekly Time Commitment (Step 3)</div>

          <div class="card-label">Primary Motivation</div>
          <div class="card-value">${escapeHtml(motivationText)}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="card">
          <div class="card-label">Realistic Weekly Hours</div>
          <div class="card-value">${escapeHtml(weeklyHoursText)}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="card" style="margin-top: 12px;">
        <div class="card-label">12-Month Personal Success Vision</div>
        <div class="card-value">${escapeHtml(data.founderMotivation.twelveMonthSuccessVision?.trim() || 'Build a validated, sustainable business with paying customers within 12 months.')}</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- 4. DAY-1 TEAM & STARTING BUDGET -->
    <div class="section">

      }

    <div class="section">
      <div class="section-title">5. Founder Fit, Dealbreakers &amp; Reality Check (Step 5)</div>

          <div class="card-value">${escapeHtml(industryConnectionText)}</div>
        </div>

        </div>

          <div class="card-value">${escapeHtml(growthTradeoffText)}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="card">

              exportPotential: data.exportPotential,
              industryCategory: data.industryCategory,
              brainDumpText: data.brainDumpText,
              conceptCanvas: data.conceptCanvas,
              founderMotivation: data.founderMotivation,
              teamAndBudget: data.teamAndBudget,
              founderRealityCheck: data.founderRealityCheck,
              grantCheck: data.grantEligibilityCheck,
            });
            return `
    <!-- 7. GRANTS & FUNDING YOU QUALIFY FOR RIGHT NOW (STEP 7) -->
    <div class="section">
      <div class="section-title">7. Grants &amp; Non-Dilutive Funding You Qualify For Right Now (Step 7)</div>
      <div class="grid-2" style="margin-bottom: 12px;">
        <div class="card" style="background: #ecfdf5; border-color: #a7f3d0;">
          <div class="card-label" style="color: #047857;">Immediate Qualified Grant &amp; Loan Pool</div>

        </div>
        <div class="card" style="background: #eef2ff; border-color: #c7d2fe;">
          <div class="card-label" style="color: #4338ca;">Unlockable Phase 2 Scale Pool</div>
          <div class="card-value" style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #312e81;">${escapeHtml(grantEval.unlockableScalePoolFormatted)} (${grantEval.unlockableNextGrants.length} Schemes Unlockable Next)</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="grid-2">
        ${[...grantEval.qualifiesNowGrants, ...grantEval.unlockableNextGrants]
          .map(
            (g) => `
          <div class="card" style="background: ${g.matchTier === 'QUALIFIES_NOW' ? '#f0fdf4' : '#fffbeb'}; border-color: ${g.matchTier === 'QUALIFIES_NOW' ? '#bbf7d0' : '#fde68a'};">
            <div class="card-label" style="color: ${g.matchTier === 'QUALIFIES_NOW' ? '#047857' : '#b45309'};">
              ${g.matchTier === 'QUALIFIES_NOW' ? '🟢 Qualifies Right Now' : '🟡 Unlockable Next'} • ${escapeHtml(g.providerAgency)} (${escapeHtml(g.fundingTypeBadge)})
            </div>
            <div class="card-value" style="font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 4px;">${escapeHtml(g.grantName)} — ${escapeHtml(g.potentialValueFormatted)}</div>
            <div style="font-size: 12px; color: #475569; margin-bottom: 4px;">${escapeHtml(g.whyYouMatchOrMiss)}</div>
            <div style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: ${g.matchTier === 'QUALIFIES_NOW' ? '#065f46' : '#92400e'};">
              ${g.matchTier === 'QUALIFIES_NOW' ? `Match / Co-Funding: ${escapeHtml(g.coFundingOrMatchRequirement)}` : `Unlock Milestone: ${escapeHtml(g.unlockRequirement || g.coFundingOrMatchRequirement)}`}
            </div>
          </div>`
          )
          .join('')}
      </div>
    </div>`;
          })()
        : ''
    }`;

  const footerCtaHtml = `<strong>Ready for Module B (Market &amp; Competitor Intelligence)?</strong>
      Your Module A Concept &amp; Readiness Brief is complete. Continue to Module B inside Startup Preflight to map your Target Customers, Competitors, ${escapeHtml(countryPack.countryName)} Market Sizing, and Competitive Edge.`;

  return renderBmuStandaloneHtmlDocument({
    documentTitle: `${data.planTitle} — Startup Concept & Readiness Brief`,
    eyebrow: brandHeader,
    planTitle: data.planTitle,
    founderName: data.founderName,
    countryName: countryPack.countryName,
    currency,
    industryCategory: data.industryCategory,
    dateStr,
    scopeLabel: 'Scope',
    scopeValue:
      data.exportPotential === 'EXPORTING_INTERNATIONALLY'
        ? 'International Export'
        : `Domestic (${countryPack.countryName})`,
    sectionsHtml,
    footerCtaHtml,
  });
}

import {
  escapeDocumentHtml as escapeHtml,
  renderBmuStandaloneHtmlDocument,
} from '@/lib/export/document-shell';
import type {
  ActiveStartupPlan,

  ModuleLCompiledSectionItem,
  ModuleLAppendixBinderItem,
} from '@/lib/auth/session-store';

export interface ModuleLBriefExportData {
  planTitle: string;
  founderName: string;
  industryCategory: string;
  hqCountryCode: string;
  baseCurrency: string;
  step1Mode?: ModuleLStep1ModeSavedData;

  step4Appendices?: ModuleLStep4AppendicesSavedData;
  step5Brief?: ModuleLStep5SubmissionBriefSavedData;
  whiteLabelEnabled?: boolean;
}

export function buildModuleLStandaloneHtmlDocument(data: ModuleLBriefExportData): string {
  const isUK = data.hqCountryCode === 'GB';
  const currencySymbol = isUK ? '£' : '€';
  const compilerMode = data.step1Mode?.compilerMode || (isUK ? 'UK_INNOVATE_UK_9Q' : 'IE_LEO_OFFICIAL_FORM');
  const targetAgency =
    data.step1Mode?.targetAgencyOrCommitteeName ||
    (isUK ? 'Innovate UK / British Business Bank' : 'Local Enterprise Office (LEO)');
  const askAmount = data.step1Mode?.targetFundingAskAmount || 50000;
  const readinessScore = data.step5Brief?.committeeReadinessScore ?? 94;

  const sections = data.step3Compiler?.sections || [];
  const appendices = data.step4Appendices?.appendices || [];

  const sectionsHtml = sections
    .map(
      (sec: ModuleLCompiledSectionItem) => `

          <div>
            <span style="display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 4px; background: #e0e7ff; color: #3730a3; margin-bottom: 6px;">
              Section ${escapeHtml(String(sec.sectionNumber))}
            </span>
            <h3 style="margin: 0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a;">
              ${escapeHtml(sec.title)}
            </h3>
          </div>
          <div style="text-align: right; font-size: 11px; color: #64748b;">
            ${sec.scoringWeightPercent > 0 ? `<strong>Weight:</strong> ${sec.scoringWeightPercent}% &bull; ` : ''}
            <strong>Limit:</strong> ${sec.wordLimit || 400}w
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style="background: #f8fafc; border-left: 3px solid #6366f1; padding: 10px 14px; margin-bottom: 14px; font-size: 12px; color: #475569; font-style: italic;">

  const appendicesHtml = appendices
    .map(
      (app: ModuleLAppendixBinderItem) => `

        <td style="padding: 10px 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #4338ca; vertical-align: top;">

        </td>

          ${escapeHtml(app.title)}
        </td>
        <td style="padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 11px; vertical-align: top;">

            app.readinessStatus === 'VERIFIED_READY'
