/**
 * Formal Executive Go-To-Market & Customer Acquisition Brief Generator (Module I).
 * Formats a clean, executive, printable HTML document & Markdown export tailored for
 * Irish LEO, Enterprise Ireland, UK Innovate UK / British Business Bank evaluators and angel investors.
 */

import type { BlindSpotItem } from '@/db/schema';
import {
  escapeDocumentHtml as escapeHtml,
  renderBmuStandaloneHtmlDocument,
} from '@/lib/export/document-shell';
import {
  getCountryRulePack,
  formatPlanCurrency,
  type SupportedCountryCode,
} from '@/lib/localization';
import type {
  BrandPositioningStep1Data,
  Modern4PsStep2Data,
  First10PlaybookStep3Data,
  MarketingBudgetStep4Data,
  MarketingExecutiveBriefStep5Data,
} from '@/lib/auth/session-store';

export interface ModuleIBriefMetrics {
  cashCac: number;
  fullyLoadedCac: number;
  ltv: number;
  ltvToCacRatio: number;
  paybackMonths: number;
  activeLtvModel: string;
  effectiveLtvMultiplier: number;
  ltvMultiplierUnitLabel: string;
  pocketProfit: number;
  firstOrderNetProfitAfterCac: number;
  warmCustomerCredit: number;
  netColdCustomersNeeded: number;
  requiredQualifiedLeads: number;
  requiredTopOfFunnelTouches: number;
  paidTouches: number;
  organicTouches: number;
  paidLeads: number;
  organicLeads: number;
  paidMediaBucketSpend: number;
  toolsBucketSpend: number;
  contentEventsBucketSpend: number;
  lineItemsTotalSpend: number;
  effectiveModuleJMonthlySpend: number;
  weeklyFounderHours: number;
  monthlyFounderHours: number;
}

export interface ModuleIBriefData {
  planTitle: string;
  founderName: string;
  industryCategory: string;
  hqCountryCode: SupportedCountryCode;
  currencySymbol: string;
  baseCurrency: string;
  dateStr?: string;
  step1Data: BrandPositioningStep1Data;
  step2Data: Modern4PsStep2Data;
  step3Data: First10PlaybookStep3Data;
  step4Data: MarketingBudgetStep4Data;
  metrics: ModuleIBriefMetrics;
  step5Data: MarketingExecutiveBriefStep5Data;
  whiteLabelEnabled?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Generates a clean, structured Markdown version of the Module I Brief.
 */
export function buildModuleIMarkdownBrief(data: ModuleIBriefData): string {
  const {
    planTitle,
    founderName,
    industryCategory,
    currencySymbol,
    step1Data,
    step2Data,
    step3Data,
    step4Data,
    metrics,
    step5Data,
  } = data;

  const isPaidOptedOut =
    step4Data.paidAdsViabilityDecision === 'OPTED_OUT_UNPROFITABLE' ||
    Number(step4Data.paidTrafficSharePercent) === 0 ||
    step4Data.excludePaidAdsFromModuleJ === true ||
    metrics.paidMediaBucketSpend === 0;
  const postureLabel =
    step5Data.marketingReadinessConfidence === 'OTHER'
      ? step5Data.otherReadinessConfidenceText || 'Custom Commercial Posture'
      : step5Data.marketingReadinessConfidence || 'Standard Posture';

  return `# ${planTitle} — Go-To-Market & Customer Acquisition Brief (Module I)
**Founder / Prepared For:** ${founderName} | **Industry:** ${industryCategory} | **Readiness Posture:** ${postureLabel}

---

## 1. Executive Commercial Defense Narrative (3-Paragraph Defense)
${step5Data.executiveMarketingSummaryNarrative || '_No defense narrative compiled yet._'}

---

## 2. Pillar 1: Brand Positioning & Strategic Wedge
- **140-Character Elevator Hook:** "${step1Data.elevatorHook140}"
- **Tone of Voice:** ${step1Data.toneOfVoice}${step1Data.otherToneOfVoiceText ? ` (${step1Data.otherToneOfVoiceText})` : ''}
- **5-Part Positioning Formula:**
  - **Target Customer:** ${step1Data.positioningFormula.targetCustomer}
  - **Core Problem:** ${step1Data.positioningFormula.customerProblem}
  - **Solution Category:** ${step1Data.positioningFormula.solutionCategory}
  - **Primary Benefit:** ${step1Data.positioningFormula.primaryBenefit}
  - **Competitive Wedge / Moat:** ${step1Data.positioningFormula.competitiveWedge}

---

## 3. Pillar 2: Modern 4Ps Commercial Architecture
- **Product Packaging (P1):** ${step2Data.productP1.packagingType}
- **Pricing Stance & Headline (P2):** ${step2Data.priceP2.pricingStance} — ${step2Data.priceP2.headlinePricePoint || 'Market Benchmark'}
- **Primary Distribution Channel (P3 - Place):** ${step2Data.placeP3.primaryChannel}
- **Primary Acquisition Engine (P4 - Promotion):** ${step2Data.promotionP4.primaryAcquisitionEngine}

---

## 4. Pillar 3: First 10 Customers Playbook
- **Acquisition Archetype:** ${step3Data.acquisitionArchetype}
- **Pilot Offer Structure:** ${step3Data.pilotOffer.pilotStructure}
- **Founder Quid Pro Quo Ask:** ${step3Data.pilotOffer.quidProQuoFounderAsk}
- **Warm Pipeline Size:** ${step3Data.targetPipeline.length} identified accounts
- **Letter of Intent (LOI) Target:** ${step3Data.letterOfIntent.targetCompanyName || 'Pilot Partner'} (${step3Data.letterOfIntent.pilotPricePoint || 'Preferential Pilot Rate'})
- **Primary Pilot Success KPI:** ${step3Data.letterOfIntent.primarySuccessKpi || 'Turnaround & ROI validation'}

---

## 5. Pillar 4: Marketing Budget, CAC & Funnel Unit Economics
- **Target Monthly New Customers:** ${step4Data.targetMonthlyNewCustomers}
- **Warm Pipeline Credit:** -${metrics.warmCustomerCredit} customers (from ${step3Data.targetPipeline.length} warm leads)
- **Net Cold Customers Needed Monthly:** ${metrics.netColdCustomersNeeded}
- **Required Qualified Leads:** ${metrics.requiredQualifiedLeads} leads (${metrics.organicLeads} organic / ${metrics.paidLeads} paid)
- **Required Top-of-Funnel Touches:** ${metrics.requiredTopOfFunnelTouches.toLocaleString()} touches (${metrics.organicTouches.toLocaleString()} organic / ${metrics.paidTouches.toLocaleString()} paid)
- **Cash CAC:** ${currencySymbol}${metrics.cashCac}
- **Founder Weekly Marketing Time:** ${metrics.weeklyFounderHours} hrs/wk (${metrics.monthlyFounderHours} hrs/mo)
- **Lifetime Value (LTV):** ${currencySymbol}${metrics.ltv} (${metrics.effectiveLtvMultiplier}x ${metrics.ltvMultiplierUnitLabel})
- **LTV to CAC Ratio:** ${metrics.ltvToCacRatio}:1
- **Payback Velocity:** ${metrics.paybackMonths} months
- **Paid Advertising Strategy:** ${
    isPaidOptedOut
      ? 'FORMALLY OPTED OUT (Negative Unit Economics). Performance ads excluded to conserve capital; zero ad burn.'
      : `Active Performance Media (${step4Data.paidTrafficSharePercent}% paid share). Planned ad spend: ${currencySymbol}${metrics.paidMediaBucketSpend.toLocaleString()}/mo.`
  }
- **Effective Monthly Overhead Synced to Module J:** ${currencySymbol}${metrics.effectiveModuleJMonthlySpend.toLocaleString()}/mo (${
    isPaidOptedOut ? 'Grant-eligible software tools & content only' : 'Full marketing line items'
  })

---

## 6. Constructive "Things to Consider" Blind-Spot Review
${
  step5Data.blindSpots.length === 0
    ? '_No commercial blind spots logged._'
    : step5Data.blindSpots
        .map(
          (b, i) =>
            `### ${i + 1}. [${b.severity}] ${b.title}\n- **Explanation:** ${b.explanation}\n- **Recommended Mitigation:** ${b.suggestedAction}`
        )
        .join('\n\n')
}
`;
}

/**

export function buildModuleIStandaloneHtmlDocument(data: ModuleIBriefData): string {
  const countryPack = getCountryRulePack(data.hqCountryCode);
  const currency = data.baseCurrency || countryPack.defaultCurrency;
  const currencySymbol =
    data.currencySymbol ||
    (data.hqCountryCode === 'GB'
      ? '£'
      : data.hqCountryCode === 'US'
      ? '$'
      : '€');

  const dateStr =
    data.dateStr ||
    new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-GB', {
      day: 'numeric',
      month: 'long',
      year: 'numeric',
    });

  const { step1Data, step2Data, step3Data, step4Data, metrics, step5Data } = data;
  const isPaidOptedOut =
    step4Data.paidAdsViabilityDecision === 'OPTED_OUT_UNPROFITABLE' ||
    Number(step4Data.paidTrafficSharePercent) === 0 ||
    step4Data.excludePaidAdsFromModuleJ === true ||
    metrics.paidMediaBucketSpend === 0;

  const sectionsHtml = `
    <!-- SECTION 1: EXECUTIVE COMMERCIAL DEFENSE NARRATIVE -->
    <div class="section">
      <div class="section-title">1. Executive Commercial Defense Narrative</div>
      <div style="background: #f8fafc; border-left: 3px solid #4f46e5; padding: 14px 18px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.65; color: #1e293b;">
        ${escapeHtml(
          step5Data.executiveMarketingSummaryNarrative ||
            'Commercial defense narrative pending completion by founders.'
        ).replace(/\n/g, '<br />')}
      </div>
      ${
        step5Data.aiAssessorTip
          ? `<div style="margin-top: 10px; font-size: 11.5px; color: #4338ca; background: #eef2ff; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px;">
              <strong>Assessor Tip:</strong> ${escapeHtml(step5Data.aiAssessorTip)}
            </div>`
          : ''
      }
    </div>

    <!-- SECTION 2: BRAND POSITIONING & STRATEGIC WEDGE -->
    <div class="section">
      <div class="section-title">2. Brand Positioning &amp; Strategic Wedge (Pillar 1)</div>
      <div style="background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 14px 16px; margin-bottom: 12px;">
        <div style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; color: #64748b; margin-bottom: 4px;">
          140-Character Commercial Elevator Hook
        </div>
        <div style="font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #0f172a;">
          &ldquo;${escapeHtml(step1Data.elevatorHook140)}&rdquo;
        </div>
        <div style="margin-top: 6px; font-size: 11.5px; color: #64748b;">
          Tone of Voice: <strong style="color: #1e293b;">${escapeHtml(step1Data.toneOfVoice)}</strong>
          ${step1Data.otherToneOfVoiceText ? ` (${escapeHtml(step1Data.otherToneOfVoiceText)})` : ''}
        </div>
      </div>

        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th style="width: 28%;">Positioning Dimension</th>
            <th>Venture Definition</th>
          </tr>

  MUST_HAVE_V1: '🟢 Day-1 V1 Core (Launch Blocker)',
  FAST_FOLLOW_V1_5: '🟡 Version 1.5 (Fast-Follow, Weeks 2–8)',
  PARKING_LOT_V2: '🔴 Phase 2 / V2 Backlog (Do Not Build Yet)',

  BUILD_IN_HOUSE: 'Tier 1 • Custom Build / Core IP ("Secret Sauce")',
  BUY_RENT_OFF_SHELF: 'Tier 2 • Buy / Rent Off-the-Shelf (Commodity Stack)',
  OUTSOURCE_PARTNER: 'Tier 3 • Configure / Specialist Partner',
};

export const COST_MODEL_LABELS: Record<BuildVsBuyCostModelType, string> = {
  MONTHLY_SUBSCRIPTION: 'Monthly Recurring (SaaS / Rent)',
  ONE_OFF_PURCHASE: 'Once-Off (CapEx / Dev / Tooling)',
  PER_UNIT_COGS: 'Per-Unit Direct Variable COGS',
  SWEAT_EQUITY_ZERO: 'Sweat Equity (Zero Direct Cash)',
  OTHER: 'Custom Cost Model',
};

export const READINESS_CONFIDENCE_LABELS: Record<ProductReadinessConfidenceType, string> = {
  READY_TO_BUILD_V1: 'Ready for Pilot Build / Production',
  NEEDS_MINOR_DE_RISKING: 'Needs Minor De-Risking (1–2 Gaps to Close)',
  NEEDS_PROTOTYPE_SPIKE_FIRST: 'Needs Technical Spike / Prototype Test First',
  OTHER: 'Custom Readiness Status',
};

export function formatTrackLabel(track: ProductTrackType, otherText?: string): string {
  if (track === 'OTHER' && otherText?.trim()) return `Other: ${otherText.trim()}`;
  return PRODUCT_TRACK_LABELS[track] || track;
}

export function formatFormFactorLabel(ff: ProductFormFactorType, otherText?: string): string {
  if (ff === 'OTHER' && otherText?.trim()) return `Other: ${otherText.trim()}`;
  return FORM_FACTOR_LABELS[ff] || ff;
}

export function formatV1ApproachLabel(app: V1PrototypeApproachType, otherText?: string): string {
  if (app === 'OTHER' && otherText?.trim()) return `Other: ${otherText.trim()}`;
  return PROTOTYPE_APPROACH_LABELS[app] || app;
}

export function formatTimelineLabel(tl: V1LaunchTimelineType, otherText?: string): string {
  if (tl === 'OTHER' && otherText?.trim()) return `Other: ${otherText.trim()}`;
  return LAUNCH_TIMELINE_LABELS[tl] || tl.replace(/_/g, ' ');
}

export function formatChannelLabel(ch: SalesChannelOptionType, otherText?: string): string {
  if (ch === 'OTHER' && otherText?.trim()) return `Other: ${otherText.trim()}`;
  return SALES_CHANNEL_LABELS[ch] || ch.replace(/_/g, ' ');
}

export function formatDeliveryLabel(del: DeliveryFulfillmentModelType, otherText?: string): string {
  if (del === 'OTHER' && otherText?.trim()) return `Other: ${otherText.trim()}`;
  return DELIVERY_MODEL_LABELS[del] || del.replace(/_/g, ' ');
}

export function formatReadinessLabel(rc: ProductReadinessConfidenceType | '', otherText?: string): string {
  if (!rc) return 'Ready for Pilot Build';
  if (rc === 'OTHER' && otherText?.trim()) return `Other: ${otherText.trim()}`;
  return READINESS_CONFIDENCE_LABELS[rc] || rc;
}

/**
 * Builds a structured Markdown brief of Module D.
 */
export function buildModuleDMarkdownBrief(data: ModuleDBriefData): string {
  const {
    planTitle,
    hqCountryCode,
    step1Data,
    step2Data,
    step3Data,
    step4Data,
    step5Data,
    step6Data,
    baseCurrency,
    beachheadSegment,
    validatedPainPoint,
    surveyResponseCount = 0,
    waitlistCount = 0,
    interviewCount = 0,
    whiteLabelEnabled = false,
  } = data;

  const countryPack = getCountryRulePack(hqCountryCode);
  const currency = baseCurrency || countryPack.defaultCurrency;

  const day1Items = step3Data.items.filter((i) => i.bucket === 'MUST_HAVE_V1');
  const v15Items = step3Data.items.filter((i) => i.bucket === 'FAST_FOLLOW_V1_5');
  const v2Items = step3Data.items.filter((i) => i.bucket === 'PARKING_LOT_V2');

  const inHouseStack = step4Data.items.filter((i) => i.tier === 'BUILD_IN_HOUSE');
  const buyRentStack = step4Data.items.filter((i) => i.tier === 'BUY_RENT_OFF_SHELF');
  const partnerStack = step4Data.items.filter((i) => i.tier === 'OUTSOURCE_PARTNER');

  const step4Monthly = step4Data.items
    .filter((i) => i.costModel === 'MONTHLY_SUBSCRIPTION')
    .reduce((sum, i) => sum + (Number(i.estimatedCostAmount) || 0), 0);
  const step4OneOff = step4Data.items
    .filter((i) => i.costModel === 'ONE_OFF_PURCHASE')
    .reduce((sum, i) => sum + (Number(i.estimatedCostAmount) || 0), 0);
  const step4PerUnit = step4Data.items
    .filter((i) => i.costModel === 'PER_UNIT_COGS')
    .reduce((sum, i) => sum + (Number(i.estimatedCostAmount) || 0), 0);

  const step5Monthly = step5Data.workPackages
    .filter((wp) => wp.costModel === 'MONTHLY_SUBSCRIPTION')
    .reduce((sum, wp) => sum + (Number(wp.estimatedCostAmount) || 0), 0);
  const step5OneOff = step5Data.workPackages
    .filter((wp) => wp.costModel === 'ONE_OFF_PURCHASE')
    .reduce((sum, wp) => sum + (Number(wp.estimatedCostAmount) || 0), 0);
  const step5PerUnit = step5Data.workPackages
    .filter((wp) => wp.costModel === 'PER_UNIT_COGS')
    .reduce((sum, wp) => sum + (Number(wp.estimatedCostAmount) || 0), 0);

  const combinedMonthly = step4Monthly + step5Monthly;
  const combinedOneOff = step4OneOff + step5OneOff;
  const combinedUnitCogs = step4PerUnit + step5PerUnit;
  const netRevenueKeptPercent = Number((100 - step2Data.estimatedBlendedFeePercent).toFixed(1));

  const trackLabel = formatTrackLabel(step1Data.productTrack, step1Data.otherProductTrackText);
  const formFactorLabel = formatFormFactorLabel(step1Data.formFactor, step1Data.otherFormFactorText);
  const v1ApproachLabel = formatV1ApproachLabel(step1Data.v1PrototypeApproach, step1Data.otherV1PrototypeApproachText);
  const timelineLabel = formatTimelineLabel(step1Data.launchTimeline, step1Data.otherLaunchTimelineText);
  const primaryChannelLabel = formatChannelLabel(step2Data.primaryChannel, step2Data.otherPrimaryChannelText);
  const secondaryChannelLabels = step2Data.secondaryChannels.map((sc) =>
    formatChannelLabel(sc, sc === 'OTHER' ? step2Data.otherSecondaryChannelText : undefined)
  );
  const deliveryModelLabel = formatDeliveryLabel(step2Data.deliveryFulfillmentModel, step2Data.otherDeliveryFulfillmentText);
  const readinessLabel = formatReadinessLabel(step6Data.readinessConfidence, step6Data.otherReadinessConfidenceText);

  const lines: string[] = [
    `# ${planTitle} — 1-Page Product, Scope & Work Package Brief (Module D)`,
    `**Country / Currency:** ${countryPack.countryName} (${currency}) | **Product Track:** ${trackLabel}`,
    `**Platform / Form Factor:** ${formFactorLabel} | **V1 Build Approach:** ${v1ApproachLabel} | **Target Launch Window:** ${timelineLabel}`,
    `**Readiness Status:** ${readinessLabel}`,
    `**Upstream Customer Proof (Modules A–C):** Target Customer: ${beachheadSegment || 'Early adopters'} | Survey Responses: ${surveyResponseCount} | Waitlist Leads: ${waitlistCount} | 1-on-1 Interviews: ${interviewCount}`,
    `**#1 Validated Pain Point:** "${validatedPainPoint || 'Deliver a fast, reliable V1 solution.'}"`,
    '',
    `## 1. Executive Product Summary & De-Risking Charter`,
    step6Data.executiveProductBriefSummary || step1Data.ahaMomentNarrative || '_No executive summary recorded yet._',
    '',
    `**De-Risking & Grant Sign-Off:** ${step6Data.keyDeRiskingSignOffNarrative || step5Data.bottleneckAndDeRiskingNarrative || '_Not recorded yet._'}`,
    '',
    `## 2. Product Vehicle, Channel Strategy & Unit Cost Roll-Up (Steps 1–2 & 4–5)`,
    `- **Product Track & Format:** ${trackLabel} — ${formFactorLabel}`,
    `- **V1 Build / Prototype Approach:** ${v1ApproachLabel}`,
    `- **60-Second Customer "Aha! Moment":** ${step1Data.ahaMomentNarrative || '—'}`,
    `- **Why This Vehicle Fits Customer:** ${step1Data.whyThisVehicleFitsCustomer || '—'}`,
    `- **Primary Distribution Channel (${step2Data.primaryChannelSharePercent}% share):** ${primaryChannelLabel}`,
    `- **Secondary Distribution Channels (${Math.max(0, 100 - step2Data.primaryChannelSharePercent)}% share):** ${secondaryChannelLabels.join(', ') || 'None (100% Primary)'}`,
    `- **Blended Platform/Payment Fee:** ${step2Data.estimatedBlendedFeePercent}% (You keep ${netRevenueKeptPercent}% Net Revenue before COGS)`,
    `- **V1 Delivery & Fulfillment Model:** ${deliveryModelLabel}`,
    `- **Rent-to-Own Customer Bridge Strategy:** ${step2Data.rentToOwnBridgeStrategy || '—'}`,
    `- **Why Channel Mix Fits Margins:** ${step2Data.channelWhyItFitsNotes || '—'}`,
    `- **Estimated Cost Structure (Synced to Module H):** ${formatPlanCurrency(combinedOneOff, currency)} once-off | ${formatPlanCurrency(combinedMonthly, currency)}/mo recurring | ${formatPlanCurrency(combinedUnitCogs, currency)}/unit direct variable COGS`,
    '',
    `## 3. Ruthless V1 Scope Filter (Step 3)`,
    step3Data.scopeDisciplineRule ? `- **Scope Discipline Rule:** ${step3Data.scopeDisciplineRule.replace(/_/g, ' ')}${step3Data.otherScopeDisciplineRuleText ? ` (${step3Data.otherScopeDisciplineRuleText})` : ''}` : '',
    `- **🟢 Day-1 V1 Core — Launch Now (${day1Items.length}):** ${day1Items.map((i) => `${i.title}${i.categoryTag ? ` [${i.categoryTag}]` : ''} (${i.effortImpact} effort)${i.rationaleOrNote ? `: ${i.rationaleOrNote}` : ''}`).join('; ') || 'None added'}`,
    `- **🟡 Version 1.5 — Fast-Follow (${v15Items.length}):** ${v15Items.map((i) => `${i.title}${i.categoryTag ? ` [${i.categoryTag}]` : ''} (${i.effortImpact} effort)`).join('; ') || 'None'}`,
    `- **🔴 Phase 2 / V2 Backlog — Do Not Build Yet (${v2Items.length}):** ${v2Items.map((i) => `${i.title}${i.categoryTag ? ` [${i.categoryTag}]` : ''}`).join('; ') || 'None'}`,
    `- **What We Explicitly Refuse to Build in V1:** ${step3Data.whatWeRefuseToBuildInV1Narrative || '—'}`,
    `- **Why Lean V1 Wins Faster:** ${step3Data.whyThisLeanV1WinsFasterNarrative || '—'}`,
    '',
    `## 4. 3-Tier "Build vs. Buy" & Core IP ("Secret Sauce") Matrix (Step 4)`,
    step4Data.coreIpOwnershipRule ? `- **Core IP Ownership Rule:** ${step4Data.coreIpOwnershipRule.replace(/_/g, ' ')}${step4Data.otherCoreIpOwnershipRuleText ? ` (${step4Data.otherCoreIpOwnershipRuleText})` : ''}` : '',
    `- **Tier 1 — Custom Build / Core IP ("Your Secret Sauce": ${inHouseStack.length}):** ${inHouseStack.map((i) => `${i.title} (${i.vendorOrToolName || 'In-house'}) — ${formatPlanCurrency(i.estimatedCostAmount, currency)} ${i.costModel.replace(/_/g, ' ')}`).join('; ') || 'None'}`,
    `- **Tier 2 — Buy / Rent Off-the-Shelf (Commodity: ${buyRentStack.length}):** ${buyRentStack.map((i) => `${i.title} (${i.vendorOrToolName || 'SaaS/Tool'}) — ${formatPlanCurrency(i.estimatedCostAmount, currency)} ${i.costModel.replace(/_/g, ' ')}`).join('; ') || 'None'}`,
    `- **Tier 3 — Configure / Specialist Partner (${partnerStack.length}):** ${partnerStack.map((i) => `${i.title} (${i.vendorOrToolName || 'Partner'}) — ${formatPlanCurrency(i.estimatedCostAmount, currency)} ${i.costModel.replace(/_/g, ' ')}`).join('; ') || 'None'}`,
    `- **Core IP & Secret Sauce Narrative:** ${step4Data.secretSauceInHouseNarrative || '—'}`,
    `- **Why Buy & Partner Saves Time:** ${step4Data.whyBuyAndPartnerSavesTimeNarrative || '—'}`,
    '',
    `## 5. System Architecture Flow & Work Packages WP1–WPn (Step 5)`,
    step5Data.executionCadenceRule ? `- **Execution Cadence Rule:** ${step5Data.executionCadenceRule.replace(/_/g, ' ')}${step5Data.otherExecutionCadenceRuleText ? ` (${step5Data.otherExecutionCadenceRuleText})` : ''}` : '',
    ...(step5Data.flowStages.length > 0
      ? [
          `**System Architecture / Delivery Flow (${step5Data.flowStages.length} Stages):**`,
          ...step5Data.flowStages.map(
            (st, idx) =>
              `- **Stage ${st.stageNumber || idx + 1} (${st.stageTitle}):** ${st.stageSubtitle ? `${st.stageSubtitle} | ` : ''}Tools/Stack: ${st.keyToolsOrMaterials || st.whatHappensHere || '—'} -> Output/Gate: ${st.outputOrHandoff || st.outputOrHandOff || '—'}`
          ),
          '',
        ]
      : []),
    `**Work Package Milestone Schedule (WP1–WP${step5Data.workPackages.length}):**`,
    ...step5Data.workPackages.map(
      (wp) =>
        `- **${wp.wpCode}: ${wp.title}** (${wp.timelineWindow.replace(/_/g, ' ')}) — Mode: ${wp.executionMode.replace(/_/g, ' ')} | Cost: ${wp.costModel === 'SWEAT_EQUITY_ZERO' ? 'Sweat Equity' : `${formatPlanCurrency(wp.estimatedCostAmount, currency)} (${wp.costModel.replace(/_/g, ' ')})`} | Deliverable: ${wp.deliverableMilestone || wp.deliverableMilestoneProof || '—'} | Proof Gate: ${wp.verificationGateOrDeRisking || wp.linkedTaskSummary || '—'}${wp.isGrantEligibleRAndDOrPrototype ? ' [★ Grant Eligible R&D/Prototype]' : ''}`
    ),
    `- **Technical Merit & State-of-the-Art Innovation:** ${step5Data.technicalMeritAndInnovationNarrative || '—'}`,
    `- **Bottleneck & Critical Path De-Risking:** ${step5Data.bottleneckAndDeRiskingNarrative || '—'}`,
    '',
    `## 6. Constructive "Things to Consider" & Mitigations (Step 6)`,
    ...step6Data.blindSpots.map(
      (bs) =>
        `- **[${bs.isResolved ? 'RESOLVED' : bs.severity}] ${bs.title} (${bs.category.replace(/_/g, ' ')}):** ${bs.whyItMatters} -> *Action:* ${bs.recommendedActionOrFix}${bs.founderMitigationNote ? ` | *Founder Mitigation:* ${bs.founderMitigationNote}` : ''}`
    ),
    '',
    whiteLabelEnabled
      ? `_Generated for ${planTitle}_`
      : `_Generated with Startup Preflight — Module D Product & Technical Blueprint_`,
  ].filter(Boolean);

  return lines.join('\n');
}

/**
 * Strips any internal `/v/[slug]` or `/v/...` route references from text
 * so readers only ever see plain-English "Public Validation Surveys".
 */
export function sanitizeSurveyTerminologyForReader(text: string): string {
  if (!text) return '';
  return text
    .replace(/\/v\/\[slug\]/gi, 'public validation surveys')
    .replace(/`\/v\/[^`\s]+`/gi, 'public validation surveys')
    .replace(/\(\/v\/[^)\s]+\)/gi, '(public validation survey)')
    .replace(/\/v\/[a-z0-9-_]+/gi, 'public validation survey');
}

/**
 * Computes Module B SOM, SAM, and TAM deterministically from the saved segments.
 */
export function computeModuleBMarketTotals(plan: ActiveStartupPlan): {
  som: number;
  sam: number;
  tam: number;
} {
  const sizing = plan.moduleBData?.marketSizing;
  if (!sizing || !Array.isArray(sizing.segments) || sizing.segments.length === 0) {
    return { som: 0, sam: 0, tam: 0 };
  }

  let som = 0;
  let sam = 0;

  for (const seg of sizing.segments) {
    const rawPrice =
      Number(String(seg.pricePerCustomerInput || '').replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '')) || 0;
    const annualPrice =
      seg.billingCadence === 'MONTHLY_SUBSCRIPTION' ? rawPrice * 12 : rawPrice;
    const customerGoal =
      Number(
        String(seg.year1To2CustomerGoalInput || '').replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '')
      ) || 0;
    const reachableCustomers =
      Number(
        String(seg.reachableCustomersInTargetMarketsInput || '').replace(
          /[^0-9.]/g,
          ''
        )
      ) || 0;

    som += annualPrice * customerGoal;
    sam += annualPrice * reachableCustomers;
  }

  const multMap: Record<string, number> = {
    '3X': 3,
    '5X': 5,
    '10X': 10,
    '20X': 20,
  };
  const customMult =
    Number(
      String(sizing.otherWiderMarketScaleText || '').replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '')
    ) || 5;
  const multiplier =
    sizing.widerMarketMultiplier === 'OTHER'
      ? customMult
      : multMap[sizing.widerMarketMultiplier] || 5;

  const tam = sam * multiplier;
  return { som, sam, tam };
}

/**
 * Builds the 100% deterministic, zero-hallucination Verified Facts Ledger
 * from the founder's saved plan state.
 */
export function extractMasterDocumentVerifiedFacts(
  params: MasterDocumentInputParams
): MasterDocumentVerifiedFacts {
  const {
    plan,
    founderName,
    brainDumpText,
    conceptCanvas,
    founderMotivation,
    teamAndBudget,
    founderRealityCheck,
  } = params;

  const countryPack = getCountryRulePack(plan.hqCountryCode);
  const currency = plan.baseCurrency || countryPack.defaultCurrency;
  const targetMarketsLabel =
    plan.targetMarketsArray && plan.targetMarketsArray.length > 0
      ? plan.targetMarketsArray.join(', ')
      : countryPack.countryName;
  const exportScopeLabel =
    plan.exportPotential === 'EXPORTING_INTERNATIONALLY'
      ? `International Export (${targetMarketsLabel})`
      : `Domestic Market (${countryPack.countryName})`;

  // Module A Check
  const hasModuleA = Boolean(
    brainDumpText.trim().length > 0 ||
      conceptCanvas.coreProblem.trim().length > 0 ||
      conceptCanvas.targetCustomer.trim().length > 0 ||
      conceptCanvas.proposedSolution.trim().length > 0
  );

  // Module B Check
  const modB = plan.moduleBData;
  const { som, sam, tam } = computeModuleBMarketTotals(plan);
  const hasModuleB = Boolean(
    modB &&
      (modB.beachhead?.beachheadSegment?.trim() ||
        (modB.competitorsAndStatusQuo?.competitors?.length ?? 0) > 0 ||
        modB.competitorsAndStatusQuo?.whySwitchOneSentence?.trim() ||
        som > 0 ||
        modB.competitiveWedge?.competitiveEdgeSummary?.trim())
  );

  // Module C Check
  const modC = plan.moduleCData;
  const validSurveys = (modC?.surveys || []).filter(
    (s) => s.questions.length > 0 || s.responses.length > 0 || s.title.trim().length > 0
  );
  const allResponses = validSurveys.flatMap((s) => s.responses || []);
  const realResponses = allResponses.filter((r) => !r.isSimulated);
  const waitlistOptIns = allResponses.filter((r) => r.joinedWaitlist);
  const interviews = modC?.interviewLogs || [];
  const strongSignalInterviews = interviews.filter(
    (i) =>
      i.signalBadge === 'STRONG_SIGNAL' ||
      i.commitmentOutcome === 'ASKED_TO_PILOT_OR_BUY'
  );
  const avgInterviewPainScore =
    interviews.length > 0
      ? (
          interviews.reduce((acc, i) => acc + i.painScore1To5, 0) /
          interviews.length
        ).toFixed(1)
      : '';
  const latestInsights = validSurveys.find((s) => Boolean(s.aiInsightsSummary))
    ?.aiInsightsSummary;
  const hasModuleC = Boolean(validSurveys.length > 0 || interviews.length > 0);

  // Module D Check
  const modD = plan.moduleDData;
  const veh = modD?.productVehicle;
  const chan = modD?.channelMatrix;
  const scope = modD?.scopeFilter;
  const bvb = modD?.buildVsBuy;
  const wps = modD?.workPackagesAndFlow;
  const modDAudit = modD?.blindSpotAudit;
  const hasModuleD = Boolean(
    modD &&
      (veh?.ahaMomentNarrative?.trim() ||
        veh?.whyThisVehicleFitsCustomer?.trim() ||
        Boolean(chan?.primaryChannel) ||
        (scope?.items?.length ?? 0) > 0 ||
        (wps?.workPackages?.length ?? 0) > 0)
  );

  // Module E Check
  const modE = plan.moduleEData;
  const opsBp = modE?.operationsBlueprint;
  const prem = modE?.premisesAndEquipment;
  const riskReg = modE?.riskRegister;
  const supQc = modE?.supportReturnsAndQc;
  const permIns = modE?.permitsAndInsurance;
  const modEAudit = modE?.blindSpotAudit;
  const hasModuleE = Boolean(
    modE &&
      ((opsBp?.orderLifecycleStages?.length ?? 0) > 0 ||
        opsBp?.endToEndFulfillmentNarrative?.trim() ||
        (prem?.equipmentItems?.length ?? 0) > 0 ||
        prem?.premisesLocationSummary?.trim() ||
        (riskReg?.riskItems?.length ?? 0) > 0)
  );

  // Module F Check (Co-Founder, Team, Personal Survival Budget & 3-Year Hiring Plan)
  const modF = plan.moduleFData;
  const teamMembers = modF?.promoterProfiles?.teamMembers || [];
  const hatAssignments = modF?.step2RoleMatrixData?.hatAssignments || [];
  const founderBudgets = modF?.step3SurvivalBudgetData?.founderBudgets || [];
  const hiringRoles = modF?.step5HiringPlanData?.roles || [];
  const hasModuleF = Boolean(
    modF &&
      (teamMembers.length > 0 ||
        modF.promoterProfiles?.executiveTeamCapabilityNarrative?.trim() ||
        hatAssignments.some(
          (h) =>
            Boolean(h.primaryOwnerMemberId?.trim()) &&
            h.primaryOwnerMemberId !== 'UNASSIGNED'
        ) ||
        founderBudgets.length > 0 ||
        hiringRoles.length > 0)
  );

  // Module G Check (Launchpad & Operations Hub — 6 Setup Cards)
  const modG = plan.moduleGData;
  const gStepsReady = modG
    ? [
        modG.step1?.state === 'ALREADY_HAVE' || Boolean(modG.step1?.registeredEntityName?.trim()),
        modG.step2?.state === 'ALREADY_HAVE' || Boolean(modG.step2?.primaryDomain?.trim()),
        modG.step3?.state === 'ALREADY_HAVE' || Boolean(modG.step3?.hasDedicatedIban),
        modG.step4?.state === 'ALREADY_HAVE' || Boolean(modG.step4?.hasAccountant),
        modG.step5?.state === 'ALREADY_HAVE' ||
          Boolean(
            modG.step5?.hasPublicLiability ||
              modG.step5?.hasProfessionalIndemnity ||
              modG.step5?.hasEmployersLiability
          ),
        modG.step6?.state === 'ALREADY_HAVE' ||
          Boolean(modG.step6?.hasIpAssignmentSigned || modG.step6?.hasPrivacyPolicy),
      ].filter(Boolean).length
    : 0;
  const opsReadinessPercent = modG
    ? typeof modG.completionPercentage === 'number' && modG.completionPercentage > 0
      ? modG.completionPercentage
      : Math.round((gStepsReady / 6) * 100)
    : 0;
  const hasModuleG = Boolean(
    modG &&
      (opsReadinessPercent > 0 ||
        modG.step1?.registeredEntityName?.trim() ||
        modG.step2?.primaryDomain?.trim() ||
        modG.step2?.officialBusinessEmail?.trim() ||
        Boolean(modG.lastSavedAt))
  );

  // Module H Check (Revenue Model, Pricing Architect & 3-Year Pocket Profit Breakeven)
  const modH = plan.moduleHData;
  const hTiers = modH?.step2PricingTiers?.tiers || [];
  const hYearTargets = modH?.step3BreakevenCalculator?.yearTargets || [];
  const hasModuleH = Boolean(
    modH &&
      (hTiers.length > 0 ||
        modH.step1RevenueModel?.offeringRangeSummary?.trim() ||
        hYearTargets.length > 0 ||
        modH.step4SalesAssumptions?.writtenAssumptionsNarrative?.trim() ||
        modH.step5RevenueBrief?.executiveCommercialSummaryNarrative?.trim())
  );

  // Module I Check (Brand Positioning, 4Ps, First 10 Customers & Marketing Budget)
  const modI = plan.moduleIData;
  const iProspects = modI?.step3First10?.targetPipeline || [];
  const hasModuleI = Boolean(
    modI &&
      (modI.step1Positioning?.elevatorHook140?.trim() ||
        modI.step2FourPs?.strategicRationale?.trim() ||
        iProspects.length > 0 ||
        (modI.step4Budget?.totalPlannedMonthlyMarketingSpend ?? 0) > 0 ||
        modI.step5MarketingBrief?.executiveMarketingSummaryNarrative?.trim())
  );

  // Module J Check (36-Month Financial Builder, Overheads, Working Capital & Cashflow Trough)
  const modJ = plan.moduleJData;
  const jOverheads = modJ?.step1OverheadsTax?.overheadLineItems || [];
  const jFundingSources = modJ?.step3CashflowGap?.fundingSources || [];
  const hasModuleJ = Boolean(
    modJ &&
      (jOverheads.length > 0 ||
        modJ.step1OverheadsTax?.overheadsAndTaxNarrative?.trim() ||
        modJ.step2WorkingCapital?.workingCapitalNarrative?.trim() ||
        jFundingSources.length > 0 ||
        modJ.step4Statements?.writtenFinancialAssumptionsBlock?.trim() ||
        modJ.step5FinanceBrief?.executiveFinancialSummaryNarrative?.trim())
  );

  // Module K Check (Non-Dilutive Grants, Capital Stack, Reimbursement Bridge & Tax Relief)
  const modK = plan.moduleKData;
  const kFundingSources = modK?.step2CapitalStack?.fundingSources || [];
  const hasModuleK = Boolean(
    modK &&

    officialBusinessEmail: modG?.step2?.officialBusinessEmail?.trim() || '',
    bankProviderLabel,
    hasDedicatedIban: Boolean(modG?.step3?.hasDedicatedIban),
    accountingSoftwareLabel,
    vatStatusLabel,
    insurancesActiveList,
    legalComplianceItemsActiveList,

    // Module H Returned Facts
    revenueModelVehicleLabel,
    valueMetric: modH?.step1RevenueModel?.valueMetric?.trim() || '',
    pricingTiersCount: hTiers.length,
    pricingTiersSummaries,
    blendedAveragePriceNet:
      Number(modH?.step2PricingTiers?.blendedAveragePriceNet) ||
      (pricingTiersSummaries[0]?.priceNetOfTax ?? 0),
    year1TargetCustomers:
      Number(y1Target?.customersNeededToBreakeven) ||
      Number(modH?.step3BreakevenCalculator?.activeCustomerSlider) ||
      0,
    year1ProjectedNetTurnover:
      (Number(y1Target?.monthlyRevenueAtBreakeven) || 0) * 12,
    year1PocketProfitNet:
      (Number(y1Target?.monthlyPocketProfitAtTarget) || 0) * 12,
    year2ProjectedNetTurnover:
      (Number(y2Target?.monthlyRevenueAtBreakeven) || 0) * 12,
    year3ProjectedNetTurnover:
      (Number(y3Target?.monthlyRevenueAtBreakeven) || 0) * 12,
    salesCycleDays: Number(modH?.step4SalesAssumptions?.salesCycleDays) || 0,
    primarySalesMotionLabel: (
      modH?.step4SalesAssumptions?.primarySalesMotion || ''
    ).replace(/_/g, ' '),
    expectedConversionRatePercent:
      Number(modH?.step4SalesAssumptions?.expectedConversionRatePercent) || 0,
    executiveCommercialSummaryNarrative: sanitizeSurveyTerminologyForReader(
      modH?.step5RevenueBrief?.executiveCommercialSummaryNarrative?.trim() ||
        modH?.step3BreakevenCalculator?.breakevenNarrative?.trim() ||
        ''
    ),

    // Module I Returned Facts
    elevatorHook140: sanitizeSurveyTerminologyForReader(
      modI?.step1Positioning?.elevatorHook140?.trim() || ''
    ),
    positioningFormulaSummary: sanitizeSurveyTerminologyForReader(
      positioningFormulaSummary
    ),
    fourPsSummary: {
      productP1:
        modI?.step2FourPs?.productP1?.coreDeliverableSummary?.trim() || '',
      priceP2:
        modI?.step2FourPs?.priceP2?.priceJustification?.trim() ||
        modI?.step2FourPs?.priceP2?.headlinePricePoint?.trim() ||
        '',
      placeP3: (modI?.step2FourPs?.placeP3?.primaryChannel || '').replace(
        /_/g,
        ' '
      ),
      promotionP4:
        modI?.step2FourPs?.promotionP4?.beachheadChannelTactics?.trim() || '',
    },
    first10ArchetypeLabel: (
      modI?.step3First10?.acquisitionArchetype || ''
    ).replace(/_/g, ' '),
    pilotOfferHeadline:
      modI?.step3First10?.pilotOffer?.pilotStructure?.trim() || '',
    first10ProspectsCount: iProspects.length,
    committedOrPilotProspectsCount,
    monthlyMarketingBudget:
      Number(modI?.step4Budget?.totalPlannedMonthlyMarketingSpend) || 0,
    calculatedCashCac: Number(modI?.step4Budget?.calculatedCashCac) || 0,
    calculatedLtv: Number(modI?.step4Budget?.calculatedLtv) || 0,
    calculatedLtvToCacRatio:
      Number(modI?.step4Budget?.calculatedLtvToCacRatio) || 0,
    calculatedPaybackMonths:
      Number(modI?.step4Budget?.calculatedPaybackMonths) || 0,
    executiveMarketingSummaryNarrative: sanitizeSurveyTerminologyForReader(
      modI?.step5MarketingBrief?.executiveMarketingSummaryNarrative?.trim() || ''
    ),

    // Module J Returned Facts
    operatingCostPostureLabel: (
      modJ?.step1OverheadsTax?.operatingCostPosture || ''
    ).replace(/_/g, ' '),
    monthlyFixedOverheadsTotal,
    monthlyFounderDrawingsYear1:
      Number(modJ?.step1OverheadsTax?.monthlyFounderDrawingsYear1) || 0,
    monthlyTeamSalariesYear1:
      Number(modJ?.step1OverheadsTax?.monthlyTeamSalariesYear1) || 0,
    customerCollectionTimingLabel: (
      modJ?.step2WorkingCapital?.customerCollectionTiming || ''
    ).replace(/_/g, ' '),
    primaryFundingStrategyLabel: (
      modJ?.step3CashflowGap?.primaryFundingStrategy || ''
    ).replace(/_/g, ' '),
    startingCashBalanceDay1:
      Number(modJ?.step3CashflowGap?.startingCashBalanceDay1) || 0,
    totalExternalFundingMapped,
    writtenFinancialAssumptionsBlock: sanitizeSurveyTerminologyForReader(
      modJ?.step4Statements?.writtenFinancialAssumptionsBlock?.trim() || ''
    ),
    executiveFinancialSummaryNarrative: sanitizeSurveyTerminologyForReader(
      modJ?.step5FinanceBrief?.executiveFinancialSummaryNarrative?.trim() || ''
    ),

    // Module K Returned Facts
    selectedGrantKey: modK?.step1Audit?.selectedGrantKey || '',
    overallAssessorReadinessScore:
      Number(modK?.step1Audit?.overallAssessorReadinessScore) ||
      Number(modK?.step5FundingBrief?.assessorReadinessScore) ||
      0,
    totalTargetFundingGap:
      Number(modK?.step2CapitalStack?.totalTargetFundingGap) || 0,
    skinInTheGameCash: Number(modK?.step2CapitalStack?.skinInTheGameCash) || 0,
    totalGrantsAllocated:
      Number(modK?.step2CapitalStack?.totalGrantsAllocated) || 0,
    totalLoansAllocated:
      Number(modK?.step2CapitalStack?.totalLoansAllocated) || 0,
    totalAngelAllocated:
      Number(modK?.step2CapitalStack?.totalAngelAllocated) || 0,
    skinInTheGamePercent:
      Number(modK?.step2CapitalStack?.skinInTheGamePercent) || 0,
    projectedEquityDilutionPercent:
      Number(modK?.step2CapitalStack?.projectedEquityDilutionPercent) || 0,
    grantReimbursementTurnaroundWeeks:
      Number(modK?.step3ReimbursementBridge?.estimatedClaimTurnaroundWeeks) || 0,
    bridgeStrategyLabel: (
      modK?.step3ReimbursementBridge?.bridgeStrategy || ''
    ).replace(/_/g, ' '),
    isAssessorLiquidityCompliant: Boolean(
      modK?.step3ReimbursementBridge?.isAssessorLiquidityCompliant
    ),
    primaryTaxScheme: modK?.step4TaxRelief?.primaryTaxScheme || '',
    targetReliefRaiseAmount:
      Number(modK?.step4TaxRelief?.targetReliefRaiseAmount) || 0,
    advanceAssuranceStatus: (
      modK?.step4TaxRelief?.advanceAssuranceStatus || ''
    ).replace(/_/g, ' '),
    executiveFundingSummaryNarrative: sanitizeSurveyTerminologyForReader(
      modK?.step5FundingBrief?.executiveSummary?.trim() ||
        modK?.step2CapitalStack?.fundingStrategyNarrative?.trim() ||
        ''
    ),

    // Module L Returned Facts
    compilerModeLabel: (modL?.step1Mode?.compilerMode || 'STANDARD_BUSINESS_PLAN').replace(/_/g, ' '),
    submissionObjectiveLabel: (modL?.step1Mode?.submissionObjective || 'INVESTOR_AND_COMMERCIAL_FINANCING').replace(/_/g, ' '),
    targetAgencyOrCommitteeName: modL?.step1Mode?.targetAgencyOrCommitteeName?.trim() || 'Assessor Committee',
    targetFundingAskAmount: Number(modL?.step1Mode?.targetFundingAskAmount) || 0,
    contradictionAuditScore: Number(modL?.step2Audit?.overallAuditScore) || (hasModuleL ? 85 : 0),
    auditPassedCount: (modL?.step2Audit?.auditItems || []).filter((i) => i.status === 'PASSED').length,
    auditWarningCount: (modL?.step2Audit?.auditItems || []).filter((i) => i.status === 'WARNING').length,
    auditCriticalCount: (modL?.step2Audit?.auditItems || []).filter((i) => i.status === 'CRITICAL').length,
    preFlightDefenseSummary: sanitizeSurveyTerminologyForReader(
      modL?.step2Audit?.preFlightDefenseSummary?.trim() || ''
    ),
    compiledSectionsCount: lSections.length,
    totalCompiledWordCount: lSections.reduce(
      (sum, s) => sum + (s.compiledResponseText?.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length || 0),
      0
    ),
    executiveHookStatement: sanitizeSurveyTerminologyForReader(
      modL?.step3Compiler?.executiveHookStatement?.trim() || ''
    ),
    appendicesReadyCount: (modL?.step4Appendices?.appendices || []).filter(
      (a: { included?: boolean; readinessStatus?: string }) =>
        a.included && a.readinessStatus === 'VERIFIED_READY'
    ).length,
    totalAppendicesCount: (modL?.step4Appendices?.appendices || []).length || 6,
    committeeReadinessScore:
      Number(modL?.step5DossierBrief?.committeeReadinessScore) ||
      Number(modL?.step2Audit?.overallAuditScore) ||
      0,
    executiveDossierSummary: sanitizeSurveyTerminologyForReader(
      modL?.step5DossierBrief?.executiveDossierSummary?.trim() || ''
    ),
  };
}

/**
 * Builds the 3-Paragraph Cohesive Executive Story using 100% deterministic,
 * strictly grounded facts from the founder's saved inputs.
 * Never invents or extrapolates any fact that has not been entered.
 */
export function buildDeterministicMasterStory(
  facts: MasterDocumentVerifiedFacts
): SavedMasterDocumentData {
  // Paragraph 1: Opportunity, Concept & Market (Modules A + B)
  const p1Parts: string[] = [];
  const p1Sources: string[] = [];

  if (facts.hasModuleA) {
    const coreIntro = `${facts.planTitle} is a ${facts.countryName}-based (${facts.currency}) ${facts.industryCategory} venture${
      facts.targetCustomer ? ` built for ${facts.targetCustomer}` : ''
    }.`;
    p1Parts.push(coreIntro);
    if (facts.coreProblem) {
      p1Parts.push(`The core problem addressed is: ${facts.coreProblem}`);
    }
    if (facts.proposedSolution) {
      p1Parts.push(`Proposed solution: ${facts.proposedSolution}`);
    }
    p1Sources.push('Module A: Concept Canvas');

    if (facts.teamStructureLabel || facts.startingBudgetLabel) {
      p1Parts.push(
        `The business is structured as a ${facts.teamStructureLabel || 'founder-led'} operation (${facts.weeklyHoursLabel || 'active weekly commitment'}) with an initial starting budget in the ${facts.startingBudgetLabel || 'bootstrapped'} bracket.`
      );
      p1Sources.push('Module A: Founder Fit & Budget');
    }
  }

  if (facts.hasModuleB) {
    if (facts.beachheadSegment) {
      p1Parts.push(
        `In Module B, the priority beachhead customer segment is defined as ${facts.beachheadSegment}${
          facts.buyerModelLabel ? ` (${facts.buyerModelLabel})` : ''
        }.`
      );
      p1Sources.push('Module B: Beachhead Persona');
    }
    if (facts.whySwitchOneSentence) {
      p1Parts.push(
        `Customers switch from existing alternatives${
          facts.competitorNames.length > 0
            ? ` (${facts.competitorNames.slice(0, 3).join(', ')})`
            : ''
        } because: ${facts.whySwitchOneSentence}`
      );
      p1Sources.push('Module B: Competitor Analysis');
    }
    if (facts.somAnnualRevenue > 0) {
      p1Parts.push(
        `Bottom-up market sizing targets a Year 1–2 Serviceable Obtainable Market (SOM) of ${facts.somFormatted}/year within a reachable market (SAM) of ${facts.samFormatted}/year.`
      );
      p1Sources.push('Module B: Market Sizing (SOM/SAM)');
    }
  }

  if (facts.hasModuleI) {
    if (facts.elevatorHook140) {
      p1Parts.push(
        `Brand positioning leads with: "${facts.elevatorHook140}"${
          facts.first10ProspectsCount > 0
            ? `, backed by a First-10 pipeline of ${facts.first10ProspectsCount} named prospect(s) (${facts.committedOrPilotProspectsCount} in active pilot/paid status)`
            : ''
        }.`
      );
      p1Sources.push('Module I: Brand Positioning & First 10');
    }
    if (facts.monthlyMarketingBudget > 0 || facts.calculatedCashCac > 0) {
      p1Parts.push(
        `Growth economics allocate ${formatPlanCurrency(
          facts.monthlyMarketingBudget,
          facts.currency
        )}/month in acquisition budget with a modeled cash CAC of ${formatPlanCurrency(
          facts.calculatedCashCac,
          facts.currency
        )}${
          facts.calculatedLtvToCacRatio > 0
            ? ` (${facts.calculatedLtvToCacRatio.toFixed(1)}:1 LTV:CAC)`
            : ''
        }.`
      );
      p1Sources.push('Module I: Marketing Budget & CAC/LTV');
    }
  }

  const paragraph1OpportunityAndMarket =
    p1Parts.length > 0
      ? sanitizeSurveyTerminologyForReader(p1Parts.join(' '))
      : `${facts.planTitle} (${facts.countryName} • ${facts.currency}) is currently capturing its initial concept, market, and positioning foundations across Modules A, B, and I.`;

  // Paragraph 2: Customer Validation & Product Architecture (Modules C + D)
  const p2Parts: string[] = [];
  const p2Sources: string[] = [];

  if (facts.hasModuleC) {
    const surveyPieces: string[] = [];
    if (facts.surveysCount > 0) {
      surveyPieces.push(
        `${facts.totalSurveyResponses} response(s) across ${facts.surveysCount} public validation survey(s)${
          facts.waitlistOptInsCount > 0
            ? ` (with ${facts.waitlistOptInsCount} early waitlist signup(s))`
            : ''
        }`
      );
      p2Sources.push('Module C: Public Validation Surveys');
    }
    if (facts.interviewsCount > 0) {
      surveyPieces.push(
        `${facts.interviewsCount} logged 1-on-1 customer discovery interview(s)${
          facts.avgInterviewPainScore
            ? ` averaging ${facts.avgInterviewPainScore}/5 on problem urgency`
            : ''
        }`
      );
      p2Sources.push('Module C: 1-on-1 Customer Interviews');
    }
    if (surveyPieces.length > 0) {
      p2Parts.push(
        `Customer validation to date encompasses ${surveyPieces.join(' and ')}.`
      );
    }
    if (facts.surveyHeadlineInsight) {
      p2Parts.push(`Key validation signal: ${facts.surveyHeadlineInsight}`);
    } else if (facts.sampleCustomerQuote) {
      p2Parts.push(`Recorded customer takeaway: "${facts.sampleCustomerQuote}"`);
    }
  }

  if (facts.hasModuleD) {
    if (facts.formFactorLabel || facts.productTrackLabel) {
      p2Parts.push(
        `On the product side, ${facts.planTitle} is building a ${
          facts.formFactorLabel || facts.productTrackLabel
        }${
          facts.launchTimelineLabel
            ? ` targeting a V1 launch window of ${facts.launchTimelineLabel}`
            : ''
        }.`
      );
      p2Sources.push('Module D: Product Vehicle');
    }
    if (
      facts.ownedChannelsSharePercent > 0 ||
      facts.rentedChannelsSharePercent > 0
    ) {
      p2Parts.push(
        `Distribution is structured around ${facts.ownedChannelsSharePercent}% owned direct channels and ${facts.rentedChannelsSharePercent}% partner or marketplace channels.`
      );
      p2Sources.push('Module D: Own vs. Rent Channel Matrix');
    }
    if (facts.v1MustHaveTitles.length > 0) {
      p2Parts.push(
        `V1 scope is strictly focused on ${facts.v1MustHaveTitles
          .slice(0, 4)
          .join(', ')}${
          facts.deferredPostV1Titles.length > 0
            ? `, while deferring ${facts.deferredPostV1Titles
                .slice(0, 3)
                .join(', ')} to post-launch phases`
            : ''
        }.`
      );
      p2Sources.push('Module D: V1 Scope Filter');
    }
    if (facts.workPackagesCount > 0) {
      p2Parts.push(
        `Execution is broken into ${facts.workPackagesCount} structured work package(s) with an estimated build budget of ${formatPlanCurrency(
          facts.totalWorkPackagesCost,
          facts.currency
        )}.`
      );
      p2Sources.push('Module D: Work Packages');
    }
  }

  if (facts.hasModuleH) {
    if (facts.revenueModelVehicleLabel || facts.pricingTiersCount > 0) {
      p2Parts.push(
        `Commercial monetization operates via ${
          facts.revenueModelVehicleLabel || 'tiered pricing'
        } across ${facts.pricingTiersCount} pricing tier(s) (blended net price: ${formatPlanCurrency(
          facts.blendedAveragePriceNet,
          facts.currency
        )}${facts.valueMetric ? ` ${facts.valueMetric}` : ''}).`
      );
      p2Sources.push('Module H: Pricing Architect');
    }
    if (facts.year1ProjectedNetTurnover > 0) {
      p2Parts.push(
        `The 3-Year Pocket Profit breakeven model targets ${
          facts.year1TargetCustomers
        } Year 1 customers generating ${formatPlanCurrency(
          facts.year1ProjectedNetTurnover,
          facts.currency
        )} in Year 1 net turnover (${formatPlanCurrency(
          facts.year1PocketProfitNet,
          facts.currency
        )} net pocket profit)${
          facts.year3ProjectedNetTurnover > 0
            ? `, scaling to ${formatPlanCurrency(
                facts.year3ProjectedNetTurnover,
                facts.currency
              )} by Year 3`
            : ''
        }.`
      );
      p2Sources.push('Module H: 3-Year Breakeven Engine');
    }
  }

  const paragraph2ValidationAndProduct =
    p2Parts.length > 0
      ? sanitizeSurveyTerminologyForReader(p2Parts.join(' '))
      : 'Customer validation (Module C), Product Architecture (Module D), and Revenue & Pricing (Module H) have not yet been populated.';

  // Paragraph 3: Operations, Fulfillment, Equipment & Risk Posture (Module E)
  const p3Parts: string[] = [];
  const p3Sources: string[] = [];

  if (facts.hasModuleE) {
    if (facts.fulfillmentModeLabel) {
      p3Parts.push(
        `Operational fulfillment runs via ${facts.fulfillmentModeLabel}${
          facts.turnaroundSlaLabel
            ? ` with a target turnaround SLA of ${facts.turnaroundSlaLabel}`
            : ''
        }.`
      );
      p3Sources.push('Module E: Fulfillment Blueprint');
    }
    if (facts.orderStagesCount > 0) {
      p3Parts.push(
        `Across ${facts.orderStagesCount} mapped order lifecycle stages, each order requires ${facts.totalActiveMinutesPerOrder} active minutes and ${formatPlanCurrency(
          facts.totalDirectVariableCostPerOrder,
          facts.currency
        )} in direct variable fulfillment cost${
          facts.maxWeeklyOrdersCapacity > 0
            ? ` (supporting up to ~${facts.maxWeeklyOrdersCapacity} orders/week within ${facts.weeklyOpsHoursAllocated} allocated weekly ops hours)`
            : ''
        }.`
      );
      p3Sources.push('Module E: Unit Order Lifecycle');
    }
    if (facts.premisesModeLabel || facts.equipmentItemsCount > 0) {
      p3Parts.push(
        `The business operates from a ${
          facts.premisesModeLabel || 'lean premises setup'
        } (${formatPlanCurrency(facts.monthlyPremisesCost, facts.currency)}/month overhead) with ${
          facts.equipmentItemsCount
        } scheduled equipment asset(s) totaling ${formatPlanCurrency(
          facts.totalEquipmentCapexExVat,
          facts.currency
        )} ex-VAT.`
      );
      p3Sources.push('Module E: Premises & Equipment Schedule');
    }
    if (facts.riskItemsCount > 0) {
      p3Parts.push(
        `Operational governance tracks ${facts.riskItemsCount} formal project risk(s)${
          facts.qcCheckpointsCount > 0
            ? ` and ${facts.qcCheckpointsCount} quality control checkpoint(s)`
            : ''
        }${
          facts.topRiskTitleAndMitigation
            ? `, led by mitigating "${facts.topRiskTitleAndMitigation}"`
            : ''
        }.`
      );
      p3Sources.push('Module E: Risk Register & QC');
    }
  } else if (facts.hasModuleA && facts.dealbreakersList.length > 0) {
    p3Parts.push(
      `Operational guardrails established in Module A enforce key founder non-negotiables (${facts.dealbreakersList.join(
        ', '
      )}) and a ${
        facts.growthTradeoffLabel || 'disciplined'
      } growth strategy.`
    );
    p3Sources.push('Module A: Founder Non-Negotiables');
  }

  if (facts.hasModuleF) {
    p3Parts.push(
      `The founding team comprises ${facts.teamMembersCount} promoter profile(s) (${
        facts.hatsAssignedCount
      }/7 functional startup hats assigned, ${formatPlanCurrency(
        facts.monthlyNetSurvivalBurnTotal,
        facts.currency
      )}/mo combined net personal survival budget${
        facts.plannedHiresCount > 0
          ? `, and ${facts.plannedHiresCount} scheduled 3-year hire(s)`
          : ''
      }).`
    );
    p3Sources.push('Module F: Team, Survival Budget & Hiring');
  }

  if (facts.hasModuleG) {
    p3Parts.push(
      `Launchpad operations readiness stands at ${facts.opsReadinessPercent}% (${
        facts.legalEntityStructureLabel || 'Legal structure'
      }${
        facts.registeredEntityName ? ` • ${facts.registeredEntityName}` : ''
      }${facts.primaryDomain ? ` • ${facts.primaryDomain}` : ''}).`
    );
    p3Sources.push('Module G: Launchpad & Ops Hub');
  }

  if (facts.hasModuleJ) {
    p3Parts.push(
      `In Module J, 36-month financials model ${formatPlanCurrency(
        facts.monthlyFixedOverheadsTotal,
        facts.currency
      )}/mo in fixed overheads, ${formatPlanCurrency(
        facts.startingCashBalanceDay1,
        facts.currency
      )} Day-1 cash, and ${formatPlanCurrency(
        facts.totalExternalFundingMapped,
        facts.currency
      )} in mapped external funding.`
    );
    p3Sources.push('Module J: 36-Month Financial Builder');
  }

  if (facts.hasModuleK) {
    p3Parts.push(
      `Module K structures a ${formatPlanCurrency(
        facts.totalTargetFundingGap,
        facts.currency
      )} capital stack (${formatPlanCurrency(
        facts.skinInTheGameCash,
        facts.currency
      )} founder cash [${facts.skinInTheGamePercent}%], ${formatPlanCurrency(
        facts.totalGrantsAllocated,
        facts.currency
      )} non-dilutive grants, ${formatPlanCurrency(
        facts.totalLoansAllocated,
        facts.currency
      )} loans, and ${formatPlanCurrency(
        facts.totalAngelAllocated,
        facts.currency
      )} equity${
        facts.primaryTaxScheme && facts.primaryTaxScheme !== 'NONE'
          ? ` via ${facts.primaryTaxScheme}`
          : ''
      }) with an assessor readiness score of ${facts.overallAssessorReadinessScore}/100.`
    );
    p3Sources.push('Module K: Grants, Capital Stack & Tax Relief');
  }

  if (facts.hasModuleL) {
    p3Parts.push(
      `Module L compiles the dossier in ${facts.compilerModeLabel} mode for ${facts.targetAgencyOrCommitteeName} (targeting ${formatPlanCurrency(facts.targetFundingAskAmount, facts.currency)}), achieving an assessor pre-flight audit clearance of ${facts.contradictionAuditScore}/100 across ${facts.compiledSectionsCount} structured narrative questions and ${facts.appendicesReadyCount}/${facts.totalAppendicesCount} verified proof appendices.`
    );
    p3Sources.push('Module L: Official Grant & Business Plan Compiler');
  }

  const paragraph3OperationsAndExecution =
    p3Parts.length > 0
      ? sanitizeSurveyTerminologyForReader(p3Parts.join(' '))
      : 'Operations (Module E), Team & Launchpad (Modules F–G), 36-Month Financials (Module J), and Non-Dilutive Capital Stack (Module K) have not yet been populated.';

  return {
    paragraph1OpportunityAndMarket,
    paragraph1Sources:
      p1Sources.length > 0 ? p1Sources : ['Awaiting Module A, B & I Inputs'],
    paragraph2ValidationAndProduct,
    paragraph2Sources:
      p2Sources.length > 0 ? p2Sources : ['Awaiting Module C, D & H Inputs'],
    paragraph3OperationsAndExecution,
    paragraph3Sources:
      p3Sources.length > 0
        ? p3Sources
        : ['Awaiting Module E, F, G, J & K Inputs'],
    isCustomEdited: false,
    lastWeavedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    aiEngineUsed: 'smart-synthesizer',
  };
}

/**
 * Generates a complete, reader-friendly Markdown export of the Living Master Document.
 * Never outputs `/v/[slug]`—always refers to Public Validation Surveys.
 */
export function buildMasterDocumentMarkdown(
  params: MasterDocumentInputParams & {
    story: SavedMasterDocumentData;
    showUpcomingChaptersRoadmap?: boolean;
  }
): string {
  const facts = extractMasterDocumentVerifiedFacts(params);
  const { plan, story, showUpcomingChaptersRoadmap } = params;
  const dateStr = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-IE', {
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'short',
    day: 'numeric',
  });

  const lines: string[] = [
    `# ${facts.planTitle} — Living Master Business Blueprint`,
    `**Prepared by:** ${facts.founderName} | **Date:** ${dateStr}`,
    `**HQ Country:** ${facts.countryName} (${facts.currency}) | **Industry:** ${facts.industryCategory} | **Scope:** ${facts.exportScopeLabel}`,
    `**Blueprint Progress:** ${facts.activeChaptersCount} of 11 Foundation Chapters Active (${facts.overallCompletionPercent}% Assembled)`,
    '',
    '---',
    '',
    '## 1. Executive Snapshot (Whole-Picture Summary)',
    '',
    '### 🎯 The Concept & Founder Fit (Module A)',
    `- **Core Problem:** ${facts.coreProblem || 'Not yet entered in Module A.'}`,
    `- **Target Customer:** ${facts.targetCustomer || 'Not yet entered in Module A.'}`,
    `- **Proposed Solution:** ${facts.proposedSolution || 'Not yet entered in Module A.'}`,
    `- **Unfair Advantage:** ${facts.unfairAdvantage || 'Not yet entered in Module A.'}`,
    `- **Founder Commitment & Budget:** ${facts.teamStructureLabel || 'Founder'} • ${facts.weeklyHoursLabel || 'Weekly hours not set'} • ${facts.startingBudgetLabel || 'Budget not set'}`,
    '',
    '### 📊 Market & Competitive Wedge (Module B)',
    ...(facts.hasModuleB
      ? [
          `- **Priority Beachhead Customer:** ${facts.beachheadSegment || 'Not yet specified'} (${facts.buyerModelLabel || 'Buyer model not set'})`,
          `- **Why Customers Switch:** ${facts.whySwitchOneSentence || 'Not yet specified'}`,

  if (facts.hasModuleJ) {

      '---',
      '',
      '## Chapter 10: 36-Month Financial Builder, Overheads, Working Capital & Cashflow Trough (Module J)',
      '',
      `- **Operating Cost Posture:** ${facts.operatingCostPostureLabel || 'Lean'} • Monthly Fixed Overheads: ${formatPlanCurrency(facts.monthlyFixedOverheadsTotal, facts.currency)}/mo`,
      `- **Year 1 Monthly Payroll & Drawings:** ${formatPlanCurrency(facts.monthlyFounderDrawingsYear1, facts.currency)}/mo Founder Drawings • ${formatPlanCurrency(facts.monthlyTeamSalariesYear1, facts.currency)}/mo Team Salaries`,
      `- **Working Capital Timing:** Customer Collection: ${facts.customerCollectionTimingLabel || '—'}`,
      `- **Funding Strategy & Cashflow Bridge:** ${facts.primaryFundingStrategyLabel || '—'} • Day-1 Cash Balance: ${formatPlanCurrency(facts.startingCashBalanceDay1, facts.currency)} • Mapped External Funding: ${formatPlanCurrency(facts.totalExternalFundingMapped, facts.currency)}`,
      ...(facts.writtenFinancialAssumptionsBlock
        ? [
            '',
            `- **Written Financial Assumptions:** ${facts.writtenFinancialAssumptionsBlock}`,
          ]
        : []),
      ...(facts.executiveFinancialSummaryNarrative
        ? [
            '',
            `- **Executive Financial Summary:** ${facts.executiveFinancialSummaryNarrative}`,
          ]
        : []),
      ''
    );
  }

  // Chapter 11: Module K
  if (facts.hasModuleK) {
    lines.push(
      '---',
      '',
      '## Chapter 11: Non-Dilutive Grants, Capital Stack, Reimbursement Bridge & Tax Relief (Module K)',
      '',
      `- **Target Primary Grant Scheme:** ${facts.selectedGrantKey || '—'} (Assessor Readiness Score: ${facts.overallAssessorReadinessScore}/100)`,
      `- **Total Target Funding Gap:** ${formatPlanCurrency(facts.totalTargetFundingGap, facts.currency)}`,
      `- **Capital Stack Breakdown:** Founder Skin-in-the-Game Cash: ${formatPlanCurrency(facts.skinInTheGameCash, facts.currency)} (${facts.skinInTheGamePercent}%) | Non-Dilutive Grants: ${formatPlanCurrency(facts.totalGrantsAllocated, facts.currency)} | Loans/Debt: ${formatPlanCurrency(facts.totalLoansAllocated, facts.currency)} | Angel/Equity: ${formatPlanCurrency(facts.totalAngelAllocated, facts.currency)} (${facts.projectedEquityDilutionPercent}% dilution)`,
      `- **Vouched Grant Reimbursement Timing Bridge:** ${facts.grantReimbursementTurnaroundWeeks} weeks estimated claim turnaround • Bridge Strategy: ${facts.bridgeStrategyLabel || '—'} (${facts.isAssessorLiquidityCompliant ? 'Assessor Liquidity Compliant' : 'Requires Additional Bridge Buffer'})`,
      `- **Investor Tax Relief Catalyst:** ${facts.primaryTaxScheme || 'NONE'} • Target Relief Raise: ${formatPlanCurrency(facts.targetReliefRaiseAmount, facts.currency)} (${facts.advanceAssuranceStatus || 'Status TBD'})`,
      ...(facts.executiveFundingSummaryNarrative
        ? [
            '',
            `- **Executive Funding & Grant Strategy Summary:** ${facts.executiveFundingSummaryNarrative}`,
          ]
        : []),
      ''
    );
  }

  // Chapter 12: Module L
  if (facts.hasModuleL) {
    lines.push(
      '---',
      '',
      '## Chapter 12: Interactive Business Plan & Official Grant Compiler (Module L)',
      '',
      `- **Compiler Mode & Objective:** ${facts.compilerModeLabel} (${facts.submissionObjectiveLabel})`,
      `- **Target Assessor Committee:** ${facts.targetAgencyOrCommitteeName} • Target Funding Ask: ${formatPlanCurrency(facts.targetFundingAskAmount, facts.currency)}`,
      `- **Cross-Module Contradiction Audit:** ${facts.contradictionAuditScore}/100 Pre-Flight Clearance (${facts.auditPassedCount} Passed, ${facts.auditWarningCount} Warnings, ${facts.auditCriticalCount} Critical)`,
      `- **Compiled Narrative Sections:** ${facts.compiledSectionsCount} structured question(s) (~${facts.totalCompiledWordCount.toLocaleString()} total words)`,
      `- **Mandatory Proof Binder (Appendices A–F):** ${facts.appendicesReadyCount}/${facts.totalAppendicesCount} verified ready`,
      `- **Final Committee Readiness Score:** ${facts.committeeReadinessScore}/100`,
      ...(facts.executiveHookStatement
        ? [
            '',
            `- **Executive Hook Statement:** ${facts.executiveHookStatement}`,
          ]
        : []),
      ...(facts.preFlightDefenseSummary
        ? [
            '',
            `- **Pre-Flight Defense Statement:** ${facts.preFlightDefenseSummary}`,
          ]
        : []),
      ...(facts.executiveDossierSummary
        ? [
            '',
            `- **Official Dossier Summary:** ${facts.executiveDossierSummary}`,
          ]
        : []),
      ''
    );
  } else if (showUpcomingChaptersRoadmap) {
    lines.push(
      '---',
      '',
      '## Official Submission & Export Readiness (Module L)',
      '- **Module L (Interactive Business Plan & Official Grant Compiler):** Ready to compile Chapters 1–11 into IE LEO Official Form + Appendices A–F, UK Innovate UK 9-Question IFS Mode, UK Start Up Loans Workbook, UK HMRC SEIS/EIS Advance Assurance Pack, or Standard Bank/Investor Business Plan.',
      ''
    );
  }

  return lines.join('\n');
}

  // Chapter 2: Module B
  if (facts.hasModuleB && plan.moduleBData) {

    sections.push(`

            <div class="box-value" style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800;">${escapeDocumentHtml(facts.tamFormatted || '—')}/yr</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="grid-2">

        ${
          comps.length > 0

                <thead>

                    <th>Typical Price</th>
                    <th>What They Do Well</th>

                      <td>${escapeDocumentHtml(c.whatTheyDoWell || '—')}</td>
                      <td>${escapeDocumentHtml(c.whereTheyFallShort || '—')}</td>
                    </tr>`
                    )
                    .join('')}
                </tbody>
              </table>`

        }

  }

  // Chapter 3: Module C
  if (facts.hasModuleC && plan.moduleCData) {
    const logs = plan.moduleCData.interviewLogs || [];
    sections.push(`
      <div class="section">
        <div class="section-header">
          <span class="section-num">C</span>
          <span class="section-title">Chapter 3: Public Validation Surveys, Waitlist & 1-on-1 Interviews (Module C)</span>
        </div>
        <div class="grid-3" style="margin-bottom: 12px;">
          <div class="box">
            <div class="box-label">Public Survey Responses</div>
            <div class="box-value"><strong>${facts.totalSurveyResponses}</strong> response(s) across ${facts.surveysCount} survey(s)</div>

import { Resend } from 'resend';

// Resend client singleton
// If RESEND_API_KEY is not defined (e.g. fresh dev environment),
// calls gracefully drop into dev mock mode rather than crashing.
export const resend = process.env.RESEND_API_KEY
  ? new Resend(process.env.RESEND_API_KEY)
  : null;

export const EMAIL_DEFAULTS = {
  // Verified domain on Resend
  from:
    process.env.EMAIL_FROM_SYSTEM ||
    'Startup Preflight <noreply@startuppreflight.com>',

import * as React from 'react';
import { Heading, Text, Section, Button } from '@react-email/components';
import { EmailLayout } from './components/layout';

export interface PasswordResetEmailProps {
  recipientEmail: string;
  resetUrl: string;
  expiresInMinutes?: number;
}

export const PasswordResetEmail: React.FC<PasswordResetEmailProps> = ({
  recipientEmail,
  resetUrl,
  expiresInMinutes = 60,
}) => {
  return (
    <EmailLayout previewText="Reset your Startup Preflight password">
      <Heading style={headingStyle}>Password Reset Request 🔐</Heading>

      <Text style={paragraphStyle}>
        We received a request to reset the password for your Startup Preflight
        account associated with <strong>{recipientEmail}</strong>.
      </Text>

      <Section style={ctaSectionStyle}>
        <Button style={buttonStyle} href={resetUrl}>
          Reset Your Password →
        </Button>
      </Section>

      <Text style={paragraphStyle}>
        This password reset link is valid for the next{' '}
        <strong>{expiresInMinutes} minutes</strong>. If you did not request a
        password reset, you can safely ignore this email — your account remains
        fully secure.
      </Text>

      <Section style={warningCardStyle}>
        <Text style={warningTextStyle}>
          <strong>Security Notice:</strong> Never forward or share this link
          with anyone. Startup Preflight staff will never ask for your password or
          reset link.
        </Text>
      </Section>
    </EmailLayout>
  );
};

const headingStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  fontSize: '22px',
  lineHeight: '28px',
  fontWeight: 800,
  color: '#0f172a',
  margin: '0 0 16px 0',
};

const paragraphStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  fontSize: '14px',
  lineHeight: '22px',
  color: '#334155',
  margin: '0 0 16px 0',
};

const ctaSectionStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  textAlign: 'center',
  margin: '24px 0',
};

const buttonStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  backgroundColor: '#4f46e5',
  borderRadius: '8px',
  color: '#ffffff',
  fontSize: '14px',
  fontWeight: 700,
  textDecoration: 'none',
  textAlign: 'center',
  display: 'inline-block',
  padding: '12px 24px',
  boxShadow: '0 2px 4px rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.25)',
};

const warningCardStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  backgroundColor: '#fef2f2',
  border: '1px solid #fee2e2',
  borderRadius: '8px',
  padding: '12px 16px',
  margin: '20px 0',
};

const warningTextStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  fontSize: '12px',
  lineHeight: '18px',
  color: '#991b1b',
  margin: 0,
};

=== src/lib/email/send.tsx ===
import React from 'react';
import { render } from '@react-email/components';
import { resend, EMAIL_DEFAULTS } from './resend';
import { db } from '@/db';
import { emailLogs } from '@/db/schema';
import {
  WelcomeFounderEmail,
  WelcomeFounderEmailProps,
} from './templates/welcome';
import {
  PasswordResetEmail,
  PasswordResetEmailProps,
} from './templates/password-reset';
import {
  VoucherRedeemedEmail,
  VoucherRedeemedEmailProps,
} from './templates/voucher-redeemed';
import {
  CofounderInviteEmail,
  CofounderInviteEmailProps,
} from './templates/cofounder-invite';
import {
  QuoteRfpPartnerInviteEmail,
  QuoteRfpPartnerInviteEmailProps,
} from './templates/quote-rfp-partner-invite';
import {
  QuoteRfpDispatchedFounderReceipt,
  QuoteRfpDispatchedFounderReceiptProps,
} from './templates/quote-rfp-dispatched-founder-receipt';
import {
  QuoteReceivedFounderEmail,
  QuoteReceivedFounderEmailProps,
} from './templates/quote-received-founder';

export type EmailTemplateType =
  | 'WELCOME_FOUNDER'
  | 'PASSWORD_RESET'
  | 'VOUCHER_REDEEMED'
  | 'COFOUNDER_INVITE'
  | 'QUOTE_RFP_PARTNER_INVITE'
  | 'QUOTE_RFP_FOUNDER_RECEIPT'
  | 'QUOTE_RECEIVED_FOUNDER';

export type TemplatePropsMap = {
  WELCOME_FOUNDER: WelcomeFounderEmailProps;
  PASSWORD_RESET: PasswordResetEmailProps;
  VOUCHER_REDEEMED: VoucherRedeemedEmailProps;
  COFOUNDER_INVITE: CofounderInviteEmailProps;
  QUOTE_RFP_PARTNER_INVITE: QuoteRfpPartnerInviteEmailProps;
  QUOTE_RFP_FOUNDER_RECEIPT: QuoteRfpDispatchedFounderReceiptProps;
  QUOTE_RECEIVED_FOUNDER: QuoteReceivedFounderEmailProps;
};

export interface SendSystemEmailParams<T extends EmailTemplateType> {
  to: string;
  template: T;
  subject: string;
  props: TemplatePropsMap[T];
  from?: string;
  replyTo?: string;
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export interface SendEmailResult {
  ok: boolean;
  resendId?: string;
  error?: string;
  isMockDev?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Renders the chosen React Email template to an HTML string.
 */
export async function renderEmailHtml<T extends EmailTemplateType>(
  template: T,
  props: TemplatePropsMap[T]
): Promise<string> {
  let element: React.ReactElement;

  switch (template) {
    case 'WELCOME_FOUNDER':
      element = <WelcomeFounderEmail {...(props as WelcomeFounderEmailProps)} />;
      break;
    case 'PASSWORD_RESET':
      element = <PasswordResetEmail {...(props as PasswordResetEmailProps)} />;
      break;
    case 'VOUCHER_REDEEMED':
      element = <VoucherRedeemedEmail {...(props as VoucherRedeemedEmailProps)} />;
      break;
    case 'COFOUNDER_INVITE':
      element = <CofounderInviteEmail {...(props as CofounderInviteEmailProps)} />;
      break;
    case 'QUOTE_RFP_PARTNER_INVITE':
      element = <QuoteRfpPartnerInviteEmail {...(props as QuoteRfpPartnerInviteEmailProps)} />;
      break;
    case 'QUOTE_RFP_FOUNDER_RECEIPT':
      element = <QuoteRfpDispatchedFounderReceipt {...(props as QuoteRfpDispatchedFounderReceiptProps)} />;
      break;
    case 'QUOTE_RECEIVED_FOUNDER':
      element = <QuoteReceivedFounderEmail {...(props as QuoteReceivedFounderEmailProps)} />;
      break;
    default:
      throw new Error(`Unknown email template: ${template}`);
  }

  return await render(element);
}

/**
 * Centralized, fail-safe system email dispatcher.
 * Logs all dispatches to PostgreSQL (email_logs) for auditability.
 * In development without RESEND_API_KEY, safely logs mock delivery.
 */
export async function sendSystemEmail<T extends EmailTemplateType>({
  to,
  template,
  subject,
  props,
  from = EMAIL_DEFAULTS.from,
  replyTo = EMAIL_DEFAULTS.replyTo,
  metadata = {},
}: SendSystemEmailParams<T>): Promise<SendEmailResult> {
  const recipientClean = to.trim().toLowerCase();

  try {
    const html = await renderEmailHtml(template, props);

    // Development / fallback if Resend client is uninitialized
    if (!resend) {
      console.warn(
        `[Email Dev Mock] RESEND_API_KEY not configured. Mocking email to ${recipientClean}: "${subject}"`
      );

      // Log mock send to database audit trail
      try {
        await db.insert(emailLogs).values({
          recipient: recipientClean,
          template,
          subject,
          status: 'MOCK_DEV',
          fromEmail: from,
          replyTo,
          metadataJson: { ...metadata, isMockDev: true },
          resendId: `mock_${Date.now()}`,
        });
      } catch (dbErr) {
        console.error('[Email Logger] Could not record mock email log:', dbErr);
      }

      return {
        ok: true,
        resendId: `mock_${Date.now()}`,
        isMockDev: true,
      };
    }

    // Live send via Resend SDK
    const { data, error } = await resend.emails.send({
      from,
      to: [recipientClean],
      replyTo,
      subject,
      html,
    });

    if (error) {
      console.error('[Resend Error]', error);

      // Record failed send to database
      try {
        await db.insert(emailLogs).values({
          recipient: recipientClean,
          template,
          subject,
          status: 'FAILED',
          fromEmail: from,
          replyTo,
          metadataJson: metadata,
          errorMessage: error.message || 'Unknown Resend dispatch error',
        });
      } catch (dbErr) {
        console.error('[Email Logger] Could not record failed email log:', dbErr);
      }

      return { ok: false, error: error.message };
    }

    const resendId = data?.id;

    // Record successful send
    try {
      await db.insert(emailLogs).values({
        recipient: recipientClean,
        template,
        subject,
        status: 'SENT',
        resendId,
        fromEmail: from,
        replyTo,
        metadataJson: metadata,
      });
    } catch (dbErr) {
      console.error('[Email Logger] Could not record success email log:', dbErr);
    }

    return { ok: true, resendId };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown exception';
    console.error(`[Email Dispatch Exception] Error sending to ${recipientClean}:`, err);

    try {
      await db.insert(emailLogs).values({
        recipient: recipientClean,
        template,
        subject,
        status: 'FAILED',
        fromEmail: from,
        replyTo,
        metadataJson: metadata,
        errorMessage: msg,
      });
    } catch {
      // Ignore secondary db logging error
    }

    return { ok: false, error: msg };
  }
}

export interface CountryRulePack {
  countryCode: SupportedCountryCode;
  countryName: string;
  defaultCurrency: SupportedCurrencyCode;
  taxName: string;
  standardTaxRatePercent: number;
  employerPayrollTaxName: string;
  employerPayrollTaxPercent: number;
  commonEntityTypes: string[];
}

export function getCountryRulePack(countryCode: string): CountryRulePack {
  const normalized = (countryCode?.toUpperCase() ||
    'IE') as SupportedCountryCode;
  const match =
    DEFAULT_COUNTRY_RULES.find((r) => r.countryCode === normalized) ??
    DEFAULT_COUNTRY_RULES[0];

  return {
    countryCode: match.countryCode,
    countryName: match.countryName,
    defaultCurrency: match.defaultCurrency,
    taxName: match.taxName,
    standardTaxRatePercent: parseFloat(match.standardTaxRatePercent),
    employerPayrollTaxName: match.employerPayrollTaxName,
    employerPayrollTaxPercent: parseFloat(match.employerPayrollTaxPercent),
    commonEntityTypes: match.commonEntityTypesJson,
  };
}

export function getGrantsForCountry(countryCode: string) {
  const normalized = countryCode?.toUpperCase() || 'IE';
  return DEFAULT_GRANTS_DIRECTORY.filter(
    (g) => g.countryCode === normalized && g.isActive
  );
}

export function formatPlanCurrency(
  amount: number,
  currencyCode: string = 'EUR',
  countryCode: string = 'IE'
): string {
  const localeMap: Record<string, string> = {
    IE: 'en-IE',
    GB: 'en-GB',
    US: 'en-US',
    AU: 'en-AU',
    CA: 'en-CA',
    EU: 'en-IE',
    ROW: 'en-US',
  };
  const locale = localeMap[countryCode] || 'en-IE';

  return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {
    style: 'currency',
    currency: currencyCode || 'EUR',
    maximumFractionDigits: 0,
  }).format(amount);
}

export type PlanFundingTrackMode = 'GRANT_AND_INVESTOR' | 'COMMERCIAL_ONLY';

export interface PlanTrackCapabilities {
  countryCode: SupportedCountryCode;
  countryName: string;
  countryFlag: string;
  isIreland: boolean;
  isUK: boolean;
  isGrantRegion: boolean;
  isGrantsEnabled: boolean;
  fundingTrackMode: PlanFundingTrackMode;
  registryAgencyLabel: string;
  taxAuthorityLabel: string;
  exampleBanksLabel: string;
  moduleKSidebarTitle: string;
  moduleKHeaderTitle: string;
}

export function getPlanTrackCapabilities(
  countryCode?: string | null,
  fundingTrackMode?: PlanFundingTrackMode | null
): PlanTrackCapabilities {
  const normalized = (countryCode?.toUpperCase() ||
    'IE') as SupportedCountryCode;
  const isIreland = normalized === 'IE';
  const isUK = normalized === 'GB';
  const isGrantRegion = isIreland || isUK;
  const effectiveTrack: PlanFundingTrackMode = isGrantRegion
    ? fundingTrackMode === 'COMMERCIAL_ONLY'
      ? 'COMMERCIAL_ONLY'
      : 'GRANT_AND_INVESTOR'
    : 'COMMERCIAL_ONLY';
  const isGrantsEnabled =
    isGrantRegion && effectiveTrack === 'GRANT_AND_INVESTOR';

  const flagMap: Record<SupportedCountryCode, string> = {
    IE: '🇮🇪',
    GB: '🇬🇧',
    US: '🇺🇸',
    CA: '🇨🇦',
    AU: '🇦🇺',
    EU: '🇪🇺',
    ROW: '🌍',
  };

  const registryMap: Record<SupportedCountryCode, string> = {
    IE: 'Companies Registration Office (CRO)',
    GB: 'Companies House (UK)',
    US: 'Secretary of State (LLC / C-Corp)',
    CA: 'Corporations Canada / Provincial Registry',
    AU: 'ASIC (Australian Securities & Investments Commission)',
    EU: 'National Commercial Register',
    ROW: 'Company Registration Authority',
  };

  const taxAuthorityMap: Record<SupportedCountryCode, string> = {
    IE: 'Revenue Commissioners (ROS)',
    GB: 'HM Revenue & Customs (HMRC)',
    US: 'IRS (EIN & Federal/State Tax)',
    CA: 'Canada Revenue Agency (CRA)',
    AU: 'Australian Taxation Office (ATO / ABN)',
    EU: 'National Tax & VAT Authority',
    ROW: 'National Tax Authority',
  };

  const bankExamplesMap: Record<SupportedCountryCode, string> = {
    IE: 'AIB, Bank of Ireland, Revolut Business',
    GB: 'Barclays, NatWest, Tide, Monzo Business, BBB Start Up Loans',
    US: 'Chase, Mercury, Silicon Valley Bank, SBA Lenders',
    CA: 'RBC, TD, BDC (Business Development Bank of Canada)',
    AU: 'CommBank, NAB, Westpac, ANZ',
    EU: 'Revolut Business, Qonto, N26, Local Commercial Banks',
    ROW: 'Commercial & Digital Business Banks',
  };

  const rulePack = getCountryRulePack(normalized);

  return {
    countryCode: rulePack.countryCode,
    countryName: rulePack.countryName,
    countryFlag: flagMap[rulePack.countryCode] || '🌍',
    isIreland,
    isUK,
    isGrantRegion,
    isGrantsEnabled,
    fundingTrackMode: effectiveTrack,
    registryAgencyLabel:
      registryMap[rulePack.countryCode] || 'Company Registration Authority',
    taxAuthorityLabel:
      taxAuthorityMap[rulePack.countryCode] || 'National Tax Authority',
    exampleBanksLabel:
      bankExamplesMap[rulePack.countryCode] || 'Commercial Business Banks',
    moduleKSidebarTitle: isGrantsEnabled
      ? 'Grants & Tax Relief'
      : 'Funding & Capital Strategy',
    moduleKHeaderTitle: isGrantsEnabled
      ? 'Non-Dilutive Grants, Loans & Investor Tax Relief Hub'
      : 'Capital Stack, Runway & Funding Readiness Hub',
  };
}
