=== src/lib/stripe/client.ts ===
import Stripe from 'stripe';

let _stripeInstance: Stripe | null = null;
let _cachedKey: string | null = null;

export const PLACEHOLDER_BUILD_KEY = 'sk_test_placeholder_key_for_build';

/**
 * Returns true if a genuine Stripe secret key is configured in the environment.
 */
export function isStripeConfigured(): boolean {
  const key = process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY?.trim();
  return Boolean(
    key &&
    key !== PLACEHOLDER_BUILD_KEY &&
    !key.includes('placeholder') &&
    (key.startsWith('sk_') || key.startsWith('rk_'))
  );
}

/**
 * Returns a configured Stripe instance.
 * If STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is omitted during Docker/Next.js static build evaluation,
 * a placeholder key is used to satisfy constructor validation without throwing.
 */
export function getStripe(strict = false): Stripe {
  const rawKey = process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY?.trim();
  const apiKey = rawKey || PLACEHOLDER_BUILD_KEY;

  if (strict && (!rawKey || rawKey === PLACEHOLDER_BUILD_KEY || rawKey.includes('placeholder'))) {
    throw new Error(
      'STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is not configured in this environment. Please ensure STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is added to your environment variables or Google Cloud Run configuration.'
    );
  }

  if (!_stripeInstance || _cachedKey !== apiKey) {
    _cachedKey = apiKey;
    _stripeInstance = new Stripe(apiKey, {
      apiVersion: '2025-02-24.acacia' as any,
      appInfo: {
        name: 'Startup Preflight Platform',
        version: '2.0.0',
        url: 'https://startuppreflight.com',
      },
    });
  }
  return _stripeInstance;
}

/**
 * Singleton proxy wrapper that lazily forwards all property and method calls
 * to the active Stripe client, ensuring environment variables are read dynamically
 * at runtime while preventing build-time instantiation crashes.
 */
export const stripe = new Proxy({} as Stripe, {
  get(_target, prop) {
    const isConfigured = isStripeConfigured();
    // Allow inspection/typeof checks without throwing
    if (prop === 'then' || prop === 'constructor' || typeof prop === 'symbol') {
      return undefined;
    }
    if (!isConfigured) {
      // In production/dev runtime, fail early with a clear descriptive message instead of sending dummy key to Stripe
      return new Proxy(() => {}, {
        get(_subTarget, _subProp) {
          return () => {
            throw new Error(
              'STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is not configured. Please add STRIPE_SECRET_KEY to your environment variables or Cloud Run service configuration.'
            );
          };
        },
        apply() {
          throw new Error(
            'STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is not configured. Please add STRIPE_SECRET_KEY to your environment variables or Cloud Run service configuration.'
          );
        },
      });
    }

    const instance = getStripe();
    const value = (instance as any)[prop];
    return typeof value === 'function' ? value.bind(instance) : value;
  },
});

async function seed() {
  console.log('🌱 Starting Startup Preflight 2.0 Database Seed...');

  // 1. Seed Default Global Tenant + Sample University Tenant
  const [defaultTenant] = await db
    .insert(tenants)
    .values({
      name: 'Startup Preflight Global',
      slug: 'default',
      brandingJson: {
        primaryColor: '#4f46e5',
        accentColor: '#f59e0b',
      },
    })
    .onConflictDoUpdate({
      target: tenants.slug,
      set: { name: 'Startup Preflight Global' },
    })
    .returning();

  const [ucdTenant] = await db
    .insert(tenants)
    .values({
      name: 'UCD Nova Innovation Hub',
      slug: 'ucd-nova',
      customDomain: 'nova.startuppreflight.com',
      brandingJson: {
        primaryColor: '#003366',
        accentColor: '#eab308',
      },
    })
    .onConflictDoUpdate({
      target: tenants.slug,
      set: { name: 'UCD Nova Innovation Hub' },
    })
    .returning();

  // 2. Seed Sample Cohort
  await db
    .insert(cohorts)
    .values({
      tenantId: ucdTenant.id,
      name: 'Spring 2027 Accelerator Batch',
      inviteCode: 'SPF-UCD-2027',
      maxSeats: 50,
      seatsUsed: 1,
      accessDurationMonths: 6,
    })
    .onConflictDoNothing();

  // 3. Seed Country Rules
  for (const rule of DEFAULT_COUNTRY_RULES) {
    await db
      .insert(countryRules)
      .values(rule)
      .onConflictDoUpdate({
        target: countryRules.countryCode,
        set: {
          countryName: rule.countryName,
          defaultCurrency: rule.defaultCurrency,
          taxName: rule.taxName,
          standardTaxRatePercent: rule.standardTaxRatePercent,
          employerPayrollTaxName: rule.employerPayrollTaxName,
          employerPayrollTaxPercent: rule.employerPayrollTaxPercent,
          commonEntityTypesJson: rule.commonEntityTypesJson,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        },
      });
  }

  // 4. Seed Grants Directory (if empty)
  const existingGrants = await db.select().from(grantsDirectory);
  if (existingGrants.length === 0) {
    await db.insert(grantsDirectory).values(DEFAULT_GRANTS_DIRECTORY);
  }

  // 5. Seed Default AI Prompts
  for (const prompt of DEFAULT_AI_PROMPTS) {
    await db
      .insert(aiPrompts)
      .values(prompt)
      .onConflictDoUpdate({
        target: aiPrompts.promptKey,
        set: {
          systemInstruction: prompt.systemInstruction,
          modelName: prompt.modelName,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        },
      });
  }

  // 6. Optional Sample Users (disabled to keep live database clean)
  // Seed sample users only if explicit flag ENABLE_DEMO_SEED_USERS is set
  if (process.env.ENABLE_DEMO_SEED_USERS === 'true') {
    const [freeFounder] = await db
      .insert(users)
      .values({
        tenantId: defaultTenant.id,
        email: 'founder@startuppreflight.com',
        name: 'Aoife Brennan (Free Tier)',
        emailVerified: true,
        role: 'FOUNDER',
        status: 'ACTIVE',
      })
      .onConflictDoUpdate({
        target: users.email,
        set: { name: 'Aoife Brennan (Free Tier)' },
      })
      .returning();

    await db
      .insert(userEntitlements)
      .values({
        userId: freeFounder.id,
        planType: 'FREE_HOOK',
        stackedCodesCount: 0,
        maxStartupPlans: 1,
        maxSeatsPerPlan: 1,
        monthlyAiCreditsLimit: 50,
        aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: 12,
        isVaultReadonly: false,
      })
      .onConflictDoNothing();

    const [sumoFounder] = await db
      .insert(users)
      .values({
        tenantId: defaultTenant.id,
        email: 'appsumo@startuppreflight.com',
        name: 'Liam O’Connor (AppSumo Tier 2)',
        emailVerified: true,
        role: 'FOUNDER',
        status: 'ACTIVE',
      })
      .onConflictDoUpdate({
        target: users.email,
        set: { name: 'Liam O’Connor (AppSumo Tier 2)' },
      })
      .returning();

    await db
      .insert(userEntitlements)
      .values({
        userId: sumoFounder.id,
        planType: 'APPSUMO_LTD',
        stackedCodesCount: 2,
        maxStartupPlans: 3,
        maxSeatsPerPlan: 3,
        monthlyAiCreditsLimit: 450,
        aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: 45,
        isVaultReadonly: false,
      })
      .onConflictDoNothing();

    const [superAdmin] = await db
      .insert(users)
      .values({
        tenantId: defaultTenant.id,
        email: 'admin@startuppreflight.com',
        name: 'Startup Preflight Super Admin',
        emailVerified: true,
        role: 'SUPER_ADMIN',
        status: 'ACTIVE',
      })
      .onConflictDoUpdate({
        target: users.email,
        set: { role: 'SUPER_ADMIN' },
      })
      .returning();

    await db
      .insert(userEntitlements)
      .values({
        userId: superAdmin.id,
        planType: 'APPSUMO_LTD',
        stackedCodesCount: 5,
        maxStartupPlans: 10,
        maxSeatsPerPlan: 5,
        monthlyAiCreditsLimit: 5000,
        aiCreditsUsedThisMonth: 0,
        whiteLabelExportEnabled: true,
        isVaultReadonly: false,
      })
      .onConflictDoNothing();
    // Seed Default Startup Plans if none exist for Aoife
    const existingPlans = await db
      .select()
      .from(startupPlans)
      .where(eq(startupPlans.ownerUserId, freeFounder.id));

    if (existingPlans.length === 0) {
      await db.insert(startupPlans).values({
        ownerUserId: freeFounder.id,
        tenantId: defaultTenant.id,
        title: 'GreenCart AI — Zero-Waste Grocery Supply Chain',
        oneLinerSummary:
          'Automated expiry prediction & dynamic markdowns for independent supermarkets in Ireland & the UK.',
        industryCategory: 'B2B SaaS / RetailTech',
        hqCountryCode: 'IE',
        baseCurrency: 'EUR',
        targetMarketsArray: ['IE', 'GB'],
        currentModuleStep: 'MOD_A_STEP_4',
        ideaComparatorScoresJson: {
          easeOfLaunch: 7,
          founderFit: 9,
          timeToRevenue: 8,
          capitalRequired: 6,
        },
        status: 'ACTIVE',
      });
    }
  }

  // 7. Seed Unclaimed AppSumo Vouchers for Testing /redeem & Code Stacking

  console.log('✅ Startup Preflight 2.0 Database Seed completed successfully!');
  await pool.end();
}

if (require.main === module) {
  seed().catch((err) => {
    console.error('❌ Seed failed:', err);
    process.exit(1);
  });
}

    rfpId: uuid('rfp_id')
      .references(() => quoteRfpRequests.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' })
      .notNull(),
    partnerId: uuid('partner_id')
      .references(() => partnerOffers.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' })
      .notNull(),
    magicToken: text('magic_token').notNull().unique(), // Secure nanoid/uuid token for /quotes/submit/[token]
    tokenExpiresAt: timestamp('token_expires_at').notNull(),
    status: quoteResponseStatusEnum('status').default('SENT').notNull(),
    quoteAmountNet: numeric('quote_amount_net', { precision: 12, scale: 2 }),
    quoteCurrency: text('quote_currency').default('EUR').notNull(),
    estimatedWeeks: integer('estimated_weeks'),
    quoteFileUrl: text('quote_file_url'), // S3 / Blob / Data URL to the uploaded quote PDF
    quoteFileName: text('quote_file_name'),
    quoteNotes: text('quote_notes'), // Notes or itemization from agency
    openedAt: timestamp('opened_at'),
    submittedAt: timestamp('submitted_at'),
    createdAt: timestamp('created_at').defaultNow().notNull(),
  },
  (table) => ({
    magicTokenIdx: uniqueIndex('quote_responses_magic_token_idx').on(table.magicToken),
  })
);

  metadataJson: jsonb('metadata_json').$type<Record<string, unknown>>().default({}),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at').defaultNow().notNull(),
  updatedAt: timestamp('updated_at').defaultNow().notNull(),
});

import { drizzle } from 'drizzle-orm/node-postgres';
import { Pool } from 'pg';
import * as schema from './schema';

const connectionString =
  process.env.DATABASE_URL ||
  'postgresql://bmu_user:bmu_local_password@localhost:5432/bmu_dev';

const DB_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT_MS =
  process.env.DB_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT_MS
    ? parseInt(process.env.DB_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT_MS, 10)
    : 10_000;
const DB_OFFLINE_COOLDOWN_MS = 15_000;
const POOL_CONFIG_VERSION = 4;

const globalForDb = globalThis as unknown as {
  pool: Pool | undefined;
  poolVersion: number | undefined;
  schemaSyncedPromise: Promise<void> | undefined;
  lastConnectionFailureAt: number | undefined;
};

function isConnectionLevelError(err: unknown): boolean {
  if (!err || typeof err !== 'object') return false;
  const msg =
    'message' in err && typeof (err as { message?: unknown }).message === 'string'
      ? (err as { message: string }).message.toLowerCase()
      : '';
  const code =
    'code' in err && typeof (err as { code?: unknown }).code === 'string'
      ? (err as { code: string }).code.toUpperCase()
      : '';
  return (
    code === 'ETIMEDOUT' ||
    code === 'ECONNREFUSED' ||
    code === 'EHOSTUNREACH' ||
    code === 'ENETUNREACH' ||
    code === 'ENOTFOUND' ||
    msg.includes('timeout expired') ||
    msg.includes('connection terminated') ||
    msg.includes('connect etimedout') ||
    msg.includes('connect econnrefused') ||
    msg.includes('offline circuit breaker')
  );
}

function createConfiguredPool(): Pool {
  const rawPool = new Pool({
    connectionString,
    max: 10,
    connectionTimeoutMillis: DB_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT_MS,
    idleTimeoutMillis: 10_000,
    keepAlive: true,
    keepAliveInitialDelayMillis: 10_000,
  });

  // Prevent unhandled pool error events from crashing the Node process when offline/hotspotting
  rawPool.on('error', (err) => {
    if (isConnectionLevelError(err)) {
      globalForDb.lastConnectionFailureAt = Date.now();
    }
  });

  const origConnect = rawPool.connect.bind(rawPool);
  const origQuery = rawPool.query.bind(rawPool);

  // Wrap connect & query with a 15-second offline circuit breaker so when Cloud SQL is
  // unreachable (e.g. mobile hotspot IP not in GCP Authorized Networks), subsequent queries
  // fail in 0ms instead of queuing multiple 2.5s–75s TCP timeouts.
  rawPool.connect = (async (...args: Parameters<typeof origConnect>) => {
    const lastFail = globalForDb.lastConnectionFailureAt;
    if (lastFail && Date.now() - lastFail < DB_OFFLINE_COOLDOWN_MS) {
      throw new Error(
        '[SPF DB Offline Circuit Breaker] PostgreSQL unreachable (cooldown active).'
      );
    }
    try {
      const result = await (origConnect as (...a: unknown[]) => Promise<unknown>)(
        ...args
      );
      globalForDb.lastConnectionFailureAt = undefined;
      return result;
    } catch (err) {
      if (isConnectionLevelError(err)) {
        globalForDb.lastConnectionFailureAt = Date.now();
      }
      throw err;
    }
  }) as typeof rawPool.connect;

  rawPool.query = (async (...args: Parameters<typeof origQuery>) => {
    const lastFail = globalForDb.lastConnectionFailureAt;
    if (lastFail && Date.now() - lastFail < DB_OFFLINE_COOLDOWN_MS) {
      throw new Error(
        '[SPF DB Offline Circuit Breaker] PostgreSQL unreachable (cooldown active).'
      );
    }
    try {
      const result = await (origQuery as (...a: unknown[]) => Promise<unknown>)(
        ...args
      );
      globalForDb.lastConnectionFailureAt = undefined;
      return result;
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const errMsg =
        err && typeof err === 'object' && 'message' in err && typeof (err as { message?: unknown }).message === 'string'
          ? (err as { message: string }).message.toLowerCase()
          : '';

      // If an idle connection in the pool was terminated by Cloud SQL / proxy while sitting idle,
      // retry once with a freshly negotiated socket instead of failing the request.
      if (errMsg.includes('connection terminated unexpectedly')) {
        try {
          const retryResult = await (origQuery as (...a: unknown[]) => Promise<unknown>)(
            ...args
          );
          globalForDb.lastConnectionFailureAt = undefined;
          return retryResult;
        } catch (retryErr) {
          if (isConnectionLevelError(retryErr)) {
            globalForDb.lastConnectionFailureAt = Date.now();
          }
          throw retryErr;
        }
      }

      if (isConnectionLevelError(err)) {
        globalForDb.lastConnectionFailureAt = Date.now();
      }
      throw err;
    }
  }) as typeof rawPool.query;

  return rawPool;
}

if (
  globalForDb.pool &&
  globalForDb.poolVersion !== POOL_CONFIG_VERSION
) {
  globalForDb.pool.end().catch(() => {});
  globalForDb.pool = undefined;
  globalForDb.schemaSyncedPromise = undefined;
}

export const pool = globalForDb.pool ?? createConfiguredPool();

if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') {
  globalForDb.pool = pool;
  globalForDb.poolVersion = POOL_CONFIG_VERSION;
}

export const db = drizzle(pool, { schema });
